	public static class PageViewStrategyRegistrator
	{
		public static void Register()
		{
			StrategyManager.Default.RegisterStrategy<PageView, SelectorStrategy<PageView, PageViewWrapper>>();
		}
	}
	public class PageViewWrapper : ISelectorWrapper<PageView>, IItemsControlWrapper<PageView>, ITargetWrapper<PageView>
	{
		public PageView Target { get; set; }

		public object ItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return Target.ItemsSource;
			}
			set
			{
				Target.ItemsSource = (IEnumerable)value;
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate ItemTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return Target.ContentTemplate;
			}
			set
			{
				Target.ContentTemplate = value;
			}
		}

		public DataTemplateSelector ItemTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return Target.ContentTemplateSelector;
			}
			set
			{
				Target.ContentTemplateSelector = value;
			}
		}

		public object SelectedItem
		{
			get
			{
				return Target.SelectedItem;
			}
			set
			{
				Target.SelectedItem = value;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler SelectionChanged
		{
			add
			{
				Target.SelectionChanged += value.Invoke;
			}
			remove
			{
				Target.SelectionChanged -= value.Invoke;
			}
		}
	}

		private class ThemeChangedEventManager : WeakEventManager
		{
			protected override void StartListening(object source)
			{
				if (source is DependencyObject)
				{
					CommonThemeHelper.AddThemeChangedHandler((DependencyObject)source, (RoutedEventHandler)base.DeliverEvent);
				}
			}

			protected override void StopListening(object source)
			{
				if (source is DependencyObject)
				{
					CommonThemeHelper.RemoveThemeChangedHandler((DependencyObject)source, (RoutedEventHandler)base.DeliverEvent);
				}
			}

			protected static ThemeChangedEventManager GetManager()
			{
				Type typeFromHandle = typeof(ThemeChangedEventManager);
				ThemeChangedEventManager themeChangedEventManager = (ThemeChangedEventManager)WeakEventManager.GetCurrentManager(typeFromHandle);
				if (themeChangedEventManager == null)
				{
					themeChangedEventManager = new ThemeChangedEventManager();
					WeakEventManager.SetCurrentManager(typeFromHandle, themeChangedEventManager);
				}
				return themeChangedEventManager;
			}

			public static void AddListener(UIElement source, IWeakEventListener listener)
			{
				GetManager().ProtectedAddListener(source, listener);
			}

			public static void RemoveListener(UIElement source, IWeakEventListener listener)
			{
				GetManager().ProtectedRemoveListener(source, listener);
			}
		}

		private class UIEventService : DependencyObject
		{
			private readonly List<AppBar> listeners = new List<AppBar>();

			private readonly int SwipeGestureBottom = 18;

			private readonly int SwipeGestureThreshold = 18;

			private readonly int SwipeGestureTop = 3;

			private readonly Locker systemGestureLocker = new Locker();

			private bool isBottom;

			private bool isInTouch;

			private bool isTop;

			private bool isRootPressed;

			private UIElement Owner;

			private WeakReference rootRef;

			private TouchPoint touchStart;

			private static readonly Dictionary<UIElement, UIEventService> ownerMap = new Dictionary<UIElement, UIEventService>();

			public bool HasListeners => listeners.Count > 0;

			public UIEventService(UIElement owner)
			{
				//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002d: Expected O, but got Unknown
				Owner = owner;
				if (LayoutHelper.FindRoot((DependencyObject)owner, false) is UIElement uIElement)
				{
					rootRef = new WeakReference(uIElement);
					uIElement.KeyDown += OnRootKeyDown;
					uIElement.MouseLeftButtonUp += OnMouseLeftButtonUp;
					uIElement.MouseLeftButtonDown += OnMouseLeftButtonDown;
					uIElement.LostMouseCapture += OnLostMouseCapture;
					uIElement.StylusSystemGesture += OnStylusSystemGesture;
					uIElement.PreviewTouchUp += OnRootPreviewTouchUp;
					if (uIElement is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
					{
						frameworkElement.AddHandler(FrameworkElement.ContextMenuOpeningEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnContextMenuOpening), handledEventsToo: true);
					}
					Touch.FrameReported += OnTouchFrameReported;
				}
			}

			public void AddListener(AppBar listener)
			{
				if (!listeners.Contains(listener))
				{
					listeners.Add(listener);
				}
			}

			public void RemoveListener(AppBar listener)
			{
				listeners.Remove(listener);
			}

			public void Unsubscribe()
			{
				if (rootRef != null && rootRef.Target is UIElement uIElement)
				{
					uIElement.KeyDown -= OnRootKeyDown;
					uIElement.MouseLeftButtonUp -= OnMouseLeftButtonUp;
					uIElement.MouseLeftButtonDown -= OnMouseLeftButtonDown;
					uIElement.LostMouseCapture -= OnLostMouseCapture;
					uIElement.StylusSystemGesture -= OnStylusSystemGesture;
					uIElement.PreviewTouchUp -= OnRootPreviewTouchUp;
					if (uIElement is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
					{
						frameworkElement.RemoveHandler(FrameworkElement.ContextMenuOpeningEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnContextMenuOpening));
					}
					Touch.FrameReported -= OnTouchFrameReported;
					rootRef = null;
				}
			}

			private void NotifyAffectedControls()
			{
				if (!HasListeners)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (AppBar listener in listeners)
				{
					listener.ToggleIsOpen();
				}
			}

			private void OnContextMenuOpening(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				systemGestureLocker.Unlock();
				if (!e.Handled)
				{
					NotifyAffectedControls();
				}
			}

			private void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				if (!isInTouch && isRootPressed)
				{
					listeners.ForEach(delegate(AppBar x)
					{
						x.Dismiss(sender, e);
					});
				}
				isRootPressed = false;
				isInTouch = false;
			}

			private void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				isRootPressed = true;
			}

			private void OnLostMouseCapture(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				isRootPressed = false;
			}

			private void OnRootKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
				{
					listeners.ForEach(delegate(AppBar x)
					{
						x.Dismiss(sender, e);
					});
				}
			}

			private void OnRootPreviewTouchUp(object sender, TouchEventArgs e)
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					if (Locker.op_Implicit(systemGestureLocker))
					{
						NotifyAffectedControls();
					}
					systemGestureLocker.Unlock();
				});
			}

			private void OnStylusSystemGesture(object sender, StylusSystemGestureEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.SystemGesture == SystemGesture.HoldEnter)
				{
					systemGestureLocker.Lock();
				}
			}

			private void OnTouchFrameReported(object sender, TouchFrameEventArgs e)
			{
				Action<TouchFrameEventArgs> action = OnTouchFrameReportedCore;
				if (CheckAccess())
				{
					action(e);
					return;
				}
				base.Dispatcher.Invoke(action, e);
			}

			private void OnTouchFrameReportedCore(TouchFrameEventArgs e)
			{
				TouchPoint primaryTouchPoint = e.GetPrimaryTouchPoint(Owner);
				if (primaryTouchPoint == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				switch (primaryTouchPoint.Action)
				{
				case TouchAction.Down:
				{
					TouchPoint touchPoint2 = primaryTouchPoint;
					isTop = (isBottom = false);
					touchStart = null;
					if (touchPoint2.Position.Y > 0.0 && touchPoint2.Position.Y < (double)SwipeGestureBottom)
					{
						touchStart = touchPoint2;
						isTop = true;
						e.SuspendMousePromotionUntilTouchUp();
					}
					if (touchPoint2.Position.Y > Owner.RenderSize.Height - (double)SwipeGestureBottom && touchPoint2.Position.Y < Owner.RenderSize.Height - (double)SwipeGestureTop)
					{
						touchStart = touchPoint2;
						isBottom = true;
						e.SuspendMousePromotionUntilTouchUp();
					}
					break;
				}
				case TouchAction.Move:
				{
					if ((!isTop && !isBottom) || !HasListeners)
					{
						break;
					}
					TouchPoint touchPoint = primaryTouchPoint;
					if (isTop && touchStart != null && touchPoint.Position.Y > touchStart.Position.Y + (double)SwipeGestureThreshold)
					{
						listeners.ForEach(delegate(AppBar x)
						{
							x.ToggleIsOpen();
						});
						isTop = false;
						isInTouch = true;
					}
					if (isBottom && touchStart != null && touchPoint.Position.Y < touchStart.Position.Y - (double)SwipeGestureThreshold)
					{
						listeners.ForEach(delegate(AppBar x)
						{
							x.ToggleIsOpen();
						});
						isBottom = false;
						isInTouch = true;
					}
					break;
				}
				case TouchAction.Up:
					break;
				}
			}

			public static void Subscribe(AppBar listener, UIElement owner)
			{
				if (owner != null)
				{
					if (!ownerMap.TryGetValue(owner, out var value))
					{
						value = new UIEventService(owner);
						ownerMap[owner] = value;
					}
					value.AddListener(listener);
				}
			}

			public static void Unsubscribe(AppBar listener, UIElement owner)
			{
				if (owner != null && ownerMap.TryGetValue(owner, out var value))
				{
					value.RemoveListener(listener);
					if (!value.HasListeners)
					{
						value.Unsubscribe();
						ownerMap.Remove(owner);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsHorizontal
		{
			get
			{
				if (Alignment != AppBarAlignment.Top)
				{
					return Alignment == AppBarAlignment.Bottom;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal AppBarBackButton PartBackButton { get; set; }

		internal AppBarExitButton PartExitButton { get; set; }

		private bool IsFar
		{
			get
			{
				if (Alignment != AppBarAlignment.Bottom)
				{
					return Alignment == AppBarAlignment.Right;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public AppBar()
		{
			ThemeChangedEventManager.AddListener(this, this);
		}

		static AppBar()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<AppBar>();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AppBar>.New().Register<bool>("IsOpen", ref IsOpenProperty, false, (Action<AppBar, bool, bool>)delegate(AppBar d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
			{
				d.OnIsOpenChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (Func<AppBar, bool, bool>)((AppBar d, bool value) => d.CoerceIsOpen(value)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<bool>("IsCompact", ref IsCompactProperty, false, (Action<AppBar, bool, bool>)delegate(AppBar d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
			{
				d.OnIsCompactChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<AppBarAlignment>("Alignment", ref AlignmentProperty, AppBarAlignment.Bottom, (Action<AppBar, AppBarAlignment, AppBarAlignment>)delegate(AppBar d, AppBarAlignment oldValue, AppBarAlignment newValue)
				{
					d.OnAlignmentChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("ItemSpacing", ref ItemSpacingProperty, 0.0, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("IsBackButtonEnabled", ref IsBackButtonEnabledProperty, false, (Action<AppBar, bool, bool>)delegate(AppBar d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
				{
					d.OnIsBackButtonEnabledChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("IsExitButtonEnabled", ref IsExitButtonEnabledProperty, false, (Action<AppBar, bool, bool>)delegate(AppBar d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
				{
					d.OnIsExitButtonEnabledChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<ICommand>("BackCommand", ref BackCommandProperty, (ICommand)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<ICommand>("ExitCommand", ref ExitCommandProperty, (ICommand)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<AppBarHideMode>("HideMode", ref HideModeProperty, AppBarHideMode.Default, (Action<AppBar, AppBarHideMode, AppBarHideMode>)delegate(AppBar d, AppBarHideMode oldValue, AppBarHideMode newValue)
				{
					d.OnHideModeChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("IsSticky", ref IsStickyProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("IsAnimationEnabled", ref IsAnimationEnabledProperty, true, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.OverrideMetadata(FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty, (object)VerticalAlignment.Bottom, (Action<AppBar>)null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None);
		}

		internal void Invalidate()
		{
			LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualChildren((DependencyObject)this).OfType<AnimatedPanel>().FirstOrDefault()?.InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnThemeChanged()
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected override void ClearTemplateChildren()
		{
			PartAnimatedPanel.Do(delegate(AnimatedPanel x)
			{
				x.DetachFromVisualTree(this);
			});
			base.ClearTemplateChildren();
		}

		protected virtual bool CoerceIsOpen(bool value)
		{
			if (HideMode == AppBarHideMode.AlwaysVisible && !value)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (value)
			{
				if (this.Opening != null)
				{
					AppBarEventArgs e = new AppBarEventArgs();
					this.Opening(this, e);
					if (e.Cancel)
					{
						return !value;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (this.Closing != null)
			{
				AppBarEventArgs e2 = new AppBarEventArgs();
				this.Closing(this, e2);
				if (e2.Cancel)
				{
					return !value;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected override void EnsureItemsPanelCore(Panel itemsPanel)
		{
			base.EnsureItemsPanelCore(itemsPanel);
			UpdateParts();
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new AppBarContentPresenter();
		}

		protected override void GetTemplateChildren()
		{
			base.GetTemplateChildren();
			ref FlyoutControl partFlyoutControl = ref PartFlyoutControl;
			DependencyObject templateChild = GetTemplateChild("PART_Flyout");
			partFlyoutControl = (FlyoutControl)(object)((templateChild is FlyoutControl) ? templateChild : null);
			PartBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_Border") as Border;
			PartExitButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_ExitButton") as AppBarExitButton;
			PartBackButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_BackButton") as AppBarBackButton;
		}

		protected override void OnApplyTemplateComplete()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplateComplete();
			if (PartFlyoutControl != null)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)PartFlyoutControl).StaysOpen = true;
				((FlyoutBase)PartFlyoutControl).AlwaysOnTop = true;
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new AppBarAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ThemeChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(this, this);
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsCompactChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is IAppBarElement appBarElement)
				{
					appBarElement.IsCompact = newValue;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsOpenChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != newValue)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded && newValue)
				{
					shiftParameter = 1.0;
				}
				if (newValue)
				{
					OnOpen();
				}
				else
				{
					OnHide();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			UIElement uIElement = (LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject((DependencyObject)this, typeof(NavigationPage), false, (DependencyObject)null) as UIElement) ?? (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this) as UIElement);
			UIEventService.Subscribe(this, uIElement);
			parentRef = new WeakReference(uIElement);
			CompositionTarget.Rendering -= CompositionTarget_Rendering;
			CompositionTarget.Rendering += CompositionTarget_Rendering;
		}

		protected override void OnUnloaded()
		{
			CompositionTarget.Rendering -= CompositionTarget_Rendering;
			if (parentRef != null)
			{
				UIElement owner = parentRef.Target as UIElement;
				UIEventService.Unsubscribe(this, owner);
				parentRef = null;
			}
			base.OnUnloaded();
		}

		private void CompositionTarget_Rendering(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (LayoutHelper.FindElementByType((FrameworkElement)this, typeof(AnimatedPanel), (Func<FrameworkElement, bool>)null) is AnimatedPanel animatedPanel)
			{
				animatedPanel.CompositionTarget_Rendering(this, e);
			}
			if (direction == SlideDirection.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			Func<double, double> func = (double t) => Math.Sin(t * Math.PI * 0.5);
			double num = (IsAnimationEnabled ? 0.04 : 1.0);
			if (direction == SlideDirection.Opening)
			{
				shiftParameter += num;
			}
			else
			{
				shiftParameter -= num;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (IsOpen && shiftParameter >= 1.0)
			{
				shiftParameter = 1.0;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!IsOpen && shiftParameter <= 0.0)
			{
				shiftParameter = 0.0;
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (PartBorder != null)
			{
				double arg = func(shiftParameter);
				if (IsHorizontal)
				{
					Func<double, double> func2 = ((!IsFar) ? ((Func<double, double>)((double t) => PartBorder.ActualHeight * (-1.0 + t))) : ((Func<double, double>)((double t) => PartBorder.ActualHeight * (1.0 - t))));
					double y = func2(arg);
					PartBorder.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform
					{
						X = 0.0,
						Y = y
					};
				}
				else
				{
					Func<double, double> func2 = ((!IsFar) ? ((Func<double, double>)((double t) => PartBorder.ActualWidth * (-1.0 + t))) : ((Func<double, double>)((double t) => PartBorder.ActualWidth * (1.0 - t))));
					double x = func2(arg);
					PartBorder.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform
					{
						X = x,
						Y = 0.0
					};
				}
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				direction = SlideDirection.None;
				if (this.Closed != null)
				{
					this.Closed(this, new EventArgs());
				}
				base.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				direction = SlideDirection.None;
				if (this.Opened != null)
				{
					this.Opened(this, new EventArgs());
				}
			}
		}

		private void Dismiss(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (HideMode != AppBarHideMode.Default || IsSticky)
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject;
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				Visual visual = dependencyObject as Visual;
				if (visual == null)
				{
					dependencyObject = LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject(dependencyObject, typeof(Visual), true, (DependencyObject)null);
				}
			}
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				AppBar appBar = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<AppBar>(dependencyObject);
				if (appBar == null && FlyoutBase.GetFlyout(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject) == null)
				{
					IsOpen = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private void Dismiss(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Escape && (HideMode == AppBarHideMode.Default || HideMode == AppBarHideMode.Sticky))
			{
				IsOpen = false;
			}
		}

		private void OnAlignmentChanged(AppBarAlignment oldValue, AppBarAlignment newValue)
		{
			if (IsHorizontal)
			{
				if (!DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)this, FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty))
				{
					SetCurrentValue(FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty, IsFar ? VerticalAlignment.Bottom : VerticalAlignment.Top);
				}
				if (!DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)this, FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty))
				{
					SetCurrentValue(FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty, HorizontalAlignment.Stretch);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)this, FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty))
				{
					SetCurrentValue(FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty, IsFar ? HorizontalAlignment.Right : HorizontalAlignment.Left);
				}
				if (!DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)this, FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty))
				{
					SetCurrentValue(FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty, VerticalAlignment.Stretch);
				}
			}
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is IAppBarElement appBarElement)
				{
					appBarElement.IsHorizontal = IsHorizontal;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnHide()
		{
			direction = SlideDirection.Closing;
		}

		private void OnHideModeChanged(AppBarHideMode oldValue, AppBarHideMode newValue)
		{
			if (newValue == AppBarHideMode.AlwaysVisible)
			{
				IsOpen = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnIsBackButtonEnabledChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (PartBackButton != null)
			{
				if (newValue && PartBackButton.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed && NavigationHelper.CanGoBack(this))
				{
					PartBackButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				else
				{
					PartBackButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnIsExitButtonEnabledChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (PartExitButton != null)
			{
				PartExitButton.Visibility = ((!newValue) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		private void OnOpen()
		{
			base.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			direction = SlideDirection.Opening;
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(ThemeChangedEventManager))
			{
				OnThemeChanged();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ToggleIsOpen()
		{
			if (HideMode == AppBarHideMode.Default || HideMode == AppBarHideMode.Sticky)
			{
				IsOpen = !IsOpen;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateParts()
		{
			if (GetTemplateChild("PART_BackButton") is AppBarButton appBarButton)
			{
				appBarButton.Visibility = ((!IsBackButtonEnabled || !NavigationHelper.CanGoBack(this)) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
			if (GetTemplateChild("PART_ExitButton") is AppBarButton appBarButton2)
			{
				appBarButton2.Visibility = ((!IsExitButtonEnabled) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
			PartAnimatedPanel.Do(delegate(AnimatedPanel x)
			{
				x.EffectsLayer = GetTemplateChild("PART_EffectsLayer") as Panel;
				x.AttachToVisualTree(this);
			});
		}
	}

	internal class ControlInfo : DependencyObject
	{
		public int Frames;

		public double? Opacity;

		public double TargetX;

		public double TargetY;

		private bool fadingIn;

		private bool fadingOut;

		private int StabilizationThreshold = 2;

		public bool AllowOpacityChange { get; set; }

		public bool FadingIn
		{
			get
			{
				return fadingIn;
			}
			set
			{
				fadingIn = value;
				if (value)
				{
					fadingOut = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool FadingOut
		{
			get
			{
				return fadingOut;
			}
			set
			{
				fadingOut = value;
				if (value)
				{
					fadingIn = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsNew => Frames <= StabilizationThreshold;

		public bool Stabilized => Frames == StabilizationThreshold;
	}

	public abstract class AppBarButtonBase : CommandButton, IFlyoutEventListener
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty FlyoutProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty HasFlyoutProperty;

		private readonly Locker IgnoreMouseEvents = new Locker();

		private readonly List<object> logicalChildren = new List<object>();

		private bool IgnoreNextClick;

		private ShapeContentPresenter PartPresenter;

		public FlyoutBase Flyout
		{
			get
			{
				return (FlyoutBase)GetValue(FlyoutProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(FlyoutProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasFlyout => (bool)GetValue(HasFlyoutProperty);

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren => (IEnumerator)new MergedEnumerator(new IEnumerator[2]
		{
			base.LogicalChildren,
			logicalChildren.GetEnumerator()
		});

		protected virtual bool ShowFlyoutOnClick => true;

		FlyoutBase IFlyoutEventListener.Flyout
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		protected AppBarButtonBase()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
		}

		static AppBarButtonBase()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AppBarButtonBase>.New().OverrideMetadata<HorizontalAlignment>(FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty, HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, (Action<AppBarButtonBase, HorizontalAlignment, HorizontalAlignment>)delegate(AppBarButtonBase d, HorizontalAlignment oldValue, HorizontalAlignment newValue)
			{
				d.OnHorizontalOrVerticalAlignmentChanged();
			}, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None).OverrideMetadata<VerticalAlignment>(FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty, VerticalAlignment.Stretch, (Action<AppBarButtonBase, VerticalAlignment, VerticalAlignment>)delegate(AppBarButtonBase d, VerticalAlignment oldValue, VerticalAlignment newValue)
			{
				d.OnHorizontalOrVerticalAlignmentChanged();
			}, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None)
				.Register<FlyoutBase>("Flyout", ref FlyoutProperty, (FlyoutBase)null, (Action<AppBarButtonBase, FlyoutBase, FlyoutBase>)delegate(AppBarButtonBase d, FlyoutBase oldValue, FlyoutBase newValue)
				{
					d.OnFlyoutChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("HasFlyout", ref HasFlyoutProperty, false, (Action<AppBarButtonBase, bool, bool>)delegate(AppBarButtonBase d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
				{
					d.OnHasFlyoutChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			if (PartPresenter != null)
			{
				PartPresenter.ClearValue(ShapeContentPresenter.AllowAccentProperty);
			}
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateFlyoutVisualState();
			PartPresenter = LayoutTreeHelper.GetTemplateChild<ShapeContentPresenter, AppBarButtonBase>(this);
			if (PartPresenter != null)
			{
				PartPresenter.SetBinding(ShapeContentPresenter.AllowAccentProperty, new Binding("AllowGlyphTheming")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			}
		}

		protected void InvalidateAppBar()
		{
			LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<AppBar>((DependencyObject)this)?.Invalidate();
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			base.OnClick();
			if (ShowFlyoutOnClick && !IgnoreMouseEvents.IsLocked && !IgnoreNextClick)
			{
				ProcessFlyoutClick();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnFlyoutChanged(FlyoutBase oldValue, FlyoutBase newValue)
		{
			SetValue(HasFlyoutProperty, newValue != null);
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(oldValue);
				logicalChildren.Remove(oldValue);
				oldValue.Opened -= OnFlyoutOpened;
				oldValue.Closed -= OnFlyoutClosed;
				oldValue.Listener = null;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				AddLogicalChild(newValue);
				logicalChildren.Add(newValue);
				newValue.Opened += OnFlyoutOpened;
				newValue.Closed += OnFlyoutClosed;
				newValue.Listener = this;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnHasFlyoutChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			UpdateFlyoutVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded()
		{
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				e.Handled = IgnoreMouseEvents.IsLocked;
			}
			IgnoreNextClick = IgnoreMouseEvents.IsLocked;
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				e.Handled = IgnoreMouseEvents.IsLocked;
			}
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
		}

		protected virtual void PrepareFlyout()
		{
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IFlyoutProvider flyoutProvider = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<IFlyoutProvider>((DependencyObject)this);
			if (flyoutProvider != null)
			{
				Flyout.FlyoutControl = flyoutProvider.FlyoutControl;
				Flyout.PlacementTarget = this;
				Flyout.Placement = flyoutProvider.Placement;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessFlyoutClick()
		{
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!HasFlyout)
			{
				return;
			}
			IFlyoutProvider flyoutProvider = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<IFlyoutProvider>((DependencyObject)this);
			if (flyoutProvider == null || !(flyoutProvider is IFlyoutServiceProvider flyoutServiceProvider))
			{
				return;
			}
			flyoutServiceProvider.FlyoutService.RegisterListener(Flyout);
			Flyout.FlyoutControl = flyoutProvider.FlyoutControl;
			Flyout.PlacementTarget = this;
			Flyout.Placement = flyoutProvider.Placement;
			Flyout.Service = flyoutServiceProvider.FlyoutService;
			if (Flyout.IsOpen || ((FlyoutBase)Flyout.FlyoutControl).IsOpen)
			{
				flyoutServiceProvider.FlyoutService.Do(delegate(FlyoutService x)
				{
					x.Hide(Flyout);
				});
			}
			else
			{
				flyoutServiceProvider.FlyoutService.Do(delegate(FlyoutService x)
				{
					x.Show(Flyout);
				});
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateFlyoutVisualState()
		{
			if (HasFlyout)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "FlyoutEnabled", useTransitions: false);
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, Flyout.IsOpen ? "FlyoutOpened" : "FlyoutClosed", useTransitions: false);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "FlyoutDisabled", useTransitions: false);
			}
		}

		private void OnFlyoutClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateFlyoutVisualState();
		}

		private void OnFlyoutOpened(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateFlyoutVisualState();

		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnFlyoutClosed(bool onClickThrough)
		{
			IFlyoutProvider flyoutProvider = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<IFlyoutProvider>((DependencyObject)this);
			if (flyoutProvider != null && flyoutProvider is IFlyoutServiceProvider flyoutServiceProvider && flyoutServiceProvider.FlyoutService.IsFlyoutShown && onClickThrough)
			{
				IgnoreMouseEvents.LockOnce();
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					IgnoreMouseEvents.Unlock();
				});
			}
		}

	public class AppBarBackButton : AppBarButton
	{
		static AppBarBackButton()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<AppBarBackButton>();
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			base.OnClick();
			AppBar appBar = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<AppBar>((DependencyObject)this);
			if (appBar != null)
			{
				if (appBar.BackCommand != null)
				{
					appBar.BackCommand.Execute(null);
				}
				else if (NavigationHelper.CanGoBack(this))
				{
					NavigationHelper.GoBack(this);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class AppBarExitButton : AppBarButton
	{
		static AppBarExitButton()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<AppBarExitButton>();
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			base.OnClick();
			AppBar appBar = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<AppBar>((DependencyObject)this);
			if (appBar == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (appBar.ExitCommand != null)
			{
				if (appBar.ExitCommand.CanExecute(null))
				{
					appBar.ExitCommand.Execute(null);
				}
			}
			else if (LayoutHelper.FindRoot((DependencyObject)this, false) is Window window)
			{
				window.Close();
			}
		}
	}

		{
			if (PartFlyoutButton != null)
			{
				PartFlyoutButton.Click -= PartFlyoutButton_Click;
			}
			if (PartButton != null)
			{
				PartButton.Click -= PartButton_Click;
			}
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartFlyoutButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_FlyoutButton") as ButtonBase;
			if (PartFlyoutButton != null)
			{
				PartFlyoutButton.Click += PartFlyoutButton_Click;
			}
			PartButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_Button") as ButtonBase;
			if (PartButton != null)
			{
				PartButton.Click += PartButton_Click;
			}
		}

			{
				base.Flyout.IndicatorTarget = this;
				AppBar appBar = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<AppBar>((DependencyObject)this);
				if (appBar != null)
				{
					base.Flyout.PlacementTarget = appBar;
				}
			}
		}

		private void InvokeClick()
		{
			ButtonAutomationPeer buttonAutomationPeer = new ButtonAutomationPeer(this);
			IInvokeProvider invokeProvider = buttonAutomationPeer.GetPattern(PatternInterface.Invoke) as IInvokeProvider;
			invokeProvider.Invoke();
		}

		{
			InvokeClick();
		}

	public class AppBarToggleButton : AppBarButton
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty GroupNameProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsCheckedProperty;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Hashtable groupNameToElements;

		public string GroupName
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(GroupNameProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GroupNameProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsChecked
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsCheckedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsCheckedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler Checked;

		public event EventHandler Unchecked;

		public AppBarToggleButton()
		{
			base.IsEnabledChanged += OnIsEnabledChanged;
		}

		static AppBarToggleButton()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<AppBarToggleButton>();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AppBarToggleButton>.New().Register<bool>("IsChecked", ref IsCheckedProperty, false, (Action<AppBarToggleButton, bool, bool>)delegate(AppBarToggleButton d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
			{
				d.OnIsCheckedChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<string>("GroupName", ref GroupNameProperty, string.Empty, (Action<AppBarToggleButton, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)OnGroupNameChanged, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: false);
		}

		internal void OnToggle()
		{
			IsChecked = !IsChecked;
		}

		protected virtual void OnChecked()
		{
			UpdateButtonGroup();
			if (this.Checked != null)
			{
				this.Checked(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			base.OnClick();
			OnToggle();
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new AppBarToggleButtonAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsCheckedChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (newValue)
			{
				OnChecked();
			}
			else
			{
				OnUnchecked();
			}
			if (UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(this) is AppBarToggleButtonAutomationPeer appBarToggleButtonAutomationPeer)
			{
				appBarToggleButtonAutomationPeer.RaiseToggleStateChangedEvent(oldValue, newValue);
			}
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected override void OnIsPressedChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnIsPressedChanged(e);
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected virtual void OnUnchecked()
		{
			if (this.Unchecked != null)
			{
				this.Unchecked(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			UpdateNormalState(useTransitions);
			UpdateCheckedState(useTransitions);
		}

		private static void OnGroupNameChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			AppBarToggleButton button = (AppBarToggleButton)dObj;
			string text = e.NewValue as string;
			string text2 = e.OldValue as string;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				Unregister(text2, button);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				Register(text, button);
			}
		}

		private static void PurgeGroup(ArrayList elements, object elementToRemove)
		{
			int num = 0;
			while (num < elements.Count)
			{
				WeakReference weakReference = (WeakReference)elements[num];
				object target = weakReference.Target;
				if (target == null || target == elementToRemove)
				{
					elements.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void Register(string groupName, AppBarToggleButton button)
		{
			if (groupNameToElements == null)
			{
				groupNameToElements = new Hashtable(1);
			}
			lock (groupNameToElements)
			{
				ArrayList arrayList = (ArrayList)groupNameToElements[groupName];
				if (arrayList == null)
				{
					arrayList = new ArrayList(1);
					groupNameToElements[groupName] = arrayList;
				}
				else
				{
					PurgeGroup(arrayList, null);
				}
				arrayList.Add(new WeakReference(button));
			}
		}

		private static void Unregister(string groupName, AppBarToggleButton button)
		{
			if (groupNameToElements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (groupNameToElements)
			{
				ArrayList arrayList = (ArrayList)groupNameToElements[groupName];
				if (arrayList != null)
				{
					PurgeGroup(arrayList, button);
					if (arrayList.Count == 0)
					{
						groupNameToElements.Remove(groupName);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnIsEnabledChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		private void UncheckButton()
		{
			SetCurrentValue(IsCheckedProperty, false);
		}

		private void UpdateButtonGroup()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(GroupName))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (groupNameToElements == null)
			{
				groupNameToElements = new Hashtable(1);
			}
			lock (groupNameToElements)
			{
				ArrayList arrayList = (ArrayList)groupNameToElements[GroupName];
				int num = 0;
				while (num < arrayList.Count)
				{
					WeakReference weakReference = (WeakReference)arrayList[num];
					if (!(weakReference.Target is AppBarToggleButton appBarToggleButton))
					{
						arrayList.RemoveAt(num);
						continue;
					}
					if (appBarToggleButton != this && appBarToggleButton.IsChecked)
					{
						appBarToggleButton.UncheckButton();
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCheckedState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (IsChecked)
			{
				if (!base.IsEnabled)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "CheckedDisabled", useTransitions);
				}
				else if (base.IsPressed)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "CheckedPressed", useTransitions);
				}
				else if (base.IsMouseOver)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "CheckedMouseOver", useTransitions);
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Checked", useTransitions);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Unchecked", useTransitions);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateNormalState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (!base.IsEnabled)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Disabled", useTransitions);
			}
			else if (base.IsPressed)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Pressed", useTransitions);
			}
			else if (base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "MouseOver", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions);
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class Extensions
	{
		public static AppBarElementAlignment ToAppBarElementAlignment(this HorizontalAlignment alignment)
		{
			return alignment switch
			{
				HorizontalAlignment.Center => AppBarElementAlignment.Center, 
				HorizontalAlignment.Right => AppBarElementAlignment.Far, 
				_ => AppBarElementAlignment.Near, 
			};
		}

		public static AppBarElementAlignment ToAppBarElementAlignment(this VerticalAlignment alignment)
		{
			return alignment switch
			{
				VerticalAlignment.Center => AppBarElementAlignment.Center, 
				VerticalAlignment.Bottom => AppBarElementAlignment.Far, 
				_ => AppBarElementAlignment.Near, 
			};
		}

		public static FlyoutPlacement ToFlyoutPlacement(this AppBarAlignment alignment)
		{
			return (FlyoutPlacement)(alignment switch
			{
				AppBarAlignment.Top => 3, 
				AppBarAlignment.Left => 2, 
				AppBarAlignment.Right => 0, 
				_ => 1, 
			});
		}
	}

		HorizontalAlignment HorizontalAlignment { get; }

		bool IsCompact { get; set; }

		bool IsHorizontal { get; set; }

		VerticalAlignment VerticalAlignment { get; }
	}

	public class HamburgerMenuAdaptiveLayoutController : IHamburgerMenuLayoutController
	{
		private IHamburgerMenu menu;

		private HamburgerMenuViewState viewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.Closed;

		private double minimizedFlyoutStateThreshold = 720.0;

		private double vompactOverlayStateThreshold = 1024.0;

		private double actualWidth;

		private bool isMenuVisible = true;

		private HamburgerMenuAvailableViewStates availableViewStates = HamburgerMenuAvailableViewStates.All;

		public HamburgerMenuViewState ViewState
		{
			get
			{
				return viewState;
			}
			set
			{
				PropertySetterHelper.SetProperty(ref viewState, value, OnViewStateChanged);
			}
		}

		public double MinimizedFlyoutStateThreshold
		{
			get
			{
				return minimizedFlyoutStateThreshold;
			}
			set
			{
				PropertySetterHelper.SetProperty(ref minimizedFlyoutStateThreshold, value, UpdateViewState);
			}
		}

		public double CompactOverlayStateThreshold
		{
			get
			{
				return vompactOverlayStateThreshold;
			}
			set
			{
				PropertySetterHelper.SetProperty(ref vompactOverlayStateThreshold, value, UpdateViewState);
			}
		}

		public double ActualWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return actualWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				PropertySetterHelper.SetProperty(ref actualWidth, value, UpdateViewState);
			}
		}

		public HamburgerMenuAvailableViewStates AvailableViewStates
		{
			get
			{
				return availableViewStates;
			}
			set
			{
				PropertySetterHelper.SetProperty(ref availableViewStates, value, UpdateViewState);
			}
		}

		public bool IsMenuVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return isMenuVisible;
			}
			set
			{
				PropertySetterHelper.SetProperty(ref isMenuVisible, value, OnIsMenuVisibleChanged);
			}
		}

		public bool IsCompactOnShow { get; set; }

		protected HamburgerMenuViewState SavedInlineState { get; set; }

		public void AttachMenu(IHamburgerMenu menu)
		{
			this.menu = menu;
			SavedInlineState = (IsCompactOnShow ? HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactInline : HamburgerMenuViewState.Inline);
			UpdateViewState();
			OnViewStateChanged(HamburgerMenuViewState.Closed);
		}

		public void ClosePane()
		{
			OnPaneClosed();
		}

		public void OnPaneClosed()
		{
			GotoClosedPaneState();
		}

		public void ToggleViewState()
		{
			if (!GotoOpenedPaneState())
			{
				GotoClosedPaneState();
			}
		}

		private bool GotoClosedPaneState()
		{
			HamburgerMenuViewState hamburgerMenuViewState = ViewState;
			if (ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Opened)
			{
				ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.Closed;
			}
			if (ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Inline)
			{
				ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactInline;
			}
			if (ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Overlay)
			{
				ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactOverlay;
			}
			return hamburgerMenuViewState != ViewState;
		}

		private bool GotoOpenedPaneState()
		{
			HamburgerMenuViewState hamburgerMenuViewState = ViewState;
			if (ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Closed)
			{
				ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.Opened;
			}
			if (ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactInline)
			{
				ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.Inline;
			}
			if (ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactOverlay)
			{
				ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.Overlay;
			}
			return hamburgerMenuViewState != ViewState;
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsMenuVisibleChanged()
		{
			UpdateViewState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnViewStateChanged(HamburgerMenuViewState oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue == HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactInline || oldValue == HamburgerMenuViewState.Inline)
			{
				SavedInlineState = oldValue;
			}
			menu.Do(delegate(IHamburgerMenu x)
			{
				x.ViewState = ViewState;
			});
		}

		private void UpdateViewState()
		{
			if (!IsMenuVisible || menu == null)
			{
				ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.Closed;
			}
			else
			{
				if (ViewModelBase.IsInDesignMode)
				{
					return;
				}
				double num = (AvailableViewStates.HasFlag(HamburgerMenuAvailableViewStates.Overlay) ? CompactOverlayStateThreshold : (-1.0));
				double num2 = (AvailableViewStates.HasFlag(HamburgerMenuAvailableViewStates.Flyout) ? MinimizedFlyoutStateThreshold : (-1.0));
				if (ActualWidth <= num2)
				{
					ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.Closed;
				}
				else if (ActualWidth <= num)
				{
					ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactOverlay;
				}
				else if (AvailableViewStates.HasFlag(HamburgerMenuAvailableViewStates.Inline))
				{
					if (ViewState != HamburgerMenuViewState.Inline && ViewState != HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactInline)
					{
						ViewState = SavedInlineState;
					}
				}
				else if (AvailableViewStates.HasFlag(HamburgerMenuAvailableViewStates.Overlay))
				{
					ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactOverlay;
				}
				else
				{
					ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.Closed;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	[TargetType(typeof(HamburgerSubMenu))]
	public class HamburgerSubMenuThemeSelectorBehavior : ThemeSelectorBehavior<HamburgerSubMenu>
	{
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public class HamburgerThemeViewModel : ThemeViewModel
		{
			public bool ShowInPreview
			{
				get
				{
					return ((BindableBase)this).GetProperty<bool>((Expression<Func<bool>>)(() => ShowInPreview));
				}
				set
				{
					((BindableBase)this).SetProperty<bool>((Expression<Func<bool>>)(() => ShowInPreview), value);
				}
			}

			public HamburgerThemeViewModel(ITheme theme)
				: base(theme)
			{
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PreviewThemeNamesProperty;

		public string PreviewThemeNames
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(PreviewThemeNamesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(PreviewThemeNamesProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		protected override DependencyProperty StyleProperty => FrameworkElement.StyleProperty;

		protected List<string> PreviewNames { get; private set; }

		static HamburgerSubMenuThemeSelectorBehavior()
		{
			string text = (CommonThemeHelper.UseLightweightThemes ? (Theme.Office2019System.Name + "," + Theme.Office2019Colorful.Name + "," + Theme.Office2019Black.Name) : (Theme.Office2019White.Name + "," + Theme.Office2019Colorful.Name + "," + Theme.Office2019Black.Name));
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<HamburgerSubMenuThemeSelectorBehavior>.New().Register<string>("PreviewThemeNames", ref PreviewThemeNamesProperty, text, (Action<HamburgerSubMenuThemeSelectorBehavior, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerSubMenuThemeSelectorBehavior d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				d.OnPreviewThemeNamesChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		protected override object CreateStyleKey()
		{
			return new HamburgerMenuElementsThemeKeyExtension
			{
				ResourceKey = HamburgerMenuElements.SubMenuThemeSelectorStyle,
				IsThemeIndependent = true
			};
		}

		protected override void Initialize(HamburgerSubMenu item)
		{
			if (item.ReadLocalValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
			{
				item.SetCurrentValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty, HamburgerMenuLocalizer.GetString(HamburgerMenuStringId.ThemeSelectorCaption));
			}
			if (item.ReadLocalValue(HamburgerSubMenu.FlyoutHeaderProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
			{
				item.SetCurrentValue(HamburgerSubMenu.FlyoutHeaderProperty, HamburgerMenuLocalizer.GetString(HamburgerMenuStringId.ThemeSelectorCaption));
			}
			if (item.ReadLocalValue(HamburgerSubMenu.MoreButtonVisibilityModeProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
			{
				item.SetCurrentValue(HamburgerSubMenu.MoreButtonVisibilityModeProperty, HamburgerSubMenuMoreButtonVisibility.Hidden);
			}
			item.IsStandaloneSelectionItemMode = true;
			((Behavior<HamburgerSubMenu>)(object)this).AssociatedObject.Do(delegate(HamburgerSubMenu x)
			{
				x.SetResourceReference(((ThemeSelectorBehavior<HamburgerSubMenu>)this).StyleProperty, base.StyleKey);
			});
			item.SetBinding(HamburgerSubMenu.ItemsSourceProperty, new Binding("ThemesCollection")
			{
				Source = this
			});
		}

		protected override void Clear(HamburgerSubMenu item)
		{
			base.Clear(item);
			item.ClearValue(HamburgerSubMenu.ItemsSourceProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnThemesCollectionChanged(ICollectionView oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected override ICollectionView CreateCollectionView()
		{
			UpdatePreviewNames();
			IEnumerable<HamburgerThemeViewModel> source = from t in CommonThemeHelper.GetThemesCollection(base.ShowTouchThemes, true, false)
				select new HamburgerThemeViewModel(t)
				{
					ShowInPreview = PreviewNames.Contains(t.Name)
				};
			ICollectionView defaultView = CollectionViewSource.GetDefaultView(source.ToArray());
			defaultView.GroupDescriptions.Add(new PropertyGroupDescription("Theme.Category"));
			return defaultView;
		}

		protected void UpdatePreviewNames()
		{
			if (PreviewNames == null)
			{
				PreviewNames = new List<string>();
			}
			else
			{
				PreviewNames.Clear();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(PreviewThemeNames))
			{
				PreviewThemeNames.Split(',', '|').ForEach(delegate(string x)
				{
					PreviewNames.Add(x);
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnPreviewThemeNamesChanged()
		{
			UpdatePreviewNames();
			if (base.ThemesCollection != null)
			{
				base.ThemesCollection.OfType<HamburgerThemeViewModel>().ForEach(delegate(HamburgerThemeViewModel x)
				{
					x.ShowInPreview = PreviewNames.Contains(((ThemeViewModel)x).Theme.Name);
				});
			}
		}
	}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnUnloaded();
			GlyphElementExtensions.UnregisterSvgStateUpdate(this, ToggleButton.IsCheckedProperty);
			DependencyPropertyDescriptor.FromProperty(Control.ForegroundProperty, typeof(Control)).RemoveValueChanged(this, OnGlyphColorChanged);
			BlendHelper2.PaletteChanged -= OnGlyphColorChanged;
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnLoaded();
			DependencyPropertyDescriptor.FromProperty(Control.ForegroundProperty, typeof(Control)).AddValueChanged(this, OnGlyphColorChanged);
			BlendHelper2.PaletteChanged += OnGlyphColorChanged;
			UpdateActualGlyphColor();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualGlyphColor()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = (GlyphColor.HasValue ? GlyphColor.Value : (base.Foreground as SolidColorBrush).Return((SolidColorBrush x) => x.Color, () => Colors.Transparent));
			ActualGlyphColor = BlendHelper2.CalcPalette(color);
		}

		private void OnGlyphColorChanged(object sender, object args)
		{
			UpdateActualGlyphColor();
		}
	}

		private IEnumerable<ISelectable> SelectableItems
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (IHamburgerMenuItem container in (IEnumerable<IHamburgerMenuItem>)Items)
				{
					if (container is ISelectable selectable)
					{
						yield return selectable;
					}
					else
					{
						if (!(container is ISupportStandaloneSelection { IsStandaloneSelectionItemMode: false } supportStandaloneSelection))
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (ISelectable selectableItem in supportStandaloneSelection.SelectableItems)
						{
							yield return selectableItem;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

					d.OnIsWindowBackButtonVisibleChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<bool>("ActualIsWindowBackButtonVisible", ref ActualIsWindowBackButtonVisiblePropertyKey, ref ActualIsWindowBackButtonVisibleProperty, false, (Action<HamburgerMenu, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerMenu d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.OnActualIsWindowBackButtonVisibleChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterAttachedReadOnly<HamburgerMenu, HamburgerMenuTemplateSettings>("GetTemplateSettings", ref TemplateSettingsPropertyKey, ref TemplateSettingsProperty, (HamburgerMenuTemplateSettings)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits)
				.Register<bool>("SyncWithWindowBackButton", ref SyncWithWindowBackButtonProperty, true, (Action<HamburgerMenu, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerMenu d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.OnSyncWithWindowBackButtonChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<System.Windows.Media.Brush>("HorizontalHeaderBackground", ref HorizontalHeaderBackgroundProperty, (System.Windows.Media.Brush)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<bool>("ActualIsHorizontalHeaderVisible", ref ActualIsHorizontalHeaderVisiblePropertyKey, ref ActualIsHorizontalHeaderVisibleProperty, false, (Action<HamburgerMenu, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerMenu d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.OnActualIsHorizontalHeaderVisibleChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("ShowRevealHighlightEffect", ref ShowRevealHighlightEffectProperty, false, (Action<HamburgerMenu, bool, bool>)delegate(HamburgerMenu d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
				{
					d.TemplateSettings.ShowRevealHighlightEffect = newValue;
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public static HamburgerMenuTemplateSettings GetTemplateSettings(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return (HamburgerMenuTemplateSettings)obj.GetValue(TemplateSettingsProperty);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public HamburgerMenu()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IsSelectedContainerValid = true;
			TemplateSettings = new HamburgerMenuTemplateSettings();
			UpdateActualIsHorizontalHeaderVisible();
			UpdateTemplateSettings();
			goBackCommandCore = new DelegateCommand<object>(GoBack, CanGoBack);
			OnGoBackCommandChanged();
			items = CreateItemsCollection();
			bottomBarItems = CreateBottomBarItemsCollection();
			ToggleViewStateCommand = new DelegateCommand(ToggleViewState);
			layoutController = CreateLayoutController();
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
			Items.CollectionChanged += OnItemsCollectionChanged;
			BottomBarItems.CollectionChanged += OnBottomBarItemsChanged;
		}

		private void OnBottomBarItemsChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ValidateSelection();
		}

		private void OnItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ValidateSelection();
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new HambugerMenuAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected virtual IHamburgerMenuLayoutController CreateLayoutController()
		{
			return new HamburgerMenuAdaptiveLayoutController();
		}

		protected virtual TemplatedSplitCollection<IHamburgerMenuItem, HamburgerMenu> CreateItemsCollection()
		{
			return new TemplatedSplitCollection<IHamburgerMenuItem, HamburgerMenu>(this, 2, (object o) => new HamburgerMenuNavigationButton
			{
				Content = o.GetType().Name
			}, (IHamburgerMenuItem x) => (x.Placement != HamburgerMenuItemPlacement.Top) ? 1 : 0);
		}

		protected virtual TemplatedCollectionWithOwner<IHamburgerMenuBottomBarItem, HamburgerMenu> CreateBottomBarItemsCollection()
		{
			return new TemplatedCollectionWithOwner<IHamburgerMenuBottomBarItem, HamburgerMenu>(this, (object o) => new HamburgerMenuBottomBarNavigationButton
			{
				Content = o.GetType().Name
			});
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnLoaded();
		}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnUnloaded();
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded()
		{
			UpdateDesignerView();
			UpdateGoBackSupportParent();
			if (BottomBarItemsSource != null && SplitView != null && LayoutHelper.FindElementByName(SplitView.Pane as FrameworkElement, "PART_BottomBarItemsPanel") is Panel { DesiredSize: { Height: 0.0 } } panel)
			{
				panel.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			if (isNavigationPending)
			{
				NavigateToSelectedItem();
			}
			if (!subsribedToCommandManager)
			{
				subsribedToCommandManager = true;
				CommandManager.RequerySuggested += OnGoBackCommandCanExecuteChanged;
				UpdateActualIsWindowBackButtonVisible();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnUnloaded()
		{
			AssignGoBackParent(null);
			if (subsribedToCommandManager)
			{
				subsribedToCommandManager = false;
				CommandManager.RequerySuggested -= OnGoBackCommandCanExecuteChanged;
				UpdateActualIsWindowBackButtonVisible();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateTemplateSettings()
		{
			TemplateSettings.CompactWidth = CompactWidth;
			TemplateSettings.IsCompact = IsCompact;
			TemplateSettings.ViewState = ViewState;
			TemplateSettings.IsMenuVisible = ActualIsMenuVisible;
			TemplateSettings.HeaderHeight = HeaderHeight;
			TemplateSettings.OpenPaneWidth = ((SplitView == null) ? OpenPaneWidth : SplitView.CalculatedOpenPaneWidth);
			TemplateSettings.IsHorizontalHeaderVisible = ActualIsHorizontalHeaderVisible;
			TemplateSettings.MenuSize = base.RenderSize;
			TemplateSettings.ShowRevealHighlightEffect = ShowRevealHighlightEffect;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateDesignerView()
		{
			if (ViewModelBase.IsInDesignMode)
			{
				if (ItemsSource != null)
				{
					Items.Refresh();
				}
				if (BottomBarItemsSource != null)
				{
					BottomBarItems.Refresh();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = SplitView.With((SplitView x) => x.Pane);
				if ((uIElement != null && (uIElement.IsKeyboardFocused || uIElement.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)) || (ToggleStateButton != null && (ToggleStateButton.IsKeyboardFocused || ToggleStateButton.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)))
				{
					CloseMenu();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			if (isNavigationPending)
			{
				NavigateToSelectedItem();
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			SplitView.Do(delegate(SplitView x)
			{
				x.PaneClosed -= OnPaneClosed;
			});
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			InitializeLayoutController();
			ToggleStateButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_ToggleStateButton") as UIElement;
			SplitView = GetTemplateChild("PART_SplitView") as SplitView;
			SplitView.Do(delegate(SplitView x)
			{
				x.PaneClosed += OnPaneClosed;
			});
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeLayoutController()
		{
			LayoutController.IsCompactOnShow = IsInitiallyCompact;
			LayoutController.AvailableViewStates = AvailableViewStates;
			LayoutController.CompactOverlayStateThreshold = CompactOverlayStateThreshold;
			LayoutController.MinimizedFlyoutStateThreshold = MinimizedFlyoutStateThreshold;
			LayoutController.IsMenuVisible = ActualIsMenuVisible;
			layoutController.ActualWidth = Math.Max(base.DesiredSize.Width, base.ActualWidth);
			LayoutController.AttachMenu(this);
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected internal void CloseMenu()
		{
			if (ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Opened || ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Overlay)
			{
				LayoutController.ClosePane();
			}
		}

		{
			UpdateActualIsMenuVisible();
		}

		protected virtual void OnActualIsMenuVisibleChanged()
		{
			HamburgerMenuViewState viewState = ViewState;
			viewStateLocker.Lock();
			LayoutController.IsMenuVisible = ActualIsMenuVisible;
			TemplateSettings.IsMenuVisible = ActualIsMenuVisible;
			UpdateActualIsHorizontalHeaderVisible();
			viewStateLocker.Unlock();
			if (!Locker.op_Implicit(viewStateLocker))
			{
				RaiseViewStateChanged(viewState);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnHideMenuWhenActivePageItemNotFoundChanged()
		{
			UpdateActualIsMenuVisible();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsCurrentPageSyncWithMenuItemChanged()
		{
			UpdateActualIsMenuVisible();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualIsMenuVisible()
		{
			ActualIsMenuVisible = IsMenuVisible && (IsCurrentPageSyncWithMenuItem || !HideMenuWhenActivePageItemNotFound) && !(SelectedItem as IHamburgerMenuNavigationItem).Return((IHamburgerMenuNavigationItem x) => x.HideMenuWhenSelected, () => false);
		}

		protected virtual void OnAvailableViewStatesChanged()
		{
			LayoutController.AvailableViewStates = AvailableViewStates;
		}

		protected virtual void OnViewStateChanged(HamburgerMenuViewState oldValue)
		{
			viewStateLocker.Lock();
			LayoutController.ViewState = ViewState;
			IsCompact = ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactInline || ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactOverlay;
			UpdateActualIsHorizontalHeaderVisible();
			UpdateTemplateSettings();
			viewStateLocker.Unlock();
			if (!Locker.op_Implicit(viewStateLocker))
			{
				RaiseViewStateChanged(oldValue);
			}
		}

		protected virtual HamburgerMenuViewState CoerceViewState(HamburgerMenuViewState value)
		{
			if (ViewModelBase.IsInDesignMode)
			{
				return HamburgerMenuViewState.Inline;
			}
			return value;
		}

		{
			LayoutController.IsCompactOnShow = IsInitiallyCompact;
		}

		protected virtual void ToggleViewState()
		{
			LayoutController.ToggleViewState();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualIsHorizontalHeaderVisible()
		{
			ActualIsHorizontalHeaderVisible = ActualIsMenuVisible && (ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Closed || ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Opened);
		}

		protected virtual void OnActualIsHorizontalHeaderVisibleChanged()
		{
			TemplateSettings.IsHorizontalHeaderVisible = ActualIsHorizontalHeaderVisible;
		}

			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			UpdateTemplateSettings();
			return result;
		}

		}

			OnAllowBuiltInNavigationChanged();
