			TemplateSettings.MenuSize = sizeInfo.NewSize;
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsWindowBackButtonVisibleChanged()
		{
			UpdateActualIsWindowBackButtonVisible();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualIsWindowBackButtonVisible()
		{
			ActualIsWindowBackButtonVisible = IsWindowBackButtonVisible && ActualGoBackCommand != null && ActualGoBackCommand.CanExecute(null);
		}

		protected virtual void OnActualIsWindowBackButtonVisibleChanged()
		{
			object target = navigationGoBackParent.Target;
			((IBackButtonSupport)((target is IBackButtonSupport) ? target : null)).Do(delegate(IBackButtonSupport x)
			{
				x.ShowBackButton = ActualIsWindowBackButtonVisible;
			});
		}

		public virtual void OnGoBackCommandChanged()
		{
			ActualGoBackCommand = GoBackCommand ?? goBackCommandCore;
		}

		protected virtual void OnActualGoBackCommandChanged(ICommand oldValue)
		{
			oldValue.Do(delegate(ICommand x)
			{
				x.CanExecuteChanged -= OnGoBackCommandCanExecuteChanged;
			});
			ActualGoBackCommand.Do(delegate(ICommand x)
			{
				x.CanExecuteChanged += OnGoBackCommandCanExecuteChanged;
			});
			UpdateActualIsWindowBackButtonVisible();
		}

		protected virtual void GoBack(object parameter)
		{
			if (CanGoBack(parameter))
			{
				ActualNavigationTarget.GoBack(parameter);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanGoBack(object parameter)
		{
			if (ActualNavigationTarget != null)
			{
				return ActualNavigationTarget.CanGoBack;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnCanGoBackChanged()
		{
			(ActualGoBackCommand as IDelegateCommand).Do(delegate(IDelegateCommand x)
			{
				x.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			});
			UpdateActualIsWindowBackButtonVisible();
		}

		private void OnGoBackCommandCanExecuteChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateActualIsWindowBackButtonVisible();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSyncWithWindowBackButtonChanged()
		{
			UpdateGoBackSupportParent();
		}

		protected void UpdateGoBackSupportParent()
		{
			if (!SyncWithWindowBackButton)
			{
				AssignGoBackParent(null);
			}
			else if (SyncWithWindowBackButton && base.IsLoaded)
			{
				AssignGoBackParent(LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<IBackButtonSupport>((DependencyObject)this));
			}
		}

		private void AssignGoBackParent(IBackButtonSupport parent)
		{
			object target = navigationGoBackParent.Target;
			IBackButtonSupport val = (IBackButtonSupport)((target is IBackButtonSupport) ? target : null);
			if (val == parent)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.ShowBackButton = false;
				val.BackRequested -= OnBackRequested;
				((ThemedWindow)(object)((val is ThemedWindow) ? val : null)).Do(delegate(ThemedWindow x)
				{
					((DependencyObject)(object)x).ClearValue(ThemedWindow.NavigateBackCommandProperty);
				});
			}
			navigationGoBackParent.Target = parent;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				parent.ShowBackButton = ActualIsWindowBackButtonVisible;
				ThemedWindow val2 = (ThemedWindow)(object)((parent is ThemedWindow) ? parent : null);
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)val2, ThemedWindow.NavigateBackCommandProperty, new Binding("ActualGoBackCommand")
					{
						Source = this
					});
				}
				else
				{
					parent.BackRequested += OnBackRequested;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnBackRequested(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ActualGoBackCommand.Execute(null);
		}

		protected virtual void OnNavigationTargetChanged()
		{
			UpdateActualNavigationTarget();
		}

		protected virtual void OnAllowBuiltInNavigationChanged()
		{
			if (!AllowBuiltInNavigation && internalFrame != null && base.Content == internalFrame)
			{
				ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!AllowBuiltInNavigation)
				{
					return;
				}
				if ((ReadLocalValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue || (internalFrame != null && base.Content == internalFrame)) && ReadLocalValue(ContentControl.ContentTemplateProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
				{
					if (internalFrame == null)
					{
						internalFrame = new NavigationFrame
						{
							IsTabStop = false
						};
					}
					SetCurrentValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty, internalFrame);
				}
				else if (base.Content == internalFrame)
				{
					ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateActualNavigationTarget()
		{
			object obj = NavigationTarget ?? base.Content;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				ActualNavigationTarget.Do(delegate(HamburgerNavigationTargetBase x)
				{
					x.Release();
				});
				ActualNavigationTarget = null;
			}
			else if (ActualNavigationTarget == null || !ActualNavigationTarget.IsNavigationObject(obj))
			{
				ActualNavigationTarget = CreateNavigationTarget(obj);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnActualNavigationTargetChanged(HamburgerNavigationTargetBase oldValue)
		{
			oldValue.Do(delegate(HamburgerNavigationTargetBase x)
			{
				x.NavigationPointChanged -= OnTargetNavigationPointChanged;
				x.CanGoBackChanged -= OnNavigationCanGoBackChanged;
				x.Release();
			});
			ActualNavigationTarget.Do(delegate(HamburgerNavigationTargetBase x)
			{
				x.NavigationPointChanged += OnTargetNavigationPointChanged;
				x.CanGoBackChanged += OnNavigationCanGoBackChanged;
			});
			OnCanGoBackChanged();
			navigationLocker.Lock();
			NavigationPoint = ActualNavigationTarget.With((HamburgerNavigationTargetBase x) => x.NavigationPoint);
			SyncSelectionWithNavigationPoint();
			navigationLocker.Unlock();
		}

		private void OnNavigationCanGoBackChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnCanGoBackChanged();
		}

		protected virtual void OnTargetNavigationPointChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			NavigationPoint = ActualNavigationTarget.NavigationPoint;
			while (--unlockOnCompleteNavigationCount > -1)
			{
				navigationLocker.Unlock();
			}
			unlockOnCompleteNavigationCount = 0;
		}

		protected virtual void OnNavigationPointChanged(NavigationPoint oldValue)
		{
			CurrentNavigatingItem = null;
			if (!Locker.op_Implicit(navigationLocker))
			{
				navigationLocker.Lock();
				SyncSelectionWithNavigationPoint();
				navigationLocker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		protected virtual HamburgerNavigationTargetBase CreateNavigationTarget(object navigationTarget)
		{
			return HamburgerNavigationTargetBase.CreateInstance(navigationTarget, this);
		}

		void INavigationOwner.NavigateToItem(ISupportNavigationTarget item)
		{
			if (CheckNavigationTargetOnSelectionChanged)
			{
				CurrentNavigatingItem = item;
			}
			NavigateToItemCore(item);
		}

		bool INavigationOwner.CanNavigate(ISupportNavigationTarget target, object parentVm)
		{
			return CanNavigateCore(target, parentVm);
		}

		protected virtual bool CanNavigateCore(ISupportNavigationTarget target, object parentVm)
		{
			HamburgerMenuNavigatingEventArgs e = RaiseNavigating(target, parentVm);
			return !e.Cancel;
		}

		protected virtual void NavigateToItemCore(ISupportNavigationTarget item)
		{
			if (!item.IsEmpty() && !item.IsSameNavigationPoint(NavigationPoint))
			{
				if (!itemClickInfo.EqualsTo(item))
				{
					itemClickInfo = null;
				}
				navigationLocker.Lock();
				HamburgerNavigationTargetBase.NavigationResult navigationResult = ActualNavigationTarget.Return((HamburgerNavigationTargetBase x) => x.Navigate(item, base.DataContext), () => HamburgerNavigationTargetBase.NavigationResult.Completed);
				if (navigationResult == HamburgerNavigationTargetBase.NavigationResult.Pending)
				{
					unlockOnCompleteNavigationCount++;
				}
				else
				{
					navigationLocker.Unlock();
				}
			}
		}

		void ISupportSelection.UpdateSelection(ISelectable item, bool? isSelected)
		{
			UpdateSelectionCore(item, isSelected);
		}

		void ISupportSelection.OnItemClick(ISelectable item)
		{
			ItemClickCore(item);
		}

		void ISupportSelection.OnItemDoubleClick(ISelectable item)
		{
		}

		void ISupportSelection.SetSelectedItem(object item)
		{
			if (!selectionLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ItemClickCore(ISelectable item)
		{
			if (SyncWithActivePage)
			{
				itemClickInfo = SelectableNavigationContainerInfo.Create(item as ISupportNavigationTarget);
			}
			bool flag = (item as ISelectableHamburgerMenuItem).Return((ISelectableHamburgerMenuItem x) => x.SelectOnClick, () => true);
			if (item != null && !item.IsSelected && flag)
			{
				UpdateSelectionCore(item, true);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSelectionCore(ISelectable item, bool? isSelected)
		{
			if (item == null || Locker.op_Implicit(selectionLocker))
			{
				return;
			}
			selectionLocker.Lock();
			if (isSelected.HasValue)
			{
				if (isSelected.Value)
				{
					object obj = ItemFromContainer(item);
					if (obj != null)
					{
						SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, obj);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, null);
				}
			}
			else if (SelectedItem == null)
			{
				SyncSelectionWithNavigationPoint();
			}
			selectionLocker.Unlock();
		}

		protected void NavigateToSelectedItem()
		{
			isNavigationPending = false;
			if (!IsSelectedContainerValid || navigationLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			IHamburgerMenuNavigationItem hamburgerMenuNavigationItem = ContainerFromItemCore(SelectedItem, selectableOnly: true) as IHamburgerMenuNavigationItem;
			if (base.IsLoaded && CheckNavigationTargetOnSelectionChanged && CurrentNavigatingItem != null && hamburgerMenuNavigationItem == CurrentNavigatingItem)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (hamburgerMenuNavigationItem != null && SyncWithActivePage)
			{
				if (!base.IsInitialized || (hamburgerMenuNavigationItem.IsEmpty() && !base.IsLoaded))
				{
					isNavigationPending = true;
				}
				else if (hamburgerMenuNavigationItem.SyncWithActivePage)
				{
					NavigateToItemCore(hamburgerMenuNavigationItem);
				}
				else
				{
					IsCurrentPageSyncWithMenuItem = false;
				}
			}
			else if (SyncWithActivePage)
			{
				IsCurrentPageSyncWithMenuItem = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedItemChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			selectionLocker.Lock();
			(ContainerFromItemCore(oldValue, selectableOnly: true) as ISelectable).Do(delegate(ISelectable x)
			{
				x.IsSelected = false;
			});
			UpdateSelectedItemCore();
			RaiseEvent(new HamburgerMenuSelectedItemChangedEventArgs(this, oldValue, SelectedItem));
			UpdateActualIsMenuVisible();
			selectionLocker.Unlock();
		}

		protected internal void ValidateSelection()
		{
			if (IsSelectedContainerValid)
			{
				IsSelectedContainerValid = SelectedItem == null || ContainerFromItemCore(SelectedItem, selectableOnly: true) != null;
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateSelectedItemCore();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedItemCore()
		{
			selectionLocker.Lock();
			object obj = ContainerFromItemCore(SelectedItem, selectableOnly: true);
			(obj as ISelectable).Do(delegate(ISelectable x)
			{
				x.IsSelected = true;
			});
			IsSelectedContainerValid = SelectedItem == null || obj != null;
			NavigateToSelectedItem();
			selectionLocker.Unlock();
		}

		public object ContainerFromItem(object item)
		{
			return ContainerFromItemCore(item, selectableOnly: false);
		}

		protected object ContainerFromItemCore(object item, bool selectableOnly)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = ((object)Items.ContainerFromItem(item)) ?? ((object)BottomBarItems.ContainerFromItem(item));
			if (obj == null)
			{
				foreach (IHamburgerMenuItem item2 in (IEnumerable<IHamburgerMenuItem>)Items)
				{
					if (item2 is ISupportStandaloneSelection supportStandaloneSelection && (!selectableOnly || !supportStandaloneSelection.IsStandaloneSelectionItemMode))
					{
						obj = supportStandaloneSelection.ContainerFromItem(item);
						if (obj != null)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected internal object ItemFromContainer(object item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = Items.ItemFromContainer(item as IHamburgerMenuItem) ?? BottomBarItems.ItemFromContainer(item as IHamburgerMenuBottomBarItem);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				foreach (IHamburgerMenuItem item2 in (IEnumerable<IHamburgerMenuItem>)Items)
				{
					if (item2 is ISupportStandaloneSelection supportStandaloneSelection)
					{
						obj = supportStandaloneSelection.ItemFromContainer(item);
						if (obj != null)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected virtual void SyncSelectionWithNavigationPoint()
		{
			ISupportNavigationTarget supportNavigationTarget = ContainerFromItem(SelectedItem) as ISupportNavigationTarget;
			if (itemClickInfo != null)
			{
				SelectableNavigationContainerInfo selectableNavigationContainerInfo = itemClickInfo;
				itemClickInfo = null;
				if (selectableNavigationContainerInfo.IsSelectionAllowed && selectableNavigationContainerInfo.EqualsTo(supportNavigationTarget) && selectableNavigationContainerInfo.IsSameNavigationPoint(NavigationPoint))
				{
					IsCurrentPageSyncWithMenuItem = selectableNavigationContainerInfo.SyncWithActivePage;
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!SyncWithActivePage || NavigationPoint.IsEmpty() || supportNavigationTarget.IsSameNavigationPoint(NavigationPoint))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ISelectable selectableItem in SelectableItems)
			{
				if (selectableItem is IHamburgerMenuNavigationItem hamburgerMenuNavigationItem && hamburgerMenuNavigationItem.IsSameNavigationPoint(NavigationPoint, hamburgerMenuNavigationItem.UseNavigationTargetParameterForSync))
				{
					IsCurrentPageSyncWithMenuItem = true;
					SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, ItemFromContainer(selectableItem));
					return;
				}
			}
			SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, null);
			IsCurrentPageSyncWithMenuItem = false;
		}

		bool IHamburgerMenu.CanProcessItemClick(object container)
		{
			object obj = FindCorrespondingHamburgerItem(container, allowVisualTreeSearch: true);
			if (ItemFromContainer(obj) == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			HamburgerMenuPreviewItemClickEventArgs e = RaisePreviewItemClick(container, obj);
			return !e.Cancel;
		}

		private object FindCorrespondingHamburgerItem(object container, bool allowVisualTreeSearch)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = null;
			if (container is IHamburgerMenuItemBase || container is IHamburgerSubMenuItem)
			{
				obj = container;
			}
			else
			{
				object owner = HamburgerMenuExtensions.GetOwner<object>(container);
				obj = FindCorrespondingHamburgerItem(owner, allowVisualTreeSearch: false);
				if (obj == null && allowVisualTreeSearch)
				{
					obj = LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject(container as DependencyObject, (Predicate<DependencyObject>)((DependencyObject x) => x is IHamburgerMenuItemBase || x is IHamburgerSubMenuItem), false, (DependencyObject)this);
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected HamburgerMenuPreviewItemClickEventArgs RaisePreviewItemClick(object item, object hamburgerItem)
		{
			HamburgerMenuPreviewItemClickEventArgs args = new HamburgerMenuPreviewItemClickEventArgs(item, hamburgerItem);
			this.PreviewItemClick.Do(delegate(EventHandler<HamburgerMenuPreviewItemClickEventArgs> x)
			{
				x(this, args);
			});
			return args;
		}

		protected HamburgerMenuNavigatingEventArgs RaiseNavigating(ISupportNavigationTarget navigationTarget, object parentVm)
		{
			HamburgerMenuNavigatingEventArgs args = new HamburgerMenuNavigatingEventArgs(navigationTarget, parentVm);
			this.Navigating.Do(delegate(EventHandler<HamburgerMenuNavigatingEventArgs> x)
			{
				x(this, args);
			});
			return args;
		}

		protected void RaiseViewStateChanged(HamburgerMenuViewState oldState)
		{
			RaiseEvent(new HamburgerMenuViewStateChangedEventArgs(this, oldState, ViewState, ActualIsMenuVisible));
		}
	}

		static HamburgerMenuHyperlinkButton()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<HamburgerMenuHyperlinkButton>();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<HamburgerMenuHyperlinkButton>.New().Register<Uri>("NavigateUri", ref NavigateUriProperty, (Uri)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<HamburgerMenuItemPlacement>("Placement", ref PlacementProperty, HamburgerMenuItemPlacement.Bottom, (Action<HamburgerMenuHyperlinkButton, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerMenuHyperlinkButton d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				d.OnPlacementChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<HamburgerItemCompactModeVisibility>("CompactModeVisibility", ref CompactModeVisibilityProperty, HamburgerItemCompactModeVisibility.Hidden, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("CollapseMenuOnClick", ref CollapseMenuOnClickProperty, true, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new HamburgerMenuHyperlinkButtonAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			if (!Owner.Return((IHamburgerMenu x) => x.CanProcessItemClick(this), () => true))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (NavigateUri != null)
			{
				CancelEventArgs args = new CancelEventArgs();
				this.RequestNavigate.Do(delegate(EventHandler<CancelEventArgs> x)
				{
					x(this, args);
				});
				if (args.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
				SafeProcess.Start(NavigateUri.AbsoluteUri);
			}
			if (CollapseMenuOnClick)
			{
				Owner.Do(delegate(HamburgerMenu x)
				{
					x.CloseMenu();
				});
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnOwnerChanged(HamburgerMenu oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnPlacementChanged()
		{
			SplitCollectionItemExtensions.UpdateCollectionIndex(this);
		}
	}

				.Register<System.Windows.Media.Color?>("GlyphColor", ref GlyphColorProperty, (System.Windows.Media.Color?)null, (Action<HamburgerMenuNavigationButton, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerMenuNavigationButton d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.UpdateActualGlyphColor();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<System.Windows.Media.Color>("ActualGlyphColor", ref ActualGlyphColorPropertyKey, ref ActualGlyphColorProperty, Colors.Transparent, (Action<HamburgerMenuNavigationButton, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerMenuNavigationButton d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.UpdateActualGlyphColor();

		{
			base.OnClickCore();
			if (CollapseMenuOnClick)

				});

		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualGlyphColor()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = (GlyphColor.HasValue ? GlyphColor.Value : (base.Foreground as SolidColorBrush).Return((SolidColorBrush x) => x.Color, () => Colors.Transparent));
			ActualGlyphColor = BlendHelper2.CalcPalette(color);
		}

		private void OnGlyphColorChanged(object sender, object args)
		{
			UpdateActualGlyphColor();
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			DependencyPropertyDescriptor.FromProperty(Control.ForegroundProperty, typeof(Control)).AddValueChanged(this, OnGlyphColorChanged);
			BlendHelper2.PaletteChanged += OnGlyphColorChanged;
			UpdateActualGlyphColor();
		}

		protected override void OnUnloaded()
		{
			base.OnUnloaded();
			DependencyPropertyDescriptor.FromProperty(Control.ForegroundProperty, typeof(Control)).RemoveValueChanged(this, OnGlyphColorChanged);
			BlendHelper2.PaletteChanged -= OnGlyphColorChanged;
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsStandaloneSelectionItemMode)
				{
					return Owner == null;
				}
				return true;
			}

		protected virtual bool CanShowFlyout
		{
			get
			{
				if (Owner != null && Owner.ActualIsMenuVisible)
				{
					return FlyoutDisplayMode == HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutDisplayMode.Always;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsOpen
		{
			get
			{
				if (ItemFlyout != null)
				{
					return ((FlyoutBase)ItemFlyout).IsOpen;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		HamburgerMenu ISupportOwner<HamburgerMenu>.Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return Owner;
			}
			set
			{
				HamburgerMenu owner = Owner;
				if (owner != value)
				{
					HamburgerMenuExtensions.SetOwner(this, value);
					OnOwnerChanged(owner);
				}
			}
		}

		{

				RemoveHandler(SelectedItemChangedEvent, value);

		static HamburgerSubMenu()
		{
			SelectedItemChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("SelectedItemChanged", RoutingStrategy.Direct, typeof(EventHandler<HamburgerMenuSelectedItemChangedEventArgs>), typeof(HamburgerSubMenu));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<HamburgerSubMenu>();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<HamburgerSubMenu>.New().Register<HamburgerMenuItemPlacement>("Placement", ref PlacementProperty, HamburgerMenuItemPlacement.Top, (Action<HamburgerSubMenu, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerSubMenu d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				d.OnPlacementChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<object>("ItemsSource", ref ItemsSourceProperty, (object)null, (Action<HamburgerSubMenu, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerSubMenu d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				d.OnItemsSourceChanged(e.OldValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplate>("ItemTemplate", ref ItemTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (Action<HamburgerSubMenu, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerSubMenu d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.OnItemTemplateChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("ItemTemplateSelector", ref ItemTemplateSelectorProperty, (DataTemplateSelector)null, (Action<HamburgerSubMenu, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerSubMenu d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.OnItemTemplateSelectorChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<Style>("ItemStyle", ref ItemStyleProperty, (Style)null, (Action<HamburgerSubMenu, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerSubMenu d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.OnItemStyleChanged((Style)e.OldValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<StyleSelector>("ItemStyleSelector", ref ItemStyleSelectorProperty, (StyleSelector)null, (Action<HamburgerSubMenu, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerSubMenu d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

				.Register<bool>("IsStandaloneSelectionItemMode", ref IsStandaloneSelectionItemModeProperty, false, (Action<HamburgerSubMenu, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerSubMenu d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new HamburgerSubMenuAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPlacementChanged()
		{
			SplitCollectionItemExtensions.UpdateCollectionIndex(this);
		}

			((ISupportItemsSource)Items).SetItemsSource(ItemsSource);
		}

			((ISupportItemTemplate)Items).ItemTemplate = ItemTemplate;
		}

			((ISupportItemTemplate)Items).ItemTemplateSelector = ItemTemplateSelector;
		}

			Items.ItemStyle = ItemStyle;
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemStyleSelectorChanged(StyleSelector oldValue)
		{
			Items.ItemStyleSelector = ItemStyleSelector;
		}

		protected virtual void OnMoreButtonVisibilityModeChanged()
		{
			UpdateIsMoreButtonVisibile();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSubMenuHeaderHeightChanged()
		{
			UpdateActualHeaderHeight();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsStandaloneSelectionItemModeChanged()
		{
			SyncSelectedItem();
		}

		protected virtual void OnOwnerChanged(HamburgerMenu oldValue)
		{
			SyncSelectedItem();
		}

		protected virtual void OnFlyoutDisplayModeChanged(HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutDisplayMode oldValue, HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutDisplayMode newValue)
		{
			UpdateIsMoreButtonVisibile();
		}

		public HamburgerSubMenu()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IsSelectedContainerValid = true;
			items = CreateItemsCollection();
			PreviewItemsCore = new ObservableCollection<HamburgerSubMenuPreviewNavigationButton>();
			PreviewItems = new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<HamburgerSubMenuPreviewNavigationButton>(PreviewItemsCore);
			base.SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
			HideFlyoutCommand = new DelegateCommand(HideFlyout);
			Items.CollectionChanged += OnItemsChanged;
			base.DataContextChanged += HamburgerSubMenu_DataContextChanged;
		}

		private void HamburgerSubMenu_DataContextChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewValue == null)
			{
				HideFlyout();
			}
		}

		private void OnItemsChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ValidateSelection();
		}

		private void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsOpen)
			{
				UpdateFlyoutSettings();
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			BeforeApplyTemplate();
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			AfterApplyTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void BeforeApplyTemplate()
		{
			Button.Do(delegate(ISupportOwner<HamburgerSubMenu> x)
			{
				x.Owner = null;
			});
			MoreButton.Do(delegate(ISupportOwner<HamburgerSubMenu> x)
			{
				x.Owner = null;
			});
			ItemFlyout.Do(delegate(HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl x)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)x).Opened -= OnFlyoutOpened;
			});
			ItemFlyout.Do(delegate(HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl x)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)x).Closed -= OnFlyoutClosed;
			});
		}

		protected virtual void AfterApplyTemplate()
		{
			Button = (HamburgerSubMenuButton)GetTemplateChild("PART_Button");
			ItemFlyout = (HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl)(object)GetTemplateChild("PART_SubMenuFlyout");
			PreviewPanel = (HamburgerSubMenuPanel)GetTemplateChild("PART_PreviewPanel");
			FlyoutPane = (HamburgerSubMenuPane)GetTemplateChild("PART_FlyoutPane");
			FlyoutPane.Do(delegate(HamburgerSubMenuPane x)
			{
				x.ApplyTemplate();
			});
			MoreButton = (HamburgerSubMenuMoreButton)GetTemplateChild("PART_MoreButton");
			ItemFlyout.Do(delegate(HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl x)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)x).Opened += OnFlyoutOpened;
			});
			ItemFlyout.Do(delegate(HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl x)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)x).Closed += OnFlyoutClosed;
			});
			Button.Do(delegate(ISupportOwner<HamburgerSubMenu> x)
			{
				x.Owner = this;
			});
			MoreButton.Do(delegate(ISupportOwner<HamburgerSubMenu> x)
			{
				x.Owner = this;
			});
			UpdateIsMoreButtonVisibile();
			UpdateIsMoreButtonSelected();
		}

		private void OnFlyoutOpened(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			isInvokedViaMoreButton = MoreButton != null && (MoreButton.IsKeyboardFocused || MoreButton.IsKeyboardFocusWithin);
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Loaded, (Action)delegate
			{
				FlyoutPane.Do(delegate(HamburgerSubMenuPane x)
				{
					x.Focus();
				});
			});
		}

		private void OnFlyoutClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (FlyoutPane == null || (!FlyoutPane.IsKeyboardFocused && !FlyoutPane.IsKeyboardFocusWithin))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (isInvokedViaMoreButton && MoreButton != null)
			{
				MoreButton.Focus();
				return;
			}
			Button.Do(delegate(HamburgerSubMenuButton x)
			{
				x.Focus();
			});
		}

		protected virtual TemplatedCollectionWithOwner<IHamburgerSubMenuItem, HamburgerSubMenu> CreateItemsCollection()
		{
			return new TemplatedCollectionWithOwner<IHamburgerSubMenuItem, HamburgerSubMenu>(this, (object o) => new HamburgerSubMenuNavigationButton
			{
				Content = o.GetType().Name,
				ShowInPreview = true
			});
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualHeaderHeight()
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(FlyoutHeaderHeight))
			{
				ActualFlyoutHeaderHeight = FlyoutHeaderHeight;
				return;
			}
			HamburgerMenuTemplateSettings templateSettings = HamburgerMenu.GetTemplateSettings(this);
			ActualFlyoutHeaderHeight = templateSettings.Return((HamburgerMenuTemplateSettings x) => x.HeaderHeight, () => double.NaN);
		}

		protected internal virtual void ShowFlyout()
		{
			if (CanShowFlyout)
			{
				UpdateFlyoutSettings();
				((FlyoutBase)ItemFlyout).IsOpen = true;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void HideFlyout()
		{
			if (ItemFlyout != null)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)ItemFlyout).IsOpen = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateFlyoutSettings()
		{
			if (IsOpen && !CanShowFlyout)
			{
				HideFlyout();
				return;
			}
			((FlyoutBase)ItemFlyout).PlacementTarget = Owner;
			UpdateActualHeaderHeight();
			UpdateActualFlyoutPaneMinWidth();
			if (Owner != null && Owner.IsCompact)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)ItemFlyout).HorizontalOffset = Owner.CompactWidth;
			}
			else if (Owner != null && Owner.ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Inline)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)ItemFlyout).HorizontalOffset = CalculateOwnerWidth();
			}
			else
			{
				((FlyoutBase)ItemFlyout).HorizontalOffset = 0.0;
			}
			IsFlyoutBackButtonVisible = Owner != null && Owner.ViewState != HamburgerMenuViewState.Inline && !Owner.IsCompact;
		}

		protected virtual double CalculateOwnerWidth()
		{
			if (Owner != null && Owner.SplitView != null && Owner.SplitView.Pane is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				return frameworkElement.ActualWidth;
			}
			return base.ActualWidth;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualFlyoutPaneMinWidth()
		{
			if (Owner != null && (Owner.ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Opened || Owner.ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Overlay))
			{
				ActualFlyoutPaneMinWidth = Math.Max(double.IsNaN(FlyoutPaneMinWidth) ? 0.0 : FlyoutPaneMinWidth, CalculateOwnerWidth());
			}
			else
			{
				ActualFlyoutPaneMinWidth = FlyoutPaneMinWidth;
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateIsMoreButtonVisibile()
		{
			IsMoreButtonVisible = FlyoutDisplayMode == HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutDisplayMode.Always && (MoreButtonVisibilityMode == HamburgerSubMenuMoreButtonVisibility.Visible || (MoreButtonVisibilityMode == HamburgerSubMenuMoreButtonVisibility.Auto && PreviewItems.Count != Items.Count));
		}

		protected void UpdateIsMoreButtonSelected()
		{
			IsMoreButtonSelected = Items.Any((IHamburgerSubMenuItem x) => !x.ShowInPreview && x is ISelectable && ((ISelectable)x).IsSelected);
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedItemChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			selectionLocker.Lock();
			if (!ActualIsStandaloneSelectionItemMode)
			{
				SelectionOwner.Do(delegate(ISupportSelection x)
				{
					x.SetSelectedItem(SelectedItem);
				});
			}
			(Items.ContainerFromItem(oldValue) as ISelectable).Do(delegate(ISelectable x)
			{
				x.IsSelected = false;
			});
			UpdateSelectedItemCore();
			UpdateIsMoreButtonSelected();
			RaiseEvent(new HamburgerMenuSelectedItemChangedEventArgs(this, oldValue, SelectedItem));
			selectionLocker.Unlock();
		}

		protected void ValidateSelection()
		{
			if (Owner != null && !ActualIsStandaloneSelectionItemMode)
			{
				Owner.ValidateSelection();
				SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, SelectionOwner.SelectedItem);
			}
			if (IsSelectedContainerValid)
			{
				IsSelectedContainerValid = SelectedItem == null || Items.ContainerFromItem(SelectedItem) != null;
				if (!IsSelectedContainerValid)
				{
					UpdateIsMoreButtonSelected();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateSelectedItemCore();
				if (IsSelectedContainerValid)
				{
					UpdateIsMoreButtonSelected();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedItemCore()
		{
			selectionLocker.Lock();
			IHamburgerSubMenuItem hamburgerSubMenuItem = Items.ContainerFromItem(SelectedItem);
			IsSelectedContainerValid = SelectedItem == null || hamburgerSubMenuItem != null;
			(hamburgerSubMenuItem as ISelectable).Do(delegate(ISelectable x)
			{
				x.IsSelected = true;
			});
			selectionLocker.Unlock();
		}

		void ISupportSelection.UpdateSelection(ISelectable item, bool? isSelected)
		{
			if (!ActualIsStandaloneSelectionItemMode)
			{
				SelectionOwner.UpdateSelection(item, isSelected);
			}
			UpdateSelectionCore(item, isSelected);
			UpdateIsMoreButtonSelected();
		}

		void ISupportSelection.OnItemClick(ISelectable item)
		{
			if (!ActualIsStandaloneSelectionItemMode)
			{
				SelectionOwner.OnItemClick(item);
			}
			else
			{
				ItemClickCore(item);
			}
		}

		void ISupportSelection.OnItemDoubleClick(ISelectable item)
		{
		}

		void ISupportSelection.SetSelectedItem(object item)
		{
			if (!Locker.op_Implicit(selectionLocker))
			{
				SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSelectionCore(ISelectable item, bool? isSelected)
		{
			if (item == null || Locker.op_Implicit(selectionLocker))
			{
				return;
			}
			selectionLocker.Lock();
			if (isSelected.HasValue)
			{
				if (isSelected.Value)
				{
					object obj = Items.ItemFromContainer(item as IHamburgerSubMenuItem);
					if (obj != null)
					{
						SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, obj);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, null);
				}
			}
			else if (SelectedItem == null)
			{
				SyncSelectedItem();
			}
			selectionLocker.Unlock();
		}

		protected virtual void SyncSelectedItem()
		{
			if (ActualIsStandaloneSelectionItemMode)
			{
				IHamburgerSubMenuItem container = Items.FirstOrDefault((IHamburgerSubMenuItem x) => x is ISelectable && ((ISelectable)x).IsSelected);
				SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, Items.ItemFromContainer(container));
			}
			else
			{
				if (SelectionOwner == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (SelectionOwner.SelectedItem != null)
				{
					SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, SelectionOwner.SelectedItem);
					return;
				}
				IHamburgerSubMenuItem container2 = Items.FirstOrDefault((IHamburgerSubMenuItem x) => x is ISelectable && ((ISelectable)x).IsSelected);
				SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, Items.ItemFromContainer(container2));
				SelectionOwner.SetSelectedItem(SelectedItem);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ItemClickCore(ISelectable item)
		{
			bool flag = (item as ISelectableHamburgerMenuItem).Return((ISelectableHamburgerMenuItem x) => x.SelectOnClick, () => true);
			if (item != null && !item.IsSelected && flag)
			{
				UpdateSelectionCore(item, true);
			}
		}

		internal bool CanProcessItemClick(object container)
		{
			return Owner.Return((IHamburgerMenu x) => x.CanProcessItemClick(container), () => true);
		}

		internal void OnItemShowInPreviewChanged(IHamburgerSubMenuItem item)
		{
			if (item.Owner == this && item.ShowInPreview)
			{
				InsertPreviewItem(item);
			}
			else
			{
				RemovePreviewItem(item);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RemovePreviewItem(IHamburgerSubMenuItem item)
		{
			PreviewItemsCore.Remove(PreviewItems.FirstOrDefault((HamburgerSubMenuPreviewNavigationButton x) => x.Owner == item));
			UpdateIsMoreButtonVisibile();
			UpdateIsMoreButtonSelected();
		}

		protected virtual void InsertPreviewItem(IHamburgerSubMenuItem item)
		{
			int index = (from x in Items.OfType<IHamburgerSubMenuItem>()
				where x.ShowInPreview
				select x).TakeWhile((IHamburgerSubMenuItem x) => x != item).Count();
			PreviewItemsCore.Insert(index, item.PreviewItem);
			UpdateIsMoreButtonVisibile();
			UpdateIsMoreButtonSelected();
		}

		void IHamburgerMenuFlyoutItem.ShowFlyout()
		{
			ShowFlyout();
		}

		void IHamburgerMenuFlyoutItem.HideFlyout()
		{
			HideFlyout();
		}

		void IHamburgerMenuFlyoutItem.UpdateFlyoutState()
		{
			UpdateFlyoutSettings();
		}

		object ISupportStandaloneSelection.ItemFromContainer(object container)
		{
			return Items.ItemFromContainer(container as IHamburgerSubMenuItem);
		}

		object ISupportStandaloneSelection.ContainerFromItem(object item)
		{
			return Items.ContainerFromItem(item);
		}
	}

		static HamburgerSubMenuNavigationButton()

			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<HamburgerSubMenuNavigationButton>();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<HamburgerSubMenuNavigationButton>.New().Register<bool>("ShowInPreview", ref ShowInPreviewProperty, false, (Action<HamburgerSubMenuNavigationButton, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerSubMenuNavigationButton d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs o)

		private void InitializePreviewItem()
		{
			if (previewItem == null)
			{
				previewItem = CreatePreviewItem();
				if (PreviewItemStyle != null)
				{
					previewItem.Style = PreviewItemStyle;
				}
				((ISupportOwner<HamburgerSubMenuNavigationButton>)previewItem).Owner = this;
				this.Forward(previewItem, HamburgerSubMenuPreviewNavigationButton.IsSelectedProperty, "IsSelected");
				this.Forward(previewItem, UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, "IsEnabled");
				this.Forward(previewItem, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, "Visibility");
				this.Forward(previewItem, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, "DataContext");
				SetBindingWithAltValueToProperty(previewItem, ContentControl.ContentProperty, this, PreviewContentProperty, ContentControl.ContentProperty);
				SetBindingWithAltValueToProperty(previewItem, ContentControl.ContentTemplateProperty, this, PreviewContentTemplateProperty, ContentControl.ContentTemplateProperty);
				SetBindingWithAltValueToProperty(previewItem, HamburgerSubMenuPreviewNavigationButton.RightContentProperty, this, PreviewRightContentProperty, HamburgerMenuNavigationButton<HamburgerSubMenu>.RightContentProperty);
				SetBindingWithAltValueToProperty(previewItem, HamburgerSubMenuPreviewNavigationButton.RightContentTemplateProperty, this, PreviewRightContentTemplateProperty, HamburgerMenuNavigationButton<HamburgerSubMenu>.RightContentTemplateProperty);
				InitializePreviewItemOverride();
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new HamburgerMenuSelectableButtonAutomationPeer<HamburgerSubMenuNavigationButton>(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPreviewItemStyleChanged()
		{
			if (previewItem != null)
			{
				if (PreviewItemStyle == null)
				{
					previewItem.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
				}
				else
				{
					previewItem.Style = PreviewItemStyle;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InitializePreviewItemOverride()
		{
		}

		protected virtual HamburgerSubMenuPreviewNavigationButton CreatePreviewItem()
		{
			return new HamburgerSubMenuPreviewNavigationButton();
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			if (skipClickCheck || base.Owner.Return((HamburgerSubMenu x) => x.CanProcessItemClick(this), () => true))
			{
				base.OnClick();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClickCore()
		{
			base.Owner.With((Func<HamburgerSubMenu, INavigationOwner>)((HamburgerSubMenu x) => x.Owner)).Do(delegate(INavigationOwner y)
			{
				y.CheckNavigationTargetOnSelectionChanged = true;
			});
			base.OnClickCore();
			base.Owner.With((Func<HamburgerSubMenu, INavigationOwner>)((HamburgerSubMenu x) => x.Owner)).Do(delegate(INavigationOwner y)
			{
				y.CheckNavigationTargetOnSelectionChanged = false;
			});
			if (CollapseFlyoutOnClick)
			{
				base.Owner.Do(delegate(HamburgerSubMenu x)
				{
					x.HideFlyout();
				});
			}
		}

		protected override void NavigateCore()
		{
			base.Owner.With((Func<HamburgerSubMenu, INavigationOwner>)((HamburgerSubMenu x) => x.Owner)).Do(delegate(INavigationOwner y)
			{
				y.NavigateToItem(this);
			});
		}

		internal void OnPreviewItemClick()
		{
			if (base.Owner.Return((HamburgerSubMenu x) => x.CanProcessItemClick(PreviewItem), () => true))
			{
				PreviewItemClickEventArgs args = new PreviewItemClickEventArgs();
				this.PreviewItemClick.Do(delegate(EventHandler<PreviewItemClickEventArgs> x)
				{
					x(this, args);
				});
				if (!args.Handled)
				{
					skipClickCheck = true;
					OnClick();
					skipClickCheck = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnShowInPreviewChanged()
		{
			base.Owner.Do(delegate(HamburgerSubMenu x)
			{
				x.OnItemShowInPreviewChanged(this);
			});
			UpdateIsPreviewMarkVisible();
		}

		protected override void OnOwnerChanged(HamburgerSubMenu oldValue)
		{
			base.OnOwnerChanged(oldValue);
			oldValue.Do(delegate(HamburgerSubMenu x)
			{
				x.OnItemShowInPreviewChanged(this);
			});
			base.Owner.Do(delegate(HamburgerSubMenu x)
			{
				x.OnItemShowInPreviewChanged(this);
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnShowPreviewMarkChanged()
		{
			UpdateIsPreviewMarkVisible();
		}

		protected void UpdateIsPreviewMarkVisible()
		{
			IsPreviewMarkVisible = ShowInPreview && ShowPreviewMark;
		}

		private static void SetBindingWithAltValueToProperty(DependencyObject target, DependencyProperty targetProperty, DependencyObject source, DependencyProperty sourceProperty, DependencyProperty altSourceProperty)
		{
			if (altSourceConverter == null)
			{
				altSourceConverter = new AltSourcePropertyConverter();
			}
			MultiBinding multiBinding = new MultiBinding();
			multiBinding.Bindings.Add(new Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath(sourceProperty),
				Source = source
			});
			multiBinding.Bindings.Add(new Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath(altSourceProperty),
				Source = source
			});
			multiBinding.Converter = altSourceConverter;
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(target, targetProperty, multiBinding);
		}
	}

	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Title", Type = typeof(ContentControl))]

	public class WinUIDialogWindow : DXDialogWindow, IWindowSurrogate
	{
		internal const string TitleElementName = "PART_Title";

		internal const string ContentElementName = "PART_Content";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentStyleProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TitleStyleProperty;

		private AdornerContainer adornerContainer;

		public Style ContentStyle

		public Style TitleStyle

				return (Style)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(TitleStyleProperty);

				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(TitleStyleProperty, (object)value);
			}

		Window IWindowSurrogate.RealWindow => (Window)(object)this;

		private event EventHandler activatedEvent;

		private event EventHandler deactivatedEvent;

		private event System.ComponentModel.CancelEventHandler closingEvent;

		private event EventHandler closedEvent;

		event EventHandler IWindowSurrogate.Activated

		static WinUIDialogWindow()
		{
			ContentStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ContentStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(WinUIDialogWindow), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			TitleStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TitleStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(WinUIDialogWindow), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			Window.WindowStyleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(WinUIDialogWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(WindowStyle.None));
			Window.AllowsTransparencyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(WinUIDialogWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true));
			Window.SizeToContentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(WinUIDialogWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(SizeToContent.Manual));
			Window.ResizeModeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(WinUIDialogWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ResizeMode.NoResize));
			Window.ShowInTaskbarProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(WinUIDialogWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<WinUIDialogWindow>();
			SplashScreenOwner.PreferVisualTreeForOwnerSearchProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(WinUIDialogWindow), new PropertyMetadata(true));
		}

		public WinUIDialogWindow()
		{
			((Window)this).Activated += delegate(object d, EventArgs e)
			{
				this.activatedEvent.Do(delegate(EventHandler x)
				{
					x(d, e);
				});
			};
			((Window)this).Deactivated += delegate(object d, EventArgs e)
			{
				this.deactivatedEvent.Do(delegate(EventHandler x)
				{
					x(d, e);
				});
			};
			((Window)this).Closing += delegate(object d, CancelEventArgs e)
			{
				this.closingEvent.Do(delegate(System.ComponentModel.CancelEventHandler x)
				{
					x(d, e);
				});
			};
			((Window)this).Closed += delegate(object d, EventArgs e)
			{
				this.closedEvent.Do(delegate(EventHandler x)
				{
					x(d, e);
				});
			};
		}

		public WinUIDialogWindow(string title)
			: this()

		}

		public WinUIDialogWindow(string title, MessageBoxButton dialogButtons, MessageBoxResult? defaultButton = null, MessageBoxResult? cancelButton = null)
			: this(title, DXDialogWindow.GenerateUICommands(dialogButtons, defaultButton, cancelButton))
		{
		}

		public WinUIDialogWindow(string title, IEnumerable<UICommand> commands)
			: this()
		{
			((Window)this).Title = title;
			((DXDialogWindow)this).CommandsSource = commands;
		}

		public void Show()
		{
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0078: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).BeginInit();
			((DXDialogWindow)this).BeforeShow();
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).EndInit();
			FrameworkElement rootElement = (FrameworkElement)((Control)this).Template.LoadContent();
			WindowStorage windowStorage = (WindowStorage)rootElement.Resources["windowStorage"];
			windowStorage.Window = this;
			AdornerDecorator adornerDecorator = LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualChildren((DependencyObject)((Window)this).Owner).OfType<AdornerDecorator>().First();
			adornerContainer = new AdornerContainer((UIElement)adornerDecorator, (UIElement)rootElement);
			((FrameworkElement)(object)adornerContainer).Tag = new object[2] { adornerDecorator.Child, this };
			AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(adornerDecorator.Child).Add((Adorner)(object)adornerContainer);
			rootElement.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualChildren((DependencyObject)rootElement).OfType<Control>().FirstOrDefault((Control x) => x.Focusable && x.IsEnabled)
					.Do(delegate(Control x)
					{
						x.Focus();
					});
			}, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
			this.activatedEvent.Do(delegate(EventHandler x)
			{
				x(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			});
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			if (((Window)this).Owner != null)
			{
				((Window)this).Owner.SizeChanged -= OnSizeChanged;
			}
			if (!base.IsDialogMode && adornerContainer != null)
			{
				CancelEventArgs args = new CancelEventArgs();
				this.closingEvent.Do(delegate(System.ComponentModel.CancelEventHandler x)
				{
					x(this, args);
				});
				if (!args.Cancel)
				{
					this.deactivatedEvent.Do(delegate(EventHandler x)
					{
						x(this, EventArgs.Empty);
					});
					this.closedEvent.Do(delegate(EventHandler x)
					{
						x(this, EventArgs.Empty);
					});
					object[] array = (object[])((FrameworkElement)(object)adornerContainer).Tag;
					AdornerLayer adornerLayer = AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer((FrameworkElement)array[0]);
					adornerLayer.Remove((Adorner)(object)adornerContainer);
					((FrameworkElement)(object)adornerContainer).Tag = null;
					adornerContainer = null;
					((DXWindow)this).OnClose();
					AdornerContainer val = LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualChildren((DependencyObject)adornerLayer).OfType<AdornerContainer>().LastOrDefault();
					if (val != null && ((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Tag != null)
					{
						WinUIDialogWindow winUIDialogWindow = ((object[])((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Tag)[1] as WinUIDialogWindow;
						winUIDialogWindow.Activate();
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((Window)this).Close();
			}
		}

		public bool Activate()
		{
			if (base.IsDialogMode)
			{
				return ((Window)this).Activate();
			}
			this.activatedEvent.Do(delegate(EventHandler x)
			{
				x(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			});
			return true;
		}

		protected override void BeforeShow()
		{
			((DXDialogWindow)this).BeforeShow();
			Init();
			if (((Window)this).Owner != null)
			{
				((Window)this).Owner.SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
			}
			((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(delegate
			{
				if (((Window)this).Owner == null && base.IsDialogMode)
				{
					Activate();
				}
			});
		}

		protected override void CloseCore(UICommand command)
		{
			if (!base.IsDialogMode)
			{
				Close();
			}
			else
			{
				((DXDialogWindow)this).CloseCore(command);
			}
		}

		private void Init()
		{
			if (((Window)this).Owner == null)
			{
				Window owner = GetOwner();
				((Window)this).Owner = (((object)owner != this) ? owner : null);
			}
			((Window)this).WindowStyle = WindowStyle.None;
			((Window)this).AllowsTransparency = true;
			((Window)this).SizeToContent = SizeToContent.Manual;
			((Window)this).WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.Manual;
			SetSize();
		}

		private void OnSizeChanged(object source, SizeChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			SetSize();
		}

		private void SetSize()
		{
			Rect rect = ((((Window)this).Owner != null && ((Window)this).Owner.WindowState == WindowState.Minimized) ? LayoutHelper.GetScreenRect((FrameworkElement)null) : LayoutHelper.GetScreenRect((FrameworkElement)((Window)this).Owner));
			((Window)this).Left = rect.Left;
			((Window)this).Top = rect.Top;
			((FrameworkElement)this).Width = rect.Width;
			((FrameworkElement)this).Height = rect.Height;
		}

		private static Window GetOwner()
		{
			Func<Window, bool> func = (Window x) => x.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && x.WindowState != WindowState.Minimized;
			if (Application.Current == null || !Application.Current.Dispatcher.CheckAccess())
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (Window window3 in Application.Current.Windows)
			{
				if (window3.IsActive && func(window3))
				{
					return window3;
				}
			}
			if (Application.Current.Windows.Count > 0)
			{
				Window window2 = Application.Current.Windows[0];
				if (func(window2))
				{
					return window2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		void IWindowSurrogate.Show()
		{
			Show();
		}

		void IWindowSurrogate.Close()
		{
			Close();
		}

		bool IWindowSurrogate.Activate()
		{
			return Activate();
		}
	}

		protected override void ClearTemplateChildren()
		{
			Action<FadingButton, RoutedEventHandler> action = delegate(FadingButton button, RoutedEventHandler onClick)
			{
				if (button != null)
				{
					button.Click -= onClick;
					button.ClearValue(UIElement.IsManipulationEnabledProperty);
				}
			};
			action(PartPrevButtonHorz, previousButton_Click);
			action(PartNextButtonHorz, nextButton_Click);
			action(PartPrevButtonVert, previousButton_Click);
			action(PartNextButtonVert, nextButton_Click);
			base.ClearTemplateChildren();
		}

		{
			return new FlipViewItem();
		}

		{
			base.GetTemplateChildren();
			PartScrollViewer = GetTemplateChild("ScrollingHost") as ScrollViewer;
			PartPrevButtonHorz = GetTemplateChild("PreviousButtonHorizontal") as FadingButton;
			PartNextButtonHorz = GetTemplateChild("NextButtonHorizontal") as FadingButton;
			PartPrevButtonVert = GetTemplateChild("PreviousButtonVertical") as FadingButton;
			PartNextButtonVert = GetTemplateChild("NextButtonVertical") as FadingButton;
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)

			return item is FlipViewItem;
		}

		protected override void OnApplyTemplateComplete()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplateComplete();
			if (PartScrollViewer != null)
			{
				PartScrollViewer.CanContentScroll = true;
				PartScrollViewer.SizeChanged += PartScrollViewer_SizeChanged;
				_reflectionHelper.SetPropertyValue((object)PartScrollViewer, "HandlesMouseWheelScrolling", (object)false, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.SetProperty);
			}
			Func<FadingButton, ButtonDirection, RoutedEventHandler, FadingButton> func = delegate(FadingButton button, ButtonDirection direction, RoutedEventHandler onClick)
			{
				if (button != null)
				{
					button.Direction = direction;
					button.Click += onClick;
					button.SetBinding(UIElement.IsManipulationEnabledProperty, new Binding("IsManipulationEnabled")
					{
						Source = this
					});
				}
				return button;
			};
			func(PartPrevButtonHorz, ButtonDirection.Left, previousButton_Click);
			func(PartNextButtonHorz, ButtonDirection.Right, nextButton_Click);
			func(PartPrevButtonVert, ButtonDirection.Up, previousButton_Click);
			func(PartNextButtonVert, ButtonDirection.Down, nextButton_Click);
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(UpdateKeys));
		}

		protected override object OnCoerceSelectedIndex(int value)
		{
			if (!manipulationCanceled)
			{
				manipulationCanceled = false;
				return base.OnCoerceSelectedIndex(value);
			}
			manipulationCanceled = false;
			return base.SelectedIndex;
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsManipulationInertiaEnabledChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)

			manipulationHelper.IsManipulationInertiaEnabled = newValue;
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemSizeChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
		}

		{
			ResetTimer();
			UpdateKeys();
		}

		protected virtual void OnOrientationChanged(Orientation oldValue, Orientation newValue)
		{
			UpdateKeys();
			if (PartScrollViewer != null)
			{
				if (ItemSizeMode == ItemSizeMode.Auto)
				{
					SetScrollViewerOffsetDependingOrientation(FlipPanel.GetChildrenDesiredLength(base.SelectedIndex, newValue));
					return;
				}
				ItemSize = ((newValue == Orientation.Horizontal) ? PartScrollViewer.ViewportWidth : PartScrollViewer.ViewportHeight);
				SetScrollViewerOffsetDependingOrientation((double)base.SelectedIndex * ItemSize);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
			if (e.OriginalSource is FadingButton || e.OriginalSource == PartScrollViewer)
			{
				switch (e.Key)
				{
				case Key.Left:
				case Key.Up:
					PrevItem();
					e.Handled = true;
					break;
				case Key.Right:
				case Key.Down:
					NextItem();
					e.Handled = true;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSelectedIndexChanged(int oldValue, int newValue)
		{
			base.OnSelectedIndexChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			FlipPanel.Do(delegate(FlipPanel x)
			{
				x.SelectedIndex = newValue;
			});
			if (canceled)
			{
				canceled = false;
				return;
			}
			if (lockSelectedIndex == 0 && PartScrollViewer != null && base.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				if (ItemSizeMode == ItemSizeMode.Auto)
				{
					if (FlipPanel != null)
					{
						int num2 = Math.Min(newValue, FlipPanel.Children.Count);
						for (int num3 = 0; num3 < num2; num3++)
						{
							UIElement uIElement = FlipPanel.Children[num3];
							num += ((Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? uIElement.DesiredSize.Width : uIElement.DesiredSize.Height);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num = (double)base.SelectedIndex * ItemSize;
				}
				double scrollViewerOffsetAfterAnimation = GetScrollViewerOffsetAfterAnimation();
				if (IsAnimationEnabled)
				{
					ScrollWithAnimation(scrollViewerOffsetAfterAnimation, num, 500.0);
				}
				else
				{
					SetScrollViewerOffsetDependingOrientation(num);
				}
			}
			timerElapsed = false;
			UpdateKeys();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateKeys()
		{
			if (PartPrevButtonHorz == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HideButton(PartPrevButtonHorz);
			HideButton(PartPrevButtonVert);
			HideButton(PartNextButtonHorz);
			HideButton(PartNextButtonVert);
			FadingButton button = ((Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? PartPrevButtonHorz : PartPrevButtonVert);
			FadingButton button2 = ((Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? PartNextButtonHorz : PartNextButtonVert);
			if (base.IsMouseOver && !CanHideNavigationButtons())
			{
				if (base.SelectedIndex > 0 && ShowPreviousButton)
				{
					ShowButton(button);
				}
				else
				{
					HideButton(button);
				}
				if (base.SelectedIndex < base.Items.Count - 1 && ShowNextButton)
				{
					ShowButton(button2);
				}
				else
				{
					HideButton(button2);
				}
			}
		}

		private double GetScrollViewerOffsetAfterAnimation()
		{
			if (currentAnimation != null)
			{
				return ((DoubleAnimation)currentAnimation.Children[0]).To.Value;
			}
			if (PartScrollViewer == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return ScrollViewerBehavior.GetVerticalOffset(PartScrollViewer);
			}
			return ScrollViewerBehavior.GetHorizontalOffset(PartScrollViewer);
		}

		private void HideButton(FadingButton button)
		{
			button.SetIsVisible(isVisible: false);
		}

		private bool IsValidIndex(int index)
		{
			if (index < base.Items.Count)
			{
				return index >= 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void keyTimer_Elapsed(object sender, ElapsedEventArgs e)
		{
			keyTimer.Stop();
			timerElapsed = true;
			base.Dispatcher.Invoke(new Action(UpdateKeys), null);
		}

		private void nextButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			NextItem();
		}

		private void NextItem()
		{
			if (base.SelectedIndex != base.Items.Count - 1)
			{
				ResetTimer();
				base.SelectedIndex++;
				if (NextCommand != null && NextCommand.CanExecute(null))
				{
					NextCommand.Execute(null);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnManipulationCompletedCore(double velocityX, double velocityY)
		{
			FlipPanel.Do(delegate(FlipPanel x)
			{
				x.IsManipulated = false;
			});
			double num = ((Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? velocityX : velocityY);
			double num2 = GetScrollViewerOffsetAfterAnimation();
			double num3 = num2;
			double num4 = 0.5;
			if (!manipulationCanceled && Math.Abs(num) > num4 && !IsManipulationInertiaEnabled)
			{
				int num5 = -1;
				if (ItemSizeMode == ItemSizeMode.Auto && FlipPanel != null)
				{
					num5 = ((num > 0.0) ? (base.SelectedIndex - 1) : (base.SelectedIndex + 1));
					if (IsValidIndex(num5))
					{
						lockSelectedIndex++;
						base.SelectedIndex = num5;
						lockSelectedIndex--;
						num3 = FlipPanel.GetChildrenDesiredLength(num5, Orientation);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num5 = ((num > 0.0) ? ((int)(num2 / ItemSize)) : ((int)(num2 / ItemSize + 1.0)));
					if (IsValidIndex(num5))
					{
						num3 = (double)num5 * ItemSize;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (ItemSizeMode == ItemSizeMode.Auto && FlipPanel != null)
			{
				int num6 = FlipPanel.CalculateAfterManipulationSelectedIndex(num2);
				lockSelectedIndex++;
				base.SelectedIndex = num6;
				lockSelectedIndex--;
				num3 = FlipPanel.GetChildrenDesiredLength(num6, Orientation);
				num2 = ((Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? PartScrollViewer.HorizontalOffset : PartScrollViewer.VerticalOffset);
				if (num2 == num3)
				{
					FlipPanel.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = Math.Round(ItemSize * Math.Round(num2 / ItemSize) + 0.5);
			}
			ScrollWithAnimation(num2, num3, 300.0);
			manipulationInProgress = false;
		}

		private void OnManipulationDeltaCore(ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			if (manipulationCanceled || (!manipulationInProgress && !RaiseSelectionChanging(base.SelectedIndex, base.SelectedIndex - Math.Sign(e.DeltaManipulation.Translation.X))))
			{
				manipulationCanceled = true;
			}
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				if ((base.SelectedIndex == 0 && e.DeltaManipulation.Translation.X > 0.0) || (base.SelectedIndex == base.Items.Count - 1 && e.DeltaManipulation.Translation.X < 0.0))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			else if ((base.SelectedIndex == 0 && e.DeltaManipulation.Translation.Y > 0.0) || (base.SelectedIndex == base.Items.Count - 1 && e.DeltaManipulation.Translation.Y < 0.0))
			{
				return;
			}
			manipulationInProgress = true;
			if (manipulationCanceled)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = 1.0 + (e.DeltaManipulation.Scale.X - 1.0) / 1.0;
			double num2 = 1.0 + (e.DeltaManipulation.Scale.Y - 1.0) / 1.0;
			double num3 = 0.0005;
			bool flag = Math.Abs(num - 1.0) <= num3;
			bool flag2 = Math.Abs(num2 - 1.0) <= num3;
			if (flag && flag2)
			{
				double scrollViewerOffsetAfterAnimation = GetScrollViewerOffsetAfterAnimation();
				if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					ScrollViewerBehavior.SetHorizontalOffset(PartScrollViewer, scrollViewerOffsetAfterAnimation - e.DeltaManipulation.Translation.X);
				}
				else
				{
					ScrollViewerBehavior.SetVerticalOffset(PartScrollViewer, scrollViewerOffsetAfterAnimation - e.DeltaManipulation.Translation.Y);
				}
			}
		}

		private void PartScrollViewer_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ItemSizeMode == ItemSizeMode.Auto)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (FlipPanel != null)
			{
				if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					ItemSize = FlipPanel.ViewportWidth;
					ScrollViewerBehavior.SetHorizontalOffset(PartScrollViewer, (double)base.SelectedIndex * ItemSize);
				}
				else
				{
					ItemSize = FlipPanel.ViewportHeight;
					ScrollViewerBehavior.SetVerticalOffset(PartScrollViewer, (double)base.SelectedIndex * ItemSize);
				}
				return;
			}
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					ItemSize = PartScrollViewer.ViewportWidth;
					ScrollViewerBehavior.SetHorizontalOffset(PartScrollViewer, (double)base.SelectedIndex * ItemSize);
				}
				else
				{
					ItemSize = PartScrollViewer.ViewportHeight;
					ScrollViewerBehavior.SetVerticalOffset(PartScrollViewer, (double)base.SelectedIndex * ItemSize);
				}
			});
		}

		private void previousButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			PrevItem();
		}

		private void PrevItem()
		{
			if (base.SelectedIndex != 0)
			{
				ResetTimer();
				base.SelectedIndex--;
				if (PreviousCommand != null && PreviousCommand.CanExecute(null))
				{
					PreviousCommand.Execute(null);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResetTimer()
		{
			if (!((DateTime.Now - lastStartTime).TotalMilliseconds < 100.0))
			{
				lastStartTime = DateTime.Now;
				keyTimer.Stop();
				keyTimer.Start();
				timerElapsed = false;
			}
		}

		private void ScrollWithAnimation(double from, double to, double duration)
		{
			if (from == to)
			{
				SyncSelectedIndexWithOffset(to);
				return;
			}
			StopAnimation();
			DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation
			{
				From = from,
				To = to,
				Duration = new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(duration)),
				FillBehavior = FillBehavior.HoldEnd,
				EasingFunction = new ExponentialEase
				{
					EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseIn
				}
			};
			Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation, new PropertyPath((Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? ScrollViewerBehavior.HorizontalOffsetProperty : ScrollViewerBehavior.VerticalOffsetProperty));
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			storyboard.Children.Add(doubleAnimation);
			Storyboard.SetTarget(storyboard, PartScrollViewer);
			storyboard.Completed += delegate
			{
				currentAnimation = null;
				SetScrollViewerOffsetDependingOrientation(to);
				storyboard.Stop();
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					SyncSelectedIndexWithOffset(to);
				});
			};
			currentAnimation = storyboard;
			storyboard.Begin();
		}

		private void SetScrollViewerOffsetDependingOrientation(double to)
		{
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				ScrollViewerBehavior.SetHorizontalOffset(PartScrollViewer, to);
				ScrollViewerBehavior.SetVerticalOffset(PartScrollViewer, 0.0);
			}
			else
			{
				ScrollViewerBehavior.SetHorizontalOffset(PartScrollViewer, 0.0);
				ScrollViewerBehavior.SetVerticalOffset(PartScrollViewer, to);
			}
		}

		private void ShowButton(FadingButton button)
		{
			button.SetIsVisible(isVisible: true);
		}

		private void StopAnimation()
		{
			if (currentAnimation != null)
			{
				currentAnimation.SkipToFill();
				currentAnimation.Stop();
				currentAnimation = null;
			}
		}

		private void SyncSelectedIndexWithOffset(double offset)
		{
			if (ItemSizeMode != ItemSizeMode.Auto)
			{
				lockSelectedIndex++;
				if (ItemSize != 0.0)
				{
					base.SelectedIndex = Math.Min((int)(offset / ItemSize + 0.5), base.Items.Count - 1);
				}
				lockSelectedIndex--;
			}
		}

		void ISupportManipulation.OnManipulationCompleted(ManipulationCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnManipulationCompletedCore(e.FinalVelocities.LinearVelocity.X, e.FinalVelocities.LinearVelocity.Y);
		}

		void ISupportManipulation.OnManipulationDelta(ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			OnManipulationDeltaCore(e);
		}

		void ISupportManipulation.OnManipulationInertiaStarting(ManipulationInertiaStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.TranslationBehavior.DesiredDeceleration = 0.005;
		}

		void ISupportManipulation.OnManipulationStarting(ManipulationStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.ManipulationContainer = this;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool ISupportManipulation.get_IsManipulationEnabled()
		{
			return base.IsManipulationEnabled;
		}
	}

	[ContentProperty("Items")]
	public class MenuFlyout : FlyoutBase, ILogicalOwner, IInputElement
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ItemStyleProperty;

		private MenuFlyoutItem _currentSelection;

		private readonly List<object> logicalHost = new List<object>();

		public object ItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ItemsSourceProperty);
			}
			set

			}
		}

		public DataTemplate ItemTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)GetValue(ItemTemplateProperty);

		public DataTemplateSelector ItemTemplateSelector
		{
			get

			set

		public Style ItemStyle
		{

			{

				SetValue(ItemStyleProperty, value);

		public MenuFlyoutItemCollection Items
		{
			get

				if (_Items == null)

					_Items = new MenuFlyoutItemCollection

					};
				}

		internal MenuFlyoutItem CurrentSelection

			get

			}

				{
					flag = _currentSelection.IsKeyboardFocused;
				}
				_currentSelection = value;
				if (_currentSelection != null && flag)

					_currentSelection.Focus();

		private bool HasItems => Items.Count > 0;

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren => (IEnumerator)new MergedEnumerator(new IEnumerator[2]
		{
