			logicalHost.GetEnumerator()
		});

		static MenuFlyout()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(MenuFlyout);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<MenuFlyout>();
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("ItemsAttachedBehavior", typeof(ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<MenuFlyout, MenuFlyoutItem>), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new UIPropertyMetadata(null));
			ItemsSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemsSource", typeof(object), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnItemsSourcePropertyChanged));
			ItemTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnItemTemplatePropertyChanged));
			ItemTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnItemTemplatePropertyChanged));
			ItemStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemStyle", typeof(Style), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnItemTemplatePropertyChanged));
			IsSelectedChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("IsSelectedChanged", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedPropertyChangedEventHandler<bool>), typeof(MenuFlyout));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(MenuFlyout), IsSelectedChangedEvent, new RoutedPropertyChangedEventHandler<bool>(OnIsSelectedChanged));
		}

		private static void OnItemsSourcePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((MenuFlyout)d).OnItemsSourceChanged(e);
		}

		private static void OnItemTemplatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((MenuFlyout)d).OnItemTemplateChanged(e);
		}

		private static void OnIsSelectedChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<bool> e)
		{
			if (!(e.OriginalSource is MenuFlyoutItem menuFlyoutItem))
			{
				return;
			}
			MenuFlyout menuFlyout = (MenuFlyout)sender;
			if (e.NewValue)
			{
				if (menuFlyout.CurrentSelection != menuFlyoutItem && menuFlyout.Items.Contains(menuFlyoutItem))
				{
					menuFlyout.CurrentSelection = menuFlyoutItem;
				}
			}
			else if (menuFlyout.CurrentSelection == menuFlyoutItem)
			{
				menuFlyout.CurrentSelection = null;
			}
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void OnItemsSourceChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewValue is IEnumerable || e.OldValue is IEnumerable)
			{
				ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<MenuFlyout, MenuFlyoutItem>.OnItemsSourcePropertyChanged((DependencyObject)this, e, ItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty, ItemTemplateProperty, ItemTemplateSelectorProperty, ItemStyleProperty, (Func<MenuFlyout, IList>)((MenuFlyout control) => control.Items), (Func<MenuFlyout, MenuFlyoutItem>)((MenuFlyout control) => control.CreateItem()), (Action<int, object>)null, (Action<MenuFlyoutItem>)InitItem, (ISupportInitialize)null, (Action<MenuFlyoutItem, object>)null, true, true, (Func<MenuFlyoutItem, bool>)null, false);
			}
		}

		private void OnItemTemplateChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<MenuFlyout, MenuFlyoutItem>.OnItemsGeneratorTemplatePropertyChanged((DependencyObject)this, e, ItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void InitItem(FrameworkElement item)
		{
			item.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentProperty, new Binding("DataContext")
			{
				Source = item
			});
		}

		protected virtual MenuFlyoutItem CreateItem()
		{
			return new MenuFlyoutItem();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			if (!base.HasCapture && !base.IsMouseOver && CurrentSelection != null && !CurrentSelection.IsKeyboardFocused)
			{
				CurrentSelection = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(e);
			if (!base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && !base.IsMenuMode && CurrentSelection != null)
			{
				CurrentSelection = null;
			}
		}

		internal override void KeyboardLeaveMenuMode()
		{
			if (base.IsMenuMode)
			{
				base.IsMenuMode = false;
			}
			else
			{
				CurrentSelection = null;
				RestorePreviousFocus();
			}
			base.KeyboardLeaveMenuMode();
		}

		internal override void OnLeaveMenuMode()
		{
			if (CurrentSelection != null)
			{
				CurrentSelection = null;
			}
		}

		private FrameworkElement FindFocusable(int startIndex, int direction, out int foundIndex)
		{
			if (HasItems)
			{
				int count = Items.Count;
				while (startIndex >= 0 && startIndex < count)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = Items[startIndex];
					if (frameworkElement != null && frameworkElement.Focusable)
					{
						foundIndex = startIndex;
						return frameworkElement;
					}
					startIndex += direction;
				}
			}
			foundIndex = -1;
			return null;
		}

		private void NavigateToItem(FrameworkElement item, int index)
		{
			if (index != -1 && item != null)
			{
				item.BringIntoView();
				item.Focus();
			}
		}

		private void NavigateToStart()
		{
			if (HasItems)
			{
				int foundIndex;
				FrameworkElement item = FindFocusable(0, 1, out foundIndex);
				NavigateToItem(item, foundIndex);
			}
		}

		private void NavigateToEnd()
		{
			if (HasItems)
			{
				int foundIndex;
				FrameworkElement item = FindFocusable(Items.Count - 1, -1, out foundIndex);
				NavigateToItem(item, foundIndex);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			if (e.Handled || !base.IsOpen)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Up:
				if (CurrentSelection == null)
				{
					NavigateToEnd();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case Key.Down:
				if (CurrentSelection == null)
				{
					NavigateToStart();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyUp(e);
			if (!e.Handled && base.IsOpen && e.Key == Key.Apps)
			{
				base.KeyboardLeaveMenuMode();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		void ILogicalOwner.AddChild(object child)
		{
			if (!logicalHost.Contains(child))
			{
				logicalHost.Add(child);
			}
			AddLogicalChild(child);
		}

		void ILogicalOwner.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			logicalHost.Remove(child);
			RemoveLogicalChild(child);
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool ILogicalOwner.get_IsLoaded()
		{
			return base.IsLoaded;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ILogicalOwner.add_Loaded(RoutedEventHandler value)
		{
			base.Loaded += value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ILogicalOwner.remove_Loaded(RoutedEventHandler value)
		{
			base.Loaded -= value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		double ILogicalOwner.get_ActualWidth()
		{
			return base.ActualWidth;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		double ILogicalOwner.get_ActualHeight()
		{
			return base.ActualHeight;
		}
	}
	public class MenuFlyoutItem : ClickableBase, ICommandSource
	{
		private class MenuFlyoutItemController : ClickableController
		{
			public MenuFlyoutItem Control => ((ControlControllerBase)this).Control as MenuFlyoutItem;

			public MenuFlyoutItemController(IControl control)
				: base(control)
			{
			}

			public override void UpdateState(bool useTransitions)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(stateName: (!Control.IsEnabled) ? "Disabled" : (((Controller)this).IsMouseLeftButtonDown ? "Pressed" : ((!((Controller)this).IsMouseEntered && !FocusHelper.IsKeyboardFocusWithin((UIElement)Control)) ? "Normal" : "MouseOver")), control: Control, useTransitions: useTransitions);
			}
		}

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty IsSelectedProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty StaysOpenOnClickProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CommandProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CommandParameterProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CommandTargetProperty;

		private bool _CanExecute = true;

		public bool IsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsSelectedProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(IsSelectedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool StaysOpenOnClick
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(StaysOpenOnClickProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(StaysOpenOnClickProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ICommand Command
		{
			get
			{
				return (ICommand)GetValue(CommandProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CommandProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public object CommandParameter
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(CommandParameterProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CommandParameterProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public IInputElement CommandTarget
		{
			get
			{
				return (IInputElement)GetValue(CommandTargetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CommandTargetProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private bool CanExecute
		{
			get
			{
				return _CanExecute;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _CanExecute)
				{
					_CanExecute = value;
					CoerceValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsEnabledCore
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.IsEnabledCore)
				{
					return CanExecute;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		static MenuFlyoutItem()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(MenuFlyoutItem);
			IsSelectedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsSelected", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false, OnIsSelectedChanged));
			StaysOpenOnClickProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("StaysOpenOnClick", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			CommandProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Command", typeof(ICommand), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnCommandChanged));
			CommandParameterProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CommandParameter", typeof(object), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			CommandTargetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CommandTarget", typeof(IInputElement), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuFlyoutItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.None));
			FrameworkElement.FocusVisualStyleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuFlyoutItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			InputMethod.IsInputMethodSuspendedProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(MenuFlyoutItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));
		}

		private static void OnIsSelectedChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is MenuFlyoutItem menuFlyoutItem)
			{
				menuFlyoutItem.OnIsSelectedChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void OnCommandChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is MenuFlyoutItem menuFlyoutItem)
			{
				menuFlyoutItem.OnCommandChanged((ICommand)e.OldValue, (ICommand)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		public MenuFlyoutItem()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<MenuFlyoutItem>(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			((ControlControllerBase)base.Controller).UpdateState(true);
			RaiseEvent(new RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<bool>(oldValue, newValue, MenuFlyout.IsSelectedChangedEvent));
		}

		private void OnCommandChanged(ICommand oldCommand, ICommand newCommand)
		{
			if (oldCommand != null)
			{
				UnhookCommand(oldCommand);
			}
			if (newCommand != null)
			{
				HookCommand(newCommand);
			}
		}

		private void UnhookCommand(ICommand command)
		{
			command.CanExecuteChanged -= OnCanExecuteChanged;
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private void HookCommand(ICommand command)
		{
			command.CanExecuteChanged += OnCanExecuteChanged;
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private void OnCanExecuteChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private void UpdateCanExecute()
		{
			CanExecute = Command == null || CommandHelper.CanExecuteCommand(this);
		}

		protected override void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(e);
			IsSelected = base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			if (!base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				Focus();
			}
			if (!IsSelected)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(IsSelectedProperty, true);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			Key key = e.Key;
			if (key == Key.Return || key == Key.Space)
			{
				base.Controller.InvokeClick();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnGotKeyboardFocus(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnGotKeyboardFocus(e);
			((ControlControllerBase)base.Controller).UpdateState(true);
		}

		protected override void OnLostKeyboardFocus(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLostKeyboardFocus(e);
			((ControlControllerBase)base.Controller).UpdateState(true);
		}

		protected override ControlControllerBase CreateController()
		{
			return (ControlControllerBase)(object)new MenuFlyoutItemController((IControl)(object)this);
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			base.OnClick();
			if (!StaysOpenOnClick)
			{
				FlyoutBase flyout = FlyoutBase.GetFlyout(this);
				if (flyout == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (flyout.Service != null)
				{
					flyout.Service.Hide(flyout);
				}
				else if (flyout.IsOpen)
				{
					flyout.IsOpen = false;
				}
			}
			CommandHelper.ExecuteCommand(this);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			IsSelected = false;
			if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(this)?.Focus();
			}
		}
	}
	public class MenuFlyoutItemCollection : ObservableCollection<FrameworkElement>
	{
		internal ILogicalOwner Owner { get; set; }

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			object item = base[index];
			Owner.Do(delegate(ILogicalOwner x)
			{
				x.RemoveChild(item);
			});
			base.RemoveItem(index);
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, FrameworkElement item)
		{
			Owner.Do(delegate(ILogicalOwner x)
			{
				x.AddChild((object)item);
			});
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
		}
	}

		static Flyout()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<Flyout> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<Flyout>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<Flyout>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("Content", ref ContentProperty, null, OnContentChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("ContentTemplate", ref ContentTemplateProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("ContentTemplateSelector", ref ContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ICommand>("Command", ref CommandProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("CommandParameter", ref CommandParameterProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<IInputElement>("CommandTarget", ref CommandTargetProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("CloseOnCommandExecute", ref CloseOnCommandExecuteProperty, defValue: true);
		}

		private static void OnContentChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((Flyout)d).OnContentChanged(e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				AddLogicalChild(newValue);
			}
		}
	}
	public class WinUIMessageBox : DXMessageBox

		protected override void InitFloatingContainerCore(FrameworkElement owner, string messageBoxText, string caption, MessageBoxImage icon, MessageBoxButton button, FloatingMode desiredFloatingMode, bool showCloseButton, bool closeOnEscape, bool allowShowAnimation)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0109: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((DXMessageBox)this).InitFloatingContainerCore(owner, messageBoxText, caption, icon, button, desiredFloatingMode, showCloseButton, closeOnEscape, allowShowAnimation);
			if ((int)desiredFloatingMode == 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			((BaseFloatingContainer)base.fc).ContainerTemplate = null;
			base.fc.SizeToContent = SizeToContent.Manual;
			base.fc.ContainerStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.Manual;
			Window window = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Window>((DependencyObject)owner) ?? Window.GetWindow(owner);
			bool flag = window?.IsLoaded ?? false;
			bool flag2 = flag && window.WindowState == WindowState.Maximized;
			bool flag3 = flag && window.WindowState == WindowState.Minimized;
			if ((int)desiredFloatingMode == 1)
			{
				FloatingContainer fc = base.fc;
				FloatingWindowContainer val = (FloatingWindowContainer)(object)((fc is FloatingWindowContainer) ? fc : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					if (flag && !flag3)
					{
						Rect rect = (flag2 ? LayoutHelper.GetScreenRect((FrameworkElement)window) : new Rect(window.Left, window.Top, window.ActualWidth, window.ActualHeight));
						System.Windows.Point point = window.TransformFromDeviceDPI(rect.Location);
						((BaseFloatingContainer)base.fc).FloatLocation = owner.PointFromScreen(point);
						((BaseFloatingContainer)base.fc).FloatSize = rect.Size;
					}
					else
					{
						((Window)(object)val.Window).WindowState = WindowState.Maximized;
					}
				}
			}
			if ((int)desiredFloatingMode == 0)
			{
				FloatingContainer fc2 = base.fc;
				FloatingAdornerContainer val2 = (FloatingAdornerContainer)(object)((fc2 is FloatingAdornerContainer) ? fc2 : null);
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					val2.UseSizingMargin = false;
				}
				if (window != null)
				{
					((BaseFloatingContainer)base.fc).FloatSize = new System.Windows.Size(window.ActualWidth, window.ActualHeight);
				}
				((BaseFloatingContainer)base.fc).FloatLocation = default(System.Windows.Point);
				base.fc.DeactivateOnClose = true;
			}
			((DXMessageBox)this).Caption = caption;
		}

		protected override FloatingContainer CreateFloatingContainer(FloatingMode floatingMode)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)floatingMode != 0)
			{
				if ((int)floatingMode == 1)
				{
					return (FloatingContainer)(object)new WinUIFloatingWindowContainer();
				}
				return ((DXMessageBox)this).CreateFloatingContainer(floatingMode);
			}
			return (FloatingContainer)(object)new WinUIFloatingAdornerContainer();
		}

	internal class ManipulationHelper
	{
		private bool _IsManipulationInertiaEnabled;

		private ISupportManipulation Owner;

		public bool IsManipulationInertiaEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsManipulationInertiaEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_IsManipulationInertiaEnabled != value)
				{
					_IsManipulationInertiaEnabled = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public ManipulationHelper(ISupportManipulation owner)
		{
			if (owner is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				Owner = owner;
				frameworkElement.ManipulationInertiaStarting += OnManipulationInertiaStarting;
				frameworkElement.ManipulationDelta += OnManipulationDelta;
				frameworkElement.ManipulationCompleted += OnManipulationCompleted;
				frameworkElement.ManipulationStarting += OnManipulationStarting;
			}
		}

		private void OnManipulationCompleted(object sender, ManipulationCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			Owner.OnManipulationCompleted(e);
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void OnManipulationDelta(object sender, ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			Owner.OnManipulationDelta(e);
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void OnManipulationInertiaStarting(object sender, ManipulationInertiaStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsManipulationInertiaEnabled)
			{
				Owner.OnManipulationInertiaStarting(e);
			}
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void OnManipulationStarting(object sender, ManipulationStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			Owner.OnManipulationStarting(e);
		}
	}

					if (_AttachedJournal != null)
					{
						_AttachedJournal.PropertyChanged += UpdateJournalProperties;
					}
					UpdateNavigationCacheProperties();
				}
			}

		static NavigationFrame()
		{
			AnimationType animationType = AnimationType.Fade;
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<NavigationFrame>();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<NavigationFrame>.New().Register<bool?>("AllowMerging", ref AllowMergingProperty, (bool?)null, (Action<NavigationFrame>)delegate(NavigationFrame d)
			{
				d.OnAllowMergingChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None).RegisterReadOnly<AnimationDirection>("AnimationDirection", ref AnimationDirectionPropertyKey, ref AnimationDirectionProperty, AnimationDirection.Forward, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<AnimationSelector>("AnimationSelector", ref AnimationSelectorProperty, (AnimationSelector)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("AnimationSpeedRatio", ref AnimationSpeedRatioProperty, 1.0, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<AnimationType>("AnimationType", ref AnimationTypeProperty, animationType, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<BackNavigationMode>("BackNavigationMode", ref BackNavigationModeProperty, BackNavigationMode.PreviousScreen, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<bool>("CanGoBack", ref CanGoBackPropertyKey, ref CanGoBackProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<bool>("CanGoForward", ref CanGoForwardPropertyKey, ref CanGoForwardProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<INavigationContentProvider>("ContentProvider", ref ContentProviderProperty, (INavigationContentProvider)null, (Action<NavigationFrame, INavigationContentProvider, INavigationContentProvider>)delegate(NavigationFrame d, INavigationContentProvider oldValue, INavigationContentProvider newValue)
				{
					d.OnContentProviderChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<IJournal>("Journal", ref JournalProperty, (IJournal)null, (Action<NavigationFrame, IJournal, IJournal>)delegate(NavigationFrame d, IJournal oldValue, IJournal newValue)
				{
					d.OnJournalChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<int>("NavigationCacheMaxSize", ref NavigationCacheMaxSizeProperty, 10, (Action<NavigationFrame>)delegate(NavigationFrame d)
				{
					d.UpdateNavigationCacheProperties();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<NavigationCacheMode>("NavigationCacheMode", ref NavigationCacheModeProperty, NavigationCacheMode.Disabled, (Action<NavigationFrame>)delegate(NavigationFrame d)
				{
					d.UpdateNavigationCacheProperties();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<IEnumerable>("PrefetchedSources", ref PrefetchedSourcesProperty, (IEnumerable)null, (Action<NavigationFrame, IEnumerable, IEnumerable>)delegate(NavigationFrame d, IEnumerable oldValue, IEnumerable newValue)
				{
					d.OnPrefetchedSourcesChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None)
				.Register<PrefetchedSourcesOptions>("PrefetchedSourcesOptions", ref PrefetchedSourcesOptionsProperty, PrefetchedSourcesOptions.NavigateToFirstElement | PrefetchedSourcesOptions.ClearNavigationHistory | PrefetchedSourcesOptions.ClearNavigationCache, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<object>("Source", ref SourceProperty, (object)null, (Action<NavigationFrame, object, object>)delegate(NavigationFrame d, object oldValue, object newValue)
				{
					d.OnSourceChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
			AnimationDelayProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AnimationDelay", typeof(TimeSpan), typeof(NavigationFrame), new PropertyMetadata(new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0, 0, 150)), ValidateAnimationDelay);
		}

		private static bool ValidateAnimationDelay(object value)
		{
			double totalMilliseconds = ((TimeSpan)value).TotalMilliseconds;
			return totalMilliseconds <= 2147483647.0;
		}

		public NavigationFrame()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			MergingProperties.SetElementMergingBehavior((DependencyObject)this, (ElementMergingBehavior)4);
			MergingProperties.SetHideElements((DependencyObject)this, true);
			Journal = new Journal(ContentProvider)
			{
				Navigator = this
			};
			base.Initialized += OnInitialized;
			initializedLocker.Lock();
		}

		public void ClearCache()
		{
			ActualJournal.ClearNavigationCache();
		}

		public void GoBack()
		{
			GoBack(null);
		}

		public void GoBack(object param)
		{
			NavigationStatus = NavigationStatus.Executing;
			Navigate(NavigationMode.Back, null, param, null);
		}

		public void GoForward()
		{
			NavigationStatus = NavigationStatus.Executing;
			Navigate(NavigationMode.Forward, null, null, null);
		}

		public void Navigate(object source)
		{
			Navigate(source, null);
		}

		public void Navigate(object source, object param)
		{
			Navigate(source, param, saveToJournal: true);
		}

		public void Navigate(object source, object param, bool saveToJournal)
		{
			NavigationStatus = NavigationStatus.Executing;
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				Navigate(NavigationMode.New, source, param, null, saveToJournal);
			});
		}

		internal void Navigate(object source, object param, object parentViewModel, bool saveToJournal)
		{
			NavigationStatus = NavigationStatus.Executing;
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				Navigate(NavigationMode.New, source, param, parentViewModel, saveToJournal);
			});
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			if (PartViewPresenter != null && !LayoutTreeHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartViewPresenter, this))
			{
				PartViewPresenter.ContentRendered -= PartViewPresenter_AnimationCompleted;
				PartViewPresenter.Dispose();
			}
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartViewPresenter = LayoutTreeHelper.GetTemplateChild<ViewPresenter, NavigationFrame>(this);
			if (PartViewPresenter != null)
			{
				PartViewPresenter.ContentRendered += PartViewPresenter_AnimationCompleted;
			}
		}

		internal void Prefetch(IEnumerable oldValue, IEnumerable newValue)
		{
			PrefetchingStrategy.RemoveSource(oldValue);
			PrefetchingStrategy.AddSource(newValue);
			NavigateToPrefetchedSource();
		}

		internal void UpdateJournalProperties()
		{
			CanGoBack = ActualJournal != null && ActualJournal.CanGoBack;
			CanGoForward = ActualJournal != null && ActualJournal.CanGoForward;
		}

		protected virtual void OnAllowMergingChanged()
		{
			//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool flag = AllowMerging.Return((bool? x) => x.Value, () => true);
			MergingProperties.SetElementMergingBehavior((DependencyObject)this, AllowMerging.Return((bool? x) => x.Value ? ((ElementMergingBehavior)4) : ((ElementMergingBehavior)3), () => (ElementMergingBehavior)0));
			MergingProperties.SetHideElements((DependencyObject)this, flag);
		}

		protected override void OnContentChanged(object oldContent, object newContent)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentProviderChanged(INavigationContentProvider oldValue, INavigationContentProvider newValue)
		{
			Journal.NavigationContentProvider = newValue;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSourceChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			Navigate(newValue);
		}

		private void Navigate(NavigationMode mode, object source, object param, object parentViewModel, bool saveToJournal = true)
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			case NavigationMode.New:
				if (!NavigationInProgress)
				{
					NavigationInProgress = true;
					ActualJournal.Navigate(source, param, parentViewModel, saveToJournal);
				}
				break;
			case NavigationMode.Back:
				if (ActualJournal.CanGoBack)
				{
					if (BackNavigationMode == BackNavigationMode.PreviousScreen)
					{
						ActualJournal.GoBack(param);
					}
					else
					{
						ActualJournal.GoHome(param);
					}
				}
				break;
			case NavigationMode.Forward:
				if (ActualJournal.CanGoForward)
				{
					ActualJournal.GoForward();
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void NavigateToPrefetchedSource()
		{
			if (Locker.op_Implicit(initializedLocker))
			{
				initializedLocker.Unlocked += OnInitializedLockerUnlocked;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!PrefetchedSourcesOptions.HasFlag(PrefetchedSourcesOptions.NavigateToFirstElement) || !PrefetchingStrategy.CanGoForward)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (PrefetchedSourcesOptions.HasFlag(PrefetchedSourcesOptions.ClearNavigationCache))
				{
					ActualJournal.ClearNavigationCache();
				}
				AfterNavigateOnPrefetchedSource = delegate
				{
					if (PrefetchedSourcesOptions.HasFlag(PrefetchedSourcesOptions.ClearNavigationHistory))
					{
						ActualJournal.ClearNavigationHistory();
					}
				};
				ActualJournal.GoForward();
				UpdateJournalProperties();
			}
		}

		private void OnInitialized(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.Initialized -= OnInitialized;
			initializedLocker.Unlock();
			initializedLocker.Unlocked -= OnInitializedLockerUnlocked;
		}

		private void OnInitializedLockerUnlocked(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			NavigateToPrefetchedSource();
		}

		private void OnJournalChanged(IJournal oldJournal, IJournal newJournal)
		{
			if (oldJournal != null)
			{
				oldJournal.PropertyChanged -= UpdateJournalProperties;
			}
			if (newJournal != null)
			{
				newJournal.PropertyChanged += UpdateJournalProperties;
			}
			UpdateNavigationCacheProperties();
		}

		private void OnPrefetchedSourcesChanged(IEnumerable oldValue, IEnumerable newValue)
		{
			Prefetch(oldValue, newValue);
		}

		private void PartViewPresenter_AnimationCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ContentRendered != null)
			{
				this.ContentRendered(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateJournalProperties(object source, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateJournalProperties();
		}

		private void UpdateNavigationCacheProperties()
		{
			(Journal as ISupportNavigationCache).Do(delegate(ISupportNavigationCache x)
			{
				x.NavigationCacheMode = NavigationCacheMode;
				x.NavigationCacheMaxSize = NavigationCacheMaxSize;
			});
			(AttachedJournal as ISupportNavigationCache).Do(delegate(ISupportNavigationCache x)
			{
				x.NavigationCacheMode = NavigationCacheMode;
				x.NavigationCacheMaxSize = NavigationCacheMaxSize;
			});
		}

		bool INavigationFrame.Navigating(object source, NavigationMode mode, object navigationState)
		{
			AnimationDirection = ((mode != NavigationMode.Back) ? AnimationDirection.Back : AnimationDirection.Forward);
			NavigatingEventArgs e = new NavigatingEventArgs(source, mode, navigationState);
			if (this.Navigating != null)
			{
				this.Navigating(this, e);
			}
			if (!e.Cancel && ActualJournal.Current != null)
			{
				object content = ActualJournal.Current.Content;
				INavigationAware navigationAware = content as INavigationAware;
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = content as FrameworkElement;
				navigationAware?.NavigatingFrom(e);
				if (frameworkElement != null && frameworkElement.DataContext is INavigationAware navigationAware2 && navigationAware2 != frameworkElement)
				{
					navigationAware2.NavigatingFrom(e);
				}
			}
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				LockContent();
			}
			return !e.Cancel;
		}

		void INavigationFrame.NavigationComplete(object source, object content, object navigationState)
		{
			object content2 = base.Content;
			base.Content = content;
			if (!(content is UIElement) && base.ContentTemplateSelector != null)
			{
				base.ContentTemplate = base.ContentTemplateSelector.SelectTemplate(source, content as DependencyObject);
			}
			NotifyNavigationAware(source, content, navigationState, content2);
			NavigationInProgress = false;
			OnNavigationCompleted(NavigationStatus.Completed);
		}

		private void OnNavigationCompleted(NavigationStatus navigationStatus)
		{
			BackgroundHelper.DoInBackground((Action)delegate
			{
			}, (Action)UnlockContent, (int)AnimationDelay.TotalMilliseconds, ThreadPriority.Normal, ApartmentState.MTA);
			if (AfterNavigateOnPrefetchedSource != null && navigationStatus == NavigationStatus.Completed)
			{
				AfterNavigateOnPrefetchedSource();
			}
			AfterNavigateOnPrefetchedSource = null;
			NavigationStatus = navigationStatus;
		}

		private void NotifyNavigationAware(object source, object content, object navigationState, object oldContent)
		{
			NavigationEventArgs e = new NavigationEventArgs(source, content, navigationState);
			if (this.Navigated != null)
			{
				this.Navigated(this, e);
			}
			INavigationAware navigationAware = oldContent as INavigationAware;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = oldContent as FrameworkElement;
			navigationAware?.NavigatedFrom(e);
			if (frameworkElement != null && frameworkElement.DataContext is INavigationAware navigationAware2 && navigationAware2 != frameworkElement)
			{
				navigationAware2.NavigatedFrom(e);
			}
			if (ActualJournal.Current != null)
			{
				object content2 = ActualJournal.Current.Content;
				INavigationAware navigationAware3 = content2 as INavigationAware;
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = content2 as FrameworkElement;
				navigationAware3?.NavigatedTo(e);
				if (frameworkElement2 != null && frameworkElement2.DataContext is INavigationAware navigationAware4 && navigationAware4 != frameworkElement2)
				{
					navigationAware4.NavigatedTo(e);
				}
			}
		}

		void INavigationFrame.NavigationFailed(object source, NavigationException ex)
		{
			if (this.NavigationFailed != null)
			{
				NavigationFailedEventArgs e = new NavigationFailedEventArgs(source, ex);
				this.NavigationFailed(this, e);
			}
			NavigationInProgress = false;
			OnNavigationCompleted(NavigationStatus.Failed);
		}

		void INavigationFrame.NavigationStopped(object source, NavigationMode mode, object navigationState)
		{
			this.NavigationCanceled?.Invoke(this, new NavigationCanceledEventArgs(source, navigationState));
			NavigationInProgress = false;
			OnNavigationCompleted(NavigationStatus.Aborted);
		}

		internal void LockContent()
		{
			if (PartViewPresenter != null)
			{
				PartViewPresenter.LockContentLoading();
			}
		}

		internal void UnlockContent()
		{
			if (PartViewPresenter != null)
			{
				PartViewPresenter.UnlockContentLoading();
			}
		}

		void INavigationContainer.Navigate(object source, object param)
		{
			Navigate(source, param);
		}

		void INavigationContainer.GoBack()
		{
			GoBack();
		}

		void INavigationContainer.GoBack(object param)
		{
			GoBack(param);
		}

		void INavigationContainer.GoForward()
		{
			GoForward();
		}

		void ISupportNavigationJournal.Navigate(object source, object param, bool saveToJournal)
		{
			Navigate(source, param, saveToJournal);
		}
	}

		static PageView()
		{
			ItemsPanelHorizontalProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemsPanelHorizontal", typeof(ItemsPanelTemplate), typeof(PageView), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ItemsPanelVerticalProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemsPanelVertical", typeof(ItemsPanelTemplate), typeof(PageView), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			TemplateLeftProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TemplateLeft", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeof(PageView), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((PageView)d).UpdateTemplate(PageHeadersAlignment.Left);
			}));
			TemplateRightProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TemplateRight", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeof(PageView), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((PageView)d).UpdateTemplate(PageHeadersAlignment.Right);
			}));
			TemplateTopProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TemplateTop", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeof(PageView), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((PageView)d).UpdateTemplate(PageHeadersAlignment.Top);
			}));
			TemplateBottomProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TemplateBottom", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeof(PageView), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((PageView)d).UpdateTemplate(PageHeadersAlignment.Bottom);
			}));
			PageViewStrategyRegistrator.Register();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<PageView> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<PageView>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<PageView>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("Header", ref HeaderProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((PageView)d).OnHeaderChanged(e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("HeaderTemplate", ref HeaderTemplateProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("HeaderTemplateSelector", ref HeaderTemplateSelectorProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("HasHeader", ref HasHeaderPropertyKey, ref HasHeaderProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ShowBackButton", ref ShowBackButtonProperty, defValue: true);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("PageHeadersAlignment", ref PageHeadersAlignmentProperty, PageHeadersAlignment.Top, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((PageView)d).OnHeaderAlignmentChanged((PageHeadersAlignment)e.OldValue, (PageHeadersAlignment)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("PageHeadersLayoutType", ref PageHeadersLayoutTypeProperty, PageHeadersLayoutType.Default, OnPageHeadersLayoutTypeChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("IsScrollable", ref IsScrollablePropertyKey, ref IsScrollableProperty, defValue: false);
			AnimationType defValue = AnimationType.Fade;
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AnimationType", ref AnimationTypeProperty, defValue);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("AnimationDirection", ref AnimationDirectionPropertyKey, ref AnimationDirectionProperty, SelectorAnimationDirection.Forward);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AnimationSpeedRatio", ref AnimationSpeedRatioProperty, 1.0);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ICommand>("BackCommand", ref BackCommandProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("BackCommandParameter", ref BackCommandParameterProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ItemCacheMode", ref ItemCacheModeProperty, ItemCacheMode.None);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Orientation", ref OrientationProperty, Orientation.Horizontal);
		}

		private static void OnPageHeadersLayoutTypeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((PageView)d).OnPageHeadersLayoutTypeChanged((PageHeadersLayoutType)e.OldValue, (PageHeadersLayoutType)e.NewValue);
		}

		public PageView()
		{
			base.ItemContainerGenerator.StatusChanged += OnItemContainerGeneratorStatusChanged;
		}

		private void OnItemContainerGeneratorStatusChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.Status == GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated && ContentPanelInitializeOperation != null)
			{
				ContentPanelInitializeOperation.Abort();
				InitializeContentPanel();
			}
		}

		private void OnHeaderAlignmentChanged(PageHeadersAlignment oldValue, PageHeadersAlignment newValue)
		{
			SetValue(OrientationProperty, (newValue == PageHeadersAlignment.Left || newValue == PageHeadersAlignment.Right) ? Orientation.Vertical : Orientation.Horizontal);
			UpdateTemplate();
		}

		private void InitializeContentPanel()
		{
			ContentPanelInitializeOperation = null;
			PartPageViewContentPanel.Do(delegate(PageViewContentPanel x)
			{
				x.Initialize(this);
			});
		}

		protected override void OnApplyTemplateComplete()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplateComplete();
			ContentPanelInitializeOperation = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(InitializeContentPanel));
		}

		protected override void EnsureItemsPanelCore(Panel itemsPanel)
		{
			base.EnsureItemsPanelCore(itemsPanel);
			if (itemsPanel is PageViewStackPanel)
			{
				itemsPanel.SetBinding(StackLayoutPanel.OrientationProperty, new Binding("Orientation")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				itemsPanel.SetBinding(PageViewStackPanel.LayoutTypeProperty, new Binding("PageHeadersLayoutType")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			}
		}

		protected override void ReleaseItemsPanelCore(Panel itemsPanel)
		{
			if (itemsPanel is PageViewStackPanel)
			{
				itemsPanel.ClearValue(StackLayoutPanel.OrientationProperty);
			}
			base.ReleaseItemsPanelCore(itemsPanel);
		}

		protected override void ClearTemplateChildren()
		{
			if (PartViewPresenter != null && !LayoutTreeHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartViewPresenter, this))
			{
				PartViewPresenter.Dispose();
				PartViewPresenter = null;
			}
			if (PartPageViewContentPanel != null && !LayoutTreeHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartPageViewContentPanel, this))
			{
				PartPageViewContentPanel.UnInitialize();
				PartPageViewContentPanel = null;
			}
			base.ClearTemplateChildren();
		}

		protected override void GetTemplateChildren()
		{
			base.GetTemplateChildren();
			PartViewPresenter = LayoutTreeHelper.GetTemplateChild<ViewPresenter, PageView>(this);
			PartPageViewContentPanel = LayoutTreeHelper.GetTemplateChild<PageViewContentPanel, PageView>(this);
			PartNavigationHeader = GetTemplateChild("PART_NavigationHeader") as NavigationHeaderControl;
		}

		protected override void OnSelectionChanged(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.RemovedItems.Count > 0)
			{
				AnimationDirection = ((base.Items.IndexOf(e.RemovedItems[0]) < base.SelectedIndex) ? SelectorAnimationDirection.Back : SelectorAnimationDirection.Forward);
			}
			base.OnSelectionChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnSelectedItemChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			int num = base.Items.IndexOf(oldValue);
			AnimationDirection = ((num < base.SelectedIndex) ? SelectorAnimationDirection.Back : SelectorAnimationDirection.Forward);
			base.OnSelectedItemChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				IScrollablePanel scrollablePanel = PartItemsPanel as IScrollablePanel;
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(newValue) as FrameworkElement;
				if (scrollablePanel != null && frameworkElement != null)
				{
					scrollablePanel.BringChildIntoView(frameworkElement);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void OnHeaderChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			SetValue(HasHeaderPropertyKey, newValue != null);
		}

		protected override ISelectorItem CreateSelectorItem()
		{
			return new PageViewItem();
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is PageViewItem;
		}

		protected override void UpdateSelectedContent()
		{
			if (PartViewPresenter != null)
			{
				PartViewPresenter.LockContentLoading();
			}
			base.UpdateSelectedContent();
			if (PartViewPresenter != null)
			{
				PartViewPresenter.UnlockContentLoading();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPageHeadersLayoutTypeChanged(PageHeadersLayoutType oldValue, PageHeadersLayoutType newValue)
		{
			IsScrollable = PageHeadersLayoutType == PageHeadersLayoutType.Scroll;
		}

		internal PageViewItem GetContainer(object item)
		{
			if (item == null || !base.Items.Contains(item))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) as PageViewItem;
		}

		internal bool IsIndexInRange(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0)
			{
				return index < base.Items.Count;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnItemsChanged(e);
			RaiseItemsChanged(e);
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ItemsChanged != null)
			{
				this.ItemsChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			UpdateTemplate();
		}

		private void UpdateTemplate()
		{
			if (TemplateLeft != null && TemplateBottom != null && TemplateRight != null && TemplateTop != null)
			{
				ControlTemplate controlTemplate = null;
				switch (PageHeadersAlignment)
				{
				case PageHeadersAlignment.Left:
					controlTemplate = TemplateLeft;
					break;
				case PageHeadersAlignment.Top:
					controlTemplate = TemplateTop;
					break;
				case PageHeadersAlignment.Right:
					controlTemplate = TemplateRight;
					break;
				case PageHeadersAlignment.Bottom:
					controlTemplate = TemplateBottom;
					break;
				}
				if (controlTemplate != base.Template)
				{
					base.Template = controlTemplate;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTemplate(PageHeadersAlignment alignment)
		{
			if (alignment == PageHeadersAlignment)
			{
				UpdateTemplate();
			}
		}

		protected override void BeforeApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.BeforeApplyTemplate();
			UpdateTemplate();
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new PageViewAutomationPeer(this);
		}
	}
	public class PageViewItem : veHeaderedContentSelectorItem, IControl

		public class PageViewItemController : ControlControllerBase
		{
			public PageViewItem Control => (PageViewItem)((ControlControllerBase)this).Control;

			public PageViewItemController(PageViewItem control)
				: base((IControl)(object)control)
			{
			}

			public override void UpdateState(bool useTransitions)
			{
				((ControlControllerBase)this).UpdateState(useTransitions);
				string stateName = "EmptySelectedState";
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(Control, stateName, useTransitions);
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(stateName: (!Control.IsSelected) ? "Unselected" : "Selected", control: Control, useTransitions: useTransitions);
			}

			protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(DXMouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				bool flag = ((Controller)this).IsMouseLeftButtonDown && ((Controller)this).IsMouseEntered;
				((Controller)this).OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
				if (flag && Control.IsMouseOver)
				{
					Control.InvokeSelectInParentContainer();
				}
			}
		}

		public ControlControllerBase Controller { get; private set; }

		protected internal override ClickMode SelectionMode => ClickMode.Release;

		FrameworkElement IControl.Control => this;

		Controller IControl.Controller => (Controller)(object)Controller;

		static PageViewItem()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<PageViewItem>();
		}

		public PageViewItem()
		{
			Controller = CreateController();
		}

		protected override void OnApplyTemplateComplete()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplateComplete();
			Controller.UpdateState(false);
		}

		protected override void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool isSelected)
		{
			base.OnIsSelectedChanged(isSelected);
			Controller.UpdateState(false);
			LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Panel>((DependencyObject)this)?.InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected virtual ControlControllerBase CreateController()
		{
			return (ControlControllerBase)(object)new PageViewItemController(this);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new PageViewItemAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool IControl.get_IsLoaded()
		{
			return base.IsLoaded;
		}
	}

	public class SlideView : veItemsControl

		private FrameworkElement PartHeaderHost;

		internal NavigationHeaderControl PartNavigationHeaderControl { get; private set; }

		internal double ViewportWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (PartScrollPanel == null)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return PartScrollPanel.ViewportBounds.Width;
			}
		}

		internal double TotalWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (PartScrollPanel == null)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return ((ScrollControl)PartScrollPanel).ScrollAreaSize.Width;
			}
		}

		internal double HorizontalOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (PartScrollPanel == null)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return ((ScrollControl)PartScrollPanel).HorizontalOffset;
			}
		}

		internal double HeaderOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (PartNavigationHeaderControl != null)
				{
					return PartNavigationHeaderControl.HeaderOffset;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(StringConverter))]
		public object Header

		}

		public DataTemplate ItemHeaderTemplate
		{

		static SlideView()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<SlideView> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<SlideView>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<SlideView>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("Header", ref HeaderProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("HeaderTemplate", ref HeaderTemplateProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("ItemHeaderTemplate", ref ItemHeaderTemplateProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("ItemHeaderTemplateSelector", ref ItemHeaderTemplateSelectorProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ICommand>("BackCommand", ref BackCommandProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("BackCommandParameter", ref BackCommandParameterProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ShowBackButton", ref ShowBackButtonProperty, defValue: true);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ItemSpacing", ref ItemSpacingProperty, 0.0);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Orientation", ref OrientationProperty, Orientation.Horizontal, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
			{
				((SlideView)o).OnOrientationChanged((Orientation)args.OldValue, (Orientation)args.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("StickyHeaders", ref StickyHeadersProperty, defValue: true);
		}

		internal void SetScrollOffset(double offset)
		{
			if (PartScrollPanel != null)
			{
				((ScrollControl)PartScrollPanel).SetOffset(new System.Windows.Point(offset, 0.0));
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearTemplateChildren()
		{
			PartNavigationHeaderControl = null;
			if (PartScrollPanel != null)
			{
				PartScrollPanel.ScrollChanged -= Panel_ScrollChanged;
			}
			base.ClearTemplateChildren();
		}

		protected override void OnApplyTemplateComplete()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplateComplete();
			if (PartScrollPanel != null)
			{
				PartScrollPanel.ScrollChanged += Panel_ScrollChanged;
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					OnHorizontalOffsetChanged();
				});
			}
		}

		private void Panel_ScrollChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnHorizontalOffsetChanged();
		}

		protected virtual void OnOrientationChanged(Orientation oldValue, Orientation newValue)
		{
			if (PartScrollPanel != null)
			{
				if (Orientation == Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					Grid.SetRow((UIElement)(object)PartScrollPanel, 1);
					Grid.SetRowSpan((UIElement)(object)PartScrollPanel, 1);
				}
				else
				{
					Grid.SetRow((UIElement)(object)PartScrollPanel, 0);
					Grid.SetRowSpan((UIElement)(object)PartScrollPanel, 2);
				}
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		protected override void GetTemplateChildren()
		{
			base.GetTemplateChildren();
			PartNavigationHeaderControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_NavigationHeader") as NavigationHeaderControl;
			PartScrollPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_ScrollPanel") as SlideViewScrollPanel;
			PartHeaderHost = GetTemplateChild("PART_HeaderHost") as FrameworkElement;
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new SlideViewItem();
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is SlideViewItem;
		}

		private void OnHorizontalOffsetChanged()
		{
			if (PartScrollPanel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is SlideViewItem slideViewItem && PartNavigationHeaderControl != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Point point = ((PartNavigationHeaderControl.PartContent != null) ? PartNavigationHeaderControl.PartContent.TranslatePoint(default(System.Windows.Point), this) : PartNavigationHeaderControl.TranslatePoint(default(System.Windows.Point), this));
					double x = slideViewItem.TranslatePoint(zero, this).X;
					slideViewItem.OnScrollChanged(x, (Header == null && HeaderTemplate == null) ? 0.0 : point.X);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainer(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			if (element is IItemContainer)
			{
				((IItemContainer)element).PrepareContainer(item, ItemHeaderTemplate, ItemHeaderTemplateSelector);
			}
			if (element is SlideViewItem slideViewItem)
			{
				slideViewItem.Owner = this;
				slideViewItem.SetBinding(SlideViewItem.HeaderPlaceholderHeightProperty, new Binding("ActualHeight")
				{
					Source = PartHeaderHost
				});
				slideViewItem.SetBinding(SlideViewItem.IsHeaderStickyProperty, new Binding("StickyHeaders")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearContainer(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			if (element is SlideViewItem slideViewItem)
			{
				slideViewItem.Owner = null;
				slideViewItem.ClearValue(SlideViewItem.HeaderPlaceholderHeightProperty);
			}
			base.ClearContainer(element, item);
		}

		protected override void EnsureItemsPanelCore(Panel itemsPanel)
		{
			if (itemsPanel is SlideViewItemsPanel)
			{
				itemsPanel.SetBinding(BaseItemsPanel.ItemSpacingProperty, new Binding("ItemSpacing")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			}
		}

		internal void OnItemClick(SlideViewItem container)
		{
			if (container != null)
			{
				EventHandler<SlideViewItemClickEventArgs> eventHandler = this.ItemClick;
				if (eventHandler != null)
				{
					object item = base.ItemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer(container);
					eventHandler(this, new SlideViewItemClickEventArgs(item));
				}
			}
		}

		public void ScrollIntoView(object item)
		{
			if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is SlideViewItem slideViewItem)
			{
				((ScrollControl)PartScrollPanel).BringChildIntoView((FrameworkElement)slideViewItem, true);
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new SlideViewAutomationPeer(this);
		}
	}

	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Header", Type = typeof(SlideViewItemHeader))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_HeaderPlaceHolder", Type = typeof(FrameworkElement))]
	public class SlideViewItem : veHeaderedContentControl, IClickableControl, IClickable, ICommandSource
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty CommandProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CommandParameterProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CommandTargetProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsHeaderInteractiveProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty IsHeaderStickyProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty InteractiveHeaderTemplateProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty HeaderPlaceholderHeightProperty;

		private SlideViewItemHeader PartSlideViewItemHeader;

		private FrameworkElement PartHeaderPlaceholder;

		private bool _CanExecute = true;

		protected internal SlideView Owner { get; internal set; }

		private bool CanExecute
		{
			get
			{
				return _CanExecute;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != _CanExecute)
				{
					_CanExecute = value;
					PartSlideViewItemHeader.Do(delegate(SlideViewItemHeader x)
					{
						x.IsEnabled = value;
					});
				}
			}
		}

		public ICommand Command
		{
			get
			{
				return (ICommand)GetValue(CommandProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CommandProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public object CommandParameter
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(CommandParameterProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CommandParameterProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public IInputElement CommandTarget
		{
			get
			{
				return (IInputElement)GetValue(CommandTargetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CommandTargetProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsHeaderInteractive
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsHeaderInteractiveProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsHeaderInteractiveProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsHeaderSticky
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsHeaderStickyProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsHeaderStickyProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate InteractiveHeaderTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)GetValue(InteractiveHeaderTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(InteractiveHeaderTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler Click;

		static SlideViewItem()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<SlideViewItem> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<SlideViewItem>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<SlideViewItem>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ICommand>("Command", ref CommandProperty, null, OnCommandChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("CommandParameter", ref CommandParameterProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<IInputElement>("CommandTarget", ref CommandTargetProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsHeaderInteractive", ref IsHeaderInteractiveProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsHeaderSticky", ref IsHeaderStickyProperty, defValue: true);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("InteractiveHeaderTemplate", ref InteractiveHeaderTemplateProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("HeaderPlaceholderHeight", ref HeaderPlaceholderHeightProperty, double.NaN);
		}

		private static void OnCommandChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SlideViewItem slideViewItem)
			{
				slideViewItem.OnCommandChanged((ICommand)e.OldValue, (ICommand)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearTemplateChildren()
		{
			if (PartSlideViewItemHeader != null)
			{
				PartSlideViewItemHeader.Owner = null;
				PartSlideViewItemHeader.ClearValue(UIElement.IsManipulationEnabledProperty);
			}
			if (PartHeaderPlaceholder != null)
			{
				PartHeaderPlaceholder.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
			}
			base.ClearTemplateChildren();
		}

		protected override void GetTemplateChildren()
		{
			base.GetTemplateChildren();
			PartSlideViewItemHeader = GetTemplateChild("PART_Header") as SlideViewItemHeader;
			PartHeaderPlaceholder = GetTemplateChild("PART_HeaderPlaceHolder") as FrameworkElement;
		}

		protected override void OnApplyTemplateComplete()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplateComplete();
			if (PartSlideViewItemHeader != null)
			{
				PartSlideViewItemHeader.Owner = this;
				if (Owner != null)
				{
					PartSlideViewItemHeader.SetBinding(UIElement.IsManipulationEnabledProperty, new Binding("IsManipulationEnabled")
					{
						Source = Owner
					});
				}
				PartSlideViewItemHeader.SetBinding(SlideViewItemHeader.IsStickyProperty, new Binding("IsHeaderSticky")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				PartSlideViewItemHeader.IsEnabled = CanExecute;
			}
			if (PartHeaderPlaceholder != null)
			{
				PartHeaderPlaceholder.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, new Binding("HeaderPlaceholderHeight")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				PartHeaderPlaceholder.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, new Binding("Orientation")
				{
					Source = Owner,
					Converter = new OrientationToVisibilityConverter()
				});
			}
		}

		internal void OnScrollChanged(double horizontalOffset, double headerOffset)
		{
			if (PartSlideViewItemHeader != null)
			{
				PartSlideViewItemHeader.SetRelativeLocation(horizontalOffset, headerOffset);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnClick()
		{
			this.Click?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			CommandHelper.ExecuteCommand(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnCommandChanged(ICommand oldValue, ICommand newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				UnhookCommand(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				HookCommand(newValue);
			}
		}

		private void UnhookCommand(ICommand command)
		{
			command.CanExecuteChanged -= OnCanExecuteChanged;
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private void HookCommand(ICommand command)
		{
			command.CanExecuteChanged += OnCanExecuteChanged;
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private void OnCanExecuteChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private void UpdateCanExecute()
		{
			CanExecute = Command == null || CommandHelper.CanExecuteCommand(this);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new SlideViewItemAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		void IClickableControl.OnClick()
		{
			OnClick();
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.OnItemClick(this);
			}
		}
	}

		}

	public class AppBarToggleButtonAutomationPeer : AppBarButtonAutomationPeer, IToggleProvider
	{
		private AppBarToggleButton AppBarToggleButton => base.Owner as AppBarToggleButton;

		public ToggleState ToggleState => ConvertToToggleState(AppBarToggleButton.IsChecked);

		private static ToggleState ConvertToToggleState(bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				return ToggleState.On;
			}
			return ToggleState.Off;
		}

		public AppBarToggleButtonAutomationPeer(AppBarToggleButton owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "AppBarToggleButton";
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface != PatternInterface.Toggle)
			{
				return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
			}
			return this;
		}

		internal void RaiseToggleStateChangedEvent(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != newValue)
			{
				RaisePropertyChangedEvent(TogglePatternIdentifiers.ToggleStateProperty, ConvertToToggleState(oldValue), ConvertToToggleState(newValue));
			}
		}

		public void Toggle()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			AppBarToggleButton?.OnToggle();
		}
	}
	public class FlipViewAutomationPeer : WinUIAutomationPeerBase<FlipView>, ISelectionProvider, IScrollProvider
	{
		internal const string cannotScrollToDirection = "Can not scroll to unsupported direcetion";

		internal const string scrollPercentIsOutOfRange = "Scroll percent is out of range";

		public bool CanSelectMultiple => false;

		public bool IsSelectionRequired => base.Owner.Items.Count != 0;

		public double HorizontalScrollPercent => ScrollPercent;

		public double HorizontalViewSize => ViewSize;

		public bool HorizontallyScrollable
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Owner.HasItems)
				{
					return IsHorizontal;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public double VerticalScrollPercent => ScrollPercent;

		public double VerticalViewSize => ViewSize;

		public bool VerticallyScrollable
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Owner.HasItems)
				{
					return !IsHorizontal;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private double ScrollPercent => 100.0 * (double)base.Owner.SelectedIndex / (double)(base.Owner.Items.Count - 1);

		private double ViewSize => 100.0 / (double)base.Owner.Items.Count;

		private bool IsHorizontal => base.Owner.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;

		public FlipViewAutomationPeer(FlipView owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			base.Owner.SelectionChanged += delegate
			{
				((AutomationPeer)(object)this).RaiseAutomationEvent(AutomationEvents.StructureChanged);
			};
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Tab;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Selection || patternInterface == PatternInterface.Scroll)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Owner.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				object obj = base.Owner.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i);
				if (obj is FrameworkElement)
				{
					AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(obj as FrameworkElement);
					if (automationPeer != null)
					{
						list.Add(automationPeer);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public IRawElementProviderSimple[] GetSelection()
		{
			if (base.Owner.SelectedItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(base.Owner.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(base.Owner.SelectedItem) is UIElement element))
			{
				return null;
			}
			AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(element);
			if (automationPeer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IRawElementProviderSimple rawElementProviderSimple = ((AutomationPeer)(object)this).ProviderFromPeer(automationPeer);
			if (rawElementProviderSimple == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new IRawElementProviderSimple[1] { rawElementProviderSimple };
		}

		public void Scroll(ScrollAmount horizontalAmount, ScrollAmount verticalAmount)
		{
			if ((!VerticallyScrollable && verticalAmount != ScrollAmount.NoAmount) || (!HorizontallyScrollable && horizontalAmount != ScrollAmount.NoAmount))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Can not scroll to unsupported direcetion");
			}
			if (!VerticallyScrollable && !HorizontallyScrollable)
			{
				return;
			}
			ScrollAmount scrollAmount = (HorizontallyScrollable ? horizontalAmount : verticalAmount);
			if (scrollAmount == ScrollAmount.LargeIncrement || scrollAmount == ScrollAmount.SmallIncrement)
			{
				if (base.Owner.SelectedIndex != base.Owner.Items.Count - 1)
				{
					base.Owner.SelectedIndex++;
				}
			}
			else if (base.Owner.SelectedIndex > 0)
			{
				base.Owner.SelectedIndex--;
			}
		}

		public void SetScrollPercent(double horizontalPercent, double verticalPercent)
		{
			if ((!VerticallyScrollable && verticalPercent != 0.0 && verticalPercent != -1.0) || (!HorizontallyScrollable && horizontalPercent != 0.0 && horizontalPercent != -1.0))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Can not scroll to unsupported direcetion");
			}
			if ((VerticallyScrollable && ((verticalPercent < 0.0 && verticalPercent != -1.0) || verticalPercent > 100.0)) || (HorizontallyScrollable && ((horizontalPercent < 0.0 && horizontalPercent != -1.0) || horizontalPercent > 100.0)))
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException("Scroll percent is out of range");
			}
			if (VerticallyScrollable || HorizontallyScrollable)
			{
				double num = (HorizontallyScrollable ? horizontalPercent : verticalPercent);
				base.Owner.SelectedIndex = Math.Min(base.Owner.Items.Count - 1, (int)Math.Floor(num * (double)base.Owner.Items.Count / 100.0));
			}
		}
	}

		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetChildrenCore();
			if (base.Owner != null && base.Owner.IsSelected && base.Owner.Owner is PageView { PartPageViewContentPanel: { } partPageViewContentPanel })

				AutomationPeer automationPeer = new FrameworkElementAutomationPeer(partPageViewContentPanel);

	public class SlideViewAutomationPeer : HeaderedControlAutomationPeerBase<SlideView>, IScrollProvider
	{
		protected override object Header => base.Owner.Header;

		public double HorizontalScrollPercent => base.Owner.HorizontalOffset * 100.0 / (base.Owner.TotalWidth - base.Owner.ViewportWidth);

		public double HorizontalViewSize => base.Owner.ViewportWidth / base.Owner.TotalWidth * 100.0;

		public bool HorizontallyScrollable => base.Owner.HasItems;

		public double VerticalScrollPercent => -1.0;

		public double VerticalViewSize => 100.0;

		public bool VerticallyScrollable => false;

		public SlideViewAutomationPeer(SlideView owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.List;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Scroll)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Owner.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				object obj = base.Owner.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i);
				if (obj is FrameworkElement)
				{
					AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(obj as FrameworkElement);
					if (automationPeer != null)
					{
						list.Add(automationPeer);
					}
				}
			}
			if (base.Owner.BackCommand != null && base.Owner.PartNavigationHeaderControl != null)
			{
				list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(base.Owner.PartNavigationHeaderControl.PartBackButton));
			}
			return list;
		}

		public void Scroll(ScrollAmount horizontalAmount, ScrollAmount verticalAmount)
		{
			if (verticalAmount != ScrollAmount.NoAmount)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Vertical Scrolling is not supported");
			}
			if (horizontalAmount != ScrollAmount.NoAmount)
			{
				switch (horizontalAmount)
				{
				case ScrollAmount.LargeDecrement:
					base.Owner.SetScrollOffset(-48.0);
					break;
				case ScrollAmount.LargeIncrement:
					base.Owner.SetScrollOffset(48.0);
					break;
				case ScrollAmount.SmallDecrement:
					base.Owner.SetScrollOffset(-16.0);
					break;
				case ScrollAmount.SmallIncrement:
					base.Owner.SetScrollOffset(16.0);
					break;
				case ScrollAmount.NoAmount:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetScrollPercent(double horizontalPercent, double verticalPercent)
		{
			if (verticalPercent != -1.0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Vertical Scrolling is not supported");
			}
			if (horizontalPercent < 0.0 || horizontalPercent > 100.0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Horizontal percent may not be " + horizontalPercent);
			}
			base.Owner.SetScrollOffset(horizontalPercent / 100.0 * base.Owner.TotalWidth);
		}
	}

	public abstract class WinUIAutomationPeerBase : BaseNavigationAutomationPeer
	{
		protected WinUIAutomationPeerBase(FrameworkElement owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected sealed override string GetNameCore()
		{
			string nameImpl = GetNameImpl();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nameImpl))
			{
				return nameImpl;
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner.GetType().Name;
		}

		protected virtual string GetNameImpl()
		{
			string nameCore = ((BaseNavigationAutomationPeer)this).GetNameCore();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(nameCore))
			{
				bool flag = default(bool);
				object obj = ((BaseNavigationAutomationPeer)this).TryGetAutomationPropertyValue(AutomationProperties.NameProperty, ref flag);
				if (flag)
				{
					return (string)obj;
				}
			}
			return nameCore;
		}

		protected sealed override string GetAutomationIdCore()
		{
			string automationIdImpl = GetAutomationIdImpl();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(automationIdImpl))
			{
				return automationIdImpl;
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner.GetType().Name;
		}

		protected virtual string GetAutomationIdImpl()
		{
			string automationIdCore = ((BaseNavigationAutomationPeer)this).GetAutomationIdCore();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(automationIdCore))
			{
				bool flag = default(bool);
				object obj = ((BaseNavigationAutomationPeer)this).TryGetAutomationPropertyValue(AutomationProperties.AutomationIdProperty, ref flag);
				if (flag)
				{
					return (string)obj;
				}
			}
			return automationIdCore;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner.GetType().Name;
		}
	}
	public abstract class WinUIAutomationPeerBase<T> : WinUIAutomationPeerBase where T : FrameworkElement
	{
		public T Owner => (T)((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).Owner;

		protected WinUIAutomationPeerBase(T owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class HeaderedControlAutomationPeerBase<T> : WinUIAutomationPeerBase<T> where T : FrameworkElement
	{
		protected abstract object Header { get; }

		protected HeaderedControlAutomationPeerBase(T owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetAutomationIdImpl()
		{
			string automationIdImpl = base.GetAutomationIdImpl();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(automationIdImpl))
			{
				if (Header == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return Header.ToString();
			}
			return automationIdImpl;
		}

		protected override string GetNameImpl()
		{
			string nameImpl = base.GetNameImpl();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(nameImpl))
			{
				if (Header == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return Header.ToString();
			}
			return nameImpl;
		}
	}
