	internal class CacheQueue : DependencyObject
	{
		private class CacheEntry
		{
			public object Page { get; private set; }

			public NavigationCacheMode CacheMode { get; private set; }

			public Action OnDrop { get; set; }

			public CacheEntry(object page, NavigationCacheMode cacheMode)
			{
				Page = page;
				CacheMode = cacheMode;
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MaxSizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MaxSize", typeof(int), typeof(CacheQueue), new PropertyMetadata(10));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CacheModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CacheMode", typeof(NavigationCacheMode), typeof(CacheQueue));

		private readonly Dictionary<object, CacheEntry> pages = new Dictionary<object, CacheEntry>();

		private readonly List<object> orderedKeys = new List<object>();

		private readonly object locker = new object();

		public int MaxSize
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(MaxSizeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MaxSizeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public NavigationCacheMode CacheMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (NavigationCacheMode)GetValue(CacheModeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CacheModeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(object key)
		{
			if (key != null)
			{
				return pages.ContainsKey(key);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public object GetPage(object key)
		{
			lock (locker)
			{
				if (orderedKeys.Count > 1)
				{
					int index = orderedKeys.IndexOf(key);
					orderedKeys.RemoveAt(index);
					orderedKeys.Add(key);
				}
				return pages[key].Page;
			}
		}

		public void InsertPage(object key, object page, bool force = false)
		{
			InsertPage(key, page, CacheMode, force);
		}

		public void InsertPage(object key, object page, NavigationCacheMode globalValue, bool force = false)
		{
			lock (locker)
			{
				if (pages.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					orderedKeys.Remove(key);
					orderedKeys.Add(key);
					return;
				}
				NavigationCacheMode navigationCacheMode = (force ? NavigationCacheMode.Required : GetVirtualCacheMode(page, globalValue));
				if (navigationCacheMode != NavigationCacheMode.Disabled)
				{
					var array = (from o in orderedKeys
						select new
						{
							key = o,
							entry = pages[o]
						} into p
						where p.entry.CacheMode == NavigationCacheMode.Enabled
						select p).Take(orderedKeys.Count - MaxSize + 1).ToArray();
					foreach (var anon in array)
					{
						DropPage(anon.key, anon.entry);
					}
					if (navigationCacheMode == NavigationCacheMode.Required || orderedKeys.Count < MaxSize)
					{
						pages[key] = new CacheEntry(page, navigationCacheMode);
						orderedKeys.Add(key);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemovePage(object key)
		{
			lock (locker)
			{
				if (pages.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					orderedKeys.Remove(key);
					pages.Remove(key);
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetOnDropHook(object key, Action onDrop)
		{
			lock (locker)
			{
				if (!pages.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					onDrop();
				}
				else if (value.CacheMode != NavigationCacheMode.Required)
				{
					value.OnDrop = onDrop;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool TryGetPageAndClearOnDropHook(object key, out object page)
		{
			lock (locker)
			{
				if (key == null || !pages.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					page = null;
					return false;
				}
				value.OnDrop = null;
				page = value.Page;
				return true;
			}
		}

		private void DropPage(object key, CacheEntry entry)
		{
			orderedKeys.Remove(key);
			pages.Remove(key);
			if (entry.OnDrop != null)
			{
				entry.OnDrop();
			}
		}

		private NavigationCacheMode GetVirtualCacheMode(object page, NavigationCacheMode globalValue)
		{
			if (page is DependencyObject dependencyObject)
			{
				object obj = dependencyObject.ReadLocalValue(NavigationPage.NavigationCacheModeProperty);
				if (obj != DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
				{
					return (NavigationCacheMode)obj;
				}
				return globalValue;
			}
			return globalValue;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			pages.Clear();
			orderedKeys.Clear();
		}
	}
	internal interface IPrefetchingStrategy
	{
		IEnumerable<object> BackStack { get; }

		bool CanGoForward { get; }

		bool CanGoBack { get; }

		object Current { get; set; }

		IEnumerable<object> ForwardStack { get; }

		void AddSource(IEnumerable source);

		object GoForward();

		object GoBack();

		void RemoveSource(IEnumerable source);
	}
	internal interface ISupportPrefetchingStrategy
	{
		IPrefetchingStrategy PrefetchingStrategy { get; }
	}
	internal class StackedPrefetchingStrategy : IPrefetchingStrategy
	{
		private readonly List<IEnumerable> PrefetchedSources = new List<IEnumerable>();

		private object _current;

		private object _prefetchedEntry;

		public IEnumerable<object> BackStack
		{
			get
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				foreach (IEnumerable prefetchedSource in PrefetchedSources)
				{
					foreach (object item in prefetchedSource)
					{
						if (item == Current)
						{
							return list;
						}
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		public bool CanGoBack => CanGoBackCore();

		public bool CanGoForward => CanGoForwardCore();

		public object Current
		{
			get
			{
				return _current;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_current != value)
				{
					_current = value;
					object obj = FindPrefetchedEntry(value);
					if (obj != null)
					{
						PrefetchedEntry = obj;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<object> ForwardStack
		{
			get
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (IEnumerable prefetchedSource in PrefetchedSources)
				{
					foreach (object item in prefetchedSource)
					{
						if (item == Current)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						else if (flag)
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private object PrefetchedEntry
		{
			get
			{
				return _prefetchedEntry;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_prefetchedEntry != value)
				{
					_prefetchedEntry = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddSource(IEnumerable source)
		{
			PrefetchedSources.Add(source);
		}

		public object GoBack()
		{
			return GetPreviousEntry();
		}

		public object GoForward()
		{
			return GetNextEntry();
		}

		public void RemoveSource(IEnumerable source)
		{
			PrefetchedSources.Remove(source);
		}

		protected virtual bool CanGoBackCore()
		{
			foreach (IEnumerable prefetchedSource in PrefetchedSources)
			{
				IEnumerable<object> source = prefetchedSource.Cast<object>();
				if (!source.Any())
				{
					return false;
				}
				object obj = FindPrefetchedEntry(Current);
				bool flag = obj != null;
				if ((PrefetchedEntry == null || flag) && ((PrefetchedEntry == null && Current == null) || obj != source.First()))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool CanGoForwardCore()
		{
			foreach (IEnumerable prefetchedSource in PrefetchedSources)
			{
				IEnumerable<object> source = prefetchedSource.Cast<object>();
				if (!source.Any())
				{
					return false;
				}
				object obj = FindPrefetchedEntry(Current);
				bool flag = obj != null;
				if ((PrefetchedEntry == null || flag) && ((PrefetchedEntry == null && Current == null) || obj != source.Last()))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool CanNavigateTo(object entry)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual object GetNextEntry()
		{
			foreach (IEnumerable prefetchedSource in PrefetchedSources)
			{
				IEnumerable<object> source = prefetchedSource.Cast<object>();
				if (PrefetchedEntry == null)
				{
					return source.FirstOrDefault();
				}
				if (source.Contains(PrefetchedEntry))
				{
					return source.SkipWhile((object x) => x != PrefetchedEntry).Skip(1).FirstOrDefault((object x) => x != null && CanNavigateTo(x));
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual object GetPreviousEntry()
		{
			foreach (IEnumerable prefetchedSource in PrefetchedSources)
			{
				IEnumerable<object> source = prefetchedSource.Cast<object>();
				if (PrefetchedEntry == null)
				{
					return source.FirstOrDefault();
				}
				if (source.Contains(PrefetchedEntry))
				{
					return source.TakeWhile((object x) => x != PrefetchedEntry).LastOrDefault((object x) => x != null && CanNavigateTo(x));
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private object FindPrefetchedEntry(object entry)
		{
			foreach (IEnumerable prefetchedSource in PrefetchedSources)
			{
				if (prefetchedSource != null)
				{
					object obj = prefetchedSource.Cast<object>().FirstOrDefault((object x) => x == entry);
					if (obj != null)
					{
						return obj;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public interface INavigationContentProvider
	{
		object Load(object source);

		IAsyncResult BeginLoad(object source, AsyncCallback userCallback, object asyncState);

		void CancelLoad(IAsyncResult asyncResult);

		LoadResult EndLoad(IAsyncResult asyncResult);

		bool CanLoad(object source);
	}
	public class NavigationContentProvider : INavigationContentProvider
	{
		private class NavigationContentProviderAsyncResult : IAsyncResult
		{
			internal object Source { get; set; }

			internal Exception Exception { get; set; }

			internal object Content { get; set; }

			public object AsyncState { get; private set; }

			public WaitHandle AsyncWaitHandle => null;

			public bool CompletedSynchronously => false;

			public bool IsCompleted { get; internal set; }

			internal NavigationContentProviderAsyncResult(object source, object asyncState)
			{
				AsyncState = asyncState;
				Source = source;
			}
		}

		private static object LoadContent(string source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type typeByName = TypeProvider.Current.GetTypeByName(source);
			if (!(typeByName != null))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return LoadByType(typeByName);
		}

		private static object LoadContent(object source)
		{
			object obj = null;
			if (source is Uri)
			{
				return XamlLoaderHelper.LoadContentFromUri((Uri)source);
			}
			if (source is Type)
			{
				return LoadByType((Type)source);
			}
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj = LoadContent(source as string);
			}
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj = source;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		private static object LoadByType(Type type)
		{
			return Activator.CreateInstance(type);
		}

		public object Load(object source)
		{
			return LoadContent(source);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginLoad(object source, AsyncCallback userCallback, object asyncState)
		{
			NavigationContentProviderAsyncResult result = new NavigationContentProviderAsyncResult(source, asyncState);
			if (source == null)
			{
				result.Exception = new ArgumentNullException("source");
			}
			Journal.NavigationOperation op = asyncState as Journal.NavigationOperation;
			Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				LoadAsync(userCallback, result, op);
			});
			return result;
		}

		private void LoadAsync(AsyncCallback loadedAction, NavigationContentProviderAsyncResult result, Journal.NavigationOperation op)
		{
			if (result.Exception != null)
			{
				result.IsCompleted = true;
			}
			try
			{
				result.Content = LoadContent(result.Source);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				result.Exception = exception;
			}
			finally
			{
				result.IsCompleted = true;
				loadedAction?.Invoke(result);
			}
		}

		public void CancelLoad(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
		}

		public LoadResult EndLoad(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			if (!(asyncResult is NavigationContentProviderAsyncResult navigationContentProviderAsyncResult))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (navigationContentProviderAsyncResult.Exception != null)
			{
				throw navigationContentProviderAsyncResult.Exception;
			}
			return new LoadResult(navigationContentProviderAsyncResult.Content);
		}

		public bool CanLoad(object source)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class LoadResult
	{
		public object LoadedContent { get; private set; }

		public LoadResult(object loadedContent)
		{
			LoadedContent = loadedContent;
		}
	}
	public abstract class NavigationElementFactory<T>
	{
		protected delegate T CreateInstance();

		private readonly IDictionary<Type, CreateInstance> initializers;

		protected IDictionary<Type, CreateInstance> Initializers => initializers;

		public NavigationElementFactory()
		{
			initializers = new Dictionary<Type, CreateInstance>();
			InitializeFactory();
		}

		protected abstract void InitializeFactory();

		private Type GetInitializerType(Type elementType)
		{
			return initializers.Keys.FirstOrDefault((Type x) => x.IsAssignableFrom(elementType));
		}

		public T Resolve(object sender)
		{
			CreateInstance value = null;
			Type initializerType = GetInitializerType(sender.GetType());
			if (initializerType != null && initializers.TryGetValue(initializerType, out value))
			{
				return value();
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException($"Could not resolve element for {initializerType ?? sender}.");
		}
	}
	public class NavigationTargetFactory : NavigationElementFactory<INavigationTarget>
	{
		protected override void InitializeFactory()
		{
			base.Initializers[typeof(ISupportNavigationJournal)] = () => new SupportNavigationJournalTarget();
			base.Initializers[typeof(INavigationContainer)] = () => new NavigationContainerTarget();
			base.Initializers[typeof(Frame)] = () => new FrameNavigationTarget();
			base.Initializers[typeof(ContentControl)] = () => new ContentControlNavigationTarget();
		}
	}
	public class NavigationHandlerFactory : NavigationElementFactory<INavigationHandler>
	{
		protected override void InitializeFactory()
		{
			base.Initializers[typeof(IClickable)] = () => new ClickableNavigationHandler();
			base.Initializers[typeof(ButtonBase)] = () => new ButtonNavigationHandler();
			base.Initializers[typeof(BarItem)] = () => new BarItemNavigationHandler();
		}
	}

	public enum NavigationMode
	{
		New,
		Back,
		Forward
	}
	public class Journal : IJournal, INotifyPropertyChanged, IJournalEx, ISupportNavigationCache
	{
		internal class NavigationOperation
		{
			public IAsyncResult AsyncResult { get; set; }

			public JournalEntry TargetEntry { get; set; }

			public NavigationMode NavigationMode { get; set; }

			public object NavigationState { get; set; }
		}

		protected class NoneJournalEntry : JournalEntry
		{
			protected internal override void SetContent(object content)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		internal JournalEntryStack _BackStack;

		internal CacheQueue _Cache;

		internal JournalEntryStack _ForwardStack;

		private readonly Locker clearHistoryLocker = new Locker();

		private readonly IPrefetchingStrategy DefaultPrefetchingStrategy = new StackedPrefetchingStrategy();

		private NavigationOperation _CurrentNavigation;

		private INavigationContentProvider _DefaultContentProvider;

		private INavigationContentProvider _NavigationContentProvider;

		private JournalEntry current;

		public IEnumerable<JournalEntry> BackStack => _BackStack;

		public bool CanGoBack
		{
			get
			{
				if (_BackStack.Count <= 1)
				{
					if (_BackStack.Count == 1)
					{
						return CurrentNotInStack;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool CanGoForward
		{
			get
			{
				if (!PrefetchingStrategy.CanGoForward)
				{
					return _ForwardStack.Count > 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public JournalEntry Current
		{
			get
			{
				return current;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (current != value)
				{
					current = value;
					PrefetchingStrategy.Current = value.With((JournalEntry x) => x.Source);
					if (this.CurrentChanged != null)
					{
						this.CurrentChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public INavigationContentProvider DefaultContentProvider => _DefaultContentProvider ?? (_DefaultContentProvider = ResolveContentProvider());

		public IEnumerable<JournalEntry> ForwardStack => _ForwardStack;

		public INavigationContentProvider NavigationContentProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return _NavigationContentProvider ?? DefaultContentProvider;
			}
			set
			{
				_NavigationContentProvider = value;
			}
		}

		public INavigationFrame Navigator { get; set; }

		protected bool NavigationInProgress { get; private set; }

		protected virtual bool SupportNoneJournalEntry => false;

		internal IPrefetchingStrategy PrefetchingStrategy => (Navigator as ISupportPrefetchingStrategy).Return((ISupportPrefetchingStrategy x) => x.PrefetchingStrategy, () => DefaultPrefetchingStrategy);

		private bool CurrentNotInStack
		{
			get
			{
				if (Current != null)
				{
					return !Current.SaveToHistory;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		int ISupportNavigationCache.NavigationCacheMaxSize
		{
			get
			{
				return _Cache.MaxSize;
			}
			set
			{
				_Cache.MaxSize = value;
			}
		}

		NavigationCacheMode ISupportNavigationCache.NavigationCacheMode
		{
			get
			{
				return _Cache.CacheMode;
			}
			set
			{
				_Cache.CacheMode = value;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler CanGoBackChanged;

		public event EventHandler CanGoForwardChanged;

		public event EventHandler CurrentChanged;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public Journal()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public Journal(INavigationContentProvider contentProvider)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			NavigationContentProvider = contentProvider;
			_BackStack = new JournalEntryStack();
			_BackStack.CountChanged += OnBackStackCountChanged;
			_ForwardStack = new JournalEntryStack();
			_ForwardStack.CountChanged += OnForwardStackCountChanged;
			_Cache = new CacheQueue();
		}

		public void ClearNavigationCache()
		{
			ClearCache();
		}

		public void ClearNavigationHistory()
		{
			clearHistoryLocker.Reset();
			if (Navigator.Status == NavigationStatus.Executing)
			{
				clearHistoryLocker.Lock();
			}
			else
			{
				ClearNavigationHistoryOverride();
			}
		}

		public void GoBack()
		{
			GoBack(closeLastPage: false, null);
		}

		public void GoBack(object param)
		{
			GoBack(closeLastPage: false, param);
		}

		public void GoForward(object param)
		{
			bool canGoForward = PrefetchingStrategy.CanGoForward;
			JournalEntry journalEntry = null;
			NavigationMode mode = NavigationMode.New;
			if (canGoForward)
			{
				journalEntry = CreateJournalEntry(PrefetchingStrategy.GoForward(), null);
			}
			if (journalEntry == null && _ForwardStack.Count > 0)
			{
				journalEntry = _ForwardStack.Peek();
				mode = NavigationMode.Forward;
			}
			if (journalEntry != null)
			{
				NavigateCore(journalEntry, mode, param);
			}
		}

		public void GoHome()
		{
			GoHome(null);
		}

		public void GoHome(object param)
		{
			if (_BackStack.Count <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			JournalEntryStack journalEntryStack = new JournalEntryStack();
			while (_BackStack.Count > 1)
			{
				journalEntryStack.Push(_BackStack.Pop());
			}
			JournalEntry journalEntry = _BackStack.Peek();
			if (journalEntry == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (param != null)
			{
				journalEntry.Parameter = param;
			}
			if (!NavigateCore(journalEntry, NavigationMode.Back, param))
			{
				while (journalEntryStack.Count > 0)
				{
					_BackStack.Push(journalEntryStack.Pop());
				}
			}
		}

		public void Navigate(object content, object navigationState = null)
		{
			Navigate(content, navigationState, saveToJournal: true);
		}

		public void Navigate(object content, object navigationState, bool saveToJournal)
		{
			JournalEntry journalEntry = CreateJournalEntry(content, navigationState);
			journalEntry.SaveToHistory = saveToJournal;
			NavigateCore(journalEntry, NavigationMode.New, navigationState);
		}

		void IJournalEx.Navigate(object content, object navigationState, object parentViewModel, bool saveToJournal)
		{
			JournalEntry journalEntry = CreateJournalEntry(content, navigationState);
			journalEntry.SaveToHistory = saveToJournal;
			if (journalEntry.GetType() == typeof(JournalEntry) && parentViewModel != null)
			{
				JournalEntryEx journalEntryEx = new JournalEntryEx(journalEntry.Source, journalEntry.Name, journalEntry.Parameter);
				if (journalEntry.Content != null)
				{
					journalEntryEx.SetContent(journalEntry.Content);
				}
				journalEntryEx.KeepAlive = journalEntry.KeepAlive;
				journalEntryEx.SaveToHistory = journalEntry.SaveToHistory;
				journalEntry = journalEntryEx;
			}
			if (parentViewModel != null)
			{
				(journalEntry as ISupportParentViewModel).Do(delegate(ISupportParentViewModel x)
				{
					if (x.ParentViewModel == null)
					{
						x.ParentViewModel = parentViewModel;
					}
				});
			}
			NavigateCore(journalEntry, NavigationMode.New, navigationState);
		}

		public void PushInForwardStack(object obj)
		{
			_ForwardStack.Push(CreateJournalEntry(obj, null));
		}

		internal void GoBack(bool closeLastPage, object param)
		{
			if (_BackStack.Count != 0 && ((SupportNoneJournalEntry && closeLastPage) || _BackStack.Count != 1 || CurrentNotInStack))
			{
				JournalEntry item = (CurrentNotInStack ? Current : _BackStack.Pop());
				JournalEntry journalEntry = ((_BackStack.Count != 0) ? _BackStack.Peek() : new NoneJournalEntry());
				if (param != null)
				{
					journalEntry.Parameter = param;
				}
				if (!NavigateCore(journalEntry, NavigationMode.Back, param) && !CurrentNotInStack)
				{
					_BackStack.Push(item);
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateJournalStack()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void ClearNavigationHistoryOverride()
		{
			_ForwardStack.Clear();
			_BackStack.Clear();
			if (Current != null && Current.SaveToHistory)
			{
				_BackStack.Push(Current);
			}
			UpdateProperties();
		}

		protected virtual JournalEntry CreateJournalEntry(object content, object navigationState)
		{
			return new JournalEntry(content, navigationState)
			{
				KeepAlive = (_Cache.CacheMode != NavigationCacheMode.Disabled)
			};
		}

		protected virtual bool NavigateCore(JournalEntry entry, NavigationMode mode, object navigationState = null)
		{
			NavigationInProgress = true;
			try
			{
				return NavigateCoreOverride(entry, mode, navigationState);
			}
			finally
			{
				NavigationInProgress = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool NavigateCoreOverride(JournalEntry entry, NavigationMode mode, object navigationState)
		{
			object navigationState2 = navigationState ?? entry.Parameter;
			_CurrentNavigation = new NavigationOperation
			{
				TargetEntry = entry,
				NavigationMode = mode,
				NavigationState = navigationState2
			};
			try
			{
				if (Navigator.Navigating(entry.Source, mode, _CurrentNavigation.NavigationState))
				{
					if (_Cache.Contains(entry.Source))
					{
						ApplyContent(_Cache.GetPage(entry.Source));
					}
					else if (entry.Source != null)
					{
						_CurrentNavigation.AsyncResult = NavigationContentProvider.BeginLoad(entry.Source, OnContentLoaded, _CurrentNavigation);
					}
					else
					{
						ApplyContent(null);
					}
					return true;
				}
				Navigator.NavigationStopped(entry.Source, mode, _CurrentNavigation.NavigationState);
			}
			catch (NavigationException e)
			{
				Navigator.NavigationFailed(entry.Source, e);
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				Navigator.NavigationFailed(entry.Source, new NavigationException(entry.Source, innerException));
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnCanGoBackChanged()
		{
			if (this.CanGoBackChanged != null)
			{
				this.CanGoBackChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnCanGoForwardChanged()
		{
			if (this.CanGoForwardChanged != null)
			{
				this.CanGoForwardChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual INavigationContentProvider ResolveContentProvider()
		{
			return new NavigationContentProvider();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateProperties()
		{
			UpdateJournalStack();
			OnPropertyChanged("CanGoBack");
			OnPropertyChanged("CanGoForward");
		}

		private void ApplyContent(object content)
		{
			JournalEntry journalEntry = _CurrentNavigation.TargetEntry;
			switch (_CurrentNavigation.NavigationMode)
			{
			case NavigationMode.New:
				if (_BackStack.Count > 0)
				{
					JournalEntry journalEntry2 = _BackStack.Peek();
					if (journalEntry2 != null && journalEntry2 == Current && journalEntry2.Content == null)
					{
						_BackStack.Pop();
					}
				}
				if (journalEntry.SaveToHistory)
				{
					_BackStack.Push(journalEntry);
				}
				_ForwardStack.Clear();
				break;
			case NavigationMode.Back:
				if (Current.Content != null && Current.SaveToHistory)
				{
					_ForwardStack.Push(Current);
				}
				break;
			case NavigationMode.Forward:
				if (Current.Content != null)
				{
					_BackStack.Push(_ForwardStack.Pop());
				}
				journalEntry = _BackStack.Peek();
				break;
			}
			if (Current != null && !Current.KeepAlive)
			{
				Current.ClearContent();
			}
			Current = journalEntry;
			if (content is DependencyObject dependencyObject)
			{
				object obj = (journalEntry as ISupportParentViewModel).With((ISupportParentViewModel x) => x.ParentViewModel);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					ViewModelExtensions.SetParentViewModel(dependencyObject, obj);
				}
			}
			Current.SetContent(content);
			UpdateProperties();
			Navigator.NavigationComplete(Current.Source, Current.Content, _CurrentNavigation.NavigationState);
		}

		private void ClearCache()
		{
			_Cache.Clear();
		}

		private void OnBackStackCountChanged(object sender, JournalEntryStackCountChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if ((e.OldValue == 1 && _BackStack.Count == 2) || (e.OldValue == 2 && _BackStack.Count == 1))
			{
				OnCanGoBackChanged();
			}
		}

		private void OnContentLoaded(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				LoadResult loadResult = NavigationContentProvider.EndLoad(result);
				if (loadResult == null)
				{
					throw new NavigationException(_CurrentNavigation.TargetEntry.Source);
				}
				object loadedContent = loadResult.LoadedContent;
				_Cache.InsertPage(_CurrentNavigation.TargetEntry.Source, loadedContent);
				ApplyContent(loadedContent);
				if (Locker.op_Implicit(clearHistoryLocker))
				{
					ClearNavigationHistoryOverride();
				}
			}
			catch (NavigationException e)
			{
				Navigator.NavigationFailed((Current != null) ? Current.Source : null, e);
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				object source = ((Current != null) ? Current.Source : _CurrentNavigation.TargetEntry.Source);
				Navigator.NavigationFailed(source, new NavigationException(source, innerException));
			}
			finally
			{
				clearHistoryLocker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		private void OnForwardStackCountChanged(object sender, JournalEntryStackCountChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if ((e.OldValue == 0 && _BackStack.Count == 1) || (e.OldValue == 1 && _BackStack.Count == 0))
			{
				OnCanGoForwardChanged();
			}
		}

		protected void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}
	public class JournalEntry
	{
		private object content;

		public string Name { get; private set; }

		public object Source { get; private set; }

		public bool SaveToHistory { get; set; }

		public object Content
		{
			get
			{
				return content;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (content != value)
				{
					content = value;
					if (this.ContentChanged != null)
					{
						this.ContentChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public object Parameter { get; internal set; }

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public object NavigationParameter => Parameter;

		public bool KeepAlive { get; set; }

		public event EventHandler ContentChanged;

		public JournalEntry(object source, string name, object parameter = null)
		{
			Source = source;
			Name = name;
			Parameter = parameter;
			SaveToHistory = true;
		}

		public JournalEntry(object source, object parameter = null)
			: this(source, string.Empty, parameter)
		{
		}

		public JournalEntry()
		{
		}

		internal void ClearContent()
		{
			if (Content != null && !KeepAlive)
			{
				SetContent(null);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetContent(object content)
		{
			Content = content;
		}
	}

			: base(source, name, parameter)

		}

	internal class JournalEntryStackCountChangedEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private readonly int oldValue;

		public int OldValue => oldValue;

		public JournalEntryStackCountChangedEventArgs(int oldValue)
		{
			this.oldValue = oldValue;
		}
	}
	internal class JournalEntryStack : IEnumerable<JournalEntry>, IEnumerable, ICollection
	{
		private readonly Stack<JournalEntry> innerStack = new Stack<JournalEntry>();

		public int Count => innerStack.Count;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => false;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot
		{
			get
			{
				ICollection collection = innerStack;
				return collection.SyncRoot;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<JournalEntryStackCountChangedEventArgs> CountChanged;

		public void Clear()
		{
			innerStack.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(JournalEntry item)
		{
			return innerStack.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(JournalEntry[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			innerStack.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public IEnumerator<JournalEntry> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return innerStack.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public JournalEntry Peek()
		{
			return innerStack.Peek();
		}

		public JournalEntry Pop()
		{
			JournalEntry result = innerStack.Pop();
			if (this.CountChanged != null)
			{
				this.CountChanged(this, new JournalEntryStackCountChangedEventArgs(Count + 1));
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void Push(JournalEntry item)
		{
			innerStack.Push(item);
			if (this.CountChanged != null)
			{
				this.CountChanged(this, new JournalEntryStackCountChangedEventArgs(Count - 1));
			}
		}

		public JournalEntry[] ToArray()
		{
			return innerStack.ToArray();
		}

		public void TrimExcess()
		{
			innerStack.TrimExcess();
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			CopyTo((JournalEntry[])array, index);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public class NavigationException : Exception
	{
		public NavigationException(string message)
			: base(message)
		{
		}

		public NavigationException(string message, Exception innerException)
			: base(message, innerException)
		{
		}

		public NavigationException(object source, Exception innerException = null)
			: base($"Navigation error navigating to {source}", innerException)
		{
		}
	}
	public class Navigation
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty NavigateToProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NavigationParameterProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NavigationTargetProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NavigationHandlerProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SaveToNavigationJournalProperty;

		private static readonly NavigationHandlerFactory NavigationHandlerFactory;

		static Navigation()
		{
			NavigationHandlerFactory = new NavigationHandlerFactory();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<Navigation> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<Navigation>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached<object>("NavigateTo", ref NavigateToProperty, null, OnNavigateToChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached<object>("NavigationParameter", ref NavigationParameterProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached<object>("NavigationTarget", ref NavigationTargetProperty, null, OnNavigationTargetChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached<INavigationHandler>("NavigationHandler", ref NavigationHandlerProperty, null, OnNavigationHandlerChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("SaveToNavigationJournal", ref SaveToNavigationJournalProperty, defValue: true);
		}

		public static object GetNavigateTo(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return target.GetValue(NavigateToProperty);
		}

		public static void SetNavigateTo(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			target.SetValue(NavigateToProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnNavigateToChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnNavigateToChanged(o, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}

		private static void OnNavigateToChanged(DependencyObject o, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			INavigationHandler navigationHandler = GetNavigationHandler(o);
			if (navigationHandler == null)
			{
				navigationHandler = NavigationHandlerFactory.Resolve(o);
				SetNavigationHandler(o, navigationHandler);
			}
			RegisterSender(o, navigationHandler);
		}

		public static object GetNavigationParameter(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return target.GetValue(NavigationParameterProperty);
		}

		public static void SetNavigationParameter(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			target.SetValue(NavigationParameterProperty, value);
		}

		public static object GetNavigationTarget(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return target.GetValue(NavigationTargetProperty);
		}

		public static void SetNavigationTarget(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			target.SetValue(NavigationTargetProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnNavigationTargetChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnNavigationTargetChanged(o, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}

		private static void OnNavigationTargetChanged(DependencyObject o, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			INavigationHandler navigationHandler = GetNavigationHandler(o);
			if (navigationHandler == null)
			{
				navigationHandler = NavigationHandlerFactory.Resolve(o);
				SetNavigationHandler(o, navigationHandler);
			}
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				navigationHandler.UnregisterTarget(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				navigationHandler.RegisterTarget(newValue);
			}
		}

		public static INavigationHandler GetNavigationHandler(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (INavigationHandler)target.GetValue(NavigationHandlerProperty);
		}

		public static void SetNavigationHandler(DependencyObject target, INavigationHandler value)
		{
			target.SetValue(NavigationHandlerProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnNavigationHandlerChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnNavigationHandlerChanged(o, (INavigationHandler)e.OldValue, (INavigationHandler)e.NewValue);
		}

		private static void OnNavigationHandlerChanged(DependencyObject o, INavigationHandler oldValue, INavigationHandler newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.UnregisterSender(o);
				oldValue.UnregisterTarget(GetNavigationTarget(o));
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				RegisterSender(o, newValue);
			}
		}

		private static void RegisterSender(DependencyObject sender, INavigationHandler handler)
		{
			handler.UnregisterSender(sender);
			object navigateTo = GetNavigateTo(sender);
			object navigationParameter = GetNavigationParameter(sender);
			handler.RegisterSender(sender, navigateTo, navigationParameter);
		}

		public static bool GetSaveToNavigationJournal(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (bool)target.GetValue(SaveToNavigationJournalProperty);
		}

		public static void SetSaveToNavigationJournal(DependencyObject target, bool value)
		{
			target.SetValue(SaveToNavigationJournalProperty, value);
		}
	}
	public interface INavigationHandler
	{
		void RegisterSender(DependencyObject sender, object navigateTo, object param);

		void UnregisterSender(DependencyObject sender);

		void RegisterTarget(object target);

		void UnregisterTarget(object target);
	}
	public abstract class NavigationHandlerBase : INavigationHandler
	{
		private readonly NavigationTargetFactory NavigationTargetFactory = new NavigationTargetFactory();

		private INavigationTarget Navigator;

		private object Target;

		protected INavigationContainer Container;

		protected abstract void RegisterSender(DependencyObject sender, object navigateTo, object param);

		protected abstract void UnregisterSender(DependencyObject sender);

		protected void RegisterTarget(object target)
		{
			Target = target;
		}

		protected virtual void UnregisterTarget(object target)
		{
			Target = null;
			Navigator = null;
		}

		protected abstract bool IsSenderSupported(DependencyObject target);

		protected virtual INavigationTarget ResolveNavigationHost(object target)
		{
			return NavigationTargetFactory.Resolve(target);
		}

		protected void InvokeNavigation(object sender, object navigateTo, object navigationParameter)
		{
			InvokeNavigation(sender as DependencyObject, navigateTo, navigationParameter);
		}

		private void InvokeNavigation(DependencyObject sender, object navigateTo, object navigationParameter)
		{
			if (sender == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (navigateTo == null)
			{
				navigateTo = Navigation.GetNavigateTo(sender);
			}
			if (navigationParameter == null)
			{
				navigationParameter = Navigation.GetNavigationParameter(sender);
			}
			bool saveToNavigationJournal = Navigation.GetSaveToNavigationJournal(sender);
			if (navigateTo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Target == null)
			{
				FrameworkElement element = sender as FrameworkElement;
				Target = NavigationHelper.GetNavigationContainer(element);
				if (Target == null)
				{
					Target = NavigationHelper.GetFrame(element);
				}
			}
			if (Target != null)
			{
				if (Navigator == null)
				{
					Navigator = ResolveNavigationHost(Target);
				}
				Navigator.Navigate(Target, navigateTo, navigationParameter, saveToNavigationJournal);
			}
		}

		void INavigationHandler.RegisterSender(DependencyObject sender, object navigateTo, object param)
		{
			if (!IsSenderSupported(sender))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			RegisterSender(sender, navigateTo, param);
		}

		void INavigationHandler.UnregisterSender(DependencyObject sender)
		{
			if (!IsSenderSupported(sender))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			UnregisterSender(sender);
		}

		void INavigationHandler.RegisterTarget(object target)
		{
			RegisterTarget(target);
		}

		void INavigationHandler.UnregisterTarget(object target)
		{
			UnregisterTarget(target);
		}
	}
	public class ClickableNavigationHandler : NavigationHandlerBase
	{
		private EventHandler Handler;

		protected override void RegisterSender(DependencyObject sender, object navigateTo, object param)
		{
			IClickable clickable = sender as IClickable;
			Handler = delegate(object s, EventArgs e)
			{
				InvokeNavigation(s, navigateTo, param);
			};
			clickable.Click += Handler;
		}

		protected override void UnregisterSender(DependencyObject sender)
		{
			IClickable clickable = sender as IClickable;
			clickable.Click -= Handler;
		}

		protected override bool IsSenderSupported(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return target is IClickable;
		}
	}
	public class ButtonNavigationHandler : NavigationHandlerBase
	{
		private RoutedEventHandler Handler;

		protected override void RegisterSender(DependencyObject sender, object navigateTo, object param)
		{
			ButtonBase buttonBase = sender as ButtonBase;
			Handler = delegate(object s, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				InvokeNavigation(s, navigateTo, param);
			};
			buttonBase.Click += Handler;
		}

		protected override void UnregisterSender(DependencyObject sender)
		{
			ButtonBase buttonBase = sender as ButtonBase;
			if (Handler != null)
			{
				buttonBase.Click -= Handler;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsSenderSupported(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return target is ButtonBase;
		}
	}
	public class BarItemNavigationHandler : NavigationHandlerBase
	{
		private ItemClickEventHandler Handler;

		protected override void RegisterSender(DependencyObject sender, object navigateTo, object param)
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Expected O, but got Unknown
			BarItem val = (BarItem)(object)((sender is BarItem) ? sender : null);
			Handler = (ItemClickEventHandler)delegate(object s, ItemClickEventArgs e)
			{
				InvokeNavigation(s, navigateTo, param);
			};
			val.ItemClick += Handler;
		}

		protected override void UnregisterSender(DependencyObject sender)
		{
			BarItem val = (BarItem)(object)((sender is BarItem) ? sender : null);
			if (Handler != null)
			{
				val.ItemClick -= Handler;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsSenderSupported(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return target is BarItem;
		}
	}
	internal static class NavigationHelper
	{
		private class ValueProvider : FrameworkElement
		{
			public static DependencyProperty ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Value", typeof(object), typeof(ValueProvider), new PropertyMetadata(null));

			public object Value
			{
				get
				{
					return GetValue(ValueProperty);
				}
				set
				{
					SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void NavigateTo(FrameworkElement element, string targetType, object dataContext, BindingBase targetParameterBinding, BindingBase targetTypeBinding = null)
		{
			object targetParameter = null;
			if (dataContext != null)
			{
				ValueProvider valueProvider = new ValueProvider
				{
					DataContext = dataContext
				};
				if (targetParameterBinding != null)
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(valueProvider, ValueProvider.ValueProperty, targetParameterBinding);
					targetParameter = valueProvider.Value;
				}
				if (targetTypeBinding != null)
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(valueProvider, ValueProvider.ValueProperty, targetTypeBinding);
					targetType = (valueProvider.Value as string) ?? targetType;
				}
			}
			NavigateTo(element, targetType, targetParameter);
		}

		private static void NavigateTo(FrameworkElement element, string targetType, object targetParameter, bool clearNavigationHistory = false)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetType))
			{
				INavigationContainer navigationContainer = GetNavigationContainer(element);
				navigationContainer.Navigate(targetType, targetParameter.ToString());
			}
		}

		private static object ResolveView(FrameworkElement element, string targetType, object dataContext, BindingBase targetParameterBinding, BindingBase targetTypeBinding = null)
		{
			object obj = null;
			if (dataContext != null)
			{
				ValueProvider valueProvider = new ValueProvider
				{
					DataContext = dataContext
				};
				if (targetParameterBinding != null)
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(valueProvider, ValueProvider.ValueProperty, targetParameterBinding);
					obj = valueProvider.Value;
				}
				if (targetTypeBinding != null)
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(valueProvider, ValueProvider.ValueProperty, targetTypeBinding);
					targetType = (valueProvider.Value as string) ?? targetType;
				}
			}
			return ResolveViewHardWay(targetType);
		}

		private static object ResolveViewHardWay(string documentType)
		{
			Application current = Application.Current;
			if (current == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = current.GetType().Assembly.GetTypes().FirstOrDefault((Type t) => t.Name == documentType);
			if (type == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Activator.CreateInstance(type);
		}

		public static void GoBack(FrameworkElement element, object param = null)
		{
			GetNavigationContainer(element)?.GoBack(param);
		}

		public static void GoForward(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			GetNavigationContainer(element)?.GoForward();
		}

		public static bool CanGoBack(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			return GetNavigationContainer(element)?.CanGoBack ?? false;
		}

		public static bool CanGoForward(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			return GetNavigationContainer(element)?.CanGoForward ?? false;
		}

		internal static INavigationContainer GetNavigationContainer(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (element is INavigationContainer)
			{
				return (INavigationContainer)element;
			}
			return LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<INavigationContainer>((DependencyObject)element);
		}

		internal static Frame GetFrame(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (element is Frame)
			{
				return (Frame)element;
			}
			return LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Frame>((DependencyObject)element);
		}
	}
	public interface INavigationTarget
	{
		void Navigate(object target, object source, object param, bool saveToJournal);

		bool IsSupported(object target);
	}
	public abstract class NavigationTargetBase<T> : INavigationTarget where T : class
	{
		protected abstract void Navigate(T target, object source, object param, bool saveToJournal);

		public bool IsSupported(object target)
		{
			return target is T;
		}

		void INavigationTarget.Navigate(object target, object source, object param, bool saveToJournal)
		{
			if (IsSupported(target))
			{
				Navigate(target as T, source, param, saveToJournal);
			}
		}

		bool INavigationTarget.IsSupported(object target)
		{
			return IsSupported(target);
		}
	}
