	public class TypeProvider
	{
		public static TypeProvider Current = new TypeProvider();

		protected static readonly Dictionary<string, Type> TypesCache = new Dictionary<string, Type>();

		public virtual IEnumerable<Assembly> Assemblies => AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();

		public virtual Type GetTypeByName(string typeName)
		{
			if (Assemblies == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type value = null;
			if (TypesCache.TryGetValue(typeName, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			Assembly executingAssembly = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly();
			value = executingAssembly.GetTypes().FirstOrDefault((Type t) => t.Name == typeName);
			if (value != null)
			{
				TypesCache[typeName] = value;
				return value;
			}
			foreach (Assembly assembly in Assemblies)
			{
				if (assembly == executingAssembly)
				{
					continue;
				}
				try
				{
					value = assembly.GetTypes().FirstOrDefault((Type t) => t.Name == typeName);
					if (value != null)
					{
						TypesCache[typeName] = value;
						return value;
					}
				}
				catch (ReflectionTypeLoadException)
				{
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	[TargetType(typeof(NavigationFrame))]
	public class FrameNavigationService : NavigationServiceBase
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty FrameNavigationServiceProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("FrameNavigationService", typeof(FrameNavigationService), typeof(FrameNavigationService), null);

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SplashScreenServiceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SplashScreenService", typeof(object), typeof(FrameNavigationService), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnSplashScreenServiceChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowSplashScreenProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowSplashScreen", typeof(bool), typeof(FrameNavigationService), new PropertyMetadata(true));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FrameProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Frame", typeof(NavigationFrame), typeof(FrameNavigationService), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnFrameChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Source", typeof(string), typeof(FrameNavigationService), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((FrameNavigationService)(object)dObj).OnSourceChanged(e.OldValue as string, e.NewValue as string);
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PrefetchedSourcesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PrefetchedSources", typeof(IEnumerable), typeof(FrameNavigationService), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnPrefetchedSourcesChanged));

		internal const string ExceptionFrameNotSet = "Navigation failed because the Frame property has not been set. Try to attach FrameNavigationService directly to NavigationFrame.";

		private NavigationFrame _ActualFrame;

		private bool notifySupportNavigation;

		public NavigationFrame Frame
		{
			get
			{
				return (NavigationFrame)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(FrameProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(FrameProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable PrefetchedSources
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(PrefetchedSourcesProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(PrefetchedSourcesProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public bool ShowSplashScreen
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ShowSplashScreenProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(ShowSplashScreenProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public string Source
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(SourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(SourceProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public object SplashScreenService
		{
			get
			{
				return ((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(SplashScreenServiceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(SplashScreenServiceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override bool AllowAttachInDesignMode => true;

		protected override BackNavigationMode BackNavigationMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualFrame == null)
				{
					return base.BackNavigationMode;
				}
				return ActualFrame.BackNavigationMode;
			}
		}

		protected override bool Initialized => ActualFrame != null;

		private NavigationFrame ActualFrame
		{
			get
			{
				return _ActualFrame;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_ActualFrame != value)
				{
					NavigationFrame actualFrame = _ActualFrame;
					_ActualFrame = value;
					OnActualFrameChanged(actualFrame, value);
				}
			}
		}

		internal event EventHandler NavigationStopped;

		private static void OnFrameChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (o is FrameNavigationService frameNavigationService)
			{
				frameNavigationService.OnFrameChanged((NavigationFrame)e.OldValue, (NavigationFrame)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static FrameNavigationService GetFrameNavigationService(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (FrameNavigationService)target.GetValue(FrameNavigationServiceProperty);
		}

		private static void SetFrameNavigationService(DependencyObject target, FrameNavigationService value)
		{
			target.SetValue(FrameNavigationServiceProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnSplashScreenServiceChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewValue == null || e.NewValue is ISplashScreenService || e.NewValue is ISplashScreenManagerService)
			{
				return;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("The SplashScreenService must implement either the ISplashScreenService or ISplashScreenManagerService interface.");
		}

		protected override void StartNavigation(JournalEntry entry)
		{
			base.StartNavigation(entry);
			DocumentJournalEntry.JournalDocument document = ((entry is DocumentJournalEntry) ? ((DocumentJournalEntry)entry).document : null);
			StartNavigation(document);
			if (!IsContentEquals(entry) && !IsContentEquals(document))
			{
				TryShowSplashScreen();
			}
		}

		private static void OnPrefetchedSourcesChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (o is FrameNavigationService frameNavigationService)
			{
				frameNavigationService.OnPrefetchedSourcesChanged((IEnumerable)e.OldValue, (IEnumerable)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnFrameNavigated(object sender, NavigationEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void OnNavigating()
		{
			base.OnNavigating();
			notifySupportNavigation = true;
		}

		protected override void CheckNavigator()
		{
			if (base.Journal.Navigator == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Navigation failed because the Frame property has not been set. Try to attach FrameNavigationService directly to NavigationFrame.");
			}
		}

		protected override bool GetCanNavigate()
		{
			return ActualFrame != null;
		}

		protected override void InvokeNavigation(Action navigationAction)
		{
			if (((DispatcherObject)(object)this).CheckAccess() && Frame == null)
			{
				((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(navigationAction, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
			}
			else
			{
				base.InvokeNavigation(navigationAction);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((ServiceBase)this).OnAttached();
			if (((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)(object)this).AssociatedObject is NavigationFrame actualFrame)
			{
				SetActualFrame(actualFrame);
			}
			else
			{
				((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)(object)this).AssociatedObject.Loaded += OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)(object)this).AssociatedObject.Loaded -= OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			ActualFrame = null;
			((ServiceBase)this).OnDetaching();
		}

		protected virtual void OnFrameChanged(NavigationFrame oldValue, NavigationFrame newValue)
		{
			ActualFrame = newValue;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSourceChanged(string oldValue, string newValue)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Source) && ActualFrame != null)
			{
				ActualFrame.Navigate(Source);
			}
		}

		private void DetachFromNavigationFrame(NavigationFrame frame)
		{
			if (frame != null)
			{
				frame.AttachedJournal = null;
				frame.Navigated -= OnFrameNavigated;
				frame.ContentRendered -= OnFrameContentRendered;
				frame.NavigationFailed -= OnFrameNavigationStopped;
				frame.NavigationCanceled -= OnFrameNavigationStopped;
				frame.ClearValue(FrameNavigationServiceProperty);
			}
		}

		private ISplashScreenService GetSplashScreenService()
		{
			if (SplashScreenService is ISplashScreenService result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return ((ServiceBaseGeneric<FrameworkElement>)(object)this).GetServicesClient()?.ServiceContainer.GetService<ISplashScreenService>();
		}

		private ISplashScreenManagerService GetSplashScreenManagerService()
		{
			if (SplashScreenService is ISplashScreenManagerService result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return ((ServiceBaseGeneric<FrameworkElement>)(object)this).GetServicesClient()?.ServiceContainer.GetService<ISplashScreenManagerService>();
		}

		private void OnActualFrameChanged(NavigationFrame oldValue, NavigationFrame newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				base.Journal.Navigator = null;
				DetachFromNavigationFrame(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				FrameNavigationService frameNavigationService = GetFrameNavigationService(newValue);
				if (frameNavigationService != null)
				{
					frameNavigationService.DetachFromNavigationFrame(frameNavigationService.Frame);
					frameNavigationService.Frame = null;
				}
				AddBackStackEntry(newValue.Journal.Current);
				base.Journal.Navigator = newValue;
				newValue.AttachedJournal = base.Journal;
				newValue.Navigated += OnFrameNavigated;
				newValue.NavigationFailed += OnFrameNavigationStopped;
				newValue.NavigationCanceled += OnFrameNavigationStopped;
				newValue.ContentRendered += OnFrameContentRendered;
				SetFrameNavigationService(newValue, this);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Source))
				{
					newValue.Navigate(Source);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnAssociatedObjectLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)(object)this).AssociatedObject.Loaded -= OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			SetActualFrame(LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<NavigationFrame>((DependencyObject)((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)(object)this).AssociatedObject));
		}

		private void OnFrameContentRendered(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			object currentContent = GetCurrentContent();
			if (currentContent != null && ViewHelper.GetViewModelFromView(currentContent) is ISupportNavigation supportNavigation && notifySupportNavigation)
			{
				supportNavigation.OnNavigatedTo();
			}
			notifySupportNavigation = false;
			TryHideSplashScreen();
		}

		private void OnFrameNavigationStopped(object sender, NavigationBaseEventArgs e)
		{
			TryHideSplashScreen();
			if (this.NavigationStopped != null)
			{
				this.NavigationStopped(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void OnPrefetchedSourcesChanged(IEnumerable oldValue, IEnumerable newValue)
		{
			ActualFrame.Prefetch(oldValue, newValue);
		}

		private void SetActualFrame(NavigationFrame frame)
		{
			if (ActualFrame == null)
			{
				ActualFrame = frame;
			}
		}

		private void TryHideSplashScreen()
		{
			if (!ShowSplashScreen)
			{
				return;
			}
			ISplashScreenManagerService service = GetSplashScreenManagerService();
			if (service != null)
			{
				BackgroundHelper.DoWithDispatcher(((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher, (Action)delegate
				{
					service.Close();
				});
				return;
			}
			GetSplashScreenService().Do(delegate(ISplashScreenService s)
			{
				BackgroundHelper.DoWithDispatcher(((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher, (Action)delegate
				{
					s.HideSplashScreen();
				});
			});
		}

		private void TryShowSplashScreen()
		{
			if (!ShowSplashScreen)
			{
				return;
			}
			ISplashScreenManagerService splashScreenManagerService = GetSplashScreenManagerService();
			if (splashScreenManagerService != null)
			{
				splashScreenManagerService.Show();
				return;
			}
			GetSplashScreenService().Do(delegate(ISplashScreenService s)
			{
				s.ShowSplashScreen();
			});
		}
	}
	public abstract class NavigationServiceBase : DocumentUIServiceBase, INavigationService, IDocumentManagerService, IDocumentOwner
	{
		internal class NavigationServiceJournalEntry : JournalEntry
		{
			public object ViewModel { get; set; }

			public object ParentViewModel { get; set; }

			public NavigationServiceJournalEntry(object source)
				: base(source)
			{
			}

			public NavigationServiceJournalEntry(object source, object parameter)
				: base(source, parameter)
			{
			}
		}

		internal class DocumentJournalEntry : NavigationServiceJournalEntry
		{
			internal class JournalDocument : IDocument, IDocumentInfo
			{
				internal string documentType;

				public object Content => ViewHelper.GetViewModelFromView(Entry.GetView());

				public bool DestroyOnClose
				{
					get
					{
						return Entry.DestroyOnClose;
					}
					set
					{
						Entry.DestroyOnClose = value;
					}
				}

				public string DocumentType => documentType;

				public DocumentJournalEntry Entry { get; private set; }

				public object Id { get; set; }

				public DocumentState State { get; internal set; }

				public object Title
				{
					get
					{
						DocumentUIServiceBase.CheckDocumentAccess(Entry.Page != null);
						return Entry.Page.Header;
					}
					set
					{
						DocumentUIServiceBase.CheckDocumentAccess(Entry.Page != null);
						Entry.Page.Header = value;
					}
				}

				public JournalDocument(DocumentJournalEntry entry)
				{
					Entry = entry;
					State = DocumentState.Hidden;
				}

				void IDocument.Close(bool force)
				{
					if (Entry.navigationService.IsSelectedDocument(this))
					{
						Entry.navigationService.CloseCurrentPage(force, allowCloseLastPage: true);
						State = ((!Entry.DestroyOnClose) ? DocumentState.Hidden : DocumentState.Destroyed);
					}
				}

				void IDocument.Hide()
				{
					State = DocumentState.Hidden;
					Entry.navigationService.GoBack();
				}

				void IDocument.Show()
				{
					State = DocumentState.Visible;
					Entry.navigationService.Navigate(this);
				}
			}

			internal JournalDocument document;

			private readonly NavigationServiceBase navigationService;

			private bool destroyOnClose = true;

			private object pageHeader;

			public bool DestroyOnClose
			{
				get
				{
					return destroyOnClose;
				}
				set
				{
					destroyOnClose = value;
					base.KeepAlive = !DestroyOnClose;
				}
			}

			public PageAdornerControl Page => (PageAdornerControl)base.Content;

			public DocumentJournalEntry(object source, NavigationServiceBase navigationService)
				: base(source)
			{
				if (navigationService == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("navigationService");
				}
				this.navigationService = navigationService;
				document = new JournalDocument(this);
			}

			public object GetView()
			{
				DocumentUIServiceBase.CheckDocumentAccess(Page != null);
				navigationService.NavigationJournal.EnsurePageContent(document);
				if (Page.Content is DependencyObject dependencyObject)
				{
					DXSerializer.SetEnabled(dependencyObject, false);
				}
				return Page.Content;
			}

			protected internal override void SetContent(object content)
			{
				if (Page != null)
				{
					pageHeader = Page.Header;
				}
				base.SetContent(content);
				if (Page != null)
				{
					Page.Header = pageHeader;
					pageHeader = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private class NavigationServiceJournal : Journal
		{
			private BackwardNavigation backwardNavigation;

			public BackwardNavigation BackwardNavigation
			{
				get
				{
					return backwardNavigation;
				}
				set
				{
					if (backwardNavigation != value)
					{
						backwardNavigation = value;
						OnPropertyChanged("BackwardNavigation");
					}
				}
			}

			public bool ForceClose { get; set; }

			public new bool NavigationInProgress => base.NavigationInProgress;

			public NavigationServiceBase Owner { get; set; }

			protected override bool SupportNoneJournalEntry => true;

			public void AddBackStackEntry(JournalEntry entry)
			{
				if (entry != null)
				{
					NavigationServiceJournalEntry navigationServiceJournalEntry = entry as NavigationServiceJournalEntry;
					if (navigationServiceJournalEntry == null)
					{
						navigationServiceJournalEntry = new NavigationServiceJournalEntry(entry.Source, entry.Parameter);
						navigationServiceJournalEntry.SetContent(entry.Content);
					}
					_BackStack.Push(navigationServiceJournalEntry);
					if (base.Current == null)
					{
						base.Current = navigationServiceJournalEntry;
					}
				}
			}

			public IDocument CreateDocument(object source, object viewModel, object parameter, object parentViewModel)
			{
				DocumentJournalEntry documentJournalEntry = new DocumentJournalEntry(source, Owner)
				{
					Parameter = parameter,
					ParentViewModel = parentViewModel,
					ViewModel = viewModel
				};
				documentJournalEntry.document.documentType = source as string;
				EnsureEntryContent(documentJournalEntry);
				return documentJournalEntry.document;
			}

			public void EnsurePageContent(IDocument document)
			{
				if (document == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				DocumentJournalEntry entry = ((DocumentJournalEntry.JournalDocument)document).Entry;
				PageAdornerControl page = entry.Page;
				if (page != null && page.Content == null)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)(page.Content = CreateView(entry));
					((ViewServiceBase)Owner).InitializeDocumentContainer((FrameworkElement)page, ContentControl.ContentProperty, Owner.GetDocumentContainerStyle(page, frameworkElement));
					if (page.Header == null)
					{
						DocumentUIServiceBase.SetTitleBinding((object)frameworkElement, veHeaderedContentControl.HeaderProperty, (DependencyObject)page, false);
					}
				}
			}

			public IDocument GetCurrentDocument()
			{
				if (base.Current is DocumentJournalEntry documentJournalEntry)
				{
					return documentJournalEntry.document;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public IEnumerable<IDocument> GetDocuments()
			{
				return (from j in base.BackStack.Concat(base.ForwardStack).OfType<DocumentJournalEntry>()
					where j.Page != null
					select j.document).Distinct().ToArray();
			}

			public void Navigate(IDocument document)
			{
				if (document != GetCurrentDocument())
				{
					DocumentJournalEntry entry = ((DocumentJournalEntry.JournalDocument)document).Entry;
					NavigateCore(entry, NavigationMode.New, entry.Parameter);
				}
			}

			public void Navigate(string viewType, object viewModel, object parameter, object parentViewModel, bool saveToJournal)
			{
				NavigationServiceJournalEntry navigationServiceJournalEntry = new NavigationServiceJournalEntry(viewType, parameter)
				{
					ViewModel = viewModel,
					ParentViewModel = parentViewModel,
					SaveToHistory = saveToJournal
				};
				NavigateCore(navigationServiceJournalEntry, NavigationMode.New, navigationServiceJournalEntry.Parameter);
			}

			internal override void UpdateJournalStack()
			{
				if (BackwardNavigation == BackwardNavigation.Default)
				{
					return;
				}
				IEnumerable<object> backStack = base.PrefetchingStrategy.BackStack;
				IEnumerable<object> forwardStack = base.PrefetchingStrategy.ForwardStack;
				List<JournalEntry> list = new List<JournalEntry>();
				while (_BackStack.Any())
				{
					list.Add(_BackStack.Pop());
				}
				foreach (object obj in backStack)
				{
					JournalEntry journalEntry = list.FirstOrDefault((JournalEntry x) => x.Source == obj);
					_BackStack.Push(journalEntry ?? CreateJournalEntry(obj, null));
				}
				if (base.Current != null)
				{
					_BackStack.Push(base.Current);
				}
				while (_ForwardStack.Any())
				{
					list.Add(_ForwardStack.Pop());
				}
				foreach (object obj2 in forwardStack)
				{
					JournalEntry journalEntry2 = list.FirstOrDefault((JournalEntry x) => x.Source == obj2);
					_ForwardStack.Push(journalEntry2 ?? CreateJournalEntry(obj2, null));
				}
			}

			protected override JournalEntry CreateJournalEntry(object content, object navigationState)
			{
				return new NavigationServiceJournalEntry(content, navigationState);
			}

			protected override bool NavigateCoreOverride(JournalEntry entry, NavigationMode mode, object navigationState)
			{
				Owner.OnNavigating();
				try
				{
					object currentContent = Owner.GetCurrentContent();
					if (currentContent != null)
					{
						object viewModelFromView = ViewHelper.GetViewModelFromView(currentContent);
						if (!ForceClose)
						{
							CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
							DocumentViewModelHelper.OnClose(viewModelFromView, e);
							if (e.Cancel)
							{
								return false;
							}
						}
						if (viewModelFromView is ISupportNavigation supportNavigation)
						{
							supportNavigation.OnNavigatedFrom();
						}
					}
					if (!base.Navigator.Navigating(entry.Source, mode, navigationState))
					{
						base.Navigator.NavigationStopped(entry.Source, mode, navigationState);
						return false;
					}
					UpdateJournal(entry, mode);
					if (base.Current != null && !base.Current.KeepAlive)
					{
						object currentViewModel = ViewHelper.GetViewModelFromView(currentContent);
						object entryViewModel = (base.Current as NavigationServiceJournalEntry).Return((NavigationServiceJournalEntry x) => x.ViewModel, () => (object)null);
						object obj = base.Current.Source ?? entryViewModel;
						FrameworkElement _content = base.Current.Content as FrameworkElement;
						if (entryViewModel != null && !_Cache.Contains(obj) && _content != null)
						{
							_content.Unloaded += NavigationServiceJournal_Unloaded;
						}
						if (obj != null)
						{
							_Cache.SetOnDropHook(obj, delegate
							{
								DocumentViewModelHelper.OnDestroy(currentViewModel);
								if (entryViewModel != null && _content != null)
								{
									_content.DataContext = null;
									_content = null;
								}
							});
						}
						base.Current.ClearContent();
					}
					base.Current = ((_BackStack.Count > 0) ? _BackStack.Peek() : (entry as NavigationServiceJournalEntry));
					base.Current.Do(delegate(JournalEntry x)
					{
						x.SetContent(entry.Content);
					});
					if (_BackStack.Count > 0 && !_BackStack.Peek().SaveToHistory)
					{
						_BackStack.Pop();
					}
					if (_ForwardStack.Count > 0 && !_ForwardStack.Peek().SaveToHistory)
					{
						_ForwardStack.Pop();
					}
					Owner.SetSelectedViewModel(ViewHelper.GetViewModelFromView(Owner.GetCurrentContent()));
					UpdateProperties();
					base.Navigator.NavigationComplete(base.Current.With((JournalEntry x) => x.Source), base.Current.With((JournalEntry x) => x.Content), navigationState);
				}
				catch (NavigationException e2)
				{
					base.Navigator.NavigationFailed(entry.Source, e2);
					return false;
				}
				catch (Exception innerException)
				{
					base.Navigator.NavigationFailed(entry.Source, new NavigationException(entry.Source, innerException));
					return false;
				}
				Owner.showNewActiveDocument = false;
				try
				{
					IDocument currentDocument = GetCurrentDocument();
					Owner.SetActiveDocument(currentDocument);
					Owner.SetActiveView(((DocumentJournalEntry.JournalDocument)currentDocument).With((DocumentJournalEntry.JournalDocument x) => x.Entry.GetView()));
				}
				finally
				{
					Owner.showNewActiveDocument = true;
				}
				return true;
			}

			private void NavigationServiceJournal_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (sender is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
				{
					frameworkElement.Unloaded -= NavigationServiceJournal_Unloaded;
					frameworkElement.DataContext = null;
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = null;
				}
			}

			protected override void OnCanGoBackChanged()
			{
				base.OnCanGoBackChanged();
				if (Owner.canGoBackChanged != null)
				{
					Owner.canGoBackChanged(Owner, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}

			protected override void OnCanGoForwardChanged()
			{
				base.OnCanGoForwardChanged();
				if (Owner.canGoForwardChanged != null)
				{
					Owner.canGoForwardChanged(Owner, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}

			private FrameworkElement CreatePage(NavigationServiceJournalEntry entry)
			{
				if (!(entry is DocumentJournalEntry documentJournalEntry))
				{
					return CreateView(entry);
				}
				PageAdornerControl pageAdornerControl = new PageAdornerControl();
				DocumentUIServiceBase.SetDocument((DependencyObject)pageAdornerControl, (IDocument)documentJournalEntry.document);
				return pageAdornerControl;
			}

			private FrameworkElement CreateView(NavigationServiceJournalEntry entry)
			{
				return (FrameworkElement)((ViewServiceBase)Owner).CreateAndInitializeView(entry.Source.With((object x) => x.ToString()), entry.ViewModel, entry.Parameter, entry.ParentViewModel, (IDocumentOwner)Owner);
			}

			private void EnsureEntryContent(NavigationServiceJournalEntry entry)
			{
				if (entry == null || entry.Content != null)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool flag = entry is DocumentJournalEntry;
				object obj = entry.Source ?? entry.ViewModel;
				if (!TryRestoreEntryContent(entry))
				{
					object obj2 = (obj as FrameworkElement) ?? CreatePage(entry);
					if (obj != null && !flag)
					{
						_Cache.InsertPage(obj, obj2);
					}
					entry.SetContent(obj2);
				}
			}

			private void ReInitializePage(object page, NavigationServiceJournalEntry entry)
			{
				ViewHelper.InitializeView(page, entry.ViewModel, entry.Parameter, entry.ParentViewModel, (IDocumentOwner)Owner);
			}

			private bool TryRestoreEntryContent(NavigationServiceJournalEntry entry)
			{
				if (entry == null || entry is DocumentJournalEntry || entry.Content != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				object obj = entry.Source ?? entry.ViewModel;
				if (obj != null && _Cache.TryGetPageAndClearOnDropHook(obj, out var page))
				{
					ReInitializePage(page, entry);
					entry.SetContent(page);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private void UpdateJournal(JournalEntry entry, NavigationMode mode)
			{
				NavigationServiceJournalEntry navigationServiceJournalEntry = entry as NavigationServiceJournalEntry;
				DocumentJournalEntry documentJournalEntry = navigationServiceJournalEntry as DocumentJournalEntry;
				TryRestoreEntryContent(navigationServiceJournalEntry);
				Owner.StartNavigation(entry);
				EnsureEntryContent(navigationServiceJournalEntry);
				EnsurePageContent(documentJournalEntry?.document);
				switch (mode)
				{
				case NavigationMode.New:
					if (navigationServiceJournalEntry == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException();
					}
					_BackStack.Push(navigationServiceJournalEntry);
					_ForwardStack.Clear();
					break;
				case NavigationMode.Back:
					_ForwardStack.Push(base.Current);
					if (entry is NoneJournalEntry)
					{
						_BackStack.Clear();
					}
					break;
				case NavigationMode.Forward:
					_BackStack.Push(_ForwardStack.Pop());
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty BackwardNavigationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BackwardNavigation", typeof(BackwardNavigation), typeof(NavigationServiceBase), new PropertyMetadata(BackwardNavigation.Default, OnBackwardNavigationChanged));

		private readonly NavigationServiceJournal NavigationJournal;

		private EventHandler canGoBackChanged;

		private EventHandler canGoForwardChanged;

		private EventHandler currentChanged;

		private JournalEntry savedCurrent;

		private DocumentJournalEntry.JournalDocument selectedDocument;

		private object selectedEntryViewModel;

		private bool showNewActiveDocument = true;

		private IDocument activeDocument;

		private ActiveDocumentChangedEventHandler activeDocumentChanged;

		internal NavigationPoint CurrentNavigationPoint => new NavigationPoint(NavigationJournal.Current ?? savedCurrent);

		internal BackwardNavigation BackwardNavigation
		{
			get
			{
				return (BackwardNavigation)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(BackwardNavigationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(BackwardNavigationProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public bool CanGoBack => NavigationJournal.CanGoBack;

		public bool CanGoForward => NavigationJournal.CanGoForward;

		public bool CanNavigate => GetCanNavigate();

		public object Current => NavigationJournal.With((NavigationServiceJournal x) => x.Current.With((JournalEntry y) => y.Content));

		protected virtual BackNavigationMode BackNavigationMode => BackNavigationMode.PreviousScreen;

		protected virtual bool Initialized => true;

		protected IJournal Journal => NavigationJournal;

		protected bool NavigationInProgress => NavigationJournal.NavigationInProgress;

		object INavigationService.Current => ViewHelper.GetViewModelFromView(Current);

		public IDocument ActiveDocument
		{
			get
			{
				return activeDocument;
			}
			set
			{
				SetActiveDocument(value);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<IDocument> Documents => NavigationJournal.GetDocuments();

		event EventHandler INavigationService.CanGoBackChanged
		{
			add
			{
				canGoBackChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(canGoBackChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				canGoBackChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(canGoBackChanged, value);
			}
		}

		event EventHandler INavigationService.CanGoForwardChanged
		{
			add
			{
				canGoForwardChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(canGoForwardChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				canGoForwardChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(canGoForwardChanged, value);
			}
		}

		event EventHandler INavigationService.CurrentChanged
		{
			add
			{
				currentChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(currentChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				currentChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(currentChanged, value);
			}
		}

		event ActiveDocumentChangedEventHandler IDocumentManagerService.ActiveDocumentChanged
		{
			add
			{
				activeDocumentChanged = (ActiveDocumentChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(activeDocumentChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				activeDocumentChanged = (ActiveDocumentChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(activeDocumentChanged, value);
			}
		}

		private static void OnBackwardNavigationChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (o is NavigationServiceBase navigationServiceBase)
			{
				navigationServiceBase.OnBackwardStrategyChanged((BackwardNavigation)e.OldValue, (BackwardNavigation)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		public NavigationServiceBase()
		{
			NavigationJournal = new NavigationServiceJournal
			{
				Owner = this
			};
			NavigationJournal.CurrentChanged += OnNavigationJournalCurrentChanged;
		}

		public void ClearCache()
		{
			Journal.ClearNavigationCache();
		}

		public void ClearNavigationHistory()
		{
			Journal.ClearNavigationHistory();
		}

		public void GoBack()
		{
			GoBack(allowCloseLastPage: false);
		}

		public void GoBack(object param)
		{
			if (BackNavigationMode == BackNavigationMode.PreviousScreen)
			{
				NavigationJournal.GoBack(closeLastPage: false, param);
			}
			else
			{
				NavigationJournal.GoHome(param);
			}
		}

		public void GoForward()
		{
			GoForward(null);
		}

		public void GoForward(object param)
		{
			NavigationJournal.GoForward(param);
		}

		public void Navigate(string viewType, object param = null, object parentViewModel = null)
		{
			Navigate(viewType, null, param, parentViewModel, saveToJournal: true);
		}

		public virtual void Navigate(string viewType, object param, object parentViewModel, bool saveToJournal)
		{
			Navigate(viewType, null, param, parentViewModel, saveToJournal);
		}

		public void Navigate(string viewType, object viewModel, object param, object parentViewModel, bool saveToJournal)
		{
			Action navigationAction = delegate
			{
				NavigationJournal.Navigate(viewType, viewModel, param, parentViewModel, saveToJournal);
			};
			InvokeNavigation(navigationAction);
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnNavigating()
		{
			CheckNavigator();
		}

		protected internal virtual void StartNavigation(IDocument document)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void AddBackStackEntry(JournalEntry entry)
		{
			NavigationJournal.AddBackStackEntry(entry);
		}

		protected virtual void CheckNavigator()
		{
		}

		protected virtual bool GetCanNavigate()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected object GetCurrentContent()
		{
			if (Journal.Current is DocumentJournalEntry documentJournalEntry)
			{
				return documentJournalEntry.Page.With((PageAdornerControl x) => x.Content);
			}
			return Journal.Current.With((JournalEntry x) => x.Content);
		}

		protected virtual void InvokeNavigation(Action navigationAction)
		{
			if (((DispatcherObject)this).CheckAccess())
			{
				navigationAction();
			}
			else
			{
				((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.Invoke(navigationAction);
			}
		}

		protected bool IsContentEquals(IDocument document)
		{
			return IsContentEquals(document as JournalEntry);
		}

		protected bool IsContentEquals(JournalEntry journalEntry)
		{
			object obj = NavigationJournal.With((NavigationServiceJournal x) => x.Current.With((JournalEntry y) => y.Content));
			return journalEntry != null && obj != null && journalEntry.Content == obj;
		}

		protected virtual void Navigate(IDocument document)
		{
			SetSelectedDocument(document as DocumentJournalEntry.JournalDocument);
			Action navigationAction = delegate
			{
				NavigationJournal.Navigate(document);
			};
			InvokeNavigation(navigationAction);
		}

		protected virtual void StartNavigation(JournalEntry entry)
		{
		}

		void IDocumentOwner.Close(IDocumentContent documentContent, bool force)
		{
			if (IsSelectedViewModel(documentContent))
			{
				CloseCurrentPage(force, allowCloseLastPage: true);
			}
		}

		private void CloseCurrentPage(bool force, bool allowCloseLastPage)
		{
			NavigationJournal.ForceClose = force;
			try
			{
				GoBack(allowCloseLastPage);
			}
			finally
			{
				NavigationJournal.ForceClose = false;
			}
		}

		private void GoBack(bool allowCloseLastPage)
		{
			if (BackNavigationMode == BackNavigationMode.PreviousScreen)
			{
				NavigationJournal.GoBack(allowCloseLastPage, null);
			}
			else
			{
				NavigationJournal.GoHome();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackwardStrategyChanged(BackwardNavigation oldValue, BackwardNavigation newValue)
		{
			NavigationJournal.BackwardNavigation = newValue;
			ClearNavigationHistory();
			ClearCache();
		}

		private void OnCurrentContentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (currentChanged != null)
			{
				currentChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void OnNavigationJournalCurrentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (savedCurrent != null)
			{
				savedCurrent.ContentChanged -= OnCurrentContentChanged;
			}
			savedCurrent = NavigationJournal.Current;
			if (savedCurrent != null)
			{
				savedCurrent.ContentChanged += OnCurrentContentChanged;
			}
			OnCurrentContentChanged(null, null);
		}

		private void SetSelectedDocument(DocumentJournalEntry.JournalDocument selectedDocument)
		{
			this.selectedDocument = selectedDocument;
			selectedEntryViewModel = null;
		}

		private void SetSelectedViewModel(object selectedEntryViewModel)
		{
			selectedDocument = null;
			this.selectedEntryViewModel = selectedEntryViewModel;
		}

		private bool IsSelectedDocument(DocumentJournalEntry.JournalDocument document)
		{
			if (selectedDocument == null)
			{
				if (document.Entry.Page != null)
				{
					return object.Equals(selectedEntryViewModel, document.Content);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return selectedDocument == document;
		}

		private bool IsSelectedViewModel(object viewModel)
		{
			if (selectedDocument == null)
			{
				return object.Equals(selectedEntryViewModel, viewModel);
			}
			if (selectedDocument.Entry.Page != null)
			{
				return object.Equals(selectedDocument.Content, viewModel);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void SetActiveDocument(IDocument newActiveDocument)
		{
			IDocument document = activeDocument;
			activeDocument = newActiveDocument;
			if (document != newActiveDocument)
			{
				OnActiveDocumentChanged(document, newActiveDocument);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnActiveDocumentChanged(IDocument oldValue, IDocument newValue)
		{
			if (showNewActiveDocument)
			{
				newValue?.Show();
			}
			if (activeDocumentChanged != null)
			{
				activeDocumentChanged(this, new ActiveDocumentChangedEventArgs(oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetActiveView(object newActiveView)
		{
		}

		IDocument IDocumentManagerService.CreateDocument(string documentType, object viewModel, object parameter, object parentViewModel)
		{
			if (!Initialized)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return NavigationJournal.CreateDocument(documentType, viewModel, parameter, parentViewModel);
		}

		protected virtual Style GetDocumentContainerStyle(DependencyObject documentContainer, object view)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	[TargetType(typeof(NavigationFrame))]
	public class FrameDocumentUIService : FrameNavigationService
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty PageAdornerControlStyleProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PageAdornerControlStyleSelectorProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActiveDocumentProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ActiveViewPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActiveViewProperty;

		private bool syncActiveDocument = true;

		public Style PageAdornerControlStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return (Style)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(PageAdornerControlStyleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(PageAdornerControlStyleProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public StyleSelector PageAdornerControlStyleSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return (StyleSelector)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(PageAdornerControlStyleSelectorProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(PageAdornerControlStyleSelectorProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public new IDocument ActiveDocument
		{
			get
			{
				return (IDocument)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ActiveDocumentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(ActiveDocumentProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public object ActiveView
		{
			get
			{
				return ((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ActiveViewProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(ActiveViewPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public event ActiveDocumentChangedEventHandler ActiveDocumentChanged;

		static FrameDocumentUIService()
		{
			PageAdornerControlStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PageAdornerControlStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(FrameDocumentUIService), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			PageAdornerControlStyleSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PageAdornerControlStyleSelector", typeof(StyleSelector), typeof(FrameDocumentUIService), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ActiveDocumentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ActiveDocument", typeof(IDocument), typeof(FrameDocumentUIService), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FrameDocumentUIService)(object)d).OnActiveDocumentChanged(e.OldValue as IDocument, e.NewValue as IDocument);
			}));
			ActiveViewPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ActiveView", typeof(object), typeof(FrameDocumentUIService), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ActiveViewProperty = ActiveViewPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FrameNavigationService.ShowSplashScreenProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(FrameDocumentUIService), new PropertyMetadata(false));
		}

		protected override void SetActiveDocument(IDocument newActiveDocument)
		{
			syncActiveDocument = false;
			try
			{
				ActiveDocument = newActiveDocument;
			}
			finally
			{
				syncActiveDocument = true;
			}
			base.SetActiveDocument(newActiveDocument);
		}

		protected override Style GetDocumentContainerStyle(DependencyObject documentContainer, object view)
		{
			return ((ViewServiceBase)this).GetDocumentContainerStyle(documentContainer, view, PageAdornerControlStyle, PageAdornerControlStyleSelector);
		}

		protected override void OnActiveDocumentChanged(IDocument oldValue, IDocument newValue)
		{
			if (syncActiveDocument)
			{
				base.OnActiveDocumentChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}
			if (this.ActiveDocumentChanged != null)
			{
				this.ActiveDocumentChanged(this, new ActiveDocumentChangedEventArgs(oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}

		protected override void SetActiveView(object newActiveView)
		{
			base.SetActiveView(newActiveView);
			ActiveView = newActiveView;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.WindowsUI.Automation

	public class HambugerMenuAutomationPeer : HamburgerMenuAutomationPeerBase<HamburgerMenu>, ISelectionProvider, IExpandCollapseProvider
	{
		public ExpandCollapseState ExpandCollapseState => HamburgerMenuAutomationHelper.GetMenuState(base.Owner.ViewState);

		public bool CanSelectMultiple => false;

		public bool IsSelectionRequired => false;

		public HambugerMenuAutomationPeer(HamburgerMenu element)
			: base(element)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Group;
		}

		protected override void FillChildrenOverride()
		{
			AddAutomationChild(base.Owner.ToggleStateButton);
			AddAutomationChild(new HamburgerMenuPaneAutomationPeer(base.Owner));
			if (!AddAutomationChild(base.Owner.Content))
			{
				AddAutomationChildRecursive(base.Owner.Content);
			}
		}

		public void Expand()
		{
			if (base.Owner.ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Closed)
			{
				base.Owner.ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.Opened;
			}
			if (base.Owner.ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactInline)
			{
				base.Owner.ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.Inline;
			}
			if (base.Owner.ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactOverlay)
			{
				base.Owner.ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.Overlay;
			}
		}

		public void Collapse()
		{
			if (base.Owner.ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Opened)
			{
				base.Owner.ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.Closed;
			}
			if (base.Owner.ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Inline)
			{
				base.Owner.ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactInline;
			}
			if (base.Owner.ViewState == HamburgerMenuViewState.Overlay)
			{
				base.Owner.ViewState = HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactOverlay;
			}
		}

		public IRawElementProviderSimple[] GetSelection()
		{
			if (!(base.Owner.ContainerFromItem(base.Owner.SelectedItem) is UIElement input))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IRawElementProviderSimple rawElementProviderSimple = input.With((UIElement x) => UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(x)).With((AutomationPeer x) => ((AutomationPeer)(object)this).ProviderFromPeer(x));
			if (rawElementProviderSimple == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new IRawElementProviderSimple[1] { rawElementProviderSimple };
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse || patternInterface == PatternInterface.Selection)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}
	}
	public class HamburgerMenuPaneAutomationPeer : HamburgerMenuElementAutomationPeerBase<HamburgerMenu>
	{
		protected override HamburgerMenu Menu => base.Owner;

		protected override bool UseOwnWidthInNonCompactMode => false;

		public HamburgerMenuPaneAutomationPeer(HamburgerMenu owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Pane;
		}

		protected override void FillChildrenOverride()
		{
			if (base.Owner.SplitView.With((SplitView x) => x.Pane) is FrameworkElement frameworkElement && base.Owner.ActualIsMenuVisible)
			{
				FillChidrenFromPanel(LayoutHelper.FindElementByName(frameworkElement, "PART_TopItemsPanel"));
				FillChidrenFromPanel(LayoutHelper.FindElementByName(frameworkElement, "PART_BottomItemsPanel"));
				FillChidrenFromPanel(LayoutHelper.FindElementByName(frameworkElement, "PART_BottomBarItemsPanel"));
			}
		}

		private void FillChidrenFromPanel(DependencyObject panel)
		{
			if (!(panel is HamburgerMenuPanelBase hamburgerMenuPanelBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UIElement visibleItem in hamburgerMenuPanelBase.GetVisibleItems())
			{
				AddAutomationChild(visibleItem);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class HamburgerMenuElementAutomationPeerBase<T> : HamburgerMenuAutomationPeerBase<T> where T : FrameworkElement
	{
		protected abstract HamburgerMenu Menu { get; }

		protected virtual bool UseOwnWidthInNonCompactMode => true;

		public HamburgerMenuElementAutomationPeerBase(T owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override Rect GetBoundingRectangleCore()
		{
			Rect boundingRectangleCore = ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetBoundingRectangleCore();
			if (Menu == null || (!Menu.IsCompact && UseOwnWidthInNonCompactMode))
			{
				return boundingRectangleCore;
			}
			double menuPaneWidth = HamburgerMenuAutomationPeerBase<T>.GetMenuPaneWidth(Menu);
			if (!double.IsNaN(menuPaneWidth))
			{
				boundingRectangleCore.Width = menuPaneWidth;
			}
			return boundingRectangleCore;
		}
	}
	public abstract class HamburgerMenuAutomationPeerBase<T> : WinUIAutomationPeerBase<T> where T : FrameworkElement
	{
		private List<AutomationPeer> Children { get; set; }

		protected HamburgerMenuAutomationPeerBase(T owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetNameImpl()
		{
			string text = base.GetNameImpl();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = (base.Owner as ContentControl).With((ContentControl x) => x.Content) as string;
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected sealed override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			Children = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			if (base.Owner != null)
			{
				FillChildrenOverride();
			}
			List<AutomationPeer> children = Children;
			Children = null;
			return children;
		}

		protected virtual void FillChildrenOverride()
		{
		}

		protected bool AddAutomationChild(object child)
		{
			if (child is AutomationPeer)
			{
				Children.Add(child as AutomationPeer);
				return true;
			}
			return AddAutomationChildCore(Children, child as UIElement);
		}

		protected void AddAutomationChildRecursive(object child)
		{
			AddChildrenRecursiveCore(Children, child as UIElement);
		}

		private static void AddChildrenRecursiveCore(List<AutomationPeer> children, UIElement parent)
		{
			if (children == null || parent == null || AddAutomationChildCore(children, parent))
			{
				return;
			}
			int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(parent);
			if (childrenCount != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < childrenCount; i++)
				{
					DependencyObject child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(parent, i);
					AddChildrenRecursiveCore(children, child as UIElement);
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool AddAutomationChildCore(List<AutomationPeer> children, UIElement child)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (children != null && child != null)
			{
				if (child.Visibility != Visibility.Visible || child.Opacity == 0.0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				else
				{
					AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(child);
					if (automationPeer != null)
					{
						result = true;
						children.Add(automationPeer);
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected static double GetMenuPaneWidth(HamburgerMenu menu)
		{
			if (menu == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (menu.IsCompact)
			{
				return menu.CompactWidth;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(menu.OpenPaneWidth))
			{
				return menu.OpenPaneWidth;
			}
			if (menu != null && menu.SplitView != null && menu.SplitView.Pane is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				return frameworkElement.ActualWidth;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}
	}
	internal static class HamburgerMenuAutomationHelper
	{
		internal static ExpandCollapseState GetMenuState(HamburgerMenuViewState state)
		{
			switch (state)
			{
			case HamburgerMenuViewState.Closed:
				return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
			case HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactInline:
			case HamburgerMenuViewState.CompactOverlay:
				return ExpandCollapseState.PartiallyExpanded;
			default:
				return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
			}
		}
	}
	public class HamburgerSubMenuAutomationPeer : HamburgerMenuElementAutomationPeerBase<HamburgerSubMenu>, IExpandCollapseProvider, ISelectionProvider
	{
		public bool CanSelectMultiple => false;

		public bool IsSelectionRequired => false;

		public ExpandCollapseState ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				if (!((IHamburgerMenuFlyoutItem)base.Owner).IsOpen)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.PartiallyExpanded;
				}
				return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
			}
		}

		protected override HamburgerMenu Menu => base.Owner.With((ISupportOwner<HamburgerMenu> x) => x.Owner);

		public HamburgerSubMenuAutomationPeer(HamburgerSubMenu owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Group;
		}

		protected override void FillChildrenOverride()
		{
			AddAutomationChild(base.Owner.Button);
			if (!Menu.IsCompact)
			{
				foreach (HamburgerSubMenuPreviewNavigationButton previewItem in base.Owner.PreviewItems)
				{
					AddAutomationChild(previewItem);
				}
			}
			if (ExpandCollapseState == ExpandCollapseState.Expanded)
			{
				AddAutomationChild(base.Owner.FlyoutPane);
			}
		}

		protected override Rect GetBoundingRectangleCore()
		{
			Rect boundingRectangleCore = base.GetBoundingRectangleCore();
			HamburgerMenu menu = Menu;
			if (menu != null && menu.IsCompact && base.Owner.Button != null)
			{
				boundingRectangleCore.Height = base.Owner.Button.ActualHeight;
			}
			return boundingRectangleCore;
		}

		public void Expand()
		{
			((IHamburgerMenuFlyoutItem)base.Owner).ShowFlyout();
		}

		public void Collapse()
		{
			((IHamburgerMenuFlyoutItem)base.Owner).HideFlyout();
		}

		public IRawElementProviderSimple[] GetSelection()
		{
			if (!base.Owner.IsStandaloneSelectionItemMode)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(((ISupportStandaloneSelection)base.Owner).ContainerFromItem(base.Owner.SelectedItem) is UIElement input))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IRawElementProviderSimple rawElementProviderSimple = input.With((UIElement x) => UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(x)).With((AutomationPeer x) => ((AutomationPeer)(object)this).ProviderFromPeer(x));
			if (rawElementProviderSimple == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new IRawElementProviderSimple[1] { rawElementProviderSimple };
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse || patternInterface == PatternInterface.Selection)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}
	}
	public class HamburgerSubMenuPaneAutomationPeer : HamburgerMenuAutomationPeerBase<HamburgerSubMenuPane>
	{
		public HamburgerSubMenuPaneAutomationPeer(HamburgerSubMenuPane owner)
			: base(owner)

		}

		{
			return AutomationControlType.Pane;

			if (base.Owner.IsBackButtonVisible)
			{
				AddAutomationChild(base.Owner.BackButton);

			foreach (object item in enumerable)
			{
				UIElement child = (item as IVisualItem).With((IVisualItem x) => x.Visual) ?? (item as UIElement);
				AddAutomationChild(child);
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class HamburgerMenuButtonAutomationPeerBase<T> : HamburgerMenuItemAutomationPeerBase<T>, IInvokeProvider where T : ButtonBase
	{
		public HamburgerMenuButtonAutomationPeerBase(T owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Invoke)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Button;
		}

		void IInvokeProvider.Invoke()
		{
			if (!base.Owner.IsEnabled)
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			MethodInfo method = base.Owner.GetType().GetMethod("OnClick", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			method.Invoke(base.Owner, null);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.WindowsUI.Internal
{
	public class AnimatedPanel : Panel, IWeakEventListener
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AlignmentProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsAnimationEnabledProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ItemSpacingProperty;

		private readonly List<Generation> controlInfo = new List<Generation>();

		private int frameNo;

		private AppBar owner;

		private double targetLength;

		private double actualLength;

		public AppBarAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				return (AppBarAlignment)GetValue(AlignmentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AlignmentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Size CompactSize { get; private set; }

		public bool IsAnimationEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsAnimationEnabledProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsAnimationEnabledProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double ItemSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ItemSpacingProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ItemSpacingProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Size NormalSize { get; private set; }

		internal Panel EffectsLayer { get; set; }

		private double EffectiveItemSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Owner.IsCompact)
				{
					return ItemSpacing;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		private bool IsHorizontal
		{
			get
			{
				if (Alignment != AppBarAlignment.Bottom)
				{
					return Alignment == AppBarAlignment.Top;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private AppBar Owner => owner ?? (owner = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<AppBar>((DependencyObject)this));

		static AnimatedPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AnimatedPanel>.New().Register<double>("ItemSpacing", ref ItemSpacingProperty, 0.0, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure).Register<AppBarAlignment>("Alignment", ref AlignmentProperty, AppBarAlignment.Bottom, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure)
				.Register<bool>("IsAnimationEnabled", ref IsAnimationEnabledProperty, true, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		internal void AttachToVisualTree(ItemsControl owner)
		{
			CollectionChangedEventManager.AddListener(owner.Items, this);
			((IWeakEventListener)this).ReceiveWeakEvent((Type)null, (object)this, (EventArgs)null);
		}

		internal void CompositionTarget_Rendering(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			List<Tuple<UIElement, Generation>> list = null;
			foreach (Generation item in this.controlInfo)
			{
				foreach (UIElement key in item.Keys)
				{
					ControlInfo controlInfo = item[key];
					TranslateTransform translateTransform = (TranslateTransform)key.RenderTransform;
					if (controlInfo.TargetX != translateTransform.X)
					{
						translateTransform.X = Math.Round(StepTo(translateTransform.X, controlInfo.TargetX));
					}
					if (controlInfo.TargetY != translateTransform.Y)
					{
						translateTransform.Y = Math.Round(StepTo(translateTransform.Y, controlInfo.TargetY));
					}
					if (controlInfo.FadingIn && !controlInfo.IsNew)
					{
						if (IsAnimationEnabled)
						{
							key.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty, key.Opacity + 0.05);
						}
						else
						{
							key.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty, controlInfo.Opacity.Value);
						}
						if (controlInfo.Opacity.HasValue && key.Opacity >= controlInfo.Opacity.Value)
						{
							key.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty, controlInfo.Opacity.Value);
							controlInfo.FadingIn = false;
						}
					}
					if (controlInfo.FadingOut)
					{
						if (IsAnimationEnabled)
						{
							key.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty, key.Opacity - 0.05);
						}
						else
						{
							key.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty, 0.0);
						}
						if (key.Opacity <= 0.0)
						{
							key.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty, 0.0);
							controlInfo.FadingOut = false;
							(list ?? (list = new List<Tuple<UIElement, Generation>>())).Add(new Tuple<UIElement, Generation>(key, item));
						}
					}
					if (controlInfo.Stabilized && controlInfo.Opacity.HasValue)
					{
						key.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty, controlInfo.Opacity.Value);
					}
					controlInfo.Frames++;
				}
			}
			if (list != null)
			{
				foreach (Tuple<UIElement, Generation> item2 in list)
				{
					EffectsLayer.Children.Remove(item2.Item1);
					item2.Item1.Opacity = 1.0;
					item2.Item2.Remove(item2.Item1);
					if (item2.Item2.Count == 0 && this.controlInfo.Count > 1)
					{
						this.controlInfo.Remove(item2.Item2);
					}
				}
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			double num = (IsHorizontal ? base.ActualHeight : base.ActualWidth);
			if (num != targetLength)
			{
				actualLength = StepTo(num, targetLength);
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			frameNo++;
		}

		internal void DetachFromVisualTree(ItemsControl owner)
		{
			CollectionChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(owner.Items, this);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
			if (finalSize.Height == 0.0 || finalSize.Width == 0.0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = (IsHorizontal ? new System.Windows.Size(child.DesiredSize.Width, finalSize.Height) : new System.Windows.Size(finalSize.Width, child.DesiredSize.Height));
				child.Arrange(new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), size));
			}
			foreach (Generation item in controlInfo)
			{
				ArrangeInternal(item, finalSize);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (controlInfo.Count == 0 && base.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				ProcessCollectionReset();
			}
			targetLength = 0.0;
			foreach (Generation item in controlInfo)
			{
				MeasureInternal(item, availableSize);
				targetLength = (IsHorizontal ? Math.Max(targetLength, NormalSize.Height) : Math.Max(NormalSize.Width, targetLength));
			}
			if (EffectsLayer != null)
			{
				if (IsHorizontal)
				{
					EffectsLayer.Height = actualLength;
				}
				else
				{
					EffectsLayer.Width = actualLength;
				}
			}
			if (frameNo < 2)
			{
				actualLength = targetLength;
			}
			if (!IsHorizontal)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Size(actualLength, NormalSize.Height);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(NormalSize.Width, actualLength);
		}

		private void ArrangeInternal(Generation generaton, System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			List<UIElement> list = new List<UIElement>();
			List<UIElement> list2 = new List<UIElement>();
			List<UIElement> list3 = new List<UIElement>();
			Dictionary<UIElement, System.Windows.Point> dictionary = DoTestArrange(generaton, finalSize);
			foreach (UIElement key in dictionary.Keys)
			{
				if (!generaton.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					break;
				}
				ControlInfo controlInfo = generaton[key];
				TranslateTransform translateTransform = (TranslateTransform)key.RenderTransform;
				if (!controlInfo.IsNew && IsAnimationEnabled)
				{
					continue;
				}
				translateTransform.X = controlInfo.TargetX;
				translateTransform.Y = controlInfo.TargetY;
				if (!controlInfo.Opacity.HasValue)
				{
					controlInfo.Opacity = key.Opacity;
					if (controlInfo.AllowOpacityChange)
					{
						key.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty, 0.0);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<UIElement, System.Windows.Point> DoTestArrange(Generation generation, System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			List<UIElement> list = new List<UIElement>();
			List<UIElement> list2 = new List<UIElement>();
			List<UIElement> list3 = new List<UIElement>();
			Dictionary<UIElement, System.Windows.Point> result = new Dictionary<UIElement, System.Windows.Point>();
			foreach (FrameworkElement key in generation.Keys)
			{
				switch (GetActualChildAlignment(key, IsHorizontal))
				{
				case AppBarElementAlignment.Center:
					list2.Add(key);
					break;
				case AppBarElementAlignment.Far:
					list3.Add(key);
					break;
				default:
					list.Add(key);
					break;
				}
			}
			Func<List<UIElement>, double> func = delegate(List<UIElement> group)
			{
				double num8 = 0.0;
				foreach (UIElement item in group)
				{
					num8 += (IsHorizontal ? item.DesiredSize.Width : item.DesiredSize.Height);
				}
				return num8 + EffectiveItemSpacing * (double)(group.Count - 1);
			};
			double num = func(list) + EffectiveItemSpacing;
			double num2 = func(list2);
			double num3 = func(list3) + EffectiveItemSpacing;
			double num4 = (IsHorizontal ? finalSize.Width : finalSize.Height);
			double finalLengthOrt = (IsHorizontal ? finalSize.Height : finalSize.Width);
			double num5 = num4 - num3;
			double val = num5 - num2;
			double num6 = 0.0;
			double num7 = Math.Min((num4 - num2) * 0.5, val);
			if (num7 < num + num6)
			{
				num7 = num + num6;
			}
			Func<List<UIElement>, double, double> func2 = delegate(List<UIElement> group, double start)
			{
				double num8 = 0.0;
				foreach (FrameworkElement item2 in group)
				{
					double num9 = Shift(finalLengthOrt, item2);
					if (generation.Keys.Contains(item2))
					{
						ControlInfo controlInfo = generation[item2];
						if (IsHorizontal)
						{
							controlInfo.TargetX = Math.Round(start + num8);
							controlInfo.TargetY = Math.Round(num9);
						}
						else
						{
							controlInfo.TargetY = Math.Round(start + num8);
							controlInfo.TargetX = Math.Round(num9);
						}
					}
					result.Add(item2, IsHorizontal ? new System.Windows.Point(start + num8, num9) : new System.Windows.Point(num9, start + num8));
					num8 += (IsHorizontal ? item2.DesiredSize.Width : item2.DesiredSize.Height) + EffectiveItemSpacing;
				}
				return 0.0;
			};
			func2(list, num6);
			func2(list2, num7);
			func2(list3, num5);
			return result;
		}

		private AppBarElementAlignment GetActualChildAlignment(FrameworkElement child, bool isHorz)
		{
			IAppBarElement input = child as IAppBarElement;
			AppBarElementAlignment appBarElementAlignment = input.Return((IAppBarElement x) => x.Alignment, () => AppBarElementAlignment.Alignment);
			HorizontalAlignment alignment = input.Return((IAppBarElement x) => x.HorizontalAlignment, () => child.HorizontalAlignment);
			VerticalAlignment alignment2 = input.Return((IAppBarElement x) => x.VerticalAlignment, () => child.VerticalAlignment);
			if (appBarElementAlignment == AppBarElementAlignment.Alignment)
			{
				if (!IsHorizontal)
				{
					return alignment2.ToAppBarElementAlignment();
				}
				return alignment.ToAppBarElementAlignment();
			}
			return appBarElementAlignment;
		}

		private void MeasureInternal(Dictionary<UIElement, ControlInfo> controlInfo, System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			if (IsHorizontal)
			{
				foreach (UIElement key in controlInfo.Keys)
				{
					key.Measure(availableSize);
					AppBarButton appBarButton = key as AppBarButton;
					AppBarSeparator appBarSeparator = key as AppBarSeparator;
					if (appBarButton != null)
					{
						appBarButton.IsCompact = Owner.IsCompact;
						num3 = Math.Max(num3, appBarButton.NormalSize.Height);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, appBarButton.CompactSize.Height);
						num += appBarButton.NormalSize.Width;
						num2 += appBarButton.CompactSize.Width;
						continue;
					}
					if (key is IAppBarElement appBarElement)
					{
						appBarElement.IsCompact = Owner.IsCompact;
					}
					num += key.DesiredSize.Width;
					num2 += key.DesiredSize.Width;
					if (appBarSeparator == null)
					{
						num3 = Math.Max(num3, key.DesiredSize.Height);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, key.DesiredSize.Height);
					}
				}
				num3 = Math.Max(num3, Owner.PartBackButton.ActualHeight);
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, Owner.PartBackButton.ActualHeight);
				num3 = Math.Max(num3, Owner.PartExitButton.ActualHeight);
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, Owner.PartExitButton.ActualHeight);
				NormalSize = new System.Windows.Size(num + ItemSpacing * (double)Math.Max(controlInfo.Count - 1, 0), num3);
				CompactSize = new System.Windows.Size(num2, num4);
				return;
			}
			foreach (UIElement key2 in controlInfo.Keys)
			{
				key2.Measure(availableSize);
				AppBarButton appBarButton2 = key2 as AppBarButton;
				AppBarSeparator appBarSeparator2 = key2 as AppBarSeparator;
				if (key2 is IAppBarElement appBarElement2)
				{
					appBarElement2.IsCompact = Owner.IsCompact;
					appBarElement2.IsHorizontal = Owner.IsHorizontal;
				}
				if (appBarButton2 != null)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, appBarButton2.NormalSize.Width);
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, appBarButton2.CompactSize.Width);
					num3 += appBarButton2.NormalSize.Height;
					num4 += appBarButton2.CompactSize.Height;
					continue;
				}
				num3 += key2.DesiredSize.Height;
				num4 += key2.DesiredSize.Height;
				if (appBarSeparator2 == null)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, key2.DesiredSize.Width);
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, key2.DesiredSize.Width);
				}
			}
			num = Math.Max(num, Owner.PartBackButton.ActualWidth);
			num2 = Math.Max(num2, Owner.PartBackButton.ActualWidth);
			num = Math.Max(num, Owner.PartExitButton.ActualWidth);
			num2 = Math.Max(num2, Owner.PartExitButton.ActualWidth);
			NormalSize = new System.Windows.Size(num, num3 + ItemSpacing * (double)Math.Max(controlInfo.Count - 1, 0));
			CompactSize = new System.Windows.Size(num2, num4);
		}

		private bool OnItemCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e != null)
			{
				switch (e.Action)
				{
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
					ProcessCollectionReset();
					break;
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				{
					Generation generation = this.controlInfo.Last();
					int newStartingIndex = e.NewStartingIndex;
					foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
					{
						if (base.Children[newStartingIndex++] is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
						{
							generation.Add(frameworkElement, new ControlInfo
							{
								FadingIn = true,
								Opacity = frameworkElement.Opacity
							});
							frameworkElement.SetCurrentValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty, 0.0);
							frameworkElement.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform();
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				{
					Generation generation = this.controlInfo.Last();
					foreach (UIElement key in generation.Keys)
					{
						if (!base.Children.Contains(key))
						{
							ControlInfo controlInfo = generation[key];
							controlInfo.FadingOut = true;
							if (!EffectsLayer.Children.Contains(key))
							{
								EffectsLayer.Children.Add(key);
							}
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				InvalidateMeasure();
				return true;
			}
			ProcessCollectionReset();
			return true;
		}

		private void ProcessCollectionReset()
		{
			Generation generation = ((!controlInfo.Any() || controlInfo.Last().Count != 0) ? new Generation() : controlInfo.Last());
			if (base.Children.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					generation.Add(child, new ControlInfo
					{
						AllowOpacityChange = base.IsLoaded
					});
					child.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform();
					foreach (Generation item in controlInfo)
					{
						if (item.ContainsKey(child) && EffectsLayer.Children.Contains(child))
						{
							EffectsLayer.Children.Remove(child);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (!controlInfo.Contains(generation))
			{
				controlInfo.Add(generation);
			}
			if (controlInfo.Count > 1)
			{
				Generation generation2 = controlInfo[controlInfo.Count - 2];
				foreach (KeyValuePair<UIElement, ControlInfo> item2 in generation2)
				{
					if (!base.Children.Contains(item2.Key))
					{
						item2.Value.FadingOut = true;
						if (!EffectsLayer.Children.Contains(item2.Key))
						{
							EffectsLayer.Children.Add(item2.Key);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender == null)
			{
				CollectionChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(Owner.Items, this);
				return true;
			}
			return OnItemCollectionChanged(sender, e as NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs);
		}

		private double Shift(double length, FrameworkElement element)
		{
			if (IsHorizontal)
			{
				switch (element.VerticalAlignment)
				{
				case VerticalAlignment.Center:
					return (length - element.DesiredSize.Height) * 0.5;
				case VerticalAlignment.Bottom:
					return length - element.DesiredSize.Height;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (element.HorizontalAlignment)
				{
				case HorizontalAlignment.Center:
					return (length - element.DesiredSize.Width) * 0.5;
				case HorizontalAlignment.Right:
					return length - element.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private double StepTo(double actual, double target)
		{
			if (!IsAnimationEnabled)
			{
				return target;
			}
			double num = Math.Abs(actual - target);
			if (num <= 1.0)
			{
				actual = target;
			}
			else
			{
				double num2 = num * 0.15 + 1.0;
				actual = ((!(actual > target)) ? (actual + num2) : (actual - num2));
			}
			return actual;
		}
	}

	public class AppBarPanel : Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AlignmentProperty;

		public AppBarAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				return (AppBarAlignment)GetValue(AlignmentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AlignmentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private bool IsHorizontal
		{
			get
			{
				if (Alignment != AppBarAlignment.Bottom)
				{
					return Alignment == AppBarAlignment.Top;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		static AppBarPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AppBarPanel>.New().Register<AppBarAlignment>("Alignment", ref AlignmentProperty, AppBarAlignment.Bottom, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size desiredSize = base.Children[0].DesiredSize;
			System.Windows.Size desiredSize2 = base.Children[1].DesiredSize;
			System.Windows.Size desiredSize3 = base.Children[2].DesiredSize;
			if (IsHorizontal)
			{
				base.Children[0].Arrange(new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), desiredSize));
				base.Children[1].Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(base.Children[0].DesiredSize.Width, 0.0), new System.Windows.Size(finalSize.Width - desiredSize.Width - desiredSize3.Width, desiredSize2.Height)));
				base.Children[2].Arrange(new Rect(finalSize.Width - desiredSize3.Width, 0.0, desiredSize3.Width, desiredSize3.Height));
			}
			else
			{
				base.Children[0].Arrange(new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), desiredSize));
				base.Children[1].Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, base.Children[0].DesiredSize.Height), new System.Windows.Size(desiredSize2.Width, finalSize.Height - desiredSize.Height - desiredSize3.Height)));
				base.Children[2].Arrange(new Rect(0.0, finalSize.Height - desiredSize3.Height, desiredSize3.Width, desiredSize3.Height));
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (FrameworkElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(availableSize);
				if (IsHorizontal)
				{
					num += child.DesiredSize.Width;
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, child.DesiredSize.Height);
				}
				else
				{
					num2 += child.DesiredSize.Height;
					num = Math.Max(num, child.DesiredSize.Width);
				}
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, num2);
		}
	}

				return Owner;

					HamburgerMenuExtensions.SetOwner(this, value);

	internal class TemplatedCollectionItemPresenter : ContentPresenter
	{
		private object defferedContent;

		public UIElement RootElement
		{
			get
			{
				int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(this);
				if (childrenCount > 0)
				{
					return VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(this, 0) as UIElement;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public TemplatedCollectionItemPresenter(DataTemplate template, object content)
		{
			if (template != null)
			{
				defferedContent = content;
				base.ContentTemplate = template;
				base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			}
			else
			{
				base.Content = content;
			}
			if (!(content is UIElement))
			{
				base.DataContext = content;
			}
		}

		protected override void ParentLayoutInvalidated(UIElement child)
		{
			base.ParentLayoutInvalidated(child);
			(base.Parent as HamburgerMenuItemsPanelBase).Do(delegate(HamburgerMenuItemsPanelBase x)
			{
				x.InvalidateMeasure();
			});
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (defferedContent != null)
			{
				base.Content = defferedContent;
				defferedContent = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class HamburgerMenuNavigationButton<TOwner> : HamburgerMenuSelectableNavigationButtonBase<TOwner>, IHamburgerMenuNavigationItem, ISelectableHamburgerMenuItem, ISelectable, ISupportNavigationTarget where TOwner : class
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty UseNavigationTargetParameterForSyncProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SyncWithActivePageProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty HideMenuWhenSelectedProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RightContentProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RightContentTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RightContentMarginProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsRightContentVisiblePropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsRightContentVisibleProperty;
