	public abstract class ObservableCollectionView<T> : BindableBase, IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable, IList, ICollection, ISupportItemsSource, ISupportRevision, INotifyCollectionChanged, IWeakEventListener where T : class
	{
		private const string Error_CannotUseItemsSource = "Cannot use ItemsSource. Collection has items.";

		private const string Error_ItemsSourceIsUsed = "Collection cannot be modified because ItemsSource is used.";

		private IList<T> innerItems;

		private IEnumerable<T> itemsSource;

		private bool isUsingItemsSource;

		private long revision;

		long ISupportRevision.Revision => revision;

		private IEnumerable<T> ActualItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isUsingItemsSource)
				{
					return innerItems;
				}
				return itemsSource;
			}
		}

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return ActualItems.ElementAt(index);
			}
			set
			{
				SetItem(index, value);
			}
		}

		public int Count => ActualItems.Count();

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => false;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => true;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => null;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[index];
			}
			set
			{
				this[index] = (T)value;
			}
		}

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		public ObservableCollectionView()
		{
			innerItems = new List<T>();
		}

		public ObservableCollectionView(IEnumerable<T> itemsSource)
			: this()
		{
			((ISupportItemsSource)this).SetItemsSource((object)itemsSource);
		}

		public virtual void Refresh()
		{
			IncrementRevision();
			NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args = new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset);
			RaiseCollectionChanged(args, raiseCountChanged: true);
		}

		protected void IncrementRevision()
		{
			if (++revision == long.MaxValue)
			{
				revision = 0L;
			}
		}

		void ISupportItemsSource.SetItemsSource(object source)
		{
			if (!isUsingItemsSource && innerItems.Count() > 0 && source != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot use ItemsSource. Collection has items.");
			}
			IncrementRevision();
			SetItemsSourceCore(source);
		}

		protected virtual void SetItemsSourceCore(object source)
		{
			(itemsSource as INotifyCollectionChanged).Do(delegate(INotifyCollectionChanged x)
			{
				CollectionChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(x, this);
			});
			OnItemsChangedOverride(null, clearCollection: true);
			itemsSource = ConvertSource(source);
			(itemsSource as INotifyCollectionChanged).Do(delegate(INotifyCollectionChanged x)
			{
				CollectionChangedEventManager.AddListener(x, this);
			});
			isUsingItemsSource = itemsSource != null;
			RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset), raiseCountChanged: true);
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<T> ConvertSource(object source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<T> enumerable = (source as IEnumerable<T>) ?? (source as IEnumerable).With((IEnumerable x) => x.OfType<T>());
			object obj = enumerable;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				if (!(source is T))
				{
					return null;
				}
				obj = new List<T> { (T)source };
			}
			return (IEnumerable<T>)obj;
		}

		public int IndexOf(T item)
		{
			if (ActualItems is IList<T> list)
			{
				return list.IndexOf(item);
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (T actualItem in ActualItems)
			{
				if (item == actualItem)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void Add(T item)
		{
			InsertItem(Count, item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			InsertItem(index, item);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveItem(index);
		}

		public bool Remove(T item)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RemoveItem(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void Move(int oldIndex, int newIndex)
		{
			MoveItem(oldIndex, newIndex);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			ClearItems();
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			return ActualItems.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			if (array == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("array");
			}
			if (ActualItems is ICollection<T> collection)
			{
				collection.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
				return;
			}
			foreach (T actualItem in ActualItems)
			{
				array[arrayIndex++] = actualItem;
			}
		}

		IEnumerator<T> IEnumerable<T>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ActualItems.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ActualItems.GetEnumerator();
		}

		protected virtual void MoveItem(int oldIndex, int newIndex)
		{
			CheckIsUsingInnerItems();
			T val = this[oldIndex];
			innerItems.RemoveAt(oldIndex);
			innerItems.Insert(newIndex, val);
			IncrementRevision();
			RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move, val, newIndex, oldIndex), raiseCountChanged: false);
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			CheckIsUsingInnerItems();
			T changedItem = innerItems[index];
			innerItems.RemoveAt(index);
			IncrementRevision();
			RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, changedItem, index), raiseCountChanged: true);
		}

		protected virtual void InsertItem(int index, T item)
		{
			CheckIsUsingInnerItems();
			innerItems.Insert(index, item);
			IncrementRevision();
			RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, item, index), raiseCountChanged: true);
		}

		protected virtual void SetItem(int index, T item)
		{
			CheckIsUsingInnerItems();
			T oldItem = innerItems[index];
			innerItems[index] = item;
			IncrementRevision();
			RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace, item, oldItem, index), raiseCountChanged: false);
		}

		protected virtual void ClearItems()
		{
			CheckIsUsingInnerItems();
			OnItemsChangedOverride(null, clearCollection: true);
			innerItems.Clear();
			IncrementRevision();
			RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset), raiseCountChanged: true);
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemsChangedOverride(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e, bool clearCollection)
		{
		}

		private void CheckIsUsingInnerItems()
		{
			if (isUsingItemsSource)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Collection cannot be modified because ItemsSource is used.");
			}
		}

		private void RaiseCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args, bool raiseCountChanged)
		{
			OnItemsChangedOverride(args, clearCollection: false);
			RaisePropertyChanged("Item[]");
			if (raiseCountChanged)
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged("Count");
			}
			this.CollectionChanged.Do(delegate(NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler x)
			{
				x(this, args);
			});
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			int count = Count;
			Add((T)value);
			return count;
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains((T)value);
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			return IndexOf((T)value);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			Insert(index, (T)value);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			Remove((T)value);
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType != typeof(CollectionChangedEventManager))
			{
				return false;
			}
			NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs eventArgs = (NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs)e;
			ReceiveWeakEventCore(sender, eventArgs);
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void ReceiveWeakEventCore(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (eventArgs != null && sender == itemsSource)
			{
				IncrementRevision();
				RaiseCollectionChanged(eventArgs, eventArgs.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace && eventArgs.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move);
			}
		}
	}
	public class SplitCollection<TItem> : VirtualCollectionBase<TItem> where TItem : class
	{
		private readonly List<object> source;

		private readonly int collectionIndex;

		private readonly ICollectionSplitter splitter;

		private bool skipRegenerateCollection;

		public override int Count => source.Count;

		public int CollectionIndex => collectionIndex;

		public ICollectionSplitter Splitter => splitter;

		public SplitCollection(ICollectionSplitter splitter, int collectionIndex)
		{
			source = new List<object>();
			this.splitter = splitter;
			this.collectionIndex = collectionIndex;
		}

		protected override IEnumerator<TItem> GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (TItem item in source)
			{
				yield return item;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void FillSource()
		{
			foreach (object item in Splitter)
			{
				if (CollectionIndex == SplitCollectionItemExtensions.GetItemCollectionIndex(item))
				{
					source.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearSource()
		{
			source.Clear();
		}

		public override int IndexOf(object item)
		{
			return source.IndexOf(item);
		}

		protected override TItem GetItemByIndex(int index)
		{
			return (TItem)source[index];
		}

		public override bool Contains(object value)
		{
			return source.Contains(value);
		}

		private int GetSplitItemIndex(int splitterIndex)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < splitterIndex; i++)
			{
				if (SplitCollectionItemExtensions.GetItemCollectionIndex(Splitter[i]) == CollectionIndex)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected internal void Refresh()
		{
			skipRegenerateCollection = true;
			RaiseReset();
			skipRegenerateCollection = false;
		}

		protected internal override void RaiseReset()
		{
			if (!skipRegenerateCollection)
			{
				ClearSource();
				FillSource();
			}
			base.RaiseReset();
		}

		protected internal override void RaiseMove(int newStartingIndex, int oldStartingIndex, object newItem)
		{
			int num = source.IndexOf(newItem);
			int splitItemIndex = GetSplitItemIndex(newStartingIndex);
			if (splitItemIndex != num)
			{
				source.RemoveAt(num);
				source.Insert(splitItemIndex, newItem);
				base.RaiseMove(splitItemIndex, num, newItem);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void RaiseAdd(int newStartingIndex, object newItem)
		{
			int num = ((newStartingIndex != Splitter.Count - 1) ? GetSplitItemIndex(newStartingIndex) : Count);
			source.Insert(num, newItem);
			base.RaiseAdd(num, newItem);
		}

		protected internal override void RaiseRemove(int oldStartingIndex, object oldItem)
		{
			int oldStartingIndex2 = source.IndexOf(oldItem);
			source.Remove(oldItem);
			base.RaiseRemove(oldStartingIndex2, oldItem);
		}

		protected internal override void RaiseReplace(int newStartingIndex, object oldItem, object newItem)
		{
			int num = source.IndexOf(oldItem);
			source[num] = newItem;
			base.RaiseReplace(num, oldItem, newItem);
		}
	}
	public abstract class TemplatedCollectionBase<TItem> : ObservableCollectionView<TItem>, ISupportItemTemplate where TItem : class
	{
		private class GeneratedContainerInfo
		{
			private WeakReference itemRef;

			private WeakReference containerRef;

			public object Item
			{
				get
				{
					return itemRef.Target;
				}
				set
				{
					itemRef = new WeakReference(value);
				}
			}

			public TItem Container
			{
				get
				{
					return (TItem)containerRef.Target;
				}
				set
				{
					containerRef = new WeakReference(value);
				}
			}

			public int RefCount { get; set; }

			public GeneratedContainerInfo(object item, TItem container)
			{
				Item = item;
				Container = container;
				RefCount = 1;
			}
		}

		private const string Error_ItemCannotBeNull = "Item cannot be null.";

		private const string Error_InvalidItemType = "Invalid item type. Expected: {0}. Actual: {1}";

		private ObservableCollectionCore<TItem> generatedItems;

		private IEnumerable mediateSource;

		private Style itemStyle;

		private StyleSelector itemStyleSelector;

		private DataTemplate itemTemplate;

		private DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector;

		private IDictionary<object, GeneratedContainerInfo> containerFromItemDict;

		private IDictionary<TItem, GeneratedContainerInfo> itemFromContainerDict;

		protected DataTemplate ItemTemplate => itemTemplate;

		protected DataTemplateSelector ItemTemplateSelector => itemTemplateSelector;

		internal Style ItemStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return itemStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				SetPropertyHelper.Set(ref itemStyle, value, OnItemStyleChanged);
			}
		}

		internal StyleSelector ItemStyleSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return itemStyleSelector;
			}
			set
			{
				SetPropertyHelper.Set(ref itemStyleSelector, value, OnItemStyleSelectorChanged);
			}
		}

		DataTemplate ISupportItemTemplate.ItemTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return itemTemplate;
			}
			set
			{
				SetPropertyHelper.Set(ref itemTemplate, value, OnItemTemplateChanged);
			}
		}

		DataTemplateSelector ISupportItemTemplate.ItemTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return itemTemplateSelector;
			}
			set
			{
				SetPropertyHelper.Set(ref itemTemplateSelector, value, OnItemTemplateSelectorChanged);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanGenerateItems => mediateSource != null;

		public TemplatedCollectionBase()
		{
			generatedItems = new ObservableCollectionCore<TItem>();
			containerFromItemDict = new Dictionary<object, GeneratedContainerInfo>();
			itemFromContainerDict = new Dictionary<TItem, GeneratedContainerInfo>();
		}

		public override void Refresh()
		{
			if (!CanGenerateItems)
			{
				ClearGeneratedItems();
				base.Refresh();
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateItems();
			}
		}

		public TItem ContainerFromItem(object item)
		{
			TItem result = null;
			if (IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(item))
			{
				TItem val = (TItem)item;
				if (Contains(val))
				{
					return val;
				}
			}
			else if (item != null)
			{
				containerFromItemDict.TryGetValue(item, out var value);
				return value.With((GeneratedContainerInfo x) => x.Container);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public object ItemFromContainer(TItem container)
		{
			if (!Contains(container) || container == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object containerItem = SplitCollectionItemExtensions.GetContainerItem(container);
			if (containerItem != null)
			{
				return containerItem;
			}
			if (CanGenerateItems)
			{
				itemFromContainerDict.TryGetValue(container, out var value);
				return value.With((GeneratedContainerInfo x) => x.Item);
			}
			return container;
		}

		protected void ApplyContainerStyle(TItem container)
		{
			if (!(container is FrameworkElement frameworkElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			object item = ItemFromContainer(container);
			Style containerStyleOverride = GetContainerStyleOverride(container, item);
			bool isStyleSet = HamburgerMenuExtensions.GetIsStyleSet(frameworkElement);
			bool flag = frameworkElement.ReadLocalValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			if (containerStyleOverride == null && isStyleSet)
			{
				frameworkElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
				HamburgerMenuExtensions.SetIsStyleSet(frameworkElement, value: false);
			}
			if (containerStyleOverride != null && (flag || isStyleSet))
			{
				if (!containerStyleOverride.TargetType.IsAssignableFrom(frameworkElement.GetType()))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException($"Style target type {containerStyleOverride.TargetType} mismatch with element type {frameworkElement.GetType()}");
				}
				frameworkElement.Style = containerStyleOverride;
				HamburgerMenuExtensions.SetIsStyleSet(frameworkElement, value: true);
			}
		}

		protected override void SetItemsSourceCore(object source)
		{
			(mediateSource as INotifyCollectionChanged).Do(delegate(INotifyCollectionChanged x)
			{
				CollectionChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(x, this);
			});
			ClearGeneratedItems();
			if (source == null || ConvertSource(source) != null)
			{
				mediateSource = null;
				base.SetItemsSourceCore(source);
				return;
			}
			mediateSource = (source as IEnumerable) ?? new List<object> { source };
			(mediateSource as INotifyCollectionChanged).Do(delegate(INotifyCollectionChanged x)
			{
				CollectionChangedEventManager.AddListener(x, this);
			});
			GenerateItems();
			base.SetItemsSourceCore(generatedItems);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<TItem> ConvertSource(object source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = source as IEnumerable<TItem>;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				if (!(source is TItem))
				{
					return null;
				}
				obj = new List<TItem> { (TItem)source };
			}
			return (IEnumerable<TItem>)obj;
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemTemplateChanged(DataTemplate oldValue, DataTemplate value)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemTemplateSelectorChanged(DataTemplateSelector oldValue, DataTemplateSelector value)
		{
		}

		protected abstract object GetContainerForItemOverride(object item);

		protected virtual Style GetContainerStyleOverride(TItem finalContainer, object item)
		{
			return ItemStyleSelector.Return((StyleSelector x) => x.SelectStyle(item, finalContainer as DependencyObject), () => ItemStyle);
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemStyleChanged(Style oldValue, Style value)
		{
			UpdateContainersStyle();
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemStyleSelectorChanged(StyleSelector oldValue, StyleSelector value)
		{
			UpdateContainersStyle();
		}

		private void UpdateContainersStyle()
		{
			foreach (TItem item in (IEnumerable<TItem>)this)
			{
				ApplyContainerStyle(item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(TItem container, object item)
		{
			if (container != item)
			{
				(container as FrameworkElement).Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
				{
					x.DataContext = item;
				});
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ClearContainerForItemOverride(TItem container, object item)
		{
			if (container != item)
			{
				(container as FrameworkElement).Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
				{
					x.DataContext = null;
				});
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is TItem;
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChangedOverride(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e, bool clearCollection)
		{
			if (clearCollection)
			{
				BeforeCollectionReset();
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					OnItemAdded((TItem)newItem);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					OnItemRemoved((TItem)oldItem);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				OnItemReplaced(e.NewStartingIndex, (TItem)e.NewItems[0], (TItem)e.OldItems[0]);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				OnItemMoved(e.NewStartingIndex, e.OldStartingIndex, (TItem)e.NewItems[0]);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				OnCollectionReset();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemReplaced(int newStartingIndex, TItem newItem, TItem oldItem)
		{
			ApplyContainerStyle(newItem);
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemRemoved(TItem item)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemAdded(TItem item)
		{
			ApplyContainerStyle(item);
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemReset(TItem item, bool isAdded)
		{
			if (isAdded)
			{
				ApplyContainerStyle(item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemMoved(int newStartingIndex, int oldStartingIndex, TItem newItem)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void BeforeCollectionReset()
		{
			foreach (TItem item in (IEnumerable<TItem>)this)
			{
				OnItemReset(item, isAdded: false);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnCollectionReset()
		{
			foreach (TItem item in (IEnumerable<TItem>)this)
			{
				OnItemReset(item, isAdded: true);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReceiveWeakEventCore(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			base.ReceiveWeakEventCore(sender, eventArgs);
			if (sender == mediateSource)
			{
				OnMediateSourceChanged(eventArgs);
			}
		}

		private void OnMediateSourceChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!CanGenerateItems)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				int num = e.NewStartingIndex;
				{
					foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
					{
						InsertItem(num, newItem, useSet: false);
						num++;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					if (oldItem != null)
					{
						RemoveItem(oldItem, removeFromSource: true);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			default:
			{
				object item = e.OldItems[0];
				object item2 = e.NewItems[0];
				InsertItem(e.NewStartingIndex, item2, useSet: true);
				RemoveItem(item, removeFromSource: false);
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				((ObservableCollection<TItem>)(object)generatedItems).Move(e.OldStartingIndex, e.NewStartingIndex);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				GenerateItems();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void InsertItem(int index, object item, bool useSet)
		{
			TItem val = CreateContainerForItem(item);
			bool flag = index < base.Count && index > -1;
			if (useSet)
			{
				((Collection<TItem>)(object)generatedItems)[index] = val;
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				((Collection<TItem>)(object)generatedItems).Insert(index, val);
			}
			else
			{
				((Collection<TItem>)(object)generatedItems).Add(val);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveItem(object item, bool removeFromSource)
		{
			TItem val = ContainerFromItem(item);
			UnlinkItemFromContainer(val, item);
			ClearContainerForItemOverride(val, item);
			if (removeFromSource)
			{
				((Collection<TItem>)(object)generatedItems).Remove(val);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateItems()
		{
			if (!CanGenerateItems)
			{
				ClearGeneratedItems();
				return;
			}
			generatedItems.BeginUpdate();
			ClearGeneratedItems();
			foreach (object item in mediateSource)
			{
				if (item != null)
				{
					((Collection<TItem>)(object)generatedItems).Add(CreateContainerForItem(item));
				}
			}
			generatedItems.EndUpdate();
		}

		private void ClearGeneratedItems()
		{
			BeforeCollectionReset();
			foreach (TItem item in (Collection<TItem>)(object)generatedItems)
			{
				ClearContainerForItemOverride(item, ItemFromContainer(item));
				SplitCollectionItemExtensions.SetContainerItem(item, null);
			}
			((Collection<TItem>)(object)generatedItems).Clear();
			containerFromItemDict.Clear();
			itemFromContainerDict.Clear();
		}

		private TItem CreateContainerForItem(object item)
		{
			object obj = null;
			obj = ((!IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(item)) ? GetContainerForItemOverride(item) : item);
			if (obj is TItem val)
			{
				PrepareContainerForItemOverride(val, item);
				LinkItemToContainer(val, item);
				ApplyContainerStyle(val);
				return val;
			}
			if (obj == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Item cannot be null.");
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid item type. Expected: {typeof(TItem).Name}. Actual: {obj.GetType().Name}");
		}

		private void LinkItemToContainer(TItem container, object item)
		{
			SplitCollectionItemExtensions.SetContainerItem(container, item);
			if (!IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(item) && container != item)
			{
				containerFromItemDict.TryGetValue(item, out var value);
				if (value != null)
				{
					GeneratedContainerInfo generatedContainerInfo = value;
					int refCount = generatedContainerInfo.RefCount + 1;
					generatedContainerInfo.RefCount = refCount;
				}
				else
				{
					value = new GeneratedContainerInfo(item, container);
					containerFromItemDict.Add(item, value);
					itemFromContainerDict.Add(container, value);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UnlinkItemFromContainer(TItem container, object item)
		{
			if (IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(item) || container == item)
			{
				SplitCollectionItemExtensions.SetContainerItem(container, null);
				return;
			}
			GeneratedContainerInfo value = null;
			if (container != null)
			{
				itemFromContainerDict.TryGetValue(container, out value);
			}
			if (value == null && item != null)
			{
				containerFromItemDict.TryGetValue(item, out value);
			}
			if (value != null)
			{
				SplitCollectionItemExtensions.SetContainerItem(value.Container, null);
				itemFromContainerDict.Remove(value.Container);
				if (value.RefCount == 1)
				{
					containerFromItemDict.Remove(value.Item);
					return;
				}
				GeneratedContainerInfo generatedContainerInfo = value;
				int refCount = generatedContainerInfo.RefCount - 1;
				generatedContainerInfo.RefCount = refCount;
			}
		}
	}
	public class TemplatedCollection<TItem> : TemplatedCollectionBase<TItem> where TItem : class
	{
		private Func<object, TItem> defaultItemContainerGenerator;

		protected override bool CanGenerateItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.CanGenerateItems)
				{
					if (base.ItemTemplate == null && base.ItemTemplateSelector == null)
					{
						return defaultItemContainerGenerator != null;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public TemplatedCollection(Func<object, TItem> defaultItemContainerGenerator)
		{
			this.defaultItemContainerGenerator = defaultItemContainerGenerator;
		}

		protected override object GetContainerForItemOverride(object item)
		{
			object obj = CreateContainerFromTemplate(item);
			if (obj == null && defaultItemContainerGenerator != null)
			{
				obj = defaultItemContainerGenerator(item);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected object CreateContainerFromTemplate(object item)
		{
			DataTemplate itemTemplateOverride = GetItemTemplateOverride(item);
			object obj = null;
			if (itemTemplateOverride != null)
			{
				TemplatedCollectionItemPresenter templatedCollectionItemPresenter = new TemplatedCollectionItemPresenter(itemTemplateOverride, item);
				templatedCollectionItemPresenter.ApplyTemplate();
				obj = templatedCollectionItemPresenter.RootElement;
				HamburgerMenuExtensions.SetItemContainer(obj, templatedCollectionItemPresenter);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected virtual DataTemplate GetItemTemplateOverride(object item)
		{
			return base.ItemTemplateSelector?.SelectTemplate(item, null) ?? base.ItemTemplate;
		}

		protected override void OnItemTemplateChanged(DataTemplate oldValue, DataTemplate value)
		{
			Refresh();
		}

		protected override void OnItemTemplateSelectorChanged(DataTemplateSelector oldValue, DataTemplateSelector value)
		{
			Refresh();
		}
	}
	public class TemplatedCollectionWithOwner<TItem, TOwner> : TemplatedCollection<TItem> where TItem : class where TOwner : class
	{
		private readonly WeakReference owner;

		private TOwner Owner => (TOwner)owner.Target;

		public TemplatedCollectionWithOwner(TOwner owner, Func<object, TItem> defaultItemContainerGenerator)
			: base(defaultItemContainerGenerator)
		{
			this.owner = new WeakReference(owner);
		}

		protected override DataTemplate GetItemTemplateOverride(object item)
		{
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = base.GetItemTemplateOverride(item);
			if (dataTemplate == null && item != null && Owner is FrameworkElement)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = Owner as FrameworkElement;
				DataTemplateKey key = new DataTemplateKey(item.GetType());
				dataTemplate = FindResourceByKeyFromOwner(frameworkElement, key);
			}
			return dataTemplate;
		}

		private static DataTemplate FindResourceByKeyFromOwner(FrameworkElement owner, object key)
		{
			if (owner == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = owner.TryFindResource(key);
			if (obj == null && !owner.IsLoaded && owner.Parent == null)
			{
				owner = HamburgerMenuExtensions.GetOwner<FrameworkElement>(owner);
				obj = FindResourceByKeyFromOwner(owner, key);
			}
			return obj as DataTemplate;
		}

		protected override void OnItemAdded(TItem item)
		{
			base.OnItemAdded(item);
			AssignOwner(item, Owner);
		}

		protected override void OnItemRemoved(TItem item)
		{
			base.OnItemRemoved(item);
			AssignOwner(item, null);
		}

		protected override void OnItemReplaced(int newStartingIndex, TItem newItem, TItem oldItem)
		{
			base.OnItemReplaced(newStartingIndex, newItem, oldItem);
			AssignOwner(oldItem, null);
			AssignOwner(newItem, Owner);
		}

		protected override void OnItemReset(TItem item, bool isAdded)
		{
			base.OnItemReset(item, isAdded);
			AssignOwner(item, isAdded ? Owner : null);
		}

		private static void AssignOwner(TItem item, TOwner owner)
		{
			(item as ISupportOwner<TOwner>).Do(delegate(ISupportOwner<TOwner> x)
			{
				x.Owner = owner;
			});
		}
	}
	public class TemplatedSplitCollection<TItem, TOwner> : TemplatedCollectionWithOwner<TItem, TOwner>, ICollectionSplitter, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, INotifyCollectionChanged where TItem : class where TOwner : class
	{
		private Func<TItem, int> GetElementCollectionIndexDelegate;

		private readonly int splitCollectionCount;

		private readonly ReadOnlyCollection<SplitCollection<TItem>> splitCollections;

		private bool ignoreCollectionIndexChanged;

		public int SplitCollectionCount => splitCollectionCount;

		public ReadOnlyCollection<SplitCollection<TItem>> SplitCollections => splitCollections;

		public TemplatedSplitCollection(TOwner owner, int splitCollectionCount, Func<object, TItem> defaultContainerGenerator)
			: this(owner, splitCollectionCount, defaultContainerGenerator, (Func<TItem, int>)null)
		{
		}

		public TemplatedSplitCollection(TOwner owner, int splitCollectionCount, Func<object, TItem> defaultContainerGenerator, Func<TItem, int> getElementCollectionIndexDelegate)
			: base(owner, defaultContainerGenerator)
		{
			GetElementCollectionIndexDelegate = getElementCollectionIndexDelegate;
			this.splitCollectionCount = splitCollectionCount;
			List<SplitCollection<TItem>> list = new List<SplitCollection<TItem>>();
			for (int i = 0; i < SplitCollectionCount; i++)
			{
				list.Add(new SplitCollection<TItem>(this, i));
			}
			splitCollections = new ReadOnlyCollection<SplitCollection<TItem>>(list);
		}

		protected override void OnItemAdded(TItem item)
		{
			base.OnItemAdded(item);
			SplitCollections[SplitCollectionItemExtensions.GetItemCollectionIndex(item, this)].RaiseAdd(IndexOf(item), item);
			SplitCollectionItemExtensions.AssignItemSplitter(item, this);
		}

		protected override void OnItemRemoved(TItem item)
		{
			base.OnItemRemoved(item);
			int itemCollectionIndex = SplitCollectionItemExtensions.GetItemCollectionIndex(item);
			SplitCollectionItemExtensions.AssignItemSplitter(item, null);
			SplitCollections[itemCollectionIndex].RaiseRemove(-1, item);
		}

		protected override void OnItemReplaced(int newStartingIndex, TItem newItem, TItem oldItem)
		{
			base.OnItemReplaced(newStartingIndex, newItem, oldItem);
			int itemCollectionIndex = SplitCollectionItemExtensions.GetItemCollectionIndex(newItem, this);
			int itemCollectionIndex2 = SplitCollectionItemExtensions.GetItemCollectionIndex(oldItem);
			SplitCollectionItemExtensions.AssignItemSplitter(oldItem, null);
			SplitCollectionItemExtensions.AssignItemSplitter(newItem, this);
			if (itemCollectionIndex == itemCollectionIndex2)
			{
				SplitCollections[itemCollectionIndex].RaiseReplace(newStartingIndex, oldItem, newItem);
				return;
			}
			SplitCollections[itemCollectionIndex2].RaiseRemove(newStartingIndex, oldItem);
			SplitCollections[itemCollectionIndex].RaiseAdd(newStartingIndex, newItem);
		}

		protected override void OnItemMoved(int newStartingIndex, int oldStartingIndex, TItem newItem)
		{
			base.OnItemMoved(newStartingIndex, oldStartingIndex, newItem);
			SplitCollections[SplitCollectionItemExtensions.GetItemCollectionIndex(newItem)].RaiseMove(newStartingIndex, oldStartingIndex, newItem);
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionReset()
		{
			SplitCollections.ForEach(delegate(SplitCollection<TItem> x)
			{
				x.BeginUpdate();
				x.ClearSource();
			});
			ignoreCollectionIndexChanged = true;
			base.OnCollectionReset();
			ignoreCollectionIndexChanged = false;
			SplitCollections.ForEach(delegate(SplitCollection<TItem> x)
			{
				x.Refresh();
				x.EndUpdate();
			});
		}

		protected override void OnItemReset(TItem item, bool isAdded)
		{
			base.OnItemReset(item, isAdded);
			if (isAdded)
			{
				SplitCollection<TItem> splitCollection = SplitCollections[SplitCollectionItemExtensions.GetItemCollectionIndex(item, this)];
				SplitCollectionItemExtensions.AssignItemSplitter(item, this);
				splitCollection.RaiseAdd(splitCollection.Count, item);
			}
			else
			{
				SplitCollectionItemExtensions.AssignItemSplitter(item, null);
			}
		}

		public void OnCollectionIndexChanged(object item, int newIndex, int oldIndex)
		{
			if (!ignoreCollectionIndexChanged)
			{
				int num = IndexOf((TItem)item);
				SplitCollections[oldIndex].RaiseRemove(num, item);
				SplitCollections[newIndex].RaiseAdd(num, item);
			}
		}

		int ICollectionSplitter.CalculateActualItemCollectionIndex(object item)
		{
			if (item == null || GetElementCollectionIndexDelegate == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			TItem arg = (TItem)item;
			return GetElementCollectionIndexDelegate(arg);
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[Browsable(false)]
	public class NavigationPoint
	{
		public Type TargetType { get; }

		public object Parameter { get; }

		public string TargetTypeName { get; }

		public string FullTargetTypeName { get; }

		public bool IsStubView { get; internal set; }

		internal bool IsClearContentPhase { get; }

		public NavigationPoint(Type targetType, object parameter)
		{
			TargetType = targetType;
			Parameter = parameter;
			TargetTypeName = GetTargetTypeName(targetType, null);
			FullTargetTypeName = GetFullTargetTypeName(targetType, null);
		}

		public NavigationPoint(ISupportNavigationTarget info)
		{
			TargetType = info.NavigationTargetType ?? ViewLocator.Default.ResolveViewType(info.NavigationTargetTypeName);
			TargetTypeName = GetTargetTypeName(TargetType, info.NavigationTargetTypeName);
			FullTargetTypeName = GetFullTargetTypeName(TargetType, info.NavigationTargetTypeName);
			Parameter = info.NavigationTargetParameter;
		}

		public NavigationPoint(JournalEntry entry)
		{
			if (entry == null)
			{
				TargetType = null;
				Parameter = null;
			}
			else
			{
				TargetType = entry.Content.With((object x) => x.GetType()) ?? (entry.Source as Type);
				Parameter = entry.Parameter;
				IsClearContentPhase = !entry.KeepAlive && entry.Content == null && entry.Source != null;
			}
			TargetTypeName = GetTargetTypeName(TargetType, null);
			FullTargetTypeName = GetFullTargetTypeName(TargetType, null);
		}

		public bool IsParameterMatch(object parameter)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameter.With((object x) => x.ToString())) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(Parameter.With((object x) => x.ToString())))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (parameter == null || Parameter == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameter.ToString()) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(Parameter.ToString()))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return object.Equals(Parameter, parameter);
		}

		public bool IsMatch(Type type, object parameter)
		{
			if (type == TargetType)
			{
				return IsParameterMatch(parameter);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return Equals(obj as NavigationPoint);
		}

		public bool Equals(NavigationPoint point)
		{
			if (point != null && TargetType == point.TargetType)
			{
				return IsParameterMatch(point.Parameter);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int hashCode = TargetType.GetHashCode();
			return (hashCode * 397) ^ ((Parameter != null) ? Parameter.GetHashCode() : 0);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(NavigationPoint point1, NavigationPoint point2)
		{
			if ((object)point1 == point2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((object)point1 == null || (object)point2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return point1.Equals(point2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(NavigationPoint point1, NavigationPoint point2)
		{
			return !(point1 == point2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format("Target: {0}. Parameter: {1}", TargetTypeName, (Parameter == null) ? "null" : Parameter);
		}

		private static string GetTargetTypeName(Type type, string fallbackValue)
		{
			if (type != null)
			{
				return type.Name;
			}
			if (fallbackValue != null)
			{
				return fallbackValue;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private static string GetFullTargetTypeName(Type type, string fallbackValue)
		{
			if (type != null)
			{
				return type.FullName;
			}
			if (fallbackValue != null)
			{
				return fallbackValue;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}

	public static class ISupportNavigationExtensions
	{
		public static string GetNavigationTargetName(this ISupportNavigationTarget self)
		{
			if (!(self.NavigationTargetType != null))
			{
				return self.NavigationTargetTypeName;
			}
			return self.NavigationTargetType.With((Type x) => x.Name);
		}

		public static string GetNavigationTargetFullName(this ISupportNavigationTarget self)
		{
			if (!(self.NavigationTargetType != null))
			{
				return self.NavigationTargetTypeName;
			}
			return self.NavigationTargetType.With((Type x) => x.FullName);
		}

		public static bool IsEmpty(this ISupportNavigationTarget self)
		{
			if (self != null)
			{
				if (self.NavigationTargetType == null)
				{
					return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(self.NavigationTargetTypeName);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsEmpty(this NavigationPoint self)
		{
			if (!(self == null))
			{
				if (self.TargetType == null)
				{
					return string.IsNullOrEmpty(self.TargetTypeName);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool EqualsTo(this ISupportNavigationTarget self, ISupportNavigationTarget target)
		{
			if (self == null || target == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (self == target)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return self.IsSameNavigationPoint(new NavigationPoint(target));
		}

		public static bool IsSameNavigationPoint(this ISupportNavigationTarget self, NavigationPoint navigationPoint)
		{
			return self.IsSameNavigationPoint(navigationPoint, useParamterForSync: true);
		}

		public static bool IsSameNavigationPoint(this ISupportNavigationTarget self, NavigationPoint navigationPoint, bool useParamterForSync)
		{
			if (self == null || navigationPoint.IsEmpty())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (useParamterForSync && !navigationPoint.IsParameterMatch(self.NavigationTargetParameter))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (self.NavigationTargetType != null && navigationPoint.TargetType != null)
			{
				return self.NavigationTargetType == navigationPoint.TargetType;
			}
			if (!(self.GetNavigationTargetFullName() == navigationPoint.FullTargetTypeName))
			{
				return self.GetNavigationTargetName() == navigationPoint.TargetTypeName;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsSameNavigationPoint(this IHamburgerMenuNavigationItem self, NavigationPoint navigationPoint, bool useParamterForSync)
		{
			if (((ISupportNavigationTarget)self).IsSameNavigationPoint(navigationPoint, useParamterForSync))
			{
				return self.SyncWithActivePage;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public static class SplitCollectionItemExtensions
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty SplitterProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty CollectionIndexProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty ContainerItemProperty;

		static SplitCollectionItemExtensions()
		{
			SplitterProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Splitter", typeof(ICollectionSplitter), typeof(SplitCollectionItemExtensions));
			CollectionIndexProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("CollectionIndex", typeof(int), typeof(SplitCollectionItemExtensions), new PropertyMetadata(0, OnCollectionIndexChanged));
			ContainerItemProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ContainerItem", typeof(WeakReference), typeof(SplitCollectionItemExtensions), new PropertyMetadata(null));
		}

		public static ICollectionSplitter GetSplitter(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (ICollectionSplitter)obj.GetValue(SplitterProperty);
		}

		public static int GetCollectionIndex(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (int)obj.GetValue(CollectionIndexProperty);
		}

		internal static void SetContainerItem(object container, object item)
		{
			HamburgerMenuExtensions.SetWeakRefObject(container, ContainerItemProperty, item);
		}

		internal static object GetContainerItem(object container)
		{
			return HamburgerMenuExtensions.GetWeakRefObject<object>(container, ContainerItemProperty);
		}

		private static void SetSplitter(DependencyObject obj, ICollectionSplitter splitter)
		{
			if (splitter == null)
			{
				obj.ClearValue(SplitterProperty);
				obj.ClearValue(CollectionIndexProperty);
				return;
			}
			if (GetSplitter(obj) == null)
			{
				GetItemCollectionIndex(obj, splitter);
			}
			obj.SetValue(SplitterProperty, splitter);
		}

		private static void SetCollectionIndex(DependencyObject obj, int index)
		{
			obj.SetValue(CollectionIndexProperty, index);
		}

		private static void OnCollectionIndexChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ICollectionSplitter splitter = GetSplitter(obj);
			splitter.Do(delegate(ICollectionSplitter x)
			{
				x.OnCollectionIndexChanged(obj, (int)e.NewValue, (int)e.OldValue);
			});
		}

		public static void UpdateCollectionIndex(DependencyObject item)
		{
			ICollectionSplitter splitter = GetSplitter(item);
			if (splitter != null)
			{
				int num = splitter.CalculateActualItemCollectionIndex(item);
				if (num > -1)
				{
					SetCollectionIndex(item, num);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void AssignItemSplitter(object item, ICollectionSplitter splitter)
		{
			if (item is ISplitCollectionItem splitCollectionItem)
			{
				splitCollectionItem.Splitter = splitter;
				return;
			}
			if (item is DependencyObject obj)
			{
				SetSplitter(obj, splitter);
				return;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid item container");
		}

		internal static int GetItemCollectionIndex(object item)
		{
			if (item is ISplitCollectionItem splitCollectionItem)
			{
				return splitCollectionItem.CollectionIndex;
			}
			if (item is DependencyObject obj)
			{
				return GetCollectionIndex(obj);
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid item container");
		}

		internal static int GetItemCollectionIndex(object item, ICollectionSplitter splitter)
		{
			if (item is ISplitCollectionItem splitCollectionItem)
			{
				return splitCollectionItem.CollectionIndex;
			}
			if (item is DependencyObject dependencyObject)
			{
				if (dependencyObject.ReadLocalValue(CollectionIndexProperty) == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue && GetSplitter(dependencyObject) == null)
				{
					int num = splitter.CalculateActualItemCollectionIndex(dependencyObject);
					if (num > -1)
					{
						SetCollectionIndex(dependencyObject, num);
					}
				}
				return GetCollectionIndex(dependencyObject);
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid item container");
		}
	}

	public class HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl : FlyoutAdornerControl
	{

		private WeakEventHandler<HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl, MouseButtonEventArgs, MouseButtonEventHandler> RootMouseUpHandler { get; set; }

		static HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl()

			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl>.New().OverrideMetadata(FlyoutBase.AllowMoveAnimationProperty, (object)false, (Action<HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl>)null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None).OverrideMetadata(FlyoutBase.AllowOutOfScreenProperty, (object)true, (Action<HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl>)null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None)
				.OverrideMetadata(FlyoutBase.AnimationDurationProperty, (object)new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(350.0)), (Action<HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl>)null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None);
		}

		public HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl()
		{
			((FlyoutBase)this).Settings = (FlyoutSettingsBase)(object)new HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutSettings();
			RootMouseUpHandler = new WeakEventHandler<HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl, MouseButtonEventArgs, MouseButtonEventHandler>(this, (Action<HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl, object, MouseButtonEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl flyout, object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs args)
			{
				flyout.RootMouseUp(sender, args);
			}, (Action<WeakEventHandler<HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl, MouseButtonEventArgs, MouseButtonEventHandler>, object>)delegate(WeakEventHandler<HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl, MouseButtonEventArgs, MouseButtonEventHandler> h, object sender)
			{
				(sender as Window).RemoveHandler(UIElement.MouseDownEvent, h.Handler);
			}, (Func<WeakEventHandler<HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl, MouseButtonEventArgs, MouseButtonEventHandler>, MouseButtonEventHandler>)((WeakEventHandler<HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutControl, MouseButtonEventArgs, MouseButtonEventHandler> h) => h.OnEvent));
		}

		protected override void RootMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void RootMouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((FlyoutBase)this).ActualIsOpen)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)this).RootMouseDown(sender, e);
			}
		}

		protected override void SubscribeWindowCore()
		{
			((FlyoutBase)this).SubscribeWindowCore();
			subscribedRoot = new WeakReference(LayoutHelper.GetTopLevelVisual((DependencyObject)(object)this));
			if (subscribedRoot.Target is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				frameworkElement.AddHandler(UIElement.MouseUpEvent, RootMouseUpHandler.Handler, handledEventsToo: true);
			}
		}

		protected override void UnsubscribeWindowCore()
		{
			((FlyoutBase)this).UnsubscribeWindowCore();
			if (subscribedRoot.With((WeakReference x) => x.Target) is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				frameworkElement.RemoveHandler(UIElement.MouseUpEvent, RootMouseUpHandler.Handler);
			}
		}

		protected override void RenderGrid_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((FlyoutBase)this).RenderGrid_SizeChanged(sender, e);
			if (((FlyoutBase)this).RenderGrid != null)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)this).RenderGrid.Clip = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, ((FlyoutBase)this).RenderGrid.ActualWidth, ((FlyoutBase)this).RenderGrid.ActualHeight));
			}
		}
	}

	public class HamburgerSubMenuFlyoutAnimator : FlyoutAnimatorBase
	{
		private const string TranslateName = "FlyoutChildTranslateName";

		public override Storyboard GetOpenAnimation(FlyoutBase flyout, System.Windows.Point offset)
		{
			TranslateTransform moveTransform = GetMoveTransform(flyout);
			if (moveTransform == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			double contentWidth = GetContentWidth(flyout.RenderGrid, ((ContentControl)(object)flyout).Content as FrameworkElement);
			if (contentWidth > 0.0)
			{
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation
				{
					From = 0.0 - contentWidth,
					To = 0.0,
					Duration = flyout.AnimationDuration,
					EasingFunction = new ExponentialEase
					{
						EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut,
						Exponent = 4.0
					}
				};
				if (((FrameworkElement)(object)flyout).FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
				{
					doubleAnimation.From = contentWidth;
				}
				Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation, new PropertyPath(TranslateTransform.XProperty));
				Storyboard.SetTargetName(doubleAnimation, "FlyoutChildTranslateName");
				storyboard.Children.Add(doubleAnimation);
			}
			DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames = new DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames
			{
				Duration = new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(0.0))
			};
			doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames.KeyFrames.Add(new DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame(1.0, KeyTime.FromPercent(0.0)));
			storyboard.Children.Insert(0, doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames);
			Storyboard.SetTarget(doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames, flyout.RenderGrid);
			Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames, new PropertyPath(UIElement.OpacityProperty));
			return storyboard;
		}

		public override Storyboard GetCloseAnimation(FlyoutBase flyout)
		{
			Duration duration = flyout.AnimationDuration;
			if (duration.TimeSpan.Milliseconds > 120)
			{
				duration = new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(120.0));
			}
			Timeline timeline = new DoubleAnimation
			{
				From = 1.0,
				To = 0.0,
				Duration = duration
			};
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			storyboard.Children.Add(timeline);
			Storyboard.SetTarget(timeline, flyout.RenderGrid);
			Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(timeline, new PropertyPath(UIElement.OpacityProperty));
			return storyboard;
		}

		public override Storyboard GetMoveAnimation(FlyoutBase flyout, System.Windows.Point from, System.Windows.Point to)
		{
			return null;
		}

		private double GetContentWidth(FrameworkElement contentContainer, FrameworkElement content)
		{
			double num = (double.IsNaN(contentContainer.Width) ? contentContainer.ActualWidth : contentContainer.Width);
			if (content == null)
			{
				return num;
			}
			double val = 0.0;
			val = Math.Max(val, double.IsNaN(content.Width) ? 0.0 : content.Width);
			val = Math.Max(val, double.IsNaN(content.MinWidth) ? 0.0 : content.MinWidth);
			return Math.Max(val, num);
		}

		private TranslateTransform GetMoveTransform(FlyoutBase flyout)
		{
			if (flyout.ChildContainer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TranslateTransform translateTransform = flyout.ChildContainer.RenderTransform as TranslateTransform;
			if (translateTransform == null)
			{
				translateTransform = new TranslateTransform();
				INameScope nameScope = NameScope.GetNameScope((DependencyObject)(object)flyout);
				if (nameScope == null)
				{
					nameScope = new NameScope();
					NameScope.SetNameScope((DependencyObject)(object)flyout, nameScope);
				}
				if (nameScope.FindName("FlyoutChildTranslateName") != null)
				{
					nameScope.UnregisterName("FlyoutChildTranslateName");
				}
				((FrameworkElement)(object)flyout).RegisterName("FlyoutChildTranslateName", (object)translateTransform);
				flyout.ChildContainer.RenderTransform = translateTransform;
			}
			return translateTransform;
		}
	}

	internal class HamburgerMenuBottomBarItemsLayoutCalculator : HamburgerMenuLayoutCalculatorBase
	{
		public int LeftItemsCount { get; protected set; }

		public int RightItemsCount => base.ItemsCount - LeftItemsCount;

		protected internal double SeparatorHeight { get; protected set; }

		protected bool NeedSeparator { get; set; }

		protected double MaxItemHeight { get; set; }

		protected override void ResetCalculatedFields()
		{
			base.ResetCalculatedFields();
			NeedSeparator = false;
			SeparatorHeight = 0.0;
			LeftItemsCount = 0;
			MaxItemHeight = 0.0;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnMeasureCore(IEnumerable<HamburgerItemMeasureInfo> items)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (HamburgerItemMeasureInfo item in items)
			{
				if (IsItemVisible(item))
				{
					if (!item.IsSpecialItem)
					{
						NeedSeparator = true;
						double num2 = CoerceItemHeight(item, item.DesiredSize.Height);
						num += num2;
						LeftItemsCount += ((item.Placement == HamburgerMenuBottomBarItemPlacement.Left) ? 1 : 0);
						int itemsCount = base.ItemsCount + 1;
						base.ItemsCount = itemsCount;
						base.MaxItemWidth = Math.Max(item.DesiredSize.Width, base.MaxItemWidth);
						MaxItemHeight = Math.Max(MaxItemHeight, CoerceItemHeight(item, num2));
					}
					else
					{
						SeparatorHeight = item.DesiredSize.Height;
					}
				}
			}
			if (base.IsCompact)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(base.CompactItemWidth) && base.CompactItemWidth > 0.0)
				{
					base.MaxItemWidth = base.CompactItemWidth;
				}
				base.DesiredWidth = base.MaxItemWidth;
				base.DesiredHeight = num;
			}
			else
			{
				base.MaxItemWidth = Math.Max(base.CompactItemWidth, base.MaxItemWidth);
				base.DesiredWidth = (double)base.ItemsCount * base.MaxItemWidth;
				base.DesiredHeight = ((base.ItemsCount > 0) ? MaxItemHeight : 0.0);
			}
			NeedSeparator = base.DesiredHeight > 0.0;
			base.DesiredHeight += (NeedSeparator ? SeparatorHeight : 0.0);
			return new System.Windows.Size(base.DesiredWidth, base.DesiredHeight);
		}

		public override System.Windows.Size OnArrange(System.Windows.Size finalSize, IEnumerable<HamburgerItemMeasureInfo> items, Action<HamburgerItemMeasureInfo> arrangeDelegate)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (HamburgerItemMeasureInfo item in items)
			{
				if (!IsItemVisible(item))
				{
					UpdateItemState(item.Item, HamburgerMenuItemState.Hidden);
					item.Location = new Rect(0.0 - base.MaxItemWidth, SeparatorHeight, base.MaxItemWidth, MaxItemHeight);
					continue;
				}
				if (item.IsSpecialItem)
				{
					if (!ArrangeSeparator(finalSize, item))
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					double y;
					double x;
					if (item.Placement == HamburgerMenuBottomBarItemPlacement.Left)
					{
						y = MaxItemHeight * (double)num + SeparatorHeight;
						x = base.MaxItemWidth * (double)num;
						num++;
					}
					else
					{
						y = (double)(LeftItemsCount + num2) * MaxItemHeight + SeparatorHeight;
						x = finalSize.Width - base.MaxItemWidth * (double)(RightItemsCount - num2);
						num2++;
					}
					if (base.IsCompact)
					{
						item.Location = new Rect(0.0, y, base.MaxItemWidth, MaxItemHeight);
					}
					else
					{
						item.Location = new Rect(x, SeparatorHeight, base.MaxItemWidth, MaxItemHeight);
					}
				}
				UpdateItemState(item.Item, null);
				arrangeDelegate(item);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		public override bool IsItemVisible(HamburgerItemMeasureInfo info)
		{
			if (info.IsIconVisible || info.IsSpecialItem)
			{
				return base.IsItemVisible(info);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ArrangeSeparator(System.Windows.Size finalSize, HamburgerItemMeasureInfo item)
		{
			if (NeedSeparator)
			{
				item.Location = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, SeparatorHeight);
				return true;
			}
			item.Location = new Rect(0.0 - finalSize.Width, 0.0, finalSize.Width, SeparatorHeight);
			UpdateItemState(item.Item, HamburgerMenuItemState.Hidden);
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class HamburgerMenuItemsLayoutCalculator : HamburgerMenuLayoutCalculatorBase
	{
		protected override System.Windows.Size OnMeasureCore(IEnumerable<HamburgerItemMeasureInfo> items)
		{
			foreach (HamburgerItemMeasureInfo item in items)
			{
				if (!item.IsSpecialItem && IsItemVisible(item))
				{
					base.DesiredHeight += CoerceItemHeight(item, item.DesiredSize.Height);
					base.MaxItemWidth = Math.Max(item.DesiredSize.Width, base.MaxItemWidth);
				}
			}
			base.DesiredWidth = (base.IsCompact ? Math.Max(base.MaxItemWidth, base.CompactItemWidth) : base.MaxItemWidth);
			return new System.Windows.Size(base.DesiredWidth, base.DesiredHeight);
		}

		public override System.Windows.Size OnArrange(System.Windows.Size finalSize, IEnumerable<HamburgerItemMeasureInfo> items, Action<HamburgerItemMeasureInfo> arrangeDelegate)
		{
			double width = finalSize.Width;
			double height = finalSize.Height;
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (HamburgerItemMeasureInfo item in items)
			{
				bool flag;
				if (item.IsSpecialItem)
				{
					flag = base.IsCompact;
					double x = (base.IsCompact ? 0.0 : (0.0 - finalSize.Width));
					item.Location = new Rect(x, base.DesiredHeight, finalSize.Width, Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Height - base.DesiredHeight));
				}
				else
				{
					flag = IsItemVisible(item);
					double num2 = CoerceItemHeight(item, item.DesiredSize.Height);
					double x2 = (flag ? 0.0 : (0.0 - finalSize.Width));
					item.Location = new Rect(x2, num, width, num2);
					num += (flag ? num2 : 0.0);
				}
				UpdateItemState(item.Item, (!flag) ? new HamburgerMenuItemState?(HamburgerMenuItemState.Hidden) : ((HamburgerMenuItemState?)null));
				arrangeDelegate(item);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public abstract class HamburgerMenuLayoutCalculatorBase : IHamburgerMenuLayoutCalculator
	{
		public bool IsCompact { get; set; }

		public double CompactItemWidth { get; set; }

		public double MaxItemWidth { get; set; }

		public double MinItemHeight { get; set; }

		public int ItemsCount { get; protected set; }

		public double DesiredWidth { get; protected set; }

		public double DesiredHeight { get; protected set; }

		public System.Windows.Size OnMeasure(IEnumerable<HamburgerItemMeasureInfo> items)
		{
			ResetCalculatedFields();
			return OnMeasureCore(items);
		}

		public abstract System.Windows.Size OnArrange(System.Windows.Size finalSize, IEnumerable<HamburgerItemMeasureInfo> items, Action<HamburgerItemMeasureInfo> arrangeDelegate);

		protected abstract System.Windows.Size OnMeasureCore(IEnumerable<HamburgerItemMeasureInfo> items);

		protected virtual void ResetCalculatedFields()
		{
			DesiredWidth = 0.0;
			DesiredHeight = 0.0;
			ItemsCount = 0;
		}

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetCalculatedFields();
			MaxItemWidth = 0.0;
			MinItemHeight = double.NaN;
			CompactItemWidth = 0.0;
			IsCompact = false;
		}

		public virtual bool IsItemVisible(HamburgerItemMeasureInfo info)
		{
			if (IsCompact)
			{
				return info.ShowInCompact;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected double CoerceItemHeight(HamburgerItemMeasureInfo info, double desiredHeight)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(MinItemHeight) && info.CanChangeItemHeight)
			{
				return Math.Max(desiredHeight, MinItemHeight);
			}
			return desiredHeight;
		}

		protected double CoerceItemHeight(double desiredHeight)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(MinItemHeight))
			{
				return Math.Max(desiredHeight, MinItemHeight);
			}
			return desiredHeight;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateItemState(UIElement item, HamburgerMenuItemState? state)
		{
			HamburgerMenuItemState state2 = (state.HasValue ? state.Value : HamburgerMenuItemState.Normal);
			SetItemState(item, state2);
		}

		protected void SetItemState(UIElement item, HamburgerMenuItemState state)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				HamburgerMenuExtensions.SetMenuItemState(item, state);
			}
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[Browsable(false)]
	public abstract class HamburgerNavigationTargetBase
	{
		public enum NavigationResult
		{
			Completed,
			Canceled,
			Failed,
			Pending
		}

		private NavigationPoint navigationPoint;

		private ISupportNavigationTarget previousNavigationInfo;

		private bool canGoBack;

		public bool IsReleased { get; private set; }

		public abstract bool CanGoBack { get; }

		public abstract bool CanGoForward { get; }

		public NavigationPoint NavigationPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return navigationPoint;
			}
			protected set
			{
				PropertySetterHelper.SetProperty(ref navigationPoint, value, OnNavigationPointChanged);
			}
		}

		protected object NavigationObject { get; private set; }

		protected virtual bool IsNavigating => (NavigationObject as ISupportAsyncNavigation).Return((ISupportAsyncNavigation x) => x.Status == NavigationStatus.Executing, () => false);

		protected bool IsPendingNavigation { get; set; }

		protected ISupportNavigationTarget NavigatingInfo { get; set; }

		protected object NavigatingParentVM { get; set; }

		protected Locker NavigatingLocker { get; set; }

		private INavigationOwner Owner { get; set; }

		public event EventHandler NavigationPointChanged;

		public event EventHandler CanGoBackChanged;

		public static HamburgerNavigationTargetBase CreateInstance(object navigationObject, INavigationOwner owner)
		{
			if (navigationObject is NavigationFrame)
			{
				return new FrameNavigationTarget(navigationObject as NavigationFrame, owner);
			}
			if (navigationObject is INavigationService)
			{
				return new ServiceNavigationTarget(navigationObject as INavigationService, owner);
			}
			if (navigationObject is HamburgerNavigationTargetBase)
			{
				return navigationObject as HamburgerNavigationTargetBase;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public HamburgerNavigationTargetBase(object navigationObject, INavigationOwner owner)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (navigationObject == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("NavigationObject");
			}
			Owner = owner;
			NavigationObject = navigationObject;
			NavigatingLocker = new Locker();
			SubscribeNavigationEvents();
			NavigationPoint = CreateNavigationPoint();
		}

		public NavigationResult Navigate(ISupportNavigationTarget navigationInfo, object parentViewModel)
		{
			if (navigationInfo.IsEmpty())
			{
				return NavigationResult.Failed;
			}
			if (navigationInfo.EqualsTo(NavigatingInfo))
			{
				return NavigationResult.Completed;
			}
			previousNavigationInfo = NavigatingInfo;
			NavigatingInfo = new NavigationTargetInfo(navigationInfo);
			if (IsNavigating)
			{
				IsPendingNavigation = true;
				NavigatingParentVM = parentViewModel;
				return NavigationResult.Pending;
			}
			if (!CanNavigate(NavigatingInfo, parentViewModel))
			{
				CurrentNavigationCanceled(checkForPendingNavigation: false);
				return NavigationResult.Canceled;
			}
			NavigatingLocker.Lock();
			NavigationResult navigationResult = NavigateCore(navigationInfo, parentViewModel);
			if (navigationResult == NavigationResult.Failed)
			{
				NavigatingLocker.Unlock();
			}
			return navigationResult;
		}

		public virtual void Release()
		{
			IsReleased = true;
			UnsubscribeNavigationEvents();
		}

		public bool IsNavigationObject(object navigationObject)
		{
			return NavigationObject == navigationObject;
		}

		public virtual void GoBack()
		{
			GoBack(null);
		}

		public abstract void GoBack(object parameter);

		public abstract void GoForward();

		public abstract NavigationResult NavigateCore(ISupportNavigationTarget navigationInfo, object parentViewModel);

		protected abstract NavigationPoint CreateNavigationPoint();

		protected abstract void SubscribeNavigationEvents();

		protected abstract void UnsubscribeNavigationEvents();

		protected virtual void OnNavigationPointChanged(NavigationPoint oldValue)
		{
			ValidateNavigationPoint(navigationPoint);
			bool flag = true;
			if (IsPendingNavigation && NavigatingInfo != null && !NavigatingInfo.IsSameNavigationPoint(navigationPoint))
			{
				if (CanNavigate(NavigatingInfo, NavigatingParentVM))
				{
					NavigateCore(NavigatingInfo, NavigatingParentVM);
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					NavigatingLocker.Lock();
					CurrentNavigationCanceled(checkForPendingNavigation: false);
				}
			}
			if (navigationPoint != null && Locker.op_Implicit(NavigatingLocker) && navigationPoint.IsStubView && NavigatingInfo != null)
			{
				navigationPoint = new NavigationPoint(NavigatingInfo);
				ValidateNavigationPoint(navigationPoint);
			}
			IsPendingNavigation = false;
			NavigatingParentVM = null;
			previousNavigationInfo = null;
			if (Locker.op_Implicit(NavigatingLocker))
			{
				NavigatingLocker.Unlock();
			}
			else
			{
				NavigatingInfo = null;
			}
			if (!IsReleased && flag)
			{
				RaiseNavigationPointChanged();
			}
			RaiseCanGoBackChangedIfNeeded();
		}

		protected void CurrentNavigationCanceled(bool checkForPendingNavigation)
		{
			if (Locker.op_Implicit(NavigatingLocker))
			{
				NavigatingLocker.Unlock();
			}
			if (checkForPendingNavigation && IsPendingNavigation && NavigatingInfo != null && !NavigatingInfo.IsSameNavigationPoint(navigationPoint) && CanNavigate(NavigatingInfo, NavigatingParentVM))
			{
				NavigateCore(NavigatingInfo, NavigatingParentVM);
			}
			else
			{
				NavigatingInfo = previousNavigationInfo;
				previousNavigationInfo = null;
			}
			IsPendingNavigation = false;
			NavigatingParentVM = null;
		}

		protected void RaiseNavigationPointChanged()
		{
			this.NavigationPointChanged.Do(delegate(EventHandler x)
			{
				x(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			});
		}

		protected void RaiseCanGoBackChangedIfNeeded()
		{
			bool flag = CanGoBack;
			if (canGoBack != flag)
			{
				canGoBack = flag;
				this.CanGoBackChanged.Do(delegate(EventHandler x)
				{
					x(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				});
			}
		}

		protected void ValidateNavigationPoint(NavigationPoint point)
		{
			if (!(point == null))
			{
				point.IsStubView = IsStubView(point.TargetType);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsStubView(Type type)
		{
			return type == typeof(FallbackView);
		}

		protected bool CanNavigate(ISupportNavigationTarget target, object parentVm)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				return Owner.CanNavigate(target, parentVm);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[Browsable(false)]
	public abstract class HamburgerNavigationTargetBase<T> : HamburgerNavigationTargetBase where T : class
	{
		protected new T NavigationObject => (T)base.NavigationObject;

		public HamburgerNavigationTargetBase(T navigationObject, INavigationOwner owner)
			: base(navigationObject, owner)
		{
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[Browsable(false)]
	public class FrameNavigationTarget : HamburgerNavigationTargetBase<NavigationFrame>
	{
		public override bool CanGoBack => base.NavigationObject.CanGoBack;

		public override bool CanGoForward => base.NavigationObject.CanGoForward;

		protected override bool IsNavigating
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.NavigationObject.NavigationInProgress)
				{
					return base.IsNavigating;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public FrameNavigationTarget(NavigationFrame frame, INavigationOwner owner)
			: base(frame, owner)
		{
		}

		public override NavigationResult NavigateCore(ISupportNavigationTarget navigationInfo, object parentViewModel)
		{
			Type type = navigationInfo.NavigationTargetType ?? ResolveType(navigationInfo.NavigationTargetTypeName);
			if (navigationInfo.ClearNavigationHistory)
			{
				IJournal journal = base.NavigationObject.AttachedJournal ?? base.NavigationObject.Journal;
				journal.ClearNavigationHistory();
			}
			if (type == null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(navigationInfo.NavigationTargetTypeName))
			{
				object source = ViewLocator.Default.ResolveView(navigationInfo.NavigationTargetTypeName);
				base.NavigationObject.Navigate(source, navigationInfo.NavigationTargetParameter, parentViewModel, navigationInfo.SaveToNavigationJournal);
			}
			else
			{
				base.NavigationObject.Navigate(type, navigationInfo.NavigationTargetParameter, parentViewModel, navigationInfo.SaveToNavigationJournal);
			}
			return NavigationResult.Completed;
		}

		public override void GoBack(object parameter)
		{
			base.NavigationObject.GoBack(parameter);
		}

		public override void GoForward()
		{
			base.NavigationObject.GoForward();
		}

		protected virtual Type ResolveType(string typeName)
		{
			return ViewLocator.Default.ResolveViewType(typeName);
		}

		protected override NavigationPoint CreateNavigationPoint()
		{
			if (base.NavigationObject == null || base.NavigationObject.Content == null)
			{
				return new NavigationPoint(null, null);
			}
			IJournal journal = base.NavigationObject.AttachedJournal ?? base.NavigationObject.Journal;
			if (journal != null && journal.Current != null)
			{
				return new NavigationPoint(journal.Current);
			}
			return new NavigationPoint(base.NavigationObject.Content.With((object x) => x.GetType()), null);
		}

		protected override void SubscribeNavigationEvents()
		{
			base.NavigationObject.Navigated += OnNavigated;
			base.NavigationObject.NavigationFailed += OnNavigationFailed;
			base.NavigationObject.NavigationCanceled += OnNavigationFailed;
		}

		protected override void UnsubscribeNavigationEvents()
		{
			base.NavigationObject.Navigated -= OnNavigated;
			base.NavigationObject.NavigationFailed -= OnNavigationFailed;
			base.NavigationObject.NavigationCanceled -= OnNavigationFailed;
		}

		private void OnNavigationFailed(object sender, NavigationBaseEventArgs e)
		{
			CurrentNavigationCanceled(checkForPendingNavigation: true);
		}

		private void OnNavigated(object sender, NavigationEventArgs e)
		{
			NavigationPoint navigationPoint = new NavigationPoint(e.Content.With((object x) => x.GetType()), e.Parameter);
			NavigationPoint navigationPoint2 = CreateNavigationPoint();
			base.NavigationPoint = ((navigationPoint.TargetType == navigationPoint2.TargetType) ? navigationPoint2 : navigationPoint);
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[Browsable(false)]
	public class ServiceNavigationTarget : HamburgerNavigationTargetBase<INavigationService>
	{
		public override bool CanGoBack => base.NavigationObject.CanGoBack;

		public override bool CanGoForward => base.NavigationObject.CanGoForward;

		public ServiceNavigationTarget(INavigationService service, INavigationOwner owner)
			: base(service, owner)
		{
		}

		public override NavigationResult NavigateCore(ISupportNavigationTarget navigationInfo, object parentViewModel)
		{
			if (!base.NavigationObject.CanNavigate)
			{
				return NavigationResult.Failed;
			}
			if (navigationInfo.ClearNavigationHistory)
			{
				base.NavigationObject.ClearNavigationHistory();
			}
			base.NavigationObject.Navigate(navigationInfo.GetNavigationTargetFullName(), navigationInfo.NavigationTargetParameter, parentViewModel, navigationInfo.SaveToNavigationJournal);
			return NavigationResult.Completed;
		}

		public override void GoBack(object parameter)
		{
			base.NavigationObject.GoBack(parameter);
		}

		public override void GoForward()
		{
			base.NavigationObject.GoForward();
		}

		protected override NavigationPoint CreateNavigationPoint()
		{
			return GetNavigationPoint();
		}

		protected override void SubscribeNavigationEvents()
		{
			base.NavigationObject.CurrentChanged += OnNavigated;
			base.NavigationObject.CanGoBackChanged += OnCanGoBackChanged;
			(base.NavigationObject as FrameNavigationService).Do(delegate(FrameNavigationService x)
			{
				x.NavigationStopped += OnNavigationStopped;
			});
		}

		protected override void UnsubscribeNavigationEvents()
		{
			base.NavigationObject.CurrentChanged -= OnNavigated;
			base.NavigationObject.CanGoBackChanged -= OnCanGoBackChanged;
			(base.NavigationObject as FrameNavigationService).Do(delegate(FrameNavigationService x)
			{
				x.NavigationStopped -= OnNavigationStopped;
			});
		}

		private void OnNavigationStopped(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CurrentNavigationCanceled(checkForPendingNavigation: true);
		}

		private void OnCanGoBackChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseCanGoBackChangedIfNeeded();
		}

		private void OnNavigated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			NavigationPoint navigationPoint = GetNavigationPoint();
			if (!navigationPoint.IsClearContentPhase)
			{
				base.NavigationPoint = navigationPoint;
			}
		}

		private NavigationPoint GetNavigationPoint()
		{
			if (base.NavigationObject == null)
			{
				return new NavigationPoint(null, null);
			}
			return (base.NavigationObject as NavigationServiceBase).With((NavigationServiceBase x) => x.CurrentNavigationPoint) ?? new NavigationPoint(base.NavigationObject.Current.With((object x) => x.GetType()), null);
		}
	}
