	public abstract class HamburgerMenuItemsPanelBase : HamburgerMenuPanelBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowSpecialElementsProperty;

		private readonly List<UIElement> specialElements;

		private bool isInitialized;

		public bool ShowSpecialElements
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowSpecialElementsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowSpecialElementsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected List<UIElement> SpecialElements => specialElements;

		static HamburgerMenuItemsPanelBase()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<HamburgerMenuItemsPanelBase>.New().Register<bool>("ShowSpecialElements", ref ShowSpecialElementsProperty, false, (Action<HamburgerMenuItemsPanelBase, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerMenuItemsPanelBase d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				d.OnShowSpecialElementsChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public HamburgerMenuItemsPanelBase()
		{
			specialElements = new List<UIElement>();
		}

		private void InitializeSpecialElements()
		{
			if (!isInitialized)
			{
				InitializeSpecialElementsCore();
				isInitialized = true;
			}
		}

		protected abstract void InitializeSpecialElementsCore();

		protected virtual void OnShowSpecialElementsChanged()
		{
			InitializeSpecialElements();
			foreach (UIElement specialElement in SpecialElements)
			{
				if (specialElement != null)
				{
					UIElement element = ItemToVisual(specialElement as IVisualItem) ?? specialElement;
					if (ShowSpecialElements && !base.Children.Contains(element))
					{
						base.Children.Add(element);
					}
					else if (!ShowSpecialElements)
					{
						base.Children.Remove(element);
					}
				}
			}
			if (!ShowSpecialElements)
			{
				SpecialElements.Clear();
				isInitialized = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void PopulateChildren()
		{
			base.PopulateChildren();
			if (!ShowSpecialElements || SpecialElements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UIElement specialElement in SpecialElements)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = ItemToVisual(specialElement as IVisualItem) ?? specialElement;
				if (uIElement != null && !base.Children.Contains(uIElement))
				{
					base.Children.Add(uIElement);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class HamburgerSubMenuPanel : ItemsSourcePanel
	{
		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				result.Height += child.DesiredSize.Height;
				result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, child.DesiredSize.Width);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, 0.0);
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				finalRect.Height = child.DesiredSize.Height;
				child.Arrange(finalRect);
				finalRect.Y += child.DesiredSize.Height;
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class HamburgerItemMeasureInfo
	{
		private UIElement container;

		public System.Windows.Size DesiredSize { get; set; }

		public HamburgerMenuBottomBarItemPlacement? Placement { get; set; }

		public UIElement Item { get; set; }

		public UIElement Container => container ?? Item;

		public bool IsSpecialItem { get; set; }

		public bool IsIconVisible { get; set; }

		public bool CanChangeItemHeight { get; set; }

		public Rect Location { get; set; }

		public bool ShowInCompact
		{
			get
			{
				if (Item is IHamburgerMenuItemBase { CompactModeVisibility: not HamburgerItemCompactModeVisibility.Auto } hamburgerMenuItemBase)
				{
					return hamburgerMenuItemBase.CompactModeVisibility == HamburgerItemCompactModeVisibility.Visible;
				}
				return IsIconVisible;
			}
		}

		public HamburgerItemMeasureInfo(System.Windows.Size desiredSize)
		{
			DesiredSize = desiredSize;
			CanChangeItemHeight = true;
		}

		public HamburgerItemMeasureInfo(UIElement visual)
		{
			DesiredSize = visual.DesiredSize;
			container = visual;
			if (visual is TemplatedCollectionItemPresenter templatedCollectionItemPresenter)
			{
				Item = templatedCollectionItemPresenter.RootElement;
			}
			else
			{
				Item = visual;
			}
			CanChangeItemHeight = (Item as FrameworkElement).Return((FrameworkElement x) => double.IsNaN(x.Height), () => false);
			IsIconVisible = (Item as IGlyphElement).IsIconVisible();
			IsSpecialItem = Item is HamburgerMenuBottomBarSeparator || Item is HamburgerMenuEmptySpaceBar;
			Placement = (Item as IHamburgerMenuBottomBarItem).Return((IHamburgerMenuBottomBarItem x) => x.Placement, () => (HamburgerMenuBottomBarItemPlacement?)null);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Item: {GetName(Item)}. DesiredSize: {DesiredSize}, Location: {Location}, ShowInCompact: {ShowInCompact}, IsSpecialItem {IsSpecialItem}";
		}

		private static string GetName(UIElement visual)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			empty = (visual as ContentControl).With((ContentControl x) => x.Content as string);
			if (empty == null)
			{
				empty = (visual as FrameworkElement).With((FrameworkElement x) => x.ToolTip as string);
			}
			if (empty == null && visual != null)
			{
				empty = visual.GetType().Name;
			}
			return empty;
		}
	}
	internal static class GlyphElementExtensions
	{
		internal const double DEFAULT_GLYPH_HEIGHT = 24.0;

		internal const double DEFAULT_GLYPH_WIDTH = 24.0;

		internal const Stretch DEFAULT_GLYPH_STRETCH = Stretch.Uniform;

		internal const string SVG_NORMAL_STATE = "Normal";

		internal const string SVG_HOVER_STATE = "Hover";

		internal const string SVG_PRESSED_STATE = "Pressed";

		internal const string SVG_CHECKED_STATE = "Checked";

		internal const string SVG_CHECKED_HOVER_STATE = "HoverChecked";

		internal const string SVG_CHECKED_PRESSED_STATE = "PressedChecked";

		private static EventHandler svgStateDependentPropertyChangedHandler = OnSvgStateDependentPropertyChanged;

		private static Dictionary<Type, DependencyProperty> selectedPropertyDict = new Dictionary<Type, DependencyProperty>();

		public static bool IsIconVisible(this IGlyphElement self)
		{
			if (self != null)
			{
				if (self.Glyph == null)
				{
					return self.GlyphTemplate != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void RegisterSvgStateUpdate(ButtonBase element, DependencyProperty selectedProperty)
		{
			UnregisterSvgStateUpdate(element, selectedProperty);
			if (element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			RegisterPropertyChanged(element, UIElement.IsMouseOverProperty, svgStateDependentPropertyChangedHandler, removeHandler: false);
			RegisterPropertyChanged(element, ButtonBase.IsPressedProperty, svgStateDependentPropertyChangedHandler, removeHandler: false);
			RegisterPropertyChanged(element, UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, svgStateDependentPropertyChangedHandler, removeHandler: false);
			if (selectedProperty != null)
			{
				if (!selectedPropertyDict.ContainsKey(element.GetType()))
				{
					selectedPropertyDict.Add(element.GetType(), selectedProperty);
				}
				RegisterPropertyChanged(element, selectedProperty, svgStateDependentPropertyChangedHandler, removeHandler: false);
			}
		}

		public static void UnregisterSvgStateUpdate(ButtonBase element, DependencyProperty selectedProperty)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				RegisterPropertyChanged(element, UIElement.IsMouseOverProperty, svgStateDependentPropertyChangedHandler, removeHandler: true);
				RegisterPropertyChanged(element, ButtonBase.IsPressedProperty, svgStateDependentPropertyChangedHandler, removeHandler: true);
				RegisterPropertyChanged(element, UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, svgStateDependentPropertyChangedHandler, removeHandler: true);
				if (selectedProperty != null)
				{
					RegisterPropertyChanged(element, selectedProperty, svgStateDependentPropertyChangedHandler, removeHandler: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void RegisterPropertyChanged(ButtonBase element, DependencyProperty prop, EventHandler handler, bool removeHandler)
		{
			DependencyPropertyDescriptor dependencyPropertyDescriptor = DependencyPropertyDescriptor.FromProperty(prop, element.GetType());
			if (dependencyPropertyDescriptor != null)
			{
				if (removeHandler)
				{
					dependencyPropertyDescriptor.RemoveValueChanged(element, handler);
				}
				else
				{
					dependencyPropertyDescriptor.AddValueChanged(element, handler);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnSvgStateDependentPropertyChanged(object sender, object args)
		{
			UpdateSvgState(sender as ButtonBase);
		}

		private static void UpdateSvgState(ButtonBase element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isSelected = GetIsSelected(element);
			string text = (isSelected ? "Checked" : "Normal");
			if (element.IsEnabled)
			{
				if (element.IsPressed)
				{
					text = (isSelected ? "PressedChecked" : "Pressed");
				}
				else if (element.IsMouseOver)
				{
					text = (isSelected ? "HoverChecked" : "Hover");
				}
			}
			SvgImageHelper.SetState((DependencyObject)element, text);
		}

		private static bool GetIsSelected(ButtonBase element)
		{
			if (!selectedPropertyDict.TryGetValue(element.GetType(), out var value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (value == ToggleButton.IsCheckedProperty)
			{
				bool? flag = (bool?)element.GetValue(value);
				if (flag.HasValue)
				{
					return flag.Value;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return (bool)element.GetValue(value);
		}
	}
	public static class PropertySetterHelper
	{
		public static void SetProperty<T>(ref T storage, T value, Action<T> changedCallback = null)
		{
			if (!object.Equals(storage, value))
			{
				T oldValue = storage;
				storage = value;
				changedCallback.Do(delegate(Action<T> x)
				{
					x(oldValue);
				});
			}
		}

		public static void SetProperty<T>(ref T storage, T value, Action changedCallback)
		{
			if (!object.Equals(storage, value))
			{
				storage = value;
				changedCallback.Do(delegate(Action x)
				{
					x();
				});
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class VirtualCollectionBase<TItem> : IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ILockable, IEnumerable<TItem>, INotifyCollectionChanged, INotifyPropertyChanged where TItem : class
	{
		private int lockCount;

		private NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs lastArgs;

		private int changesCount;

		public abstract int Count { get; }

		public object this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return GetItemByIndex(index);
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		int ICollection.Count => Count;

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => false;

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => true;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => false;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => this;

		public bool IsLockUpdate => lockCount > 0;

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected abstract TItem GetItemByIndex(int index);

		public abstract int IndexOf(object value);

		protected abstract IEnumerator<TItem> GetEnumerator();

		public abstract bool Contains(object value);

		protected internal virtual void RaiseReset()
		{
			RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset), raiseCountChanged: true);
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseMove(int newStartingIndex, int oldStartingIndex, object newItem)
		{
			RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move, newItem, newStartingIndex, oldStartingIndex), raiseCountChanged: false);
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseAdd(int newStartingIndex, object newItem)
		{
			RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, newItem, newStartingIndex), raiseCountChanged: true);
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseRemove(int oldStartingIndex, object oldItem)
		{
			RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, oldItem, oldStartingIndex), raiseCountChanged: true);
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseReplace(int newStartingIndex, object oldItem, object newItem)
		{
			RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace, newItem, oldItem, newStartingIndex), raiseCountChanged: false);
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e, bool raiseCountChanged)
		{
			if (IsLockUpdate)
			{
				lastArgs = ((++changesCount == 1) ? e : null);
				return;
			}
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Item[]"));
				if (raiseCountChanged)
				{
					this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Count"));
				}
			}
			this.CollectionChanged.Do(delegate(NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler x)
			{
				x(this, e);
			});
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		void IList.Clear()
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains(value);
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			return IndexOf(value);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		void IList.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator<TItem> IEnumerable<TItem>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void BeginUpdate()
		{
			lockCount++;
		}

		public void EndUpdate()
		{
			if (--lockCount == 0 && changesCount > 0)
			{
				ResetOnEndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void ResetOnEndUpdate()
		{
			changesCount = 0;
			lastArgs = lastArgs ?? new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset);
			RaiseCollectionChanged(lastArgs, lastArgs.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move && lastArgs.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace);
			lastArgs = null;
		}
	}
	public class DoubleToGridLengthConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			double num;
			try
			{
				num = ((value != null) ? System.Convert.ToDouble(value) : double.NaN);
			}
			catch
			{
				num = double.NaN;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return GridLength.Auto;
			}
			return new GridLength(num);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}
	}
	internal class AltSourcePropertyConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			object obj = values[0];
			object obj2 = values[1];
			if (obj == null || obj == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
			{
				if (!(obj2 is Visual))
				{
					return obj2;
				}
				return obj2.ToString();
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	public interface IHamburgerMenuLayoutController
	{

	public abstract class HamburgerMenuPanelBase : ItemsSourcePanel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsCompactProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CompactItemWidthProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MinItemHeightProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LayoutCalculatorProperty;

		private IHamburgerMenuLayoutCalculator defaultCalculator;

		public bool IsCompact
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsCompactProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsCompactProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double CompactItemWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(CompactItemWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CompactItemWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double MinItemHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(MinItemHeightProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MinItemHeightProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public IHamburgerMenuLayoutCalculator LayoutCalculator
		{
			get
			{
				return (IHamburgerMenuLayoutCalculator)GetValue(LayoutCalculatorProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LayoutCalculatorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal IHamburgerMenuLayoutCalculator ActualCalculator
		{
			get
			{
				if (LayoutCalculator != null)
				{
					return LayoutCalculator;
				}
				if (defaultCalculator == null)
				{
					defaultCalculator = CreateDefaultLayoutCalculator();
					if (defaultCalculator == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("LayoutCalculator cannot be null.");
					}
				}
				return defaultCalculator;
			}
		}

		static HamburgerMenuPanelBase()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<HamburgerMenuPanelBase>.New().Register<bool>("IsCompact", ref IsCompactProperty, false, (Action<HamburgerMenuPanelBase, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerMenuPanelBase d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				d.PrepareLayoutCalculator();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure).Register<double>("CompactItemWidth", ref CompactItemWidthProperty, double.NaN, (Action<HamburgerMenuPanelBase, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(HamburgerMenuPanelBase d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				d.PrepareLayoutCalculator();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure)
				.Register<double>("MinItemHeight", ref MinItemHeightProperty, double.NaN, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure)
				.Register<IHamburgerMenuLayoutCalculator>("LayoutCalculator", ref LayoutCalculatorProperty, (IHamburgerMenuLayoutCalculator)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure);
		}

		protected abstract IHamburgerMenuLayoutCalculator CreateDefaultLayoutCalculator();

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (base.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			}
			PrepareLayoutCalculator();
			return ActualCalculator.OnMeasure(GetItemsInfo(doMeasure: true, CompactItemWidth));
		}

		protected virtual void PrepareLayoutCalculator()
		{
			ActualCalculator.Reset();
			ActualCalculator.IsCompact = IsCompact;
			ActualCalculator.CompactItemWidth = CompactItemWidth;
			ActualCalculator.MinItemHeight = MinItemHeight;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (base.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
			}
			IEnumerable<HamburgerItemMeasureInfo> itemsInfo = GetItemsInfo(doMeasure: false, CompactItemWidth);
			if (finalSize.Height == 0.0 && itemsInfo.Any((HamburgerItemMeasureInfo x) => !x.IsSpecialItem && ActualCalculator.IsItemVisible(x)))
			{
				InvalidateMeasure();
				return finalSize;
			}
			return ActualCalculator.OnArrange(finalSize, GetItemsInfo(doMeasure: false, CompactItemWidth), delegate(HamburgerItemMeasureInfo itemInfo)
			{
				itemInfo.Container.Arrange(itemInfo.Location);
			});
		}

		internal IEnumerable<UIElement> GetVisibleItems()
		{
			return from x in GetItemsInfo(doMeasure: false, double.NaN)
				where x.IsSpecialItem || ActualCalculator.IsItemVisible(x)
				select x.Item;
		}

		private IEnumerable<HamburgerItemMeasureInfo> GetItemsInfo(bool doMeasure, double compactWidth)
		{
			return (from x in base.Children.OfType<UIElement>()
				where IsElementVisible(x)
				select x).Select(delegate(UIElement x)
			{
				if (doMeasure)
				{
					x.InvalidateMeasure();
					x.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
					if (compactWidth > x.DesiredSize.Width)
					{
						x.InvalidateMeasure();
						x.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(compactWidth, double.PositiveInfinity));
					}
				}
				return new HamburgerItemMeasureInfo(x);
			});
		}

		private static bool IsElementVisible(UIElement element)
		{
			if (element is TemplatedCollectionItemPresenter templatedCollectionItemPresenter)
			{
				if (templatedCollectionItemPresenter.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					return templatedCollectionItemPresenter.RootElement.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (element != null)
			{
				return element.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ItemsSourcePanel : ItemsPanelBase<IVisualItem>
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ItemsSourceProperty;

		public object ItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ItemsSourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ItemsSourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override IEnumerable<IVisualItem> ItemsCore => (IEnumerable<IVisualItem>)ItemsSource;

		static ItemsSourcePanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ItemsSourcePanel>.New().Register<object>("ItemsSource", ref ItemsSourceProperty, (object)null, (Action<ItemsSourcePanel, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(ItemsSourcePanel d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				d.OnItemsSourceChanged(e.OldValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public bool FocusSelectedItemOrDefault(bool focusDefaultIfSelectedNotFound)
		{
			IVisualItem visualItem = ItemsCore.FirstOrDefault((IVisualItem x) => IsSelected(x)) ?? (focusDefaultIfSelectedNotFound ? ItemsCore.FirstOrDefault() : null);
			bool flag = visualItem != null && visualItem.Visual != null;
			if (flag)
			{
				visualItem.Visual.Focus();
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemsSourceChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			UnsubscribeSourceEvents(oldValue);
			SubscribeSourceEvents(ItemsSource);
			PopulateChildren();
		}

		protected override UIElement ItemToVisual(IVisualItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UIElement visual = item.Visual;
			UIElement itemContainer = HamburgerMenuExtensions.GetItemContainer((item as DependencyObject) ?? visual);
			return itemContainer ?? visual;
		}

		private static bool IsSelected(IVisualItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((item as ISelectable) ?? (item.Visual as ISelectable))?.IsSelected ?? false;
		}
	}
	[ContentProperty]
	public abstract class ItemsPanelBase<TItem> : Panel, IWeakEventListener where TItem : class
	{
		protected internal abstract IEnumerable<TItem> ItemsCore { get; }

		public ItemsPanelBase()
		{
			Initialize();
		}

		protected void SubscribeSourceEvents(object source)
		{
			(source as INotifyCollectionChanged).Do(delegate(INotifyCollectionChanged x)
			{
				CollectionChangedEventManager.AddListener(x, this);
			});
		}

		protected void UnsubscribeSourceEvents(object source)
		{
			(source as INotifyCollectionChanged).Do(delegate(INotifyCollectionChanged x)
			{
				CollectionChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(x, this);
			});
		}

		protected abstract UIElement ItemToVisual(TItem item);

		protected UIElement ItemToVisual(object item)
		{
			return ItemToVisual((TItem)item);
		}

		protected virtual void Initialize()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnChildRemoved(TItem item, UIElement visualItem)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnChildAdded(TItem item, UIElement visualItem)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void PopulateChildren()
		{
			ClearChidren();
			if (ItemsCore == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (TItem item in ItemsCore)
			{
				InsertChild(base.Children.Count, item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ClearChidren()
		{
			List<UIElement> list = base.Children.OfType<UIElement>().ToList();
			base.Children.Clear();
			foreach (UIElement item in list)
			{
				OnChildRemoved(null, item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InsertChild(int childIndex, TItem child)
		{
			UIElement uIElement = ItemToVisual(child);
			base.Children.Insert(childIndex, uIElement);
			OnChildAdded(child, uIElement);
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveChild(TItem child)
		{
			UIElement uIElement = ItemToVisual(child);
			base.Children.Remove(uIElement);
			OnChildRemoved(child, uIElement);
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveChild(int childIndex)
		{
			UIElement visualItem = base.Children[childIndex];
			base.Children.RemoveAt(childIndex);
			OnChildRemoved(null, visualItem);
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType != typeof(CollectionChangedEventManager))
			{
				return false;
			}
			NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e2 = (NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs)e;
			if (e2 == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			switch (e2.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				int newStartingIndex = e2.NewStartingIndex;
				bool flag = newStartingIndex < base.Children.Count && newStartingIndex > -1;
				foreach (TItem newItem in e2.NewItems)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						InsertChild(newStartingIndex, newItem);
					}
					else
					{
						InsertChild(base.Children.Count, newItem);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				RemoveChild(e2.OldStartingIndex);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				RemoveChild(e2.NewStartingIndex);
				InsertChild(e2.NewStartingIndex, (TItem)e2.NewItems[0]);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				RemoveChild(e2.OldStartingIndex);
				InsertChild(e2.NewStartingIndex, (TItem)e2.NewItems[0]);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				PopulateChildren();
				break;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		public SplitView()
		{
			templateSettings = new SplitViewTemplateSettings();
			UpdateTemplateSettings();
			UpdateActualState();
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			PaneContainer.Do(delegate(Decorator x)
			{
				x.Child = null;
			});
			ContentContainer.Do(delegate(Decorator x)
			{
				x.Child = null;
			});
			LightDismissLayer.Do(delegate(UIElement x)
			{
				x.MouseUp -= OnLightDismissLayerMouseUp;
			});
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PaneRoot = GetTemplateChild("PART_PaneRoot") as UIElement;
			LightDismissLayer = GetTemplateChild("LightDismissLayer") as UIElement;
			PaneContainer = GetTemplateChild("PART_Pane") as Decorator;
			ContentContainer = GetTemplateChild("PART_Content") as Decorator;
			LightDismissLayer.Do(delegate(UIElement x)
			{
				x.MouseUp += OnLightDismissLayerMouseUp;
			});
			PaneContainer.Do(delegate(Decorator x)
			{
				x.Child = Pane;
			});
			ContentContainer.Do(delegate(Decorator x)
			{
				x.Child = Content;
			});
			UpdateTemplateSettings();
			RegisterTransforms();
		}

		private void RegisterTransforms()
		{
			try
			{
				if (FindName("PaneTransform") != null)
				{
					UnregisterName("PaneTransform");
				}
				if (FindName("PaneClipRectangleTransform") != null)
				{
					UnregisterName("PaneClipRectangleTransform");
				}
				RegisterName("PaneTransform", PaneRoot.RenderTransform);
				RegisterName("PaneClipRectangleTransform", PaneRoot.Clip.Transform);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void OnLightDismissLayerMouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsPaneOpen && (DisplayMode == SplitViewDisplayMode.Overlay || DisplayMode == SplitViewDisplayMode.CompactOverlay) && !RaiseClosing())
			{
				skipClosingEvent = true;
				SetCurrentValue(IsPaneOpenProperty, false);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPaneChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			PaneContainer.Do(delegate(Decorator x)
			{
				x.Child = Pane;
			});
			UpdateTemplateSettings();
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ContentContainer.Do(delegate(Decorator x)
			{
				x.Child = Content;
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnOpenPaneWidthChanged()
		{
			UpdateTemplateSettings();
		}

		protected virtual void OnCompactPaneWidthChanged()
		{
			UpdateTemplateSettings();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(OpenPaneWidth) && Pane != null)
			{
				Pane.Measure(constraint);
				TemplateSettings.UpdateTemplateSize(Pane.DesiredSize.Width, CompactPaneWidth);
				SyncOpenPaneWidth();
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
			UpdateTemplateSettings(suppressClipUpdate: true);
			UpdatePaneClip(result.Height);
			RestartAnimationOnPaneWidthChanged();
			return result;
		}

		protected void UpdateTemplateSettings(bool suppressClipUpdate = false)
		{
			if (TemplateSettings.UpdateTemplateSize(CalculatedOpenPaneWidth, CompactPaneWidth))
			{
				if (!suppressClipUpdate)
				{
					UpdatePaneClip(base.ActualHeight);
				}
				SyncOpenPaneWidth();
			}
		}

		private void SyncOpenPaneWidth()
		{
			if (CurrentAnimation == null)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(ActualOpenPaneWidthProperty, OpenPaneWidth);
			}
		}

		private void EnsurePaneClip()
		{
			if (CurrentAnimation == null)
			{
				UpdatePaneClip(base.ActualHeight);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdatePaneClip(double actualHeight)
		{
			if (!(PaneRoot.With((UIElement x) => x.Clip) is RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry))
			{
				return;
			}
			rectangleGeometry.Rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, TemplateSettings.OpenPaneWidth, actualHeight);
			if (ActualState == SplitViewState.ClosedCompactLeft)
			{
				TemplateSettings.CompactWidthClipOffset = TemplateSettings.NegativeOpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth;
			}
			else if (ActualState == SplitViewState.ClosedCompactRight)
			{
				TemplateSettings.CompactWidthClipOffset = TemplateSettings.OpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth;
			}
			else
			{
				TemplateSettings.CompactWidthClipOffset = 0.0;
			}
			if (CurrentAnimation == null)
			{
				TranslateTransform input = rectangleGeometry.Transform as TranslateTransform;
				input.Do(delegate(TranslateTransform x)
				{
					x.SetCurrentValue(TranslateTransform.XProperty, TemplateSettings.CompactWidthClipOffset);
				});
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPanePlacementChanged()
		{
			UpdateActualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnDisplayModeChanged()
		{
			UpdateActualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsPaneOpenChanged()
		{
			if (!IsPaneOpen && !skipClosingEvent)
			{
				RaiseClosing();
			}
			skipClosingEvent = false;
			UpdateActualState();
			if (!IsPaneOpen)
			{
				RaiseClosed();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnActualStateChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdatePaneClip(base.ActualHeight);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualState()
		{
			SplitViewState splitViewState = SplitViewState.Closed;
			if (IsPaneOpen)
			{
				splitViewState = ((DisplayMode == SplitViewDisplayMode.Overlay) ? SplitViewState.OpenOverlayLeft : ((DisplayMode != SplitViewDisplayMode.CompactOverlay) ? SplitViewState.OpenInlineLeft : SplitViewState.OpenCompactOverlayLeft));
			}
			else if (DisplayMode == SplitViewDisplayMode.CompactInline || DisplayMode == SplitViewDisplayMode.CompactOverlay)
			{
				splitViewState = SplitViewState.ClosedCompactLeft;
			}
			if (PanePlacement == SplitViewPanePlacement.Right && splitViewState != SplitViewState.Closed)
			{
				splitViewState += 4;
			}
			if (ActualCanAnimate)
			{
				prevState = ActualState;
				if (double.IsNaN(OpenPaneWidth))
				{
					animateTransition = true;
					InvalidateMeasure();
					InvalidateArrange();
				}
				else
				{
					Animate(SplitViewAnimationFactory.GetAnimationStoryboard(prevState, splitViewState, this));
				}
			}
			ActualState = splitViewState;
		}

		private void Animate(Storyboard storyboard)
		{
			if (storyboard == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (CurrentAnimation != null)
			{
				CurrentAnimation.SkipToFill(this);
			}
			CurrentAnimation = storyboard;
			storyboard.Completed += delegate
			{
				if (storyboard == CurrentAnimation)
				{
					CurrentAnimation = null;
				}
			};
			try
			{
				storyboard.Begin(this, isControllable: true);
			}
			catch
			{
				CurrentAnimation = null;
			}
		}

		private void RestartAnimationOnPaneWidthChanged()
		{
			bool flag = animateTransition;
			animateTransition = false;
			if (ActualCanAnimate && flag)
			{
				Animate(SplitViewAnimationFactory.GetAnimationStoryboard(prevState, ActualState, this));
			}
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateTemplateSettings();
			RegisterTransforms();
			canAnimate = true;
		}

		private static double GetElementWidth(UIElement pane)
		{
			if (!(pane is FrameworkElement frameworkElement))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(frameworkElement.Width))
			{
				return frameworkElement.Width;
			}
			return frameworkElement.ActualWidth;
		}

		private void RaiseClosed()
		{
			this.PaneClosed.Do(delegate(EventHandler x)
			{
				x(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			});
		}

		private bool RaiseClosing()
		{
			CancelEventArgs args = new CancelEventArgs();
			this.PaneClosing.Do(delegate(EventHandler<CancelEventArgs> x)
			{
				x(this, args);
			});
			return args.Cancel;
		}
	}
	public class SplitViewAnimationBuilder
	{
		public virtual Storyboard GetAnimationStoryboard(SplitViewState fromState, SplitViewState toState, SplitView target)
		{
			if (fromState == toState || target == null || (target.AnimationSettings != null && target.AnimationSettings.PaneCloseAnimationDuration == 0.0 && target.AnimationSettings.PaneOpenAnimationDuration == 0.0))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetAnimationStoryboardCore(fromState, toState, target);
		}

		protected Storyboard GetAnimationStoryboardCore(SplitViewState fromState, SplitViewState toState, SplitView target)
		{
			double keyTime = ((target.AnimationSettings == null) ? 350.0 : target.AnimationSettings.PaneOpenAnimationDuration);
			double keyTime2 = ((target.AnimationSettings == null) ? 120.0 : target.AnimationSettings.PaneCloseAnimationDuration);
			if (fromState == SplitViewState.Closed && toState == SplitViewState.OpenOverlayLeft)
			{
				Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
				Timeline value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneTransform", "X", CreateDescreteObjectKeyFrame(0.0, target.TemplateSettings.NegativeOpenPaneWidth), CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime, 0.0, 0.1, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard.Children.Add(value);
				value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneClipRectangleTransform", "X", CreateDescreteObjectKeyFrame(0.0, target.TemplateSettings.OpenPaneWidth), CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime, 0.0, 0.1, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard.Children.Add(value);
				return storyboard;
			}
			if (fromState == SplitViewState.Closed && toState == SplitViewState.ClosedCompactLeft)
			{
				Storyboard storyboard2 = new Storyboard();
				Timeline value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneTransform", "X", CreateDescreteObjectKeyFrame(0.0, 0.0));
				storyboard2.Children.Add(value);
				value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneClipRectangleTransform", "X", CreateDescreteObjectKeyFrame(0.0, target.TemplateSettings.NegativeOpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth));
				storyboard2.Children.Add(value);
				return storyboard2;
			}
			if (fromState == SplitViewState.Closed && toState == SplitViewState.OpenOverlayRight)
			{
				Storyboard storyboard3 = new Storyboard();
				Timeline value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneTransform", "X", CreateDescreteObjectKeyFrame(0.0, target.TemplateSettings.OpenPaneWidth), CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime, 0.0, 0.1, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard3.Children.Add(value);
				value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneClipRectangleTransform", "X", CreateDescreteObjectKeyFrame(0.0, target.TemplateSettings.NegativeOpenPaneWidth), CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime, 0.0, 0.1, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard3.Children.Add(value);
				return storyboard3;
			}
			if (fromState == SplitViewState.ClosedCompactLeft && toState == SplitViewState.OpenCompactOverlayLeft)
			{
				Storyboard storyboard4 = new Storyboard();
				Timeline value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneClipRectangleTransform", "X", CreateDescreteObjectKeyFrame(0.0, target.TemplateSettings.NegativeOpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth), CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime, 0.0, 0.1, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard4.Children.Add(value);
				return storyboard4;
			}
			if (fromState == SplitViewState.ClosedCompactRight && toState == SplitViewState.OpenCompactOverlayRight)
			{
				Storyboard storyboard5 = new Storyboard();
				Timeline value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneClipRectangleTransform", "X", CreateDescreteObjectKeyFrame(0.0, target.TemplateSettings.OpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth), CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime, 0.0, 0.1, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard5.Children.Add(value);
				return storyboard5;
			}
			if (fromState == SplitViewState.OpenOverlayLeft && toState == SplitViewState.Closed)
			{
				Storyboard storyboard6 = new Storyboard();
				Timeline value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneTransform", "X", CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime2, 0.0, 0.3, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard6.Children.Add(value);
				value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneClipRectangleTransform", "X", CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime2, 0.0, 0.3, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard6.Children.Add(value);
				return storyboard6;
			}
			if (fromState == SplitViewState.OpenOverlayRight && toState == SplitViewState.Closed)
			{
				Storyboard storyboard7 = new Storyboard();
				Timeline value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneTransform", "X", CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime2, 0.0, 0.3, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard7.Children.Add(value);
				value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneClipRectangleTransform", "X", CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime2, 0.0, 0.3, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard7.Children.Add(value);
				return storyboard7;
			}
			if (fromState == SplitViewState.OpenCompactOverlayLeft && toState == SplitViewState.ClosedCompactLeft)
			{
				Storyboard storyboard8 = new Storyboard();
				Timeline value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneClipRectangleTransform", "X", CreateDescreteObjectKeyFrame(0.0, 0.0), CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime2, target.TemplateSettings.NegativeOpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth, 0.3, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard8.Children.Add(value);
				return storyboard8;
			}
			if (fromState == SplitViewState.OpenInlineLeft && toState == SplitViewState.ClosedCompactLeft)
			{
				Storyboard storyboard9 = new Storyboard();
				Timeline value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneClipRectangleTransform", "X", CreateDescreteObjectKeyFrame(0.0, 0.0), CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime2, target.TemplateSettings.NegativeOpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth, 0.3, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard9.Children.Add(value);
				return storyboard9;
			}
			if (fromState == SplitViewState.ClosedCompactLeft && toState == SplitViewState.OpenInlineLeft)
			{
				Storyboard storyboard10 = new Storyboard();
				Timeline value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneClipRectangleTransform", "X", CreateDescreteObjectKeyFrame(0.0, target.TemplateSettings.NegativeOpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth), CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime, 0.0, 0.1, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard10.Children.Add(value);
				value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation(target, "ActualOpenPaneWidth", CreateDescreteObjectKeyFrame(0.1, target.TemplateSettings.CompactPaneGridLength.Value), CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime, target.TemplateSettings.OpenPaneWidth, 0.1, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard10.Children.Add(value);
				return storyboard10;
			}
			if (fromState == SplitViewState.OpenCompactOverlayRight && toState == SplitViewState.ClosedCompactRight)
			{
				Storyboard storyboard11 = new Storyboard();
				Timeline value = CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation("PaneClipRectangleTransform", "X", CreateDescreteObjectKeyFrame(0.0, 0.0), CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(keyTime2, target.TemplateSettings.OpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth, 0.3, 0.9, 0.2, 1.0));
				storyboard11.Children.Add(value);
				return storyboard11;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static Timeline CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation(DependencyObject target, string targetProperty, params DoubleKeyFrame[] keyFrames)
		{
			return CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation(target, null, targetProperty, keyFrames);
		}

		private static Timeline CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation(string targetName, string targetProperty, params DoubleKeyFrame[] keyFrames)
		{
			return CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation(null, targetName, targetProperty, keyFrames);
		}

		private static Timeline CreateDoubleKeyFrameAnimation(DependencyObject target, string targetName, string targetProperty, params DoubleKeyFrame[] keyFrames)
		{
			DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames = new DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames
			{
				FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop
			};
			if (target != null)
			{
				Storyboard.SetTarget(doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames, target);
			}
			else
			{
				Storyboard.SetTargetName(doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames, targetName);
			}
			Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames, new PropertyPath(targetProperty));
			foreach (DoubleKeyFrame keyFrame in keyFrames)
			{
				doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames.KeyFrames.Add(keyFrame);
			}
			return doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames;
		}

		private static DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame CreateDescreteObjectKeyFrame(double keyTime, double value)
		{
			return new DiscreteDoubleKeyFrame
			{
				KeyTime = KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(keyTime)),
				Value = value
			};
		}

		private static SplineDoubleKeyFrame CreateSplineDoubleKeyFrame(double keyTime, double value, double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2)
		{
			return new SplineDoubleKeyFrame
			{
				KeyTime = KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(keyTime)),
				Value = value,
				KeySpline = new KeySpline(new System.Windows.Point(x1, y1), new System.Windows.Point(x2, y2))
			};
		}
	}
	public sealed class SplitViewTemplateSettings : BindableBase
	{
		public GridLength CompactPaneGridLength
		{

		public GridLength OpenPaneGridLength
		{
			get

				return GetProperty(() => OpenPaneGridLength);
			}

			}
		}

		public double NegativeOpenPaneWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty(() => NegativeOpenPaneWidth);
			}
			private set

			}
		}

		public double NegativeOpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty(() => NegativeOpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetProperty(() => NegativeOpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth, value);
			}
		}

		public double OpenPaneWidth
		{
			get

				return GetProperty(() => OpenPaneWidth);
			}

			}
		}

		public double OpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty(() => OpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetProperty(() => OpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth, value);
			}
		}

		public double CompactWidthClipOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty(() => CompactWidthClipOffset);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetProperty(() => CompactWidthClipOffset, value);
			}
		}

		internal bool UpdateTemplateSize(double openPaneLength, double compactPaneLength)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (double.IsNaN(openPaneLength))
			{
				flag = true;
				openPaneLength = 0.0;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(compactPaneLength))
			{
				compactPaneLength = 0.0;
			}
			if (openPaneLength == OpenPaneGridLength.Value && compactPaneLength == CompactPaneGridLength.Value)
			{
				return false;
			}
			OpenPaneGridLength = (flag ? GridLength.Auto : new GridLength(openPaneLength));
			CompactPaneGridLength = new GridLength(compactPaneLength);
			NegativeOpenPaneWidth = 0.0 - openPaneLength;
			OpenPaneWidth = (flag ? double.NaN : openPaneLength);
			OpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth = openPaneLength - compactPaneLength;
			if (OpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth < 0.0)
			{
				OpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth = 0.0;
			}
			NegativeOpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth = 0.0 - OpenPaneWidthMinusCompactWidth;
			return true;
		}
	}
	public static class HamburgerMenuExtensions
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty MenuItemStateProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey MenuItemStatePropertyKey;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty OwnerInternalProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty IsStyleSetProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty ItemContainerInternalProperty;

		static HamburgerMenuExtensions()
		{
			OwnerInternalProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("OwnerInternal", typeof(WeakReference), typeof(HamburgerMenuExtensions), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ItemContainerInternalProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ItemContainerInternal", typeof(WeakReference), typeof(HamburgerMenuExtensions), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			IsStyleSetProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("IsStyleSet", typeof(bool), typeof(HamburgerMenuExtensions), new PropertyMetadata(false));
			MenuItemStatePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("MenuItemState", typeof(HamburgerMenuItemState), typeof(HamburgerMenuExtensions), new PropertyMetadata(HamburgerMenuItemState.Normal));
			MenuItemStateProperty = MenuItemStatePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
		}

		public static HamburgerMenuItemState GetMenuItemState(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (HamburgerMenuItemState)obj.GetValue(MenuItemStateProperty);
		}

		internal static void SetMenuItemState(DependencyObject obj, HamburgerMenuItemState state)
		{
			obj.SetValue(MenuItemStatePropertyKey, state);
		}

		public static UIElement GetItemContainer(object obj)
		{
			return GetWeakRefObject<UIElement>(obj, ItemContainerInternalProperty);
		}

		internal static void SetItemContainer(object container, object item)
		{
			SetWeakRefObject(container, ItemContainerInternalProperty, item);
		}

		internal static void SetOwner(object container, object item)
		{
			SetWeakRefObject(container, OwnerInternalProperty, item);
		}

		internal static TOwner GetOwner<TOwner>(object container) where TOwner : class
		{
			return GetWeakRefObject<TOwner>(container, OwnerInternalProperty);
		}

		internal static bool GetIsStyleSet(DependencyObject dp)
		{
			return (bool)dp.GetValue(IsStyleSetProperty);
		}

		internal static void SetIsStyleSet(DependencyObject dp, bool value)
		{
			dp.SetValue(IsStyleSetProperty, value);
		}

		internal static TItem GetWeakRefObject<TItem>(object target, DependencyProperty property) where TItem : class
		{
			if (!(target is DependencyObject dependencyObject))
			{
				return null;
			}
			WeakReference input = dependencyObject.GetValue(property) as WeakReference;
			return input.With((WeakReference x) => x.Target as TItem);
		}

		internal static void SetWeakRefObject(object target, DependencyProperty property, object value)
		{
			if (target is DependencyObject dependencyObject)
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					dependencyObject.ClearValue(property);
				}
				else
				{
					dependencyObject.SetValue(property, new WeakReference(value));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class PageViewContentPanel : Panel
	{
		private class FastContentPresenter : ContentPresenter
		{
			public static readonly DependencyProperty IsTouchEnabledProperty;

			[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
			private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsTouchEnabledPropertyKey;

			private WeakReference focusedElement;

			public bool IsTouchEnabled
			{
				get
				{
					return (bool)GetValue(IsTouchEnabledProperty);
				}
				set
				{
					SetValue(IsTouchEnabledProperty, value);
				}
			}

			static FastContentPresenter()
			{
				DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FastContentPresenter>.New().OverrideMetadata<Visibility>(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, (Action<FastContentPresenter, Visibility, Visibility>)delegate(FastContentPresenter d, Visibility oldValue, Visibility newValue)
				{
					d.OnVisibilityChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}).Register<bool>("IsTouchEnabled", ref IsTouchEnabledProperty, false, (Action<FastContentPresenter, bool, bool>)delegate(FastContentPresenter d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
				{
					d.OnIsTouchEnabledChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
				try
				{
					FieldInfo field = typeof(ThemeManager).GetField("IsTouchEnabledPropertyKey", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
					IsTouchEnabledPropertyKey = field.GetValue(null) as DependencyPropertyKey;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}

			protected override void OnLostKeyboardFocus(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				base.OnLostKeyboardFocus(e);
				focusedElement = new WeakReference(e.OldFocus);
			}

			private void OnIsTouchEnabledChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
			{
				if (IsTouchEnabledPropertyKey != null)
				{
					SetValue(IsTouchEnabledPropertyKey, newValue);
				}
			}

			private void OnVisibilityChanged(Visibility oldValue, Visibility newValue)
			{
				if (newValue != Visibility.Visible || !base.IsVisible)
				{
					return;
				}
				IInputElement fe = ((focusedElement == null) ? null : (focusedElement.Target as IInputElement));
				if (fe == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					if (!fe.IsKeyboardFocused && !fe.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
					{
						fe.Focus();
					}
				});
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnimationTypeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnimationDirectionProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnimationSpeedRatioProperty;

		private AnimationProvider animationProvider;

		private bool fRequestClear;

		private Locker animationLocker = new Locker();

		private bool allowUpdateSelection = true;
