		public PageView Owner { get; private set; }

		protected internal ContentPresenter SelectedItem { get; set; }

		protected internal Dictionary<object, ContentPresenter> Items { get; set; }

		static PageViewContentPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<PageViewContentPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<PageViewContentPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ItemCacheMode", ref ItemCacheModeProperty, ItemCacheMode.None, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((PageViewContentPanel)d).OnItemCacheModeChanged((ItemCacheMode)e.OldValue, (ItemCacheMode)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AnimationType", ref AnimationTypeProperty, AnimationType.None);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AnimationDirection", ref AnimationDirectionProperty, SelectorAnimationDirection.Forward);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AnimationSpeedRatio", ref AnimationSpeedRatioProperty, 0.0);
		}

		public PageViewContentPanel()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Items = new Dictionary<object, ContentPresenter>();
			animationProvider = new AnimationProvider(this)
			{
				AllowInitialAnimation = false
			};
			base.SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Clip = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight));
		}

		public void Initialize(PageView owner)
		{
			if (Owner != owner)
			{
				if (owner == null)
				{
					UnInitialize();
					return;
				}
				Owner = owner;
				Owner.ItemsChanged += OnOwnerItemsChanged;
				Owner.SelectionChanged += OnOwnerSelectionChanged;
				Update();
			}
		}

		public void UnInitialize()
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.ItemsChanged -= OnOwnerItemsChanged;
				Owner.SelectionChanged -= OnOwnerSelectionChanged;
				Clear();
				Owner = null;
				SelectedItem = null;
			}
		}

		private void Update()
		{
			UpdateItems();
			UpdateSelection();
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemCacheModeChanged(ItemCacheMode oldValue, ItemCacheMode newValue)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				if (newValue == ItemCacheMode.None)
				{
					Clear();
				}
				Update();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnOwnerItemsChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add)
			{
				OnOwnerItemsAdd(e);
			}
			else if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove)
			{
				OnOwnerItemsRemove(e);
			}
			else if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace)
			{
				OnOwnerItemsReplace(e);
			}
			else if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				Clear();
			}
			Update();
		}

		private void OnOwnerItemsAdd(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewItems == null || ItemCacheMode != ItemCacheMode.CacheAll)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < e.NewItems.Count; i++)
			{
				object obj = e.NewItems[i];
				if (obj != null && !Items.ContainsKey(obj))
				{
					InsertItem(obj, e.NewStartingIndex + i);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnOwnerItemsRemove(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < e.OldItems.Count; i++)
			{
				object obj = e.OldItems[i];
				if (obj != null)
				{
					RemoveItem(obj);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual PageViewItem GetContainer(object content)
		{
			return (content as PageViewItem) ?? Owner.GetContainer(content);
		}

		private void OnOwnerItemsReplace(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewItems != null && e.OldItems != null)
			{
				object obj = e.OldItems[0];
				object obj2 = e.NewItems[0];
				if (obj != null && obj2 != null && Items.ContainsKey(obj))
				{
					RemoveItem(obj);
					InsertItem(obj2, e.NewStartingIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnOwnerSelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OriginalSource != Owner)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Owner.Items.Count != Items.Count || Owner.Items.Count != base.Children.Count)
			{
				if (ItemCacheMode == ItemCacheMode.None)
				{
					fRequestClear = AnimationType != AnimationType.None;
					if (!fRequestClear)
					{
						Clear();
					}
				}
				UpdateItems();
			}
			animationLocker.Lock();
			UpdateSelection();
			animationLocker.Unlock();
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (SelectedItem == null)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			}
			foreach (UIElement internalChild in base.InternalChildren)
			{
				internalChild.Measure(availableSize);
			}
			return SelectedItem.DesiredSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (SelectedItem != null)
			{
				SelectedItem.Arrange(new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), finalSize));
				return new System.Windows.Size(SelectedItem.ActualWidth, SelectedItem.ActualHeight);
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateItems()
		{
			if (ItemCacheMode == ItemCacheMode.CacheAll)
			{
				SynchronizeAllTabs();
			}
			else
			{
				SynchronizeSelectedTab();
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizeSelectedTab()
		{
			object obj = (Owner.IsIndexInRange(Owner.SelectedIndex) ? Owner.Items[Owner.SelectedIndex] : null);
			if (obj != null)
			{
				AddItem(obj);
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizeAllTabs()
		{
			allowUpdateSelection = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < Owner.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				object obj = Owner.Items[i];
				if (obj != null)
				{
					AddItem(obj);
				}
			}
			allowUpdateSelection = true;
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateSelection()
		{
			if (Owner != null && allowUpdateSelection)
			{
				object obj = (Owner.IsIndexInRange(Owner.SelectedIndex) ? Owner.Items[Owner.SelectedIndex] : null);
				ContentPresenter contentPresenter = ((obj != null && Items.ContainsKey(obj)) ? Items[obj] : null);
				HideItemsExcept((SelectedItem == null || AnimationType == AnimationType.None) ? null : SelectedItem, contentPresenter);
				if (SelectedItem != contentPresenter)
				{
					animationProvider.Animate(SelectedItem, contentPresenter, AnimationType, AnimationDirection, AnimationSpeedRatio, OnAnimationComplete);
				}
				SelectedItem = contentPresenter;
			}
		}

		private void OnAnimationComplete()
		{
			if (fRequestClear)
			{
				Clear(SelectedItem);
				fRequestClear = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Clear(object selectedItem)
		{
			List<object> list = Items.Where((KeyValuePair<object, ContentPresenter> x) => x.Value != selectedItem).ToDictionary((KeyValuePair<object, ContentPresenter> x) => x.Key, (KeyValuePair<object, ContentPresenter> x) => x.Value).Keys.ToList();
			foreach (object item in list)
			{
				base.Children.Remove(Items[item]);
			}
		}

		private void HideItemsExcept(params ContentPresenter[] presenters)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Visibility = ((!presenters.Contains(child)) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CollapseAllItems(UIElement selectedElement)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Visibility = ((child != selectedElement) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void AddItem(object item)
		{
			if (Items.ContainsKey(item))
			{
				ContentPresenter element = Items[item];
				if (!base.Children.Contains(element))
				{
					base.Children.Add(element);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				InsertItem(item, base.Children.Count);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InsertItem(object item, int index)
		{
			PageViewItem container = GetContainer(item);
			if (container != null)
			{
				FastContentPresenter fastContentPresenter = new FastContentPresenter
				{
					Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
				};
				BindItem(fastContentPresenter, container);
				base.Children.Add(fastContentPresenter);
				Items.Add(item, fastContentPresenter);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveItem(object item)
		{
			if (item != null && Items.ContainsKey(item))
			{
				base.Children.Remove(Items[item]);
				Items.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Clear()
		{
			foreach (ContentPresenter child in base.Children)
			{
				ClearBind(child);
			}
			Items.Clear();
			base.Children.Clear();
			SelectedItem = null;
		}

		protected virtual void BindItem(ContentPresenter cp, PageViewItem pageViewItem)
		{
			cp.SetBinding(ContentPresenter.ContentProperty, new Binding("Content")
			{
				Source = pageViewItem
			});
			cp.SetBinding(ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateProperty, new MultiBinding
			{
				Bindings = 
				{
					(BindingBase)new Binding("ContentTemplate")
					{
						Source = pageViewItem
					},
					(BindingBase)new Binding("ContentTemplate")
					{
						Source = Owner
					}
				},
				Converter = new ContentTemplateMultiBindingConverter()
			});
			cp.SetBinding(ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty, new MultiBinding
			{
				Bindings = 
				{
					(BindingBase)new Binding("ContentTemplateSelector")
					{
						Source = pageViewItem
					},
					(BindingBase)new Binding("ContentTemplateSelector")
					{
						Source = Owner
					}
				},
				Converter = new ContentTemplateMultiBindingConverter()
			});
			if (cp is FastContentPresenter)
			{
				cp.SetBinding(FastContentPresenter.IsTouchEnabledProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath(ThemeManager.IsTouchEnabledProperty),
					Source = pageViewItem
				});
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ClearBind(ContentPresenter cp)
		{
			BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(cp);
			cp.Content = null;
			cp.ContentTemplate = null;
		}
	}
	internal class ContentTemplateMultiBindingConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return values[0] ?? values[1];
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class AnimationProvider : DependencyObject
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty OldContentTranslateXProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NewContentTranslateXProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty OldContentTranslateYProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NewContentTranslateYProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty OldContentOpacityProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NewContentOpacityProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty StoryboardNameProperty;

		private StoryboardCollection Storyboards;

		private Storyboard DefaultStoryboard;

		private Storyboard CurrentStoryboard;

		private FrameworkElement owner;

		private ContentPresenter oldContent;

		private ContentPresenter newContent;

		private AnimationType animationType;

		private SelectorAnimationDirection oldAnimationDirection;

		private SelectorAnimationDirection animationDirection;

		private double animationSpeedRatio;

		private bool animationInProgress;

		private Action OnCompleteAction;

		internal bool AllowInitialAnimation { get; set; }

		public double OldContentTranslateX
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(OldContentTranslateXProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OldContentTranslateXProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double NewContentTranslateX
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(NewContentTranslateXProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(NewContentTranslateXProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double OldContentTranslateY
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(OldContentTranslateYProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OldContentTranslateYProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double NewContentTranslateY
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(NewContentTranslateYProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(NewContentTranslateYProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double NewContentOpacity
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(NewContentOpacityProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(NewContentOpacityProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double OldContentOpacity
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(OldContentOpacityProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OldContentOpacityProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static AnimationProvider()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AnimationProvider> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AnimationProvider>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("OldContentTranslateX", ref OldContentTranslateXProperty, 0.0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AnimationProvider)d).OnOldContentTranslateXChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("NewContentTranslateX", ref NewContentTranslateXProperty, 0.0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AnimationProvider)d).OnNewContentTranslateXChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("OldContentTranslateY", ref OldContentTranslateYProperty, 0.0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AnimationProvider)d).OnOldContentTranslateYChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("NewContentTranslateY", ref NewContentTranslateYProperty, 0.0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AnimationProvider)d).OnNewContentTranslateYChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("OldContentOpacity", ref OldContentOpacityProperty, 1.0);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("NewContentOpacity", ref NewContentOpacityProperty, 1.0);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached<string>("StoryboardName", ref StoryboardNameProperty);
		}

		public static string GetStoryboardName(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (string)obj.GetValue(StoryboardNameProperty);
		}

		public static void SetStoryboardName(DependencyObject obj, string value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(StoryboardNameProperty, value);
		}

		public AnimationProvider(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			owner.SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
			ResourceDictionary resourceDictionary = new ResourceDictionary
			{
				Source = AssemblyHelper.GetResourceUri(typeof(AnimationProvider).Assembly, "WindowsUI/Themes/Generic/ViewPresenter.xaml")
			};
			DefaultStoryboard = resourceDictionary["defaultStoryboard"] as Storyboard;
			Storyboards = resourceDictionary["storyboards"] as StoryboardCollection;
		}

		private void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateTransform();
		}

		public void Animate(ContentPresenter oldContentPresenter, ContentPresenter newContentPresenter, AnimationType animationType, SelectorAnimationDirection animationDirection, double animationSpeedRatio, Action onComplete)
		{
			if (animationType == AnimationType.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			oldContent = oldContentPresenter;
			newContent = newContentPresenter;
			this.animationType = animationType;
			this.animationDirection = animationDirection;
			this.animationSpeedRatio = animationSpeedRatio;
			if (animationInProgress)
			{
				if (animationType != AnimationType.Fade)
				{
					if (oldAnimationDirection == animationDirection)
					{
						CurrentStoryboard.Pause();
						UpdateTransform();
						CurrentStoryboard.Resume();
					}
					else
					{
						ReverseAnimation();
					}
					oldAnimationDirection = animationDirection;
				}
				return;
			}
			oldAnimationDirection = animationDirection;
			InitTransform();
			ResetTransform();
			SetBindings();
			SetCurrentStoryboard();
			animationInProgress = true;
			if (oldContent != null || AllowInitialAnimation)
			{
				OnCompleteAction = onComplete;
				CurrentStoryboard.Begin();
			}
			else
			{
				OnAnimatationCompleted();
			}
		}

		private void OnAnimatationCompleted()
		{
			animationInProgress = false;
			if (CurrentStoryboard != null)
			{
				CurrentStoryboard.Completed -= CurrentStoryboardCompleted;
			}
			ClearCurrentStoryboard();
			ClearBindings();
			if (oldContent != null)
			{
				oldContent.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			newContent = null;
			if (OnCompleteAction != null)
			{
				OnCompleteAction();
			}
			OnCompleteAction = null;
		}

		private void CurrentStoryboardCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnAnimatationCompleted();
		}

		private void ReverseAnimation()
		{
			double oldContentTranslateX = OldContentTranslateX;
			double newContentTranslateX = NewContentTranslateX;
			double oldContentTranslateY = OldContentTranslateY;
			double newContentTranslateY = NewContentTranslateY;
			CurrentStoryboard.Stop();
			owner.BeginAnimation(OldContentTranslateXProperty, null);
			owner.BeginAnimation(NewContentTranslateXProperty, null);
			owner.BeginAnimation(OldContentTranslateYProperty, null);
			owner.BeginAnimation(NewContentTranslateYProperty, null);
			OldContentTranslateX = newContentTranslateX;
			NewContentTranslateX = oldContentTranslateX;
			OldContentTranslateY = newContentTranslateY;
			NewContentTranslateY = oldContentTranslateY;
			UpdateTransform();
			SetCurrentStoryboard();
			CurrentStoryboard.Begin();
		}

		private void ClearCurrentStoryboard()
		{
			if (CurrentStoryboard != null)
			{
				CurrentStoryboard.Stop();
			}
			owner.BeginAnimation(NewContentTranslateXProperty, null);
			owner.BeginAnimation(OldContentTranslateXProperty, null);
			NewContentTranslateX = 0.0;
			NewContentTranslateY = 0.0;
			UpdateTransform();
		}

		private void SetBindings()
		{
			if (oldContent != null)
			{
				oldContent.SetBinding(UIElement.OpacityProperty, new Binding("OldContentOpacity")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			}
			if (newContent != null)
			{
				newContent.SetBinding(UIElement.OpacityProperty, new Binding("NewContentOpacity")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			}
		}

		private void ClearBindings()
		{
			if (oldContent != null)
			{
				oldContent.ClearValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty);
			}
			if (newContent != null)
			{
				newContent.ClearValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty);
			}
		}

		private void InitTransform()
		{
			if (oldContent != null && !(oldContent.RenderTransform is TranslateTransform))
			{
				oldContent.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform();
			}
			if (newContent != null && !(newContent.RenderTransform is TranslateTransform))
			{
				newContent.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform();
			}
		}

		private void ResetTransform()
		{
			if (animationType == AnimationType.SlideHorizontal)
			{
				NewContentTranslateX = ((animationDirection == SelectorAnimationDirection.Back) ? 1 : (-1));
				NewContentTranslateY = 0.0;
			}
			if (animationType == AnimationType.SlideVertical)
			{
				NewContentTranslateY = ((animationDirection == SelectorAnimationDirection.Back) ? 1 : (-1));
				NewContentTranslateX = 0.0;
			}
			double oldContentTranslateX = (OldContentTranslateY = 0.0);
			OldContentTranslateX = oldContentTranslateX;
		}

		private void UpdateTransform()
		{
			InitTransform();
			OnOldContentTranslateXChanged();
			OnOldContentTranslateYChanged();
			OnNewContentTranslateXChanged();
			OnNewContentTranslateYChanged();
		}

		private void OnOldContentTranslateXChanged()
		{
			if (oldContent != null && oldContent.RenderTransform is TranslateTransform)
			{
				((TranslateTransform)oldContent.RenderTransform).X = OldContentTranslateX * owner.ActualWidth;
			}
		}

		private void OnNewContentTranslateXChanged()
		{
			if (newContent != null && newContent.RenderTransform is TranslateTransform)
			{
				((TranslateTransform)newContent.RenderTransform).X = NewContentTranslateX * owner.ActualWidth;
			}
		}

		private void OnOldContentTranslateYChanged()
		{
			if (oldContent != null && oldContent.RenderTransform is TranslateTransform)
			{
				((TranslateTransform)oldContent.RenderTransform).Y = OldContentTranslateY * owner.ActualHeight;
			}
		}

		private void OnNewContentTranslateYChanged()
		{
			if (newContent != null && newContent.RenderTransform is TranslateTransform)
			{
				((TranslateTransform)newContent.RenderTransform).Y = NewContentTranslateY * owner.ActualHeight;
			}
		}

		private double ValidateAnimationSpeedRatio(double animationSpeedRatio)
		{
			if (double.IsInfinity(animationSpeedRatio) || double.IsNaN(animationSpeedRatio) || animationSpeedRatio <= 0.0)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return animationSpeedRatio;
		}

		private void SetCurrentStoryboard()
		{
			if (CurrentStoryboard != null)
			{
				CurrentStoryboard.Completed -= CurrentStoryboardCompleted;
			}
			if (animationType == AnimationType.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			Storyboard storyboard = null;
			if (Storyboards == null || Storyboards.Count == 0 || animationType == AnimationType.Fade)
			{
				storyboard = DefaultStoryboard;
			}
			if (animationType == AnimationType.SlideHorizontal)
			{
				storyboard = Storyboards.Where((Storyboard sb) => GetStoryboardName(sb) == ((animationDirection == SelectorAnimationDirection.Forward) ? "FromLeft" : "FromRight")).Single();
			}
			if (animationType == AnimationType.SlideVertical)
			{
				storyboard = Storyboards.Where((Storyboard sb) => GetStoryboardName(sb) == ((animationDirection == SelectorAnimationDirection.Forward) ? "FromTop" : "FromBottom")).Single();
			}
			if (storyboard != null)
			{
				storyboard = storyboard.Clone();
				if (!DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertyAssigned((DependencyObject)storyboard, Timeline.DurationProperty))
				{
					storyboard.SpeedRatio = ValidateAnimationSpeedRatio(animationSpeedRatio);
				}
				CurrentStoryboard = storyboard;
			}
			Storyboard.SetTarget(CurrentStoryboard, this);
			CurrentStoryboard.Completed += CurrentStoryboardCompleted;
		}
	}
	internal class AnimationLayer
	{
		public FrameworkElement Target { get; }

		public Queue<AnimationStoryboard> Storyboards { get; }

		public AnimationLayer(FrameworkElement target)
		{
			Target = target;
			Storyboards = new Queue<AnimationStoryboard>();
		}

		public AnimationStoryboard CreateStoryboard()
		{
			return new AnimationStoryboard(this);
		}

		public void CompleteStoryboard()
		{
			SetupStoryboard()?.Complete();
		}

		public void StopStoryboard()
		{
			SetupStoryboard()?.Stop();
		}

		private AnimationStoryboard SetupStoryboard()
		{
			if (Storyboards.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AnimationStoryboard animationStoryboard = Storyboards.Dequeue();
			Storyboards.Clear();
			Storyboards.Enqueue(animationStoryboard);
			return animationStoryboard;
		}
	}
	internal class AnimationStoryboard
	{
		private readonly AnimationLayer layer;

		private Queue<AnimationStoryboard> Storyboards => layer.Storyboards;

		private FrameworkElement Target => layer.Target;

		private Storyboard Storyboard { get; }

		private bool ShouldComplete
		{
			get
			{
				double? currentProgress = Storyboard.GetCurrentProgress(Target);
				if (currentProgress.HasValue)
				{
					return Math.Abs(currentProgress.Value - 1.0) < double.Epsilon;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public AnimationStoryboard(AnimationLayer layer)
		{
			this.layer = layer;
			Storyboard = new Storyboard();
		}

		public void Start()
		{
			Storyboard.Completed += OnCompleted;
			Storyboards.Enqueue(this);
			if (Storyboards.Count == 1)
			{
				BeginCore();
			}
		}

		public void Stop()
		{
			if (Storyboards.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ShouldComplete)
			{
				Storyboards.Dequeue();
				if (Storyboards.Count == 1)
				{
					Storyboards.Peek().BeginCore();
				}
				return;
			}
			Storyboards.Dequeue();
			if (Storyboards.Count == 1)
			{
				Storyboard.Stop(Target);
				Storyboard.Completed -= OnCompleted;
			}
		}

		public void Complete()
		{
			if (Storyboards.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ShouldComplete)
			{
				Storyboards.Dequeue();
				if (Storyboards.Count == 1)
				{
					Storyboards.Peek().BeginCore();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Storyboard.SetSpeedRatio(Target, 2.0);
			}
		}

		public void AnimateGradientColor(string targetName, System.Windows.Media.Color to, TimeSpan beginTime, TimeSpan duration)
		{
			AddAnimation(CreateColorAnimation(to, beginTime, duration), targetName, GradientStop.ColorProperty);
		}

		public void AnimateGradientOffset(string targetName, double to, TimeSpan beginTime, TimeSpan duration)
		{
			AddAnimation(CreateDoubleAnimation(to, beginTime, duration), targetName, GradientStop.OffsetProperty);
		}

		private DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames CreateDoubleAnimation(double to, TimeSpan beginTime, TimeSpan duration)
		{
			DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames = new DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames();
			doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames.KeyFrames.Add(new LinearDoubleKeyFrame(to, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(duration)));
			doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames.BeginTime = beginTime;
			doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames.Duration = new Duration(duration);
			return doubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames;
		}

		private ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames CreateColorAnimation(System.Windows.Media.Color to, TimeSpan beginTime, TimeSpan duration)
		{
			ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames colorAnimationUsingKeyFrames = new ColorAnimationUsingKeyFrames();
			colorAnimationUsingKeyFrames.KeyFrames.Add(new LinearColorKeyFrame(to, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(duration)));
			colorAnimationUsingKeyFrames.BeginTime = beginTime;
			colorAnimationUsingKeyFrames.Duration = new Duration(duration);
			return colorAnimationUsingKeyFrames;
		}

		private void AddAnimation(Timeline currentAnimation, string targetName, DependencyProperty property)
		{
			Storyboard.Children.Add(currentAnimation);
			Storyboard.SetTargetName(currentAnimation, targetName);
			Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(currentAnimation, new PropertyPath(property));
		}

		private void OnCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Storyboards.Count != 0)
			{
				Storyboards.Dequeue();
				if (Storyboards.Count == 1)
				{
					Storyboards.Peek().BeginCore();
				}
			}
		}

		private void BeginCore()
		{
			Storyboard.Begin(Target, HandoffBehavior.SnapshotAndReplace, isControllable: true);
		}
	}
	internal class DefaultRevealHighlightOptions
	{
		private static TimeSpan pressedAnimationDuration = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0, 1);

		private static Thickness borderThickness = new Thickness(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0);

		public static TimeSpan PressedAnimationDuration => pressedAnimationDuration;

		public static Thickness BorderThickness => borderThickness;

		public static double HoverRadius => 200.0;

		public static double BorderRadius => 75.0;
	}
	internal class DefaultRevealHighlightPallete
	{
		private static System.Windows.Media.Color hoverBackground = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(48, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue);

		private static System.Windows.Media.Color hoverBorder = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(69, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue, byte.MaxValue);

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color HoverBackground => hoverBackground;

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color HoverBorder => hoverBorder;
	}
	internal class MouseHitInfo
	{
		private int primaryIndex;

		private bool isMouseOver;

		public System.Windows.Point AbsolutePosition { get; }

		public List<RevealHighlightBehavior> Behaviors { get; }

		public RevealHighlightBehavior PrimaryBehavior
		{
			get
			{
				if (primaryIndex < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Behaviors[primaryIndex];
			}
		}

		public static MouseHitInfo Create(UIElement panel, IList<RevealHighlightBehavior> childBehaviors)
		{
			if (childBehaviors == null || childBehaviors.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PresentationSource activeSource = Mouse.PrimaryDevice.ActiveSource;
			if (activeSource == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(activeSource.RootVisual is UIElement relativeTo))
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Windows.Point position = Mouse.GetPosition(panel);
			MouseHitInfo mouseHitInfo = new MouseHitInfo(Mouse.GetPosition(relativeTo));
			Rect revealRect = CreateRectByRing(position, panel.RenderSize, DefaultRevealHighlightOptions.BorderRadius);
			mouseHitInfo.CalculateProperties(panel, childBehaviors, position, revealRect);
			return mouseHitInfo;
		}

		public static Rect CreateRectByRing(System.Windows.Point center, System.Windows.Size size, double radius)
		{
			double num = center.X - radius;
			double num2 = center.Y - radius;
			double num3 = center.X + radius;
			double num4 = center.Y + radius;
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			if (num3 > size.Width)
			{
				num3 -= num3 - size.Width;
			}
			if (num2 < 0.0)
			{
				num2 = 0.0;
			}
			if (num4 > size.Height)
			{
				num4 -= num4 - size.Height;
			}
			return new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(num, num2), new System.Windows.Point(num3, num4));
		}

		public MouseHitInfo(System.Windows.Point absolutePosition)
		{
			AbsolutePosition = absolutePosition;
			Behaviors = new List<RevealHighlightBehavior>();
			primaryIndex = -1;
		}

		public void CalculateProperties(UIElement panel, IEnumerable<RevealHighlightBehavior> childBehaviors, System.Windows.Point panelMousePosition, Rect revealRect)
		{
			foreach (RevealHighlightBehavior childBehavior in childBehaviors)
			{
				FrameworkElement associatedObject = childBehavior.AssociatedObject;
				if (IsVisible(associatedObject) && GetBehaviorRect(panel, associatedObject).IntersectsWith(revealRect))
				{
					Behaviors.Add(childBehavior);
					if (IsMouseOver(panel, associatedObject, panelMousePosition))
					{
						primaryIndex = Behaviors.Count - 1;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual Rect GetBehaviorRect(UIElement panel, UIElement child)
		{
			return new Rect(child.TranslatePoint(default(System.Windows.Point), panel), child.RenderSize);
		}

		public virtual bool IsVisible(UIElement target)
		{
			if (target != null && target.IsHitTestVisible && target.IsVisible)
			{
				return target.Opacity != 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsMouseOver(UIElement panel, FrameworkElement childObject, System.Windows.Point hitPoint)
		{
			isMouseOver = false;
			VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(panel, (DependencyObject o) => FilterCallback(o, childObject), (HitTestResult r) => HitTestResultBehavior.Continue, new PointHitTestParameters(hitPoint));
			return isMouseOver;
		}

		private HitTestFilterBehavior FilterCallback(DependencyObject target, FrameworkElement childObject)
		{
			if (!(target is UIElement { Visibility: not Visibility.Collapsed } uIElement))
			{
				return HitTestFilterBehavior.ContinueSkipSelfAndChildren;
			}
			if (uIElement == childObject)
			{
				isMouseOver = true;
				return HitTestFilterBehavior.Stop;
			}
			return HitTestFilterBehavior.Continue;
		}
	}
	internal class RevealHighlightBehavior : DependencyObject
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty InstanceProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AssociatedBorderThicknessProperty;

		private RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel behaviorsPanel;

		private FrameworkElement associatedObject;

		private RevealHighlightEffectMode mode;

		private DispatcherOperation modeChangedOperation;

		public FrameworkElement AssociatedObject => associatedObject;

		public RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel BehaviorsPanel => behaviorsPanel;

		public RevealHighlightEffectMode Mode
		{
			get
			{
				return mode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (mode != value)
				{
					mode = value;
					OnModeChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color BorderColor { get; set; }

		public System.Windows.Media.Color BackgroundColor { get; set; }

		public Thickness? BorderThickness { get; set; }

		public RevealHighlightEffect Effect { get; set; }

		public FrameworkElement HighlightBorder { get; set; }

		public AnimationLayer AnimationLayer { get; set; }

		public CornerRadius CornerRadius
		{
			get
			{
				if (associatedObject is Border)
				{
					return ((Border)associatedObject).CornerRadius;
				}
				return default(CornerRadius);
			}
		}

		public Thickness AssociatedBorderThickness => (Thickness)GetValue(AssociatedBorderThicknessProperty);

		public Thickness ActualBorderThickness
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Mode.HasFlag(RevealHighlightEffectMode.Border))
				{
					return default(Thickness);
				}
				if (BorderThickness.HasValue)
				{
					return BorderThickness.Value;
				}
				if (associatedObject.ReadLocalValue(Border.BorderThicknessProperty) != DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
				{
					return AssociatedBorderThickness;
				}
				return RevealHighlightOptions.GetBorderThickness(associatedObject);
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color ActualBackgroundColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (Mode.HasFlag(RevealHighlightEffectMode.Background))
				{
					return RevealHighlightOptions.GetBackgroundColor(associatedObject);
				}
				return default(System.Windows.Media.Color);
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color ActualBorderColor
		{
			get
			{
				if (Mode.HasFlag(RevealHighlightEffectMode.Border))
				{
					return RevealHighlightOptions.GetBorderColor(associatedObject);
				}
				return default(System.Windows.Media.Color);
			}
		}

		static RevealHighlightBehavior()
		{
			InstanceProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Instance", typeof(RevealHighlightBehavior), typeof(RevealHighlightBehavior), new PropertyMetadata((object)null));
			AssociatedBorderThicknessProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AssociatedBorderThickness", typeof(Thickness), typeof(RevealHighlightBehavior));
		}

		public static void SetInstance(DependencyObject element, RevealHighlightBehavior value)
		{
			element.SetValue(InstanceProperty, value);
		}

		public static RevealHighlightBehavior GetInstance(DependencyObject element)
		{
			return (RevealHighlightBehavior)element.GetValue(InstanceProperty);
		}

		public static RevealHighlightBehavior GetOrCreateBehavior(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			RevealHighlightBehavior instance = GetInstance(obj);
			if (instance != null)
			{
				return instance;
			}
			instance = new RevealHighlightBehavior(obj as FrameworkElement, RevealHighlightEffectMode.Disabled);
			SetInstance(obj, instance);
			return instance;
		}

		public RevealHighlightBehavior(FrameworkElement associatedObject, RevealHighlightEffectMode mode)
		{
			this.associatedObject = associatedObject;
			this.mode = mode;
			SetBindings();
			this.associatedObject.Loaded += OnLoadedAssociatedObject;
			this.associatedObject.Unloaded += OnUnloadedAssociatedObject;
		}

		public bool CreateEffect(System.Windows.Point mousePosition, bool shouldCreateBackground)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color actualBackgroundColor = ActualBackgroundColor;
			System.Windows.Media.Color actualBorderColor = ActualBorderColor;
			bool flag = actualBackgroundColor != default(System.Windows.Media.Color) && shouldCreateBackground;
			bool flag2 = actualBorderColor != default(System.Windows.Media.Color);
			if (!flag2 && !flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Effect == null)
			{
				Effect = new RevealHighlightEffect();
			}
			double scaleX = ScreenHelper.GetScaleX((Visual)associatedObject);
			System.Windows.Point point = associatedObject.TranslatePoint(default(System.Windows.Point), Window.GetWindow(associatedObject));
			System.Windows.Size renderSize = associatedObject.RenderSize;
			Thickness actualBorderThickness = ActualBorderThickness;
			CornerRadius cornerRadius = CornerRadius;
			HighlightBorder = CreateBackgroundBorder(flag, actualBackgroundColor, renderSize, actualBorderThickness, cornerRadius);
			Effect.MousePosition = new System.Windows.Point(mousePosition.X * scaleX, mousePosition.Y * scaleX);
			Effect.HoverRadius = DefaultRevealHighlightOptions.HoverRadius;
			Effect.BackgroundBrush = CreateVisualBrush(HighlightBorder);
			Effect.BorderBrush = CreateVisualBrush(CreateBorderBrushBorder(flag2, actualBorderColor, renderSize, actualBorderThickness, cornerRadius));
			Effect.MaskBorder = CreateVisualBrush(CreateMaskBorder(renderSize, actualBorderThickness, cornerRadius));
			Effect.InputTopLeft = new System.Windows.Point(point.X * scaleX, point.Y * scaleX);
			Effect.InputSize = new System.Windows.Size(associatedObject.ActualWidth * scaleX, associatedObject.ActualHeight * scaleX);
			Effect.BorderRadius = DefaultRevealHighlightOptions.BorderRadius;
			AssociatedObject.Effect = Effect;
			AnimationLayer = (flag ? new AnimationLayer(HighlightBorder) : null);
			return true;
		}

		public void ClearEffect()
		{
			AssociatedObject.Effect = null;
		}

		public void CreateAnimation()
		{
			if (AnimationLayer != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Color backgroundColor = RevealHighlightOptions.GetBackgroundColor(associatedObject);
				int num = backgroundColor.A / 4;
				int num2 = backgroundColor.A / 6;
				int num3 = 4;
				System.Windows.Media.Color to = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb((byte)(backgroundColor.A + num * num3), backgroundColor.R, backgroundColor.G, backgroundColor.B);
				System.Windows.Media.Color to2 = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb((byte)(backgroundColor.A + num2 * num3), backgroundColor.R, backgroundColor.G, backgroundColor.B);
				TimeSpan pressedAnimationDuration = DefaultRevealHighlightOptions.PressedAnimationDuration;
				AnimationLayer.StopStoryboard();
				AnimationStoryboard animationStoryboard = AnimationLayer.CreateStoryboard();
				TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(pressedAnimationDuration.TotalMilliseconds / (double)num3);
				TimeSpan zero = TimeSpan.Zero;
				string targetName = CreateStopName(0);
				string targetName2 = CreateStopName(1);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientColor(targetName, to, zero, TimeSpan.Zero);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientOffset(targetName, 0.15, zero, TimeSpan.Zero);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientColor(targetName2, to2, zero, TimeSpan.Zero);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientOffset(targetName2, 0.2, zero, TimeSpan.Zero);
				zero += timeSpan;
				to.A = (byte)(to.A - num);
				to2.A = (byte)(to2.A - num2);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientColor(targetName, to, zero, timeSpan);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientOffset(targetName, 0.4, zero, timeSpan);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientColor(targetName2, to2, zero, timeSpan);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientOffset(targetName2, 0.45, zero, timeSpan);
				zero += timeSpan;
				to.A = (byte)(to.A - num);
				to2.A = (byte)(to2.A - num2);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientColor(targetName, to, zero, timeSpan);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientOffset(targetName, 0.6, zero, timeSpan);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientColor(targetName2, to2, zero, timeSpan);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientOffset(targetName2, 0.65, zero, timeSpan);
				zero += timeSpan;
				to.A = (byte)(to.A - num);
				to2.A = (byte)(to2.A - num2);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientColor(targetName, to, zero, timeSpan);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientOffset(targetName, 0.8, zero, timeSpan);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientColor(targetName2, to2, zero, timeSpan);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientOffset(targetName2, 0.85, zero, timeSpan);
				zero += timeSpan;
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientColor(targetName, backgroundColor, zero, timeSpan);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientOffset(targetName, 1.0, zero, timeSpan);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientColor(targetName2, backgroundColor, zero, timeSpan);
				animationStoryboard.AnimateGradientOffset(targetName2, 1.0, zero, timeSpan);
				animationStoryboard.Start();
			}
		}

		public void CompleteAnimation()
		{
			if (AnimationLayer != null)
			{
				AnimationLayer.CompleteStoryboard();
			}
		}

		public void StopAnimation()
		{
			if (AnimationLayer != null)
			{
				AnimationLayer.StopStoryboard();
			}
		}

		private void OnModeChanged()
		{
			modeChangedOperation?.Abort();
			modeChangedOperation = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				FindBehaviorsPanel();
				if (behaviorsPanel != null)
				{
					behaviorsPanel.OnModeChanged(this);
				}
				modeChangedOperation = null;
			}, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}

		private Border CreateBackgroundBorder(bool hasBackground, System.Windows.Media.Color color, System.Windows.Size size, Thickness thickness, CornerRadius cornerRadius)
		{
			Border border = CreateBorder(size, thickness, cornerRadius);
			border.Background = (hasBackground ? CreateGradientBackgroundBrush(border, color, 0.0, 0.2, 1.0) : System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent);
			return border;
		}

		private Border CreateBorderBrushBorder(bool hasBorderBrush, System.Windows.Media.Color color, System.Windows.Size size, Thickness thickness, CornerRadius cornerRadius)
		{
			Border border = CreateBorder(size, thickness, cornerRadius);
			border.BorderBrush = (hasBorderBrush ? CreateGradientBorderBrush(color) : System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent);
			border.Background = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
			return border;
		}

		private Border CreateMaskBorder(System.Windows.Size size, Thickness thickness, CornerRadius cornerRadius)
		{
			Border border = CreateBorder(size, thickness, cornerRadius);
			border.BorderBrush = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White;
			return border;
		}

		private string CreateStopName(int index)
		{
			return $"stop{index}";
		}

		private Border CreateBorder(System.Windows.Size size, Thickness thickness, CornerRadius cornerRadius)
		{
			Border border = new Border
			{
				OverridesDefaultStyle = true,
				Style = null
			};
			NameScope.SetNameScope(border, new NameScope());
			border.Width = size.Width;
			border.Height = size.Height;
			border.BorderThickness = thickness;
			border.CornerRadius = cornerRadius;
			return border;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateGradientBorderBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			RadialGradientBrush radialGradientBrush = new RadialGradientBrush();
			radialGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Colors.Transparent, 0.0));
			radialGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(color, 1.0));
			return radialGradientBrush;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateGradientBackgroundBrush(FrameworkElement element, System.Windows.Media.Color color, params double[] offsets)
		{
			RadialGradientBrush radialGradientBrush = new RadialGradientBrush();
			GradientStopCollection gradientStops = radialGradientBrush.GradientStops;
			for (int i = 0; i < offsets.Length; i++)
			{
				GradientStop gradientStop = new GradientStop(color, offsets[i]);
				gradientStops.Add(gradientStop);
				element.RegisterName(CreateStopName(i), gradientStop);
			}
			return radialGradientBrush;
		}

		private VisualBrush CreateVisualBrush(Visual visual)
		{
			VisualBrush visualBrush = new VisualBrush(visual);
			visualBrush.AutoLayoutContent = true;
			return visualBrush;
		}

		private void SetBindings()
		{
			if (associatedObject is Border)
			{
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, AssociatedBorderThicknessProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath(Border.BorderThicknessProperty),
					Source = associatedObject
				});
			}
			else if (associatedObject is Control)
			{
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, AssociatedBorderThicknessProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath(Control.BorderThicknessProperty),
					Source = associatedObject
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnLoadedAssociatedObject(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (mode != RevealHighlightEffectMode.Disabled)
			{
				if (AssociatedObject is Border { Background: null } border && !BindingOperations.IsDataBound(border, Border.BackgroundProperty))
				{
					border.SetCurrentValue(Border.BackgroundProperty, System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent);
				}
				FindBehaviorsPanel();
				if (behaviorsPanel != null)
				{
					behaviorsPanel.OnLoadedAssociatedObject(this);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnUnloadedAssociatedObject(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (behaviorsPanel != null)
			{
				behaviorsPanel.OnUnloadedAssociatedObject(this);
			}
		}

		private void FindBehaviorsPanel()
		{
			if (behaviorsPanel == null)
			{
				behaviorsPanel = RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel.FindOrCreate(associatedObject);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel : DependencyObject
	{
		private static readonly DependencyProperty InstanceProperty;

		private readonly UIElement panelObject;

		private readonly List<RevealHighlightBehavior> items;

		private bool isEnabled;

		public bool IsEnabled => isEnabled;

		public List<RevealHighlightBehavior> Items => items;

		public MouseHitInfo CachedHitInfo { get; set; }

		static RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel()
		{
			InstanceProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Instance", typeof(RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel), typeof(RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel));
		}

		private static void SetInstance(DependencyObject element, RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel value)
		{
			element.SetValue(InstanceProperty, value);
		}

		private static RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel GetInstance(DependencyObject element)
		{
			return (RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel)element.GetValue(InstanceProperty);
		}

		public static RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel FindOrCreate(UIElement obj)
		{
			UIElement uIElement = null;
			while (obj != null)
			{
				obj = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(obj) as UIElement;
				if (obj != null)
				{
					uIElement = obj;
					RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel instance = GetInstance(obj);
					if (instance != null)
					{
						return instance;
					}
				}
			}
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				UIElement element = uIElement;
				RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel instance = new RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel(element);
				SetInstance(element, instance);
				return instance;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal RevealHighlightBehaviorsPanel(UIElement panelObject)
		{
			this.panelObject = panelObject;
			items = new List<RevealHighlightBehavior>();
		}

		public void CalculateEffects(MouseHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (CachedHitInfo == null && hitInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (CachedHitInfo == null)
			{
				CachedHitInfo = hitInfo;
				{
					foreach (RevealHighlightBehavior behavior in hitInfo.Behaviors)
					{
						behavior.CreateEffect(hitInfo.AbsolutePosition, behavior == hitInfo.PrimaryBehavior);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (hitInfo == null)
			{
				ClearEffectCore();
				CachedHitInfo = null;
			}
			else
			{
				if (IsEquals(hitInfo, CachedHitInfo))
				{
					return;
				}
				ClearEffectCore();
				foreach (RevealHighlightBehavior behavior2 in hitInfo.Behaviors)
				{
					if (!behavior2.CreateEffect(hitInfo.AbsolutePosition, behavior2 == hitInfo.PrimaryBehavior))
					{
						behavior2.ClearEffect();
					}
				}
				CachedHitInfo = hitInfo;
			}
		}

		public void OnLoadedAssociatedObject(RevealHighlightBehavior behavior)
		{
			RegisterItem(behavior);
		}

		public void OnUnloadedAssociatedObject(RevealHighlightBehavior behavior)
		{
			StopAnimation();
			UnregisterItem(behavior);
		}

		public void OnModeChanged(RevealHighlightBehavior behavior)
		{
			if (behavior.Mode != RevealHighlightEffectMode.Disabled)
			{
				if (!items.Contains(behavior))
				{
					RegisterItem(behavior);
				}
			}
			else if (items.Contains(behavior))
			{
				UnregisterItem(behavior);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateEffects()
		{
			CalculateEffects(CreateHitInfo());
		}

		private void CreateAnimation()
		{
			if (CachedHitInfo != null && CachedHitInfo.PrimaryBehavior != null)
			{
				CachedHitInfo.PrimaryBehavior.CreateAnimation();
			}
		}

		private void CompleteAnimation()
		{
			if (CachedHitInfo != null && CachedHitInfo.PrimaryBehavior != null)
			{
				CachedHitInfo.PrimaryBehavior.CompleteAnimation();
			}
		}

		private void StopAnimation()
		{
			if (CachedHitInfo != null && CachedHitInfo.PrimaryBehavior != null)
			{
				CachedHitInfo.PrimaryBehavior.StopAnimation();
			}
		}

		private void ClearEffects()
		{
			if (CachedHitInfo != null)
			{
				ClearEffectCore();
				CachedHitInfo = null;
			}
		}

		private void RegisterItem(RevealHighlightBehavior item)
		{
			items.Add(item);
			if (!isEnabled)
			{
				isEnabled = true;
				panelObject.PreviewMouseMove += OnMouseMove;
				panelObject.PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown += OnMouseLeftButtonDown;
				panelObject.MouseLeave += OnMouseLeave;
				panelObject.PreviewMouseUp += OnMouseUp;
			}
		}

		private void UnregisterItem(RevealHighlightBehavior item)
		{
			items.Remove(item);
			if (isEnabled && items.Count == 0)
			{
				isEnabled = false;
				panelObject.PreviewMouseMove -= OnMouseMove;
				panelObject.PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown -= OnMouseLeftButtonDown;
				panelObject.MouseLeave -= OnMouseLeave;
				panelObject.PreviewMouseUp -= OnMouseUp;
			}
		}

		private void ClearEffectCore()
		{
			foreach (RevealHighlightBehavior behavior in CachedHitInfo.Behaviors)
			{
				behavior.ClearEffect();
			}
		}

		private MouseHitInfo CreateHitInfo()
		{
			return MouseHitInfo.Create(panelObject, items);
		}

		private bool IsEquals(MouseHitInfo left, MouseHitInfo right)
		{
			if (left.AbsolutePosition != right.AbsolutePosition)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = left.Behaviors.Count;
			if (count != right.Behaviors.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (left.Behaviors[i].AssociatedObject != right.Behaviors[i].AssociatedObject)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void OnMouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			CalculateEffects();
		}

		private void OnMouseLeave(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			ClearEffects();
		}

		private void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			CreateAnimation();
		}

		private void OnMouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			CompleteAnimation();
		}
	}

			InputProperty = ShaderEffect.RegisterPixelShaderSamplerProperty("Input", typeof(RevealHighlightEffect), 0);
			BackgroundBrushProperty = ShaderEffect.RegisterPixelShaderSamplerProperty("BackgroundBrush", typeof(RevealHighlightEffect), 1);
			BorderBrushProperty = ShaderEffect.RegisterPixelShaderSamplerProperty("BorderBrush", typeof(RevealHighlightEffect), 2);

		}

	[ValueConversion(typeof(Orientation), typeof(Orientation))]
	public class OrientationInvertConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if ((Orientation)value == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return Orientation.Vertical;
			}
			return Orientation.Horizontal;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	public class OrientationToVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return ((Orientation)value != Orientation.Horizontal) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
		}
	}
	public class DoubleToThicknessConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is double))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return new Thickness((double)value);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	public class FlipPanel : VirtualizingScrollPanel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ItemCacheModeProperty;

		private TranslateTransform translateTransform = new TranslateTransform();

		private bool forceCleanUp;

		public ItemCacheMode ItemCacheMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (ItemCacheMode)GetValue(ItemCacheModeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ItemCacheModeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private bool IsHorizontal => base.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;

		internal bool IsManipulated { get; set; }

		protected override double LineSizeHorizontal => 0.0;

		static FlipPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FlipPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FlipPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ItemCacheMode", ref ItemCacheModeProperty, ItemCacheMode.None, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FlipPanel)d).OnViewCacheModeChanged((ItemCacheMode)e.OldValue, (ItemCacheMode)e.NewValue);
			});
		}

		public FlipPanel()
		{
			base.RenderTransform = translateTransform;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size CalculateExtent(System.Windows.Size availableSize, int itemCount)
		{
			if (base.ItemSizeMode == DevExpress.Xpf.WindowsUI.ItemSizeMode.Auto)
			{
				double childrenDesiredLength = GetChildrenDesiredLength(base.Children.Count, base.Orientation);
				if (base.Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width * (double)itemCount, childrenDesiredLength);
				}
				return new System.Windows.Size(childrenDesiredLength, availableSize.Height * (double)itemCount);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width * (double)itemCount, availableSize.Height * (double)itemCount);
		}

		internal double GetChildrenDesiredLength(int lastIndex, Orientation orientation)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < lastIndex; i++)
			{
				num += GetChildDesiredLength(i, orientation);
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override bool CanUpdateScrollInfoOnMeasure(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (!IsHorizontal)
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height);
			}
			return !double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width);
		}

		internal int CalculateAfterManipulationSelectedIndex(double offset)
		{
			int result = SelectedIndex;
			double num = double.PositiveInfinity;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			bool flag = ManipulationIsRightToLeft(offset);
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					num2 += GetChildDesiredLength(i, base.Orientation);
				}
				double num3 = Math.Abs(offset - num2);
				if (num3 < num)
				{
					result = i;
					num = num3;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					num2 += GetChildDesiredLength(i, base.Orientation);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double GetChildDesiredLength(int index, Orientation orientation)
		{
			if (index >= base.Children.Count)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = base.Children[index];
			if (orientation != Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return uIElement.DesiredSize.Height;
			}
			return uIElement.DesiredSize.Width;
		}

		private bool ManipulationIsRightToLeft(double offset)
		{
			if (SelectedIndex != 0)
			{
				return offset > GetChildDesiredLength(SelectedIndex, base.Orientation);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void GetVisibleRange(System.Windows.Size size, out int firstItemIndex, out int lastItemIndex)
		{
			ItemsControl itemsOwner = ItemsControl.GetItemsOwner(this);
			int count = itemsOwner.Items.Count;
			if (ItemCacheMode == ItemCacheMode.CacheAll || base.NeedMeasureEveryChild)
			{
				firstItemIndex = 0;
				lastItemIndex = count - 1;
				return;
			}
			double num;
			double num2;
			if (base.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				num = size.Width;
				num2 = base.HorizontalOffset;
				lastItemIndex = (int)Math.Ceiling((num2 + base.ViewportWidth) / num) - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				num = size.Height;
				num2 = base.VerticalOffset;
				lastItemIndex = (int)Math.Ceiling((num2 + base.ViewportHeight) / num) - 1;
			}
			firstItemIndex = (int)Math.Floor(num2 / num);
			if (lastItemIndex >= count)
			{
				lastItemIndex = count - 1;
			}
		}

		private void CleanUpAllItems()
		{
			forceCleanUp = true;
			CleanUpItems(base.Children.Count - 1, 0);
			forceCleanUp = false;
		}

		protected override void CleanUpItems(int minDesiredGenerated, int maxDesiredGenerated)
		{
			if (ItemCacheMode == ItemCacheMode.None || forceCleanUp)
			{
				base.CleanUpItems(minDesiredGenerated, maxDesiredGenerated);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnViewCacheModeChanged(ItemCacheMode oldValue, ItemCacheMode newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue == ItemCacheMode.CacheAll || base.NeedMeasureEveryChild)
			{
				CleanUpAllItems();
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected override void OnItemSizeModeChanged(DevExpress.Xpf.WindowsUI.ItemSizeMode oldValue, DevExpress.Xpf.WindowsUI.ItemSizeMode newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue == DevExpress.Xpf.WindowsUI.ItemSizeMode.Auto)
			{
				CleanUpAllItems();
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected override void ArrangeChild(int itemIndex, UIElement child, System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (base.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				child.Arrange(new Rect((double)itemIndex * finalSize.Width, base.VerticalOffset, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height));
			}
			else
			{
				child.Arrange(new Rect(base.HorizontalOffset, (double)itemIndex * finalSize.Height, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height));
			}
		}

		protected override double CalculateOffset(double extent, double viewport, double desiredOffset)
		{
			if (desiredOffset < 0.0 || viewport >= extent)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (base.ItemSizeMode == DevExpress.Xpf.WindowsUI.ItemSizeMode.Auto)
			{
				if (IsManipulated && ManipulationIsRightToLeft(desiredOffset))
				{
					desiredOffset = CorrectOffset(desiredOffset, viewport);
				}
			}
			else if (desiredOffset + viewport >= extent)
			{
				desiredOffset = extent - viewport;
			}
			return desiredOffset;
		}

		private double CorrectOffset(double desiredOffset, double viewport)
		{
			double childrenDesiredLength = GetChildrenDesiredLength(base.Children.Count, base.Orientation);
			if (!(desiredOffset > childrenDesiredLength - viewport))
			{
				return desiredOffset;
			}
			return childrenDesiredLength - viewport;
		}

		protected override void OnHorizontalOffsetChanged(double offset)
		{
			if (base.ScrollOwner != null)
			{
				base.ScrollOwner.InvalidateScrollInfo();
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected override void OnVerticalOffsetChanged(double offset)
		{
			if (base.ScrollOwner != null)
			{
				base.ScrollOwner.InvalidateScrollInfo();
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected override Rect MakeVisibleCore(Rect rectangle)
		{
			int num = ((base.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? ((int)(rectangle.X / base.ViewportWidth)) : ((int)(rectangle.Y / base.ViewportHeight)));
			if (base.Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return new Rect(base.HorizontalOffset, (double)num * base.ViewportHeight, base.ViewportWidth, base.ViewportHeight);
			}
			return new Rect((double)num * base.ViewportWidth, base.VerticalOffset, base.ViewportWidth, base.ViewportHeight);
		}

		protected override void AfterArrange()
		{
			base.AfterArrange();
			translateTransform.X = 0.0 - GetScrollOffset().X;
			translateTransform.Y = 0.0 - GetScrollOffset().Y;
		}

		protected override Geometry GetLayoutClip(System.Windows.Size layoutSlotSize)
		{
			Geometry layoutClip = base.GetLayoutClip(layoutSlotSize);
			if (layoutClip == null)
			{
				return layoutClip;
			}
			Rect bounds = layoutClip.Bounds;
			if (base.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(0.0 - translateTransform.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Width, bounds.Height));
			}
			return new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(bounds.X, 0.0 - translateTransform.Y, bounds.Width, bounds.Height));
		}
	}

		static SlideViewScrollPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<SlideViewScrollPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<SlideViewScrollPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<UIElement>("Child", ref ChildProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SlideViewScrollPanel)(object)d).OnChildChanged((UIElement)e.OldValue, (UIElement)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Orientation", ref OrientationProperty, Orientation.Horizontal, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SlideViewScrollPanel)(object)d).OnOrientationChanged((Orientation)e.OldValue, (Orientation)e.NewValue);
			});
		}

		public SlideViewScrollPanel()
		{
			timer = new DispatcherTimer
			{
				Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.5)
			};
			timer.Tick += timer_Tick;
			timer.Start();
			((Controller)((ScrollControl)this).Controller).HorzScrollBar.Opacity = 0.0;
			((UIElement)this).MouseMove += SlideViewScrollPanel_MouseMove;
		}

		protected virtual void OnChildChanged(UIElement oldValue, UIElement newValue)
		{
			((Panel)this).Children.Remove(oldValue);
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				((Panel)this).Children.Add(newValue);
			}
		}

		protected virtual LayoutParametersBase CreateLayoutProviderParameters()
		{
			return new LayoutParametersBase(0.0);
		}

		protected virtual void OnOrientationChanged(Orientation oldValue, Orientation newValue)
		{
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				((ScrollControl)this).SetOffset(new System.Windows.Point(((ScrollControl)this).VerticalOffset * ((ScrollControl)this).ScrollAreaSize.Height / ((ScrollControl)this).ScrollAreaSize.Width, 0.0));
			}
			else
			{
				((ScrollControl)this).SetOffset(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, (((ScrollControl)this).ScrollAreaSize.Width == 0.0) ? 0.0 : (((ScrollControl)this).HorizontalOffset * ((ScrollControl)this).ScrollAreaSize.Height / ((ScrollControl)this).ScrollAreaSize.Width)));
			}
			((UIElement)this).InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnMeasure(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement item in (Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)((PanelBase)this).GetLogicalChildren(false))
			{
				if (!UIElementExtensions.GetVisible((UIElement)item))
				{
					item.Measure(availableSize);
				}
			}
			return LayoutProvider.Measure(((PanelBase)this).GetLogicalChildren(true), availableSize, CreateLayoutProviderParameters());
		}

		private void timer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			HideScrollBars();
			timer.Stop();
		}

		private void AnimateOpacity(UIElement control, double from, double to)
		{
			DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation
			{
				To = to,
				Duration = new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500.0))
			};
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			Storyboard.SetTarget(storyboard, control);
			Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation, new PropertyPath(UIElement.OpacityProperty));
			storyboard.Children.Add(doubleAnimation);
			storyboard.Begin();
		}

		private void ShowScrollBars()
		{
			if (((Controller)((ScrollControl)this).Controller).HorzScrollBar.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && ((Controller)((ScrollControl)this).Controller).HorzScrollBar.Opacity == 0.0)
			{
				AnimateOpacity(((Controller)((ScrollControl)this).Controller).HorzScrollBar, 0.0, 1.0);
			}
			if (((Controller)((ScrollControl)this).Controller).VertScrollBar.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && ((Controller)((ScrollControl)this).Controller).VertScrollBar.Opacity == 0.0)
			{
				AnimateOpacity(((Controller)((ScrollControl)this).Controller).VertScrollBar, 0.0, 1.0);
			}
		}

		private void HideScrollBars()
		{
			if (((Controller)((ScrollControl)this).Controller).HorzScrollBar.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				AnimateOpacity(((Controller)((ScrollControl)this).Controller).HorzScrollBar, 1.0, 0.0);
			}
			if (((Controller)((ScrollControl)this).Controller).VertScrollBar.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				AnimateOpacity(((Controller)((ScrollControl)this).Controller).VertScrollBar, 1.0, 0.0);
			}
		}

		private void SlideViewScrollPanel_MouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			timer.Stop();
			timer.Start();
			ShowScrollBars();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnArrange(Rect bounds)
		{
			ViewportBounds = bounds;
			if (((Controller)((ScrollControl)this).Controller).IsScrollable())
			{
				RectHelper.Offset(ref bounds, 0.0 - ((ScrollControl)this).HorizontalOffset, 0.0 - ((ScrollControl)this).VerticalOffset);
			}
			System.Windows.Size result = LayoutProvider.Arrange(((PanelBase)this).GetLogicalChildren(true), bounds, ViewportBounds, CreateLayoutProviderParameters());
			if (afterArrangeAction != null)
			{
				afterArrangeAction();
				afterArrangeAction = null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal void QueueArrangeAction(Action action)
		{
			afterArrangeAction = action;
		}

		protected override void OnOffsetChanged(bool isHorizontal, double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			((ScrollControl)this).OnOffsetChanged(isHorizontal, oldValue, newValue);
			QueueArrangeAction(delegate
			{
				RaiseScrollChanged();
			});
		}

		private void RaiseScrollChanged()
		{
			this.ScrollChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		protected virtual LayoutProviderBase CreateLayoutProvider()
		{
			return new SlideViewLayoutProvider(this);
		}

		protected override PanelControllerBase CreateController()
		{
			return (PanelControllerBase)(object)new SlideViewScrollPanelController(this);
		}
	}

		}

	public class LayoutParametersBase

		}
	}
	public abstract class LayoutProviderBase
	{
		private LayoutParametersBase _Parameters;

		protected LayoutParametersBase Parameters
		{
			get
			{
				return _Parameters;
			}
			private set
			{
				_Parameters = value;
				OnParametersChanged();
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Size Measure(FrameworkElements items, System.Windows.Size maxSize, LayoutParametersBase parameters)
		{
			Parameters = parameters;
			return OnMeasure(items, maxSize);

			Parameters = parameters;

			return new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Size OnArrange(FrameworkElements items, Rect bounds, Rect viewPortBounds)
