			return RectHelper.Size(bounds);
		}

		protected virtual void OnParametersChanged()
		{
		}
	}
	public class SlideViewLayoutProvider : LayoutProviderBase
	{
		public class SlideViewItemInfo
		{
			public SlideViewLayoutItemSize Size;

			public SlideViewLayoutItemPosition Position { get; private set; }

			public SlideViewItemInfo(SlideViewLayoutItemSize size, SlideViewLayoutItemPosition position)
			{
				Position = position;
				Size = size;
			}
		}

		public struct SlideViewLayoutItemPosition
		{
			public double LayerOffset;

			public double ItemOffset;

			public SlideViewLayoutItemPosition(double layerOffset, double itemOffset)
			{
				LayerOffset = layerOffset;
				ItemOffset = itemOffset;
			}
		}

		public struct SlideViewLayoutItemSize
		{
			public double Width;

			public double Length;

			public SlideViewLayoutItemSize(double width, double length)
			{
				Width = width;
				Length = length;
			}
		}

		protected delegate System.Windows.Size MeasureItem(FrameworkElement item);

		protected delegate void ArrangeItem(FrameworkElement item, SlideViewLayoutItemPosition itemPosition, SlideViewLayoutItemSize itemSize);

		protected List<SlideViewItemInfo> LayerInfos = new List<SlideViewItemInfo>();

		protected SlideViewScrollPanel Panel { get; set; }

		public virtual Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				if (Panel != null)
				{
					return Panel.Orientation;
				}
				return Orientation.Horizontal;
			}
		}

		public SlideViewLayoutProvider()
		{
		}

		public SlideViewLayoutProvider(SlideViewScrollPanel panel)
		{
			Panel = panel;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnArrange(FrameworkElements items, Rect bounds, Rect viewPortBounds)
		{
			CalculateLayout(items, bounds, (FrameworkElement item) => (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? new System.Windows.Size(UIElementExtensions.GetDesiredSize((UIElement)item).Width, bounds.Height) : new System.Windows.Size(bounds.Width, UIElementExtensions.GetDesiredSize((UIElement)item).Height), delegate(FrameworkElement item, SlideViewLayoutItemPosition itemPosition, SlideViewLayoutItemSize itemSize)
			{
				item.Arrange(GetItemBounds(itemPosition, itemSize));
			});
			return RectHelper.Size(bounds);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnMeasure(FrameworkElements items, System.Windows.Size maxSize)
		{
			CalculateLayout(items, RectHelper.New(maxSize), delegate(FrameworkElement item)
			{
				SlideViewLayoutItemSize itemSize3 = ((Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal) ? new SlideViewLayoutItemSize(maxSize.Width, double.PositiveInfinity) : new SlideViewLayoutItemSize(maxSize.Height, double.PositiveInfinity));
				System.Windows.Size itemSize4 = GetItemSize(itemSize3, maxSize);
				item.Measure(itemSize4);
				return UIElementExtensions.GetDesiredSize((UIElement)item);
			}, null);
			SlideViewLayoutItemSize itemSize = new SlideViewLayoutItemSize(0.0, 0.0);
			if (((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count != 0)
			{
				for (int num = 0; num < LayerInfos.Count; num++)
				{
					SlideViewItemInfo slideViewItemInfo = LayerInfos[num];
					if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
					{
						itemSize.Width += slideViewItemInfo.Size.Width;
						itemSize.Length = Math.Max(itemSize.Length, slideViewItemInfo.Size.Length);
					}
					else
					{
						itemSize.Length += slideViewItemInfo.Size.Length;
						itemSize.Width = Math.Max(itemSize.Width, slideViewItemInfo.Size.Width);
					}
				}
			}
			System.Windows.Size itemSize2 = GetItemSize(itemSize);
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				if (!double.IsInfinity(maxSize.Height))
				{
					itemSize2.Height = maxSize.Height;
				}
			}
			else if (!double.IsInfinity(maxSize.Width))
			{
				itemSize2.Width = maxSize.Width;
			}
			return itemSize2;
		}

		protected double GetLayerContentStart(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return bounds.Top;
			}
			return bounds.Left;
		}

		protected double GetLayerStart(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return bounds.Left;
			}
			return bounds.Top;
		}

		protected System.Windows.Size GetItemSize(SlideViewLayoutItemSize itemSize)
		{
			return RectHelper.Size(GetItemBounds(new SlideViewLayoutItemPosition(0.0, 0.0), itemSize));
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Size GetItemSize(SlideViewLayoutItemSize itemSize, System.Windows.Size maxSize)
		{
			return GetItemSize(itemSize);
		}

		protected void GetItemPositionAndSize(Rect itemBounds, out SlideViewLayoutItemPosition itemPosition, out SlideViewLayoutItemSize itemSize)
		{
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				itemPosition = new SlideViewLayoutItemPosition(itemBounds.Y, itemBounds.X);
				itemSize = new SlideViewLayoutItemSize(itemBounds.Height, itemBounds.Width);
			}
			else
			{
				itemPosition = new SlideViewLayoutItemPosition(itemBounds.X, itemBounds.Y);
				itemSize = new SlideViewLayoutItemSize(itemBounds.Width, itemBounds.Height);
			}
		}

		protected SlideViewLayoutItemSize GetItemSize(System.Windows.Size itemSize)
		{
			GetItemPositionAndSize(RectHelper.New(itemSize), out var _, out var itemSize2);
			return itemSize2;
		}

		protected Rect GetItemBounds(SlideViewLayoutItemPosition itemPosition, SlideViewLayoutItemSize itemSize)
		{
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return new Rect(itemPosition.ItemOffset, itemPosition.LayerOffset, itemSize.Length, itemSize.Width);
			}
			return new Rect(itemPosition.LayerOffset, itemPosition.ItemOffset, itemSize.Width, itemSize.Length);
		}

		protected virtual void CalculateLayout(FrameworkElements items, Rect bounds, MeasureItem measureItem, ArrangeItem arrangeItem)
		{
			double layerContentStart = GetLayerContentStart(bounds);
			SlideViewLayoutItemPosition slideViewLayoutItemPosition = new SlideViewLayoutItemPosition(GetLayerStart(bounds), layerContentStart);
			SlideViewItemInfo slideViewItemInfo = null;
			LayerInfos.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count; i++)
			{
				FrameworkElement item = ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[i];
				SlideViewLayoutItemSize itemSize = GetItemSize(measureItem(item));
				slideViewItemInfo = new SlideViewItemInfo(itemSize, slideViewLayoutItemPosition);
				LayerInfos.Add(slideViewItemInfo);
				arrangeItem?.Invoke(item, slideViewLayoutItemPosition, itemSize);
				slideViewLayoutItemPosition.ItemOffset += itemSize.Length + base.Parameters.ItemSpace;
			}
		}
	}
	internal interface IFlyoutServiceProvider : IFlyoutProvider
	{
		FlyoutService FlyoutService { get; }
	}
	internal interface IFlyoutProvider
	{
		FlyoutControl FlyoutControl { get; }

		FlyoutPlacement Placement { get; }

		IFlyoutEventListener FlyoutEventListener { get; set; }
	}
	internal interface IFlyoutEventListener
	{
		FlyoutBase Flyout { get; }

		void OnFlyoutClosed(bool onClickThrough);

		void OnFlyoutClosed();

		void OnFlyoutOpened();

		void OnMouseLeave();

		void OnMouseEnter();
	}
	internal class FlyoutManager
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty FlyoutManagerProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("FlyoutManager", typeof(FlyoutManager), typeof(FlyoutManager), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));

		private FrameworkElement Owner;

		private readonly WeakList<IFlyoutProvider> pendingProviders = new WeakList<IFlyoutProvider>();

		private FrameworkElement topElement;

		private Window windowCore;

		protected WeakReference applicationWr = new WeakReference(null);

		private Dictionary<IFlyoutProvider, IFlyoutEventListener> map = new Dictionary<IFlyoutProvider, IFlyoutEventListener>();

		protected internal FrameworkElement TopElement
		{
			get
			{
				return topElement;
			}
			set
			{
				if (TopElement != value)
				{
					if (TopElement != null)
					{
						Unsubscribe();
					}
					topElement = value;
					if (TopElement != null)
					{
						Subscribe();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal bool CloseOnTopElementMouseDown { get; set; }

		protected Window Window
		{
			get
			{
				if (windowCore == null)
				{
					windowCore = Window.GetWindow(TopElement);
				}
				return windowCore;
			}
		}

		public static FlyoutManager GetFlyoutManager(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (FlyoutManager)obj.GetValue(FlyoutManagerProperty);
		}

		public static void SetFlyoutManager(DependencyObject obj, FlyoutManager value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(FlyoutManagerProperty, value);
		}

		public FlyoutManager(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
			if (Owner.IsLoaded)
			{
				TopElement = LayoutHelper.FindRoot((DependencyObject)Owner, false) as FrameworkElement;
			}
			Owner.Loaded += OnOwnerLoaded;
			Owner.Unloaded += OnOwnerUnloaded;
			Owner.SizeChanged += OnOwnerSizeChanged;
			CloseOnTopElementMouseDown = true;
		}

		private void OnOwnerLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			TopElement = LayoutHelper.FindRoot((DependencyObject)Owner, false) as FrameworkElement;
		}

		private void OnOwnerUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			TopElement = null;
			windowCore = null;
		}

		private void Subscribe()
		{
			if (TopElement != null)
			{
				SubscribeTopElementEvents();
				SubscribeApplicationEvents();
				SubscribeWindowEvents();
			}
		}

		private void Unsubscribe()
		{
			if (TopElement != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeTopElementEvents();
				UnsubscribeApplicationEvents();
				UnsubscribeWindowEvents();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeApplicationEvents()
		{
			UnsubscribeApplicationEvents();
			if (Application.Current != null)
			{
				Application.Current.Deactivated += OnApplicationDeactivated;
				applicationWr = new WeakReference(Application.Current);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeApplicationEvents()
		{
			if (applicationWr.Target is Application application)
			{
				application.Deactivated -= OnApplicationDeactivated;
				applicationWr = new WeakReference(null);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeWindowEvents()
		{
			if (Window != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeWindowEvents();
				Window.Deactivated += OwnerWindowDeactivated;
				Window.LocationChanged += OwnerWindowLoactionChanged;
				Window.SizeChanged += OwnerWindowSizeChanged;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeWindowEvents()
		{
			if (Window != null)
			{
				Window.Deactivated -= OwnerWindowDeactivated;
				Window.LocationChanged -= OwnerWindowLoactionChanged;
				Window.SizeChanged -= OwnerWindowSizeChanged;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeTopElementEvents()
		{
			TopElement.AddHandler(UIElement.MouseDownEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(TopElementMouseDown), handledEventsToo: true);
		}

		private void UnsubscribeTopElementEvents()
		{
			TopElement.RemoveHandler(UIElement.MouseDownEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(TopElementMouseDown));
		}

		private void ConditionalClose(bool force = false)
		{
			if (CloseOnTopElementMouseDown || force)
			{
				CloseAll();
			}
		}

		private void OnOwnerSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ConditionalClose(force: true);
		}

		private void OnApplicationDeactivated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ConditionalClose(force: true);
		}

		private void OwnerWindowDeactivated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ConditionalClose();
		}

		private void OwnerWindowLoactionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ConditionalClose();
		}

		private void OwnerWindowSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ConditionalClose();
		}

		private void TopElementMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!CloseOnTopElementMouseDown)
			{
				return;
			}
			FlyoutBase flyout = FlyoutBase.GetFlyout(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject);
			foreach (IFlyoutProvider key in map.Keys)
			{
				if ((object)flyout == key.FlyoutControl || CheckFlyouts(flyout, (FlyoutBase)(object)key.FlyoutControl))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			IEnumerable<DependencyObject> visualParents = LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualParents(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject, (DependencyObject)null);
			foreach (DependencyObject item in visualParents)
			{
				if ((item as INavElement).Return((INavElement x) => x.TileNavPane == Owner, () => false) || item == Owner)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!(item is TileBar tileBar) || map.Count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (IFlyoutProvider key2 in map.Keys)
				{
					if (CheckFlyouts((FlyoutBase)(object)tileBar.PartFlyoutControl, (FlyoutBase)(object)key2.FlyoutControl))
					{
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (IFlyoutProvider key3 in map.Keys)
			{
				if (key3.FlyoutControl != null)
				{
					((FlyoutBase)key3.FlyoutControl).IsOpen = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CheckFlyouts(FlyoutBase start, FlyoutBase check)
		{
			FlyoutBase root = FlyoutWrapper.GetRoot((DependencyObject)(object)start);
			if (root == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (root == check)
			{
				return true;
			}
			for (FlyoutBase child = FlyoutWrapper.GetChild((DependencyObject)(object)root); child != null; child = FlyoutWrapper.GetChild((DependencyObject)(object)child))
			{
				if (child == check)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public IFlyoutEventListener GetFlyoutTarget(FlyoutControl partFlyoutControl)
		{
			foreach (IFlyoutProvider key in map.Keys)
			{
				if (key.FlyoutControl == partFlyoutControl)
				{
					return map[key];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Register(IFlyoutProvider provider, IFlyoutEventListener target)
		{
			map[provider] = target;
		}

		public void Show(IFlyoutProvider provider, IFlyoutEventListener target)
		{
			if (((FlyoutBase)provider.FlyoutControl).IsOpen || ((FlyoutBase)provider.FlyoutControl).ActualIsOpen)
			{
				if (!((FlyoutBase)provider.FlyoutControl).IsOpen)
				{
					((FlyoutBase)provider.FlyoutControl).IsOpen = true;
				}
				IFlyoutEventListener value = null;
				if (map.TryGetValue(provider, out value) && value != target)
				{
					value.OnFlyoutClosed();
				}
				target.OnFlyoutOpened();
			}
			else
			{
				((FlyoutBase)provider.FlyoutControl).PlacementTarget = provider as UIElement;
				((FlyoutBase)provider.FlyoutControl).Closed -= OnFlyoutControlClosed;
				((FlyoutBase)provider.FlyoutControl).Closed += OnFlyoutControlClosed;
				((FlyoutBase)provider.FlyoutControl).Opened += OnFlyoutControlOpened;
				((FlyoutBase)provider.FlyoutControl).IsOpen = true;
			}
			map[provider] = target;
			FlyoutBase flyout = FlyoutBase.GetFlyout((DependencyObject)Owner);
			if (flyout != null)
			{
				FlyoutWrapper.SetParent((DependencyObject)(object)provider.FlyoutControl, flyout);
				FlyoutWrapper.SetChild((DependencyObject)(object)flyout, (FlyoutBase)(object)provider.FlyoutControl);
			}
		}

		public void Hide(IFlyoutProvider provider, IFlyoutEventListener target)
		{
			if (provider.FlyoutControl != null && ((FlyoutBase)provider.FlyoutControl).IsOpen)
			{
				Close(provider);
			}
		}

		public void CloseAll()
		{
			IFlyoutProvider[] array = map.Keys.Reverse().ToArray();
			IFlyoutProvider[] array2 = array;
			foreach (IFlyoutProvider flyoutProvider in array2)
			{
				if (flyoutProvider.FlyoutControl != null && (((FlyoutBase)flyoutProvider.FlyoutControl).IsOpen || ((FlyoutBase)flyoutProvider.FlyoutControl).ActualIsOpen))
				{
					Close(flyoutProvider);
				}
				else if (!pendingProviders.Contains(flyoutProvider))
				{
					map.Remove(flyoutProvider);
				}
			}
		}

		public void CloseAllExcept(IFlyoutProvider provider)
		{
			List<IFlyoutProvider> list = map.Keys.ToList();
			foreach (IFlyoutProvider item in list)
			{
				IFlyoutEventListener flyoutEventListener = map[item];
				if (provider != item)
				{
					if (item.FlyoutControl != null)
					{
						((FlyoutBase)item.FlyoutControl).IsOpen = false;
					}
					flyoutEventListener.OnFlyoutClosed();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Close(IFlyoutProvider provider, bool immediately)
		{
			if (immediately)
			{
				CloseCore(provider.FlyoutControl);
			}
			else
			{
				Close(provider);
			}
		}

		private void Close(IFlyoutProvider provider)
		{
			pendingProviders.Add(provider);
			List<FlyoutBase> children = FlyoutWrapper.GetChildren((DependencyObject)(object)provider.FlyoutControl);
			children.Insert(0, (FlyoutBase)(object)provider.FlyoutControl);
			foreach (FlyoutBase item in children.AsEnumerable().Reverse())
			{
				item.IsOpen = false;
			}
		}

		private void OnFlyoutControlClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CloseCore(sender);
		}

		private void OnFlyoutControlOpened(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Dictionary<IFlyoutProvider, IFlyoutEventListener>.KeyCollection keys = map.Keys;
			foreach (IFlyoutProvider item in keys)
			{
				if (item.FlyoutControl == sender)
				{
					map[item].OnFlyoutOpened();
				}
			}
			FlyoutControl val = (FlyoutControl)((sender is FlyoutControl) ? sender : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)val).Opened -= OnFlyoutControlOpened;
			}
		}

		private void CloseCore(object flyoutControl)
		{
			Dictionary<IFlyoutProvider, IFlyoutEventListener>.KeyCollection keys = map.Keys;
			foreach (IFlyoutProvider item in keys)
			{
				if (item.FlyoutControl == flyoutControl)
				{
					pendingProviders.Remove(item);
					map[item].OnFlyoutClosed();
					map.Remove(item);
					break;
				}
			}
			FlyoutControl val = (FlyoutControl)((flyoutControl is FlyoutControl) ? flyoutControl : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				if (((FlyoutBase)val).IsOpen)
				{
					((FlyoutBase)val).IsOpen = false;
				}
				FlyoutWrapper.SetParent((DependencyObject)(object)val, null);
				FlyoutWrapper.SetChild((DependencyObject)(object)val, null);
				((FlyoutBase)val).Closed -= OnFlyoutControlClosed;
				((FlyoutBase)val).PlacementTarget = null;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class FlyoutService
	{
		private FrameworkElement Owner;

		private FrameworkElement topElement;

		private Window windowCore;

		protected WeakReference applicationWr = new WeakReference(null);

		private WeakList<FlyoutBase> listeners = new WeakList<FlyoutBase>();

		private FlyoutBase openedFlyout;

		protected internal FrameworkElement TopElement
		{
			get
			{
				return topElement;
			}
			set
			{
				if (TopElement != value)
				{
					if (TopElement != null)
					{
						Unsubscribe();
					}
					topElement = value;
					if (TopElement != null)
					{
						Subscribe();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected Window Window
		{
			get
			{
				if (windowCore == null)
				{
					windowCore = Window.GetWindow(TopElement);
				}
				return windowCore;
			}
		}

		private FlyoutBase OpenedFlyout
		{
			get
			{
				return openedFlyout;
			}
			set
			{
				if (openedFlyout != value)
				{
					if (openedFlyout != null)
					{
						openedFlyout.Closed -= OnOpenedFlyoutClosed;
					}
					openedFlyout = value;
					if (openedFlyout != null)
					{
						openedFlyout.Closed += OnOpenedFlyoutClosed;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsFlyoutShown => OpenedFlyout != null;

		public FlyoutService(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
			if (Owner.IsLoaded)
			{
				TopElement = LayoutHelper.FindRoot((DependencyObject)Owner, false) as FrameworkElement;
			}
			Owner.Loaded += OnOwnerLoaded;
			Owner.Unloaded += OnOwnerUnloaded;
			Owner.SizeChanged += OnOwnerSizeChanged;
			Owner.AddHandler(Mouse.PreviewMouseDownOutsideCapturedElementEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPreviewMouseOutside));
			Owner.AddHandler(Mouse.PreviewMouseUpOutsideCapturedElementEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPreviewMouseOutside));
		}

		private void OnPreviewMouseOutside(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (OpenedFlyout != null && OpenedFlyout == Mouse.Captured)
			{
				CloseAll(onClickThrough: true);
			}
		}

		private void OnOwnerLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			TopElement = LayoutHelper.FindRoot((DependencyObject)Owner, false) as FrameworkElement;
		}

		private void OnOwnerUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			TopElement = null;
			windowCore = null;
		}

		private void OnOwnerSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CloseAll();
		}

		private void Subscribe()
		{
			if (TopElement != null)
			{
				SubscribeApplicationEvents();
				SubscribeWindowEvents();
			}
		}

		private void Unsubscribe()
		{
			if (TopElement != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeApplicationEvents();
				UnsubscribeWindowEvents();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeApplicationEvents()
		{
			UnsubscribeApplicationEvents();
			if (Application.Current != null)
			{
				Application.Current.Deactivated += OnApplicationDeactivated;
				applicationWr = new WeakReference(Application.Current);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeWindowEvents()
		{
			if (Window != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeWindowEvents();
				Window.Deactivated += OwnerWindowDeactivated;
				Window.LocationChanged += OwnerWindowLoactionChanged;
				Window.SizeChanged += OwnerWindowSizeChanged;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeApplicationEvents()
		{
			if (applicationWr.Target is Application application)
			{
				application.Deactivated -= OnApplicationDeactivated;
				applicationWr = new WeakReference(null);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeWindowEvents()
		{
			if (Window != null)
			{
				Window.Deactivated -= OwnerWindowDeactivated;
				Window.LocationChanged -= OwnerWindowLoactionChanged;
				Window.SizeChanged -= OwnerWindowSizeChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnApplicationDeactivated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CloseAll();
		}

		private void OwnerWindowDeactivated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CloseAll();
		}

		private void OwnerWindowLoactionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CloseAll();
		}

		private void OwnerWindowSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CloseAll();
		}

		private void CloseAll(bool onClickThrough = false)
		{
			foreach (FlyoutBase listener in listeners)
			{
				listener.Close(onClickThrough);
			}
			SetShownFlyout(null);
		}

		public void RegisterListener(FlyoutBase flyout)
		{
			listeners.CleanResolvedReferences();
			if (!listeners.Contains(flyout))
			{
				listeners.Add(flyout);
			}
		}

		public void UnregisterListener(FlyoutBase flyout)
		{
			if (listeners.Contains(flyout))
			{
				listeners.Remove(flyout);
			}
			listeners.CleanResolvedReferences();
		}

		internal void SetShownFlyout(FlyoutBase shownFlyout)
		{
			OpenedFlyout = shownFlyout;
		}

		private void OnOpenedFlyoutClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender == OpenedFlyout)
			{
				SetShownFlyout(null);
			}
		}

		public void Show(FlyoutBase flyout)
		{
			if (OpenedFlyout != null && OpenedFlyout != flyout && OpenedFlyout.FlyoutControl != null && OpenedFlyout.FlyoutControl == flyout.FlyoutControl)
			{
				OpenedFlyout.FlyoutControl = null;
				OpenedFlyout.IsOpen = false;
			}
			FlyoutBase flyout2 = FlyoutBase.GetFlyout((DependencyObject)Owner);
			if (flyout2 != null)
			{
				FlyoutWrapper.SetParent((DependencyObject)(object)flyout.FlyoutControl, flyout2);
				FlyoutWrapper.SetChild((DependencyObject)(object)flyout2, (FlyoutBase)(object)flyout.FlyoutControl);
			}
			SetShownFlyout(flyout);
			flyout.IsOpen = true;
		}

		public void Hide(FlyoutBase flyout)
		{
			flyout.IsOpen = false;
			if (((FlyoutBase)flyout.FlyoutControl).IsOpen)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)flyout.FlyoutControl).IsOpen = false;
			}
			if (OpenedFlyout == flyout)
			{
				SetShownFlyout(null);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class FlyoutWrapper : DependencyObject
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ParentProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Parent", typeof(FlyoutBase), typeof(FlyoutWrapper), new PropertyMetadata());

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChildProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Child", typeof(FlyoutBase), typeof(FlyoutWrapper), new PropertyMetadata());

		public static FlyoutBase GetParent(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (FlyoutBase)obj.GetValue(ParentProperty);
		}

		public static void SetParent(DependencyObject obj, FlyoutBase value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ParentProperty, value);
		}

		public static FlyoutBase GetChild(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (FlyoutBase)obj.GetValue(ChildProperty);
		}

		public static void SetChild(DependencyObject obj, FlyoutBase value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ChildProperty, value);
		}

		public static List<FlyoutBase> GetChildren(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			List<FlyoutBase> list = new List<FlyoutBase>();
			for (FlyoutBase child = GetChild(obj); child != null; child = GetChild((DependencyObject)(object)child))
			{
				list.Add(child);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static FlyoutBase GetRoot(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FlyoutBase parent = GetParent(obj);
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return (FlyoutBase)obj;
			}
			return GetRoot((DependencyObject)(object)parent);
		}

		public static bool IsDescendant(FlyoutBase root, FlyoutBase item)
		{
			FlyoutBase val = item;
			do
			{
				if (val == root)
				{
					return true;
				}
				val = GetParent((DependencyObject)(object)val);
			}
			while (val != null);
			return false;
		}
	}

		static ShapeContentPresenter()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ShapeContentPresenter> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ShapeContentPresenter>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Style>("ShapeStyle", ref ShapeStyleProperty, null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None);

			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("TextAlignment", ref TextAlignmentProperty, TextAlignment.Center, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("FontFamily", ref FontFamilyProperty, "Segoe UI", FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("FontSize", ref FontSizeProperty, 11, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AccentColor", ref AccentColorProperty, Colors.Transparent, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

			ContentPresenter.ContentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(ShapeContentPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnContentChanged));

		private static void UpdateImageColor(UIElement image, System.Windows.Media.Color color, bool enabled)
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Effect effect = image.Effect;
			ColorizerEffect val = (ColorizerEffect)(object)((effect is ColorizerEffect) ? effect : null);
			if (!enabled || color == Colors.Transparent)
			{
				image.Effect = null;
			}
			else if (image.Effect == null)
			{
				image.Effect = (Effect)new ColorizerEffect
				{
					Color = color
				};
			}
			else
			{
				val.Color = color;
			}
		}

		private static void OnContentChanged(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			((ShapeContentPresenter)sender).OnContentChanged(args.OldValue as DependencyObject, args.NewValue as DependencyObject);
		}

		protected static IEnumerable<FrameworkElement> GetShapes(DependencyObject content)
		{
			if (content is Shape shape)
			{
				yield return shape;
			}
			if (content is Panel panel)
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in panel.Children)
				{
					IEnumerable<FrameworkElement> shapes = GetShapes(child);
					foreach (FrameworkElement item in shapes)
					{
						yield return item;
					}
				}
			}
			if (content is TextBlock textBlock)
			{
				yield return textBlock;
			}
			if (content is Viewbox viewbox)
			{
				IEnumerable<FrameworkElement> shapes2 = GetShapes(viewbox.Child);
				foreach (FrameworkElement item2 in shapes2)
				{
					yield return item2;
				}
			}
			if (content is System.Windows.Controls.Image image)
			{
				yield return image;
			}
		}

		public ShapeContentPresenter()
		{
			base.Loaded += ShapeContentPresenter_Loaded;
			base.Unloaded += ShapeContentPresenter_Unloaded;
		}

		private void ShapeContentPresenter_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateImageColor(this, AccentColor, AllowAccent);
		}

		private void ShapeContentPresenter_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateImageColor(this, AccentColor, AllowAccent);
		}

		private void OnContentChanged(DependencyObject oldValue, DependencyObject newValue)
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement shape in GetShapes(oldValue))
			{
				UpdateShapeStyle(shape, null);
				UnbindShape(shape);
			}
			foreach (FrameworkElement shape2 in GetShapes(newValue))
			{
				UpdateShapeStyle(shape2, ShapeStyle);
				BindShape(shape2);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnAccentColorChanged(System.Windows.Media.Color oldValue, System.Windows.Media.Color newValue)
		{
			if (base.IsLoaded)
			{
				UpdateImageColor(this, AccentColor, AllowAccent);
			}
		}

		public void OnAllowAccentChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (base.IsLoaded)
			{
				UpdateImageColor(this, AccentColor, AllowAccent);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OAllowAccentChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (base.IsLoaded)
			{
				UpdateImageColor(this, AccentColor, AllowAccent);
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			foreach (FrameworkElement shape in GetShapes(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(this, 0)))
			{
				BindShape(shape);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void BindShape(FrameworkElement shape)
		{
			if (shape is Shape)
			{
				this.Forward(shape, Shape.StrokeProperty, "Foreground");
				this.Forward(shape, Shape.FillProperty, "Foreground");
			}
			else if (shape is TextBlock)
			{
				this.Forward(shape, TextBlock.ForegroundProperty, "Foreground");
				this.Forward(shape, TextBlock.TextWrappingProperty, "TextWrapping");
				this.Forward(shape, TextBlock.TextAlignmentProperty, "TextAlignment");
				this.Forward(shape, TextBlock.FontFamilyProperty, "FontFamily");
				this.Forward(shape, TextBlock.FontSizeProperty, "FontSize");
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnbindShape(FrameworkElement shape)
		{
			if (shape is Shape)
			{
				shape.ClearValue(Shape.StrokeProperty);
				shape.ClearValue(Shape.FillProperty);
			}
			else if (shape is TextBlock)
			{
				shape.ClearValue(TextBlock.ForegroundProperty);
				shape.ClearValue(TextBlock.TextWrappingProperty);
				shape.ClearValue(TextBlock.TextAlignmentProperty);
				shape.ClearValue(TextBlock.FontFamilyProperty);
				shape.ClearValue(TextBlock.FontSizeProperty);
			}
			else if (shape is System.Windows.Controls.Image)
			{
				ImageColorizer.SetIsEnabled((DependencyObject)shape, false);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnShapeStyleChanged(Style style)
		{
			UpdateShapeStyle(style);
		}

		protected void UpdateShapeStyle(Style style)
		{
			foreach (Shape shape in GetShapes(base.Content as DependencyObject))
			{
				UpdateShapeStyle(shape, style);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateShapeStyle(FrameworkElement shape, Style style)
		{
			if (shape != null)
			{
				if (style != null)
				{
					shape.Style = style;
				}
				else
				{
					shape.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class ScrollViewerBehavior
	{
		public static DependencyProperty HorizontalOffsetProperty;

		public static DependencyProperty VerticalOffsetProperty;

		static ScrollViewerBehavior()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ScrollViewerBehavior> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ScrollViewerBehavior>();

		}

	public class ConstrainedSizeBehavior : Behavior<FrameworkElement>
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ConstrainedWidthProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ConstrainedHeightProperty;

		static ConstrainedSizeBehavior()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ConstrainedSizeBehavior> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ConstrainedSizeBehavior>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("ConstrainedWidth", ref ConstrainedWidthProperty, double.NaN, OnConstraintChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("ConstrainedHeight", ref ConstrainedHeightProperty, double.NaN, OnConstraintChanged);
		}

		public static double GetConstrainedHeight(FrameworkElement obj)
		{
			return (double)obj.GetValue(ConstrainedHeightProperty);
		}

		public static void SetConstrainedHeight(FrameworkElement obj, double value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ConstrainedHeightProperty, value);
		}

		public static double GetConstrainedWidth(FrameworkElement obj)
		{
			return (double)obj.GetValue(ConstrainedWidthProperty);
		}

		public static void SetConstrainedWidth(FrameworkElement obj, double value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ConstrainedWidthProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnConstraintChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				double constrainedWidth = GetConstrainedWidth(frameworkElement);
				double constrainedHeight = GetConstrainedHeight(frameworkElement);
				if (!double.IsNaN(constrainedWidth) && !double.IsNaN(constrainedHeight))
				{
					double height = (frameworkElement.Width = Math.Min(constrainedWidth, constrainedHeight));
					frameworkElement.Height = height;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			base.AssociatedObject.SizeChanged += AssociatedObject_SizeChanged;
			base.AssociatedObject.Loaded += AssociatedObject_Loaded;
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
			base.AssociatedObject.SizeChanged -= AssociatedObject_SizeChanged;
			base.AssociatedObject.Loaded -= AssociatedObject_Loaded;
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SetConstraints();
		}

		private void AssociatedObject_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			SetConstraints();
		}

		private void SetConstraints()
		{
			FrameworkElement associatedObject = base.AssociatedObject;
			if (associatedObject != null)
			{
				double actualWidth = associatedObject.ActualWidth;
				double actualHeight = associatedObject.ActualHeight;
				if (!double.IsInfinity(actualWidth) && !double.IsInfinity(actualHeight))
				{
					double height = (associatedObject.Width = Math.Min(actualWidth, actualHeight));
					associatedObject.Height = height;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class PageViewStackPanel : StackLayoutPanel, IScrollablePanel
	{
		private class PageViewStackPanelProvider : ClippedStackLayoutPanelProvider
		{
			private ILayoutCalculatorResult measureResult;

			protected new PageViewStackPanelParameters Parameters => (PageViewStackPanelParameters)base.Parameters;

			private bool IsScrollable => Parameters.LayoutType == PageHeadersLayoutType.Scroll;

			public PageViewStackPanelProvider(IStackPanelModel model)
				: base(model)
			{
			}

			public override HorizontalAlignment GetItemHorizontalAlignment(FrameworkElement item)
			{
				if (!base.Model.IsHorizontal)
				{
					return HorizontalAlignment.Stretch;
				}
				return HorizontalAlignment.Right;
			}

			protected override System.Windows.Size OnArrange(FrameworkElements items, Rect bounds, Rect viewPortBounds)
			{
				if (IsScrollable || measureResult == null)
				{
					return base.OnArrange(items, bounds, viewPortBounds);
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count; i++)
				{
					((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[i].Arrange(measureResult.ItemRects[i]);
				}
				return bounds.Size;
			}

			protected override System.Windows.Size OnMeasure(FrameworkElements items, System.Windows.Size maxSize)
			{
				measureResult = null;
				PageHeadersLayoutType layoutType = Parameters.LayoutType;
				System.Windows.Size result = base.OnMeasure(items, maxSize);
				if (IsScrollable)
				{
					return result;
				}
				IItemHeaderInfo[] array = new IItemHeaderInfo[((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count; i++)
				{
					ISelectorItem selectorItem = ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[i] as ISelectorItem;
					array[i] = new BaseItemOptions(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[i].DesiredSize, selectorItem?.IsSelected ?? false);
				}
				ILayoutCalculator layoutCalculator = LayoutCalculatorFactory.Resolve(base.Model.IsHorizontal, Parameters.LayoutType);
				measureResult = layoutCalculator.Measure(new BaseMeasureOptions(maxSize, array, Parameters.ItemSpace));
				return measureResult.TotalSize;
			}
		}

		public class PageViewStackPanelController : StackLayoutPanelController
		{
			public PageViewStackPanel Control => (PageViewStackPanel)(object)((Controller)this).Control;

			public PageViewStackPanelController(PageViewStackPanel control)

			}

			}

			}
		}

		private class PageViewStackPanelParameters : StackLayoutPanelParameters
		{

				: base(itemSpace, allowItemClipping, allowItemAlignment)
			{
				LayoutType = layoutType;
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LayoutTypeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsScrollableProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsScrollablePropertyKey;

		private ScrollableControl ScrollableControl;

		public new PageViewStackPanelController Controller => (PageViewStackPanelController)base.Controller;

		protected override bool IsClipped
		{
			get
			{
				if (!((PanelBase)this).IsClipped)
				{
					return ((UIElement)(object)this).ClipToBounds;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool IsScrollable
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(IsScrollableProperty);
			}
			private set

				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(IsScrollablePropertyKey, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public PageHeadersLayoutType LayoutType
		{

				return (PageHeadersLayoutType)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(LayoutTypeProperty);

				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(LayoutTypeProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		ScrollableControl IScrollablePanel.ScrollOwner
		{

				return ScrollableControl;
			}
			set
			{
				ScrollableControl = value;
			}
		}

		bool IScrollablePanel.CanScrollPrev
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsScrollable)
				{
					return (base.IsHorizontal ? ((ScrollControl)this).HorizontalOffset : ((ScrollControl)this).VerticalOffset) > 0.0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		bool IScrollablePanel.CanScrollNext
		{
			get
			{
				bool isHorizontal = base.IsHorizontal;
				double num = (isHorizontal ? ((PanelBase)this).ContentBounds.Size.Width : ((PanelBase)this).ContentBounds.Size.Height);
				double num2 = (isHorizontal ? ((ScrollControl)this).ScrollAreaSize.Width : ((ScrollControl)this).ScrollAreaSize.Height);
				double num3 = (isHorizontal ? ((ScrollControl)this).HorizontalOffset : ((ScrollControl)this).VerticalOffset);
				if (IsScrollable)
				{
					return num2 - num3 > num;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		Orientation IScrollablePanel.Orientation
		{

				return base.Orientation;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Orientation = value;
			}
		}

		static PageViewStackPanel()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(PageViewStackPanel);
			StackLayoutPanel.AllowItemAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true));
			StackLayoutPanel.AllowItemClippingProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			LayoutTypeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LayoutType", typeof(PageHeadersLayoutType), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(PageHeadersLayoutType.Default, OnLayoutTypeChanged));
			IsScrollablePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsScrollable", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			IsScrollableProperty = IsScrollablePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
		}

		private static void OnLayoutTypeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((PageViewStackPanel)(object)d).OnIsLayoutTypeChanged((PageHeadersLayoutType)e.OldValue, (PageHeadersLayoutType)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected override Geometry GetGeometry()
		{
			Rect rect = RectHelper.New(FrameworkElementExtensions.GetSize((FrameworkElement)(object)this));
			Thickness thickness = (base.IsHorizontal ? new Thickness(((PanelBase)this).ContentPadding.Left, 0.0, ((PanelBase)this).ContentPadding.Right, 0.0) : new Thickness(0.0, ((PanelBase)this).ContentPadding.Top, 0.0, ((PanelBase)this).ContentPadding.Bottom));
			RectHelper.Deflate(ref rect, thickness);
			return new RectangleGeometry
			{
				Rect = rect
			};
		}

		protected override void OnPaddingChanged(Thickness oldValue, Thickness newValue)
		{
			base.OnPaddingChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			((PanelBase)this).UpdateClip();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsLayoutTypeChanged(PageHeadersLayoutType oldValue, PageHeadersLayoutType newValue)
		{
			IsScrollable = newValue == PageHeadersLayoutType.Scroll;
			Controller.EnsureScrolling();
			((PanelBase)this).Changed();
		}

		protected override void AfterArrange()
		{
			base.AfterArrange();
			if (ScrollableControl != null)
			{
				ScrollableControl.InvalidateScroll();
			}
		}

		private double CalculateForwardScrollOffset()
		{
			bool isHorizontal = base.IsHorizontal;
			double num = (isHorizontal ? ((PanelBase)this).ContentBounds.Size.Width : ((PanelBase)this).ContentBounds.Size.Height);
			double num2 = (isHorizontal ? ((ScrollControl)this).ScrollAreaSize.Width : ((ScrollControl)this).ScrollAreaSize.Height);
			double num3 = (isHorizontal ? ((ScrollControl)this).HorizontalOffset : ((ScrollControl)this).VerticalOffset);
			double num4 = num2 - num3;
			System.Windows.Point point = (isHorizontal ? new System.Windows.Point(num3 + num + ((PanelBase)this).ChildrenBounds.X, ((PanelBase)this).Size.Height / 2.0) : new System.Windows.Point(((PanelBase)this).Size.Width / 2.0, num3 + num + ((PanelBase)this).ChildrenBounds.Y));
			if (((PanelBase)this).ChildAt(point, true, true, true) is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				if (!isHorizontal)
				{
					return ((PanelBase)this).GetChildBounds(frameworkElement).Y - ((PanelBase)this).ChildrenBounds.Y;
				}
				return ((PanelBase)this).GetChildBounds(frameworkElement).X - ((PanelBase)this).ChildrenBounds.X;
			}
			return num3 + num;
		}

		private double CalculateBackwardScrollOffset()
		{
			bool isHorizontal = base.IsHorizontal;
			double num = (isHorizontal ? ((PanelBase)this).ContentBounds.Size.Width : ((PanelBase)this).ContentBounds.Size.Height);
			double num2 = (isHorizontal ? ((ScrollControl)this).ScrollAreaSize.Width : ((ScrollControl)this).ScrollAreaSize.Height);
			double num3 = (isHorizontal ? ((ScrollControl)this).HorizontalOffset : ((ScrollControl)this).VerticalOffset);
			double num4 = num2 - num3;
			System.Windows.Point point = (isHorizontal ? new System.Windows.Point(0.0, ((PanelBase)this).Size.Height / 2.0) : new System.Windows.Point(((PanelBase)this).Size.Width / 2.0, 0.0));
			if (((PanelBase)this).ChildAt(point, true, true, true) is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				Rect childBounds = ((PanelBase)this).GetChildBounds(frameworkElement);
				if (!isHorizontal)
				{
					return num3 + childBounds.Y - ((PanelBase)this).ContentBounds.Y - num + childBounds.Height;
				}
				return num3 + childBounds.X - ((PanelBase)this).ContentBounds.X - num + childBounds.Width;
			}
			return num3 - num;
		}

		protected override PanelControllerBase CreateController()
		{
			return (PanelControllerBase)(object)new PageViewStackPanelController(this);
		}

		protected override LayoutPanelProviderBase CreateLayoutProvider()
		{
			return new PageViewStackPanelProvider(this);
		}

		protected override LayoutPanelParametersBase CreateLayoutProviderParameters()
		{
			return new PageViewStackPanelParameters(LayoutType, base.ItemSpacing, base.AllowItemClipping, base.AllowItemAlignment);
		}

		void IScrollablePanel.ScrollNext()
		{
			((ScrollControlController)Controller).Scroll(base.Orientation, CalculateForwardScrollOffset(), true, true);
		}

		void IScrollablePanel.ScrollPrev()
		{
			((ScrollControlController)Controller).Scroll(base.Orientation, CalculateBackwardScrollOffset(), true, true);
		}

		bool IScrollablePanel.BringChildIntoView(FrameworkElement child)
		{
			return ((ScrollControl)this).BringChildIntoView(child, true);
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool IScrollablePanel.get_IsLoaded()
		{
			return ((FrameworkElement)(object)this).IsLoaded;
		}
	}
	public class PageViewPanel : SplitPanel
	{
		private ILayoutCalculator _layoutCalculatorCore;

		private ILayoutCalculatorResult measureResult;

		private ILayoutCalculator layoutCalculatorCore
		{
			get
			{
				if (_layoutCalculatorCore is ClipLayoutCalculator clipLayoutCalculator)
				{
					clipLayoutCalculator.IsHorizontal = base.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
				}
				return _layoutCalculatorCore;
			}
			set
			{
				_layoutCalculatorCore = value;
			}
		}

		protected ILayoutCalculator LayoutCalculator
		{
			get
			{
				if (layoutCalculatorCore == null)
				{
					layoutCalculatorCore = GetDefaultLayoutCalculator();
				}
				return layoutCalculatorCore;
			}
		}

		static PageViewPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<PageViewPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<PageViewPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(SplitPanel.ItemSizeModeProperty, ItemSizeMode.AutoSize);
		}

		protected virtual ILayoutCalculator GetDefaultLayoutCalculator()
		{
			return new ClipLayoutCalculator
			{
				IsHorizontal = (base.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			};
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnMeasure(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			base.OnMeasure(availableSize);
			IItemHeaderInfo[] array = new IItemHeaderInfo[base.Children.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				if (base.Children[i] is ISelectorItem)
				{
					array[i] = new BaseItemOptions(base.Children[i].DesiredSize, ((ISelectorItem)base.Children[i]).IsSelected);
				}
				else
				{
					array[i] = new BaseItemOptions(default(System.Windows.Size), isSelected: false);
				}
			}
			measureResult = LayoutCalculator.Measure(new BaseMeasureOptions(availableSize, array, base.ItemSpacing));
			return measureResult.TotalSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnArrange(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				base.Children[i].Arrange(measureResult.ItemRects[i]);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class SlideViewHeaderPanel : Panel
	{
		private double ArrangeX;

		internal void SetRelativeLocation(double scrollOffset, double headerOffset)
		{
			if (base.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = base.Children[0];
			if (scrollOffset >= headerOffset)
			{
				ArrangeX = 0.0;
				InvalidateArrange();
				uIElement.Opacity = 1.0;
				return;
			}
			double num = headerOffset - scrollOffset + base.Margin.Left;
			double num2 = base.ActualWidth - uIElement.DesiredSize.Width;
			if (num > num2)
			{
				uIElement.Opacity = Math.Max(0.0, 1.0 - (num - num2) / uIElement.DesiredSize.Width);
			}
			else
			{
				uIElement.Opacity = 1.0;
			}
			ArrangeX = num;
			InvalidateArrange();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (base.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return default(System.Windows.Size);
			}
			UIElement uIElement = base.Children[0];
			uIElement.Measure(availableSize);
			return uIElement.DesiredSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Arrange(new Rect(ArrangeX, 0.0, Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Width - ArrangeX), finalSize.Height));
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class SlideViewItemHeader : veContentControl, IControl, IClickableControl, IClickable
	{
		public class SlideViewItemHeaderController : ControlControllerBase
		{
			private SlideViewItemHeader ClickableControl => ((ControlControllerBase)this).Control as SlideViewItemHeader;

			public SlideViewItemHeaderController(IControl control)
				: base(control)
			{
			}

			protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(DXMouseButtonEventArgs e)
			{
				if (((Controller)this).IsMouseLeftButtonDown)
				{
					ClickableControl.OnClick();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				((Controller)this).OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			}

			public override void UpdateState(bool useTransitions)
			{
				if (ClickableControl == null || ClickableControl.Owner == null || ClickableControl.Owner.IsHeaderInteractive || !ClickableControl.IsEnabled)
				{
					((ControlControllerBase)this).UpdateState(useTransitions);
				}
				if (ClickableControl != null)
				{
					ClickableControl.GoToState(ClickableControl.IsHeaderInteractive ? "Interactive" : "Noninteractive");
				}
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsHeaderInteractiveProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty InteractiveHeaderTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsStickyProperty;

			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsSticky", ref IsStickyProperty, defValue: true);

			headerPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_HeaderPanel") as SlideViewHeaderPanel;
			if (Controller is SlideViewItemHeaderController)

				((ControlControllerBase)(SlideViewItemHeaderController)(object)Controller).UpdateState(false);
			}
		}

		}

			}
		}

		}

		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				((IClickableControl)Owner).OnClick();
			}
			if (this.Click != null)
			{
				this.Click(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		{
			OnClick();
		}

		}

			}

		private bool IsContentLocked => loadingCount > 0;

		public bool IsDisposing { get; private set; }

		public event EventHandler ContentRendered;

		static ViewPresenter()
		{
			setBlockMerging = ReflectionHelper.CreateInstanceMethodHandler<Action<DependencyObject, bool>>((object)null, "SetBlockMerging", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic, typeof(MergingProperties), (int?)null, (Type[])null, true);
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ViewPresenter> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ViewPresenter>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<ViewPresenter>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("Content", ref ContentProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ViewPresenter)d).OnContentChanged(e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("ContentTemplate", ref ContentTemplateProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("ContentTemplateSelector", ref ContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<AnimationSelector>("AnimationSelector", ref AnimationSelectorProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AnimationType", ref AnimationTypeProperty, AnimationType.Fade);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AnimationDirection", ref AnimationDirectionProperty, AnimationDirection.Forward);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AnimationSpeedRatio", ref AnimationSpeedRatioProperty, 1.0);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Storyboard>("DefaultStoryboard", ref DefaultStoryboardProperty, null, null, CoerceStoryboard);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Storyboard", ref StoryboardProperty, string.Empty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ContentPresenter>("OldContent", ref OldContentProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ContentPresenter>("NewContent", ref NewContentProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("OldContentTranslateX", ref OldContentTranslateXProperty, 0.0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ViewPresenter)d).OnOldContentTranslateXChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("NewContentTranslateX", ref NewContentTranslateXProperty, 0.0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ViewPresenter)d).OnNewContentTranslateXChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("OldContentTranslateY", ref OldContentTranslateYProperty, 0.0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ViewPresenter)d).OnOldContentTranslateYChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("NewContentTranslateY", ref NewContentTranslateYProperty, 0.0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ViewPresenter)d).OnNewContentTranslateYChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Storyboards", ref StoryboardsProperty, StoryboardCollection.Empty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached<string>("StoryboardName", ref StoryboardNameProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AnimationDelay", ref AnimationDelayProperty, new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0, 0, 150));
		}

		private static object CoerceStoryboard(DependencyObject d, object source)
		{
			return ((Storyboard)source)?.Clone();
		}

		public static string GetStoryboardName(Storyboard sb)
		{
			return (string)sb.GetValue(StoryboardNameProperty);
		}

		public static void SetStoryboardName(Storyboard sb, string value)
		{
			sb.SetValue(StoryboardNameProperty, value);
		}

		public ViewPresenter()
		{
			base.SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
		}

		protected virtual bool ViewIsReadyToAppear(object view)
		{
			return !IsContentLocked;
		}

		protected virtual void SetViewIsVisible(object view, bool value)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseBeforeViewDisappear(object view)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseAfterViewDisappear(object view)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private FrameAnimation CreateFrameAnimation(object oldContent, object newContent)
		{
			return new FrameAnimation
			{
				OldSource = oldContent,
				NewSource = newContent,
				Type = AnimationType,
				Direction = AnimationDirection,
				SpeedRatio = AnimationSpeedRatio
			};
		}

		private double ValidateAnimationSpeedRatio(double speedRatio)
		{
			if (double.IsInfinity(speedRatio) || double.IsNaN(speedRatio) || speedRatio <= 0.0)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return speedRatio;
		}

		private void SetStoryboard(object oldContent, object newContent)
		{
			FrameAnimation settings = CreateFrameAnimation(oldContent, newContent);
			AnimationSelector.Do(delegate(AnimationSelector x)
			{
				x.Select(settings);
			});
			actualAnimationDirection = settings.Direction;
			if (settings.Storyboard != null)
			{
				storyboard = settings.Storyboard;
			}
			else if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Storyboard))
			{
				if (Storyboards == null || Storyboards.Count == 0)
				{
					storyboard = DefaultStoryboard;
				}
				else
				{
					if (settings.Type == AnimationType.Fade)
					{
						storyboard = DefaultStoryboard;
					}
					if (settings.Type == AnimationType.SlideHorizontal)
					{
						storyboard = Storyboards.Where((Storyboard sb) => GetStoryboardName(sb) == ((settings.Direction == AnimationDirection.Forward) ? "FromLeft" : "FromRight")).Single();
					}
					if (settings.Type == AnimationType.SlideVertical)
					{
						storyboard = Storyboards.Where((Storyboard sb) => GetStoryboardName(sb) == ((settings.Direction == AnimationDirection.Forward) ? "FromTop" : "FromBottom")).Single();
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				string name = Storyboard;
				storyboard = Storyboards.Where((Storyboard sb) => GetStoryboardName(sb) == name).Single();
			}
			if (storyboard != null)
			{
				storyboard = storyboard.Clone();
				if (!DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertyAssigned((DependencyObject)storyboard, Timeline.DurationProperty))
				{
					storyboard.SpeedRatio = ValidateAnimationSpeedRatio(settings.SpeedRatio);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (CurrentView == null || IsDisposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (animationInProgress)
			{
				Context.PostponedAnimation = true;
				Context.OldContent = oldValue;
				Context.NewContent = newValue;
				return;
			}
			Context.PostponedAnimation = false;
			if (PreviousView != null)
			{
				if (PreviousView.Content == newValue)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					PreviousView.ContentTemplate = ContentTemplate;
					PreviousView.ContentTemplateSelector = ContentTemplateSelector;
				}
			}
			oldAnimationDirection = actualAnimationDirection;
			base.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			if (AnimationType != AnimationType.None)
			{
				animationInProgress = true;
			}
			NewContent = CurrentView;
			CurrentView = PreviousView;
			PreviousView = NewContent;
			if (OldContent != null && OldContent.Content != null)
			{
				OldContent.IsHitTestVisible = false;
				SetViewIsVisible(OldContent.Content, value: false);
				RaiseBeforeViewDisappear(OldContent.Content);
			}
			PrepareNewContent(newValue);
			Panel.SetZIndex(NewContent, 5);
			InitTransform(NewContent);
			SetStoryboard(oldValue, newValue);
			if (OldContent == null || storyboard == null)
			{
				NewContent.Opacity = 1.0;
				FinishContentChanging();
				storyboard = null;
				return;
			}
			ResetTransform();
			System.Windows.Media.Animation.Storyboard.SetTarget(storyboard, this);
			storyboard.Completed += OnStoryboardCompleted;
			if (ViewIsReadyToAppear(newValue))
			{
				OnNewValueViewIsReadyToAppearChanged(newValue, null);
			}
		}

		private void PrepareNewContent(object newValue)
		{
			NewContent.Content = newValue;
			NewContent.RenderTransformOrigin = new System.Windows.Point(0.5, 0.5);
			NewContent.Opacity = 0.0;
			NewContent.SetBinding(ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateProperty, new Binding("ContentTemplate")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			NewContent.SetBinding(ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty, new Binding("ContentTemplateSelector")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			NewContent.IsHitTestVisible = true;
		}

		private void OnStoryboardCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			NewContent.Opacity = 1.0;
			storyboard.Completed -= OnStoryboardCompleted;
			storyboard.Stop();
			storyboard = null;
			AnimationStarted = false;
			FinishContentChanging();
			InvokePostponed();
		}

		private void InvokePostponed()
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (Context.PostponedAnimation)
				{
					LockContentLoading();
					Context.PostponedAnimation = false;
					OnContentChanged(Context.OldContent, Context.NewContent);
					BackgroundHelper.DoInBackground((Action)delegate
					{
					}, (Action)delegate
					{
						UnlockContentLoading();
					}, (int)AnimationDelay.TotalMilliseconds, ThreadPriority.Normal, ApartmentState.MTA);
				}
			});
		}

		private void ResetTransform()
		{
			if (AnimationType == AnimationType.SlideHorizontal)
			{
				NewContentTranslateX = ((actualAnimationDirection == AnimationDirection.Back) ? 1 : (-1));
				NewContentTranslateY = 0.0;
			}
			if (AnimationType == AnimationType.SlideVertical)
			{
				NewContentTranslateY = ((actualAnimationDirection == AnimationDirection.Back) ? 1 : (-1));
				NewContentTranslateX = 0.0;
			}
			double oldContentTranslateX = (OldContentTranslateY = 0.0);
			OldContentTranslateX = oldContentTranslateX;
		}

		private void OnNewValueViewIsReadyToAppearChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!Context.PostponedAnimation || !AnimationStarted)
			{
				if (storyboard != null)
				{
					storyboard.Begin();
					AnimationStarted = true;
				}
				else
				{
					animationInProgress = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private void RaiseContentRendered()
		{
			EventHandler eventHandler = this.ContentRendered;
			if (!animationInProgress)
			{
				eventHandler?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void FinishContentChanging()
		{
			ContentPresenter oldContent = OldContent;
			ContentPresenter newContent = NewContent;
			if (OldContent != null)
			{
				if (OldContent.Content != null)
				{
					RaiseAfterViewDisappear(OldContent.Content);
				}
				OldContent.Content = null;
				OldContent.ContentTemplate = null;
				OldContent.ContentTemplateSelector = null;
			}
			OldContent = NewContent;
			NewContent = null;
			Panel.SetZIndex(OldContent, 10);
			InitTransform(OldContent);
			if (OldContent != null && OldContent.Content != null)
			{
				SetViewIsVisible(OldContent.Content, value: true);
			}
			animationInProgress = false;
			RaiseContentRendered();
			base.IsHitTestVisible = true;
			(oldContent.With((Func<ContentPresenter, UIElement>)((ContentPresenter x) => x)) ?? oldContent).Do(LockMerging);
			(newContent.With((Func<ContentPresenter, UIElement>)((ContentPresenter x) => x)) ?? newContent).Do(UnlockMerging);
		}

		internal static void LockMerging(UIElement element)
		{
			setBlockMerging(element, arg2: true);
		}

		internal static void UnlockMerging(UIElement element)
		{
			setBlockMerging(element, arg2: false);
		}

		private void InitTransform(FrameworkElement fe)
		{
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			transformGroup.Children.Add(new ScaleTransform());
			transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform());
			fe.RenderTransform = transformGroup;
		}

		private void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateTransform();
		}

		private void UpdateTransform()
		{
			base.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
			{
				Rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight)
			};
			if (OldContent != null)
			{
				OnOldContentTranslateXChanged();
				OnOldContentTranslateYChanged();
			}
			if (NewContent != null)
			{
				OnNewContentTranslateXChanged();
				OnNewContentTranslateYChanged();
			}
		}

		private void OnOldContentTranslateXChanged()
		{
			if (animationInProgress)
			{
				OldContentTranslate.X = OldContentTranslateX * base.ActualWidth;
			}
		}

		private void OnNewContentTranslateXChanged()
		{
			if (!animationInProgress || NewContentTranslate == null)
			{
				NewContentTranslateX = 0.0;
			}
			else
			{
				NewContentTranslate.X = NewContentTranslateX * base.ActualWidth;
			}
		}

		private void OnOldContentTranslateYChanged()
		{
			if (animationInProgress)
			{
				OldContentTranslate.Y = OldContentTranslateY * base.ActualHeight;
			}
		}

		private void OnNewContentTranslateYChanged()
		{
			if (!animationInProgress || NewContentTranslate == null)
			{
				NewContentTranslateY = 0.0;
			}
			else
			{
				NewContentTranslate.Y = NewContentTranslateY * base.ActualHeight;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			root = (ContentPresenter)GetTemplateChild("Root");
			CurrentView = (ContentPresenter)GetTemplateChild("PART_CurrentView");
			PreviousView = (ContentPresenter)GetTemplateChild("PART_PreviousView");
			CurrentView.Do(LockMerging);
			PreviousView.Do(LockMerging);
			if (Content != null)
			{
				OnContentChanged(null, Content);
			}
		}

		internal void LockContentLoading()
		{
			loadingCount++;
		}

		internal void UnlockContentLoading()
		{
			if (IsContentLocked)
			{
				loadingCount--;
			}
			if (!IsContentLocked)
			{
				OnNewValueViewIsReadyToAppearChanged(Content, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!IsDisposing)
			{
				IsDisposing = true;
				OnDispose();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDispose()
		{
			ClearValue(ContentProperty);
			ClearValue(ContentTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(ContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
			ClearValue(AnimationDirectionProperty);
			ClearValue(AnimationTypeProperty);
			if (CurrentView != null)
			{
				CurrentView.Content = null;
			}
			if (PreviousView != null)
			{
				PreviousView.Content = null;
			}
		}
	}

	}

	public interface ISplitStrategy

	internal class ProportionalSplitStrategy : ISplitStrategy
	{
		public Rect[] Split(Rect content, ILayoutCell[] layoutCells, double spacing, bool horizontal)
		{
			return Split(content, layoutCells, spacing, horizontal, allowClipping: false);
		}

		public Rect[] Split(Rect content, ILayoutCell[] layoutCells, double spacing, bool horizontal, bool allowClipping)
		{
			return ProportionalLayoutCalculator.Calc(content, layoutCells, spacing, horizontal);
		}
	}
	internal static class ProportionalLayoutCalculator
	{
		private class CorrectionEntry
		{
			public readonly int Index;

			public readonly double Ratio;

			private double valueCore;

			private double correctionCore;

			public double Value => valueCore;

			public double Correction => correctionCore;

			public CorrectionEntry(int index, double ratio, double value)
			{
				Index = index;
				Ratio = ratio;
				valueCore = value;
			}

			public static int Compare(CorrectionEntry e1, CorrectionEntry e2)
			{
				if (e1 == e2)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (e1 == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return e2?.Value.CompareTo(e1.Value) ?? 1;
			}

			public static void Correct(CorrectionEntry[] entries, int startPos, double value)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				for (int i = startPos; i < entries.Length; i++)
				{
					if (entries[i] != null)
					{
						num += entries[i].Ratio;
						num2 += entries[i].Value;
					}
				}
				if (!MathHelper.IsZero(value + num2) && value + num2 > 0.0)
				{
					return;
				}
				entries[startPos - 1].correctionCore = value;
				double num3 = value / num;
				for (int j = startPos; j < entries.Length; j++)
				{
					if (entries[j] == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					CorrectionEntry correctionEntry = entries[j];
					double num4 = correctionEntry.Ratio * num3;
					double num5 = num4 + correctionEntry.Value;
					if (MathHelper.IsZero(num5) || num5 < 0.0)
					{
						correctionEntry.correctionCore -= num4;
						value -= num4;
						correctionEntry.valueCore += num4;
						continue;
					}
					correctionEntry.correctionCore += correctionEntry.Value;
					value += correctionEntry.Value;
					correctionEntry.valueCore = 0.0;
					if (!MathHelper.AreClose(num, correctionEntry.Ratio))
					{
						num -= correctionEntry.Ratio;
						num3 = value / num;
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return string.Format("{1},[{0}],{2}*,({3})", Index, Value, Ratio, Correction);
			}
		}

		public static Rect[] Calc(Rect bounds, ILayoutCell[] layoutCells, bool horizontal)
		{
			return Calc(bounds, layoutCells, 0.0, horizontal);
		}

		public static Rect[] Calc(Rect bounds, ILayoutCell[] layoutCells, double spacing, bool horizontal)
		{
			double[] array = new double[Math.Max(0, layoutCells.Length - 1)];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = spacing;
			}
			return Calc(bounds, layoutCells, array, horizontal);
		}

		public static Rect[] Calc(Rect bounds, ILayoutCell[] layoutCells, double[] spacings, bool horizontal)
		{
			Rect[] array = new Rect[layoutCells.Length];
			if (layoutCells.Length == 0)
			{
				return array;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double val = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < layoutCells.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!layoutCells[i].IsAutoSize)
				{
					num++;
					double dimension = MathHelper.GetDimension(layoutCells[i].StretchRatio, 1.0);
					num4 += dimension;
				}
				else
				{
					num2++;
					double length = layoutCells[i].GetLength(horizontal);
					num3 += length;
					val = Math.Max(val, length);
				}
			}
			double num5 = 0.0;
			for (int j = 0; j < spacings.Length; j++)
			{
				num5 += spacings[j];
			}
			double num6 = (horizontal ? bounds.Width : bounds.Height);
			double num7 = 0.0;
			bool flag = double.IsInfinity(num6) || double.IsNaN(num6);
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (!MathHelper.AreClose(num6, num3))
				{
					num6 = Math.Max(0.0, num6 - num5);
				}
				num7 = (num6 - num3) / num4;
			}
			else
			{
				num7 = 0.0;
			}
			double[] array2 = new double[layoutCells.Length];
			CorrectionEntry[] array3 = new CorrectionEntry[layoutCells.Length];
			for (int k = 0; k < array2.Length; k++)
			{
				double length2 = layoutCells[k].GetLength(horizontal);
				if (flag || layoutCells[k].IsAutoSize)
				{
					array2[k] = length2;
					continue;
				}
				double dimension2 = MathHelper.GetDimension(layoutCells[k].StretchRatio, 1.0);
				array2[k] = num7 * dimension2;
				if (array2[k] < 0.0)
				{
					array2[k] = 0.0;
					if (k > 0)
					{
						spacings[k - 1] = 0.0;
					}
				}
				array3[k] = new CorrectionEntry(k, dimension2, length2 - array2[k]);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				Array.Sort(array3, CorrectionEntry.Compare);
				for (int l = 0; l < array3.Length; l++)
				{
					if (array3[l] != null)
					{
						if (!(array3[l].Value > 0.0))
						{
							break;
						}
						CorrectionEntry.Correct(array3, l + 1, array3[l].Value);
					}
				}
				for (int m = 0; m < array3.Length; m++)
				{
					if (array3[m] != null)
					{
						array2[array3[m].Index] += array3[m].Correction;
					}
				}
			}
			double num8 = 0.0;
			int num9 = 0;
			double num10 = 0.0;
			for (int n = 0; n < array.Length; n++)
			{
				double num11 = array2[n] + num10;
				num9 = (int)(num11 + 0.5);
				num10 = num11 - (double)num9;
				if (horizontal)
				{
					array[n] = new Rect(bounds.Left + num8, bounds.Top, num9, bounds.Height);
				}
				else
				{
					array[n] = new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top + num8, bounds.Width, num9);
				}
				if (n + 1 < array.Length)
				{
					num8 += (double)num9 + spacings[n];
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				LayoutAlignmentHelper.CorrectCellRectsByAlignment(array, layoutCells, bounds, spacings, horizontal);
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	internal class StackedSplitStrategy : ISplitStrategy
	{
		public Rect[] Split(Rect content, ILayoutCell[] layoutCells, double spacing, bool horizontal)
		{
			return Split(content, layoutCells, spacing, horizontal, allowClipping: false);
		}

		public Rect[] Split(Rect content, ILayoutCell[] layoutCells, double spacing, bool horizontal, bool allowClipping)
		{
			double[] array = new double[layoutCells.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < layoutCells.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = (horizontal ? layoutCells[i].DesiredSize.Width : layoutCells[i].DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			Rect[] array2 = StackedLayoutCalculator.Calc(content, array, spacing, horizontal);
			double d = (horizontal ? content.Width : content.Height);
			if (!double.IsInfinity(d))
			{
				CorrectCellsByAlignment(content, layoutCells, spacing, horizontal, array2);
			}
			return array2;
		}

		protected virtual void CorrectCellsByAlignment(Rect content, ILayoutCell[] layoutCells, double spacing, bool horizontal, Rect[] rects)
		{
			LayoutAlignmentHelper.CorrectCellRectsByAlignment(rects, layoutCells, content, spacing, horizontal);
		}
	}
	internal static class StackedLayoutCalculator
	{
		public static Rect[] Calc(Rect bounds, double[] splitLengths, double spacing, bool horizontal, bool allowClipping = false)
		{
			Rect[] array = new Rect[splitLengths.Length];
			if (splitLengths.Length == 0)
			{
				return array;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = (horizontal ? bounds.Width : bounds.Height);
			double num3 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				num3 = splitLengths[i];
				if (!allowClipping && num + num3 - num2 > 0.1)
				{
					num3 = 0.0;
				}
				if (horizontal)
				{
					array[i] = new Rect(bounds.Left + num, bounds.Top, num3, bounds.Height);
				}
				else
				{
					array[i] = new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top + num, bounds.Width, num3);
				}
				if (i + 1 < array.Length && num3 > 0.0)
				{
					num += num3 + spacing;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	public class SplitPanel : BaseItemsPanel
	{

		private ISplitStrategy strategyCore;

		private Rect[] layoutCellsCore;

		public Thickness Padding
		{

			set

				SetValue(AllowClippingProperty, value);

		}

		protected ISplitStrategy Strategy
		{
			[DebuggerStepThrough]
			get
			{
				if (strategyCore == null)
				{
					switch (ItemSizeMode)
					{
					case ItemSizeMode.Default:
					case ItemSizeMode.Stretch:
						strategyCore = CreateProportionalSplitStrategy();
						break;
					case ItemSizeMode.AutoSize:
						strategyCore = CreateStackedSplitStrategy();
						break;
					default:
						throw new NotSupportedException();
					}
				}
				return strategyCore;
			}
		}

		protected Rect[] LayoutCells => layoutCellsCore;

			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ItemSizeMode", ref ItemSizeModeProperty, ItemSizeMode.Default, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

				((SplitPanel)dObj).OnItemSizeModeChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("Index", ref IndexProperty, -1, OnIndexChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("StretchRatio", ref StretchRatioProperty, double.NaN, OnStretchRatioChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("SizeMode", ref SizeModeProperty, ItemSizeMode.Default, OnSizeModeChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AllowClipping", ref AllowClippingProperty, defValue: false, OnAllowClippingChanged);
		}
