		protected virtual ILayoutCell[] GetLayoutCells(System.Windows.Size availableSize, UIElementCollection elements, bool isMeasure)
		{
			IDictionary<int, ICollection<ILayoutCell>> dictionary = new SortedDictionary<int, ICollection<ILayoutCell>>();
			bool isHorizontal = base.IsHorizontal;
			System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = new System.Windows.Size(isHorizontal ? double.PositiveInfinity : availableSize.Width, isHorizontal ? availableSize.Height : double.PositiveInfinity);
			bool flag = double.IsInfinity(isHorizontal ? availableSize.Width : availableSize.Height);
			int num = 0;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					if (isMeasure)
					{
						child.Measure(availableSize);
					}
					continue;
				}
				int num2 = Math.Max(-1, GetIndex(child));
				if (num2 == -1)
				{
					num2 = num++;
				}
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(num2, out var value))
				{
					value = new List<ILayoutCell>();
					dictionary.Add(num2, value);
				}
				if (isMeasure)
				{
					if (flag || IsAutoSize(child))
					{
						child.Measure(availableSize2);
					}
					else
					{
						child.Measure(availableSize);
					}
				}
				value.Add(CreateLayoutCell(child));
			}
			int num3 = 0;
			ILayoutCell[] array = new ILayoutCell[dictionary.Count];
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, ICollection<ILayoutCell>> item in dictionary)
			{
				array[num3++] = MergeLayoutCells(item.Value);
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected virtual ILayoutCell CreateLayoutCell(UIElement child)
		{
			bool flag = IsAutoSize(child);
			double ratio = ((!flag) ? GetStretchRatio(child) : double.NaN);
			return new LayoutCell(child.DesiredSize, GetLayoutAlignment(child), ratio, flag);
		}

		protected bool IsAutoSize(UIElement child)
		{
			object obj = child.ReadLocalValue(SizeModeProperty);
			ItemSizeMode itemSizeMode = ((obj == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue || object.Equals(obj, ItemSizeMode.Default)) ? ItemSizeMode : ((ItemSizeMode)obj));
			return itemSizeMode == ItemSizeMode.AutoSize;
		}

		protected LayoutAlignment GetLayoutAlignment(UIElement child)
		{
			bool isHorizontal = base.IsHorizontal;
			DependencyProperty dp = (isHorizontal ? FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty : FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty);
			object objA = (isHorizontal ? ((object)HorizontalAlignment.Left) : ((object)VerticalAlignment.Top));
			object objA2 = (isHorizontal ? ((object)HorizontalAlignment.Right) : ((object)VerticalAlignment.Bottom));
			object objB = child.ReadLocalValue(dp);
			if (object.Equals(objA, objB))
			{
				return LayoutAlignment.Near;
			}
			if (object.Equals(objA2, objB))
			{
				return LayoutAlignment.Far;
			}
			return LayoutAlignment.Default;
		}

		protected ILayoutCell MergeLayoutCells(IEnumerable<ILayoutCell> cells)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
			double num = double.NaN;
			bool flag = false;
			LayoutAlignment? layoutAlignment = null;
			foreach (ILayoutCell cell in cells)
			{
				size = MathHelper.Union(size, cell.DesiredSize);
				if (!layoutAlignment.HasValue)
				{
					if (cell.DesiredAlignment != LayoutAlignment.Default)
					{
						layoutAlignment = cell.DesiredAlignment;
					}
				}
				else if (cell.DesiredAlignment != layoutAlignment.Value)
				{
					layoutAlignment = LayoutAlignment.Default;
				}
				flag |= cell.IsAutoSize;
				if (!flag && !double.IsNaN(cell.StretchRatio))
				{
					num = Math.Max(cell.StretchRatio, MathHelper.GetDimension(num));
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				num = double.NaN;
			}
			return new LayoutCell(size, layoutAlignment ?? LayoutAlignment.Default, num, flag);
		}

		protected virtual void StretchLayoutCells(System.Windows.Size availableSize, ILayoutCell[] cells, Rect[] rects)
		{
			bool isHorizontal = base.IsHorizontal;
			int cellIndex = 0;
			bool flag = double.IsInfinity(isHorizontal ? availableSize.Width : availableSize.Height);
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					int num = NextLayoutCellIndex(ref cellIndex, child, cells.Length);
					if (!flag && !cells[num].IsAutoSize)
					{
						System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = new System.Windows.Size(isHorizontal ? rects[num].Width : availableSize.Width, isHorizontal ? availableSize.Height : rects[num].Height);
						child.Measure(availableSize2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected int NextLayoutCellIndex(ref int cellIndex, UIElement child, int maxIndex)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(-1, GetIndex(child));
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return cellIndex++;
			}
			return Math.Min(maxIndex, num);
		}

		protected virtual Rect[] SplitCore(Rect content, ILayoutCell[] layoutCells, double spacing, bool horz)
		{
			return Strategy.Split(content, layoutCells, spacing, horz, AllowClipping);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnArrange(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			bool isHorizontal = base.IsHorizontal;
			Rect content = MathHelper.DeflateSize(finalSize, Padding);
			System.Windows.Size availableSize = new System.Windows.Size(content.Width, content.Height);
			ILayoutCell[] layoutCells = GetLayoutCells(availableSize, base.Children, isMeasure: false);
			double dimension = MathHelper.GetDimension(base.ItemSpacing);
			Rect[] array = (layoutCellsCore = SplitCore(content, layoutCells, dimension, isHorizontal));
			int cellIndex = 0;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					int num = NextLayoutCellIndex(ref cellIndex, child, array.Length);
					child.Arrange(array[num]);
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnMeasure(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			bool isHorizontal = base.IsHorizontal;
			Rect content = MathHelper.DeflateSize(availableSize, Padding);
			System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = new System.Windows.Size(content.Width, content.Height);
			ILayoutCell[] layoutCells = GetLayoutCells(availableSize2, base.Children, isMeasure: true);
			double dimension = MathHelper.GetDimension(base.ItemSpacing);
			Rect[] array = SplitCore(content, layoutCells, dimension, isHorizontal);
			StretchLayoutCells(availableSize2, layoutCells, array);
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				System.Windows.Size desiredSize = layoutCells[i].DesiredSize;
				if (isHorizontal)
				{
					double num3 = ((i == 0 || desiredSize.Width <= 0.0) ? 0.0 : dimension);
					num += desiredSize.Width + num3;
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, desiredSize.Height);
				}
				else
				{
					double num4 = ((i == 0 || desiredSize.Height <= 0.0) ? 0.0 : dimension);
					num = Math.Max(num, desiredSize.Width);
					num2 += desiredSize.Height + num4;
				}
			}
			num = Math.Min(content.Width, num);
			num2 = Math.Min(content.Height, num2);
			return MathHelper.Inflate(new System.Windows.Size(num, num2), Padding);
		}
	}
	internal static class LayoutAlignmentHelper
	{
		internal static void CorrectCellRectsByAlignment(Rect[] rects, ILayoutCell[] layoutCells, Rect bounds, double spacing, bool horizontal)
		{
			double[] array = new double[Math.Max(0, layoutCells.Length - 1)];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = spacing;
			}
			CorrectCellRectsByAlignment(rects, layoutCells, bounds, array, horizontal);
		}

		internal static void CorrectCellRectsByAlignment(Rect[] rects, ILayoutCell[] layoutCells, Rect bounds, double[] spacings, bool horizontal)
		{
			double num = (horizontal ? bounds.Right : bounds.Bottom);
			int num2 = layoutCells.Length - 1;
			while (num2 >= 0 && layoutCells[num2].DesiredAlignment == LayoutAlignment.Far)
			{
				double num3 = (horizontal ? rects[num2].Width : rects[num2].Height);
				if (horizontal)
				{
					rects[num2] = new Rect(num - num3, rects[num2].Top, rects[num2].Width, rects[num2].Height);
				}
				else
				{
					rects[num2] = new Rect(rects[num2].Left, num - num3, rects[num2].Width, rects[num2].Height);
				}
				if (num2 - 1 >= 0)
				{
					num -= num3 + spacings[num2 - 1];
				}
				num2--;
			}
		}

		internal static void CorrectAllCellRectsByAlignment(Rect[] rects, ILayoutCell[] layoutCells, Rect bounds, double spacing, bool horizontal)
		{
			double[] array = new double[Math.Max(0, layoutCells.Length - 1)];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = spacing;
			}
			CorrectAllCellRectsByAlignment(rects, layoutCells, bounds, array, horizontal);
		}

		internal static void CorrectAllCellRectsByAlignment(Rect[] rects, ILayoutCell[] layoutCells, Rect bounds, double[] spacings, bool horizontal)
		{
			double num = (horizontal ? bounds.Right : bounds.Bottom);
			double num2 = 0.0;
			for (int num3 = layoutCells.Length - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
			{
				if (layoutCells[num3].DesiredAlignment != LayoutAlignment.Default)
				{
					double num4 = (horizontal ? rects[num3].Width : rects[num3].Height);
					if (layoutCells[num3].DesiredAlignment == LayoutAlignment.Far)
					{
						double x = (horizontal ? (num - num4) : rects[num3].Left);
						double y = (horizontal ? rects[num3].Top : (num - num4));
						rects[num3] = new Rect(x, y, rects[num3].Width, rects[num3].Height);
						if (num3 - 1 >= 0)
						{
							num -= num4 + spacings[num3 - 1];
						}
					}
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < layoutCells.Length; i++)
			{
				if (layoutCells[i].DesiredAlignment == LayoutAlignment.Near)
				{
					double num5 = (horizontal ? rects[i].Width : rects[i].Height);
					double x2 = (horizontal ? num2 : rects[i].Left);
					double y2 = (horizontal ? rects[i].Top : num2);
					rects[i] = new Rect(x2, y2, rects[i].Width, rects[i].Height);
					if (i + 1 < layoutCells.Length)
					{
						num2 += num5 + spacings[i];
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < layoutCells.Length; j++)
			{
				if (layoutCells[j].DesiredAlignment == LayoutAlignment.Default)
				{
					double num6 = (horizontal ? rects[j].Width : rects[j].Height);
					double x3 = (horizontal ? num2 : rects[j].Left);
					double y3 = (horizontal ? rects[j].Top : num2);
					rects[j] = new Rect(x3, y3, rects[j].Width, rects[j].Height);
					if (j + 1 < layoutCells.Length)
					{
						num2 += num6 + spacings[j];
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

		internal bool IsMenuMode
		{
			get
			{
				return _bitFlags[4];
			}
			set
			{
				bool flag = _bitFlags[4];
				if (flag == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool flag2 = (_bitFlags[4] = value);
				flag = flag2;
				if (flag)
				{
					if (!IsDescendant(this, Mouse.Captured as Visual) && !DoCapture(this, CaptureMode.SubTree))
					{
						flag2 = (_bitFlags[4] = false);
						flag = flag2;
					}
					else
					{
						if (!HasPushedMenuMode)
						{
							PushMenuMode(isAcquireFocusMenuMode: false);
						}
						FocusOnOpen();
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					OnLeaveMenuMode();
					if (HasPushedMenuMode)
					{
						PopMenuMode();
					}
					if (HasCapture)
					{
						Mouse.Capture(null);
					}
					RestorePreviousFocus();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnPromotedMouseButton(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangedButton == MouseButton.Left)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private static void OnPreviewKeyboardInputProviderAcquireFocus(object sender, KeyboardInputProviderAcquireFocusEventArgs e)
		{
			FlyoutBase flyoutBase = (FlyoutBase)sender;
			if (!flyoutBase.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && !flyoutBase.HasPushedMenuMode)
			{
				flyoutBase.PushMenuMode(isAcquireFocusMenuMode: true);
			}
		}

		private static void OnKeyboardInputProviderAcquireFocus(object sender, KeyboardInputProviderAcquireFocusEventArgs e)
		{
			FlyoutBase flyoutBase = (FlyoutBase)sender;
			if (!flyoutBase.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && !e.FocusAcquired && flyoutBase.IsAcquireFocusMenuMode)
			{
				flyoutBase.PopMenuMode();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(e);
			if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				if (!IsMenuMode)
				{
					IsMenuMode = true;
				}
			}
			else if (IsMenuMode && HasCapture)
			{
				IsMenuMode = false;
			}
			InvokeMenuOpenedClosedAutomationEvent(base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin);
		}

		private void InvokeMenuOpenedClosedAutomationEvent(bool open)
		{
			AutomationEvents automationEvent = (open ? AutomationEvents.MenuOpened : AutomationEvents.MenuClosed);
			if (!AutomationPeer.ListenerExists(automationEvent))
			{
				return;
			}
			AutomationPeer peer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(this);
			if (peer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (open)
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Input, (DispatcherOperationCallback)delegate
				{
					peer.RaiseAutomationEvent(automationEvent);
					return (object)null;
				}, null);
			}
			else
			{
				peer.RaiseAutomationEvent(automationEvent);
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsDescendant(DependencyObject reference, DependencyObject node)
		{
			FlyoutBase flyoutBase = reference as FlyoutBase;
			FlyoutBase flyoutBase2 = node as FlyoutBase;
			if (flyoutBase != null && flyoutBase2 != null && FlyoutWrapper.IsDescendant((FlyoutBase)(object)flyoutBase.FlyoutControl, (FlyoutBase)(object)flyoutBase2.FlyoutControl))
			{
				return true;
			}
			bool result = false;
			for (DependencyObject dependencyObject = node; dependencyObject != null; dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject))
			{
				if (dependencyObject == reference)
				{
					result = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Escape:
				KeyboardLeaveMenuMode();
				e.Handled = true;
				Service.Do(delegate(FlyoutService x)
				{
					x.Hide(this);
				});
				break;
			case Key.System:
				if (e.SystemKey == Key.LeftAlt || e.SystemKey == Key.RightAlt || e.SystemKey == Key.F10)
				{
					KeyboardLeaveMenuMode();
					e.Handled = true;
					Service.Do(delegate(FlyoutService x)
					{
						x.Hide(this);
					});
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool DoCapture(IInputElement element, CaptureMode mode)
		{
			if (AllowMouseCapture)
			{
				return Mouse.Capture(element, mode);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void OnLostMouseCapture(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			FlyoutBase flyoutBase = sender as FlyoutBase;
			if (Mouse.Captured == flyoutBase)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.OriginalSource == flyoutBase)
			{
				if (Mouse.Captured == null || !IsDescendant(flyoutBase, Mouse.Captured as DependencyObject))
				{
					flyoutBase.IsMenuMode = false;
				}
			}
			else if (IsDescendant(flyoutBase, e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject))
			{
				if (flyoutBase.IsMenuMode && Mouse.Captured == null && Native.GetCapture() == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					Mouse.Capture(flyoutBase, CaptureMode.SubTree);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				flyoutBase.IsMenuMode = false;
			}
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		protected void RestorePreviousFocus()
		{
			if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				IntPtr focus = Native.GetFocus();
				HwndSource hwndSource = ((focus != IntPtr.Zero) ? HwndSource.FromHwnd(focus) : null);
				if (hwndSource != null)
				{
					Keyboard.Focus(null);
				}
				else
				{
					Keyboard.ClearFocus();
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void KeyboardLeaveMenuMode()
		{
			if (IsMenuMode)
			{
				IsMenuMode = false;
			}
			else
			{
				RestorePreviousFocus();
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnLeaveMenuMode()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void FocusOnOpen()
		{
			if (!base.IsKeyboardFocused && !base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				Focus();
			}
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		private void PushMenuMode(bool isAcquireFocusMenuMode)
		{
			_pushedMenuMode = PresentationSource.FromVisual(this);
			if (_pushedMenuMode != null)
			{
				IsAcquireFocusMenuMode = isAcquireFocusMenuMode;
				InputManager.Current.PushMenuMode(_pushedMenuMode);
			}
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		private void PopMenuMode()
		{
			if (_pushedMenuMode != null)
			{
				PresentationSource pushedMenuMode = _pushedMenuMode;
				_pushedMenuMode = null;
				IsAcquireFocusMenuMode = false;
				InputManager.Current.PopMenuMode(pushedMenuMode);
			}
		}

		static FlyoutBase()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FlyoutBase> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FlyoutBase>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideFrameworkMetadata(FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty, HorizontalAlignment.Center);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideFrameworkMetadata(FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty, VerticalAlignment.Center);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<UIElement>("IndicatorTarget", ref IndicatorTargetProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<FlyoutPlacement>("Placement", ref PlacementProperty, (FlyoutPlacement)1);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<UIElement>("PlacementTarget", ref PlacementTargetProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Style>("FlyoutStyle", ref FlyoutStyleProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsOpen", ref IsOpenProperty, defValue: false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)d).OnIsOpenChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ShowIndicator", ref ShowIndicatorProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttachedInherited<FlyoutBase>("Flyout", ref FlyoutProperty);
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(FlyoutBase), Mouse.LostMouseCaptureEvent, new MouseEventHandler(OnLostMouseCapture));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(FlyoutBase), Mouse.MouseDownEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPromotedMouseButton));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(FlyoutBase), Mouse.MouseUpEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPromotedMouseButton));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(FlyoutBase), Keyboard.PreviewKeyboardInputProviderAcquireFocusEvent, new KeyboardInputProviderAcquireFocusEventHandler(OnPreviewKeyboardInputProviderAcquireFocus), handledEventsToo: true);
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(FlyoutBase), Keyboard.KeyboardInputProviderAcquireFocusEvent, new KeyboardInputProviderAcquireFocusEventHandler(OnKeyboardInputProviderAcquireFocus), handledEventsToo: true);
			FocusManager.IsFocusScopeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(FlyoutBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true));
			Control.IsTabStopProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(FlyoutBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false));
			KeyboardNavigation.TabNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(FlyoutBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle));
			KeyboardNavigation.ControlTabNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(FlyoutBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.Contained));
			KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(FlyoutBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle));
			FrameworkElement.FocusVisualStyleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(FlyoutBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			InputMethod.IsInputMethodSuspendedProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(FlyoutBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));
		}

		protected FlyoutBase()

			AllowMouseCapture = true;

		private void OnFlyoutChanged(FlyoutControl oldValue, FlyoutControl value)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)oldValue).Opened -= OnFlyoutPopupOpened;
				((FlyoutBase)oldValue).Closed -= OnFlyoutPopupClosed;
				ClearValue(FlyoutBase.FlyoutProperty);
			}
			if (value != null)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)value).Opened += OnFlyoutPopupOpened;
				((FlyoutBase)value).Closed += OnFlyoutPopupClosed;
				FlyoutBase.SetFlyout((DependencyObject)this, (FlyoutBase)(object)value);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnFlyoutPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, (Action<object>)delegate(object x)
			{
				FlyoutBase flyoutBase = (FlyoutBase)x;
				if (!flyoutBase.IsOpen)
				{
					FocusManager.SetFocusedElement(flyoutBase, null);
				}
			}, this);
			IsMenuMode = false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnFlyoutPopupOpened(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			IsMenuMode = true;
		}

		private void RaiseOnClosed()
		{
			this.Closed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void RaiseOnOpened()
		{
			this.Opened?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnOpened()
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((FrameworkElement)(object)FlyoutControl).Style = FlyoutStyle;
			((FlyoutBase)FlyoutControl).PlacementTarget = PlacementTarget;
			((FlyoutBase)FlyoutControl).Settings = (FlyoutSettingsBase)new FlyoutSettings
			{
				Placement = Placement,
				IndicatorTarget = IndicatorTarget,
				ShowIndicator = ShowIndicator
			};
			NonLogicalContainer.Content = null;
			((ContentControl)(object)FlyoutControl).Content = NonLogicalContainer;
			NonLogicalContainer.Content = this;
			this.Forward((FrameworkElement)(object)FlyoutControl, FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty, "VerticalAlignment");
			this.Forward((FrameworkElement)(object)FlyoutControl, FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty, "HorizontalAlignment");
			this.Forward((FrameworkElement)(object)FlyoutControl, FlyoutBase.IsOpenProperty, "IsOpen", BindingMode.TwoWay);
			RaiseOnOpened();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsOpenChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (newValue)
			{
				if (FlyoutControl != null)
				{
					OnOpened();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (FlyoutControl != null)
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)FlyoutControl).ClearValue(FlyoutBase.IsOpenProperty);
			}
			RaiseOnClosed();
		}

		protected virtual void CloseCore()
		{
			if (CanClose)
			{
				IsOpen = false;
			}
		}

		public void Close(bool onClickThrough)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			CloseCore();
			if (flag)
			{
				Listener.Do(delegate(IFlyoutEventListener x)
				{
					x.OnFlyoutClosed(onClickThrough);
				});
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseDown(e);
			e.Handled = true;
		}
	}

	public class AssertionException : Exception
	{
		public static readonly string AssertionFails = "Assertion Fails";

		public AssertionException(string message)
			: base(message)
		{
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		[Conditional("DEBUGTEST")]
		public static void IsTrue(bool condition)
		{
			if (!condition)
			{
				throw new AssertionException(AssertionFails);
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		[Conditional("DEBUGTEST")]
		public static void IsFalse(bool condition)
		{
			if (condition)
			{
				throw new AssertionException(AssertionFails);
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		[Conditional("DEBUGTEST")]
		public static void IsTrue(bool condition, string message)
		{
			if (!condition)
			{
				throw new AssertionException(message);
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		[Conditional("DEBUGTEST")]
		public static void IsNotNull(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				throw new AssertionException(AssertionFails);
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		[Conditional("DEBUGTEST")]
		public static void IsNull(object obj)
		{
			if (obj != null)
			{
				throw new AssertionException(AssertionFails);
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		[Conditional("DEBUGTEST")]
		public static void IsNotNull(object obj, string message)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				throw new AssertionException(message);
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		[Conditional("DEBUGTEST")]
		public static void Is<T>(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is T))
			{
				throw new AssertionException(AssertionFails);
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		[Conditional("DEBUGTEST")]
		public static void Is<T>(object obj, string message)
		{
			if (!(obj is T))
			{
				throw new AssertionException(message);
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		[Conditional("DEBUGTEST")]
		public static void AreEqual(object obj1, object obj2)
		{
			if (!object.Equals(obj1, obj2))
			{
				throw new AssertionException(AssertionFails);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class DependencyPropertyRegistrator<OwnerType> where OwnerType : class
	{
		public void Register<T>(string name, ref DependencyProperty property, T defValue, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions options, PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{
			property = DependencyPropertyManager.Register(name, typeof(T), typeof(OwnerType), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(defValue, options, changed, coerce));
		}

		public void Register<T>(string name, ref DependencyProperty property, T defValue = default(T), PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{
			property = DependencyPropertyManager.Register(name, typeof(T), typeof(OwnerType), new PropertyMetadata(defValue, changed, coerce));
		}

		public void RegisterReadonly<T>(string name, ref DependencyPropertyKey propertyKey, ref DependencyProperty property, T defValue = default(T), PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{
			propertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly(name, typeof(T), typeof(OwnerType), new PropertyMetadata(defValue, changed, coerce));
			property = propertyKey.DependencyProperty;
		}

		public void RegisterAttached<T>(string name, ref DependencyProperty property, T defValue = default(T), PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{
			property = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached(name, typeof(T), typeof(OwnerType), new PropertyMetadata(defValue, changed, coerce));
		}

		public void RegisterAttachedReadonly<T>(string name, ref DependencyPropertyKey propertyKey, ref DependencyProperty property, T defValue = default(T), PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{
			propertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttachedReadOnly(name, typeof(T), typeof(OwnerType), new PropertyMetadata(defValue, changed, coerce));
			property = propertyKey.DependencyProperty;
		}

		public void RegisterAttachedInherited<T>(string name, ref DependencyProperty property, T defValue = default(T), PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{
			property = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached(name, typeof(T), typeof(OwnerType), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(defValue, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, changed, coerce));
		}

		public void RegisterAttachedReadonlyInherited<T>(string name, ref DependencyPropertyKey propertyKey, ref DependencyProperty property, T defValue = default(T), PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{
			propertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttachedReadOnly(name, typeof(T), typeof(OwnerType), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(defValue, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, changed, coerce));
			property = propertyKey.DependencyProperty;
		}

		public DependencyProperty AddOwner<T>(string name, DependencyProperty property, T defValue = default(T), PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{
			return property.AddOwner(typeof(OwnerType), new PropertyMetadata(defValue, changed, coerce));
		}

		public void OverrideMetadata<T>(DependencyProperty property, T defValue = default(T), PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{
			property.OverrideMetadata(typeof(OwnerType), new PropertyMetadata(defValue, changed, coerce));
		}

		public void OverrideMetadata<T>(DependencyPropertyKey propertyKey, T defValue = default(T), PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{
			propertyKey.OverrideMetadata(typeof(OwnerType), new PropertyMetadata(defValue, changed, coerce));
		}

		public void OverrideDefaultStyleKey(DependencyProperty propertyKey)
		{
			propertyKey.OverrideMetadata(typeof(OwnerType), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(OwnerType)));
		}

		public void OverrideUIMetadata<T>(DependencyProperty property, T defValue = default(T), PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{

		{

		{

			return property;

		public void OverrideMetadataNotDataBindable<T>(DependencyProperty property, T defValue = default(T), PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{

		}

	internal static class TransformExtensions
	{
		public static System.Windows.Point TransformToDeviceDPI(this Visual visual, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			Matrix transformToDevice = PresentationSource.FromVisual(visual).CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice;
			return new System.Windows.Point(pt.X / transformToDevice.M11, pt.Y / transformToDevice.M22);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Size TransformToDeviceDPI(this Visual visual, System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			Matrix transformToDevice = PresentationSource.FromVisual(visual).CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice;
			return new System.Windows.Size(size.Width / transformToDevice.M11, size.Height / transformToDevice.M22);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Size TransformFromDeviceDPI(this Visual visual, System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			Matrix transformToDevice = PresentationSource.FromVisual(visual).CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice;
			return new System.Windows.Size(size.Width * transformToDevice.M11, size.Height * transformToDevice.M22);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point TransformFromDeviceDPI(this Visual visual, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			Matrix transformToDevice = PresentationSource.FromVisual(visual).CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice;

		}

	internal static class MathHelper
	{
		public static double GetDimension(double value, double defaultDimension = 0.0)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return defaultDimension;
		}

		public static bool AreClose(double value1, double value2, double epsilon = 1E-09)
		{
			return Math.Abs(value1 - value2) < epsilon;
		}

		public static bool IsZero(double value, double epsilon = 1E-09)
		{
			return Math.Abs(value) < epsilon;
		}

		public static Rect Deflate(Rect rect, Thickness padding)
		{
			double dimension = GetDimension(padding.Left);
			double dimension2 = GetDimension(padding.Top);
			double dimension3 = GetDimension(padding.Right);
			double dimension4 = GetDimension(padding.Bottom);
			return new Rect(rect.Left + dimension, rect.Top + dimension2, Math.Max(0.0, rect.Width - (dimension + dimension3)), Math.Max(0.0, rect.Height - (dimension2 + dimension4)));
		}

		public static Rect Inflate(Rect rect, Thickness padding)
		{
			double dimension = GetDimension(padding.Left);
			double dimension2 = GetDimension(padding.Top);
			double dimension3 = GetDimension(padding.Right);
			double dimension4 = GetDimension(padding.Bottom);
			return new Rect(rect.Left - dimension, rect.Top - dimension2, rect.Width + (dimension + dimension3), rect.Height + (dimension2 + dimension4));
		}

		public static System.Windows.Size Deflate(System.Windows.Size size, Thickness padding)
		{
			double num = GetDimension(padding.Left) + GetDimension(padding.Right);
			double num2 = GetDimension(padding.Top) + GetDimension(padding.Bottom);
			return new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, size.Width - num), Math.Max(0.0, size.Height - num2));
		}

		public static System.Windows.Size Inflate(System.Windows.Size size, Thickness padding)
		{
			double num = GetDimension(padding.Left) + GetDimension(padding.Right);
			double num2 = GetDimension(padding.Top) + GetDimension(padding.Bottom);
			return new System.Windows.Size(size.Width + num, size.Height + num2);
		}

		public static Rect DeflateSize(System.Windows.Size size, Thickness padding)
		{
			return Deflate(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, size.Width, size.Height), padding);
		}

		public static Rect InflateSize(System.Windows.Size size, Thickness padding)
		{
			return Inflate(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, size.Width, size.Height), padding);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Size Union(IEnumerable<System.Windows.Size> sizes)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
			foreach (System.Windows.Size size2 in sizes)
			{
				size = Union(size, size2);
			}
			return size;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Size Union(System.Windows.Size size, System.Windows.Size s)
		{
			double width = Math.Max(GetDimension(s.Width), size.Width);
			double height = Math.Max(GetDimension(s.Height), size.Height);
			return new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
		}
	}
	internal static class XamlLoaderHelper
	{
		private static void TryPreventWindowShowing(ContentControl control)
		{
			if (control is Window window)
			{
				window.Close();
			}
		}

		public static object LoadContentFromUri(Uri uri)
		{
			object obj = null;
			object obj2 = Application.LoadComponent(uri);
			if (obj2 is ContentControl contentControl)
			{
				TryPreventWindowShowing(contentControl);
				if (contentControl is Window)
				{
					obj = contentControl.Content;
					contentControl.Content = null;
				}
				else
				{
					obj = contentControl;
				}
			}
			if (obj2 is Page page)
			{
				obj = page.Content;
				page.Content = null;
			}
			if (obj != obj2 && obj is DependencyObject && obj2 is DependencyObject)
			{
				NameScope.SetNameScope((DependencyObject)obj, NameScope.GetNameScope((DependencyObject)obj2));
			}
			return obj;
		}
	}
	public class veControlBase : Control, IDisposable
	{
		private bool _IsInitializingPropertyListener;

		public bool IsDisposing { get; private set; }

		protected static DependencyProperty RegisterPropertyListener(string propertyName)
		{
			return DependencyProperty.Register(propertyName + "Listener", typeof(object), typeof(veContentControlBase), new PropertyMetadata(delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				veControlBase veControlBase2 = (veControlBase)o;
				if (!veControlBase2._IsInitializingPropertyListener)
				{
					veControlBase2.OnPropertyChanged(e.Property, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
				}
			}));
		}

		public veControlBase()
		{
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			if (!IsDisposing)
			{
				IsDisposing = true;
				UnSubscribeEvents();
				OnDispose();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeEvents()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void UnSubscribeEvents()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnDispose()
		{
			ClearContainer();
		}

		protected virtual void ClearContainer()
		{
		}

		protected void AttachPropertyListener(string propertyName, DependencyProperty propertyListener, object source = null)
		{
			_IsInitializingPropertyListener = true;
			try
			{
				SetBinding(propertyListener, new Binding(propertyName)
				{
					Source = (source ?? this)
				});
			}
			finally
			{
				_IsInitializingPropertyListener = false;
			}
		}

		protected void DetachPropertyListener(DependencyProperty propertyListener)
		{
			_IsInitializingPropertyListener = true;
			try
			{
				ClearValue(propertyListener);
			}
			finally
			{
				_IsInitializingPropertyListener = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyProperty propertyListener, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
		}
	}

			}

			}
		}

		public bool HasHeaderTemplate => (bool)GetValue(HasHeaderTemplateProperty);

		static veHeaderedItemsControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<veHeaderedItemsControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<veHeaderedItemsControl>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("Header", ref HeaderProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((veHeaderedItemsControl)dObj).OnHeaderChanged(e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<string>("HeaderStringFormat", ref HeaderStringFormatProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((veHeaderedItemsControl)dObj).OnHeaderStringFormatChanged((string)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("HeaderTemplate", ref HeaderTemplateProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((veHeaderedItemsControl)dObj).OnHeaderTemplateChanged((DataTemplate)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("HeaderTemplateSelector", ref HeaderTemplateSelectorProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((veHeaderedItemsControl)dObj).OnHeaderTemplateSelectorChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("ActualHeader", ref ActualHeaderProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("HasHeader", ref HasHeaderProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((veHeaderedItemsControl)dObj).OnHasHeaderChanged();
			});

			{
				((veHeaderedItemsControl)dObj).OnHasHeaderTemplateChanged();
			});
		}

		}

		{
		}

		{
			SetValue(HasHeaderTemplateProperty, headerTemplate != null);
		}

		protected virtual void OnHeaderTemplateSelectorChanged()
		{
		}
	}

			ForegroundListener = RegisterPropertyListener("Foreground");
			BackgroundListener = RegisterPropertyListener("Background");
		}

		protected static DependencyProperty RegisterPropertyListener(string propertyName)
		{
			return DependencyProperty.Register(propertyName + "Listener", typeof(object), typeof(veContentControlBase), new PropertyMetadata(delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				veContentControlBase veContentControlBase2 = (veContentControlBase)o;
				if (!veContentControlBase2._IsInitializingPropertyListener)
				{
					veContentControlBase2.OnPropertyChanged(e.Property, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
				}
			}));
		}

		public veContentControlBase()
		{
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			if (!IsDisposing)
			{
				IsDisposing = true;
				UnSubscribeEvents();
				OnDispose();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeEvents()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void UnSubscribeEvents()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnDispose()
		{
			ClearContainer();
		}

		protected virtual void ClearContainer()
		{
			ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty);
			ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
		}

		protected void AttachPropertyListener(string propertyName, DependencyProperty propertyListener, object source = null)
		{
			_IsInitializingPropertyListener = true;
			try
			{
				SetBinding(propertyListener, new Binding(propertyName)
				{
					Source = (source ?? this)
				});
			}
			finally
			{
				_IsInitializingPropertyListener = false;
			}
		}

		protected void DetachPropertyListener(DependencyProperty propertyListener)
		{
			_IsInitializingPropertyListener = true;
			try
			{
				ClearValue(propertyListener);
			}
			finally
			{
				_IsInitializingPropertyListener = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyProperty propertyListener, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
		}
	}

	public abstract class veContentSelector : veSelector, IContentSelector, ISelector
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectedContentProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectedContentTemplateProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectedContentTemplateSelectorProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentTemplateSelectorProperty;

		public object SelectedContent
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(SelectedContentProperty);
			}
			protected set
			{
				SetValue(SelectedContentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate SelectedContentTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)GetValue(SelectedContentTemplateProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(SelectedContentTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplateSelector SelectedContentTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplateSelector)GetValue(SelectedContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(SelectedContentTemplateSelectorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate ContentTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)GetValue(ContentTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ContentTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplateSelector ContentTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplateSelector)GetValue(ContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ContentTemplateSelectorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static veContentSelector()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<veContentSelector> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<veContentSelector>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("SelectedContent", ref SelectedContentProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((veContentSelector)dObj).OnSelectedContentChanged(e.NewValue, e.OldValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("SelectedContentTemplate", ref SelectedContentTemplateProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((veContentSelector)dObj).OnSelectedContentTemplateChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("SelectedContentTemplateSelector", ref SelectedContentTemplateSelectorProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((veContentSelector)dObj).OnSelectedContentTemplateSelectorChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("ContentTemplate", ref ContentTemplateProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((veContentSelector)dObj).OnContentTemplateChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("ContentTemplateSelector", ref ContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
		}

		private void OnContentTemplateChanged()
		{
			UpdateSelectedContent();
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			UpdateSelectedContent();
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ClearValue(SelectedContentProperty);
			ClearValue(SelectedContentTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(SelectedContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSelectionChanged(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnSelectionChanged(e);
			UpdateSelectedContent();
		}

		protected override void OnApplyTemplateComplete()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplateComplete();
			UpdateSelectedContent();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedContentChanged(object newValue, object oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedContentTemplateChanged()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedContentTemplateSelectorChanged()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSelectedContent()
		{
			if (!base.IsLoaded)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.SelectedIndex < 0)
			{
				ClearValue(SelectedContentProperty);
				ClearValue(SelectedContentTemplateProperty);
				ClearValue(SelectedContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
				return;
			}
			IContentSelectorItem selectedItem = GetSelectedItem();
			if (selectedItem != null)
			{
				SelectedContent = selectedItem.Content;
				if (selectedItem.ContentTemplate != null || selectedItem.ContentTemplateSelector != null)
				{
					SelectedContentTemplate = selectedItem.ContentTemplate;
					SelectedContentTemplateSelector = selectedItem.ContentTemplateSelector;
					return;
				}
				SetBinding(SelectedContentTemplateProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath("ContentTemplate"),
					Source = this
				});
				SetBinding(SelectedContentTemplateSelectorProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath("ContentTemplateSelector"),
					Source = this
				});
			}
			else
			{
				SelectedContent = base.SelectedItem;
				SetBinding(SelectedContentTemplateProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath("ContentTemplate"),
					Source = this
				});
				SetBinding(SelectedContentTemplateSelectorProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath("ContentTemplateSelector"),
					Source = this
				});
			}
		}

		protected IContentSelectorItem GetSelectedItem()
		{
			if (base.SelectedItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object selectedItem = base.SelectedItem;
			IContentSelectorItem contentSelectorItem = selectedItem as IContentSelectorItem;
			if (contentSelectorItem == null)
			{
				contentSelectorItem = base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(base.SelectedIndex) as IContentSelectorItem;
			}
			return contentSelectorItem;
		}

		protected override void UpdateSelectionCore()
		{
			UpdateSelectedContent();
		}

		[SpecialName]
		int ISelector.get_SelectedIndex()
		{
			return base.SelectedIndex;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ISelector.set_SelectedIndex(int value)
		{
			base.SelectedIndex = value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		object ISelector.get_SelectedItem()
		{
			return base.SelectedItem;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ISelector.set_SelectedItem(object value)
		{
			base.SelectedItem = value;
		}
	}
	public abstract class veContentSelectorItem : veSelectorItem, IContentSelectorItem, ISelectorItem, IDisposable
	{
		protected internal virtual ClickMode SelectionMode => ClickMode.Press;

		object IContentSelectorItem.Content => base.Content;

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (SelectionMode == ClickMode.Press)
			{
				InvokeSelectInParentContainer();
			}
		}

		protected internal void InvokeSelectInParentContainer()
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				SelectInParentContainer();
			});
		}

		protected virtual bool SelectInParentContainer()
		{
			veItemsControl veItemsControl2 = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<veItemsControl>((DependencyObject)this);
			ISelector selector = base.Owner ?? (veItemsControl2 as ISelector);
			selector?.Select(this);
			return selector != null;
		}

		protected override void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool isSelected)
		{
			base.OnIsSelectedChanged(isSelected);
			if (isSelected)
			{
				veItemsControl veItemsControl2 = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<veItemsControl>((DependencyObject)this);
				(base.Owner ?? (veItemsControl2 as ISelector))?.Select(this);
			}
		}

		private void NotifyOwner()
		{
			if (base.Owner != null)
			{
				base.Owner.UpdateSelection();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnContentChanged(object oldContent, object newContent)
		{
			base.OnContentChanged(oldContent, newContent);
			NotifyOwner();
		}

		protected override void OnContentTemplateChanged(DataTemplate oldContentTemplate, DataTemplate newContentTemplate)
		{
			base.OnContentTemplateChanged(oldContentTemplate, newContentTemplate);
			NotifyOwner();
		}

		protected override void OnContentTemplateSelectorChanged(DataTemplateSelector oldContentTemplateSelector, DataTemplateSelector newContentTemplateSelector)
		{
			base.OnContentTemplateSelectorChanged(oldContentTemplateSelector, newContentTemplateSelector);
			NotifyOwner();
		}

		[SpecialName]
		DataTemplate IContentSelectorItem.get_ContentTemplate()
		{
			return base.ContentTemplate;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		DataTemplateSelector IContentSelectorItem.get_ContentTemplateSelector()
		{
			return base.ContentTemplateSelector;
		}
	}

		static veHeaderedContentControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<veHeaderedContentControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<veHeaderedContentControl>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("Header", ref HeaderProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("HeaderTemplateSelector", ref HeaderTemplateSelectorProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

			{
				((veHeaderedContentControl)dObj).OnHasHeaderChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("HasHeaderTemplate", ref HasHeaderTemplateProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((veHeaderedContentControl)dObj).OnHasHeaderTemplateChanged();
			});

		protected internal veHeaderedContentControl()
		{
			UpdateActualHeader(Header, HeaderStringFormat);
		}

		protected virtual void OnHeaderChanged(object oldHeader, object newHeader)
		{
			UpdateActualHeader(newHeader, HeaderStringFormat);
		}

		protected virtual void OnHeaderStringFormatChanged(string headerFormat)
		{
			UpdateActualHeader(Header, headerFormat);
		}

		private void UpdateActualHeader(object header, string headerFormat)
		{
			object actualHeader = HeaderedControlHelper.GetActualHeader(header, headerFormat, base.Language.IetfLanguageTag);
			SetValue(ActualHeaderProperty, actualHeader);
			SetValue(HasHeaderProperty, actualHeader != null);
		}

		protected virtual void OnHasHeaderChanged()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnHasHeaderTemplateChanged()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnHeaderTemplateChanged(DataTemplate headerTemplate)
		{
			SetValue(HasHeaderTemplateProperty, headerTemplate != null);
		}

		protected virtual void OnHeaderTemplateSelectorChanged()
		{
		}

		private void PrepareHeaderedContentControl(object item, DataTemplate itemTemplate, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector)
		{
			if (item != this)
			{
				if (!(item is UIElement) && Header == null)
				{
					Header = item;
				}
				if (itemTemplate != null && HeaderTemplate == null)
				{
					SetValue(HeaderTemplateProperty, itemTemplate);
				}
				if (itemTemplateSelector != null && HeaderTemplateSelector == null)
				{
					SetValue(HeaderTemplateSelectorProperty, itemTemplateSelector);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearContainer()
		{
			ClearValue(HeaderProperty);
			ClearValue(HeaderTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(HeaderTemplateSelectorProperty);
			ClearValue(HeaderStringFormatProperty);
			ClearValue(ActualHeaderProperty);
			base.ClearContainer();
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainer(object item, DataTemplate itemTemplate, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector)
		{
			PrepareHeaderedContentControl(item, itemTemplate, itemTemplateSelector);
		}
	}
	internal class HeaderedControlHelper
	{
		public static object GetActualHeader(object header, string headerFormat, string language)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(headerFormat) && header != null)
			{
				CultureInfo provider = new CultureInfo(language);
				if (header is string || header is DateTime)
				{
					return string.Format(provider, headerFormat, new object[1] { header });
				}
				if (header.GetType().IsPrimitive)
				{
					return string.Format(provider, headerFormat, new object[1] { header });
				}
			}
			return header;
		}
	}

		{
			SetValue(HasHeaderTemplateProperty, headerTemplate != null);
		}

		protected virtual void OnHeaderTemplateSelectorChanged()
		{
		}

		private void PrepareHeaderedContentControl(object item, DataTemplate itemTemplate, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector)
		{
			if (item != this)
			{
				if (!(item is UIElement))
				{
					Header = item;
				}
				if (itemTemplate != null)
				{
					SetValue(HeaderTemplateProperty, itemTemplate);
				}
				if (itemTemplateSelector != null)
				{
					SetValue(HeaderTemplateSelectorProperty, itemTemplateSelector);
				}
				ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentTemplateProperty);
				ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearContainer()
		{
			ClearValue(HeaderProperty);
			ClearValue(HeaderTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(HeaderTemplateSelectorProperty);
			ClearValue(HeaderStringFormatProperty);
			ClearValue(ActualHeaderProperty);
			base.ClearContainer();
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainer(object item, DataTemplate itemTemplate, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector)
		{
			PrepareHeaderedContentControl(item, itemTemplate, itemTemplateSelector);
		}
	}

	internal class LayoutTreeHelper
	{
		private class TemplateTreeEnumerator<TTemplatedParent> : IEnumerator<DependencyObject>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private DependencyObject Root;

			private Stack<DependencyObject> Stack;

			private Predicate<DependencyObject> Filter;

			private DependencyObject current;

			object IEnumerator.Current => current;

			public DependencyObject Current => current;

			public TemplateTreeEnumerator(DependencyObject root, Predicate<DependencyObject> filter)
			{
				Stack = new Stack<DependencyObject>(16);
				Filter = filter;
				Root = root;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				Reset();
				Stack = null;
				Filter = null;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				if (current == null)
				{
					current = Root;
				}
				else
				{
					int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(current);
					DependencyObject[] array = new DependencyObject[childrenCount];
					for (int i = 0; i < childrenCount; i++)
					{
						array[i] = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(current, i);
					}
					if (array.Length != 0)
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
						{
							DependencyObject dependencyObject = array[array.Length - 1 - j];
							if (!(dependencyObject is TTemplatedParent) && (Filter == null || Filter(dependencyObject)))
							{
								Stack.Push(dependencyObject);
							}
						}
					}
					current = ((Stack.Count > 0) ? Stack.Pop() : null);
				}
				return current != null;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				Stack.Clear();
				current = null;
			}
		}

		public static TTemplatedParent GetTemplateParent<TTemplatedParent>(DependencyObject dObj) where TTemplatedParent : DependencyObject
		{
			return GetTemplateParent<TTemplatedParent, Control>(dObj);
		}

		public static T GetTemplateParent<T, TTemplatedParent>(DependencyObject dObj) where T : DependencyObject where TTemplatedParent : DependencyObject
		{
			if (dObj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DependencyObject visualParent = GetVisualParent(dObj);
			while (visualParent != null && !(visualParent is T) && !(visualParent is TTemplatedParent))
			{
				visualParent = GetVisualParent(visualParent);
			}
			return visualParent as T;
		}

		public static bool IsTemplateChild<T>(DependencyObject dObj, T root) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			return FindParentObject<T>(dObj) == root;
		}

		public static T GetTemplateChild<T, TTemplatedParent>(DependencyObject element) where T : DependencyObject where TTemplatedParent : DependencyObject
		{
			T result = null;
			using (IEnumerator<DependencyObject> enumerator = GetEnumerator<TTemplatedParent>(element, null))
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (enumerator.Current is T)
					{
						result = enumerator.Current as T;
						return result;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static T GetTemplateChildByName<T, TTemplatedParent>(DependencyObject element, string name) where T : DependencyObject where TTemplatedParent : DependencyObject
		{
			T result = null;
			using (IEnumerator<DependencyObject> enumerator = GetEnumerator<TTemplatedParent>(element, null))
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (enumerator.Current is T && ((FrameworkElement)enumerator.Current).Name == name)
					{
						result = enumerator.Current as T;
						return result;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static T GetTemplateChild<T, TTemplatedParent>(DependencyObject element, bool acceptRoot) where T : DependencyObject where TTemplatedParent : DependencyObject
		{
			T result = null;
			using (IEnumerator<DependencyObject> enumerator = GetEnumerator<TTemplatedParent>(element, null))
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (enumerator.Current is T && (acceptRoot || enumerator.Current != element))
					{
						result = enumerator.Current as T;
						return result;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static T GetChild<T>(DependencyObject element) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			if (element != null && VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(element) == 1)
			{
				return VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(element, 0) as T;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static IEnumerator<DependencyObject> GetEnumerator<TTemplatedParent>(DependencyObject element, Predicate<DependencyObject> filter)
		{
			return new TemplateTreeEnumerator<TTemplatedParent>(element, filter);
		}

		private static DependencyObject GetVisualParent(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			return VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dObj);
		}

		private static T FindParentObject<T>(DependencyObject child) where T : class
		{
			while (child != null)
			{
				if (child is T)
				{
					return child as T;
				}
				child = GetVisualParent(child);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal static class LayoutCalculatorFactory
	{
		public static ILayoutCalculator Resolve(bool isHorz, PageHeadersLayoutType layoutType)
		{
			if (layoutType != PageHeadersLayoutType.Scroll)
			{
				return new ClipLayoutCalculator
				{
					IsHorizontal = isHorz
				};
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException("layoutType");
		}
	}
	public class ClipLayoutCalculator : ILayoutCalculator
	{
		public bool IsHorizontal { get; set; }

		public ClipLayoutCalculator()
		{
			IsHorizontal = true;
		}

		public ILayoutCalculatorResult Measure(ILayoutCalculatorOptions options)
		{
			Rect[] array = null;
			System.Windows.Size totalSize = default(System.Windows.Size);
			if (options != null)
			{
				array = GetRects(options);
				totalSize = GetTotalSize(options, array);
				for (int i = 0; i < options.Headers.Length; i++)
				{
					if (IsHorizontal)
					{
						if (array[i].Width != 0.0)
						{
							array[i].Height = totalSize.Height;
						}
					}
					else if (array[i].Height != 0.0)
					{
						array[i].Width = totalSize.Width;
					}
				}
			}
			return new BaseMeasureResult(array, totalSize);
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetTotalSize(ILayoutCalculatorOptions options, Rect[] rects)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			int num3 = 0;
			System.Windows.Size result = default(System.Windows.Size);
			for (int i = 0; i < rects.Length; i++)
			{
				if (IsHorizontal)
				{
					if (0.0 != rects[i].Width)
					{
						num += rects[i].Width;
						num3++;
					}
				}
				else if (0.0 != rects[i].Height)
				{
					num2 += rects[i].Height;
					num3++;
				}
			}
			if (num3 > 0)
			{
				if (IsHorizontal)
				{
					double num4 = options.AvailableSize.Height;
					if (double.IsInfinity(num4))
					{
						num4 = 0.0;
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < options.Headers.Length; j++)
					{
						if (rects[j].Width != 0.0)
						{
							num4 = Math.Max(num4, options.Headers[j].Header.Height);
						}
					}
					result.Height = num4;
					result.Width = num + (double)(num3 - 1) * options.Spacing;
				}
				else
				{
					double num5 = options.AvailableSize.Width;
					if (double.IsInfinity(num5))
					{
						num5 = 0.0;
					}
					for (int k = 0; k < options.Headers.Length; k++)
					{
						if (rects[k].Height != 0.0)
						{
							num5 = Math.Max(num5, options.Headers[k].Header.Width);
						}
					}
					result.Height = num2 + (double)(num3 - 1) * options.Spacing;
					result.Width = num5;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double GetLength(System.Windows.Size s)
		{
			if (!IsHorizontal)
			{
				return s.Height;
			}
			return s.Width;
		}

		private Rect[] GetRects(ILayoutCalculatorOptions options)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = 0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			bool flag2 = false;
			Rect[] array = null;
			bool flag3 = true;
			double length = GetLength(options.AvailableSize);
			IItemHeaderInfo[] headers = options.Headers;
			foreach (IItemHeaderInfo itemHeaderInfo in headers)
			{
				if (itemHeaderInfo.IsSelected)
				{
					flag = true;
					num = num2;
					double length2 = GetLength(itemHeaderInfo.Header);
					flag3 = length2 <= length;
					break;
				}
				num3 += GetLength(itemHeaderInfo.Header) + options.Spacing;
				num2++;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (!flag3)
				{
					return new Rect[options.Headers.Length];
				}
				flag2 = GetLength(options.Headers[num].Header) + num3 <= length;
			}
			int num4 = 0;
			double num5 = 0.0;
			if (!flag2 && flag)
			{
				IItemHeaderInfo[] headers2 = options.Headers;
				foreach (IItemHeaderInfo itemHeaderInfo2 in headers2)
				{
					if (num4 == num)
					{
						break;
					}
					double length3 = GetLength(itemHeaderInfo2.Header);
					num5 += length3 + options.Spacing;
					num4++;
					if (GetLength(options.Headers[num].Header) + num3 - num5 <= length)
					{
						flag2 = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag2 || !flag)
			{
				array = new Rect[options.Headers.Length];
				double num6 = 0.0;
				double num7 = 0.0;
				for (int k = num4; k < options.Headers.Length; k++)
				{
					double length4 = GetLength(options.Headers[k].Header);
					if (IsHorizontal)
					{
						if (num6 + length4 <= length)
						{
							array[k].Width = length4;
						}
						array[k].X = num6;
						num6 += length4 + options.Spacing;
					}
					else
					{
						if (num7 + length4 <= length)
						{
							array[k].Height = length4;
						}
						array[k].Y = num7;
						num7 += length4 + options.Spacing;
					}
				}
			}
			return array;
		}
	}

	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_ItemsPresenter", Type = typeof(System.Windows.Controls.ItemsPresenter))]
	public abstract class veSelector : veSelectorBase, ISelector
	{
		private int selectionLock;

		protected virtual bool RequiresSelectedItem => true;

		protected bool IsSelectionLocked => selectionLock > 0;

		protected override void OnItemContainerGeneratorStatusChanged()
		{
			if (RequiresSelectedItem)
			{
				EnsureSelectedItem();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnHasItemsChanged(bool hasItems)
		{
			base.OnHasItemsChanged(hasItems);
			if (RequiresSelectedItem)
			{
				EnsureSelectedItem();
			}
		}

		private void EnsureSelectedItem()
		{
			if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.Status == GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated && base.HasItems && base.SelectedItem == null)
			{
				selectionLock++;
				try
				{
					base.SelectedIndex = 0;
				}
				finally
				{
					selectionLock--;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSelectionChangedCore(IList removedItems, IList addedItems)
		{
			if (removedItems != null)
			{
				foreach (object item in removedItems)
				{
					DependencyObject dependencyObject = base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item);
					if (dependencyObject is ISelectorItem selectorItem && !addedItems.Return((IList x) => x.Contains(item), () => false))
					{
						selectorItem.IsSelected = false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (addedItems != null && addedItems.Count > 0)
			{
				object item2 = addedItems[addedItems.Count - 1];
				DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item2);
				if (dependencyObject2 is ISelectorItem selectorItem2)
				{
					selectorItem2.IsSelected = true;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanChangeSelection()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnItemsChanged(e);
			if (CanChangeSelection() && e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove && base.SelectedIndex == -1)
			{
				int num = e.OldStartingIndex + 1;
				if (num > base.Items.Count)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				ISelectorItem selectorItem = FindNextContainer(num, -1);
				if (selectorItem != null)
				{
					selectorItem.IsSelected = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private ISelectorItem FindNextContainer(int startIndex, int direction)
		{
			if (direction != 0)
			{
				int num = startIndex;
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Items.Count; i++)
				{
					num += direction;
					if (num >= base.Items.Count)
					{
						num = 0;
					}
					else if (num < 0)
					{
						num = base.Items.Count - 1;
					}
					ISelectorItem selectorItem = base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(num) as ISelectorItem;
					if (CheckItem(selectorItem))
					{
						return selectorItem;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual bool CheckItem(ISelectorItem item)
		{
			return item != null;
		}

		protected sealed override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return CreateSelectorItem() as DependencyObject;
		}

		protected abstract ISelectorItem CreateSelectorItem();

		protected sealed override void PrepareContainer(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainer(element, item);
			PrepareSelectorItem(element as ISelectorItem, item);
		}

		protected sealed override void ClearContainer(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			ClearSelectorItem(element as ISelectorItem, item);
			base.ClearContainer(element, item);
		}

		protected virtual void ClearSelectorItem(ISelectorItem selectorItem, object item)
		{
			if (selectorItem != null)
