	public abstract class VirtualizingScrollPanel : VirtualizingPanel, IScrollInfo
	{
		private class ScrollInfo
		{
			internal System.Windows.Point _offset;

			internal System.Windows.Size _viewport;

			internal System.Windows.Size _extent;
		}

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty ItemSizeModeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty;

		private const double WheelSize = 48.0;

		private ScrollInfo scrollInfo;

		internal int SelectedIndex;

		private bool MeasuredByInfinity;

		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Orientation)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected virtual double LineSizeHorizontal => 16.0;

		protected bool NeedMeasureEveryChild
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsAutoSize)
				{
					return MeasuredByInfinity;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsAutoSize => ItemSizeMode == ItemSizeMode.Auto;

		public ItemSizeMode ItemSizeMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (ItemSizeMode)GetValue(ItemSizeModeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ItemSizeModeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool CanHorizontallyScroll { get; set; }

		public bool CanVerticallyScroll { get; set; }

		public double ExtentHeight => scrollInfo._extent.Height;

		public double ExtentWidth => scrollInfo._extent.Width;

		public double HorizontalOffset => scrollInfo._offset.X;

		public ScrollViewer ScrollOwner { get; set; }

		public double VerticalOffset => scrollInfo._offset.Y;

		public double ViewportHeight => scrollInfo._viewport.Height;

		public double ViewportWidth => scrollInfo._viewport.Width;

		private static double ComputeScrollOffset(double topView, double bottomView, double topChild, double bottomChild)
		{
			bool flag = topChild < topView && bottomChild < bottomView;
			bool flag2 = bottomChild > bottomView && topChild > topView;
			bool flag3 = bottomChild - topChild > bottomView - topView;
			if (!flag && !flag2)
			{
				return topView;
			}
			if ((flag && !flag3) || (flag2 && flag3))
			{
				return topChild;
			}
			return bottomChild - (bottomView - topView);
		}

		static VirtualizingScrollPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<VirtualizingScrollPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<VirtualizingScrollPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ItemSizeMode", ref ItemSizeModeProperty, ItemSizeMode.Stretch, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((VirtualizingScrollPanel)d).OnItemSizeModeChanged((ItemSizeMode)e.OldValue, (ItemSizeMode)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Orientation", ref OrientationProperty, Orientation.Horizontal, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((UIElement)d).InvalidateMeasure();
			});
		}

		protected VirtualizingScrollPanel()
		{
			scrollInfo = new ScrollInfo();
			base.ClipToBounds = true;
		}

		protected virtual bool CanUpdateScrollInfoOnMeasure(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (!double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width))
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			MeasuredByInfinity = (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal && double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width)) || (Orientation == Orientation.Vertical && double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height));
			if (CanUpdateScrollInfoOnMeasure(availableSize))
			{
				UpdateScrollInfo(availableSize);
			}
			GetVisibleRange(availableSize, out var firstItemIndex, out var lastItemIndex);
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			IItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator = base.ItemContainerGenerator;
			GeneratorPosition position = itemContainerGenerator.GeneratorPositionFromIndex(firstItemIndex);
			int num = ((position.Offset == 0) ? position.Index : (position.Index + 1));
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				using (itemContainerGenerator.StartAt(position, GeneratorDirection.Forward, allowStartAtRealizedItem: true))
				{
					int num4 = firstItemIndex;
					while (num4 <= lastItemIndex)
					{
						bool isNewlyRealized;
						UIElement uIElement = itemContainerGenerator.GenerateNext(out isNewlyRealized) as UIElement;
						if (isNewlyRealized)
						{
							if (num >= internalChildren.Count)
							{
								AddInternalChild(uIElement);
							}
							else
							{
								InsertInternalChild(num, uIElement);
							}
							itemContainerGenerator.PrepareItemContainer(uIElement);
						}
						if (IsAutoSize)
						{
							System.Windows.Size availableSize2 = ((Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, availableSize.Height) : new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width, double.PositiveInfinity));
							uIElement.Measure(availableSize2);
						}
						else
						{
							uIElement.Measure(availableSize);
						}
						num2 = Math.Max(uIElement.DesiredSize.Width, num2);
						num3 = Math.Max(uIElement.DesiredSize.Height, num3);
						num4++;
						num++;
					}
				}
				CleanUpItems(firstItemIndex, lastItemIndex);
			}
			num3 = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) ? num3 : availableSize.Height);
			num2 = (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) ? num2 : availableSize.Width);
			System.Windows.Size size;
			if (IsAutoSize)
			{
				if (SelectedIndex >= 0 && SelectedIndex < internalChildren.Count)
				{
					System.Windows.Size desiredSize = internalChildren[SelectedIndex].DesiredSize;
					size = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Min(desiredSize.Width, availableSize.Width), Math.Min(desiredSize.Height, availableSize.Height));
				}
				else
				{
					size = default(System.Windows.Size);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				size = new System.Windows.Size(num2, num3);
			}
			if (CanUpdateScrollInfoOnMeasure(availableSize) || IsAutoSize)
			{
				UpdateScrollInfo(size);
			}
			return size;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (IsAutoSize)
			{
				finalSize.Width = ViewportWidth;
				finalSize.Height = ViewportHeight;
			}
			IItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator = base.ItemContainerGenerator;
			UpdateScrollInfo(finalSize);
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = base.Children[i];
				if (IsAutoSize)
				{
					Rect finalRect;
					if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
					{
						finalRect = new Rect(num, VerticalOffset, uIElement.DesiredSize.Width, finalSize.Height);
						num += uIElement.DesiredSize.Width;
					}
					else
					{
						finalRect = new Rect(HorizontalOffset, num, finalSize.Width, uIElement.DesiredSize.Height);
						num += uIElement.DesiredSize.Height;
					}
					uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
				}
				else
				{
					int childIndex = itemContainerGenerator.IndexFromGeneratorPosition(new GeneratorPosition(i, 0));
					ArrangeChild(childIndex, uIElement, finalSize);
				}
			}
			AfterArrange();
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected virtual void AfterArrange()
		{
		}

		private void UpdateScrollInfo(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			ItemsControl itemsOwner = ItemsControl.GetItemsOwner(this);
			int count = itemsOwner.Items.Count;
			System.Windows.Size extent = CalculateExtent(availableSize, count);
			InvalidateScrollInfo(availableSize, extent);
		}

		protected virtual void CleanUpItems(int minDesiredGenerated, int maxDesiredGenerated)
		{
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			IItemContainerGenerator itemContainerGenerator = base.ItemContainerGenerator;
			for (int num = internalChildren.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				GeneratorPosition position = new GeneratorPosition(num, 0);
				int num2 = itemContainerGenerator.IndexFromGeneratorPosition(position);
				if (num2 < minDesiredGenerated || num2 > maxDesiredGenerated)
				{
					itemContainerGenerator.Remove(position, 1);
					RemoveInternalChildRange(num, 1);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(object sender, ItemsChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			switch (args.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				RemoveInternalChildRange(args.Position.Index, args.ItemUICount);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemSizeModeChanged(ItemSizeMode oldValue, ItemSizeMode newValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual Rect MakeVisibleCore(Rect rectangle)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(HorizontalOffset, VerticalOffset, ViewportWidth, ViewportHeight);
			rectangle.X += rect.X;
			rectangle.Y += rect.Y;
			rect.X = ComputeScrollOffset(rect.Left, rect.Right, rectangle.Left, rectangle.Right);
			rect.Y = ComputeScrollOffset(rect.Top, rect.Bottom, rectangle.Top, rectangle.Bottom);
			SetHorizontalOffset(rect.X);
			SetVerticalOffset(rect.Y);
			rectangle.Intersect(rect);
			rectangle.X -= rect.X;
			rectangle.Y -= rect.Y;
			return rectangle;
		}

		protected void InvalidateScrollInfo(System.Windows.Size viewport, System.Windows.Size extent)
		{
			if (double.IsInfinity(viewport.Width))
			{
				viewport.Width = extent.Width;
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(viewport.Height))
			{
				viewport.Height = extent.Height;
			}
			scrollInfo._extent = extent;
			scrollInfo._viewport = viewport;
			System.Windows.Point point = ((!IsAutoSize) ? new System.Windows.Point(Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(scrollInfo._offset.X, ExtentWidth - ViewportWidth)), Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(scrollInfo._offset.Y, ExtentHeight - ViewportHeight))) : new System.Windows.Point(Math.Max(0.0, scrollInfo._offset.X), Math.Max(0.0, scrollInfo._offset.Y)));
			if (double.IsNaN(point.X))
			{
				point.X = 0.0;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(point.Y))
			{
				point.Y = 0.0;
			}
			scrollInfo._offset.X = point.X;
			scrollInfo._offset.Y = point.Y;
			if (ScrollOwner != null)
			{
				ScrollOwner.InvalidateScrollInfo();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnHorizontalOffsetChanged(double offset)
		{
			InvalidateArrange();
		}

		protected virtual void OnVerticalOffsetChanged(double offset)
		{
			InvalidateArrange();
		}

		protected virtual double CalculateOffset(double extent, double viewport, double desiredOffset)
		{
			desiredOffset = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(desiredOffset, extent - viewport));
			return desiredOffset;
		}

		protected System.Windows.Point GetScrollOffset()
		{
			return scrollInfo._offset;
		}

		protected abstract void ArrangeChild(int childIndex, UIElement child, System.Windows.Size finalSize);

		protected abstract System.Windows.Size CalculateExtent(System.Windows.Size availableSize, int itemsCount);

		protected abstract void GetVisibleRange(System.Windows.Size size, out int firstItemIndex, out int lastItemIndex);

		public void LineDown()
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(VerticalOffset + LineSizeHorizontal);
		}

		public void LineLeft()
		{
			SetHorizontalOffset(HorizontalOffset - LineSizeHorizontal);
		}

		public void LineRight()
		{
			SetHorizontalOffset(HorizontalOffset + LineSizeHorizontal);
		}

		public void LineUp()
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(VerticalOffset - LineSizeHorizontal);
		}

		public Rect MakeVisible(Visual visual, Rect rectangle)
		{
			if (rectangle.IsEmpty || visual == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (!IsAncestorOf(visual))
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			rectangle = visual.TransformToAncestor(this).TransformBounds(rectangle);
			return MakeVisibleCore(rectangle);
		}

		public void MouseWheelDown()
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(VerticalOffset + 48.0);
		}

		public void MouseWheelLeft()
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(VerticalOffset + 48.0);
		}

		public void MouseWheelRight()
		{
			SetHorizontalOffset(HorizontalOffset + 48.0);
		}

		public void MouseWheelUp()
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(VerticalOffset - 48.0);
		}

		public void PageDown()
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(VerticalOffset + ViewportHeight);
		}

		public void PageLeft()
		{
			SetHorizontalOffset(HorizontalOffset - ViewportWidth);
		}

		public void PageRight()
		{
			SetHorizontalOffset(HorizontalOffset + ViewportWidth);
		}

		public void PageUp()
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(VerticalOffset - ViewportHeight);
		}

		public void SetHorizontalOffset(double offset)
		{
			offset = CalculateOffset(scrollInfo._extent.Width, scrollInfo._viewport.Width, offset);
			if (offset != scrollInfo._offset.X)
			{
				scrollInfo._offset.X = offset;
				OnHorizontalOffsetChanged(offset);
			}
		}

		public void SetVerticalOffset(double offset)
		{
			offset = CalculateOffset(scrollInfo._extent.Height, scrollInfo._viewport.Height, offset);
			if (offset != scrollInfo._offset.Y)
			{
				scrollInfo._offset.Y = offset;
				OnVerticalOffsetChanged(offset);
			}
		}
	}
}

		static NavigationBarItem()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(NavigationBarItem);
			DisplayModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DisplayMode", typeof(ItemDisplayMode), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(ItemDisplayMode.Default, OnDisplayModeChanged));
			GlyphAlignmentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GlyphAlignment", typeof(Dock), typeFromHandle, new UIPropertyMetadata(Dock.Left));
			GlyphProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Glyph", typeof(ImageSource), typeFromHandle);
			IsGlyphActuallyVisiblePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsGlyphActuallyVisible", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new UIPropertyMetadata(true, OnIsGlyphActuallyVisibleChanged, OnCoerceIsGlyphActuallyVisible));
			IsGlyphActuallyVisibleProperty = IsGlyphActuallyVisiblePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsContentActuallyVisiblePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsContentActuallyVisible", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new UIPropertyMetadata(true, OnIsContentActuallyVisibleChanged, OnCoerceIsContentActuallyVisible));
			IsContentActuallyVisibleProperty = IsContentActuallyVisiblePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FlyoutProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Flyout", typeof(FlyoutBase), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnFlyoutChanged));
			HasPeekFormPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("HasPeekForm", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			HasPeekFormProperty = HasPeekFormPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CustomizationCaptionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CustomizationCaption", typeof(object), typeFromHandle);
			CustomizationCaptionTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CustomizationCaptionTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle);
			CustomizationCaptionTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CustomizationCaptionTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle);
			OrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Orientation", typeof(Orientation), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(Orientation.Horizontal, OnOrientationChanged));
			PeekFormTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PeekFormTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnPeekFormTemplateChanged));
			PeekFormTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PeekFormTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnPeekFormTemplateSelectorChanged));
			IsCompactPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("IsCompact", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false, OnIsCompactChanged));
			IsCompactProperty = IsCompactPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
		}

		internal void ShowPeekForm()
		{
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ShowPeekTimer.Stop();
			EnsurePeekForm();
			if (!HasPeekForm || !(base.Owner is OfficeNavigationBar { ShowPeekFormOnItemHover: not false }))
			{
				return;
			}
			IFlyoutProvider flyoutProvider = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<IFlyoutProvider>((DependencyObject)this);
			if (flyoutProvider != null)
			{
				Flyout.FlyoutControl = flyoutProvider.FlyoutControl;
				Flyout.PlacementTarget = this;
				Flyout.Placement = flyoutProvider.Placement;
				IFlyoutEventListener flyoutEventListener = flyoutProvider.FlyoutEventListener;
				if (flyoutEventListener != null && flyoutEventListener != this)
				{
					flyoutEventListener.Flyout.FlyoutControl = null;
					flyoutEventListener.Flyout.IsOpen = false;
				}
				flyoutProvider.FlyoutEventListener = this;
			}
			Flyout.IsOpen = true;
		}

		private void OnShowPeekTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ShowPeekForm();
		}

		private void EnsurePeekForm()
		{
			if (HasPeekForm)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = null;
			dataTemplate = PeekFormTemplate;
			if (PeekFormTemplateSelector != null)
			{
				dataTemplate = PeekFormTemplateSelector.SelectTemplate(base.Content, this);
			}
			if (dataTemplate != null)
			{
				object obj = dataTemplate.LoadContent();
				FlyoutBase flyoutBase = obj as FlyoutBase;
				if (flyoutBase == null)
				{
					flyoutBase = new Flyout
					{
						ContentTemplate = dataTemplate
					};
				}
				Flyout = flyoutBase;
			}
		}

		private void HidePeekForm()
		{
			if (HasPeekForm)
			{
				IFlyoutProvider flyoutProvider = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<IFlyoutProvider>((DependencyObject)this);
				if (flyoutProvider != null && flyoutProvider.FlyoutEventListener == this)
				{
					Flyout.IsOpen = false;
					return;
				}
				Flyout.FlyoutControl = null;
				Flyout.IsOpen = false;
			}
		}

		private void OnHidePeekTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			HidePeekTimer.Stop();
			HidePeekForm();
		}

		private void ShowPeekOnMouseEnter()
		{
			ShowPeekTimer.Stop();
			HidePeekTimer.Stop();
			if (base.Owner is OfficeNavigationBar { ShowPeekFormOnItemHover: not false } officeNavigationBar)
			{
				int num = ((officeNavigationBar.NavigationClient != null) ? officeNavigationBar.NavigationClient.PeekFormShowDelay : officeNavigationBar.PeekFormShowDelay);
				ShowPeekTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(num);
				ShowPeekTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		private void HidePeekOnMouseLeave()
		{
			StartPeekFormHide();
		}

		private void StartPeekFormHide(bool immediately = false)
		{
			ShowPeekTimer.Stop();
			HidePeekTimer.Stop();
			if (base.Owner is OfficeNavigationBar { ShowPeekFormOnItemHover: not false } officeNavigationBar)
			{
				if (immediately)
				{
					HidePeekForm();
					return;
				}
				int num = ((officeNavigationBar.NavigationClient != null) ? officeNavigationBar.NavigationClient.PeekFormHideDelay : officeNavigationBar.PeekFormHideDelay);
				HidePeekTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(num);
				HidePeekTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			ShowPeekOnMouseEnter();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			if (!base.IsMouseOver && !base.IsKeyboardFocused && !base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				HidePeekOnMouseLeave();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnFlyoutChanged(FlyoutBase oldValue, FlyoutBase newValue)
		{
			SetValue(HasPeekFormPropertyKey, newValue != null);
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(oldValue);
				logicalChildren.Remove(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				AddLogicalChild(newValue);
				logicalChildren.Add(newValue);
				newValue.AllowMouseCapture = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnOrientationChanged(Orientation oldValue, Orientation newValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnPeekFormTemplateChanged(DataTemplate oldValue, DataTemplate newValue)
		{
			HidePeekForm();
			Flyout = null;
		}

		protected virtual void OnPeekFormTemplateSelectorChanged(DataTemplateSelector oldValue, DataTemplateSelector newValue)
		{
			HidePeekForm();
			Flyout = null;
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsCompactChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(IsContentActuallyVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(IsGlyphActuallyVisibleProperty);
		}

		protected override ControlControllerBase CreateController()
		{
			return (ControlControllerBase)(object)new NavigationBarItemController(this);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new NavigationBarItemAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnFlyoutClosed()
		{
		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnFlyoutOpened()
		{
		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnMouseLeave()
		{
			HidePeekOnMouseLeave();
		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnMouseEnter()
		{
			ShowPeekOnMouseEnter();
		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnFlyoutClosed(bool onClickThrough)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

		internal NavigationBarButton CustomizationButton
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0061: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (_CustomizationButton == null)
				{
					_CustomizationButton = new NavigationBarCustomizationButton();
					_CustomizationButton.Command = ShowCustomizationMenuCommand;
					BarManager.SetDXContextMenu((UIElement)_CustomizationButton, (IPopupControl)(object)CustomizationHelper.NavigationBarCustomizationMenu);
					_CustomizationButton.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, new Binding("IsCustomizationButtonVisible")
					{
						Source = this,
						Converter = (IValueConverter)new BoolToVisibilityConverter()
					});
				}
				return _CustomizationButton;
			}
		}

		private Collection<NavigationBarButton> DefaultButtons
		{
			get
			{
				if (_DefaultButtons == null)
				{
					_DefaultButtons = new NavigationBarButtonCollection();
					_DefaultButtons.Add(CustomizationButton);
				}
				return _DefaultButtons;
			}
		}

		private DelegateCommand ShowCustomizationMenuCommand
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ShowCustomizationMenuCommand == null)

					_ShowCustomizationMenuCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
					{
						ContextMenuManager.ShowElementContextMenu((object)CustomizationButton, (ContextMenuOpenReason)0);

				return _ShowCustomizationMenuCommand;
			}

		FlyoutControl IFlyoutProvider.FlyoutControl => PartFlyoutControl;

		FlyoutPlacement IFlyoutProvider.Placement
		{
			get
			{
				if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					return (FlyoutPlacement)1;
				}
				return (FlyoutPlacement)2;
			}
		}

		static OfficeNavigationBar()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(OfficeNavigationBar);
			ItemSpacingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemSpacing", typeof(double), typeFromHandle);
			IsCompactProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsCompact", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false, OnIsCompactChanged));
			MaxItemCountProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MaxItemCount", typeof(int), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(-1, OnMaxItemCountChanged));
			CustomButtonsAttachedBehaviorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("CustomButtonsAttachedBehavior", typeof(ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<OfficeNavigationBar, NavigationBarButton>), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new UIPropertyMetadata(null));
			CustomButtonsSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CustomButtonsSource", typeof(IEnumerable), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnCustomButtonsSourcePropertyChanged));
			CustomButtonTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CustomButtonTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnCustomButtonTemplatePropertyChanged));
			CustomButtonTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CustomButtonTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnCustomButtonTemplatePropertyChanged));
			CustomButtonStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CustomButtonStyle", typeof(Style), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnCustomButtonTemplatePropertyChanged));
			ButtonsAlignmentPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ButtonsAlignment", typeof(Dock), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(Dock.Right));
			ButtonsAlignmentProperty = ButtonsAlignmentPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			OrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Orientation", typeof(Orientation), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(Orientation.Horizontal, OnOrientationChanged));
			ItemOrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemOrientation", typeof(Orientation), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(Orientation.Horizontal));
			AllowItemDragDropProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowItemDragDrop", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle);
			CustomizationButtonVisibilityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CustomizationButtonVisibility", typeof(CustomizationButtonVisibility), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(CustomizationButtonVisibility.ShowAfterItems, OnCustomizationButtonVisibilityChanged));
			IsCustomizationButtonVisibleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsCustomizationButtonVisible", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true));
			NavigationClientProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("NavigationClient", typeof(INavigatorClient), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnNavigationClientChanged));
			ShowPeekFormOnItemHoverProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowPeekFormOnItemHover", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true));
			PeekFormShowDelayProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PeekFormShowDelay", typeof(int), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(700));
			PeekFormHideDelayProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PeekFormHideDelay", typeof(int), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(400));
			Selector.SelectedItemProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, (DependencyObject d, object value) => ((OfficeNavigationBar)d).OnCoerceSelectedItem(value)));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<OfficeNavigationBar>();
		}

			//IL_0023: Expected O, but got Unknown

		public OfficeNavigationBar()
		{
			new FlyoutManager(this).Register(this, new InternalFlyoutEventListener
			{
				Owner = this
			});
			ValuesProvider = new NavigationBarThemeDependentValuesProvider();
		}

		internal void LockSelection()
		{
			SelectionLocker.Lock();
		}

		internal void UnlockSelection()
		{
			SelectionLocker.Unlock();
		}

		protected override bool CanChangeSelection()
		{
			if (!SelectionLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return base.CanChangeSelection();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void ClearSelectorItem(ISelectorItem selectorItem, object item)
		{
			base.ClearSelectorItem(selectorItem, item);
			if (selectorItem == _FlyoutEventListener)
			{
				_FlyoutEventListener = null;
			}
			if (selectorItem is NavigationBarItem navigationBarItem)
			{
				navigationBarItem.ClearValue(NavigationBarItem.IsCompactPropertyKey);
				navigationBarItem.ClearValue(NavigationBarItem.OrientationProperty);
				INavigationItem val = (INavigationItem)((item is INavigationItem) ? item : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					navigationBarItem.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
					navigationBarItem.ClearValue(NavigationBarItem.PeekFormTemplateProperty);
					navigationBarItem.ClearValue(NavigationBarItem.PeekFormTemplateSelectorProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearTemplateChildren()
		{
			base.ClearTemplateChildren();
			if (PartButtonsItemsControl != null && !LayoutTreeHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartButtonsItemsControl, this))
			{
				PartButtonsItemsControl.ItemsSource = null;
			}
			if (PartFlyoutControl != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeFlyoutEvents();
			}
		}

		protected override ISelectorItem CreateSelectorItem()
		{
			return new NavigationBarItem();
		}

		protected override void EnsureItemsPanelCore(Panel itemsPanel)
		{
			base.EnsureItemsPanelCore(itemsPanel);
			if (itemsPanel is NavigationBarItemsPanel navigationBarItemsPanel)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)(object)navigationBarItemsPanel).SetBinding(LayoutPanelBase.ItemSpacingProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("ItemSpacing")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				((FrameworkElement)(object)navigationBarItemsPanel).SetBinding(NavigationBarItemsPanel.MaxItemCountProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("MaxItemCount")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				((FrameworkElement)(object)navigationBarItemsPanel).SetBinding(FlowLayoutPanel.OrientationProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("Orientation")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				((FrameworkElement)(object)navigationBarItemsPanel).SetBinding(FlowLayoutPanel.AllowItemMovingProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("AllowItemDragDrop")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				navigationBarItemsPanel.Owner = this;
			}
		}

		protected override void GetTemplateChildren()
		{
			base.GetTemplateChildren();
			PartButtonsItemsControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_ButtonsItemsControl") as ItemsControl;
			ref FlyoutControl partFlyoutControl = ref PartFlyoutControl;
			DependencyObject templateChild = GetTemplateChild("PART_FlyoutControl");
			partFlyoutControl = (FlyoutControl)(object)((templateChild is FlyoutControl) ? templateChild : null);
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (index < base.VisualChildrenCount)
			{
				return base.GetVisualChild(index);
			}
			return ValuesProvider;
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is NavigationBarItem;
		}

		protected override void OnApplyTemplateComplete()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplateComplete();
			if (PartButtonsItemsControl != null)
			{
				CompositeCollection compositeCollection = new CompositeCollection();
				compositeCollection.Add(new CollectionContainer
				{
					Collection = DefaultButtons
				});
				compositeCollection.Add(new CollectionContainer
				{
					Collection = CustomButtons
				});
				PartButtonsItemsControl.ItemsSource = compositeCollection;
			}
			if (PartFlyoutControl != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeFlyoutEvents();
				SubscribeFlyoutEvents();
			}
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual object OnCoerceSelectedItem(object value)
		{
			if (!CanChangeSelection())
			{
				return base.SelectedItem;
			}
			return Selector.SelectedItemProperty.GetMetadata(typeof(veSelector)).CoerceValueCallback(this, value);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new OfficeNavigationBarAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnCustomizationButtonVisibilityChanged(CustomizationButtonVisibility oldValue, CustomizationButtonVisibility newValue)
		{
			SetValue(IsCustomizationButtonVisibleProperty, newValue != CustomizationButtonVisibility.Hidden);
			UpdateButtonsAlignment();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsCompactChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (NavigationClient != null)
			{
				NavigationClient.Compact = newValue;
				UpdateCompactState();
			}
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is NavigationBarItem navigationBarItem)
				{
					navigationBarItem.IsCompact = newValue;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnItemsChanged(e);
			CustomizationHelper.InvalidateState();
			if (NetVersionDetector.IsNet8())
			{
				UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(this)?.ResetChildrenCache();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			AddValuesProvider();
		}

		protected virtual void OnMaxItemCountChanged(int oldValue, int newValue)
		{
			if (NavigationClient != null)
			{
				NavigationClient.MaxVisibleItems = newValue;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnNavigationClientChanged(INavigatorClient oldValue, INavigatorClient newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				ClearValue(ItemsControl.ItemsSourceProperty);
				((INotifyPropertyChanged)oldValue).PropertyChanged -= OnNavigatorClientPropertyChanged;
				if (oldValue.MenuActions != null)
				{
					oldValue.MenuActions.Remove((IBarManagerControllerAction)(object)CustomizationHelper.NavigationOptionsBarItem);
				}
				oldValue.IsAttached = false;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				if (newValue.Items != null)
				{
					base.ItemsSource = newValue.Items;
				}
				base.SelectedItem = newValue.SelectedItem;
				if (newValue.AcceptsCompactNavigation)
				{
					IsCompact = newValue.Compact;
				}
				((INotifyPropertyChanged)newValue).PropertyChanged += OnNavigatorClientPropertyChanged;
				if (base.ItemTemplateSelector == null && base.IsInitialized)
				{
					base.ItemTemplateSelector = this.FindResource<DataTemplateSelector>("navigationItemTemplateSelector");
				}
				if (newValue.MenuActions != null)
				{
					newValue.MenuActions.Add((IBarManagerControllerAction)(object)CustomizationHelper.NavigationOptionsBarItem);
				}
				newValue.IsAttached = true;
			}
			UpdateCompactState();
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			if (base.ItemTemplateSelector == null)
			{
				base.ItemTemplateSelector = this.FindResource<DataTemplateSelector>("navigationItemTemplateSelector");
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnOrientationChanged(Orientation oldValue, Orientation newValue)
		{
			UpdateButtonsAlignment();
			UpdateOrientationState();
		}

		protected override void OnSelectedItemChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.OnSelectedItemChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (NavigationClient != null)
			{
				INavigationItem val = (INavigationItem)((newValue is INavigationItem) ? newValue : null);
				NavigationClient.SelectedItem = val;
				if (val != null && !base.IsSelectionLocked)
				{
					CommandHelper.ExecuteCommand((ICommandSource)val);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareSelectorItem(ISelectorItem selectorItem, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareSelectorItem(selectorItem, item);
			if (selectorItem is NavigationBarItem navigationBarItem)
			{
				navigationBarItem.IsCompact = IsCompact;
				navigationBarItem.SetBinding(NavigationBarItem.OrientationProperty, new Binding("ItemOrientation")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				INavigationItem val = (INavigationItem)((item is INavigationItem) ? item : null);
				if (NavigationClient != null && val != null)
				{
					navigationBarItem.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, new Binding("DataContext")
					{
						Source = val
					});
					navigationBarItem.SetBinding(NavigationBarItem.PeekFormTemplateProperty, new Binding("PeekFormTemplate")
					{
						Source = val
					});
					navigationBarItem.SetBinding(NavigationBarItem.PeekFormTemplateSelectorProperty, new Binding("PeekFormTemplateSelector")
					{
						Source = val
					});
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReleaseItemsPanelCore(Panel itemsPanel)
		{
			if (itemsPanel is NavigationBarItemsPanel navigationBarItemsPanel)
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)navigationBarItemsPanel).ClearValue(LayoutPanelBase.ItemSpacingProperty);
				((DependencyObject)(object)navigationBarItemsPanel).ClearValue(NavigationBarItemsPanel.MaxItemCountProperty);
				((DependencyObject)(object)navigationBarItemsPanel).ClearValue(FlowLayoutPanel.OrientationProperty);
				((DependencyObject)(object)navigationBarItemsPanel).ClearValue(FlowLayoutPanel.AllowItemMovingProperty);
				navigationBarItemsPanel.Owner = null;
			}
			base.ReleaseItemsPanelCore(itemsPanel);
		}

		private void AddValuesProvider()
		{
			if (ValuesProvider.Parent != this)
			{
				((ILogicalOwner)this).AddChild((object)ValuesProvider);
				AddVisualChild(ValuesProvider);
			}
		}

		private void OnCustomButtonsSourceChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewValue is IEnumerable || e.OldValue is IEnumerable)
			{
				ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<OfficeNavigationBar, NavigationBarButton>.OnItemsSourcePropertyChanged((DependencyObject)this, e, CustomButtonsAttachedBehaviorProperty, CustomButtonTemplateProperty, CustomButtonTemplateSelectorProperty, CustomButtonStyleProperty, (Func<OfficeNavigationBar, IList>)((OfficeNavigationBar control) => control.CustomButtons), (Func<OfficeNavigationBar, NavigationBarButton>)((OfficeNavigationBar category) => new NavigationBarButton()), (Action<int, object>)null, (Action<NavigationBarButton>)null, (ISupportInitialize)null, (Action<NavigationBarButton, object>)null, true, true, (Func<NavigationBarButton, bool>)null, false);
			}
		}

		private void OnCustomButtonTemplateChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<OfficeNavigationBar, NavigationBarButton>.OnItemsGeneratorTemplatePropertyChanged((DependencyObject)this, e, CustomButtonsAttachedBehaviorProperty);
		}

		private void OnNavigatorClientPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "SelectedItem")
			{
				base.SelectedItem = NavigationClient.SelectedItem;
			}
			if (e.PropertyName == "Items")
			{
				base.ItemsSource = NavigationClient.Items;
				CustomizationHelper.ClearCustomizationState();
			}
			if (e.PropertyName == "Compact")
			{
				IsCompact = NavigationClient.Compact;
			}
		}

		private void OnPartFlyoutControlLostKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_FlyoutEventListener != null && !((UIElement)(object)PartFlyoutControl).IsMouseOver && !((UIElement)(object)PartFlyoutControl).IsKeyboardFocused && !((UIElement)(object)PartFlyoutControl).IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				_FlyoutEventListener.OnMouseLeave();
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeFlyoutEvents()
		{
			((UIElement)(object)PartFlyoutControl).LostKeyboardFocus += OnPartFlyoutControlLostKeyboardFocus;
		}

		private void UnsubscribeFlyoutEvents()
		{
			((UIElement)(object)PartFlyoutControl).LostKeyboardFocus -= OnPartFlyoutControlLostKeyboardFocus;
		}

		private void UpdateButtonsAlignment()
		{
			bool flag = Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
			bool flag2 = CustomizationButtonVisibility == CustomizationButtonVisibility.ShowBeforeItems;
			Dock dock = ((!flag) ? (flag2 ? Dock.Top : Dock.Bottom) : ((!flag2) ? Dock.Right : Dock.Left));
			SetValue(ButtonsAlignmentPropertyKey, dock);
		}

		private void UpdateCompactState()
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, (IsCompact && NavigationClient != null && NavigationClient.AcceptsCompactNavigation) ? "Compact" : "NonCompact", useTransitions: false);
		}

		private void UpdateOrientationState()
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, Orientation.ToString(), useTransitions: false);
		}

		private void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			UpdateOrientationState();
			UpdateCompactState();
		}

		public new void AddChild(object child)
		{
			if (!logicalChildrenCore.Contains(child))
			{
				logicalChildrenCore.Add(child);
			}
			AddLogicalChild(child);
		}

		public void RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			if (logicalChildrenCore.Contains(child))
			{
				logicalChildrenCore.Remove(child);
			}
			RemoveLogicalChild(child);
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool ILogicalOwner.get_IsLoaded()
		{
			return base.IsLoaded;
		}

		[SpecialName]

		{
			base.Loaded += value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ILogicalOwner.remove_Loaded(RoutedEventHandler value)
		{
			base.Loaded -= value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		double ILogicalOwner.get_ActualWidth()
		{
			return base.ActualWidth;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		double ILogicalOwner.get_ActualHeight()
		{
			return base.ActualHeight;
		}

		FlyoutControl IFlyoutProvider.FlyoutControl => PartFlyoutControl;

		FlyoutPlacement IFlyoutProvider.Placement
		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
				bool flag2 = FlyoutShowDirection == FlyoutShowDirection.Default;
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						return (FlyoutPlacement)2;
					}
					return (FlyoutPlacement)0;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					return (FlyoutPlacement)3;
				}
				return (FlyoutPlacement)1;
			}
		}

			}
		}

		static TileBar()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(TileBar);
			AllowItemSelectionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowItemSelection", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true, OnAllowItemSelectionChanged));
			OrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Orientation", typeof(Orientation), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(Orientation.Horizontal, OnOrientationChanged));
			ShowGroupHeadersProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowGroupHeaders", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true));
			GroupHeaderProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("GroupHeader", typeof(object), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(OnGroupHeaderChanged));
			GroupHeaderSpacingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GroupHeaderSpacing", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(5.0));
			GroupHeaderStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GroupHeaderStyle", typeof(Style), typeFromHandle);
			GroupHeaderTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GroupHeaderTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle);
			ItemColorModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemColorMode", typeof(TileColorMode), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(OnItemColorModeChanged));
			FlyoutShowDirectionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FlyoutShowDirection", typeof(FlyoutShowDirection), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(FlyoutShowDirection.Default, OnFlyoutShowDirectionChanged));
			ItemSpacingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemSpacing", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(10.0));
			FlyoutShowModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FlyoutShowMode", typeof(FlyoutShowMode), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(FlyoutShowMode.Adorner, OnFlyoutShowModeChanged));
			ShowItemShadowProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowItemShadow", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			ItemsArrowDirectionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemsArrowDirection", typeof(ButtonDirection), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(ButtonDirection.Down));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<TileBar>();
		}

		private static void OnGroupHeaderChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.SetGroupHeader(d, e.NewValue);
		}

		[Browsable(false)]

			element.SetValue(GroupHeaderProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnItemColorModeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((TileBar)d).OnItemColorModeChanged((TileColorMode)e.OldValue, (TileColorMode)e.NewValue);
		}

		private static void OnFlyoutShowModeChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((TileBar)dObj).OnFlyoutShowModeChanged(e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}

			((TileBar)dObj).OnOrientationChanged(e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}

		{
			((TileBar)dObj).OnFlyoutShowDirectionChanged(e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}

		private static void OnAllowItemSelectionChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((TileBar)dObj).OnAllowItemSelectionChanged((bool)e.NewValue);

		public TileBar()
		{
			FlyoutManager.SetFlyoutManager(this, FlyoutManager);
		}

		internal void SetScrollOffset(System.Windows.Point offset)
		{
			TileBarItemsPanel tileBarItemsPanel = TileBarItemsPanel;
			if (tileBarItemsPanel != null)
			{
				((ScrollControl)tileBarItemsPanel).SetOffset(offset);
			}
		}

		public void CloseFlyout()
		{
			FlyoutManager.CloseAll();
		}

		internal void BringChildIntoView(FrameworkElement child)
		{
			TileBarItemsPanel tileBarItemsPanel = TileBarItemsPanel;
			if (tileBarItemsPanel != null)
			{
				((ScrollControl)tileBarItemsPanel).BringChildIntoView(child, false);
			}
		}

		protected override void BeforeApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.BeforeApplyTemplate();
			FlyoutManager.Close(this, immediately: true);
		}

		protected override void ClearSelectorItem(ISelectorItem selectorItem, object item)
		{
			if (selectorItem is TileSelectorItem tileSelectorItem)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(tileSelectorItem, TileSelectorItem.ShowShadowProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(tileSelectorItem, TileSelectorItem.ArrowDirectionProperty);
				CoerceItemProperties(tileSelectorItem);
			}
			base.ClearSelectorItem(selectorItem, item);
		}

		protected override void ClearTemplateChildren()
		{
			if (PartFlyoutDecorator != null)
			{
				PartFlyoutDecorator.SizeChanged -= OntTleNavFlyoutDecoratorSizeChanged;
			}
			if (PartScrollableControl != null)
			{
				PartScrollableControl.ScrollChanged -= OnPartScrollableControlScrollChanged;
			}
			base.ClearTemplateChildren();
		}

		protected override ISelectorItem CreateSelectorItem()
		{
			return new TileBarItem();
		}

		protected override void EnsureItemsPanelCore(Panel itemsPanel)
		{
			base.EnsureItemsPanelCore(itemsPanel);
			if (itemsPanel is TileBarItemsPanel)
			{
				itemsPanel.SetBinding(HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.ShowGroupHeadersProperty, new Binding("ShowGroupHeaders")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				itemsPanel.SetBinding(HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.GroupHeaderSpaceProperty, new Binding("GroupHeaderSpacing")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				itemsPanel.SetBinding(HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.GroupHeaderStyleProperty, new Binding("GroupHeaderStyle")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				itemsPanel.SetBinding(HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.GroupHeaderTemplateProperty, new Binding("GroupHeaderTemplate")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				itemsPanel.SetBinding(LayoutPanelBase.ItemSpacingProperty, new Binding("ItemSpacing")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			}
			if (ShowGroupHeaders && !itemsPanel.IsItemsHost)
			{
				ItemContainerSyncHelper.Attach(itemsPanel);
			}
		}

		protected override void GetTemplateChildren()
		{
			base.GetTemplateChildren();
			EnsureFlyoutControl();
		}

		protected virtual void OnAllowItemSelectionChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is TileSelectorItem tileSelectorItem)
				{
					tileSelectorItem.CoerceValue(TileSelectorItem.ActualSelectionPaddingProperty);
					tileSelectorItem.CoerceValue(TileSelectorItem.IsSelectedProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnApplyTemplateComplete()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplateComplete();
			if (PartScrollableControl != null)
			{
				PartScrollableControl.ScrollChanged += OnPartScrollableControlScrollChanged;
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new TileBarAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnFlyoutShowDirectionChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			ItemsArrowDirectionUpdate();
		}

		protected virtual void OnFlyoutShowModeChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (PartFlyoutControl != null)
			{
				FlyoutManager.CloseAll();
				EnsureFlyoutControl(onApplyTemplate: false);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemColorModeChanged(TileColorMode oldValue, TileColorMode newValue)
		{
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is TileSelectorItem tileSelectorItem)
				{
					tileSelectorItem.CoerceValue(TileSelectorItem.ActualColorModeProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnItemsPanelChanged(ItemsPanelTemplate oldItemsPanel, ItemsPanelTemplate newItemsPanel)
		{
			base.OnItemsPanelChanged(oldItemsPanel, newItemsPanel);
			_ = base.ItemsPanel;
		}

		protected virtual void OnOrientationChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			ItemsArrowDirectionUpdate();
		}

		protected override void OnSelectedItemChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.OnSelectedItemChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			FrameworkElement child = base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(newValue) as FrameworkElement;
			BringChildIntoView(child);
		}

		protected override void PrepareSelectorItem(ISelectorItem selectorItem, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareSelectorItem(selectorItem, item);
			if (selectorItem is TileSelectorItem tileSelectorItem)
			{
				tileSelectorItem.SetBinding(TileSelectorItem.ShowShadowProperty, new Binding("ShowItemShadow")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				tileSelectorItem.SetBinding(TileSelectorItem.ArrowDirectionProperty, new Binding("ItemsArrowDirection")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				CoerceItemProperties(tileSelectorItem);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReleaseItemsPanelCore(Panel itemsPanel)
		{
			if (ShowGroupHeaders && !itemsPanel.IsItemsHost)
			{
				ItemContainerSyncHelper.Detach(itemsPanel);
			}
			if (itemsPanel is TileBarItemsPanel)
			{
				(itemsPanel as ILockable).Do(delegate(ILockable x)
				{
					x.BeginUpdate();
				});
				itemsPanel.ClearValue(HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.ShowGroupHeadersProperty);
				itemsPanel.ClearValue(HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.GroupHeaderSpaceProperty);
				itemsPanel.ClearValue(HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.GroupHeaderStyleProperty);
				itemsPanel.ClearValue(HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.GroupHeaderTemplateProperty);
				itemsPanel.ClearValue(LayoutPanelBase.ItemSpacingProperty);
				(itemsPanel as ILockable).Do(delegate(ILockable x)
				{
					x.EndUpdate();
				});
			}
			base.ReleaseItemsPanelCore(itemsPanel);
		}

		private void CoerceItemProperties(TileSelectorItem container)
		{
			container.CoerceValue(TileSelectorItem.ActualColorModeProperty);
			container.CoerceValue(TileSelectorItem.ActualSelectionPaddingProperty);
			container.CoerceValue(TileSelectorItem.IsSelectedProperty);
		}

		private void EnsureFlyoutControl(bool onApplyTemplate = true)
		{
			if (PartFlyoutControl != null)
			{
				((ContentControl)(object)PartFlyoutControl).Content = null;
				PartFlyoutControl = null;
			}
			PartFlyoutDecorator = GetTemplateChild("PART_TileNavFlyoutDecorator") as FlyoutDecorator;
			if (PartFlyoutDecorator != null)
			{
				PartFlyoutDecorator.FlyoutShowMode = FlyoutShowMode;
				if (onApplyTemplate)
				{
					PartFlyoutDecorator.SizeChanged += OntTleNavFlyoutDecoratorSizeChanged;
				}
				else
				{
					PartFlyoutControl = PartFlyoutDecorator.ActualFlyoutControl;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DependencyObject templateChild = GetTemplateChild("PART_FlyoutControl");
				PartFlyoutControl = (FlyoutControl)(object)((templateChild is FlyoutControl) ? templateChild : null);
			}
			PartScrollableControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_ScrollableControl") as ScrollableControl;
		}

		private void ItemsArrowDirectionUpdate()
		{
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				ItemsArrowDirection = ((FlyoutShowDirection != FlyoutShowDirection.Default) ? ButtonDirection.Up : ButtonDirection.Down);
			}
			else
			{
				ItemsArrowDirection = ((FlyoutShowDirection == FlyoutShowDirection.Default) ? ButtonDirection.Right : ButtonDirection.Left);
			}
		}

		private void OnPartScrollableControlScrollChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			FlyoutManager.CloseAll();
		}

		private void OntTleNavFlyoutDecoratorSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			PartFlyoutDecorator.SizeChanged -= OntTleNavFlyoutDecoratorSizeChanged;
			PartFlyoutControl = PartFlyoutDecorator.ActualFlyoutControl;
		}

		void ILogicalOwner.AddChild(object child)
		{
			if (!logicalChildren.Contains(child))
			{
				logicalChildren.Add(child);
			}
		}

		void ILogicalOwner.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			logicalChildren.Remove(child);
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool ILogicalOwner.get_IsLoaded()
		{
			return base.IsLoaded;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ILogicalOwner.add_Loaded(RoutedEventHandler value)
		{
			base.Loaded += value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ILogicalOwner.remove_Loaded(RoutedEventHandler value)
		{
			base.Loaded -= value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		double ILogicalOwner.get_ActualWidth()
		{
			return base.ActualWidth;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		double ILogicalOwner.get_ActualHeight()
		{
			return base.ActualHeight;
		}
	}

		object IContentSelectorItem.Content => base.Content;

		static TileBarItem()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<TileBarItem>();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TileBarItem>.New().Register<object>("FlyoutContent", ref FlyoutContentProperty, (object)null, (Action<TileBarItem>)delegate(TileBarItem d)
			{
				d.OnFlyoutPropertyChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<DataTemplate>("FlyoutContentTemplate", ref FlyoutContentTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (Action<TileBarItem>)delegate(TileBarItem d)
			{
				d.OnFlyoutPropertyChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("FlyoutContentTemplateSelector", ref FlyoutContentTemplateSelectorProperty, (DataTemplateSelector)null, (Action<TileBarItem>)delegate(TileBarItem d)
				{
					d.OnFlyoutPropertyChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		protected override UIElement GetFlyoutContainer()
		{
			TileNavPaneContentControl tileNavPaneContentControl = new TileNavPaneContentControl();
			tileNavPaneContentControl.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentProperty, new Binding("FlyoutContent")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			tileNavPaneContentControl.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentTemplateProperty, new Binding("FlyoutContentTemplate")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			tileNavPaneContentControl.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty, new Binding("FlyoutContentTemplateSelector")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			return tileNavPaneContentControl;
		}

		protected override object OnCoerceIsFlyoutButtonVisible(bool value)
		{
			return base.ShowFlyoutButton && (FlyoutContent != null || FlyoutContentTemplate != null || FlyoutContentTemplateSelector != null);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new TileBarItemAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnFlyoutPropertyChanged()
		{
			CoerceValue(TileSelectorItem.IsFlyoutButtonVisibleProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnGotFocus(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnGotFocus(e);
			SelectIfPossible();
		}

		[SpecialName]
		DataTemplate IContentSelectorItem.get_ContentTemplate()
		{
			return base.ContentTemplate;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		DataTemplateSelector IContentSelectorItem.get_ContentTemplateSelector()
		{

		}

	public abstract class TileBase : ClickableBase, ITileSizeManagerOwner, ITileSizeProvider
	{
		internal class SizeProvider
		{
			public System.Windows.Size GetSize(TileSize tileSize)
			{
				return GetSizeCore(tileSize);
			}

			protected virtual System.Windows.Size GetSizeCore(TileSize tileSize)
			{
				return tileSize switch
				{
					TileSize.Auto => new System.Windows.Size(double.NaN, double.NaN), 
					TileSize.Small => new System.Windows.Size(70.0, 68.0), 
					TileSize.Wide => new System.Windows.Size(310.0, 68.0), 
					_ => new System.Windows.Size(150.0, 68.0), 
				};
			}
		}

		static TileBase()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(TileBase);
			SizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Size", typeof(TileSize), typeFromHandle, new UIPropertyMetadata(TileSize.Default, OnSizeChanged));
			TileGlyphProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TileGlyph", typeof(ImageSource), typeFromHandle);
			HorizontalTileGlyphAlignmentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalTileGlyphAlignment", typeof(HorizontalAlignment), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(HorizontalAlignment.Left));
			VerticalTileGlyphAlignmentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VerticalTileGlyphAlignment", typeof(VerticalAlignment), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(VerticalAlignment.Top));
			ActualTileContentPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ActualTileContent", typeof(object), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ActualTileContentProperty = ActualTileContentPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ActualTileContentTemplatePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ActualTileContentTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ActualTileContentTemplateProperty = ActualTileContentTemplatePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ActualTileContentTemplateSelectorPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ActualTileContentTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ActualTileContentTemplateSelectorProperty = ActualTileContentTemplateSelectorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
		}

		private static void OnSizeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is TileBase tileBase)
			{
				tileBase.OnSizeChanged((TileSize)e.OldValue, (TileSize)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		protected TileBase()
		{
			UpdateTileSize();
		}

		protected override void OnApplyTemplateComplete()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplateComplete();
			EnsureSizeManager();
		}

		protected virtual void EnsureSizeManager()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnSizeChanged(TileSize oldValue, TileSize newValue)
		{
			UpdateTileSize();
		}

		protected override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
			UpdateTileSize();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateTileSize()
		{
			if (SizeManager != null)
			{
				bool isInDesignMode = DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this);
				bool hasWidth = (isInDesignMode ? (!DependencyObjectExtensions.HasDefaultValue((DependencyObject)this, FrameworkElement.WidthProperty)) : DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)this, FrameworkElement.WidthProperty));
				bool hasHeight = (isInDesignMode ? (!DependencyObjectExtensions.HasDefaultValue((DependencyObject)this, FrameworkElement.HeightProperty)) : DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)this, FrameworkElement.HeightProperty));
				SizeManager.UpdateActualSize(Size, isLarge: false, hasWidth, 1, 0.0, hasHeight);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnContentChanged(object oldContent, object newContent)
		{
			base.OnContentChanged(oldContent, newContent);
			UpdateActualTileContent();
		}

		protected override void OnContentTemplateChanged(DataTemplate oldContentTemplate, DataTemplate newContentTemplate)
		{
			base.OnContentTemplateChanged(oldContentTemplate, newContentTemplate);
			UpdateActualTileContent();
		}

		protected override void OnContentTemplateSelectorChanged(DataTemplateSelector oldContentTemplateSelector, DataTemplateSelector newContentTemplateSelector)
		{
			base.OnContentTemplateSelectorChanged(oldContentTemplateSelector, newContentTemplateSelector);
			UpdateActualTileContent();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualTileContent()
		{
			SetValue(ActualTileContentPropertyKey, base.Content);
			SetValue(ActualTileContentTemplatePropertyKey, base.ContentTemplate);
			SetValue(ActualTileContentTemplateSelectorPropertyKey, base.ContentTemplateSelector);
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Size GetSizeForTileSize(TileSize tileSize)
		{
			return new SizeProvider().GetSize(tileSize);
		}

		void ITileSizeManagerOwner.OnSizeChanged()
		{
			UpdateTileSize();
		}

		System.Windows.Size ITileSizeProvider.GetSize(TileSize tileSize)
		{
			return GetSizeForTileSize(tileSize);
		}
	}

		Standard,
		Auto,
		Inverted
	}

					if (PartButton != null)

					}
				}
			}

		internal UIElement FlyoutContentContainer => flyoutContentContainer ?? (flyoutContentContainer = GetFlyoutContainer());

		internal bool IsFlyoutActuallyOpen
		{
			get
			{
				return isFlyoutActuallyOpen;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isFlyoutActuallyOpen != value)
				{
					isFlyoutActuallyOpen = value;
					Locker val = flyoutClosedLocker.Lock();
					try
					{
						SetCurrentValue(IsFlyoutOpenProperty, value);
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
					}
					RaiseIsFlyoutOpenChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsFlyoutOpen
		{

				return (bool)GetValue(IsFlyoutOpenProperty);

			}
		}

		protected TileSelectorItem()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown
			AttachPropertyListener("Background", veContentControlBase.BackgroundListener);
			AttachPropertyListener("Foreground", veContentControlBase.ForegroundListener);
			CoerceValue(IsFlyoutButtonVisibleProperty);
		}

		static TileSelectorItem()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TileSelectorItem>.New().AddOwner<bool>(ref IsSelectedProperty, Selector.IsSelectedProperty, false, (Action<TileSelectorItem, bool, bool>)delegate(TileSelectorItem d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
			{
				d.OnIsSelectedChanged(newValue);
			}, (Func<TileSelectorItem, bool, bool>)((TileSelectorItem d, bool value) => (bool)d.OnCoerceIsSelected(value)), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentMeasure | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Journal).Register<bool>("ShowFlyoutButton", ref ShowFlyoutButtonProperty, true, (Action<TileSelectorItem, bool, bool>)delegate(TileSelectorItem d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
			{
				d.OnShowFlyoutButtonChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("AllowGlyphTheming", ref AllowGlyphThemingProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<ICommand>("Command", ref CommandProperty, (ICommand)null, (Action<TileSelectorItem, ICommand, ICommand>)delegate(TileSelectorItem d, ICommand oldValue, ICommand newValue)
				{
					d.OnCommandChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<object>("CommandParameter", ref CommandParameterProperty, (object)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<IInputElement>("CommandTarget", ref CommandTargetProperty, (IInputElement)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<Thickness>("SelectionPadding", ref SelectionPaddingProperty, default(Thickness), (Action<TileSelectorItem, Thickness, Thickness>)delegate(TileSelectorItem d, Thickness oldValue, Thickness newValue)
				{
					d.OnSelectionPaddingChanged(newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<TileColorMode>("ColorMode", ref ColorModeProperty, TileColorMode.Standard, (Action<TileSelectorItem, TileColorMode, TileColorMode>)delegate(TileSelectorItem d, TileColorMode oldValue, TileColorMode newValue)
				{
					d.OnColorModeChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<TileColorMode>("ActualColorMode", ref ActualColorModeProperty, TileColorMode.Standard, (Action<TileSelectorItem, TileColorMode, TileColorMode>)delegate(TileSelectorItem d, TileColorMode oldValue, TileColorMode newValue)
				{
					d.OnActualColorModeChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (Func<TileSelectorItem, TileColorMode, TileColorMode>)((TileSelectorItem d, TileColorMode value) => d.OnCoerceActualColorMode(value)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("ShowShadow", ref ShowShadowProperty, false, (Action<TileSelectorItem, bool, bool>)delegate(TileSelectorItem d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
				{
					d.OnShowShadowChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<ButtonDirection>("ArrowDirection", ref ArrowDirectionProperty, ButtonDirection.Down, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("IsFlyoutOpen", ref IsFlyoutOpenProperty, false, (Action<TileSelectorItem, bool, bool>)delegate(TileSelectorItem d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
				{
					d.OnIsFlyoutOpenChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<bool>("IsFlyoutButtonVisible", ref IsFlyoutButtonVisiblePropertyKey, ref IsFlyoutButtonVisibleProperty, false, (Func<TileSelectorItem, bool, bool>)((TileSelectorItem d, bool value) => (bool)d.OnCoerceIsFlyoutButtonVisible(value)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<Thickness>("ActualSelectionPadding", ref ActualSelectionPaddingPropertyKey, ref ActualSelectionPaddingProperty, default(Thickness), (Func<TileSelectorItem, Thickness, Thickness>)((TileSelectorItem d, Thickness value) => d.OnCoerceActualSelectionPadding(value)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)

				.RegisterReadOnly<System.Windows.Media.Brush>("CalculatedForeground", ref CalculatedForegroundPropertyKey, ref CalculatedForegroundProperty, (System.Windows.Media.Brush)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
