		internal virtual FlyoutManager GetFlyoutManager()
		{
			return FlyoutManager.GetFlyoutManager(this);
		}

		internal void OnPartArrowControlClick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ToggleFlyout();
		}

		internal void PartArrowControl_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnPartArrowControlClick(sender, e);
		}

		internal void ToggleFlyout()
		{
			FlyoutManager flyoutManager = FlyoutManager.GetFlyoutManager(this);
			FlyoutControl flyoutControl = GetFlyoutControl();
			if (flyoutManager != null && flyoutControl != null)
			{
				bool flag = ((FlyoutBase)flyoutControl).IsOpen && flyoutManager.GetFlyoutTarget(flyoutControl) == this;
				SetCurrentValue(IsFlyoutOpenProperty, !flag);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void BeforeFlyoutOpened()
		{
		}

		protected override void ClearTemplateChildren()
		{
			if (PartArrowButton != null)
			{
				PartArrowButton.Click -= OnPartArrowControlClick;
				((DependencyObject)(object)PartArrowButton).ClearValue(TileArrowControl.ArrowDirectionProperty);
			}
			base.ClearTemplateChildren();
		}

		protected override ControlControllerBase CreateController()
		{
			return (ControlControllerBase)(object)new TileSelectorItemController(this);
		}

		protected void EnsureOwnerSelection(bool isSelected)
		{
			RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(isSelected ? Selector.SelectedEvent : Selector.UnselectedEvent, this));
			if (isSelected)
			{
				SelectInParentContainer();
			}
			((ControlControllerBase)base.Controller).UpdateState(false);
		}

		protected override void EnsureSizeManager()
		{
			FrameworkElement sizeManagerHolder = GetSizeManagerHolder();
			if (sizeManagerHolder != null)
			{
				object obj = sizeManagerHolder.Resources["SizeManager"];
				SizeManager = obj as TileSizeManager;
				if (SizeManager != null)
				{
					SizeManager.OwnerRef = new WeakReference(this);
				}
				UpdateTileSize();
			}
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush GetCalculatedBackground()
		{
			switch (ActualColorMode)
			{
			case TileColorMode.Standard:
			case TileColorMode.Auto:
				return base.Background;
			case TileColorMode.Inverted:
				return base.Foreground;
			default:
				return base.Background;
			}
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush GetCalculatedForeground()
		{
			switch (ActualColorMode)
			{
			case TileColorMode.Standard:
			case TileColorMode.Auto:
				return base.Foreground;
			case TileColorMode.Inverted:
				return base.Background;
			default:
				return base.Background;
			}
		}

		protected virtual UIElement GetFlyoutContainer()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual double GetFlyoutOffset()
		{
			return 10.0;
		}

		protected virtual FrameworkElement GetSizeManagerHolder()
		{
			return PartButton;
		}

		protected override void GetTemplateChildren()
		{
			base.GetTemplateChildren();
			PartArrowButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_ArrowButton") as TileBarItemArrowControl;
			PartButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_Button") as TileButtonControl;
		}

		protected virtual void InvokeCommand()
		{
			CommandHelper.ExecuteCommand(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnActualColorModeChanged(TileColorMode oldValue, TileColorMode newValue)
		{
			UpdateCalculatedBrushes();
		}

		protected override void OnApplyTemplateComplete()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplateComplete();
			if (PartArrowButton != null)
			{
				PartArrowButton.Click += OnPartArrowControlClick;
				((FrameworkElement)(object)PartArrowButton).SetBinding(TileArrowControl.ArrowDirectionProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("ArrowDirection")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			}
			if (PartButton != null)
			{
				PartButton.IsEnabled = CanExecute;
			}
			((ControlControllerBase)base.Controller).UpdateState(false);
		}

		protected virtual void OnBrushPropertyChanged()
		{
			UpdateCalculatedBrushes();
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			base.OnClick();
			FlyoutManager flyoutManager = GetFlyoutManager();
			if (flyoutManager != null)
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					bool cancel = false;
					OnFlyoutClosing(ref cancel);
					if (!cancel)
					{
						flyoutManager.CloseAll();
					}
				});
			}
			InvokeCommand();
		}

		protected virtual TileColorMode OnCoerceActualColorMode(TileColorMode value)
		{
			TileBar tileBar = Owner as TileBar;
			if (ColorMode != TileColorMode.Standard)
			{
				return ColorMode;
			}
			return tileBar?.ItemColorMode ?? ColorMode;
		}

		protected virtual Thickness OnCoerceActualSelectionPadding(Thickness value)
		{
			if (!(Owner is TileBar { AllowItemSelection: false }))
			{
				return SelectionPadding;
			}
			return default(Thickness);
		}

		protected virtual object OnCoerceIsFlyoutButtonVisible(bool value)
		{
			return ShowFlyoutButton;
		}

		protected virtual object OnCoerceIsSelected(bool value)
		{
			bool flag = CanExecute && value;
			TileBar tileBar = Owner as TileBar;
			return flag && (tileBar?.AllowItemSelection ?? true);
		}

		protected virtual void OnColorModeChanged(TileColorMode oldValue, TileColorMode newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualColorModeProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnCommandChanged(ICommand oldValue, ICommand newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.CanExecuteChanged -= OnCanExecuteChanged;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.CanExecuteChanged += OnCanExecuteChanged;
			}
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ownerCore = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected virtual void OnFlyoutClosing(ref bool cancel)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool isSelected)
		{
			EnsureOwnerSelection(isSelected);
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			UpdateCalculatedBrushes();
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyProperty propertyListener, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(propertyListener, oldValue, newValue);
			if (propertyListener == veContentControlBase.BackgroundListener)
			{
				OnBrushPropertyChanged();
			}
			if (propertyListener == veContentControlBase.ForegroundListener)
			{
				OnBrushPropertyChanged();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectionPaddingChanged(Thickness newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualSelectionPaddingProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnShowFlyoutButtonChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(IsFlyoutButtonVisibleProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnShowShadowChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			((ControlControllerBase)base.Controller).UpdateState(false);
		}

		protected void SelectIfPossible()
		{
			if (Locker.op_Implicit(selectionLocker))
			{
				return;
			}
			Locker val = selectionLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				if (Owner is TileBar tileBar && CanExecute && tileBar.AllowItemSelection && CanBeSelected)
				{
					SelectInParentContainer();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool SelectInParentContainer()
		{
			ItemsControl itemsControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<ItemsControl>((DependencyObject)this);
			ISelector selector = Owner ?? (itemsControl as ISelector);
			selector?.Select(this);
			return selector != null;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateCalculatedBrushes()
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualColorModeProperty);
			CalculatedBackground = GetCalculatedBackground();
			CalculatedForeground = GetCalculatedForeground();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateFlyout(FlyoutControl flyoutControl)
		{
		}

		private FlyoutControl GetFlyoutControl()
		{
			return LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<IFlyoutProvider>((DependencyObject)this)?.FlyoutControl;
		}

		private void HideFlyout()
		{
			IFlyoutProvider provider = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<IFlyoutProvider>((DependencyObject)this);
			FlyoutControl flyoutControl = GetFlyoutControl();
			FlyoutManager flyoutManager = FlyoutManager.GetFlyoutManager(this);
			if (provider != null && flyoutManager != null && flyoutControl != null && ((FlyoutBase)flyoutControl).IsOpen && flyoutManager.GetFlyoutTarget(flyoutControl) == this)
			{
				flyoutClosedLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					flyoutManager.Hide(provider, this);
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnCanExecuteChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private void OnIsFlyoutOpenChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (newValue)
			{
				ShowFlyout();
			}
			else
			{
				HideFlyout();
			}
		}

		private void RaiseIsFlyoutOpenChanged()
		{
			foreach (EventHandler isFlyoutOpenChangedHandler in isFlyoutOpenChangedHandlers)
			{
				isFlyoutOpenChangedHandler(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void ShowFlyout()
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IFlyoutProvider flyoutProvider = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<IFlyoutProvider>((DependencyObject)this);
			FlyoutControl flyoutControl = GetFlyoutControl();
			FlyoutManager flyoutManager = FlyoutManager.GetFlyoutManager(this);
			if (flyoutProvider != null && flyoutManager != null && flyoutControl != null)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)flyoutControl).Settings = (FlyoutSettingsBase)new FlyoutSettings
				{
					Placement = flyoutProvider.Placement,
					IndicatorTarget = GetIndicatorTarget(),
					ShowIndicator = true
				};
				((FlyoutBase)flyoutControl).StaysOpen = true;
				((ContentControl)(object)flyoutControl).Content = FlyoutContentContainer;
				UpdateFlyout(flyoutControl);
				((FrameworkElement)(object)flyoutControl).SetBinding(Control.BackgroundProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("Background")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				((FrameworkElement)(object)flyoutControl).SetBinding(Control.BorderBrushProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("Background")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				UpdateFlyoutAlignment(flyoutProvider);
				UpdateFlyoutOffset(flyoutProvider);
				BeforeFlyoutOpened();
				flyoutManager.Show(flyoutProvider, this);
			}
		}

		private UIElement GetIndicatorTarget()
		{
			if (PartArrowButton != null && ((UIElement)(object)PartArrowButton).IsVisible)
			{
				return (UIElement)(object)PartArrowButton;
			}
			return this;
		}

		private void UpdateCanExecute()
		{
			CanExecute = Command == null || CommandHelper.CanExecuteCommand(this);
		}

		private void UpdateFlyoutAlignment(IFlyoutProvider provider)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			FlyoutControl flyoutControl = provider.FlyoutControl;
			FlyoutPlacement placement = provider.Placement;
			if (flyoutControl != null)
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)flyoutControl).ClearValue(FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty);
				((DependencyObject)(object)flyoutControl).ClearValue(FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty);
				if ((int)placement == 3 || (int)placement == 1)
				{
					((FrameworkElement)(object)flyoutControl).HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch;
				}
				else
				{
					((FrameworkElement)(object)flyoutControl).VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Stretch;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFlyoutOffset(IFlyoutProvider provider)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0091: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00b5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b7: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0103: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			FlyoutPlacement placement = provider.Placement;
			FlyoutControl flyoutControl = provider.FlyoutControl;
			if (provider is UIElement uIElement && flyoutControl != null)
			{
				double flyoutOffset = GetFlyoutOffset();
				((FlyoutBase)flyoutControl).VerticalOffset = 0.0;
				((FlyoutBase)flyoutControl).HorizontalOffset = 0.0;
				if ((int)placement == 3)
				{
					System.Windows.Point point = TranslatePoint(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, base.RenderSize.Height), uIElement);
					double num = uIElement.RenderSize.Height - point.Y;
					((FlyoutBase)flyoutControl).VerticalOffset = 0.0 - num + flyoutOffset;
				}
				if ((int)placement == 1)
				{
					((FlyoutBase)flyoutControl).VerticalOffset = TranslatePoint(default(System.Windows.Point), uIElement).Y - flyoutOffset;
				}
				if ((int)placement == 2)
				{
					System.Windows.Point point2 = TranslatePoint(new System.Windows.Point(base.RenderSize.Width, 0.0), uIElement);
					double num2 = uIElement.RenderSize.Width - point2.X;
					((FlyoutBase)flyoutControl).HorizontalOffset = 0.0 - num2 + flyoutOffset;
				}
				if ((int)placement == 0)
				{
					((FlyoutBase)flyoutControl).HorizontalOffset = TranslatePoint(default(System.Windows.Point), uIElement).X - flyoutOffset;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnFlyoutClosed()
		{
			IsChecked = false;
			IsFlyoutActuallyOpen = false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnFlyoutOpened()
		{
			IsChecked = true;
			IsFlyoutActuallyOpen = true;
		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnFlyoutClosed()
		{
			OnFlyoutClosed();
		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnFlyoutOpened()
		{
			OnFlyoutOpened();
		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnMouseLeave()
		{
		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnMouseEnter()
		{
		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnFlyoutClosed(bool onClickThrough)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

	internal class TileSelectorItemController : ClickableController
	{
		public TileSelectorItem Control => (TileSelectorItem)((ControlControllerBase)this).Control;

		protected override bool FocusOnMouseDown => Control.FocusOnMouseDown;

		protected override bool FocusOnMouseUp => Control.FocusOnMouseUp;

		public TileSelectorItemController(TileSelectorItem control)
			: base((IControl)(object)control)
		{
		}

		public override void UpdateState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			((ControlControllerBase)this).UpdateState(useTransitions);
			string stateName = "EmptySelectedState";
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(Control, stateName, useTransitions);
			stateName = (Control.IsSelected ? "Selected" : "Unselected");
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(Control, stateName, useTransitions);
			stateName = (Control.ShowShadow ? "ShadowVisible" : "ShadowHidden");
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(Control, stateName, useTransitions);
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			if (Control.CanClick)
			{
				OnClickCore();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnClickCore()
		{
			base.OnClick();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(DXMouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (!Control.CanClick)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}
	}
	public interface INavElement : IClickable, ILogicalOwner, IInputElement
	{
		INavElement NavParent { get; set; }

		bool AllowSelection { get; set; }

		bool HasItems { get; }

		TileNavPane TileNavPane { get; set; }
	}
	public class NavElementCollection : ObservableCollection<INavElement>
	{
		private INavElement Owner;

		internal NavElementCollection(INavElement owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, INavElement item)
		{
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
			item.AllowSelection = Owner.AllowSelection;
			if (!(Owner is NavButton))
			{
				item.NavParent = Owner;
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			INavElement navElement = base[index];
			if (navElement != null && navElement.NavParent == Owner)
			{
				navElement.NavParent = null;
			}
			base.RemoveItem(index);
		}
	}

		static NavButton()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(NavButton);
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<NavButton> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<NavButton>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsMain", ref IsMainProperty, defValue: false, OnIsMainChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("IsFlyoutButtonVisible", ref IsFlyoutButtonVisiblePropertyKey, ref IsFlyoutButtonVisibleProperty, defValue: false, null, OnCoerceIsFlyoutButtonVisible);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ShowFlyoutButton", ref ShowFlyoutButtonProperty, defValue: true, OnShowFlyoutButtonChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AllowGlyphTheming", ref AllowGlyphThemingProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideFrameworkMetadata(FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty, HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((NavButton)d).OnHorizontalAlignmentChanged();
			});
			ItemsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Items", typeof(NavElementCollection), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ItemsProperty = ItemsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("ItemsAttachedBehavior", typeof(ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<NavButton, NavElementBase>), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new UIPropertyMetadata(null));
			ItemsSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemsSource", typeof(object), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnItemsSourcePropertyChanged));
			ItemTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnItemTemplatePropertyChanged));
			ItemTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnItemTemplatePropertyChanged));
			ItemStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemStyle", typeof(Style), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnItemTemplatePropertyChanged));
			HasItemsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("HasItems", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			HasItemsProperty = HasItemsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			AllowSelectionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowSelection", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			ItemsPresenterProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ItemsPresenter", typeof(UIElement), typeof(NavButton));
		}

		public NavButton()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<NavButton>(this);
			Items = new NavElementCollection(this);
			Items.CollectionChanged += OnItemsCollectionChanged;
		}

		protected override void OnApplyTemplateComplete()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplateComplete();
			TileNavPane tileNavPane = GetTileNavPane();
			if (tileNavPane != null)
			{
				if (!tileNavPane.ContinuousNavigation)
				{
					IsChecked = false;
				}
				else if (((IFlyoutProvider)tileNavPane).FlyoutControl == null || !((FlyoutBase)((IFlyoutProvider)tileNavPane).FlyoutControl).IsOpen)
				{
					IsChecked = false;
				}
			}
		}

			return itemsPresenter ?? ItemsPresenter;
		}

			tileNavPaneBar.SetBinding(ItemsControl.ItemsSourceProperty, new Binding("Items")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			tileNavPaneBar.SetBinding(ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyleProperty, new Binding("ItemStyle")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			return tileNavPaneBar;
		}

		{
			if (e.NewValue is IEnumerable || e.OldValue is IEnumerable)
			{
				ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<NavButton, NavElementBase>.OnItemsSourcePropertyChanged((DependencyObject)this, e, ItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty, ItemTemplateProperty, ItemTemplateSelectorProperty, ItemStyleProperty, (Func<NavButton, IList>)((NavButton control) => control.Items), (Func<NavButton, NavElementBase>)((NavButton control) => control.CreateItem()), (Action<int, object>)null, (Action<NavElementBase>)delegate(NavElementBase item)
				{
					InitItem(item);
				}, (ISupportInitialize)null, (Action<NavElementBase, object>)null, true, true, (Func<NavElementBase, bool>)null, false);
			}
		}

		protected override ControlControllerBase CreateController()
		{
			return (ControlControllerBase)(object)new NavButtonController(this);
		}

		private TileNavPane GetTileNavPane()
		{
			if (TileNavPane != null)
			{
				return TileNavPane;
			}
			for (INavElement navParent = ((INavElement)this).NavParent; navParent != null; navParent = navParent.NavParent)
			{
				if (navParent.TileNavPane != null)
				{
					return navParent.TileNavPane;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void OnShowFlyoutButtonChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(IsFlyoutButtonVisibleProperty);
		}

		protected virtual object OnCoerceIsFlyoutButtonVisible(bool value)
		{
			return ShowFlyoutButton && (HasItems || IsMain);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new NavButtonAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		private void RaiseIsFlyoutOpenChanged()
		{
			foreach (EventHandler isFlyoutOpenChangedHandler in isFlyoutOpenChangedHandlers)
			{
				isFlyoutOpenChangedHandler(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		{
			IsChecked = false;
			IsFlyoutOpen = false;
		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnFlyoutOpened()
		{
			IsChecked = true;
			IsFlyoutOpen = true;
		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnMouseLeave()
		{
		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnMouseEnter()
		{
		}

		void ILogicalOwner.AddChild(object child)

			AddLogicalChild(child);
			if (!logicalChildren.Contains(child))
			{
				logicalChildren.Add(child);
			}
		}

		void ILogicalOwner.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			logicalChildren.Remove(child);
			RemoveLogicalChild(child);
		}

		void IFlyoutEventListener.OnFlyoutClosed(bool onClickThrough)

			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

	public class NavButtonCollection : ObservableCollectionCore<NavButton>
	{
		internal TileNavPane Owner { get; private set; }

		internal NavButtonCollection(TileNavPane owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		public void Add(params NavButton[] items)
		{
			Array.ForEach(items, ((Collection<NavButton>)(object)this).Add);
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, NavButton item)
		{
			((ObservableCollection<NavButton>)(object)this).InsertItem(index, item);
			((ITileNavButton)item).OwnerCollection = this;
			((INavElement)item).TileNavPane = Owner;
			if (item.IsMain)
			{
				SetMainButton(item);
			}
			item.Click += item_Click;
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			NavButton navButton = ((Collection<NavButton>)(object)this)[index];
			if (navButton != null)
			{
				navButton.Click -= item_Click;
				((ITileNavButton)navButton).OwnerCollection = null;
				((INavElement)navButton).TileNavPane = null;
			}
			((ObservableCollection<NavButton>)(object)this).RemoveItem(index);
		}

		private void item_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
		}

		internal void SetMainButton(NavButton mainButton)
		{
			foreach (NavButton item in (Collection<NavButton>)(object)this)
			{
				if (!mainButton.Equals(item))
				{
					item.IsMain = false;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		TileNavPane INavElement.TileNavPane

					TileNavPane tileNavPane = TileNavPane;
					TileNavPane = value;
					OnTileNavPaneChanged(tileNavPane);
				}
			}

			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<NavElementBase>.New().Register<bool>("AllowSelection", ref AllowSelectionProperty, true, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<object>("TileContent", ref TileContentProperty, (object)null, (Action<NavElementBase, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(NavElementBase d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

		protected override ControlControllerBase CreateController()
		{
			return (ControlControllerBase)(object)new TileNavElementController(this);
		}

		protected virtual bool GetHasItemsCore()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new NavElementBaseAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		private void PrepareContainerCore(object item, DataTemplate itemTemplate, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector)
		{
			if (base.IsSelected)
			{
				EnsureOwnerSelection(base.IsSelected);
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainer(object item, DataTemplate itemTemplate, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector)
		{
			base.PrepareContainer(item, itemTemplate, itemTemplateSelector);
			PrepareContainerCore(item, itemTemplate, itemTemplateSelector);
		}

		protected override void UpdateActualTileContent()
		{
			SetValue(TileBase.ActualTileContentPropertyKey, TileContent ?? base.Content);
			SetValue(TileBase.ActualTileContentTemplatePropertyKey, TileContentTemplate ?? base.ContentTemplate);
			SetValue(TileBase.ActualTileContentTemplateSelectorPropertyKey, TileContentTemplateSelector ?? base.ContentTemplateSelector);
		}

		protected override void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool isSelected)
		{
			base.OnIsSelectedChanged(isSelected);
			if (!isSelected && base.Owner != null && base.Owner.SelectedItem == this)
			{
				base.Owner.SelectedItem = null;
			}
			((INavElement)this).TileNavPane?.SetSelectedElement(this, isSelected);
		}

		private TileNavPane GetTileNavPane()
		{
			if (TileNavPane != null)
			{
				return TileNavPane;
			}
			for (INavElement navParent = ((INavElement)this).NavParent; navParent != null; navParent = navParent.NavParent)
			{
				if (navParent.TileNavPane != null)
				{
					return navParent.TileNavPane;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void UpdateFlyout(FlyoutControl flyoutControl)
		{
			base.UpdateFlyout(flyoutControl);
			((FlyoutBase)flyoutControl).AlwaysOnTop = true;
		}

		protected override void OnFlyoutClosing(ref bool cancel)
		{
			cancel = GetTileNavPane().Return((TileNavPane x) => x.ContinuousNavigation, () => false);
		}

		internal override FlyoutManager GetFlyoutManager()
		{
			if (INavElement.TileNavPane != null)
			{
				return FlyoutManager.GetFlyoutManager(INavElement.TileNavPane);
			}
			return base.GetFlyoutManager();
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			bool isSelected = base.IsSelected;
			base.OnClick();
			SelectIfPossible();
			if (isSelected)
			{
				INavElement.TileNavPane.Do(delegate(TileNavPane x)
				{
					x.UpdateFlyout();
				});
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnNavButtonStyleChanged(Style oldValue, Style newValue)
		{
			InitNavButtonStyle();
		}

		private void OnTileNavPaneChanged(TileNavPane oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null && base.IsSelected)
			{
				oldValue.SetSelectedElement(this, isSelected: false);
			}
		}

		private void InitNavButtonStyle()
		{
			NavButton navButton = NavButton;
			if (navButton != null)
			{
				DependencyObjectExtensions.SetValueIfNotDefault((DependencyObject)navButton, FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, (object)NavButtonStyle);
			}
		}

		void ILogicalOwner.AddChild(object child)
		{
			AddLogicalChild(child);
		}

		void ILogicalOwner.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			RemoveLogicalChild(child);
		}

		[SpecialName]

		{
			return base.IsLoaded;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ILogicalOwner.add_Loaded(RoutedEventHandler value)
		{
			base.Loaded += value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ILogicalOwner.remove_Loaded(RoutedEventHandler value)
		{
			base.Loaded -= value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		double ILogicalOwner.get_ActualWidth()
		{
			return base.ActualWidth;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		double ILogicalOwner.get_ActualHeight()
		{
			return base.ActualHeight;
		}

	public abstract class NavElementCollectionBase<T> : ObservableCollection<T>
	{
		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			T[] array = base.Items.ToArray();
			base.ClearItems();
			T[] array2 = array;
			foreach (T item in array2)
			{
				RemoveItemCore(item);
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, T item)
		{
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
			InsertItemCore(item);
		}

		protected virtual void InsertItemCore(T item)
		{
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			T item = base[index];
			RemoveItemCore(item);
			base.RemoveItem(index);
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveItemCore(T item)
		{
		}
	}

			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TileNavItem>.New().RegisterReadOnly<TileNavSubItemCollection>("Items", ref ItemsPropertyKey, ref ItemsProperty, (TileNavSubItemCollection)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<object>("ItemsSource", ref ItemsSourceProperty, (object)null, (Action<TileNavItem, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(TileNavItem d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				d.OnItemsSourceChanged(e);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplate>("ItemTemplate", ref ItemTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (Action<TileNavItem, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(TileNavItem d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.OnItemTemplateChanged(e);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("ItemTemplateSelector", ref ItemTemplateSelectorProperty, (DataTemplateSelector)null, (Action<TileNavItem, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(TileNavItem d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.OnItemTemplateChanged(e);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<Style>("ItemStyle", ref ItemStyleProperty, (Style)null, (Action<TileNavItem, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(TileNavItem d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.OnItemTemplateChanged(e);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<bool>("HasItems", ref HasItemsPropertyKey, ref HasItemsProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(TileNavItem);
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("ItemsAttachedBehavior", typeof(ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<TileNavItem, TileNavSubItem>), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new UIPropertyMetadata(null));
		}

		public TileNavItem()
		{
			Items = new TileNavSubItemCollection(this);
			Items.CollectionChanged += OnItemsCollectionChanged;
		}

		private void OnItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			HasItems = Items.Count > 0;
			CoerceValue(TileSelectorItem.IsFlyoutButtonVisibleProperty);
		}

		protected override object OnCoerceIsFlyoutButtonVisible(bool value)
		{
			return base.ShowFlyoutButton && HasItems;
		}

		private void OnItemsSourceChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewValue is IEnumerable || e.OldValue is IEnumerable)
			{
				ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<TileNavItem, TileNavSubItem>.OnItemsSourcePropertyChanged((DependencyObject)this, e, ItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty, ItemTemplateProperty, ItemTemplateSelectorProperty, ItemStyleProperty, (Func<TileNavItem, IList>)((TileNavItem control) => control.Items), (Func<TileNavItem, TileNavSubItem>)((TileNavItem control) => control.CreateItem()), (Action<int, object>)null, (Action<TileNavSubItem>)delegate(TileNavSubItem item)
				{
					InitItem(item);
				}, (ISupportInitialize)null, (Action<TileNavSubItem, object>)null, true, true, (Func<TileNavSubItem, bool>)null, false);
			}
		}

		private void OnItemTemplateChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<TileNavItem, TileNavSubItem>.OnItemsGeneratorTemplatePropertyChanged((DependencyObject)this, e, ItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void InitItem(FrameworkElement item)
		{
			item.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentProperty, new Binding("DataContext")
			{
				Source = item
			});
		}

		protected virtual TileNavSubItem CreateItem()
		{
			return new TileNavSubItem();
		}

		protected override UIElement GetFlyoutContainer()
		{
			return PartFlyoutContent;
		}

		protected override void BeforeFlyoutOpened()
		{
			base.BeforeFlyoutOpened();
			FlyoutSourceTypeHelper.SetFlyoutSourceType(PartItemsControl, FlyoutSourceType.FromTileBar);
			PartFlyoutContent.Content = PartItemsControl;
		}

		protected override void OnFlyoutClosed()
		{
			base.OnFlyoutClosed();
			PartFlyoutContent.ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty);
		}

		protected override bool GetHasItemsCore()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override double GetFlyoutOffset()
		{
			return 7.0;
		}

	public class TileNavItemCollection : NavElementCollectionBase<TileNavItem>
	{
		private INavElement Owner;

		internal TileNavItemCollection(INavElement owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		protected override void InsertItemCore(TileNavItem item)
		{
			item.AllowSelection = Owner.AllowSelection;
			if (!(Owner is NavButton))
			{
				((INavElement)item).NavParent = Owner;
				((INavElement)item).TileNavPane = Owner.TileNavPane;
				((ILogicalOwner)Owner).AddChild((object)item);
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveItemCore(TileNavItem item)
		{
			if (item != null && ((INavElement)item).NavParent == Owner)
			{
				((INavElement)item).TileNavPane = null;
				((INavElement)item).NavParent = null;
				((ILogicalOwner)Owner).RemoveChild((object)item);
			}
		}
	}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			if (PartHeadersItemsControl != null)
			{
				PartHeadersItemsControl.ClearValue(ItemsControl.ItemsSourceProperty);
			}
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			EnsureFlyoutControl();
			PartHeadersItemsControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_HeadersItemsControl") as ItemsControl;
			if (PartHeadersItemsControl != null)
			{
				CompositeCollection compositeCollection = new CompositeCollection();
				compositeCollection.Add(new CollectionContainer
				{
					Collection = (IEnumerable)NavButtons
				});
				compositeCollection.Add(new CollectionContainer
				{
					Collection = (IEnumerable)DefaultButtons
				});
				PartHeadersItemsControl.ItemsSource = compositeCollection;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureFlyoutControl(bool onApplyTemplate = true)
		{
			if (PartFlyoutControl != null)
			{
				((ContentControl)(object)PartFlyoutControl).Content = null;
				PartFlyoutControl = null;
			}
			PartFlyoutDecorator = GetTemplateChild("PART_TileNavFlyoutDecorator") as FlyoutDecorator;
			if (PartFlyoutDecorator != null)
			{
				PartFlyoutDecorator.FlyoutShowMode = FlyoutShowMode;
				if (onApplyTemplate)
				{
					PartFlyoutDecorator.SizeChanged += tileNavFlyoutDecorator_SizeChanged;
				}
				else
				{
					PartFlyoutControl = PartFlyoutDecorator.ActualFlyoutControl;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DependencyObject templateChild = GetTemplateChild("PART_FlyoutControl");
				PartFlyoutControl = (FlyoutControl)(object)((templateChild is FlyoutControl) ? templateChild : null);
			}
			EnsureFlyoutControlProperties();
		}

		private void tileNavFlyoutDecorator_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			PartFlyoutDecorator.SizeChanged -= tileNavFlyoutDecorator_SizeChanged;
			PartFlyoutControl = PartFlyoutDecorator.ActualFlyoutControl;
			EnsureFlyoutControlProperties();
		}

		private void EnsureFlyoutControlProperties()
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (PartFlyoutControl != null)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)(object)PartFlyoutControl).HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch;
				((FlyoutBase)PartFlyoutControl).Settings = (FlyoutSettingsBase)new FlyoutSettings
				{
					Placement = ((IFlyoutProvider)this).Placement
				};
				((FlyoutBase)PartFlyoutControl).StaysOpen = true;
				((FlyoutBase)PartFlyoutControl).AlwaysOnTop = true;
				((FlyoutBase)PartFlyoutControl).PlacementTarget = this;
				((FlyoutBase)PartFlyoutControl).AllowMoveAnimation = false;
				((ContentControl)(object)PartFlyoutControl).Content = PartTileNavPaneContentControl;
			}
		}

		internal void OnNavElementClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OriginalSource is INavElement navElement)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
				if (navElement is NavButton navButton && PartFlyoutControl != null)
				{
					UpdateFlyout(navButton);
				}
				else
				{
					CloseFlyoutInternal();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateNavButtonsCheckState(NavButton checkedButton)
		{
			foreach (NavButton item in (Collection<NavButton>)(object)DefaultButtons)
			{
				if (item != checkedButton)
				{
					item.IsChecked = false;
				}
			}
			foreach (NavButton item2 in (Collection<NavButton>)(object)NavButtons)
			{
				if (item2 != checkedButton)
				{
					item2.IsChecked = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFlyout(NavButton navButton)
		{
			if (navButton == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateNavButtonsCheckState(navButton);
			IFlyoutEventListener flyoutTarget = FlyoutManager.GetFlyoutTarget(PartFlyoutControl);
			if (flyoutTarget == navButton)
			{
				if (((FlyoutBase)PartFlyoutControl).IsOpen)
				{
					CloseFlyoutInternal(forceClose: true);
				}
				else
				{
					ShowFlyout(navButton);
				}
				return;
			}
			UIElement itemsPresenter = navButton.GetItemsPresenter();
			FlyoutSourceTypeHelper.SetFlyoutSourceType(itemsPresenter, FlyoutSourceType.FromTileNavPane);
			(itemsPresenter as TileBar).Do(delegate(TileBar x)
			{
				x.SetBinding(TileBar.FlyoutShowModeProperty, new Binding("FlyoutShowMode")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			});
			(itemsPresenter as TileBar).Do(delegate(TileBar x)
			{
				x.SetBinding(TileBar.FlyoutShowDirectionProperty, new Binding("FlyoutShowDirection")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			});
			(itemsPresenter as TileBar).Do(delegate(TileBar x)
			{
				x.SetBinding(TileBar.ShowItemShadowProperty, new Binding("ShowItemShadow")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			});
			if (navButton.IsMain)
			{
				if (Categories.Count <= 0)
				{
					CloseFlyoutInternal();
					return;
				}
				FlyoutManager.CloseAllExcept(this);
				PartTileNavPaneContentControl.Content = itemsPresenter;
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(itemsPresenter, ItemsControl.ItemsSourceProperty, new Binding("Categories")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(itemsPresenter, ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyleProperty, new Binding("CategoryStyle")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				ShowFlyout(navButton);
			}
			else if (!navButton.HasItems)
			{
				CloseFlyoutInternal(forceClose: true);
			}
			else
			{
				FlyoutManager.CloseAllExcept(this);
				PartTileNavPaneContentControl.Content = itemsPresenter;
				ShowFlyout(navButton);
			}
		}

		private void ShowFlyout(INavElement element)
		{
			FlyoutManager.Show(this, element as IFlyoutEventListener);
		}

		private void CloseFlyoutInternal(bool forceClose = false)
		{
			if (!ContinuousNavigation || forceClose)
			{
				FlyoutManager.CloseAll();
			}
		}

		public void CloseFlyout()
		{
			CloseFlyoutInternal(forceClose: true);
		}

		private void UpdateDefaultButtonsCollection(NavElementBase element)
		{
			if (DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
			{
				return;
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<NavButton>)DefaultButtons).BeginUpdate();
			((Collection<NavButton>)(object)DefaultButtons).Clear();
			for (INavElement navElement = element; navElement != null; navElement = navElement.NavParent)
			{
				SelectedNavButton selectedNavButton = new SelectedNavButton();
				selectedNavButton.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentProperty, new Binding("Content")
				{
					Source = navElement
				});
				selectedNavButton.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentTemplateProperty, new Binding("ContentTemplate")
				{
					Source = navElement
				});
				selectedNavButton.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty, new Binding("ContentTemplateSelector")
				{
					Source = navElement
				});
				if (navElement.HasItems)
				{
					selectedNavButton.SetBinding(NavButton.ItemsSourceProperty, new Binding("Items")
					{
						Source = navElement
					});
					selectedNavButton.SetBinding(NavButton.ItemStyleProperty, new Binding("ItemStyle")
					{
						Source = navElement
					});
					if (navElement is TileNavCategory)
					{
						NavButton.SetItemsPresenter(selectedNavButton, ((TileNavCategory)navElement).PartItemsControl);
					}
					if (navElement is TileNavItem)
					{
						NavButton.SetItemsPresenter(selectedNavButton, ((TileNavItem)navElement).PartItemsControl);
					}
					if (ContinuousNavigation && element == navElement && (element is TileNavCategory || element is TileNavItem))
					{
						UpdateFlyout(selectedNavButton);
					}
				}
				if (navElement is NavElementBase navElementBase)
				{
					navElementBase.NavButton = selectedNavButton;
				}
				((Collection<NavButton>)(object)DefaultButtons).Insert(0, (NavButton)selectedNavButton);
				((Collection<NavButton>)(object)DefaultButtons).Insert(0, (NavButton)new NavButtonSeparator());
			}
			NavButton navButton = ((IEnumerable<NavButton>)NavButtons).FirstOrDefault((NavButton x) => x.IsMain);
			if ((navButton == null || !navButton.IsVisible) && ((Collection<NavButton>)(object)DefaultButtons).Count > 0 && ((Collection<NavButton>)(object)DefaultButtons)[0] is NavButtonSeparator)
			{
				((Collection<NavButton>)(object)DefaultButtons).RemoveAt(0);
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<NavButton>)DefaultButtons).EndUpdate();
		}

		internal void UpdateFlyout()
		{
			UpdateDefaultButtonsCollection(SelectedElement);
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedElementChanged(NavElementBase oldValue, NavElementBase newValue)
		{
			UpdateDefaultButtonsCollection(newValue);
			if (!DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this) && oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.IsSelected = false;
			}
			RaiseSelectedElementChanged(SelectedElement);
		}

		private bool SetSelectedElement(NavElementBase element)
		{
			if (element == null || SelectedElement == element)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SelectedElement = element;
			return true;
		}

		internal void SetSelectedElement(NavElementBase element, bool isSelected)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				if (isSelected)
				{
					SetSelectedElement(element);
				}
				else if (SelectedElement == element)
				{
					SelectedElement = null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void RaiseSelectedElementChanged(NavElementBase element)
		{
			TileNavPaneSelectionChangedEventArgs e = new TileNavPaneSelectionChangedEventArgs
			{
				SelectedElement = element
			};
			this.SelectionChanged?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnFlyoutShowModeChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			CloseAndEnsureFlyout();
		}

		protected virtual void OnFlyoutShowDirectionChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			CloseAndEnsureFlyout();
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new TileNavPaneAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		private void CloseAndEnsureFlyout()
		{
			if (PartFlyoutControl != null)
			{
				FlyoutManager.CloseAll();
				EnsureFlyoutControl(onApplyTemplate: false);
				UpdateNavButtonsCheckState(null);
			}
		}

		private void OnNavButtons_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (NetVersionDetector.IsNet8())
			{
				UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(this)?.ResetChildrenCache();
			}
		}

		void ILogicalOwner.AddChild(object child)
		{
			AddLogicalChild(child);
		}

		void ILogicalOwner.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			RemoveLogicalChild(child);
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool ILogicalOwner.get_IsLoaded()
		{
			return base.IsLoaded;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ILogicalOwner.add_Loaded(RoutedEventHandler value)
		{
			base.Loaded += value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ILogicalOwner.remove_Loaded(RoutedEventHandler value)
		{
			base.Loaded -= value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		double ILogicalOwner.get_ActualWidth()
		{
			return base.ActualWidth;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		double ILogicalOwner.get_ActualHeight()
		{
			return base.ActualHeight;
		}
	}

	public class TileNavSubItem : NavElementBase
	{
		internal class TilNavSubItemSizeProvider : SizeProvider
		{
			protected override System.Windows.Size GetSizeCore(TileSize tileSize)
			{
				return tileSize switch
				{
					TileSize.Auto => new System.Windows.Size(double.NaN, double.NaN), 
					TileSize.Small => new System.Windows.Size(60.0, 58.0), 
					TileSize.Wide => new System.Windows.Size(260.0, 58.0), 
					_ => new System.Windows.Size(125.0, 58.0), 
				};
			}
		}

		private bool shouldInvertBrushes;

		static TileNavSubItem()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<TileNavSubItem>();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TileNavSubItem>.New().OverrideMetadata(TileSelectorItem.ColorModeProperty, (object)TileColorMode.Auto, (Action<TileNavSubItem>)null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None).OverrideMetadata(TileSelectorItem.ShowFlyoutButtonProperty, (object)false, (Action<TileNavSubItem>)null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size GetSizeForTileSize(TileSize tileSize)
		{
			return new TilNavSubItemSizeProvider().GetSize(tileSize);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetCalculatedBackground()
		{
			if (!shouldInvertBrushes)
			{
				return base.GetCalculatedBackground();
			}
			return base.Foreground;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Media.Brush GetCalculatedForeground()
		{
			if (!shouldInvertBrushes)
			{
				return base.GetCalculatedForeground();
			}
			return base.Background;
		}

		protected override void UpdateCalculatedBrushes()
		{
			if (!(base.Owner is TileNavPaneBar target))
			{
				base.UpdateCalculatedBrushes();
				return;
			}
			shouldInvertBrushes = !DependencyObjectExtensions.IsInDesignTool((DependencyObject)this) && FlyoutSourceTypeHelper.GetFlyoutSourceType(target) != FlyoutSourceType.FromTileNavPane && base.ActualColorMode == TileColorMode.Auto;
			base.UpdateCalculatedBrushes();
		}

		protected override void OnFlyoutClosing(ref bool cancel)
		{
			cancel = false;
		}

		protected override object OnCoerceIsFlyoutButtonVisible(bool value)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class TileNavSubItemCollection : NavElementCollectionBase<TileNavSubItem>
	{
		private INavElement Owner;

		internal TileNavSubItemCollection(INavElement owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		protected override void InsertItemCore(TileNavSubItem item)
		{
			item.AllowSelection = Owner.AllowSelection;
			if (!(Owner is NavButton))
			{
				((INavElement)item).NavParent = Owner;
				((INavElement)item).TileNavPane = Owner.TileNavPane;
				((ILogicalOwner)Owner).AddChild((object)item);
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveItemCore(TileNavSubItem item)
		{
			if (item != null && ((INavElement)item).NavParent == Owner)
			{
				((INavElement)item).NavParent = null;
				((INavElement)item).TileNavPane = null;
				((ILogicalOwner)Owner).RemoveChild((object)item);
			}
		}
	}

	public class OfficeNavigationBarAutomationPeer : WinUIAutomationPeerBase<OfficeNavigationBar>, ISelectionProvider
	{
		public bool CanSelectMultiple => false;

		public bool IsSelectionRequired => true;

		public OfficeNavigationBarAutomationPeer(OfficeNavigationBar owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> childrenCore = ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetChildrenCore();
			if (!NetVersionDetector.IsNet8())
			{
				return childrenCore;
			}
			NavigationBarButton navigationBarButton = base.Owner?.CustomizationButton;
			IEnumerable<NavigationBarItemAutomationPeer> enumerable = childrenCore.OfType<NavigationBarItemAutomationPeer>();
			if (navigationBarButton != null)
			{
				return ((IEnumerable<AutomationPeer>)enumerable).Union(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(navigationBarButton).Yield()).ToList();
			}
			return enumerable.Cast<AutomationPeer>().ToList();
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.List;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Selection)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		public IRawElementProviderSimple[] GetSelection()
		{
			if (base.Owner.SelectedItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(base.Owner.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(base.Owner.SelectedItem) is UIElement element))
			{
				return null;
			}
			AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(element);
			if (automationPeer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IRawElementProviderSimple rawElementProviderSimple = ((AutomationPeer)(object)this).ProviderFromPeer(automationPeer);
			if (rawElementProviderSimple == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new IRawElementProviderSimple[1] { rawElementProviderSimple };
		}
	}

	public class TileBarAutomationPeer : WinUIAutomationPeerBase<TileBar>, ISelectionProvider, IScrollProvider
	{
		internal const string cannotScrollToDirection = "Can not scroll to unsupported direcetion";

		internal const string scrollPercentIsOutOfRange = "Scroll percent is out of range";

		public bool CanSelectMultiple => false;

		public bool IsSelectionRequired => base.Owner.IsSelectionRequired;

		private double ScrollPercent => base.Owner.Offset * 100.0 / (base.Owner.Extent - base.Owner.Viewport);

		private double ViewSize => base.Owner.Viewport * 100.0 / base.Owner.Extent;

		private bool IsScrollable => base.Owner.Extent > base.Owner.Viewport;

		private bool IsHorizontal => base.Owner.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;

		public double HorizontalScrollPercent
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsHorizontal)
				{
					return -1.0;
				}
				return ScrollPercent;
			}
		}

		public double VerticalScrollPercent
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsHorizontal)
				{
					return ScrollPercent;
				}
				return -1.0;
			}
		}

		public double HorizontalViewSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsHorizontal)
				{
					return 100.0;
				}
				return ViewSize;
			}
		}

		public double VerticalViewSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsHorizontal)
				{
					return ViewSize;
				}
				return 100.0;
			}
		}

		public bool HorizontallyScrollable
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsHorizontal)
				{
					return IsScrollable;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool VerticallyScrollable
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsHorizontal)
				{
					return IsScrollable;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public TileBarAutomationPeer(TileBar owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Group;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Selection || patternInterface == PatternInterface.Scroll)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		public IRawElementProviderSimple[] GetSelection()
		{
			if (base.Owner.SelectedItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(base.Owner.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(base.Owner.SelectedItem) is UIElement element))
			{
				return null;
			}
			AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(element);
			if (automationPeer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IRawElementProviderSimple rawElementProviderSimple = ((AutomationPeer)(object)this).ProviderFromPeer(automationPeer);
			if (rawElementProviderSimple == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new IRawElementProviderSimple[1] { rawElementProviderSimple };
		}

		private double GetOffset(ScrollAmount amount)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (amount)
			{
			case ScrollAmount.LargeDecrement:
				result = -48.0;
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.LargeIncrement:
				result = 48.0;
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.SmallDecrement:
				result = -16.0;
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.SmallIncrement:
				result = 16.0;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void Scroll(ScrollAmount horizontalAmount, ScrollAmount verticalAmount)
		{
			if ((!VerticallyScrollable && verticalAmount != ScrollAmount.NoAmount) || (!HorizontallyScrollable && horizontalAmount != ScrollAmount.NoAmount))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Can not scroll to unsupported direcetion");
			}
			if (VerticallyScrollable || HorizontallyScrollable)
			{
				double scrollPercent = ScrollPercent;
				double offset = GetOffset(horizontalAmount);
				double offset2 = GetOffset(verticalAmount);
				base.Owner.SetScrollOffset(new System.Windows.Point(offset, offset2));
				if (scrollPercent != ScrollPercent)
				{
					((AutomationPeer)(object)this).RaisePropertyChangedEvent(HorizontallyScrollable ? ScrollPatternIdentifiers.HorizontalScrollPercentProperty : ScrollPatternIdentifiers.VerticalScrollPercentProperty, (object)scrollPercent, (object)ScrollPercent);
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetScrollPercent(double horizontalPercent, double verticalPercent)
		{
			if ((!VerticallyScrollable && verticalPercent != 0.0 && verticalPercent != -1.0) || (!HorizontallyScrollable && horizontalPercent != 0.0 && horizontalPercent != -1.0))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Can not scroll to unsupported direcetion");
			}
			if ((VerticallyScrollable && ((verticalPercent < 0.0 && verticalPercent != -1.0) || verticalPercent > 100.0)) || (HorizontallyScrollable && ((horizontalPercent < 0.0 && horizontalPercent != -1.0) || horizontalPercent > 100.0)))
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException("Scroll percent is out of range");
			}
			if (VerticallyScrollable || HorizontallyScrollable)
			{
				double num = (HorizontallyScrollable ? HorizontalScrollPercent : VerticalScrollPercent);
				double num2 = (HorizontallyScrollable ? horizontalPercent : verticalPercent);
				base.Owner.SetScrollOffset(new System.Windows.Point(horizontalPercent / 100.0 * base.Owner.Extent, verticalPercent / 100.0 * base.Owner.Extent));
				((AutomationPeer)(object)this).RaisePropertyChangedEvent(HorizontallyScrollable ? ScrollPatternIdentifiers.HorizontalScrollPercentProperty : ScrollPatternIdentifiers.VerticalScrollPercentProperty, (object)num, (object)num2);
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class TileSelectorItemAutomationPeer : WinUIAutomationPeerBase<TileSelectorItem>, ISelectionItemProvider, IInvokeProvider, IExpandCollapseProvider, IScrollItemProvider
	{

		public ExpandCollapseState ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.Owner.IsFlyoutOpen)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
				}
				return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
			}
		}

		public TileSelectorItemAutomationPeer(TileSelectorItem owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			isFlyoutOpenChangedHandler = OnOwnerIsFlyoutOpenChanged;
			base.Owner.IsFlyoutOpenChanged += isFlyoutOpenChangedHandler;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			switch (patternInterface)
			{
			case PatternInterface.Invoke:
			case PatternInterface.ScrollItem:
			case PatternInterface.SelectionItem:
				return this;
			case PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse:
				if (base.Owner.IsFlyoutButtonVisible)
				{
					return this;
				}
				break;
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Button;
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> childrenCore = ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetChildrenCore();
			if (base.Owner.IsFlyoutOpen)
			{
				BarsAutomationHelper.GetChildrenRecursive(childrenCore, (DependencyObject)base.Owner.FlyoutContentContainer);
			}
			return childrenCore;
		}

		private void OnOwnerIsFlyoutOpenChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				((AutomationPeer)(object)this).ResetChildrenCache();
				((AutomationPeer)(object)this).RaiseAutomationEvent(AutomationEvents.StructureChanged);
			}, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}

		public void Select()
		{
			base.Owner.IsSelected = true;
		}

		public void AddToSelection()
		{
			Select();
		}

		public void RemoveFromSelection()
		{
			base.Owner.IsSelected = false;
		}

		public void Invoke()
		{
			if (!((AutomationPeer)(object)this).IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			base.Owner.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				base.Owner.Controller.InvokeClick();
			}, DispatcherPriority.Input);
		}

		public void Expand()
		{
			base.Owner.IsFlyoutOpen = true;
		}

		public void Collapse()
		{
			base.Owner.IsFlyoutOpen = false;
		}

		public void ScrollIntoView()
		{
			if (base.Owner.Owner is TileBar tileBar)
			{
				tileBar.BringChildIntoView(base.Owner);
			}
		}
	}

		private void OnDownButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			int selectedIndex = listBox.SelectedIndex;
			int toIndex = selectedIndex + 1;
			if (toIndex < ((Collection<object>)(object)itemsSource).Count)
			{
				Owner.CustomizationHelper.EnqueueCustomizationAction(new MoveCustomizationAction
				{
					FromIndex = selectedIndex,
					ToIndex = toIndex
				});
				object selectedItem = listBox.SelectedItem;
				((Collection<object>)(object)itemsSource).RemoveAt(selectedIndex);
				((Collection<object>)(object)itemsSource).Insert(toIndex, selectedItem);
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					SelectedIndex = toIndex;
					listBox.ScrollIntoView(listBox.SelectedItem);
				});
			}
		}

			NavigationBarCustomizationHelper.CustomizationState customizationState = Owner.CustomizationHelper.GetCustomizationState();
			if (customizationState != null)

				PopulateItemsSource(customizationState.OriginalItems);
				ItemsCount = ((Collection<object>)(object)itemsSource).Count;
				int originalMaxItemsCount = customizationState.OriginalMaxItemsCount;
				VisibleItemsCount = ((originalMaxItemsCount >= 0 && originalMaxItemsCount < ItemsCount) ? originalMaxItemsCount : ItemsCount);
			}
		}

		private void OnUpButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)

				Owner.CustomizationHelper.EnqueueCustomizationAction(new MoveCustomizationAction
				{
					FromIndex = selectedIndex,
					ToIndex = toIndex
				});
				object selectedItem = listBox.SelectedItem;
				((Collection<object>)(object)itemsSource).RemoveAt(selectedIndex);

		private void PopulateItemsSource()

		private void PopulateItemsSource(IList items)
		{
			((Collection<object>)(object)itemsSource).Clear();
			itemsSource.BeginUpdate();
			foreach (object item in items)
			{
				if (Owner.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is NavigationBarItem navigationBarItem)
				{
					object content = navigationBarItem.CustomizationCaption ?? ((navigationBarItem.Content is UIElement) ? navigationBarItem.Content.ToString() : navigationBarItem.Content);
					DataTemplate template = navigationBarItem.CustomizationCaptionTemplate ?? navigationBarItem.ContentTemplate;
					DataTemplateSelector templateSelector = navigationBarItem.CustomizationCaptionTemplateSelector ?? navigationBarItem.ContentTemplateSelector;
					if (content == null && template == null && templateSelector == null)
					{
						content = navigationBarItem.GetType().Name;
					}
					CustomizableItem item2 = ViewModelSource.Create(() => new CustomizableItem
					{
						Content = content,
						ContentTemplate = template,
						ContentTemplateSelector = templateSelector,
						Tag = item
					});
					((Collection<object>)(object)itemsSource).Add((object)item2);
				}
			}
			itemsSource.EndUpdate();
			int selectedIndex = SelectedIndex;
			SelectedIndex = ((((Collection<object>)(object)itemsSource).Count <= 0) ? (-1) : 0);
			OnSelectedIndexChanged(selectedIndex, SelectedIndex);
			ItemsCount = ((Collection<object>)(object)itemsSource).Count;
			int maxItemCount = Owner.MaxItemCount;
			VisibleItemsCount = ((maxItemCount >= 0 && maxItemCount < ItemsCount) ? maxItemCount : ItemsCount);
			IsCompact = Owner.IsCompact;
			SupportCompactMode = Owner.NavigationClient != null && Owner.NavigationClient.AcceptsCompactNavigation;
		}

				Property = OfficeNavigationBar.MaxItemCountProperty,
				Value = Convert.ToInt32(e.NewValue)
			});
		}

	public class NavigationBarCustomizationHelper
	{
		internal class CustomizationState : ILockable
		{
			private int lockCount;

			public ObservableCollection<object> OriginalItems { get; set; }

			public int OriginalMaxItemsCount { get; set; }

			public bool IsLockUpdate => lockCount > 0;

			public void BeginUpdate()
			{
				lockCount++;
			}

			public void EndUpdate()
			{
				lockCount--;
			}
		}

		private readonly List<CustomizationAction> customizationActions = new List<CustomizationAction>();

		private readonly OfficeNavigationBar Owner;

		private readonly List<CustomizationAction> undoActions = new List<CustomizationAction>();

		private CustomizationControl _customizationControl;

		private CustomizationControl _defaultCustomizationControl;

		private NavigationBarMenu _NavigationBarCustomizationMenu;

		private CustomizationState _State;

		private int lockCustomizationState;

		private BarItem navigationOptionsBarItem;

		private ICommand navigationOptionsCommand;

		public CustomizationControl CustomizationControl
		{
			get
			{
				return _customizationControl ?? DefaultCustomizationControl;
			}
			set
			{
				_customizationControl = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsCustomizationFormVisible
		{
			get

				{
					return ((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).IsOpen;

				return false;
			}
		}

		internal BarItem NavigationOptionsBarItem
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002b: Expected O, but got Unknown

		private bool IsCustomizationStateLocked => lockCustomizationState > 0;

		private ICommand NavigationOptionsCommand
		{
			get
			{
				if (navigationOptionsCommand == null)
				{
					navigationOptionsCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
					{
						ShowCustomizationForm((ILogicalOwner)(object)Owner);
					});
				}
				return navigationOptionsCommand;
			}
		}

		public NavigationBarCustomizationHelper(OfficeNavigationBar owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		public void ApplyCustomization()
		{
			IEnumerable enumerable = Owner.ItemsSource ?? Owner.Items;
			IList list = enumerable as IList;
			if (list == null)
			{
				list = new EnumerableObservableWrapper<object>(enumerable);
			}
			if (_State == null)
			{
				_State = new CustomizationState
				{
					OriginalMaxItemsCount = Owner.MaxItemCount
				};
			}
			if (!_State.IsLockUpdate)
			{
				_State.BeginUpdate();
				_State.OriginalItems = new ObservableCollection<object>(list.Cast<object>());
			}
			List<CustomizationAction> list2 = customizationActions.ToList();
			customizationActions.Clear();
			lockCustomizationState++;
			object selectedItem = Owner.SelectedItem;
			ISupportInitialize supportInitialize = Owner.NavigationClient as ISupportInitialize;
			try
			{
				supportInitialize?.BeginInit();
				ILockable lockable = list as ILockable;
				lockable?.BeginUpdate();
				Owner.LockSelection();
				foreach (CustomizationAction item in list2)
				{
					if (item is ResetCustomizationAction)
					{
						ResetCustomization();
						continue;
					}
					if (item is MoveCustomizationAction moveCustomizationAction)
					{
						if (!IsValidIndex(list, moveCustomizationAction.FromIndex) || !IsValidIndex(list, moveCustomizationAction.ToIndex))
						{
							continue;
						}
						object value = list[moveCustomizationAction.FromIndex];
						list.RemoveAt(moveCustomizationAction.FromIndex);
						list.Insert(moveCustomizationAction.ToIndex, value);
					}
					if (item is PropertyCustomizationAction propertyCustomizationAction)
					{
						Owner.SetValue(propertyCustomizationAction.Property, propertyCustomizationAction.Value);
					}
					undoActions.Insert(0, item);
				}
				lockable?.EndUpdate();
				supportInitialize?.EndInit();
			}
			finally
			{
				Owner.UnlockSelection();
				int num = list.IndexOf(selectedItem);
				if (num != Owner.SelectedIndex)
				{
					Owner.SetCurrentValue(Selector.SelectedIndexProperty, num);
				}
				lockCustomizationState--;
			}
		}

		public void CancelCustomization()
		{
			customizationActions.Clear();
		}

		public void CloseCustomizationForm()
		{
			CustomizationForm.Do(delegate(FloatingContainer x)
			{
				x.Close();
			});
		}

		public void EnqueueCustomizationAction(CustomizationAction action)
		{
			if (action is ResetCustomizationAction)
			{
				customizationActions.Clear();
			}
			customizationActions.Add(action);
		}

		public void ShowCustomizationForm(ILogicalOwner owner)
		{
			CustomizationForm = FloatingContainerFactory.Create((FloatingMode)1);
			((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).BeginUpdate();
			((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).UseActiveStateOnly = true;
			CustomizationForm.Caption = NavigationLocalizer.GetString(NavigationStringId.CustomizationForm_Caption);
			owner.AddChild((object)CustomizationForm);
			((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).Owner = owner as FrameworkElement;
			if (((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).Owner == null)
			{
				((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).Owner = Owner;
			}
			((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).Content = CustomizationControl;
			CustomizationForm.CloseOnEscape = true;
			CustomizationForm.ShowModal = true;
			CustomizationForm.ContainerStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).FloatSize = ((Owner == null) ? new System.Windows.Size(325.0, 275.0) : ((System.Windows.Size)Owner.ValuesProvider.CustomizationFormFloatSize));
			double minHeight = ((Owner == null) ? 325.0 : Owner.ValuesProvider.CustomizationFormMinHeight);
			double minWidth = ((Owner == null) ? 275.0 : Owner.ValuesProvider.CustomizationFormMinWidth);
			((FrameworkElement)(object)CustomizationForm).MinHeight = minHeight;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)CustomizationForm).MinWidth = minWidth;
			CustomizationForm.SizeToContent = SizeToContent.Width;
			CustomizationForm.Hidden += OnCustomizationFormHidden;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).EndUpdate();
			FloatingContainer customizationForm = CustomizationForm;
			((FloatingWindowContainer)(object)((customizationForm is FloatingWindowContainer) ? customizationForm : null)).With((FloatingWindowContainer x) => x.Window).Do(delegate(WindowContentHolder x)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)(object)x).MinHeight = minHeight;
				((FrameworkElement)(object)x).MinWidth = minWidth;
			});
			((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).IsOpen = true;
		}

		internal void ClearCustomizationState()
		{
			_State = null;
		}

		internal CustomizationState GetCustomizationState()
		{
			return _State;
		}

		internal void InvalidateState()
		{
			if (!IsCustomizationStateLocked)
			{
				if (_State != null)
				{
					_State.EndUpdate();
				}
				undoActions.Clear();
				customizationActions.Clear();
			}
		}

		protected virtual CustomizationControl CreateDefaultCustomizationControl()
		{
			return new CustomizationControl(Owner);
		}

		private bool IsValidIndex(IList collection, int index)
		{
			if (index < collection.Count)
			{
				return index >= 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnCustomizationFormHidden(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			Owner.RemoveChild(CustomizationForm);
			CustomizationForm.Hidden -= OnCustomizationFormHidden;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).Content = null;
			CustomizationControl.OnCustomizationFormHidden();
		}

		private void ResetCustomization()
		{
			List<CustomizationAction> list = undoActions.ToList();
			undoActions.Clear();
			customizationActions.Clear();
			IEnumerable enumerable = Owner.ItemsSource ?? Owner.Items;
			IList list2 = enumerable as IList;
			if (list2 == null)
			{
				list2 = new EnumerableObservableWrapper<object>(enumerable);
			}
			ILockable lockable = list2 as ILockable;
			lockable?.BeginUpdate();
			foreach (CustomizationAction item in list)
			{
				if (item is MoveCustomizationAction moveCustomizationAction && IsValidIndex(list2, moveCustomizationAction.FromIndex) && IsValidIndex(list2, moveCustomizationAction.ToIndex))
				{
					object value = list2[moveCustomizationAction.ToIndex];
					list2.RemoveAt(moveCustomizationAction.ToIndex);
					list2.Insert(moveCustomizationAction.FromIndex, value);
				}
			}
			Owner.MaxItemCount = _State.OriginalMaxItemsCount;
			lockable?.EndUpdate();
		}

	public class NavigationBarMenuInfo : NavigationBarMenuInfoBase
	{
		private static int menuItemCounter;

		public new NavigationBarMenu Menu => (NavigationBarMenu)base.Menu;

		internal OfficeNavigationBar NavigationBar => ((BarPopupBase)Menu).Owner as OfficeNavigationBar;

		public override bool CanCreateItems => true;

		public override BarManagerMenuController MenuController => new BarManagerMenuController((PopupMenu)(object)Menu);

		public NavigationBarMenuInfo(NavigationBarMenu menu)
			: base(menu)
		{
		}

		public static string GetUniqueMenuItemName()
		{
			return $"MenuItem{++menuItemCounter}";
		}

		protected override void CreateItems()
		{
			CreateBarButtonItem("ItemCustomizationNavigationOptions", NavigationStringId.CustomizationMenu_NavigationOptions, beginGroup: false, null, DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
			{
				NavigationBar.CustomizationHelper.ShowCustomizationForm((ILogicalOwner)(object)NavigationBar);
			}));
			int actualHiddenItemsCount = NavigationBar.ActualHiddenItemsCount;
			if (actualHiddenItemsCount <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int num2 = NavigationBar.Items.Count - actualHiddenItemsCount; num2 < NavigationBar.Items.Count; num2++)
			{
				if (NavigationBar.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(num2) is NavigationBarItem container)
				{
					CreateMenuItem(container, num++);
				}
			}
		}

		private BarCheckItem CreateMenuItem(NavigationBarItem container, int itemsCount)
		{
			object obj = container.CustomizationCaption ?? ((container.Content is UIElement) ? container.Content.ToString() : container.Content);
			INavigationItem val = (INavigationItem)((obj is INavigationItem) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				obj = val.Header;
			}
			DataTemplate contentTemplate = container.CustomizationCaptionTemplate ?? container.ContentTemplate;
			DataTemplateSelector contentTemplateSelector = container.CustomizationCaptionTemplateSelector ?? container.ContentTemplateSelector;
			BarCheckItem val2 = CreateBarCheckItem(GetUniqueMenuItemName(), obj, container.IsSelected, itemsCount == 0, null, DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
			{
				container.IsSelected = true;
			}));
			if (val == null)
			{
				((BarItem)val2).ContentTemplate = contentTemplate;
				((BarItem)val2).ContentTemplateSelector = contentTemplateSelector;
			}
			return val2;
		}
	}

		private bool IsValidIndex(IList collection, int index)
		{
			if (index < collection.Count)
			{
				return index >= 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SyncCollectionItems(int oldPosition, int newPosition, IEnumerable targetCollection)
		{
			IList list = targetCollection as IList;
			if (list == null)
			{
				list = new EnumerableObservableWrapper<object>(targetCollection);
			}
			ILockable input = list as ILockable;
			try
			{
				Owner.LockSelection();
				input.Do(delegate(ILockable x)
				{
					x.BeginUpdate();
				});
				if (IsValidIndex(list, oldPosition) && IsValidIndex(list, newPosition))
				{
					object value = list[oldPosition];
					list.RemoveAt(oldPosition);
					list.Insert(newPosition, value);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Owner.UnlockSelection();
				input.Do(delegate(ILockable x)
				{
					x.EndUpdate();
				});
			}
		}

		private void SyncItems(int oldPosition, int newPosition)
		{
			if (Owner == null || oldPosition == newPosition)
			{
				return;
			}
			ISupportInitialize input = Owner.NavigationClient as ISupportInitialize;
			input.Do(delegate(ISupportInitialize x)
			{
				x.BeginInit();
			});
			int selectedIndex = Owner.SelectedIndex;
			IEnumerable enumerable = Owner.ItemsSource ?? Owner.Items;
			if (enumerable is INotifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				SyncCollectionItems(oldPosition, newPosition, enumerable);
				if (selectedIndex == oldPosition)
				{
					Owner.SelectedIndex = newPosition;
				}
			}
			input.Do(delegate(ISupportInitialize x)
			{
				x.EndInit();
			});
		}

		protected override PanelControllerBase CreateController()
		{
			return (PanelControllerBase)(object)new NavigationBarItemsPanelController(this);
		}

		protected override void AfterArrange()
		{
			base.AfterArrange();
			childrenChanged.Do(delegate(EventHandler x)
			{
				x(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			});
		}

		protected FrameworkElement GetActiveChild()
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement visibleChild in LayoutProvider.VisibleChildren)
			{
				if ((bool)visibleChild.GetValue(Selector.IsSelectedProperty))
				{
					return visibleChild;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

	public class NavigationBarDragController : LocalDragPanelController<NavigationBarItemsPanel, NavigationBarItemsPanel>
	{
		private IDragPanel IDragPanel => (IDragPanel)(object)((DragPanelControllerBase<NavigationBarItemsPanel, NavigationBarItemsPanel>)(object)this).DragPanel;

		protected override double GetDragChildMaxOffset()
		{
			return base.GetDragChildMaxOffset() + ((DragPanelControllerBase<NavigationBarItemsPanel, NavigationBarItemsPanel>)(object)this).DragPanel.ItemSpacing * (double)(IDragPanel.Children.Count() - base.DragChildIndex - 1);
		}

		protected override double GetDragChildMinOffset()
		{
			return base.GetDragChildMinOffset() - ((DragPanelControllerBase<NavigationBarItemsPanel, NavigationBarItemsPanel>)(object)this).DragPanel.ItemSpacing * (double)base.DragChildIndex;
		}

		protected override double GetDragOffset()
		{
			return base.GetDragOffset() + ((DragPanelControllerBase<NavigationBarItemsPanel, NavigationBarItemsPanel>)(object)this).DragPanel.ItemSpacing;
		}

		protected override void OnDrop()
		{
			((DragPanelControllerBase<NavigationBarItemsPanel, NavigationBarItemsPanel>)(object)this).DragPanel.Owner.Do(delegate(OfficeNavigationBar x)
			{
				x.LockSelection();
			});
			base.OnDrop();
			((DragPanelControllerBase<NavigationBarItemsPanel, NavigationBarItemsPanel>)(object)this).DragPanel.Owner.Do(delegate(OfficeNavigationBar x)
			{
				x.UnlockSelection();
			});
			IDragItem.Do(delegate(IDragItem x)
			{
				x.IsDragStarted = false;
			});
		}

		protected override void OnDragStarted()
		{
			base.OnDragStarted();
			IDragItem.Do(delegate(IDragItem x)
			{
				x.IsDragStarted = true;
			});
		}

		{
			if (oldValue != null)

		protected virtual void OnContent1Changed(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
