				base.Children.Remove(oldValue);
			}
			if (Content1 != null)
			{
				base.Children.Add(Content1);
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			UIElement content = Content1;
			UIElement content2 = Content2;
			content.Measure(availableSize);
			content2.Measure(availableSize);
			System.Windows.Size desiredSize = content.DesiredSize;
			System.Windows.Size desiredSize2 = content2.DesiredSize;
			bool flag = Content1Location == Dock.Left || Content1Location == Dock.Right;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (desiredSize.Width + desiredSize2.Width + ItemSpacing > availableSize.Width)
				{
					content.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Width - desiredSize2.Width - ItemSpacing), availableSize.Height));
					desiredSize = content.DesiredSize;
					content2.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Width - desiredSize.Width - ItemSpacing), availableSize.Height));
					desiredSize2 = content2.DesiredSize;
				}
			}
			else if (desiredSize.Height + desiredSize2.Height + ItemSpacing > availableSize.Height)
			{
				content.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width, Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Height - desiredSize2.Height - ItemSpacing)));
				desiredSize = content.DesiredSize;
				content2.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(availableSize.Width, Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Height - desiredSize.Height - ItemSpacing)));
				desiredSize2 = content2.DesiredSize;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			num = ((!flag) ? (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height) ? (desiredSize.Height + desiredSize2.Height) : Math.Min(availableSize.Height, desiredSize.Height + desiredSize2.Height)) : (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width) ? (desiredSize.Width + desiredSize2.Width) : Math.Min(availableSize.Width, desiredSize.Width + desiredSize2.Width)));
			num += ItemSpacing;
			if (!flag)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(desiredSize.Width, desiredSize2.Width), num);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, Math.Max(desiredSize.Height, desiredSize2.Height));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			UIElement content = Content1;
			UIElement content2 = Content2;
			System.Windows.Size desiredSize = content.DesiredSize;
			System.Windows.Size desiredSize2 = content2.DesiredSize;
			switch (Content1Location)
			{
			case Dock.Top:
				content2.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, desiredSize2.Height));
				content.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, desiredSize2.Height + ItemSpacing, finalSize.Width, Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Height - desiredSize2.Height - ItemSpacing)));
				break;
			case Dock.Left:
				content2.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, desiredSize2.Width, finalSize.Height));
				content.Arrange(new Rect(desiredSize2.Width + ItemSpacing, 0.0, Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Width - desiredSize2.Width - ItemSpacing), finalSize.Height));
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
			{
				double num2 = Math.Max(finalSize.Height - desiredSize.Height - ItemSpacing, desiredSize2.Height);
				content.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Height - num2 - ItemSpacing)));
				content2.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, finalSize.Height - num2, finalSize.Width, num2));
				break;
			}
			default:
			{
				double num = Math.Max(finalSize.Width - desiredSize.Width - ItemSpacing, desiredSize2.Width);
				content.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Width - num - ItemSpacing), finalSize.Height));
				content2.Arrange(new Rect(finalSize.Width - num, 0.0, num, finalSize.Height));
				break;
			}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

	public class TileBarItemsCollection : UIElementCollection
	{
		private ILogicalOwner LogicalParent;

		public TileBarItemsCollection(UIElement visualParent, FrameworkElement logicalParent)
			: base(visualParent, logicalParent)
		{
			LogicalParent = (ILogicalOwner)(object)((logicalParent is ILogicalOwner) ? logicalParent : null);
		}

		public override int Add(UIElement element)
		{
			LogicalParent.Do(delegate(ILogicalOwner x)
			{
				x.AddChild((object)element);
			});
			return base.Add(element);
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			UIElement[] array = new UIElement[Count];
			CopyTo(array, 0);
			base.Clear();
			array.ForEach(delegate(UIElement x)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(x);
			});
		}

		public override void Insert(int index, UIElement element)
		{
			LogicalParent.Do(delegate(ILogicalOwner x)
			{
				x.AddChild((object)element);
			});
			base.Insert(index, element);
		}

		public override void Remove(UIElement element)
		{
			LogicalParent.Do(delegate(ILogicalOwner x)
			{
				x.RemoveChild((object)element);
			});
			base.Remove(element);
		}

		public override void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveLogicalChild(index);
			base.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public override void RemoveRange(int index, int count)
		{
			for (int i = index; i <= count; i++)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(index);
			}
			base.RemoveRange(index, count);
		}

		private void RemoveLogicalChild(int index)
		{
			if (index > 0 && index < Count)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(this[index]);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveLogicalChild(UIElement child)
		{
			LogicalParent.Do(delegate(ILogicalOwner x)
			{
				x.RemoveChild((object)child);
			});
		}
	}
	public class TileBarItemsPanel : HeaderedStackLayoutPanel, IScrollablePanel, IItemsPanel, ILockable

			}
		}

		private bool showGroupHeadersCore;

		private ItemsControl ItemsControl;

		private ScrollableControl ScrollableControl;

		private int lockUpdate;

		internal double Extent => GetLength(((ScrollControl)this).ScrollAreaSize);

		internal double ScrollOffset
		{

		internal double Viewport => GetLength(((PanelBase)this).ContentBounds);

		bool IScrollablePanel.CanScrollPrev => (base.IsHorizontal ? ((ScrollControl)this).HorizontalOffset : ((ScrollControl)this).VerticalOffset) > 0.0;

		bool IScrollablePanel.CanScrollNext
		{
			get
			{
				bool isHorizontal = base.IsHorizontal;
				double num = (isHorizontal ? ((PanelBase)this).ContentBounds.Size.Width : ((PanelBase)this).ContentBounds.Size.Height);
				double num2 = (isHorizontal ? ((ScrollControl)this).ScrollAreaSize.Width : ((ScrollControl)this).ScrollAreaSize.Height);
				double num3 = (isHorizontal ? ((ScrollControl)this).HorizontalOffset : ((ScrollControl)this).VerticalOffset);
				return num2 - num3 > num;
			}
		}

		Orientation IScrollablePanel.Orientation
		{

				return base.Orientation;

		static TileBarItemsPanel()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(TileBarItemsPanel);
			StackLayoutPanel.AllowItemClippingProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.ShowGroupHeadersProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false, OnShowGroupHeadersChanged));
			Panel.IsItemsHostProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, null, CoerceIsItemsHost));
		}

		private static void OnShowGroupHeadersChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((TileBarItemsPanel)(object)d).OnShowGroupHeadersChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
		}

		private static object CoerceIsItemsHost(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
		{
			return ((TileBarItemsPanel)(object)d).CoerceIsItemsHost(baseValue);
		}

		protected override void OnShowGroupHeadersChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			base.OnShowGroupHeadersChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			bool isLockUpdate = ((ILockable)this).IsLockUpdate;
			if (((Panel)(object)this).IsItemsHost && newValue != showGroupHeadersCore && !isLockUpdate && !DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode((DependencyObject)(object)this))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot change ShowGroupHeaders after a UIElementCollection has been created");
			}
			showGroupHeadersCore = newValue;
		}

		protected override Geometry GetGeometry()
		{
			Rect rect = RectHelper.New(FrameworkElementExtensions.GetSize((FrameworkElement)(object)this));
			Thickness thickness = (base.IsHorizontal ? new Thickness(((PanelBase)this).ContentPadding.Left, 0.0, ((PanelBase)this).ContentPadding.Right, 0.0) : new Thickness(0.0, ((PanelBase)this).ContentPadding.Top, 0.0, ((PanelBase)this).ContentPadding.Bottom));
			RectHelper.Deflate(ref rect, thickness);
			return new RectangleGeometry
			{
				Rect = rect
			};
		}

		protected override void OnPaddingChanged(Thickness oldValue, Thickness newValue)

			base.OnPaddingChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			((PanelBase)this).UpdateClip();

		private double GetLength(Rect rect)
		{
			if (!base.IsHorizontal)
			{
				return rect.Height;
			}
			return rect.Width;
		}

		private double GetLength(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			if (!base.IsHorizontal)
			{
				return size.Height;
			}
			return size.Width;
		}

		private double GetLocation(Rect rect)
		{
			if (!base.IsHorizontal)
			{
				return rect.Y;
			}
			return rect.X;
		}

		private double CalculateForwardScrollOffset()
		{
			double length = GetLength(((PanelBase)this).ContentBounds);
			double num = (base.IsHorizontal ? ((ScrollControl)this).HorizontalOffset : ((ScrollControl)this).VerticalOffset);
			if (!IsGrouping)
			{
				double location = GetLocation(((PanelBase)this).ChildrenBounds);
				double num2 = num + location;
				double num3 = num2 + length;
				foreach (object child in ((Panel)(object)this).Children)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = child as FrameworkElement;
					if (frameworkElement == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					Rect childBounds = ((PanelBase)this).GetChildBounds(frameworkElement);
					double location2 = GetLocation(childBounds);
					double num4 = location2 + GetLength(childBounds);
					if (num4 > num3)
					{
						if (location2 <= num2)
						{
							frameworkElement = GetChild(frameworkElement, 1);
						}
						if (frameworkElement != null)
						{
							return GetLocation(((PanelBase)this).GetChildBounds(frameworkElement)) - location;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return num + length;
		}

		private double CalculateBackwardScrollOffset()
		{
			double length = GetLength(((PanelBase)this).ContentBounds);
			double num = (base.IsHorizontal ? ((ScrollControl)this).HorizontalOffset : ((ScrollControl)this).VerticalOffset);
			if (!IsGrouping)
			{
				double location = GetLocation(((PanelBase)this).ChildrenBounds);
				double num2 = num + location;
				double num3 = num2 + length;
				for (int num4 = ((Panel)(object)this).Children.Count - 1; num4 >= 0; num4--)
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((Panel)(object)this).Children[num4] as FrameworkElement;
					if (frameworkElement != null)
					{
						Rect childBounds = ((PanelBase)this).GetChildBounds(frameworkElement);
						double location2 = GetLocation(childBounds);
						double num5 = location2 + GetLength(childBounds);
						if (location2 < num2)
						{
							if (num5 >= num3)
							{
								frameworkElement = GetChild(frameworkElement, -1);
							}
							if (frameworkElement != null)
							{
								double val = length - GetLength(((PanelBase)this).GetChildBounds(frameworkElement));
								return GetLocation(((PanelBase)this).GetChildBounds(frameworkElement)) - location - Math.Max(0.0, val);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return num - length;
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetChild(FrameworkElement child, int indexIncrement)
		{
			FrameworkElements logicalChildren = ((PanelBase)this).GetLogicalChildren(false);
			int num = ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)logicalChildren).IndexOf(child);
			if (IListExtensions.IsValidIndex<FrameworkElement>((IList<FrameworkElement>)logicalChildren, num + indexIncrement))
			{
				return ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)logicalChildren)[num + indexIncrement];
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override PanelControllerBase CreateController()
		{
			return (PanelControllerBase)(object)new TileBarItemsPanelController(this);
		}

		protected override UIElementCollection CreateUIElementCollection(FrameworkElement logicalParent)
		{
			if (ItemsControl == null)
			{
				ItemsControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<TileBar>((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			}
			showGroupHeadersCore = TileBar.Return((TileBar x) => x.ShowGroupHeaders, () => showGroupHeadersCore);
			if (ItemsControl != null && !((Panel)(object)this).IsItemsHost && showGroupHeadersCore)
			{
				logicalParent = ItemsControl;
			}
			return new TileBarItemsCollection((UIElement)(object)this, logicalParent);
		}

		protected override StackPanelGroupHeaders CreateGroupHeaders()
		{
			return new TileBarGroupHeaders((Panel)(object)this);
		}

		private object CoerceIsItemsHost(object baseValue)
		{
			showGroupHeadersCore = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<TileBar>((DependencyObject)(object)this).Return((TileBar x) => x.ShowGroupHeaders, () => showGroupHeadersCore);
			if (!showGroupHeadersCore)
			{
				return baseValue;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void ScrollNext()
		{
			((ScrollControlController)base.Controller).Scroll(base.Orientation, CalculateForwardScrollOffset(), true, true);
		}

		void IScrollablePanel.ScrollNext()
		{
			ScrollNext();
		}

		protected virtual void ScrollPrev()
		{
			((ScrollControlController)base.Controller).Scroll(base.Orientation, CalculateBackwardScrollOffset(), true, true);
		}

		void IScrollablePanel.ScrollPrev()
		{
			ScrollPrev();
		}

		bool IScrollablePanel.BringChildIntoView(FrameworkElement child)
		{
			return ((ScrollControl)this).BringChildIntoView(child, true);
		}

		void ILockable.BeginUpdate()
		{
			lockUpdate++;
		}

		void ILockable.EndUpdate()
		{
			lockUpdate--;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool IScrollablePanel.get_IsLoaded()
		{
			return ((FrameworkElement)(object)this).IsLoaded;
		}
	}

	public sealed class TileSizeManager : Freezable
	{
		internal static double DefaultSize;

		internal const double LargeSize = 310.0;

		internal const double SmallSize = 70.0;

		internal const double WideWidth = 310.0;

		internal const double WideHeight = 150.0;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty WidthProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty HeightProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualWidthProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualHeightProperty;

		public WeakReference OwnerRef;

		public ITileSizeProvider TileSizeProvider { get; internal set; }

		public double Width
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(WidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(WidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double Height
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(HeightProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(HeightProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double ActualWidth => (double)GetValue(ActualWidthProperty);

		public double ActualHeight => (double)GetValue(ActualHeightProperty);

		static TileSizeManager()
		{
			DefaultSize = 150.0;
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TileSizeManager> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TileSizeManager>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Width", ref WidthProperty, double.NaN, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((TileSizeManager)dObj).OnSizeChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Height", ref HeightProperty, double.NaN, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((TileSizeManager)dObj).OnSizeChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualWidth", ref ActualWidthProperty, DefaultSize);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualHeight", ref ActualHeightProperty, DefaultSize);
		}

		private void OnSizeChanged()
		{
			if (OwnerRef != null)
			{
				if (OwnerRef.Target is ITileSizeManagerOwner tileSizeManagerOwner)
				{
					tileSizeManagerOwner.OnSizeChanged();
				}
				else
				{
					OwnerRef = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateActualSize(bool isLarge, bool hasWidth, int rowCount, double rowIndent, bool hasHeight)
		{
			SetValue(ActualWidthProperty, hasWidth ? Width : (isLarge ? (DefaultSize * 2.0 + rowIndent) : DefaultSize));
			SetValue(ActualHeightProperty, hasHeight ? Height : (DefaultSize * (double)rowCount + (double)(rowCount - 1) * rowIndent));
		}

		public void UpdateActualSize(TileSize tileSize, bool isLarge, bool hasWidth, int rowCount, double rowIndent, bool hasHeight)
		{
			System.Windows.Size tileSize2 = GetTileSize((!isLarge) ? tileSize : TileSize.Default);
			double num = (hasWidth ? Width : (isLarge ? (tileSize2.Width * 2.0 + rowIndent) : tileSize2.Width));
			double num2 = (hasHeight ? Height : (tileSize2.Height * (double)rowCount + (double)(rowCount - 1) * rowIndent));
			SetValue(ActualWidthProperty, num);
			SetValue(ActualHeightProperty, num2);
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetTileSize(TileSize tileSize)
		{
			if (!(OwnerRef.Target is ITileSizeManagerOwner tileSizeManagerOwner))
			{
				return default(System.Windows.Size);
			}
			return tileSizeManagerOwner.GetSize(tileSize);
		}

		protected override Freezable CreateInstanceCore()
		{
			return new TileSizeManager();
		}
	}

	public class NavButtonPanel : SplitLayoutPanel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty GlyphSpaceProperty;

		public double GlyphSpace
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(GlyphSpaceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(GlyphSpaceProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		static NavButtonPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<NavButtonPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<NavButtonPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("GlyphSpace", ref GlyphSpaceProperty, 0.0, OnGlyphSpaceChanged);
		}

		private static void OnGlyphSpaceChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((NavButtonPanel)(object)d).OnGlyphSpaceChanged((double)e.NewValue);
		}

		private void OnGlyphSpaceChanged(double value)
		{
			((UIElement)this).InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			EnsureContent1Margin();
			return ((SplitLayoutPanel)this).MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}

		private static bool IsPropertyHasDefaultOrInheritedValue(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyProperty property)
		{
			return DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(dObj, property).BaseValueSource <= BaseValueSource.Inherited;
		}

		private void EnsureContent1Margin()
		{
			switch (((SplitLayoutPanel)this).Content1Location)
			{
			case Dock.Bottom:
				if (IsPropertyHasDefaultOrInheritedValue((DependencyObject)(object)this, SplitLayoutPanel.BottomContent1MarginProperty))
				{
					((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(SplitLayoutPanel.BottomContent1MarginProperty, (object)new Thickness(0.0, GlyphSpace, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
				break;
			case Dock.Left:
				if (IsPropertyHasDefaultOrInheritedValue((DependencyObject)(object)this, SplitLayoutPanel.LeftContent1MarginProperty))
				{
					((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(SplitLayoutPanel.LeftContent1MarginProperty, (object)new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, GlyphSpace, 0.0));
				}
				break;
			case Dock.Right:
				if (IsPropertyHasDefaultOrInheritedValue((DependencyObject)(object)this, SplitLayoutPanel.RightContent1MarginProperty))
				{
					((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(SplitLayoutPanel.RightContent1MarginProperty, (object)new Thickness(GlyphSpace, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
				break;
			case Dock.Top:
				if (IsPropertyHasDefaultOrInheritedValue((DependencyObject)(object)this, SplitLayoutPanel.TopContent1MarginProperty))
				{
					((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(SplitLayoutPanel.TopContent1MarginProperty, (object)new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, GlyphSpace));
				}
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	public class TileNavPaneHeadersPanel : StackLayoutPanel
	{
		private class TileNavPaneHeadersLayoutProvider : StackLayoutPanelProvider
		{
			public TileNavPaneHeadersLayoutProvider(IStackPanelModel model)
				: base(model)
			{
			}

			protected override System.Windows.Size OnMeasure(FrameworkElements items, System.Windows.Size maxSize)
			{
				PrepareItems(items);
				return base.OnMeasure(items, maxSize);
			}

			protected override System.Windows.Size OnArrange(FrameworkElements items, Rect bounds, Rect viewPortBounds)
			{
				PrepareItems(items);
				return base.OnArrange(items, bounds, viewPortBounds);
			}

			private void PrepareItems(FrameworkElements items)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((IEnumerable<FrameworkElement>)items).FirstOrDefault((FrameworkElement x) => ((NavButton)x).IsMain);
				if (frameworkElement == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				List<FrameworkElement> list = ((IEnumerable<FrameworkElement>)items).Where((FrameworkElement x) => x is SelectedNavButton || x is NavButtonSeparator).ToList();
				foreach (FrameworkElement item in list)
				{
					if (frameworkElement.HorizontalAlignment == HorizontalAlignment.Stretch)
					{
						item.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left;
					}
					else
					{
						item.HorizontalAlignment = frameworkElement.HorizontalAlignment;
					}
					((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Remove(item);
				}
				list.Reverse();
				int num = ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).IndexOf(frameworkElement);
				foreach (FrameworkElement item2 in list)
				{
					((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Insert(num + 1, item2);
				}
			}
		}

		static TileNavPaneHeadersPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TileNavPaneHeadersPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TileNavPaneHeadersPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<Thickness>(LayoutPanelBase.PaddingProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(StackLayoutPanel.AllowItemAlignmentProperty, defValue: true);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(StackLayoutPanel.AllowItemClippingProperty, defValue: false);
		}

		protected override LayoutPanelProviderBase CreateLayoutProvider()
		{
			return new TileNavPaneHeadersLayoutProvider(this);
		}
	}

	public class PreloadProvider : IPreloadSupport
	{
		IEnumerable<FrameworkElement> IPreloadSupport.GetConfiguredTree()

			yield return CreateStepProgressBar();
			yield return CreateTileBar();
			yield return CreateHamburgerMenu();
			yield return CreateTileNavPane();
		}

		private FrameworkElement CreateStepProgressBar()
		{
			StepProgressBar stepProgressBar = new StepProgressBar
			{
				CompletePreviousStepsOnSelection = false
			};
			stepProgressBar.BeginInit();
			stepProgressBar.Items.Add(new StepProgressBarItem
			{
				State = StepProgressBarItemState.NotStarted
			});
			stepProgressBar.Items.Add(new StepProgressBarItem
			{
				State = StepProgressBarItemState.Indeterminate
			});
			stepProgressBar.Items.Add(new StepProgressBarItem
			{
				State = StepProgressBarItemState.Completed
			});
			stepProgressBar.EndInit();
			return stepProgressBar;
		}

		private FrameworkElement CreateTileBar()
		{
			TileBar tileBar = new TileBar();
			SolidColorBrush foreground = new SolidColorBrush
			{
				Color = Colors.Red
			};
			SolidColorBrush background = new SolidColorBrush
			{
				Color = Colors.Green
			};
			tileBar.BeginInit();
			tileBar.Items.Add(new TileBarItem
			{
				Background = background,
				Foreground = foreground
			});
			tileBar.Items.Add(new TileBarItem
			{
				Background = background,
				Foreground = foreground,
				IsSelected = true
			});
			tileBar.EndInit();
			return tileBar;
		}

		private FrameworkElement CreateHamburgerMenu()
		{
			HamburgerMenu hamburgerMenu = new HamburgerMenu();
			hamburgerMenu.BeginInit();

			});
			HamburgerSubMenu hamburgerSubMenu = new HamburgerSubMenu
			{
				Content = "Content 1"
			};
			hamburgerSubMenu.Items.Add(new HamburgerSubMenuNavigationButton
			{
				Content = "c1",
				RightContent = "r1",
				ShowInPreview = true
			});
			hamburgerSubMenu.Items.Add(new HamburgerSubMenuNavigationButton
			{
				Content = "c2",

			});
			hamburgerSubMenu.Items.Add(new HamburgerSubMenuNavigationButton

			hamburgerMenu.BottomBarItems.Add(new HamburgerMenuBottomBarRadioButton
			{
				GroupName = "test"
			});

		private static void UpdateSymbology(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BarCodeControl)d).UpdateSymbology(e);
		}

		private static void InvalidateVisual(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BarCodeControl)d).BarCodeInvalidateVisual();
		}

		private static void InvalidateStyle(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BarCodeControl)d).BarCodeInvalidateStyle();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			gridRoot = (Grid)GetTemplateChild("Part_RootGrid");
			barCodePainter = new BarCodePainterWrapper();
			gridRoot.Children.Add((UIElement)(object)barCodePainter);
			if (Symbology != null)
			{
				gridRoot.Children.Add((UIElement)(object)Symbology);
			}
			((BarCodePainter)barCodePainter).Symbology = (BarCodeStyleSettings)(object)new BarCodeStyleSettingsWrapper(Symbology.GeneratorBase);
			barCodePainter.SetData((IBarCodeData)(object)new FullBarCodeDataWrapper((IBarCodeData)(object)this));
			BarCodeInvalidateStyle();
		}

		protected internal virtual void BarCodeInvalidateStyle()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			TextAlignment fullAlignment = AlignmentHelper.GetFullAlignment(VerticalTextAlignment, HorizontalTextAlignment);
			brickStyle.BackColor = WindowsFormsHelper.ConvertBrushToColor(base.Background);
			brickStyle.ForeColor = WindowsFormsHelper.ConvertBrushToColor(base.Foreground);
			brickStyle.StringFormat = BrickStringFormat.Create(fullAlignment, true);
			brickStyle.TextAlignment = fullAlignment;
			brickStyle.Padding = new PaddingInfo((int)base.Padding.Left, (int)base.Padding.Right, (int)base.Padding.Top, (int)base.Padding.Bottom, GraphicsDpi.Pixel);
			BarCodeInvalidateVisual();
		}

		protected internal virtual void BarCodeInvalidateVisual()
		{
			if (barCodePainter != null)
			{
				((BarCodePainter)barCodePainter).InvalidateBarCodePainter();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateSymbology(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SymbologyBase symbologyBase = (SymbologyBase)e.NewValue;
			if (gridRoot != null)
			{
				if (e.OldValue is UIElement)
				{
					gridRoot.Children.Remove(e.OldValue as UIElement);
				}
				gridRoot.Children.Add((UIElement)(object)symbologyBase);
			}
			if (barCodePainter != null)
			{
				((BarCodePainter)barCodePainter).Symbology = (BarCodeStyleSettings)(object)new BarCodeStyleSettingsWrapper(symbologyBase.GeneratorBase);
			}
			symbologyBase.BarCodeControl = this;
			BarCodeInvalidateVisual();
		}
	}
	public abstract class SymbologyBase : DXFrameworkElement
	{
		public abstract BarCodeGeneratorBase GeneratorBase { get; }

		internal BarCodeControl BarCodeControl { get; set; }

		public SymbologyBase()
		{
			((DXFrameworkElement)this).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		public static void BarCodeControlInvalidateVisual(DependencyObject d)
		{
			if (((SymbologyBase)(object)d).BarCodeControl != null)
			{
				((SymbologyBase)(object)d).BarCodeControl.BarCodeInvalidateVisual();
			}
		}
	}

		protected T Generator => barCodeGeneratorBase;

		public SymbologyBase()

		}

		{

		protected virtual void OnPageIndexChange(int oldValue, int newValue)
		{
			if (!isPageIndexChanging)
			{
				int num = RaisePageIndexChanging(oldValue, newValue);
				if (num != newValue)
				{
					isPageIndexChanging = true;
					SetValue(PageIndexProperty, num);
					isPageIndexChanging = false;
				}
				if (num != oldValue)
				{
					RaisePageIndexChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}
			}
			UpdateAllProperties();
		}

		protected virtual int RaisePageIndexChanging(int oldValue, int newValue)
		{
			if (this.PageIndexChanging == null)
			{
				return newValue;
			}
			PageIndexChangingEventArgs e = new PageIndexChangingEventArgs(oldValue, newValue);
			this.PageIndexChanging(this, e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				return e.NewPageIndex;
			}
			return e.OldPageIndex;
		}

		protected virtual void RaisePageIndexChanged(int oldValue, int newValue)
		{
			if (this.PageIndexChanged != null)
			{
				this.PageIndexChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)

			IKeyboardHandlerService val = (IKeyboardHandlerService)GetService(typeof(IKeyboardHandlerService));

		protected internal BookTemplateElement GetTemplateElement(string name)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)GetTemplateChild(name);
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				return new NullBookTemplateElement();
			}
			return new BookTemplateElement(frameworkElement);
		}

		protected internal BookTemplateElement GetTemplateElement(BookTemplateElementType element, BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			string childName = layout.ToString() + element;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)GetTemplateChild(childName);
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				return new NullBookTemplateElement();
			}
			switch (element)
			{
			case BookTemplateElementType.BaseForeShadow:
			case BookTemplateElementType.OverlayForeShadow:
			case BookTemplateElementType.BackShadow:
				return new BookShadowTemplateElement(frameworkElement);
			default:
				return new BookTemplateElement(frameworkElement);
			}
		}

	public abstract class BookCommand : Command
	{
		private readonly Book control;

		protected internal Book Control => control;

		protected internal abstract BookStringId MenuCaptionStringId { get; }

		protected internal abstract BookStringId DescriptionStringId { get; }

		public override string MenuCaption => BookLocalizer.GetString(MenuCaptionStringId);

		public override string Description => BookLocalizer.GetString(DescriptionStringId);

		protected BookCommand(Book control)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)control, "control");
			this.control = control;
		}

		protected override void UpdateUIStateCore(ICommandUIState state)
		{
		}
	}
	public class BookPreviousPageCommand : BookCommand
	{
		protected internal override BookStringId DescriptionStringId => BookStringId.MenuCmd_PreviousPage;

		protected internal override BookStringId MenuCaptionStringId => BookStringId.MenuCmd_PreviousPageDescription;

		public BookPreviousPageCommand(Book control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		public override void ForceExecute(ICommandUIState state)
		{
			base.Control.Animator.Start(BookAnimationType.TurnOnePageBackward);
		}

		protected override void UpdateUIStateCore(ICommandUIState state)
		{
			base.UpdateUIStateCore(state);
			state.Enabled = base.Control.PageManager.IsPrevPage && !base.Control.EventHandler.IsUninterruptedAnimation;
			state.Visible = true;
		}
	}
	public class BookNextPageCommand : BookCommand
	{
		protected internal override BookStringId DescriptionStringId => BookStringId.MenuCmd_NextPage;

		protected internal override BookStringId MenuCaptionStringId => BookStringId.MenuCmd_NextPageDescription;

		public BookNextPageCommand(Book control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		public override void ForceExecute(ICommandUIState state)
		{
			base.Control.Animator.Start(BookAnimationType.TurnOnePageForward);
		}

		protected override void UpdateUIStateCore(ICommandUIState state)
		{
			base.UpdateUIStateCore(state);
			state.Enabled = base.Control.PageManager.IsNextPage && !base.Control.EventHandler.IsUninterruptedAnimation;
			state.Visible = true;
		}
	}

			state.Enabled = base.Control.PageManager.IsPrevPage && !base.Control.EventHandler.IsUninterruptedAnimation && base.Control.EventHandler.ViewState == BookViewState.Current;
			state.Visible = true;
		}
	}

	public class NormalKeyboardHandler : CommandBasedKeyboardHandler<Type>
	{
		private Book Control { get; set; }

		public NormalKeyboardHandler(Book control)
		{
			Control = control;
		}

		public override Command CreateHandlerCommand(Type handlerType)
		{
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ConstructorInfo constructor = handlerType.GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(Book) });
			if (constructor != null)
			{
				return (Command)constructor.Invoke(new object[1] { Control });
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override IKeyHashProvider CreateKeyHashProviderFromContext()
		{
			return (IKeyHashProvider)(object)new BookKeyHashProvider();
		}

		protected override void ValidateHandlerId(Type handlerType)
		{
			if (!typeof(BookCommand).IsAssignableFrom(handlerType))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("handlerType");
			}
		}
	}

	public class BreadcrumbHistoryNode : BreadcrumbPathNode
	{
		internal BreadcrumbHistoryNode(object item, string path, ImageSource image, string text)
			: base(item, path, image, text)
		{
		}

		internal BreadcrumbHistoryNode UpdatePath(string oldSeparator, string newSeparator)
		{
			return new BreadcrumbHistoryNode(base.Item, base.Path.Replace(oldSeparator, newSeparator), base.Image, base.Text);
		}
	}
	public class BreadcrumbHistoryNodeCollection : IEnumerable<BreadcrumbHistoryNode>, IEnumerable, INotifyCollectionChanged
	{
		private ObservableCollection<BreadcrumbHistoryNode> History { get; }

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		public BreadcrumbHistoryNodeCollection()
		{
			History = new ObservableCollection<BreadcrumbHistoryNode>();
			History.CollectionChanged += OnHistoryChanged;
		}

		private void OnHistoryChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			this.CollectionChanged?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		internal void Add(BreadcrumbHistoryNode node)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < History.Count(); i++)
			{
				if (BreadcrumbDataController.CompareString(History[i].Path, node.Path))
				{
					History.Move(i, 0);
					return;
				}
			}
			History.Insert(0, node);
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			History.Clear();
		}

		internal void UpdatePaths(string oldSeparator, string newSeparator)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(oldSeparator))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < History.Count; i++)
				{
					BreadcrumbHistoryNode breadcrumbHistoryNode = History[i];
					BreadcrumbHistoryNode value = breadcrumbHistoryNode.UpdatePath(oldSeparator, newSeparator);
					History[i] = value;
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator<BreadcrumbHistoryNode> IEnumerable<BreadcrumbHistoryNode>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return History.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return History.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public class BreadcrumbNode : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private ImageSource image;

		private string text;

		private bool hasChildNodes;

		private BreadcrumbNodesCollection childNodes;

		protected BreadcrumbDataController Controller { get; }

		public BreadcrumbNode ParentNode { get; }

		public object Item { get; }

		public ImageSource Image
		{
			get
			{
				return image;
			}
			private set
			{
				SetPropertyHelper.Set(ref image, value, (Action)delegate
				{
					OnImageChanged();
				});
			}
		}

		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return text;
			}
			private set
			{
				SetPropertyHelper.Set(ref text, value, (Action)delegate
				{
					OnTextChanged();
				});
			}
		}

		public bool HasChildNodes
		{
			get
			{
				return hasChildNodes;
			}
			private set
			{
				SetPropertyHelper.Set(ref hasChildNodes, value, (Action)delegate
				{
					OnHasChildNodesChanged();
				});
			}
		}

		public BreadcrumbNodesCollection ChildNodes
		{
			get
			{
				return childNodes;
			}
			private set
			{
				SetPropertyHelper.Set(ref childNodes, value, (Action)delegate
				{
					OnChildNodesChanged();
				});
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		internal BreadcrumbNode(BreadcrumbNode parentNode, object item, BreadcrumbDataController controller)
		{
			ParentNode = parentNode;
			Controller = controller;
			Item = item;
			UpdateImage();
			UpdateText();
			UpdateChildNodes();
			UpdateHasChildNodes();
			AttachToItemPropertyChanging();
		}

		internal void UpdateProperty(BreadcrumbDataController.UpdateNodeProperty update)
		{
			switch (update)
			{
			case BreadcrumbDataController.UpdateNodeProperty.Text:
				UpdateText();
				break;
			case BreadcrumbDataController.UpdateNodeProperty.Image:
				UpdateImage();
				break;
			case BreadcrumbDataController.UpdateNodeProperty.HasChildren:
				UpdateHasChildNodes();
				break;
			case BreadcrumbDataController.UpdateNodeProperty.Children:
				UpdateChildNodes();
				UpdateHasChildNodes();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateImage()
		{
			Image = InitializeImage();
		}

		protected virtual ImageSource InitializeImage()
		{
			return Controller.DataAdapter.GetImage(Item);
		}

		private void UpdateText()
		{
			Text = InitializeText();
		}

		protected virtual string InitializeText()
		{
			return Controller.DataAdapter.GetDisplayText(Item);
		}

		private void UpdateChildNodes()
		{
			ChildNodes = InitializeChildNodes();
		}

		protected virtual BreadcrumbNodesCollection InitializeChildNodes()
		{
			return new BreadcrumbNodesCollection(this, () => Controller.DataProvider.GetChildren(Item), (object child) => Controller.CreateNode(this, child));
		}

		private void UpdateHasChildNodes()
		{
			HasChildNodes = InitializeHasChildNodes();
		}

		protected virtual bool InitializeHasChildNodes()
		{
			if (ChildNodes.IsChildNodesCreated)
			{
				return ChildNodes.Any();
			}
			bool? flag = Controller.DataAdapter.HasChildren(Item);
			if (!flag.HasValue)
			{
				return Any(Controller.DataProvider.GetChildren(Item));
			}
			return flag.Value;
		}

		private static bool Any(IEnumerable items)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = items.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				if (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					object current = enumerator.Current;
					return true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void AttachToItemPropertyChanging()
		{
			(Item as INotifyPropertyChanged).Do(delegate(INotifyPropertyChanged inpc)
			{
				inpc.PropertyChanged += OnItemPropertyChanged;
			});
		}

		private void OnItemPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Controller.NotifyItemPropertyChanged(this, e.PropertyName);
		}

		private void OnImageChanged()
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged("Image");
		}

		private void OnTextChanged()
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged("Text");
		}

		private void OnHasChildNodesChanged()
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged("HasChildNodes");
		}

		private void OnChildNodesChanged()
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged("ChildNodes");
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}
	}

	{

		public string Path { get; }

	public class BreadcrumbNodesCollection : IReadOnlyList<BreadcrumbNode>, IReadOnlyCollection<BreadcrumbNode>, IEnumerable<BreadcrumbNode>, IEnumerable, INotifyCollectionChanged
	{
		private static ListChangedType[] IgnoredChangedTypes = new ListChangedType[3]
		{
			ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorAdded,
			ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorDeleted,
			ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged
		};

		private Func<IEnumerable> ChildSelector { get; }

		private Func<object, BreadcrumbNode> NodesFactory { get; }

		private BreadcrumbNode Parent { get; }

		private IBindingList ChildrenList { get; set; }

		private List<BreadcrumbNode> ChildNodesCollection { get; set; }

		public bool IsChildNodesCreated { get; private set; }

		public int Count => GetFromChildNodes(() => ChildNodesCollection.Count);

		public BreadcrumbNode this[int index] => GetFromChildNodes(() => ChildNodesCollection[index]);

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		internal BreadcrumbNodesCollection(BreadcrumbNode parent, Func<IEnumerable> childSelector, Func<object, BreadcrumbNode> nodesFactory)
		{
			Parent = parent;
			ChildSelector = childSelector;
			NodesFactory = nodesFactory;
			ChildNodesCollection = new List<BreadcrumbNode>();
		}

		private void CreateChildNodes()
		{
			if (IsChildNodesCreated)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable enumerable = ChildSelector();
			foreach (object item in enumerable)
			{
				ChildNodesCollection.Add(NodesFactory(item));
			}
			ChildrenList = BreadcrumbDataController.ExtractListSource(enumerable);
			ChildrenList.ListChanged += OnChildrenListChanged;
			IsChildNodesCreated = true;
			UpdateParentCollectionProperty();
		}

		private void UpdateParentCollectionProperty()
		{
			Parent?.UpdateProperty(BreadcrumbDataController.UpdateNodeProperty.HasChildren);
		}

		public IEnumerator<BreadcrumbNode> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetFromChildNodes(ChildNodesCollection.GetEnumerator);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetFromChildNodes(ChildNodesCollection.GetEnumerator);
		}

		private T GetFromChildNodes<T>(Func<T> getFunc)
		{
			CreateChildNodes();
			return getFunc();
		}

		private void OnChildrenListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!IgnoredChangedTypes.Contains(e.ListChangedType))
			{
				switch (e.ListChangedType)
				{
				case ListChangedType.Reset:
					ChildNodesCollection.Clear();
					UpdateParentCollectionProperty();
					RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
					break;
				case ListChangedType.ItemAdded:
				{
					BreadcrumbNode breadcrumbNode3 = NodesFactory(ChildrenList[e.NewIndex]);
					ChildNodesCollection.Insert(e.NewIndex, breadcrumbNode3);
					UpdateParentCollectionProperty();
					RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, breadcrumbNode3, e.NewIndex));
					break;
				}
				case ListChangedType.ItemDeleted:
				{
					BreadcrumbNode changedItem = ChildNodesCollection[e.NewIndex];
					ChildNodesCollection.RemoveAt(e.NewIndex);
					UpdateParentCollectionProperty();
					RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, changedItem, e.NewIndex));
					break;
				}
				case ListChangedType.ItemMoved:
				{
					BreadcrumbNode breadcrumbNode2 = ChildNodesCollection[e.OldIndex];
					ChildNodesCollection.RemoveAt(e.OldIndex);
					ChildNodesCollection.Insert(e.NewIndex, breadcrumbNode2);
					RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move, breadcrumbNode2, e.NewIndex, e.OldIndex));
					break;
				}
				case ListChangedType.ItemChanged:
				{
					BreadcrumbNode breadcrumbNode = NodesFactory(ChildrenList[e.NewIndex]);
					BreadcrumbNode oldItem = ChildNodesCollection[e.NewIndex];
					ChildNodesCollection.RemoveAt(e.NewIndex);
					ChildNodesCollection.Insert(e.NewIndex, breadcrumbNode);
					RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace, breadcrumbNode, oldItem, e.NewIndex));
					break;
				}
				}
			}
		}

		private void RaiseCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			this.CollectionChanged?.Invoke(this, args);
		}
	}

		private string CoerceSelectedItemPathSeparator(string value)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return SelectedItemPathSeparator;
		}

		private object CoerceSelectedItem(object value)
		{
			if (SkipCoerceSelection)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (DataController.FindItem(value) == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private string CoerceSelectedItemPath(string value)
		{
			if (SkipCoerceSelection)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (DataController.FindPath(value) == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void OnDisplayMemberChanged()
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged("DisplayMember");
			if (IsSelectionPropertyStored(SelectedItemPathProperty))
			{
				CoerceValue(SelectedItemPathProperty);
			}
			SyncSelection();
		}

		private void OnImageMemberChanged()
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged("ImageMember");
			SyncSelection();
		}

		private void OnKeyMemberChanged()
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged("KeyMember");
			RestoreLocalSelection();
		}

		private void OnParentMemberChanged()
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged("ParentMember");
			RestoreLocalSelection();
		}

		private void OnChildMemberChanged()
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged("ChildMember");
			RestoreLocalSelection();
		}

		private void OnChildSelectorChanged()
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged("ChildMember");
			RestoreLocalSelection();
		}

		private void OnHasChildMemberChanged()
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged("HasChildMember");
			SyncSelection();
		}

		private void OnItemsSourceChanged()
		{
			DataController.Source = ItemsSource;
			RestoreLocalSelection();
		}

		private void RestoreLocalSelection()
		{
			DependencyProperty localSelectionProperty = GetLocalSelectionProperty();
			if (localSelectionProperty != null)
			{
				CoerceValue(localSelectionProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				SetSelectionLocker.DoOrPostpone(GetSyncronizationSelectionAction());
			}
		}

		private DependencyProperty GetLocalSelectionProperty()
		{
			return GetSelectionProperties().FirstOrDefault(IsSelectionPropertyStored);
		}

		private DependencyProperty[] GetSelectionProperties()
		{
			return new DependencyProperty[3] { SelectedItemsProperty, SelectedItemPathProperty, SelectedItemProperty };
		}

		private bool IsSelectionPropertyStored(DependencyProperty property)
		{
			object objA = ReadLocalValue(property);
			if (!object.Equals(objA, DependencyProperty.UnsetValue))
			{
				return !object.Equals(objA, GetValue(property));
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnSelectedItemChanged()
		{
			SetSelectionLocker.DoOrPostpone(GetSetSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				DataController.SelectItem(SelectedItem);
			}));
		}

		private void OnSelectedNodeChanged()
		{
			UpdateDataSelection(delegate
			{
				DataController.SelectNode(SelectedNode);
			});
		}

		private void OnSelectedItemsChanged()
		{
			DetachSelectedItemsChanged();
			SetSelectionLocker.DoOrPostpone(GetSetSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				DataController.SelectItems(SelectedItems?.Cast<object>());
			}));
			SelectedItemsList = BreadcrumbDataController.ExtractListSource(SelectedItems);
			AttachSelectedItemsChanged();
		}

		private void DetachSelectedItemsChanged()
		{
			if (SelectedItemsList != null)
			{
				SelectedItemsList.ListChanged -= OnSelectedItemsListChanged;
			}
		}

		private void AttachSelectedItemsChanged()
		{
			if (SelectedItemsList != null)
			{
				SelectedItemsList.ListChanged += OnSelectedItemsListChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnSelectedItemsListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SetSelectionLocker.DoOrPostpone(GetSetSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				DataController.SelectItems(SelectedItems?.Cast<object>());
			}));
		}

		private void OnSelectedItemPathChanged()
		{
			SetSelectionLocker.DoOrPostpone(GetSetSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				DataController.SelectPath(SelectedItemPath);
			}));
		}

		private void OnSelectedItemPathSeparatorChanged()
		{
			DataController.PathSeparator = SelectedItemPathSeparator;
			if (SelectedItem != null)
			{
				UpdateDataSelectionLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					SelectedItemPath = DataController.SelectedNodePath;
					UpdatePathEdit();
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnEditModeChanged()
		{
			if (EditMode != BreadcrumbEditMode.Both)
			{
				SetActualEditMode((BreadcrumbActualEditMode)EditMode);
			}
		}

		private void OnActualEditModeChanged()
		{
			RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(ActualEditModeChangedEvent, this));
			UpdateEditModeState();
		}

		private void OnEmptyItemTextChanged()
		{
			DataController.EmptySelectionText = EmptyItemText;
			SyncSelection();
		}

		private void OnShowSelectedItemImageChanged()
		{
			UpdateSelectedItemImageIsVisible();
		}

		private void OnAllowSwitchRootNodesChanged()
		{
			UpdatePredefinedItemsSource();
		}

		private void OnAllowFillHistoryChanged()
		{
			DataController.AllowFillHistory = AllowFillHistory;
		}

		public BreadcrumbControl()
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0074: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DataController = CreateDataController();
			DataController.HistoryChanging += OnDataControllerHistoryChanging;
			UpdatePathEditLocker = new Locker();
			UpdateDataSelectionLocker = new Locker();
			SetSelectionLocker = new BreadcrumbLocker();
			FillHistoryPopupAction = new PostponedAction((Func<bool>)(() => true));
			PathEditSourceCollection = new DXObservableCollection<BreadcrumbPathNode>();
			SetValue(PathEditSourcePropertyKey, new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<BreadcrumbPathNode>((ObservableCollection<BreadcrumbPathNode>)(object)PathEditSourceCollection));
			AddHandler(BreadcrumbItem.ItemClickEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnItemClick));
			UpdateDataSelectionLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				SyncSelectedNode();
				SyncSelectedNodes();
			});
			HistoryNodes = DataController.HistoryNodes;
		}

		protected virtual BreadcrumbDataController CreateDataController()
		{
			return new BreadcrumbDataController(this, SelectedItemPathSeparator, AllowFillHistory);
		}

		private void OnDataControllerHistoryChanging(object sender, BreadcrumbDataController.HistoryChangingEventArgs e)
		{
			BreadcrumbHistoryChangingEventArgs e2 = new BreadcrumbHistoryChangingEventArgs(this, e.Node, e.Reason);
			RaiseEvent((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e2);
			e.Cancel = ((CancelRoutedEventArgs)e2).Cancel;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			UnsubscribeEvents();
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartBreadcrumbItemsControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_BreadcrumbItemsControl") as BreadcrumbItemsControl;
			PartBreadcrumbPathEdit = GetTemplateChild("PART_BreadcrumbPathEdit") as BreadcrumbPathEdit;
			PartBreadcrumbSelectedItemImage = GetTemplateChild("PART_BreadcrumbSelectedItemImage") as BreadcrumbSelectedItemImage;
			UpdateSelectedItemImageIsVisible();
			UpdatePredefinedItemsSource();
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		private void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
			PartBreadcrumbPathEdit.Do(delegate(BreadcrumbPathEdit x)
			{
				//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_006c: Expected O, but got Unknown
				((AutoSuggestEdit)x).QuerySubmitted -= OnQuerySubmitted;
				((AutoSuggestEdit)x).TextChanged -= OnPathEditTextChanged;
				((UIElement)(object)x).IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged -= OnPathEditFocusChanged;
				((PopupBaseEdit)x).PopupOpened -= OnPathEditPopupOpened;
				x.EditCoreAssigned -= OnEditCoreAssigned;
				((PopupBaseEdit)x).PopupClosed -= new ClosePopupEventHandler(OnPopupClosed);
				((ButtonEdit)x).DefaultButtonClick -= OnDefaultButtonClick;
			});
			PartBreadcrumbSelectedItemImage.Do(delegate(BreadcrumbSelectedItemImage x)
			{
				x.Click -= OnSelectedItemImageClick;
			});
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			PartBreadcrumbPathEdit.Do(delegate(BreadcrumbPathEdit x)
			{
				//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_006c: Expected O, but got Unknown
				((AutoSuggestEdit)x).QuerySubmitted += OnQuerySubmitted;
				((AutoSuggestEdit)x).TextChanged += OnPathEditTextChanged;
				((UIElement)(object)x).IsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged += OnPathEditFocusChanged;
				((PopupBaseEdit)x).PopupOpened += OnPathEditPopupOpened;
				x.EditCoreAssigned += OnEditCoreAssigned;
				((PopupBaseEdit)x).PopupClosed += new ClosePopupEventHandler(OnPopupClosed);
				((ButtonEdit)x).DefaultButtonClick += OnDefaultButtonClick;
			});
			PartBreadcrumbSelectedItemImage.Do(delegate(BreadcrumbSelectedItemImage x)
			{
				x.Click += OnSelectedItemImageClick;
			});
		}

		private void OnPopupClosed(object sender, ClosePopupEventArgs e)
		{
			((Collection<BreadcrumbPathNode>)(object)PathEditSourceCollection).Clear();
		}

		private void OnEditCoreAssigned(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateEditModeState();
		}

		private void OnQuerySubmitted(object sender, AutoSuggestEditQuerySubmittedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsSubmittedOnTextInput())
			{
				UpdatePathEditSource(e.Text);
			}
		}

		private bool IsSubmittedOnTextInput()
		{
			return ((UIElement)(object)PartBreadcrumbPathEdit).IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
		}

		private void OnPathEditTextChanged(object sender, AutoSuggestEditTextChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdatePathEditLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				PathEditTextChangedHandler(e.Text);
			});
		}

		private void PathEditTextChangedHandler(string text)
		{
			if (BreadcrumbDataController.CompareString(text, SelectedItemPath))
			{
				UpdateFocus();
				return;
			}
			BreadcrumbNode breadcrumbNode = DataController.FindPath(text);
			if (breadcrumbNode == null)
			{
				UpdatePathEdit();
				return;
			}
			DataController.SelectNode(breadcrumbNode, BreadcrumbHistoryChangingReason.SelectPath);
			SyncSelection();
			UpdateFocus();
		}

		private void UpdateFocus()
		{
			if (((UIElement)(object)PartBreadcrumbPathEdit).IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				Focus();
			}
		}

		private void OnPathEditFocusChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SetActualEditMode(((bool)e.NewValue) ? BreadcrumbActualEditMode.Path : BreadcrumbActualEditMode.Items);
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
			if (e.Key == Key.F4)
			{
				FillHistoryPopupAction.PerformPostpone((Action)FillHistoryPopup);
			}
		}

		private void OnDefaultButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			FillHistoryPopupAction.PerformPostpone((Action)FillHistoryPopup);
		}

		private void OnPathEditPopupOpened(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			SetActualEditMode(BreadcrumbActualEditMode.Path);
			FillHistoryPopupAction.PerformForce();
		}

		private void FillHistoryPopup()
		{
			HistoryNodes.ForEach(delegate(BreadcrumbHistoryNode x)
			{
				((Collection<BreadcrumbPathNode>)(object)PathEditSourceCollection).Add((BreadcrumbPathNode)x);
			});
		}

		private void SetActualEditMode(BreadcrumbActualEditMode mode)
		{
			if (ActualEditMode != mode && (mode == (BreadcrumbActualEditMode)EditMode || EditMode == BreadcrumbEditMode.Both))
			{
				ActualEditMode = mode;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateEditModeState()
		{
			if (IsEditCoreAssigned)
			{
				((BaseEdit)PartBreadcrumbPathEdit).EditCore.Visibility = MatchEditMode(Visibility.Hidden, Visibility.Visible);
				PartBreadcrumbItemsControl.Visibility = MatchEditMode(Visibility.Visible, Visibility.Hidden);
				if (ActualEditMode == BreadcrumbActualEditMode.Path)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)PartBreadcrumbPathEdit).Focus();
					((BaseEdit)PartBreadcrumbPathEdit).SelectAll();
				}
				else if (!IsEditTextSynchronized())
				{
					UpdatePathEdit();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsEditTextSynchronized()
		{
			return BreadcrumbDataController.CompareString(SelectedItemPath, ((TextEditBase)PartBreadcrumbPathEdit).EditText);
		}

		private T MatchEditMode<T>(T crumbsValue, T pathValue)
		{
			return ActualEditMode switch
			{
				BreadcrumbActualEditMode.Items => crumbsValue, 
				BreadcrumbActualEditMode.Path => pathValue, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException("ActualEditMode property value " + ActualEditMode), 
			};
		}

		private void OnSelectedItemImageClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnSelectedItemImageClick();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedItemImageClick()
		{
			SetActualEditMode(BreadcrumbActualEditMode.Path);
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			Navigate(((IBreadcrumbItem)e.OriginalSource).BreadcrumbNode);
		}

		protected virtual void Navigate(BreadcrumbNode node)
		{
			SelectedNode = node;
		}

		public void ClearHistory()
		{
			DataController.ClearHistory();
		}

		public void RefreshData()
		{
			DataController.RefreshData();
			SetSelectionLocker.DoOrPostpone(GetSyncronizationSelectionAction());
		}

		public void BeginDataInit()
		{
			BeginInit();
		}

		public void EndDataInit()
		{
			EndInit();
		}

		public override void BeginInit()
		{
			base.BeginInit();
			DataController.BeginDataInit();
			UpdateDataSelectionLocker.Lock();
			SetSelectionLocker.Lock();
		}

		public override void EndInit()
		{
			base.EndInit();
			DataController.EndDataInit();
			UpdateDataSelectionLocker.Unlock();
			SetSelectionLocker.Unlock();
		}

		private BreadcrumbLockerAction GetSetSelectionAction(Action updateDataControllerAction)
		{
			return new BreadcrumbLockerAction(delegate
			{
				UpdateDataSelection(updateDataControllerAction);
			}, 1);
		}

		private BreadcrumbLockerAction GetSyncronizationSelectionAction()
		{
			return new BreadcrumbLockerAction(delegate
			{
				SyncSelection();
			}, 0);
		}

		private void UpdateDataSelection(Action updateDataControllerAction)
		{
			UpdateDataSelectionLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				updateDataControllerAction();
				SyncSelection();
			});
		}

		private void SyncSelection()
		{
			UpdateDataSelectionLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				SyncSelectedNode();
				SyncSelectedItem();
				SyncSelectedNodes();
				SyncSelectedItems();
				SyncSelectedItemPath();
				UpdatePathEdit();
				UpdateSelectedItemImageIsVisible();
				UpdatePredefinedItemsSource();
			});
		}

		private void SyncSelectedNode()
		{
			SetValue(SelectedNodePropertyKey, DataController.SelectedNode);
		}

		private void SyncSelectedItem()
		{
			if (SelectedItem != DataController.SelectedNode.Item)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemProperty, DataController.SelectedNode.Item);
			}
		}

		private void SyncSelectedNodes()
		{
			SetValue(SelectedNodesPropertyKey, BreadcrumbDataController.GetNodesPath(DataController.SelectedNode).ToReadOnlyObservableCollection());
		}

		private void SyncSelectedItems()
		{
			if (SelectedItems == null)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemsProperty, new ObservableCollection<object>());
			}
			SelectedItems.Clear();
			if (DataController.IsEmptySelection)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (BreadcrumbNode item in BreadcrumbDataController.GetNodesPath(DataController.SelectedNode))
			{
				SelectedItems.Add(item.Item);
			}
		}

		private void SyncSelectedItemPath()
		{
			string text = (DataController.IsEmptySelection ? null : DataController.SelectedNodePath);
			if (!BreadcrumbDataController.CompareString(SelectedItemPath, text))
			{
				SetCurrentValue(SelectedItemPathProperty, text);
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePathEdit()
		{
			if (PartBreadcrumbPathEdit != null)
			{
				UpdatePathEditLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					((TextEditBase)PartBreadcrumbPathEdit).Text = SelectedItemPath;
					((BaseEdit)PartBreadcrumbPathEdit).ClearError();
					UpdatePathEditSource(SelectedItemPath);
				});
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePathEditSource(string path)
		{
			((Collection<BreadcrumbPathNode>)(object)PathEditSourceCollection).Clear();
			FillHistoryPopupAction.PerformPostpone((Action)null);
			UpdatePathEditLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				UpdatePathEditSourceCore(path);
			});
		}

		private void UpdatePathEditSourceCore(string path)
		{
			DataController.Navigate(path).ForEach(delegate(BreadcrumbPathNode node)
			{
				((Collection<BreadcrumbPathNode>)(object)PathEditSourceCollection).Add(node);
			});
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedItemImageIsVisible()
		{
			if (PartBreadcrumbSelectedItemImage != null)
			{
				bool flag = ShowSelectedItemImage ?? (SelectedNode.Image != null);
				PartBreadcrumbSelectedItemImage.Visibility = ((!flag) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdatePredefinedItemsSource()
		{
			if (PartBreadcrumbItemsControl != null)
			{
				PartBreadcrumbItemsControl.ShowPredefinedItemsSource = AllowSwitchRootNodes && !DataController.IsEmptySelection;
				PartBreadcrumbItemsControl.PredefinedItemsSource = DataController.RootNode.ChildNodes;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseRightButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewMouseRightButtonUp(e);
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseRightButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewMouseRightButtonDown(e);
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		string IBreadcrumbDataAdapter.GetCustomDisplayText(object item)
		{
			BreadcrumbCustomDisplayTextEventArgs e = new BreadcrumbCustomDisplayTextEventArgs(this, item);
			RaiseEvent(e);
			return e.DisplayText;
		}

		ImageSource IBreadcrumbDataAdapter.GetCustomImage(object item)
		{
			BreadcrumbCustomImageEventArgs e = new BreadcrumbCustomImageEventArgs(this, item);
			RaiseEvent(e);
			return e.Image;
		}

		IEnumerable IBreadcrumbDataAdapter.QueryPath(IEnumerable<string> path)
		{
			BreadcrumbQueryPathEventArgs e = new BreadcrumbQueryPathEventArgs(this, path, SelectedItemPathSeparator);
			RaiseEvent(e);
			return e.Breadcrumbs;
		}
	}
	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class HorizontalControlPanel : Control
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChaptersVisibilityProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChaptersDisplayTypeProperty;

		private StackPanel panel;

		private MediaSliderControl slider;

		private bool _controlsIsBottom;

		public ChaptersDisplayType ChaptersDisplayType
		{
			get
			{
				return (ChaptersDisplayType)GetValue(ChaptersDisplayTypeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ChaptersDisplayTypeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Visibility ChaptersVisibility
		{
			get
			{
				return (Visibility)GetValue(ChaptersVisibilityProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ChaptersVisibilityProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool SliderIsBottom
		{
			get
			{
				return _controlsIsBottom;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_controlsIsBottom != value)
				{
					_controlsIsBottom = value;
					ChangeControlsPosition();
				}
			}
		}

		static HorizontalControlPanel()
		{
			ChaptersVisibilityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ChaptersVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(HorizontalControlPanel), new PropertyMetadata(Visibility.Visible));
			ChaptersDisplayTypeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ChaptersDisplayType", typeof(ChaptersDisplayType), typeof(HorizontalControlPanel), new PropertyMetadata(ChaptersDisplayType.Text));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.UseIndependentThemeStyleKey<HorizontalControlPanel>();
		}

		public HorizontalControlPanel()
		{
			base.HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center;
			base.VerticalContentAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			panel = (StackPanel)FindControlHelper.FindChildControlByType(this, typeof(StackPanel));
			slider = (MediaSliderControl)FindControlHelper.FindChildControlByType(this, typeof(MediaSliderControl));
			ChangeControlsPosition();
		}

		private void ChangeControlsPosition()
		{
			if (panel != null && slider != null)
			{
				if (SliderIsBottom)
				{
					Grid.SetRow(panel, 0);
					Grid.SetRow(slider, 1);
				}
				else
				{
					Grid.SetRow(panel, 1);
					Grid.SetRow(slider, 0);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class MediaButton : Button
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		public static readonly DependencyProperty MediaManagerProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MediaManager", typeof(MediaManager), typeof(MediaButton), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public MediaManager MediaManager
		{
			get
			{
				return (MediaManager)GetValue(MediaManagerProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(MediaManagerProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected MediaElement MediaElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (MediaManager != null)
				{
					return MediaManager.MediaElement;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		{
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
		}

		{
			if (MediaManager == null)
			{
				InitializeMediaManager();
			}
			if (MediaElement != null)
			{
				MediaManager.SelectedIndexChanged += OnMediaManagerSelectedIndexChanged;
				MediaManager.MediaList.CollectionChanged += OnMediaListCollectionChanged;
			}
			base.IsEnabled = SetEnabled();
		}

			base.IsEnabled = SetEnabled();

			{
				return false;
			}
			return MediaManager.MediaList.Count != 0;
		}

		private void InitializeMediaManager()
		{
			MediaManager = FindControlHelper.GetMediaManager(VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this));
		}
	}

	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class PositionInfoButton : MediaButton
	{
		public PositionInfoButton()
		{
			base.Click += OnClick;
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLoaded(sender, e);
			InitializeBindings();
		}

		protected virtual void OnClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.MediaManager != null)
			{
				switch (base.MediaManager.PositionInfoType)
				{
				case PositionInfoType.PositionDuration:
					base.MediaManager.PositionInfoType = PositionInfoType.Position;
					break;
				case PositionInfoType.Position:
					base.MediaManager.PositionInfoType = PositionInfoType.DurationLeft;
					break;
				case PositionInfoType.DurationLeft:
					base.MediaManager.PositionInfoType = PositionInfoType.PositionDuration;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeBindings()
		{
			if (base.MediaManager != null)
			{
				Binding binding = new Binding();
				binding.Source = base.MediaManager;
				binding.Path = new PropertyPath("PositionInfoText");
				SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentProperty, binding);
			}
		}
	}

	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class PlayPauseControl : MediaToggleButton
	{
		static PlayPauseControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.UseIndependentThemeStyleKey<PlayPauseControl>();
		}

		public PlayPauseControl()
		{
			base.Click += OnClick;
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.IsThreeState = false;
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLoaded(sender, e);
			if (base.MediaManager != null)
			{
				base.MediaManager.CurrentStateChanged += OnMediaManagerCurrentStateChanged;
			}
			InitializeIsChecked();
		}

		protected virtual void OnClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.MediaElement != null)
			{
				if (base.IsChecked.Value)
				{
					base.MediaManager.Play();
				}
				else
				{
					base.MediaManager.Pause();
				}
				InitializeIsChecked();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaManagerCurrentStateChanged(object sender, CurrentStateChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			InitializeIsChecked();
		}

		private void InitializeIsChecked()
		{
			if (base.MediaManager != null && base.MediaManager.CurrentState == MediaManagerState.Playing)
			{
				base.IsChecked = true;
			}
			else
			{
				base.IsChecked = false;
			}
		}
	}

		{
			base.OnLoaded(sender, e);
			if (base.MediaElement != null)
			{
				Binding binding = new Binding();
				binding.Source = base.MediaElement;
				binding.Path = new PropertyPath("IsMuted");

	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class FullscreenControl : MediaToggleButton
	{
		static FullscreenControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.UseIndependentThemeStyleKey<FullscreenControl>();
		}

		public FullscreenControl()
		{
			base.Click += OnClick;
			base.IsThreeState = false;
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLoaded(sender, e);
			if (base.MediaManager != null)
			{
				base.MediaManager.IsFullscreenChanged += OnMediaManagerIsFullscreenChanged;
				if (base.MediaElement != null)
				{
					base.MediaElement.MediaOpened += OnMediaElementMediaOpened;
					base.MediaElement.MediaFailed += OnMediaElementMediaFailed;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.MediaManager.IsFullscreen = base.IsChecked.Value;
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaElementMediaFailed(object sender, ExceptionRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			SetVisibility();
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaElementMediaOpened(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			SetVisibility();
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaManagerIsFullscreenChanged(object sender, IsFullscreenChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.IsChecked = e.IsFullscreen;
		}

		private void SetVisibility()
		{
			if (!base.MediaElement.HasVideo)
			{
				base.MediaManager.IsFullscreen = false;
				base.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			else
			{
				base.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
		}
	}
