		static MediaManager()
		{
			BottomPanelProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BottomPanel", typeof(UIElement), typeof(MediaManager), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			InformationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Information", typeof(string), typeof(MediaManager), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty));
			IsFullscreenProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsFullscreen", typeof(bool), typeof(MediaManager), new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((MediaManager)d).OnIsFullscreenChanged(d, (bool)e.NewValue);
			}));
			LeftPanelProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LeftPanel", typeof(object), typeof(MediaManager), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			MediaElementProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MediaElement", typeof(MediaElement), typeof(MediaManager), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			MediaListProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MediaList", typeof(ObservableCollection<MediaItem>), typeof(MediaManager), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((MediaManager)d).OnMediaListChanged(d, e);
			}));
			RightPanelProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RightPanel", typeof(object), typeof(MediaManager), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			SelectedIndexProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SelectedIndex", typeof(int), typeof(MediaManager), new PropertyMetadata(-1, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((MediaManager)d).OnSelectedIndexChanged(d, e);
			}));
			SelectedItemProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SelectedItem", typeof(MediaItem), typeof(MediaManager), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((MediaManager)d).OnSelectedItemChanged(d, e);
			}));
			TopPanelProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TopPanel", typeof(object), typeof(MediaManager), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			IsRandomProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsRandom", typeof(bool), typeof(MediaManager), new PropertyMetadata(false));
			PositionInfoTypeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PositionInfoType", typeof(PositionInfoType), typeof(MediaManager), new PropertyMetadata(PositionInfoType.PositionDuration));
			PositionInfoTextProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PositionInfoText", typeof(string), typeof(MediaManager), new PropertyMetadata("00:00:00"));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.UseIndependentThemeStyleKey<MediaManager>();
		}

		public MediaManager()
		{
			Initialize();
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			MediaElementContentPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_MediaElementContentPresenter") as ContentPresenter;
			SetPositionForMediaElement();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsFullscreenChanged(DependencyObject d, bool e)
		{
			if (Application.Current != null)
			{
				if (IsFullscreen)
				{
					SaveWindowSettings();
					MediaElement.Focus();
					Application.Current.MainWindow.WindowStyle = WindowStyle.None;
					Application.Current.MainWindow.WindowState = WindowState.Normal;
					Application.Current.MainWindow.WindowState = WindowState.Maximized;
				}
				else
				{
					Application.Current.MainWindow.WindowStyle = _winStyle;
					Application.Current.MainWindow.WindowState = _winState;
				}
				if (this.IsFullscreenChanged != null)
				{
					this.IsFullscreenChanged(this, new IsFullscreenChangedEventArgs(e));
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaEnded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (SelectedIndex < MediaList.Count - 1)
			{
				Next();
			}
			else
			{
				Stop();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaFailed(object sender, ExceptionRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			Information = "Failed: " + e.ErrorException.Message;
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaListChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SelectedIndex = -1;
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaListCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				needIndex = -1;
				needItem = null;
				SelectedIndex = -1;
			}
			else if (needIndex < MediaList.Count && needIndex > -1)
			{
				SelectedIndex = needIndex;
			}
			else if (MediaList.Contains(needItem))
			{
				SelectedItem = needItem;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaOpened(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			InitializeMediaMarkers();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedIndexChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			int num = (int)e.NewValue;
			if (MediaList.Count <= num || num < -1)
			{
				SelectedIndex = (int)e.OldValue;
				needIndex = (int)e.NewValue;
				SelectedItem = null;
				return;
			}
			SelectedItem = (IsIndexInRange(num) ? MediaList.ElementAt((int)e.NewValue) : null);
			if (this.SelectedIndexChanged != null)
			{
				this.SelectedIndexChanged(this, new SelectedIndexChangedEventArgs((int)e.OldValue, (int)e.NewValue));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedItemChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			MediaItem item = (MediaItem)e.NewValue;
			if (MediaList.Contains(item))
			{
				SelectedIndex = MediaList.IndexOf((MediaItem)e.NewValue);
				UpdateSource();
				if (this.SelectedItemChanged != null)
				{
					this.SelectedItemChanged(this, new SelectedItemChangedEventArgs((MediaItem)e.OldValue));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				needItem = (MediaItem)e.NewValue;
				SelectedItem = (MediaList.Contains((MediaItem)e.OldValue) ? ((MediaItem)e.OldValue) : null);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnCurrentStateChanged()
		{
			if (CurrentState == MediaManagerState.Playing || CurrentState == MediaManagerState.Paused)
			{
				timer.Start();
			}
			else
			{
				timer.Stop();
			}
			if (this.CurrentStateChanged != null)
			{
				this.CurrentStateChanged(this, new CurrentStateChangedEventArgs(_currentState));
			}
		}

		public virtual void Pause()
		{
			if (MediaElement != null && MediaElement.Source != null)
			{
				MediaElement.Pause();
				CurrentState = MediaManagerState.Paused;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Play()
		{
			if (MediaElement != null && MediaElement.Source != null)
			{
				MediaElement.Play();
				CurrentState = MediaManagerState.Playing;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Stop()
		{
			if (MediaElement != null && MediaElement.Source != null)
			{
				MediaElement.Stop();
				CurrentState = MediaManagerState.Stopped;
			}
			MediaElement.Position = TimeSpan.Zero;
		}

		public virtual void Next()
		{
			if (IsRandom)
			{
				SelectedIndex = GetRandomIndex();
			}
			else
			{
				SelectedIndex++;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Previous()
		{
			if (IsRandom)
			{
				SelectedIndex = GetRandomIndex();
			}
			else
			{
				SelectedIndex--;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Close()
		{
			if (MediaElement != null && MediaElement.Source != null)
			{
				MediaElement.Close();
				CurrentState = MediaManagerState.Closed;
			}
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			MediaList = new ObservableCollection<MediaItem>();
			base.Background = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Black);
			needIndex = -1;
			needItem = null;
			ShowControlsOnVideo = true;
			timer = new DispatcherTimer();
			timer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(0.5);
			timer.Tick += OnTimerTick;
			InitializeMediaElement();
		}

		private void OnTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdatePositionInfoText();
		}

		private void UpdatePositionInfoText()
		{
			string positionInfoText = string.Empty;
			string text = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(0.0).ToString();
			string text2 = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(0.0).ToString();
			string text3 = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(0.0).ToString();
			string format = "{0:HH:mm:ss}";
			text = MediaElement.Position.ToString();
			if (text.Contains('.'))
			{
				text = text.Remove(text.LastIndexOf('.'));
			}
			if (MediaElement.NaturalDuration.HasTimeSpan)
			{
				text2 = string.Format(format, new DateTime(MediaElement.NaturalDuration.TimeSpan.Ticks));
				TimeSpan timeSpan = MediaElement.NaturalDuration.TimeSpan - MediaElement.Position;
				text3 = $"{timeSpan.Hours:00}:{timeSpan.Minutes:00}:{timeSpan.Seconds:00}";
			}
			switch (PositionInfoType)
			{
			case PositionInfoType.PositionDuration:
				positionInfoText = text + " / " + text2;
				break;
			case PositionInfoType.Position:
				positionInfoText = text;
				break;
			case PositionInfoType.DurationLeft:
				positionInfoText = "-" + text3;
				break;
			}
			PositionInfoText = positionInfoText;
		}

		private void InitializeMediaElement()
		{
			MediaElement = new MediaElement();
			MediaElement.LoadedBehavior = MediaState.Manual;
			MediaElement.UnloadedBehavior = MediaState.Close;
		}

		private void InitializeMediaMarkers()
		{
		}

		private bool IsIndexInRange(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0)
			{
				return index < MediaList.Count;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetPositionForMediaElement()
		{
			if (MediaElementContentPresenter != null)
			{
				if (ShowControlsOnVideo)
				{
					Grid.SetRow(MediaElementContentPresenter, 0);
					Grid.SetColumn(MediaElementContentPresenter, 0);
					Grid.SetRowSpan(MediaElementContentPresenter, 3);
					Grid.SetColumnSpan(MediaElementContentPresenter, 3);
				}
				else
				{
					Grid.SetRow(MediaElementContentPresenter, 1);
					Grid.SetColumn(MediaElementContentPresenter, 1);
					Grid.SetRowSpan(MediaElementContentPresenter, 1);
					Grid.SetColumnSpan(MediaElementContentPresenter, 1);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			MediaList.CollectionChanged += OnMediaListCollectionChanged;
			MediaElement.MediaOpened += OnMediaOpened;
			MediaElement.MediaFailed += OnMediaFailed;
			MediaElement.MediaEnded += OnMediaEnded;
		}

		private void UpdateSource()
		{
			Information = string.Empty;
			if (MediaElement != null)
			{
				Stop();
				Close();
				if (SelectedItem != null)
				{
					MediaElement.Source = SelectedItem.Source;
					Play();
				}
				else
				{
					MediaElement.Source = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private int GetRandomIndex()
		{
			if (MediaList.Count <= 1)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			NonCryptographicRandom val = NonCryptographicRandom.Default;
			int num = val.Next(MediaList.Count);
			if (num == SelectedIndex)
			{
				num = GetRandomIndex();
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void SaveWindowSettings()
		{
			_winState = ((Application.Current != null) ? Application.Current.MainWindow.WindowState : WindowState.Normal);
			_winStyle = ((Application.Current == null) ? WindowStyle.SingleBorderWindow : Application.Current.MainWindow.WindowStyle);
		}
	}
	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class MediaItem : DependencyObject
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChaptersProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Chapters", typeof(List<MediaChapter>), typeof(MediaItem), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DescriptionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Description", typeof(string), typeof(MediaItem), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Source", typeof(Uri), typeof(MediaItem), null);

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ThumbnailProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Thumbnail", typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Image), typeof(MediaItem), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public List<MediaChapter> Chapters
		{
			get
			{
				return (List<MediaChapter>)GetValue(ChaptersProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ChaptersProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string Description
		{
			get
			{

	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class ChapterPanel : Panel
	{
		internal MediaSliderControl Container => (MediaSliderControl)FindControlHelper.FindParentControlByType(this, typeof(MediaSliderControl));

		internal double Duration
		{
			get
			{
				if (Container == null || !Container.MediaElement.NaturalDuration.HasTimeSpan)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return Container.MediaElement.NaturalDuration.TimeSpan.TotalMilliseconds;
			}
		}

		internal double TrackWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (Container == null || Container.Slider == null)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return Container.Slider.TrackWidth;
			}
		}

		public ChapterPanel()
		{
			base.SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
			InvalidateArrange();
			UpdateLayout();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(CalculateElementSize(child).Width, availableSize.Height));
				num2 += child.DesiredSize.Width;
				num = Math.Max(child.DesiredSize.Height, num);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Size(num2, num);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			double num = finalSize.Width - (base.ActualWidth - TrackWidth) / 2.0;
			for (int num2 = base.Children.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = base.Children[num2];
				System.Windows.Size size = CalculateElementSize(uIElement);
				num -= size.Width;
				Rect finalRect = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(num, 0.0), size);
				uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		private System.Windows.Size CalculateElementSize(UIElement element)
		{
			PositionSliderItem positionSliderItem = element as PositionSliderItem;
			System.Windows.Size result = default(System.Windows.Size);
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = base.Children.IndexOf(positionSliderItem);
			if (positionSliderItem != null && Duration != 0.0)
			{
				if (positionSliderItem.Chapter.Position.TotalMilliseconds >= Duration)
				{
					return default(System.Windows.Size);
				}
				if (num2 < base.Children.Count - 1)
				{
					PositionSliderItem positionSliderItem2 = base.Children[num2 + 1] as PositionSliderItem;
					num = ((!(positionSliderItem2.Chapter.Position.TotalMilliseconds <= Duration)) ? (Duration - positionSliderItem.Chapter.Position.TotalMilliseconds) : (positionSliderItem2.Chapter.Position.TotalMilliseconds - positionSliderItem.Chapter.Position.TotalMilliseconds));
				}
				else
				{
					num = Duration - positionSliderItem.Chapter.Position.TotalMilliseconds;
				}
				num = ((num > 0.0) ? num : 0.0);
				result.Width = TrackWidth * num / Duration;
				result.Height = element.DesiredSize.Height;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

	[Browsable(false)]

	public class MediaSliderControl : ItemsControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChaptersVisibilityProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChaptersDisplayTypeProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty MediaManagerProperty;

		private Border chaptersBorder;

		public ChaptersDisplayType ChaptersDisplayType
		{
			get

				return (ChaptersDisplayType)GetValue(ChaptersDisplayTypeProperty);
			}
			set

				SetValue(ChaptersDisplayTypeProperty, value);
			}

		public Visibility ChaptersVisibility
		{
			get
			{
				return (Visibility)GetValue(ChaptersVisibilityProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ChaptersVisibilityProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal MediaElement MediaElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (MediaManager != null)
				{
					return MediaManager.MediaElement;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal MediaManager MediaManager
		{
			get
			{
				return (MediaManager)GetValue(MediaManagerProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MediaManagerProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal PositionSlider Slider { get; set; }

		static MediaSliderControl()
		{
			ChaptersVisibilityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ChaptersVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(MediaSliderControl), new PropertyMetadata(Visibility.Visible));
			ChaptersDisplayTypeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ChaptersDisplayType", typeof(ChaptersDisplayType), typeof(MediaSliderControl), new PropertyMetadata(ChaptersDisplayType.Text, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((MediaSliderControl)d).OnChapterDiplayTypeChanged();
			}));
			MediaManagerProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MediaManager", typeof(MediaManager), typeof(MediaSliderControl), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.UseIndependentThemeStyleKey<MediaSliderControl>();
		}

		public MediaSliderControl()
		{
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.DisplayMemberPath = "Text";
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			InitializeControls();
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new PositionSliderItem();
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			PositionSliderItem positionSliderItem = element as PositionSliderItem;
			positionSliderItem.Owner = this;
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is PositionSliderItem;
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			MediaManager = FindControlHelper.GetMediaManager(VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this));
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaElementMediaOpened(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			InitializeSource();
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaManagerSelectedItemChanged(object sender, SelectedItemChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			chaptersBorder.Opacity = 0.0;
			base.ItemsSource = null;
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaManagerCurrentStateChanged(object sender, CurrentStateChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.State == MediaManagerState.Playing)
			{
				base.IsHitTestVisible = true;
			}
			else if (e.State == MediaManagerState.Stopped || e.State == MediaManagerState.Closed)
			{
				base.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnChapterDiplayTypeChanged()
		{
			ChangeDisplayType();
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			if (MediaManager != null)
			{
				MediaManager.CurrentStateChanged += OnMediaManagerCurrentStateChanged;
				MediaManager.SelectedItemChanged += OnMediaManagerSelectedItemChanged;
				MediaElement.MediaOpened += OnMediaElementMediaOpened;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeControls()
		{
			Slider = GetTemplateChild("PART_PositionSlider") as PositionSlider;
			chaptersBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_ChaptersBorder") as Border;
		}

		private void InitializeSource()
		{
			List<MediaChapter> chapters = MediaManager.SelectedItem.Chapters;
			chapters.Sort();
			base.ItemsSource = chapters;
			UpdateChaptersVisibility();
		}

		private void UpdateChaptersVisibility()
		{
			if (chaptersBorder != null)
			{
				if (MediaManager.SelectedItem == null || MediaManager.SelectedItem.Chapters.Count == 0)
				{
					chaptersBorder.Opacity = 0.0;
				}
				else
				{
					chaptersBorder.Opacity = 1.0;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ChangeDisplayType()
		{
			switch (ChaptersDisplayType)
			{
			case ChaptersDisplayType.Text:
				base.DisplayMemberPath = "Text";
				break;
			case ChaptersDisplayType.Position:
				base.DisplayMemberPath = "Position";
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Track", Type = typeof(Border))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_downloadProgress", Type = typeof(Border))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_ProgressTrack", Type = typeof(Border))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_progress", Type = typeof(Border))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Thumb", Type = typeof(Thumb))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "RART_PopupPositionTip", Type = typeof(PopupBase))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_PopupText", Type = typeof(TextBlock))]
	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class PositionSlider : RangeBase
	{
		private bool isMouseDown;

		private Thumb thumb;

		private Border progressBorder;

		private Border downloadBorder;

		private Border trackBorder;

		private Border progressTrackBorder;

		private DispatcherTimer timer;

		private MediaManager mm;

		private MediaManagerState oldState;

		private PopupBase positionPopup;

		private TextBlock popupTextBlock;

		internal double CalculatedWidth => base.ActualWidth - ThumbWidth;

		internal MediaManager MediaManager
		{
			get
			{
				return mm;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null && mm != value)
				{
					mm = value;
					OnMediaManagerChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal MediaElement MediaElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (MediaManager == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return MediaManager.MediaElement;
			}
		}

		internal double TrackWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (trackBorder == null)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return trackBorder.ActualWidth;
			}
		}

		internal double ThumbWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (thumb == null)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return thumb.ActualWidth;
			}
		}

		static PositionSlider()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.UseIndependentThemeStyleKey<PositionSlider>();
		}

		public PositionSlider()
		{
			timer = new DispatcherTimer
			{
				Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(10.0)
			};
			SubscribeEvents();
			DisableSlider();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			thumb = GetTemplateChild("PART_Thumb") as Thumb;
			progressBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_progress") as Border;
			downloadBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_downloadProgress") as Border;
			trackBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_Track") as Border;
			progressTrackBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_ProgressTrack") as Border;
			ref PopupBase reference = ref positionPopup;
			DependencyObject templateChild = GetTemplateChild("RART_PopupPositionTip");
			reference = (PopupBase)(object)((templateChild is PopupBase) ? templateChild : null);
			popupTextBlock = GetTemplateChild("PART_PopupText") as TextBlock;
			if (positionPopup != null)
			{
				((Popup)(object)positionPopup).PlacementTarget = this;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnValueChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			base.OnValueChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			UpdateProgress();
			UpdatePopup();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			DoOnMouseEnter(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
			if (isMouseDown)
			{
				base.Value = GetValueByMousePosition(e.GetPosition(this));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			DoOnMouseLeave(e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (MediaManager == null)
			{
				MediaManager = FindControlHelper.GetMediaManager(VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Value = GetValueByMousePosition(e.GetPosition(this));
			CaptureMouse();
			isMouseDown = true;
			oldState = MediaManager.CurrentState;
			MediaElement.Pause();
		}

		protected virtual void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			MediaElement.Position = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(base.Value);
			ReleaseMouseCapture();
			isMouseDown = false;
			if (MediaManagerState.Playing == oldState)
			{
				MediaElement.Play();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateProgress();
		}

		protected virtual void OnTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (MediaElement != null)
			{
				if (!isMouseDown)
				{
					base.Value = MediaElement.Position.TotalMilliseconds;
				}
				else
				{
					MediaElement.Position = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(base.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaManagerChanged()
		{
			SubscribeMediaManagerEvents();
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaManagerSelectedItemChanged(object sender, SelectedItemChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DisableSlider();
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaManagerCurrentStateChanged(object sender, CurrentStateChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.State == MediaManagerState.Playing)
			{
				EnableSlider();
			}
			else if (e.State == MediaManagerState.Stopped || e.State == MediaManagerState.Closed)
			{
				DisableSlider();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnMediaElementMediaEnded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			DisableSlider();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnMediaElementMediaOpened(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((MediaElement)sender).NaturalDuration.HasTimeSpan)
			{
				EnableSlider();
			}
			else
			{
				DisableSlider();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateProgress()
		{
			progressBorder.Width = base.Value * CalculatedWidth / base.Maximum;
			if (progressTrackBorder != null)
			{
				double num = ((trackBorder != null) ? trackBorder.ActualWidth : base.ActualWidth);
				progressTrackBorder.Width = base.Value * num / base.Maximum;
			}
		}

		private double GetValueByMousePosition(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return (point.X - ThumbWidth / 2.0) / CalculatedWidth * base.Maximum;
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
			base.PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown += OnMouseLeftButtonDown;
			base.PreviewMouseLeftButtonUp += OnMouseLeftButtonUp;
			timer.Tick += OnTimerTick;
		}

		private void SubscribeMediaManagerEvents()
		{
			if (MediaManager != null)
			{
				MediaManager.SelectedItemChanged += OnMediaManagerSelectedItemChanged;
				MediaManager.CurrentStateChanged += OnMediaManagerCurrentStateChanged;
			}
			if (MediaElement != null)
			{
				MediaElement.MediaOpened += OnMediaElementMediaOpened;
				MediaElement.MediaEnded += OnMediaElementMediaEnded;
			}
		}

		private void DisableSlider()
		{
			timer.Stop();
			base.Maximum = 1.0;
			base.Value = 0.0;
		}

		private void EnableSlider()
		{
			if (MediaElement.NaturalDuration.HasTimeSpan)
			{
				base.Maximum = MediaElement.NaturalDuration.TimeSpan.TotalMilliseconds;
				timer.Start();
			}
			if (downloadBorder != null)
			{
				SetDownloadBorderVisibility();
			}
		}

		private void SetDownloadBorderVisibility()
		{
			if (MediaElement.Source.IsFile)
			{
				downloadBorder.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			else
			{
				downloadBorder.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
		}

		private void DoOnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			PopupControlService.Instance.UpdateState((Popup)(object)positionPopup, true);
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "MouseOver", useTransitions: false);
		}

		private void DoOnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			PopupControlService.Instance.UpdateState((Popup)(object)positionPopup, false);
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions: false);
		}

		private void UpdatePopup()
		{
			if (positionPopup != null && popupTextBlock != null)
			{
				string text = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(base.Value).ToString();
				popupTextBlock.Text = (text.Contains('.') ? text.Remove(text.IndexOf('.')) : text);
				double horizontalOffset = progressBorder.ActualWidth - popupTextBlock.ActualWidth / 3.0;
				((Popup)(object)positionPopup).HorizontalOffset = horizontalOffset;
			}
		}
	}

				return null;

			set

					MediaManager.MediaList = value;
				}

		public MediaManager MediaManager

			get

				return (MediaManager)GetValue(MediaManagerProperty);

		protected internal MediaElement MediaElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (MediaManager != null)
				{
					return MediaManager.MediaElement;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		static PlayListControl()
		{
			CaptionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Caption", typeof(string), typeof(PlayListControl), new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty));
			MediaManagerProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MediaManager", typeof(MediaManager), typeof(PlayListControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((PlayListControl)d).OnMediaManagerChanged(d, e);
			}));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.UseIndependentThemeStyleKey<PlayListControl>();
		}

		public PlayListControl()
		{
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.SelectionChanged += OnSelectionChanged;
			base.DisplayMemberPath = "Description";
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			bRemoveSelectedItem = (Button)GetTemplateChild("bRemove");
			bRemoveAll = (Button)GetTemplateChild("bRemoveAll");
		}

		protected virtual void OnbRemoveAllClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (MediaManager != null)
			{
				MediaManager.MediaList.Clear();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnbRemoveSelectedItemClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (MediaManager != null)
			{
				MediaManager.MediaList.Remove((MediaItem)base.SelectedItem);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (MediaManager == null)
			{
				InitializeMediaManager();
			}
			InitializeSource();
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaElementMediaFailed(object sender, ExceptionRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateSelectedItem();
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaElementMediaOpened(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateSelectedItem();
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaManagerChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			InitializeSource();
		}

		protected virtual void OnMediaManagerSelectedIndexChanged(object sender, SelectedIndexChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.ItemsSource = MediaList;
			UpdateSelectedItem();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (MediaManager != null && base.SelectedItem != null && MediaList.Contains((MediaItem)base.SelectedItem))
			{
				MediaManager.SelectedIndex = MediaList.IndexOf((MediaItem)base.SelectedItem);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeMediaManager()
		{
			MediaManager = FindControlHelper.GetMediaManager(VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this));
		}

		private void InitializeSource()
		{
			base.ItemsSource = MediaList;
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			if (MediaManager != null)
			{
				MediaElement.MediaOpened += OnMediaElementMediaOpened;
				MediaElement.MediaFailed += OnMediaElementMediaFailed;
				MediaManager.SelectedIndexChanged += OnMediaManagerSelectedIndexChanged;
			}
			if (bRemoveAll != null)
			{
				bRemoveAll.Click += OnbRemoveAllClick;
			}
			if (bRemoveSelectedItem != null)
			{
				bRemoveSelectedItem.Click += OnbRemoveSelectedItemClick;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedItem()
		{
			base.SelectedItem = MediaManager.SelectedItem;
			if (base.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				Caption = "Playlist: " + (MediaManager.SelectedIndex + 1) + " of " + MediaList.Count;
			}
			else
			{
				Caption = "Playlist: <" + MediaList.Count + ">";
			}
		}
	}

	internal static class FindControlHelper
	{
		public static DependencyObject FindChildControlByType(DependencyObject reference, Type childType)
		{
			if (reference != null)
			{
				if (reference.GetType() == childType)
				{
					return reference;
				}
				int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(reference);
				for (int i = 0; i < childrenCount; i++)
				{
					DependencyObject child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(reference, i);
					if (child.GetType() == childType)
					{
						return child;
					}
					DependencyObject dependencyObject = FindChildControlByType(child, childType);
					if (dependencyObject != null)
					{
						return dependencyObject;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static DependencyObject FindParentControlByType(DependencyObject reference, Type parentType)
		{
			if (reference == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (reference.GetType() == parentType)
			{
				return reference;
			}
			return FindParentControlByType(VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(reference), parentType);
		}

		public static MediaManager GetMediaManager(DependencyObject reference)
		{
			return (MediaManager)FindParentControlByType(reference, typeof(MediaManager));
		}
	}

		private double CalculateProgress()
		{
			if (base.SelectedIndex > 0 && base.Items.Count >= 2)
			{
				return (double)base.SelectedIndex * 100.0 / (double)(base.Items.Count - 1);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private int CalculateIndexByProgress()
		{
			return (int)(Progress * (double)(base.Items.Count - 1) / 100.0 + 0.01);
		}

		public StepProgressBar()
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated += delegate
			{
				SetProgressBarPosition();
			};
			base.Loaded += delegate
			{
				SetProgressBarPosition();
			};
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ProgressBarOuterBorder = null;
			ProgressBar = GetTemplateChild("PART_ProgressBar") as ProgressBar;
			PartCanvas = GetTemplateChild("PART_Canvas") as Canvas;
			RootGrid = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(PartCanvas) as Grid;
			isProgressBarPositionValid = false;
		}

		protected override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
			isProgressBarPositionValid = false;
			SyncProcess(useAnimation: false);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
			SetItemsSizes();
			return result;
		}

		private void SetItemsSizes()
		{
			GetMaxDefinitionLengths(out var maxNearContentLength, out var maxIndicatorLength, out var maxFarContentLength, out var unitStarValue);
			for (int i = 0; i < base.ItemContainerGenerator.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				StepProgressBarItem stepProgressBarItem = (StepProgressBarItem)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i);
				if (!IsContainerRootGridValid(stepProgressBarItem))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					if (NearContentLength.IsStar)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.RowDefinitions[0].SetCurrentValue(RowDefinition.HeightProperty, new GridLength(NearContentLength.Value * unitStarValue));
					}
					if (IndicatorLength.IsStar)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.RowDefinitions[1].SetCurrentValue(RowDefinition.HeightProperty, new GridLength(IndicatorLength.Value * unitStarValue));
					}
					if (FarContentLength.IsStar)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.RowDefinitions[2].SetCurrentValue(RowDefinition.HeightProperty, new GridLength(FarContentLength.Value * unitStarValue));
					}
					if (NearContentLength.IsAuto)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.RowDefinitions[0].SetCurrentValue(RowDefinition.HeightProperty, new GridLength(maxNearContentLength));
					}
					if (IndicatorLength.IsAuto)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.RowDefinitions[1].SetCurrentValue(RowDefinition.HeightProperty, new GridLength(maxIndicatorLength));
					}
					if (FarContentLength.IsAuto)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.RowDefinitions[2].SetCurrentValue(RowDefinition.HeightProperty, new GridLength(maxFarContentLength));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (NearContentLength.IsStar)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.ColumnDefinitions[0].SetCurrentValue(ColumnDefinition.WidthProperty, new GridLength(NearContentLength.Value * unitStarValue));
					}
					if (IndicatorLength.IsStar)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.ColumnDefinitions[1].SetCurrentValue(ColumnDefinition.WidthProperty, new GridLength(IndicatorLength.Value * unitStarValue));
					}
					if (FarContentLength.IsStar)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.ColumnDefinitions[2].SetCurrentValue(ColumnDefinition.WidthProperty, new GridLength(FarContentLength.Value * unitStarValue));
					}
					if (NearContentLength.IsAuto)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.ColumnDefinitions[0].SetCurrentValue(ColumnDefinition.WidthProperty, new GridLength(maxNearContentLength));
					}
					if (IndicatorLength.IsAuto)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.ColumnDefinitions[1].SetCurrentValue(ColumnDefinition.WidthProperty, new GridLength(maxIndicatorLength));
					}
					if (FarContentLength.IsAuto)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.ColumnDefinitions[2].SetCurrentValue(ColumnDefinition.WidthProperty, new GridLength(maxFarContentLength));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void GetMaxDefinitionLengths(out double maxNearContentLength, out double maxIndicatorLength, out double maxFarContentLength, out double unitStarValue)
		{
			maxNearContentLength = 0.0;
			maxIndicatorLength = 0.0;
			maxFarContentLength = 0.0;
			unitStarValue = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.ItemContainerGenerator.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				StepProgressBarItem stepProgressBarItem = (StepProgressBarItem)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i);
				if (!IsContainerRootGridValid(stepProgressBarItem))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					maxNearContentLength = Math.Max(maxNearContentLength, stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.RowDefinitions[0].ActualHeight);
					maxIndicatorLength = Math.Max(maxIndicatorLength, stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.RowDefinitions[1].ActualHeight);
					maxFarContentLength = Math.Max(maxFarContentLength, stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.RowDefinitions[2].ActualHeight);
					if (NearContentLength.IsStar)
					{
						unitStarValue = Math.Max(unitStarValue, stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.RowDefinitions[0].ActualHeight / NearContentLength.Value);
					}
					if (IndicatorLength.IsStar)
					{
						unitStarValue = Math.Max(unitStarValue, stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.RowDefinitions[1].ActualHeight / IndicatorLength.Value);
					}
					if (FarContentLength.IsStar)
					{
						unitStarValue = Math.Max(unitStarValue, stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.RowDefinitions[2].ActualHeight / FarContentLength.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					maxNearContentLength = Math.Max(maxNearContentLength, stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.ColumnDefinitions[0].ActualWidth);
					maxIndicatorLength = Math.Max(maxIndicatorLength, stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.ColumnDefinitions[1].ActualWidth);
					maxFarContentLength = Math.Max(maxFarContentLength, stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.ColumnDefinitions[2].ActualWidth);
					if (NearContentLength.IsStar)
					{
						unitStarValue = Math.Max(unitStarValue, stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.ColumnDefinitions[0].ActualWidth / NearContentLength.Value);
					}
					if (IndicatorLength.IsStar)
					{
						unitStarValue = Math.Max(unitStarValue, stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.ColumnDefinitions[1].ActualWidth / IndicatorLength.Value);
					}
					if (FarContentLength.IsStar)
					{
						unitStarValue = Math.Max(unitStarValue, stepProgressBarItem.RootGrid.ColumnDefinitions[2].ActualWidth / FarContentLength.Value);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsContainerRootGridValid(StepProgressBarItem container)
		{
			if (container.RootGrid != null)
			{
				if (Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal || container.RootGrid.RowDefinitions.Count != 3)
				{
					if (Orientation == Orientation.Vertical)
					{
						return container.RootGrid.ColumnDefinitions.Count == 3;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			isProgressBarPositionValid = false;
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnItemsChanged(e);
			isProgressBarPositionValid = false;
			SyncProcess(useAnimation: false);
		}

		protected override void OnSelectionChanged(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnSelectionChanged(e);
			SyncProcess();
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewMouseDown(e);
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			StepProgressBarItem stepProgressBarItem = (StepProgressBarItem)element;
			stepProgressBarItem.Index = base.Items.IndexOf(item);
			if (element.GetType() != item.GetType())
			{
				stepProgressBarItem.ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty);
			}
			if (base.Items.IndexOf(item) == base.Items.Count - 1)
			{
				SyncProcess(useAnimation: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new StepProgressBarItem();
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is StepProgressBarItem;
		}

		private void OnProgressChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			if (CalculateIndexByProgress() == base.SelectedIndex)
			{
				OverallSync();
			}
			else if (!isProgressHasAnimation)
			{
				syncByProgress = true;
				SetValue(Selector.SelectedIndexProperty, CalculateIndexByProgress());
				syncByProgress = false;
			}
			else if (CompletePreviousStepsOnSelection)
			{
				((StepProgressBarItem)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(CalculateIndexByProgress()))?.SetCurrentValue(StepProgressBarItem.StateProperty, StepProgressBarItemState.Completed);
			}
		}

		private double OnCoerceProgress(double value)
		{
			if (value < 0.0)
			{
				value = 0.0;
			}
			if (value > 100.0)
			{
				value = 100.0;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void OnOrientationChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			isProgressBarPositionValid = false;
			SyncProcess(useAnimation: false);
		}

		private void OnShowOuterBorderChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (newValue)
			{
				isProgressBarPositionValid = false;
			}
			else
			{
				ClearOuterBorder();
			}
		}

		private void OnOuterBorderSizeChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			isProgressBarPositionValid = false;
			SyncBackgroundBorders();
		}

		private void OnOuterBorderIndentChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			isProgressBarPositionValid = false;
			SyncBackgroundBorders();
		}

		private void OnReverseOrderChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			isProgressBarPositionValid = false;
		}

		private void OnProgressSizeChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			isProgressBarPositionValid = false;
		}

		private void OnOffsetChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			isProgressBarPositionValid = false;
		}

		private void OnSelectedItemStateChanged(StepProgressBarItemState oldValue, StepProgressBarItemState newValue)
		{
			if (IsSelectedIndexValid)
			{
				((StepProgressBarItem)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(base.SelectedIndex))?.SetCurrentValue(StepProgressBarItem.StateProperty, newValue);
			}
		}

		private void SyncProcess(bool useAnimation = true)
		{
			if (base.Items != null)
			{
				useAnimation = useAnimation && CalculateProgress() > Progress && ProgressAnimationDuration.HasTimeSpan && ProgressAnimationDuration.TimeSpan != TimeSpan.Zero;
				SyncProgress(useAnimation);
				OverallSync(!useAnimation);
			}
		}

		private void OverallSync(bool syncState = true)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				StepProgressBarItem stepProgressBarItem = (StepProgressBarItem)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i);
				if (stepProgressBarItem == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				stepProgressBarItem.Index = i;
				if (i < base.SelectedIndex && CompletePreviousStepsOnSelection)
				{
					if (syncState)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.SetCurrentValue(StepProgressBarItem.StateProperty, StepProgressBarItemState.Completed);
					}
					stepProgressBarItem.IsSelected = false;
				}
				if (i > base.SelectedIndex && CompletePreviousStepsOnSelection)
				{
					if (syncState || CompletePreviousStepsOnSelection)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.SetCurrentValue(StepProgressBarItem.StateProperty, StepProgressBarItemState.NotStarted);
					}
					stepProgressBarItem.IsSelected = false;
				}
				if (i == base.SelectedIndex)
				{
					stepProgressBarItem.IsSelected = true;
					if (syncState)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.SetCurrentValue(StepProgressBarItem.StateProperty, SelectedItemState);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void SyncProgress(bool useAnimation)
		{
			if (!syncByProgress)
			{
				ClearAnimation();
				if (!useAnimation)
				{
					SetValue(ProgressProperty, CalculateProgress());
					return;
				}
				ProgressAnimation = new DoubleAnimation(Progress, CalculateProgress(), ProgressAnimationDuration);
				ProgressAnimation.Completed += AnimationCompleted;
				SetAnimation();
			}
		}

		private void SetAnimation()
		{
			if (ProgressAnimation != null)
			{
				BeginAnimation(ProgressProperty, ProgressAnimation);
				isProgressHasAnimation = true;
			}
		}

		private void ClearAnimation()
		{
			BeginAnimation(ProgressProperty, null);
			isProgressHasAnimation = false;
		}

		private void AnimationCompleted(object s, EventArgs e)
		{
			ClearAnimation();
			SetValue(ProgressProperty, CalculateProgress());
		}

		private void SyncRotationOfProgressBar()
		{
			if (ProgressBar != null)
			{
				ProgressBar.RenderTransformOrigin = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5);
				ProgressBar.RenderTransform = GetRotationTransformGroup();
				if (ProgressBarOuterBorder != null)
				{
					ProgressBarOuterBorder.RenderTransformOrigin = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5);
					ProgressBarOuterBorder.RenderTransform = GetRotationTransformGroup();
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetProgressBarPosition()
		{
			if (!isProgressBarPositionValid && base.Items.Count >= 2 && ProgressBar != null && RootGrid != null && RootGrid.IsLoaded)
			{
				isProgressBarPositionValid = true;
				StepProgressBarItem stepProgressBarItem = (StepProgressBarItem)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(0);
				StepProgressBarItem stepProgressBarItem2 = (StepProgressBarItem)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(base.Items.Count - 1);
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = stepProgressBarItem.GetIndicatorsPath();
				if (frameworkElement == null || frameworkElement.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					frameworkElement = stepProgressBarItem.GetIndicatorContent();
				}
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = stepProgressBarItem2.GetIndicatorsPath();
				if (frameworkElement2 == null || frameworkElement2.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					frameworkElement2 = stepProgressBarItem2.GetIndicatorContent();
				}
				if (frameworkElement == null || frameworkElement2 == null)
				{
					ShowProgress = false;
					return;
				}
				System.Windows.Point centerOfElement = GetCenterOfElement(frameworkElement);
				System.Windows.Point centerOfElement2 = GetCenterOfElement(frameworkElement2);
				Canvas.SetLeft(ProgressBar, Math.Abs(Math.Min(centerOfElement.X, centerOfElement2.X)));
				Canvas.SetTop(ProgressBar, Math.Abs(Math.Min(centerOfElement.Y, centerOfElement2.Y)) - ProgressBar.ActualHeight / 2.0);
				ProgressBar.Width = ((Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? Math.Abs(centerOfElement.X - centerOfElement2.X) : Math.Abs(centerOfElement.Y - centerOfElement2.Y));
				SyncBackgroundBorders();
				SyncRotationOfProgressBar();
			}
		}

		private void SyncBackgroundBorders()
		{
			if (PartCanvas != null && ShowOuterBorder)
			{
				SyncProgressBarOuterBorderPosition();
				SyncIndicatorsOuterBorderPostition();
			}
		}

		private Path CreateIndicatorsOuterBackgroundPath(StepProgressBarItem item)
		{
			Path path = new Path();
			path.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding("Background")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			path.SetBinding(Path.DataProperty, new Binding("IndicatorGeometry")
			{
				Source = item
			});
			Panel.SetZIndex(path, -2);
			return path;
		}

		private Path CreateIndicatorsOuterBorderPath(StepProgressBarItem item)
		{
			Path path = new Path();
			path.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding("OuterBorderBrush")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			path.SetBinding(Path.DataProperty, new Binding("IndicatorGeometry")
			{
				Source = item
			});
			Panel.SetZIndex(path, -4);
			return path;
		}

		private System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle CreateProgressBarOuterBorder()
		{
			System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle rectangle = new System.Windows.Shapes.Rectangle();
			rectangle.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeProperty, new Binding("OuterBorderBrush")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			rectangle.SetBinding(Shape.FillProperty, new Binding("Background")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			rectangle.SetBinding(Shape.StrokeThicknessProperty, new Binding("OuterBorderSize")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			rectangle.SetBinding(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, new Binding("Visibility")
			{
				Source = ProgressBar
			});
			Panel.SetZIndex(rectangle, -3);
			return rectangle;
		}

		private void ClearOuterBorder()
		{
			if (ProgressBarOuterBorder != null)
			{
				PartCanvas.Children.Remove(ProgressBarOuterBorder);
				BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(ProgressBarOuterBorder);
				ProgressBarOuterBorder = null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				StepProgressBarItem stepProgressBarItem = (StepProgressBarItem)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i);
				if (stepProgressBarItem != null)
				{
					if (stepProgressBarItem.OuterBackgroundPath != null)
					{
						BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(stepProgressBarItem.OuterBackgroundPath);
					}
					if (stepProgressBarItem.OuterBorderPath != null)
					{
						BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(stepProgressBarItem.OuterBorderPath);
					}
					PartCanvas.Children.Remove(stepProgressBarItem.OuterBackgroundPath);
					PartCanvas.Children.Remove(stepProgressBarItem.OuterBorderPath);
					stepProgressBarItem.OuterBackgroundPath = null;
					stepProgressBarItem.OuterBorderPath = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SyncProgressBarOuterBorderPosition()
		{
			if (ShowProgress && ShowOuterBorder && ProgressBar != null)
			{
				if (ProgressBarOuterBorder == null)
				{
					ProgressBarOuterBorder = CreateProgressBarOuterBorder();
					PartCanvas.Children.Add(ProgressBarOuterBorder);
				}
				ProgressBarOuterBorder.Width = ProgressBar.Width;
				ProgressBarOuterBorder.Height = ProgressBar.ActualHeight + 2.0 * OuterBorderSize + 2.0 * OuterBorderIndent;
				double length = Canvas.GetTop(ProgressBar) + ProgressBar.ActualHeight / 2.0 - ProgressBarOuterBorder.Height / 2.0;
				Canvas.SetLeft(ProgressBarOuterBorder, Canvas.GetLeft(ProgressBar));
				Canvas.SetTop(ProgressBarOuterBorder, length);
			}
		}

		private void SyncIndicatorsOuterBorderPostition()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				StepProgressBarItem stepProgressBarItem = (StepProgressBarItem)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i);
				Path indicatorsPath = stepProgressBarItem.GetIndicatorsPath();
				if (indicatorsPath != null)
				{
					if (stepProgressBarItem.OuterBackgroundPath == null)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.OuterBackgroundPath = CreateIndicatorsOuterBackgroundPath(stepProgressBarItem);
						PartCanvas.Children.Add(stepProgressBarItem.OuterBackgroundPath);
						isProgressBarPositionValid = false;
					}
					if (stepProgressBarItem.OuterBorderPath == null)
					{
						stepProgressBarItem.OuterBorderPath = CreateIndicatorsOuterBorderPath(stepProgressBarItem);
						PartCanvas.Children.Add(stepProgressBarItem.OuterBorderPath);
						isProgressBarPositionValid = false;
					}
					SetIndicatorsOuterBordersSize(stepProgressBarItem.OuterBackgroundPath, stepProgressBarItem.OuterBorderPath, indicatorsPath);
					stepProgressBarItem.InvalidateVisual();
					SetOuterBorderPathsPosition(stepProgressBarItem.OuterBackgroundPath, indicatorsPath);
					SetOuterBorderPathsPosition(stepProgressBarItem.OuterBorderPath, indicatorsPath);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetIndicatorsOuterBordersSize(Path outerBackgroundPath, Path outerBorderPath, Path indicator)
		{
			outerBackgroundPath.StrokeThickness = 2.0 * OuterBorderIndent + indicator.StrokeThickness;
			outerBorderPath.StrokeThickness = 2.0 * (OuterBorderSize + OuterBorderIndent) + indicator.StrokeThickness;
			Grid grid = (Grid)FrameworkElementExtensions.GetParent((FrameworkElement)indicator);
			if (grid != null)
			{
				grid.Margin = new Thickness(OuterBorderSize + OuterBorderIndent);
			}
		}

		private void SetOuterBorderPathsPosition(Path pathBorder, Path containerIndicator)
		{
			Canvas.SetTop(pathBorder, GetIndicatorsOuterBorderTop(pathBorder, containerIndicator));
			Canvas.SetLeft(pathBorder, GetIndicatorsOuterBorderLeft(pathBorder, containerIndicator));
		}

		private double GetIndicatorsOuterBorderTop(Path pathBorder, Path indicator)
		{
			return Math.Abs(GetTop(indicator));
		}

		private double GetIndicatorsOuterBorderLeft(Path pathBorder, Path indicator)
		{
			return Math.Abs(GetLeft(indicator));
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetCenterOfElement(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = element.TransformToAncestor(RootGrid).Transform(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0));
			double num = ((base.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.LeftToRight) ? (element.ActualWidth / 2.0) : ((0.0 - element.RenderSize.Width) / 2.0));
			return new System.Windows.Point(point.X + num, point.Y + element.RenderSize.Height / 2.0);
		}

		private double GetTop(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			return element.TransformToAncestor(RootGrid).Transform(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0)).Y;
		}

		private double GetLeft(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			return element.TransformToAncestor(RootGrid).Transform(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0)).X;
		}

		private double GetAngle()
		{
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Vertical)
			{
				if (!ReverseOrder)
				{
					return 90.0;
				}
				return 270.0;
			}
			if (!ReverseOrder)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return 180.0;
		}

		private TransformGroup GetRotationTransformGroup()
		{
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform
			{
				Angle = GetAngle()
			});
			if (ReverseOrder)
			{
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform((Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? ProgressBar.Width : 0.0, (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? 0.0 : ProgressBar.Width));
			}
			return transformGroup;
		}
	}

		static StepProgressBarItem()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(StepProgressBarItem);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<StepProgressBarItem>();
			StateChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("StateChanged", RoutingStrategy.Direct, typeof(EventHandler<StateChangedEventArgs>), typeFromHandle);
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<StepProgressBarItem>.New().AddOwner<bool>(ref IsSelectedProperty, Selector.IsSelectedProperty, false, (Action<StepProgressBarItem, bool, bool>)delegate(StepProgressBarItem x, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
			{
				x.OnIsSelectedChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}).Register<StepProgressBarItemState>("State", ref StateProperty, StepProgressBarItemState.NotStarted, (Action<StepProgressBarItem, StepProgressBarItemState, StepProgressBarItemState>)delegate(StepProgressBarItem x, StepProgressBarItemState oldValue, StepProgressBarItemState newValue)
			{
				x.OnStateChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<object>("NearContent", ref NearContentProperty, (object)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplate>("NearContentTemplate", ref NearContentTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("NearContentTemplateSelector", ref NearContentTemplateSelectorProperty, (DataTemplateSelector)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<HorizontalAlignment>("NearContentHorizontalAlignment", ref NearContentHorizontalAlignmentProperty, HorizontalAlignment.Center, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<VerticalAlignment>("NearContentVerticalAlignment", ref NearContentVerticalAlignmentProperty, VerticalAlignment.Center, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<object>("FarContent", ref FarContentProperty, (object)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplate>("FarContentTemplate", ref FarContentTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("FarContentTemplateSelector", ref FarContentTemplateSelectorProperty, (DataTemplateSelector)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("IndicatorBorderSize", ref IndicatorBorderSizeProperty, 0.0, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<Geometry>("IndicatorGeometry", ref IndicatorGeometryProperty, (Geometry)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<System.Windows.Media.Brush>("HoverBackground", ref HoverBackgroundProperty, (System.Windows.Media.Brush)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<System.Windows.Media.Brush>("HoverBorderBrush", ref HoverBorderBrushProperty, (System.Windows.Media.Brush)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<HorizontalAlignment>("FarContentHorizontalAlignment", ref FarContentHorizontalAlignmentProperty, HorizontalAlignment.Center, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<VerticalAlignment>("FarContentVerticalAlignment", ref FarContentVerticalAlignmentProperty, VerticalAlignment.Center, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<int>("Index", ref IndexPropertyKey, ref IndexProperty, -1, (Action<StepProgressBarItem, int, int>)delegate(StepProgressBarItem x, int oldValue, int newValue)
				{

				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);

		{
			return GetTemplateChild("PART_IndicatorsGeometry") as Path;
		}

		{
			return GetTemplateChild("PART_IndicatorContent") as FrameworkElement;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UnSubscribe();
			RootGrid = GetTemplateChild("PART_ItemRootGrid") as Grid;
			IndicatorGrid = GetTemplateChild("PART_IndicatorGrid") as Grid;
			MouseOverPath = GetTemplateChild("PART_IndicatorsGeometry_MouseOver") as Path;
			Subscribe();
		}

		private void UnSubscribe()
		{
			if (IndicatorGrid != null)
			{
				IndicatorGrid.MouseEnter -= IndicatorGrid_MouseEnter;
				IndicatorGrid.MouseLeave -= IndicatorGrid_MouseExit;
			}
		}

		private void Subscribe()
		{
			IndicatorGrid.MouseEnter += IndicatorGrid_MouseEnter;
			IndicatorGrid.MouseLeave += IndicatorGrid_MouseExit;
		}

		private void IndicatorGrid_MouseEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (MouseOverPath != null)
			{
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation(1.0, new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(15.0)));
				doubleAnimation.Completed += delegate
				{
					MouseOverPath.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, null);
					MouseOverPath.Opacity = 1.0;
				};
				MouseOverPath.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, doubleAnimation);
			}
		}

		private void IndicatorGrid_MouseExit(object sender, MouseEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (MouseOverPath != null)
			{
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation(0.0, new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(10.0)));
				doubleAnimation.Completed += delegate
				{
					MouseOverPath.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, null);
					MouseOverPath.Opacity = 0.0;
				};
				MouseOverPath.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, doubleAnimation);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewMouseDown(e);
			if (IsAreaClickable(e.OriginalSource) && base.IsEnabled)
			{
				SelectSelf();
			}
		}

		private void SelectSelf()
		{
			if (ItemsControl.ItemsControlFromItemContainer(this) is StepProgressBar stepProgressBar)
			{
				stepProgressBar.SetCurrentValue(Selector.SelectedIndexProperty, stepProgressBar.ItemContainerGenerator.IndexFromContainer(this));
			}
		}

		private bool IsAreaClickable(object originalSource)
		{
			return LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualParents(originalSource as DependencyObject, (DependencyObject)this)?.OfType<Grid>()?.FirstOrDefault((Grid x) => x.Name == "PART_IndicatorGrid") != null;
		}

		private void OnStateChanged(StepProgressBarItemState oldValue, StepProgressBarItemState newValue)
		{
			RaiseEvent(new StateChangedEventArgs(oldValue, newValue)
			{
				RoutedEvent = StateChangedEvent
			});
		}

		private void OnIndexChanged(int oldValue, int newValue)
		{
			indexEntry = newValue;
		}

		private void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (newValue)
			{
				SelectSelf();
			}
		}
	}
	public class StateChangedEventArgs : RoutedEventArgs
	{
		public StepProgressBarItemState OldState { get; }

		public StepProgressBarItemState NewState { get; }

		internal StateChangedEventArgs(StepProgressBarItemState oldState, StepProgressBarItemState newState)
		{
			OldState = oldState;
			NewState = newState;
		}
	}
	public enum StepProgressBarItemState
	{
		NotStarted,
		Indeterminate,
		Completed
	}
	public static class Categories
	{
		public const string Brush = "Brush";

		public const string Layout = "Layout";

		public const string Appearance = "Appearance";

		public const string Common = "Common";

		public const string Automation = "Automation";

		public const string Transform = "Transform";
