	internal class WizardNavigationService : ViewServiceBase, INavigationService
	{
		private class WizardServiceJournal
		{
			private readonly JournalEntryStack _BackStack;

			private readonly CacheQueue _Cache;

			private readonly JournalEntryStack _ForwardStack;

			private BackwardNavigation backwardNavigation;

			private JournalEntry current;

			public BackwardNavigation BackwardNavigation
			{
				get
				{
					return backwardNavigation;
				}
				set
				{
					if (backwardNavigation != value)
					{
						backwardNavigation = value;
						OnPropertyChanged("BackwardNavigation");
					}
				}
			}

			public bool CanGoBack
			{
				get
				{
					if (!PrefetchingStrategy.CanGoBack)
					{
						return _BackStack.Count > 1;
					}
					return true;
				}
			}

			public bool CanGoForward
			{
				get
				{
					if (!PrefetchingStrategy.CanGoForward)
					{
						return _ForwardStack.Count > 0;
					}
					return true;
				}
			}

			public JournalEntry Current
			{
				get
				{
					return current;
				}
				protected set
				{
					if (current != value)
					{
						current = value;
						PrefetchingStrategy.Current = value.With((JournalEntry x) => x.Source);
						if (this.CurrentChanged != null)
						{
							this.CurrentChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			public bool NavigationInProgress { get; private set; }

			public INavigationFrame Navigator { get; set; }

			public WizardNavigationService Owner { get; set; }

			private IPrefetchingStrategy PrefetchingStrategy => Owner.Wizard.PrefetchingStrategy;

			public event EventHandler CurrentChanged;

			public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

			public WizardServiceJournal()
			{
				_BackStack = new JournalEntryStack();
				_BackStack.CountChanged += OnBackStackCountChanged;
				_ForwardStack = new JournalEntryStack();
				_ForwardStack.CountChanged += OnForwardStackCountChanged;
				_Cache = new CacheQueue();
			}

			public void ClearNavigationCache()
			{
				ClearCache();
			}

			public void ClearNavigationHistory()
			{
				ClearNavigationHistoryOverride();
			}

			public void GoBack(object param)
			{
				if (BackwardNavigation == BackwardNavigation.Default)
				{
					if (_BackStack.Count > 1)
					{
						JournalEntry item = _BackStack.Pop();
						JournalEntry journalEntry = _BackStack.Peek();
						if (param != null)
						{
							journalEntry.Parameter = param;
						}
						if (!NavigateCore(journalEntry, NavigationMode.Back, param))
						{
							_BackStack.Push(item);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					bool canGoBack = PrefetchingStrategy.CanGoBack;
					JournalEntry journalEntry2 = null;
					NavigationMode mode = NavigationMode.Back;
					if (canGoBack)
					{
						journalEntry2 = CreateJournalEntry(PrefetchingStrategy.GoBack(), null);
					}
					if (journalEntry2 != null)
					{
						NavigateCore(journalEntry2, mode, param);
					}
				}
			}

			public void GoForward(object param)
			{
				bool canGoForward = PrefetchingStrategy.CanGoForward;
				JournalEntry journalEntry = null;
				NavigationMode mode = NavigationMode.New;
				if (canGoForward)
				{
					journalEntry = CreateJournalEntry(PrefetchingStrategy.GoForward(), null);
				}
				if (journalEntry == null && _ForwardStack.Count > 0)
				{
					journalEntry = _ForwardStack.Peek();
					mode = NavigationMode.Forward;
				}
				if (journalEntry != null)
				{
					NavigateCore(journalEntry, mode, param);
				}
			}

			public void Navigate(string viewType, object viewModel, object parameter, object parentViewModel, bool saveToJournal)
			{
				WizardServiceJournalEntry wizardServiceJournalEntry = new WizardServiceJournalEntry(viewType)
				{
					ViewModel = viewModel,
					Parameter = parameter,
					ParentViewModel = parentViewModel,
					SaveToHistory = saveToJournal
				};
				NavigateCore(wizardServiceJournalEntry, NavigationMode.New, wizardServiceJournalEntry.Parameter);
			}

			internal virtual void UpdateJournalStack()
			{
				if (BackwardNavigation == BackwardNavigation.Default)
				{
					return;
				}
				IEnumerable<object> backStack = PrefetchingStrategy.BackStack;
				IEnumerable<object> forwardStack = PrefetchingStrategy.ForwardStack;
				List<JournalEntry> list = new List<JournalEntry>();
				while (_BackStack.Any())
				{
					list.Add(_BackStack.Pop());
				}
				foreach (object obj in backStack)
				{
					JournalEntry journalEntry = list.FirstOrDefault((JournalEntry x) => x.Source == obj);
					_BackStack.Push(journalEntry ?? CreateJournalEntry(obj, null));
				}
				if (Current != null)
				{
					_BackStack.Push(Current);
				}
				while (_ForwardStack.Any())
				{
					list.Add(_ForwardStack.Pop());
				}
				foreach (object obj2 in forwardStack)
				{
					JournalEntry journalEntry2 = list.FirstOrDefault((JournalEntry x) => x.Source == obj2);
					_ForwardStack.Push(journalEntry2 ?? CreateJournalEntry(obj2, null));
				}
			}

			protected virtual void ClearNavigationHistoryOverride()
			{
				_ForwardStack.Clear();
				_BackStack.Clear();
				if (Current != null)
				{
					_BackStack.Push(Current);
				}
				UpdateProperties();
			}

			protected virtual JournalEntry CreateJournalEntry(object content, object navigationState)
			{
				return new WizardServiceJournalEntry(content);
			}

			protected virtual bool NavigateCore(JournalEntry entry, NavigationMode mode, object navigationState = null)
			{
				NavigationInProgress = true;
				try
				{
					return NavigateCoreOverride(entry, mode, navigationState);
				}
				finally
				{
					NavigationInProgress = false;
				}
			}

			protected virtual bool NavigateCoreOverride(JournalEntry entry, NavigationMode mode, object navigationState)
			{
				Owner.OnNavigating();
				try
				{
					object currentContent = Owner.GetCurrentContent();
					if (currentContent != null)
					{
						object viewModelFromView = ViewHelper.GetViewModelFromView(currentContent);
						if (viewModelFromView is ISupportNavigation supportNavigation)
						{
							supportNavigation.OnNavigatedFrom();
						}
					}
					UpdateJournal(entry, mode);
					JournalEntry journalEntry = Current;
					Current = ((BackwardNavigation == BackwardNavigation.Default && _BackStack.Count > 0) ? _BackStack.Peek() : (entry as WizardServiceJournalEntry));
					Current.Do(delegate(JournalEntry x)
					{
						x.SetContent(entry.Content);
					});
					if (journalEntry != null && !journalEntry.KeepAlive)
					{
						journalEntry.ClearContent();
					}
					UpdateProperties();
					currentContent = Owner.GetCurrentContent();
					if (currentContent != null && ViewHelper.GetViewModelFromView(currentContent) is ISupportNavigation supportNavigation2)
					{
						supportNavigation2.OnNavigatedTo();
					}
				}
				catch (NavigationException ex)
				{
					NavigationException ex2 = ex;
					NavigationException ex3 = ex2;
					Navigator.Do(delegate(INavigationFrame x)
					{
						x.NavigationFailed(entry.Source, ex3);
					});
					return false;
				}
				catch (Exception ex4)
				{
					Exception ex5 = ex4;
					Exception ex6 = ex5;
					Navigator.Do(delegate(INavigationFrame x)
					{
						x.NavigationFailed(entry.Source, new NavigationException(entry.Source, ex6));
					});
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			protected virtual void OnCanGoBackChanged()
			{
				if (Owner.canGoBackChanged != null)
				{
					Owner.canGoBackChanged(Owner, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}

			protected virtual void OnCanGoForwardChanged()
			{
				if (Owner.canGoForwardChanged != null)
				{
					Owner.canGoForwardChanged(Owner, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}

			protected virtual void UpdateProperties()
			{
				UpdateJournalStack();
				OnPropertyChanged("CanGoBack");
				OnPropertyChanged("CanGoForward");
			}

			private void ClearCache()
			{
				_Cache.Clear();
			}

			private FrameworkElement CreatePage(WizardServiceJournalEntry entry)
			{
				return CreateView(entry);
			}

			private FrameworkElement CreateView(WizardServiceJournalEntry entry)
			{
				return (FrameworkElement)((ViewServiceBase)Owner).CreateAndInitializeView(entry.Source.With((object x) => x.ToString()), entry.ViewModel, entry.Parameter, entry.ParentViewModel, (IDocumentOwner)null);
			}

			private void EnsureEntryContent(WizardServiceJournalEntry entry)
			{
				if (entry == null || entry.Content != null)
				{
					return;
				}
				object obj = entry.Source ?? entry.ViewModel;
				if (!TryRestoreEntryContent(entry))
				{
					object obj2 = (obj as FrameworkElement) ?? CreatePage(entry);
					if (obj != null)
					{
						_Cache.InsertPage(obj, obj2);
					}
					entry.SetContent(obj2);
				}
			}

			private void OnBackStackCountChanged(object sender, JournalEntryStackCountChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if ((e.OldValue == 1 && _BackStack.Count == 2) || (e.OldValue == 2 && _BackStack.Count == 1))
				{
					OnCanGoBackChanged();
				}
			}

			private void OnForwardStackCountChanged(object sender, JournalEntryStackCountChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if ((e.OldValue == 0 && _BackStack.Count == 1) || (e.OldValue == 1 && _BackStack.Count == 0))
				{
					OnCanGoForwardChanged();
				}
			}

			private void ReInitializePage(object page, WizardServiceJournalEntry entry)
			{
				ViewHelper.InitializeView(page, entry.ViewModel, entry.Parameter, entry.ParentViewModel, (IDocumentOwner)null);
			}

			private bool TryRestoreEntryContent(WizardServiceJournalEntry entry)
			{
				if (entry == null || entry.Content != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				object obj = entry.Source ?? entry.ViewModel;
				if (obj != null && _Cache.TryGetPageAndClearOnDropHook(obj, out var page))
				{
					ReInitializePage(page, entry);
					entry.SetContent(page);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private void UpdateJournal(JournalEntry entry, NavigationMode mode)
			{
				WizardServiceJournalEntry wizardServiceJournalEntry = entry as WizardServiceJournalEntry;
				TryRestoreEntryContent(wizardServiceJournalEntry);
				Owner.StartNavigation(entry);
				EnsureEntryContent(wizardServiceJournalEntry);
				switch (mode)
				{
				case NavigationMode.New:
					if (wizardServiceJournalEntry == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException();
					}
					if (wizardServiceJournalEntry.SaveToHistory)
					{
						_BackStack.Push(wizardServiceJournalEntry);
					}
					_ForwardStack.Clear();
					break;
				case NavigationMode.Back:
					_ForwardStack.Push(Current);
					break;
				case NavigationMode.Forward:
					_BackStack.Push(_ForwardStack.Pop());
					break;
				}
			}

			protected void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
			{
				if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
				{
					this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
				}
			}
		}

		internal class WizardServiceJournalEntry : JournalEntry
		{
			public object ParentViewModel { get; set; }

			public object ViewModel { get; set; }

			public WizardServiceJournalEntry(object source)
				: base(source)
			{
			}
		}

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty BackwardNavigationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BackwardNavigation", typeof(BackwardNavigation), typeof(WizardNavigationService), new PropertyMetadata(BackwardNavigation.Default, OnBackwardNavigationChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SplashScreenServiceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SplashScreenService", typeof(object), typeof(WizardNavigationService), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnSplashScreenServiceChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowSplashScreenProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowSplashScreen", typeof(bool), typeof(WizardNavigationService), new PropertyMetadata(true));

		private readonly WizardServiceJournal NavigationJournal;

		private EventHandler canGoBackChanged;

		private EventHandler canGoForwardChanged;

		private EventHandler currentChanged;

		private JournalEntry savedCurrent;

		private Wizard wizard;

		public bool CanGoBack => NavigationJournal.CanGoBack;

		public bool CanGoForward => NavigationJournal.CanGoForward;

		public bool CanNavigate => true;

		public object Current => NavigationJournal.With((WizardServiceJournal x) => x.Current.With((JournalEntry y) => y.Content));

		public bool ShowSplashScreen
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(ShowSplashScreenProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(ShowSplashScreenProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public object SplashScreenService
		{
			get
			{
				return ((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(SplashScreenServiceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(SplashScreenServiceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Wizard Wizard
		{
			get
			{
				return wizard;
			}
			set
			{
				if (wizard != value)
				{
					if (wizard != null)
					{
						wizard.ContentRendered -= OnWizardContentRendered;
					}
					wizard = value;
					if (wizard != null)
					{
						wizard.ContentRendered += OnWizardContentRendered;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal BackwardNavigation BackwardNavigation
		{
			get
			{
				return (BackwardNavigation)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(BackwardNavigationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(BackwardNavigationProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		protected bool NavigationInProgress => NavigationJournal.NavigationInProgress;

		object INavigationService.Current => Current;

		private WizardServiceJournal Journal => NavigationJournal;

		event EventHandler INavigationService.CanGoBackChanged
		{
			add
			{
				canGoBackChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(canGoBackChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				canGoBackChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(canGoBackChanged, value);
			}
		}

		event EventHandler INavigationService.CanGoForwardChanged
		{
			add
			{
				canGoForwardChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(canGoForwardChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				canGoForwardChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(canGoForwardChanged, value);
			}
		}

		event EventHandler INavigationService.CurrentChanged
		{
			add
			{
				currentChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(currentChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				currentChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(currentChanged, value);
			}
		}

		private static void OnBackwardNavigationChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (o is WizardNavigationService wizardNavigationService)
			{
				wizardNavigationService.OnBackwardStrategyChanged((BackwardNavigation)e.OldValue, (BackwardNavigation)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void OnSplashScreenServiceChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewValue == null || e.NewValue is ISplashScreenService || e.NewValue is ISplashScreenManagerService)
			{
				return;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("The SplashScreenService must implement either the ISplashScreenService or ISplashScreenManagerService interface.");
		}

		public WizardNavigationService()
		{
			NavigationJournal = new WizardServiceJournal
			{
				Owner = this
			};
			NavigationJournal.CurrentChanged += OnNavigationJournalCurrentChanged;
		}

		public void ClearCache()
		{
			Journal.ClearNavigationCache();
		}

		public void ClearNavigationHistory()
		{
			Journal.ClearNavigationHistory();
		}

		public void GoBack()
		{
			GoBack(null);
		}

		public void GoBack(object param)
		{
			NavigationJournal.GoBack(param);
		}

		public void GoForward()
		{
			GoForward(null);
		}

		public void GoForward(object param)
		{
			NavigationJournal.GoForward(param);
		}

		public void Navigate(string viewType, object param = null, object parentViewModel = null)
		{
			Navigate(viewType, null, param, parentViewModel, saveToJournal: true);
		}

		public virtual void Navigate(string viewType, object param, object parentViewModel, bool saveToJournal)
		{
			Navigate(viewType, null, param, parentViewModel, saveToJournal);
		}

		public void Navigate(string viewType, object viewModel, object param, object parentViewModel, bool saveToJournal)
		{
			Action navigationAction = delegate
			{
				NavigationJournal.Navigate(viewType, viewModel, param, parentViewModel, saveToJournal);
			};
			InvokeNavigation(navigationAction);
		}

		internal virtual void OnFrameNavigated(object sender, NavigationEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnNavigating()
		{
		}

		protected object GetCurrentContent()
		{
			return Journal.Current.With((JournalEntry x) => x.Content);
		}

		protected virtual void InvokeNavigation(Action navigationAction)
		{
			if (!((DispatcherObject)this).CheckAccess())
			{
				((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(navigationAction, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
			}
			else
			{
				navigationAction();
			}
		}

		protected bool IsContentEquals(JournalEntry journalEntry)
		{
			object obj = NavigationJournal.With((WizardServiceJournal x) => x.Current.With((JournalEntry y) => y.Content));
			return journalEntry != null && obj != null && journalEntry.Content == obj;
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackwardStrategyChanged(BackwardNavigation oldValue, BackwardNavigation newValue)
		{
			NavigationJournal.BackwardNavigation = newValue;
			ClearNavigationHistory();
			ClearCache();
		}

		protected virtual void StartNavigation(JournalEntry entry)
		{
			if (!IsContentEquals(entry))
			{
				TryShowSplashScreen();
			}
		}

		private ISplashScreenService GetSplashScreenService()
		{
			if (SplashScreenService is ISplashScreenService result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return ((ServiceBaseGeneric<FrameworkElement>)this).GetServicesClient()?.ServiceContainer.GetService<ISplashScreenService>();
		}

		private ISplashScreenManagerService GetSplashScreenManagerService()
		{
			if (SplashScreenService is ISplashScreenManagerService result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return ((ServiceBaseGeneric<FrameworkElement>)this).GetServicesClient()?.ServiceContainer.GetService<ISplashScreenManagerService>();
		}

		private void OnCurrentContentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (currentChanged != null)
			{
				currentChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void OnWizardContentRendered(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			TryHideSplashScreen();
		}

		private void OnNavigationJournalCurrentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (savedCurrent != null)
			{
				savedCurrent.ContentChanged -= OnCurrentContentChanged;
			}
			savedCurrent = NavigationJournal.Current;
			if (savedCurrent != null)
			{
				savedCurrent.ContentChanged += OnCurrentContentChanged;
			}
			OnCurrentContentChanged(null, null);
		}

		private void TryHideSplashScreen()
		{
			if (!ShowSplashScreen)
			{
				return;
			}
			ISplashScreenManagerService service = GetSplashScreenManagerService();
			if (service != null)
			{
				BackgroundHelper.DoWithDispatcher(((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher, (Action)delegate
				{
					service.Close();
				});
				return;
			}
			GetSplashScreenService().Do(delegate(ISplashScreenService s)
			{
				BackgroundHelper.DoWithDispatcher(((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher, (Action)delegate
				{
					s.HideSplashScreen();
				});
			});
		}

		private void TryShowSplashScreen()
		{
			if (!ShowSplashScreen)
			{
				return;
			}
			ISplashScreenManagerService splashScreenManagerService = GetSplashScreenManagerService();
			if (splashScreenManagerService != null)
			{
				splashScreenManagerService.Show();
				return;
			}
			GetSplashScreenService().Do(delegate(ISplashScreenService s)
			{
				s.ShowSplashScreen();
			});
		}
	}
	public enum WizardDefaultButton
	{
		None,
		Next,
		NextThenFinish
	}
	[TargetType(typeof(Wizard))]
	public class WizardService : ViewServiceBase, IWizardService
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ClearDataContextOnNavigationProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PageGeneratorTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PageGeneratorTemplateSelectorProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty WizardProperty;

		internal const string ExceptionWizardNotSet = "Navigation failed because the Wizard property has not been set. Try to attach WizardService directly to Wizard.";

		private Wizard _ActualWizard;

		public bool ClearDataContextOnNavigation
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(ClearDataContextOnNavigationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(ClearDataContextOnNavigationProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate PageGeneratorTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(PageGeneratorTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(PageGeneratorTemplateProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplateSelector PageGeneratorTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplateSelector)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(PageGeneratorTemplateSelectorProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(PageGeneratorTemplateSelectorProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public Wizard Wizard
		{
			get
			{
				return (Wizard)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(WizardProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(WizardProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		protected override bool AllowAttachInDesignMode => true;

		private Wizard ActualWizard
		{
			get
			{
				return _ActualWizard;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_ActualWizard != value)
				{
					Wizard actualWizard = _ActualWizard;
					_ActualWizard = value;
					OnActualWizardChanged(actualWizard, value);
				}
			}
		}

		object IWizardService.Current => ActualWizard.Controller.CurrentPage;

		static WizardService()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<WizardService>.New().Register<bool>("ClearDataContextOnNavigation", ref ClearDataContextOnNavigationProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<DataTemplate>("PageGeneratorTemplate", ref PageGeneratorTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("PageGeneratorTemplateSelector", ref PageGeneratorTemplateSelectorProperty, (DataTemplateSelector)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<Wizard>("Wizard", ref WizardProperty, (Wizard)null, (Action<WizardService, Wizard, Wizard>)delegate(WizardService d, Wizard oldValue, Wizard newValue)
				{
					d.OnWizardChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public void GoBack(object parameter)
		{
			CheckWizard();
			ActualWizard.Controller.Back(parameter);
		}

		public void GoForward(object parameter)
		{
			CheckWizard();
			ActualWizard.Controller.Next(parameter);
		}

		public void Navigate(string viewType, object viewModel, object parameter, object parentViewModel)
		{
			CheckWizard();
			ActualWizard.Controller.Navigate(viewType, viewModel, parameter, parentViewModel);
		}

		protected void CheckWizard()
		{
			if (ActualWizard == null)
			{
				ActualWizard = Wizard ?? (((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)this).AssociatedObject as Wizard);
			}
			if (ActualWizard == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Navigation failed because the Wizard property has not been set. Try to attach WizardService directly to Wizard.");
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((ServiceBase)this).OnAttached();
			if (((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)this).AssociatedObject.IsLoaded)
			{
				SetActualWizard(((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)this).AssociatedObject as Wizard);
			}
			else
			{
				((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)this).AssociatedObject.Loaded += OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)this).AssociatedObject.Loaded -= OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			((ServiceBase)this).OnDetaching();
		}

		void IWizardService.GoBack(object param)
		{
			GoBack(param);
		}

		void IWizardService.GoForward(object param)
		{
			GoForward(param);
		}

		void IWizardService.Navigate(string viewType, object viewModel, object param, object parentViewModel)
		{
			Navigate(viewType, viewModel, param, parentViewModel);
		}

		private void OnActualWizardChanged(Wizard oldValue, Wizard value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				value.Controller.WizardService = this;
				((FrameworkElement)(object)value).SetBinding(Wizard.ClearDataContextOnNavigationProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("ClearDataContextOnNavigation")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				((FrameworkElement)(object)value).SetBinding(Wizard.ViewLocatorProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("ViewLocator")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				((FrameworkElement)(object)value).SetBinding(Wizard.ViewTemplateProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("ViewTemplate")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				((FrameworkElement)(object)value).SetBinding(Wizard.ViewTemplateSelectorProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("ViewTemplateSelector")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				((FrameworkElement)(object)value).SetBinding(Wizard.PageGeneratorTemplateProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("PageGeneratorTemplate")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				((FrameworkElement)(object)value).SetBinding(Wizard.PageGeneratorTemplateSelectorProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("PageGeneratorTemplateSelector")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			}
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.Controller.WizardService = null;
				((DependencyObject)(object)oldValue).ClearValue(Wizard.ClearDataContextOnNavigationProperty);
				((DependencyObject)(object)oldValue).ClearValue(Wizard.ViewLocatorProperty);
				((DependencyObject)(object)oldValue).ClearValue(Wizard.ViewTemplateSelectorProperty);
				((DependencyObject)(object)oldValue).ClearValue(Wizard.ViewTemplateSelectorProperty);
				((DependencyObject)(object)oldValue).ClearValue(Wizard.PageGeneratorTemplateProperty);
				((DependencyObject)(object)oldValue).ClearValue(Wizard.PageGeneratorTemplateSelectorProperty);
			}
		}

		private void OnAssociatedObjectLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)this).AssociatedObject.Loaded -= OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			SetActualWizard(LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Wizard>((DependencyObject)((Behavior<FrameworkElement>)this).AssociatedObject));
		}

		private void OnWizardChanged(Wizard oldValue, Wizard newValue)
		{
			ActualWizard = newValue;
		}

		private void SetActualWizard(Wizard frame)
		{
			if (ActualWizard == null)
			{
				ActualWizard = frame;
			}
		}
	}

		Empty,
		DefaultButton

	public class WizardDialogFooter : DialogFooter
	{
		private ContentPresenter presenter;

		private VisualCollection visualChildrenCore;

		protected override int VisualChildrenCount => ((NonVisualDecorator)this).VisualChildrenCount + visualChildrenCore.Count;

		private ContentPresenter Presenter => presenter ?? (presenter = CreatePresenter());

		public WizardDialogFooter()
		{
			visualChildrenCore = new VisualCollection((Visual)(object)this);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeSize)
		{
			Presenter.Arrange(new Rect(arrangeSize));
			return arrangeSize;
		}

		protected virtual ContentPresenter CreatePresenter()
		{
			return new ContentPresenter();
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (index < ((NonVisualDecorator)this).VisualChildrenCount)
			{
				return ((NonVisualDecorator)this).GetVisualChild(index);
			}
			return visualChildrenCore[index - ((NonVisualDecorator)this).VisualChildrenCount];
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			Presenter.Measure(constraint);
			return Presenter.DesiredSize;
		}

		protected override void OnActualChildChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((DialogFooter)this).ActualDialogWindow == null)
			{
				Presenter.Content = e.NewValue;
			}
			((DialogFooter)this).OnActualChildChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnActualDialogWindowChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewValue != null)
			{
				Presenter.Content = null;
			}
			((DialogFooter)this).OnActualDialogWindowChanged(e);
			if (e.NewValue == null)
			{
				Presenter.Content = ((NonVisualDecorator)this).Child;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			((DialogFooter)this).OnInitialized(e);
			visualChildrenCore.Add(Presenter);
		}
	}

		internal class DefaultWizardViewLocator : IViewLocator
		{
			private readonly Wizard Wizard;

			public DefaultWizardViewLocator(Wizard wizard)
			{
				Wizard = wizard;
			}

			public object ResolveView(string name)
			{
				if (Wizard.ContainerFromId(name) is WizardPage result)
				{
					return result;
				}
				if (Wizard.ViewTemplate != null || Wizard.ViewTemplateSelector != null)
				{
					return ViewHelper.CreateView((IViewLocator)null, (string)null, Wizard.ViewTemplate, Wizard.ViewTemplateSelector);
				}
				IViewLocator actualLocator = GetActualLocator();
				return actualLocator.ResolveView(name);
			}

			private IViewLocator GetActualLocator()
			{
				return Wizard.ViewLocator ?? ViewLocator.Default;
			}

			public Type ResolveViewType(string name)
			{
				IViewLocator actualLocator = GetActualLocator();
				return actualLocator.ResolveViewType(name);
			}

			string IViewLocator.GetViewTypeName(Type type)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		internal class DefaultWizardController : WizardController
		{
			public Wizard Wizard { get; set; }

			protected override bool CloseWindowOnCancelClick => Wizard.CloseWindowOnCancelClick;

			protected override bool CloseWindowOnFinishClick => Wizard.CloseWindowOnFinishClick;

			public DefaultWizardController(object viewModel, object parameter)
				: base(viewModel, parameter)
			{
			}

			public DefaultWizardController(string startPageViewType, object startPageViewModel, object parameter)
				: base(startPageViewType, startPageViewModel, parameter)
			{
			}

			public DefaultWizardController(Func<INavigationService> getNavigationServiceCallback, Func<ICurrentDialogService> getCurrentDialogServiceCallback, object parameter, object parentViewModel)
				: base(getNavigationServiceCallback, getCurrentDialogServiceCallback, parameter, parentViewModel)
			{
			}

			public override void Back(object parameter)
			{
				Wizard.Presenter.Do(delegate(ViewPresenter x)
				{
					x.AnimationDirection = AnimationDirection.Forward;
				});
				base.Back(parameter);
			}

			public override void Navigate(string viewType, object viewModel, object parameter, object parentViewModel)
			{
				Wizard.Presenter.Do(delegate(ViewPresenter x)
				{
					x.AnimationDirection = AnimationDirection.Back;
				});
				base.Navigate(viewType, viewModel, parameter, parentViewModel);
			}

			public override void NavigateToPage(string page, object parameter)
			{
				Wizard.Presenter.Do(delegate(ViewPresenter x)
				{
					x.AnimationDirection = AnimationDirection.Back;
				});
				base.NavigateToPage(page, parameter);
			}

			public override void NavigateToPage(string page, object pageViewModel, object parameter)
			{
				Wizard.Presenter.Do(delegate(ViewPresenter x)
				{
					x.AnimationDirection = AnimationDirection.Back;
				});
				base.NavigateToPage(page, pageViewModel, parameter);
			}

			internal override object CreateContainerForView(object view)
			{
				return Wizard.CreateContainerForView(view);
			}

			protected override object GetCurrentPage()
			{
				object currentPage = base.GetCurrentPage();
				if (currentPage is WizardPageViewModel wizardPageViewModel)
				{
					return wizardPageViewModel.Context;
				}
				return currentPage;
			}

			protected override void NavigateToOverride(object pageViewModel)
			{
				string text = Wizard.IdFromItem(pageViewModel);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					text = Wizard.LinkItem(pageViewModel);
				}
				NavigateToPage(text, pageViewModel, null);
			}

			protected override void OnCurrentPageChanged(object oldValue)
			{
				base.OnCurrentPageChanged(oldValue);
				Wizard.CurrentContent = base.CurrentContainer;
				Wizard.OnWizardControllerCurrentPageChanged(base.WizardViewModel);
			}
		}

		private class WizardPrefetchingStrategy : StackedPrefetchingStrategy
		{
			private Wizard Wizard { get; set; }

			public WizardPrefetchingStrategy(Wizard wizard)
			{
				Wizard = wizard;
			}

			protected override bool CanGoBackCore()
			{
				return GetPreviousEntry() != null;
			}

			protected override bool CanGoForwardCore()
			{
				return GetNextEntry() != null;
			}

			protected override bool CanNavigateTo(object entry)
			{
				WizardPage containerPage = Wizard.GetContainerPage(entry);
				if (containerPage != null)
				{
					return ((UIElement)(object)containerPage).Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
				}
				return false;
			}

			protected override object GetNextEntry()
			{
				return GetNextEntryForCustomNavigation() ?? base.GetNextEntry();
			}

			protected override object GetPreviousEntry()
			{
				return GetPreviousEntryForCustomNavigation() ?? base.GetPreviousEntry();
			}

			private object GetNextEntryForCustomNavigation()
			{
				object current = base.Current;
				WizardPage containerPage = Wizard.GetContainerPage(current);
				if (containerPage != null)
				{
					ISupportCustomNavigation supportCustomNavigation = containerPage.With((WizardPage x) => x.ViewModel);
					if (supportCustomNavigation != null)
					{
						object nextPage = supportCustomNavigation.NextPage;
						if (nextPage != null)
						{
							string containerId = Wizard.GetContainerId(nextPage);
							if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(containerId))
							{
								return containerId;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			private object GetPreviousEntryForCustomNavigation()
			{
				object current = base.Current;
				WizardPage containerPage = Wizard.GetContainerPage(current);
				if (containerPage != null)
				{
					ISupportCustomNavigation supportCustomNavigation = containerPage.With((WizardPage x) => x.ViewModel);
					if (supportCustomNavigation != null)
					{
						object previousPage = supportCustomNavigation.PreviousPage;
						if (previousPage != null)
						{
							string containerId = Wizard.GetContainerId(previousPage);
							if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(containerId))
							{
								return containerId;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

					{
						x.Unloaded += OnCurrentContentUnloaded;
					});

					LockContent();

						Presenter.Content = _currentContent;
					}
					BackgroundHelper.DoInBackground((Action)delegate
					{
					}, (Action)UnlockContent, (int)AnimationDelay.TotalMilliseconds, ThreadPriority.Normal, ApartmentState.MTA);
					InvalidateCommands();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsWizardCommandChanged(DependencyObject sender, bool oldValue, bool newValue, WizardCommand buttonType)
		{
			if (!newValue)
			{
				List<WizardCommandBehavior> list = ((IEnumerable)Interaction.GetBehaviors(sender)).OfType<WizardCommandBehavior>().ToList();
				list.ForEach(delegate(WizardCommandBehavior x)
				{
					((FreezableCollection<Behavior>)(object)Interaction.GetBehaviors(sender)).Remove((Behavior)(object)x);
				});
			}
			else
			{
				WizardCommandBehavior value = new WizardCommandBehavior
				{
					ButtonType = buttonType
				};
				((FreezableCollection<Behavior>)(object)Interaction.GetBehaviors(sender)).Add((Behavior)(object)value);
			}
		}

			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Loaded += OnLoaded;
			_itemsContainerSyncHelper = new ItemsContainerSyncHelper(((ItemsControl)(object)this).ItemContainerGenerator);

			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Initialized += OnInitialized;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			((SelectorBase<Wizard, WizardPage>)(object)this).OnApplyTemplate();
			if (Presenter != null)
			{
				Presenter.ContentRendered -= OnPresenterContentRendered;
			}
			Presenter = ((FrameworkElement)(object)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_ViewPresenter") as ViewPresenter;
			if (Presenter != null)
			{
				Presenter.Content = CurrentContent;
				Presenter.ContentRendered += OnPresenterContentRendered;
			}
			ICurrentDialogService currentDialogService = CurrentDialogService;
			CurrentDialogService val = (CurrentDialogService)((currentDialogService is CurrentDialogService) ? currentDialogService : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				((WindowAwareServiceBase)val).WindowSource = Presenter;
			}
			EnsureController();
			UpdateDefaultButton();
		}

		internal bool CanCancel(object parameter)
		{
			if (AllowCancel && Controller != null)
			{
				return Controller.CanCancel(null);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool CanFinish(object parameter)
		{
			if (AllowFinish && Controller != null)
			{
				return Controller.CanFinish(null);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool CanGoBack(object parameter)
		{
			if (AllowBack && Controller != null && Controller.CanBack())
			{
				return CurrentContent == Controller.CurrentContainer;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool CanGoNext(object parameter)
		{
			if (AllowNext && Controller != null && Controller.CanNext())
			{
				return CurrentContent == Controller.CurrentContainer;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool CanGoToPage(object parameter)
		{
			return parameter != null;
		}

		internal void GoToPage(object parameter)
		{
			string text = GetContainerId(parameter);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && parameter is string)
			{
				text = (string)parameter;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				Controller.NavigateTo(parameter);
			}
			else
			{
				Controller.NavigateToPage(text);
			}
		}

		internal void OnBack(object parameter)
		{
			CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
			this.Back(this, e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				Controller.Back(parameter);
			}
		}

		internal void OnCancel(object parameter)
		{
			CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
			this.Cancel(this, e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				Controller.Cancel(null);
			}
		}

		internal void OnFinish(object parameter)
		{
			CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
			this.Finish(this, e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				Controller.Finish(null);
			}
		}

		internal void OnNext(object parameter)
		{
			CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
			this.Next(this, e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				Controller.NavigateToPage(null, parameter);
			}
		}

		internal void RegisterWizardButton(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is Button button && !wizardButtons.Contains(button))
			{
				wizardButtons.Add(button);
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			if (logicalChildrenCore.Contains(element))
			{
				logicalChildrenCore.Remove(element);
				((FrameworkElement)(object)this).RemoveLogicalChild((object)element);
			}
			UnlinkContainer(element, item);
			base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
		}

		protected override WizardPage CreateContainer()
		{
			return new WizardPage();
		}

		protected virtual object CreateContainerForView(object view)
		{
			object viewModelFromView = ViewHelper.GetViewModelFromView(view);
			WizardPage wizardPage = view as WizardPage;
			if (wizardPage == null)
			{
				wizardPage = ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<Wizard, WizardPage>.CreateItem((DependencyObject)(object)this, PagesAttachedBehaviorProperty, viewModelFromView);
				if (wizardPage == null)
				{
					wizardPage = ((SelectorBase<Wizard, WizardPage>)(object)this).CreateContainer();
					((FrameworkElement)(object)wizardPage).DataContext = viewModelFromView;
				}
				wizardPage.IsAutoGenerated = true;
				if (!DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)(object)wizardPage, WizardPage.ShowFinishProperty))
				{
					((DependencyObject)(object)wizardPage).SetCurrentValue(WizardPage.ShowFinishProperty, (object)true);
				}
				if (!DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)(object)wizardPage, WizardPage.AllowFinishProperty))
				{
					DependencyObjectExtensions.SetCurrentValueIfDefault((DependencyObject)(object)wizardPage, WizardPage.AllowFinishProperty, (object)true);
				}
				if (!DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)(object)wizardPage, ContentControl.ContentProperty))
				{
					((DependencyObject)(object)wizardPage).SetCurrentValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty, view);
				}
			}
			NonLogicalContentControl nonLogicalContentControl = GetDecorator((DependencyObject)(object)wizardPage);
			if (nonLogicalContentControl == null)
			{
				nonLogicalContentControl = new NonLogicalContentControl
				{
					Content = wizardPage,
					DataContext = wizardPage.ViewModel,
					Focusable = false
				};
				SetDecorator((DependencyObject)(object)wizardPage, nonLogicalContentControl);
			}
			return nonLogicalContentControl;
		}

		protected virtual WizardController CreateController()
		{
			return new DefaultWizardController(() => NavigationService, () => CurrentDialogService, null, null)
			{
				Wizard = this
			};
		}

		protected virtual INavigationService CreateNavigationService()
		{
			WizardNavigationService obj = new WizardNavigationService
			{
				Wizard = this
			};
			((ViewServiceBase)obj).ViewLocator = ActualViewLocator;
			WizardNavigationService wizardNavigationService = obj;
			BindingOperations.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)wizardNavigationService, ViewServiceBase.ViewTemplateProperty, new Binding("ViewTemplate")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			BindingOperations.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)wizardNavigationService, ViewServiceBase.ViewTemplateSelectorProperty, new Binding("ViewTemplateSelector")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			BindingOperations.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)wizardNavigationService, WizardNavigationService.BackwardNavigationProperty, new Binding("BackwardNavigation")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			return wizardNavigationService;
		}

		protected virtual void Initialize()
		{
			if (((ItemsControl)(object)this).HasItems && ((SelectorBase<Wizard, WizardPage>)(object)this).SelectedContainer == null)
			{
				Controller.Next();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSelectedContainerChanged(WizardPage oldValue, WizardPage newValue)
		{
			((SelectorBase<Wizard, WizardPage>)(object)this).OnSelectedContainerChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			InitializeItemsContainerGenerator();
			if (Controller == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WizardPage containerPage = GetContainerPage(Controller.WizardViewModel);
			if (containerPage != newValue)
			{
				if (newValue == null)
				{
					CurrentContent = null;
				}
				else
				{
					GoToPage(newValue);
				}
			}
			else if (CurrentContent != Controller.CurrentContainer)
			{
				CurrentContent = Controller.CurrentContainer;
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			UnlinkContainer(element, item);
			LinkContainer(element, item);
			if (LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(element) == null)
			{
				logicalChildrenCore.Add(element);
				((FrameworkElement)(object)this).AddLogicalChild((object)element);
			}
			NonLogicalContentControl decorator = GetDecorator(element);
			if (decorator != null)
			{
				decorator.Content = null;
				decorator.Content = element;
			}
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateButtonsVisibility()
		{
			IsBackButtonVisible = ShowBack && ActualButtonsVisibility.HasFlag(WizardButtons.Back);
			IsCancelButtonVisible = ShowCancel && ActualButtonsVisibility.HasFlag(WizardButtons.Cancel);
			IsFinishButtonVisible = ShowFinish && ActualButtonsVisibility.HasFlag(WizardButtons.Finish);
			IsNextButtonVisible = ShowNext && ActualButtonsVisibility.HasFlag(WizardButtons.Next);
		}

		private DependencyObject ContainerFromId(string id)
		{
			_id2Contaier.TryGetValue(id, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		private void EnsureController()
		{
			if (((FrameworkElement)(object)this).IsLoaded)
			{
				Initialize();
			}
		}

		private string GetContainerId(object obj)
		{
			WizardPage containerPage = GetContainerPage(obj);
			if (containerPage == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return _container2Id[(DependencyObject)(object)containerPage];
		}

		private WizardPage GetContainerPage(object obj)
		{
			if (_containers.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (obj is string)
			{
				WizardPage wizardPage = _containers.FirstOrDefault((WizardPage x) => object.Equals(((FrameworkElement)(object)x).Name, obj));
				if (wizardPage != null)
				{
					return wizardPage;
				}
				if (ContainerFromId((string)obj) is WizardPage result)
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			if (obj is WizardPage)
			{
				WizardPage wizardPage2 = _containers.FirstOrDefault((WizardPage x) => object.Equals(x, obj));
				if (wizardPage2 != null)
				{
					return wizardPage2;
				}
			}
			if (obj is WizardPageViewModel)
			{
				WizardPage wizardPage3 = _containers.FirstOrDefault((WizardPage x) => x.ViewModel == obj);
				if (wizardPage3 != null)
				{
					return wizardPage3;
				}
			}
			if (obj != null)
			{
				if (_item2Id.TryGetValue(obj, out var value))
				{
					return _id2Contaier[value] as WizardPage;
				}
				WizardPage wizardPage4 = _containers.FirstOrDefault((WizardPage x) => object.Equals(((FrameworkElement)(object)x).DataContext, obj));
				if (wizardPage4 != null)
				{
					return wizardPage4;
				}
				if (int.TryParse(obj.ToString(), out var result2) && IListExtensions.IsValidIndex<WizardPage>((IList<WizardPage>)_containers, result2))
				{
					return _containers[result2];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string IdFromItem(object item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			_item2Id.TryGetValue(item, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		private void InitializeItemsContainerGenerator()
		{
			if (!isItemsContainerGeneratorInitialized)
			{
				isItemsContainerGeneratorInitialized = true;
				_itemsContainerSyncHelper.Attach(null);
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateCommands()
		{
			CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
		}

		private string LinkContainer(DependencyObject container, object item)
		{
			string text = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
			if (container != null)
			{
				_container2Id[container] = text;
				_id2Contaier[text] = container;
				(container as WizardPage).Do(delegate(WizardPage x)
				{
					_containers.Add(x);
				});
			}
			if (item != null)
			{
				_item2Id[item] = text;
				_id2Item[text] = item;
			}
			int num = ((((ItemsControl)(object)this).ItemsSource is IList list && list.Contains(item)) ? list.IndexOf(item) : ((ItemsControl)(object)this).Items.IndexOf(container));
			if (num != -1)
			{
				PrefetchedItems.Insert(num, text);
			}
			else
			{
				PrefetchedItems.Add(text);
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string LinkItem(object item)
		{
			string text = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
			if (item != null)
			{
				_item2Id[item] = text;
				_id2Item[text] = item;
			}
			return text;
		}

		private void LockContent()
		{
			if (Presenter != null)
			{
				Presenter.LockContentLoading();
			}
		}

		private void MoveFocusToSelectedPage()
		{
			if (DefaultFocus == WizardDefaultFocus.DefaultButton)
			{
				((IEnumerable<Button>)wizardButtons).FirstOrDefault((Button x) => x.IsDefault).Do(delegate(Button x)
				{
					x.Focus();
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnActualButtonsVisibilityChanged()
		{
			UpdateButtonsVisibility();
		}

		private void OnCurrentContentUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			(sender as FrameworkElement).Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
			{
				x.Unloaded -= OnCurrentContentUnloaded;
			});
			if (!(sender is NonLogicalContentControl { Content: WizardPage content } nonLogicalContentControl))
			{
				return;
			}
			content.OnNavigatedFrom();
			if (!content.IsAutoGenerated)
			{
				return;
			}
			nonLogicalContentControl.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
			((DependencyObject)(object)content).ClearValue(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
			if (ClearDataContextOnNavigation)
			{
				(((ContentControl)(object)content).Content as FrameworkElement).Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
				{
					x.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnInitialized(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Initialized -= OnInitialized;
			InitializeItemsContainerGenerator();
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Loaded -= OnLoaded;
			EnsureController();
			UpdateDefaultButton();
		}

		private void OnPresenterContentRendered(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ContentRendered != null)
			{
				this.ContentRendered(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void OnShowFooterInternalChanged()
		{
			IsFooterVisible = ShowFooterInternal;
		}

		private void OnShowPropertyChanged()
		{
			UpdateButtonsVisibility();
		}

		private void OnWizardControllerCurrentPageChanged(object currentPage)
		{
			WizardPage containerPage = GetContainerPage(currentPage);
			if (_containers.Contains(containerPage))
			{
				object obj = ((ItemsControl)(object)this).ItemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer((DependencyObject)(object)containerPage);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					((SelectorBase<Wizard, WizardPage>)(object)this).SelectedItem = obj;
				}
			}
			WizardPage wizardPage = ((SelectorBase<Wizard, WizardPage>)(object)this).SelectedContainer ?? (currentPage as WizardPageViewModel).With((WizardPageViewModel x) => x.Owner);
			if (wizardPage != null)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)(object)this).SetBinding(ActualButtonsVisibilityProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding
				{
					Source = wizardPage,
					Path = new PropertyPath(WizardPage.ActualButtonsProperty)
				});
				((FrameworkElement)(object)this).SetBinding(ShowFooterInternalProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding
				{
					Source = wizardPage,
					Path = new PropertyPath(WizardPage.ShowFooterProperty)
				});
			}
			else
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).ClearValue(ActualButtonsVisibilityProperty);
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).ClearValue(ShowFooterInternalProperty);
			}
			((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				UpdateDefaultButton();
				MoveFocusToSelectedPage();
			}, DispatcherPriority.Background);
		}

		private void UnlinkContainer(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			string containerId = GetContainerId(element);
			WizardPage page = element as WizardPage;
			page.Do(delegate
			{
				_containers.Remove(page);
			});
			_item2Id.Remove(item);
			_id2Item.Remove(containerId);
			_container2Id.Remove(element);
			_id2Contaier.Remove(containerId);
			PrefetchedItems.Remove(containerId);
		}

		private void UnlockContent()
		{
			if (Presenter != null)
			{
				Presenter.UnlockContentLoading();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDefaultButton()
		{
			foreach (Button wizardButton in wizardButtons)
			{
				wizardButton.Do(delegate(Button x)
				{
					x.IsDefault = false;
				});
			}
			Func<Button> func = () => (!CanGoNext(null)) ? null : ((IEnumerable<Button>)wizardButtons).FirstOrDefault((Button x) => GetIsButtonNext(x) && x.IsVisible);
			Func<Button> func2 = () => (!CanFinish(null)) ? null : ((IEnumerable<Button>)wizardButtons).FirstOrDefault((Button x) => GetIsButtonFinish(x) && x.IsVisible).Do(delegate(Button x)
			{
				x.IsDefault = true;
			});
			switch (DefaultButton)
			{
			case WizardDefaultButton.Next:
			{
				Button input2 = func();
				input2.Do(delegate(Button x)
				{
					x.IsDefault = true;
				});
				break;
			}
			case WizardDefaultButton.NextThenFinish:
			{
				Button button = func();
				Button button2 = func2();
				Button input = button ?? button2;
				input.Do(delegate(Button x)
				{
					x.IsDefault = true;
				});
				break;
			}
			}
		}
	}
	public static class WizardCommands
	{
		private static readonly RoutedCommand backCommand;

		private static readonly RoutedCommand cancelCommand;

		private static readonly RoutedCommand finishCommand;

		private static readonly RoutedCommand goToPage;

		private static readonly RoutedCommand nextCommand;

		public static RoutedCommand BackCommand => backCommand;

		public static RoutedCommand CancelCommand => cancelCommand;

		public static RoutedCommand FinishCommand => finishCommand;

		public static RoutedCommand GoToPage => goToPage;

		public static RoutedCommand NextCommand => nextCommand;

		static WizardCommands()
		{
			goToPage = new RoutedCommand("GoToPage", typeof(Wizard));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(Wizard), new CommandBinding(goToPage, OnGoToPage, CanGoToPage));
			nextCommand = new RoutedCommand("NextCommand", typeof(Wizard));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(Wizard), new CommandBinding(nextCommand, OnNextCommand, CanNextCommand));
			backCommand = new RoutedCommand("BackCommand", typeof(Wizard));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(Wizard), new CommandBinding(backCommand, OnBackCommand, CanBackCommand));
			cancelCommand = new RoutedCommand("CancelCommand", typeof(Wizard));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(Wizard), new CommandBinding(cancelCommand, OnCancelCommand, CanCancelCommand));
			finishCommand = new RoutedCommand("FinishCommand", typeof(Wizard));
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(Wizard), new CommandBinding(finishCommand, OnFinishCommand, CanFinishCommand));
		}

		internal static ICommand GetCommand(WizardCommand kind)
		{
			return kind switch
			{
				WizardCommand.Next => NextCommand, 
				WizardCommand.Back => BackCommand, 
				WizardCommand.Finish => FinishCommand, 
				WizardCommand.Cancel => CancelCommand, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private static void CanBackCommand(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			e.CanExecute = (sender as Wizard).Return((Wizard x) => x.CanGoBack(e.Parameter), () => false);
		}

		private static void CanCancelCommand(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			e.CanExecute = (sender as Wizard).Return((Wizard x) => x.CanCancel(e.Parameter), () => false);
		}

		private static void CanFinishCommand(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			e.CanExecute = (sender as Wizard).Return((Wizard x) => x.CanFinish(e.Parameter), () => false);
		}

		private static void CanGoToPage(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			e.CanExecute = (sender as Wizard).Return((Wizard x) => x.CanGoToPage(e.Parameter), () => false);
		}

		private static void CanNextCommand(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			e.CanExecute = (sender as Wizard).Return((Wizard x) => x.CanGoNext(e.Parameter), () => false);
		}

		private static void OnBackCommand(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as Wizard).Do(delegate(Wizard x)
			{
				x.OnBack(e.Parameter);
			});
		}

		private static void OnCancelCommand(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as Wizard).Do(delegate(Wizard x)
			{
				x.OnCancel(e.Parameter);
			});
		}

		private static void OnFinishCommand(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as Wizard).Do(delegate(Wizard x)
			{
				x.OnFinish(e.Parameter);
			});
		}

		private static void OnGoToPage(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as Wizard).Do(delegate(Wizard x)
			{
				x.GoToPage(e.Parameter);
			});
		}

		private static void OnNextCommand(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as Wizard).Do(delegate(Wizard x)
			{
				x.OnNext(e.Parameter);
			});
		}
	}

	internal class WizardPageViewModel : DependencyObject, ISupportWizardFinishCommand, ISupportWizardNextCommand, ISupportWizardBackCommand, ISupportWizardCancelCommand, ISupportCustomNavigation, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty CanCancelProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CanFinishProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CanGoBackProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CanGoForwardProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContextProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NextPageProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PreviousPageProperty;

		public bool CanCancel

		public bool CanFinish

			}

		public bool CanGoBack
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(CanGoBackProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CanGoBackProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool CanGoForward
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(CanGoForwardProperty);
			}
			set

				SetValue(CanGoForwardProperty, value);
			}

		public object Context

				SetValue(PreviousPageProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public WizardPage Owner { get; private set; }

		bool ISupportWizardFinishCommand.CanFinish => (Context as ISupportWizardFinishCommand).Return((ISupportWizardFinishCommand x) => x.CanFinish, () => CanFinish);

		bool ISupportWizardBackCommand.CanGoBack => (Context as ISupportWizardBackCommand).Return((ISupportWizardBackCommand x) => x.CanGoBack, () => CanGoBack);

		bool ISupportWizardNextCommand.CanGoForward => (Context as ISupportWizardNextCommand).Return((ISupportWizardNextCommand x) => x.CanGoForward, () => CanGoForward);

		bool ISupportWizardCancelCommand.CanCancel => (Context as ISupportWizardCancelCommand).Return((ISupportWizardCancelCommand x) => x.CanCancel, () => CanCancel);

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		static WizardPageViewModel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<WizardPageViewModel>.New().Register<bool>("CanCancel", ref CanCancelProperty, false, (Action<WizardPageViewModel, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(WizardPageViewModel d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				d.RaisePropertyChanged(e);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<bool>("CanFinish", ref CanFinishProperty, false, (Action<WizardPageViewModel, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(WizardPageViewModel d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				d.RaisePropertyChanged(e);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("CanGoBack", ref CanGoBackProperty, false, (Action<WizardPageViewModel, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(WizardPageViewModel d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.RaisePropertyChanged(e);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("CanGoForward", ref CanGoForwardProperty, false, (Action<WizardPageViewModel, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(WizardPageViewModel d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.RaisePropertyChanged(e);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<object>("Context", ref ContextProperty, (object)null, (Action<WizardPageViewModel, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(WizardPageViewModel d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					d.OnContextChanged(e.OldValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<object>("NextPage", ref NextPageProperty, (object)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<object>("PreviousPage", ref PreviousPageProperty, (object)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		private static void SetBinding(DependencyObject target, DependencyProperty targetProperty, object source, DependencyProperty sourceProperty)
		{
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(target, targetProperty, new Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath(sourceProperty),
				Source = source
			});
		}

		public WizardPageViewModel(WizardPage owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
			SetBinding(this, CanCancelProperty, Owner, WizardPage.AllowCancelProperty);
			SetBinding(this, CanFinishProperty, Owner, WizardPage.AllowFinishProperty);
			SetBinding(this, CanGoBackProperty, Owner, WizardPage.AllowBackProperty);
			SetBinding(this, CanGoForwardProperty, Owner, WizardPage.AllowNextProperty);
			SetBinding(this, ContextProperty, Owner, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
			SetBinding(this, NextPageProperty, Owner, WizardPage.NextPageProperty);
			SetBinding(this, PreviousPageProperty, Owner, WizardPage.PreviousPageProperty);
		}

		private void OnContextChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			(oldValue as INotifyPropertyChanged).Do(delegate(INotifyPropertyChanged x)
			{
				x.PropertyChanged -= OnContextPropertyChanged;
			});
			(Context as INotifyPropertyChanged).Do(delegate(INotifyPropertyChanged x)
			{
				x.PropertyChanged += OnContextPropertyChanged;
			});
		}

		private void OnContextPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyName((ISupportWizardNextCommand x) => x.CanGoForward))
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged(e.PropertyName);
			}
			else if (e.PropertyName == ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyName((ISupportWizardFinishCommand x) => x.CanFinish))
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged(e.PropertyName);
			}
			else if (e.PropertyName == ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyName((ISupportWizardCancelCommand x) => x.CanCancel))
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged(e.PropertyName);
			}
			else if (e.PropertyName == ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyName((ISupportWizardBackCommand x) => x.CanGoBack))
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged(e.PropertyName);
			}
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged(e.Property.Name);
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string name)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
		}

		void ISupportWizardFinishCommand.OnFinish(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			(Context as ISupportWizardFinishCommand).Do(delegate(ISupportWizardFinishCommand x)
			{
				x.OnFinish(e);
			});
		}

		void ISupportWizardBackCommand.OnGoBack(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			(Context as ISupportWizardBackCommand).Do(delegate(ISupportWizardBackCommand x)
			{
				x.OnGoBack(e);
			});
		}

		void ISupportWizardNextCommand.OnGoForward(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			(Context as ISupportWizardNextCommand).Do(delegate(ISupportWizardNextCommand x)
			{
				x.OnGoForward(e);
			});
		}

		void ISupportWizardCancelCommand.OnCancel(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			(Context as ISupportWizardCancelCommand).Do(delegate(ISupportWizardCancelCommand x)
			{
				x.OnCancel(e);
			});
		}
	}

		internal void OnNavigatedFrom()
		{
			if (visibilityCache.HasValue)
			{
				visibilityLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetCurrentValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, (object)visibilityCache.Value);
				});
				visibilityCache = null;
			}
		}

		internal void OnNavigatedTo()
		{
			if (((UIElement)(object)this).Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
			{
				visibilityCache = ((UIElement)(object)this).Visibility;
				visibilityLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetCurrentValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, (object)Visibility.Visible);
				});
			}
		}

		protected override void OnHeaderChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.OnHeaderChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			UpdateIsHeaderVisible();
		}

		protected override void OnHeaderTemplateChanged(DataTemplate oldValue, DataTemplate newValue)
		{
			base.OnHeaderTemplateChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			UpdateIsHeaderVisible();
		}

		protected override void OnHeaderTemplateSelectorChanged(DataTemplateSelector oldValue, DataTemplateSelector newValue)
		{
			base.OnHeaderTemplateSelectorChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			UpdateIsHeaderVisible();
		}

		protected virtual void OnShowPropertyChanged()
		{
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).CoerceValue(ActualButtonsProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnTitleChanged(string oldValue, string newValue)
		{
			UpdateIsHeaderVisible();
		}

		protected override void OnVisibilityChanged(Visibility oldValue, Visibility newValue)
		{
			((SelectorItemBase<Wizard, WizardPage>)(object)this).OnVisibilityChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (!Locker.op_Implicit(visibilityLocker))
			{
				visibilityCache = newValue;
			}
		}

		private WizardButtons CoerceActualButtons(WizardButtons value)
		{
			WizardButtons wizardButtons = WizardButtons.None;
			if (ShowBack)
			{
				wizardButtons |= WizardButtons.Back;
			}
			if (ShowCancel)
			{
				wizardButtons |= WizardButtons.Cancel;
			}
			if (ShowFinish)
			{
				wizardButtons |= WizardButtons.Finish;
			}
			if (ShowNext)
			{
				wizardButtons |= WizardButtons.Next;
			}
			return wizardButtons;
		}

		private void UpdateIsHeaderVisible()
		{
			IsHeaderVisible = base.Header != null || base.HeaderTemplate != null || base.HeaderTemplateSelector != null || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Title);
		}
	}

			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0075: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00af: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			MINMAXINFO structure = (MINMAXINFO)Marshal.PtrToStructure(lParam, typeof(MINMAXINFO));
			int flags = 2;
			IntPtr intPtr = MonitorFromWindow(hwnd, flags);
			if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				MONITORINFO mONITORINFO = new MONITORINFO();
				GetMonitorInfo(intPtr, mONITORINFO);
				RECT rcWork = mONITORINFO.rcWork;
				RECT rcMonitor = mONITORINFO.rcMonitor;
				structure.ptMaxPosition.x = Math.Abs(rcWork.left - rcMonitor.left);
				structure.ptMaxPosition.y = Math.Abs(rcWork.top - rcMonitor.top);
				structure.ptMinTrackSize.x = 0;
				structure.ptMinTrackSize.y = 0;
				structure.ptMaxSize.x = Math.Abs(rcWork.right - rcWork.left);
				structure.ptMaxSize.y = Math.Abs(rcWork.bottom - rcWork.top);
			}

		}

		private void UpdateContainers(DataTemplate oldItemFooterTemplate, DataTemplateSelector oldItemFooterTemplateSelector, string oldItemFooterStringFormat)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ItemsControl)(object)this).Items.Count; i++)
			{
				TItem container = base.GetContainer(i);
				if (container != null)
				{
					if (container.FooterTemplate == oldItemFooterTemplate)
					{
						container.FooterTemplate = ItemFooterTemplate;
					}
					if (container.FooterTemplateSelector == oldItemFooterTemplateSelector)
					{
						container.FooterTemplateSelector = ItemFooterTemplateSelector;
					}
					if (container.FooterStringFormat == oldItemFooterStringFormat)
					{
						container.FooterStringFormat = ItemFooterStringFormat;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			TItem val = (TItem)(FooteredSelectorItemBase<TContainer, TItem>)(object)element;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)(object)val;
			if (!(item is Visual) && !DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)(object)val, FooteredSelectorItemBase<TContainer, TItem>.FooterProperty))
			{
				val.Footer = item;
			}
			if (ItemFooterTemplate != null && !DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)(object)val, FooteredSelectorItemBase<TContainer, TItem>.FooterTemplateProperty))
			{
				val.FooterTemplate = ItemFooterTemplate;
			}
			if (ItemFooterTemplateSelector != null && !DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)(object)val, FooteredSelectorItemBase<TContainer, TItem>.FooterTemplateSelectorProperty))
			{
				val.FooterTemplateSelector = ItemFooterTemplateSelector;
			}
			if (ItemFooterStringFormat != null && !DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)(object)val, FooteredSelectorItemBase<TContainer, TItem>.FooterStringFormatProperty))
			{
				val.FooterStringFormat = ItemFooterStringFormat;
			}
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
		}

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			TItem val = (TItem)(FooteredSelectorItemBase<TContainer, TItem>)(object)element;
			if (val.Footer == item)
			{
				val.Footer = null;
			}
			base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
		}

		protected override void UpdateSelectionProperties()
		{
			base.UpdateSelectionProperties();
			if (!base.IsIndexInRange(base.SelectedIndex))
			{
				SelectedItemFooter = null;
				SelectedItemFooterTemplate = null;
				SelectedItemFooterTemplateSelector = null;
				SelectedItemFooterStringFormat = null;
				return;
			}
			TItem selectedContainer = base.SelectedContainer;
			if (selectedContainer != null)
			{
				SelectedItemFooter = selectedContainer.Footer;
				if (selectedContainer.FooterTemplate != null || selectedContainer.FooterTemplateSelector != null || selectedContainer.FooterStringFormat != null)
				{
					SelectedItemFooterTemplate = selectedContainer.FooterTemplate;
					SelectedItemFooterTemplateSelector = selectedContainer.FooterTemplateSelector;
					SelectedItemFooterStringFormat = selectedContainer.FooterStringFormat;
				}
				else
				{
					SelectedItemFooterTemplate = ItemFooterTemplate;
					SelectedItemFooterTemplateSelector = ItemFooterTemplateSelector;
					SelectedItemFooterStringFormat = ItemFooterStringFormat;
				}
			}
		}

				return (string)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(CommandPropertyNameProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(CommandPropertyNameProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		private WizardControl Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			set
			{
				if (owner != value)
				{
					WizardControl oldValue = owner;
					owner = value;
					OnOwnerChanged(oldValue, value);
				}
			}
		}

		private DelegateCommand Command
		{
			get
			{
				return command;
			}
			set
			{
				if (command != value)
				{
					DelegateCommand oldValue = command;
					command = value;
					OnCommandChanged(oldValue, value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			Owner = FindOwner();
			if (Owner == null)
			{
				SubsribeAssociatedObject(base.AssociatedObject);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			UnsubsribeAssociatedObject(base.AssociatedObject);
			Command = null;
			Owner = null;
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
		}

		private void SubsribeAssociatedObject(object obj)
		{
			FrameworkElement input = obj as FrameworkElement;
			FrameworkContentElement input2 = obj as FrameworkContentElement;
			input.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
			{
				x.Loaded += OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			});
			input.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
			{
				x.LayoutUpdated += OnAssociatedObjectLayoutUpdated;
			});
			input2.Do(delegate(FrameworkContentElement x)
			{
				x.Loaded += OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			});
		}

		private void UnsubsribeAssociatedObject(object obj)
		{
			FrameworkElement input = obj as FrameworkElement;
			FrameworkContentElement input2 = obj as FrameworkContentElement;
			input.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
			{
				x.Loaded -= OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			});
			input.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
			{
				x.LayoutUpdated -= OnAssociatedObjectLayoutUpdated;
			});
			input2.Do(delegate(FrameworkContentElement x)
			{
				x.Loaded -= OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			});
		}

		private void OnAssociatedObjectLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			Owner = FindOwner();
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				UnsubsribeAssociatedObject(base.AssociatedObject);
			}
		}

		private void OnAssociatedObjectLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Owner = FindOwner();
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				UnsubsribeAssociatedObject(base.AssociatedObject);
			}
		}

		private void OnOwnerChanged(WizardControl oldValue, WizardControl newValue)
		{
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.Do(delegate(WizardControl x)
				{
					//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
					x.SelectionChanged -= new SelectorSelectionChangedEventHandler(OnOwnerSelectionChanged);
				});
				newValue.Do(delegate(WizardControl x)
				{
					//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
					x.SelectionChanged += new SelectorSelectionChangedEventHandler(OnOwnerSelectionChanged);
				});
				oldValue.Do(delegate(WizardControl x)
				{
					((SelectorBase<WizardControl, WizardItem>)x).ItemsChanged -= OnOwnerItemsChanged;
				});
				newValue.Do(delegate(WizardControl x)
				{
					((SelectorBase<WizardControl, WizardItem>)x).ItemsChanged += OnOwnerItemsChanged;
				});
				Command = new DelegateCommand(OnCommandExecute, OnCommandCanExecute, false);
			}
		}

		private void OnOwnerSelectionChanged(object sender, SelectorSelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Command.Do(delegate(DelegateCommand x)
			{
				x.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			});
		}

		private void OnOwnerItemsChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Command.Do(delegate(DelegateCommand x)
			{
				x.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			});
		}

		private void OnCommandChanged(DelegateCommand oldValue, DelegateCommand newValue)
		{
			Type type = base.AssociatedObject.GetType();
			PropertyInfo property = type.GetProperty(CommandPropertyName, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.SetProperty);
			if (!(property == null))
			{
				property.SetValue(base.AssociatedObject, newValue, null);
			}
		}

		private void OnCommandExecute()
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				if (ButtonType == WizardButtonKind.Back)
				{
					Owner.Back();
				}
				else if (ButtonType == WizardButtonKind.Next)
				{
					Owner.Next();
				}
				else if (ButtonType == WizardButtonKind.Cancel)
				{
					Owner.Cancel();
				}
				else if (ButtonType == WizardButtonKind.Finish)
				{
					Owner.Finish();
				}
				else if (ButtonType == WizardButtonKind.NavigateTo)
				{
					Owner.NavigateTo(WizardControl.GetIsButtonNavigateTo(base.AssociatedObject));
				}
			}
		}

		private bool OnCommandCanExecute()
		{
			if (Owner == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ButtonType == WizardButtonKind.Back)
			{
				return Owner.CanBack();
			}
			if (ButtonType == WizardButtonKind.Next)
			{
				return Owner.CanNext();
			}
			if (ButtonType == WizardButtonKind.Cancel)
			{
				return Owner.CanCancel();
			}
			if (ButtonType == WizardButtonKind.Finish)
			{
				return Owner.CanFinish();
			}
			if (ButtonType == WizardButtonKind.NavigateTo)
			{
				return Owner.CanNavigateTo(WizardControl.GetIsButtonNavigateTo(base.AssociatedObject));
			}
			return true;
		}

		private WizardControl FindOwner()
		{
			return LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualParents(base.AssociatedObject, (DependencyObject)null).OfType<WizardControl>().FirstOrDefault();
		}
	}

		private static void OnIsWizardButtonChanged(DependencyObject sender, bool oldValue, bool newValue, WizardButtonKind buttonType)
		{
			if (!newValue)
			{
				List<WizardButtonBehavior> list = ((IEnumerable)Interaction.GetBehaviors(sender)).OfType<WizardButtonBehavior>().ToList();
				list.ForEach(delegate(WizardButtonBehavior x)
				{
					((FreezableCollection<Behavior>)(object)Interaction.GetBehaviors(sender)).Remove((Behavior)(object)x);
				});
			}
			else
			{
				WizardButtonBehavior value = new WizardButtonBehavior
				{
					ButtonType = buttonType
				};
				((FreezableCollection<Behavior>)(object)Interaction.GetBehaviors(sender)).Add((Behavior)(object)value);
			}
		}

		public void Finish()
		{
			if (CanFinish())
			{
				OwnerService.Do(delegate(WizardService x)

					x.SetResult(WizardResult.Finish);
				});
				OwnerService.Do(delegate
				{
					Window.GetWindow((DependencyObject)(object)this).Close();
				});
			}
		}

		}
