		public void NavigateTo(object id)
		{
			if (CanNavigateTo(id))
			{
				object itemBasedOnId = GetItemBasedOnId(id);
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetCurrentValue(SelectorBase<WizardControl, WizardItem>.SelectedItemProperty, itemBasedOnId);
			}
		}

		public bool CanNavigateTo(object id)
		{
			object itemBasedOnId = GetItemBasedOnId(id);
			if (itemBasedOnId == null || ((SelectorBase<WizardControl, WizardItem>)this).SelectedItem == itemBasedOnId)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private object GetItemBasedOnId(object id)
		{
			if (((ItemsControl)(object)this).Items.Contains(id))
			{
				return id;
			}
			WizardItem wizardItem = null;
			if (id is WizardItem)
			{
				wizardItem = (WizardItem)id;
			}
			if (id is string)
			{
				wizardItem = ((SelectorBase<WizardControl, WizardItem>)this).GetContainers().FirstOrDefault((WizardItem x) => ((FrameworkElement)(object)x).Name == (string)id);
			}
			if (wizardItem == null)
			{
				wizardItem = ((SelectorBase<WizardControl, WizardItem>)this).GetContainers().FirstOrDefault((WizardItem x) => ((FrameworkElement)(object)x).DataContext == id);
			}
			if (wizardItem == null)
			{
				wizardItem = ((SelectorBase<WizardControl, WizardItem>)this).GetContainers().FirstOrDefault((WizardItem x) => ((ContentControl)(object)x).Content == id);
			}
			if (wizardItem != null)
			{
				if (!((ItemsControl)(object)this).Items.Contains(wizardItem))
				{
					return ((ItemsControl)(object)this).ItemContainerGenerator.ItemFromContainer((DependencyObject)(object)wizardItem);
				}
				return wizardItem;
			}
			return null;
		}

	{

		void Back();

		void Next();

		void Finish();

		void Cancel();

	public class WizardService : DialogService, IWizardService2
	{
		private WizardResult Result;

		private WizardControl WizardControl { get; set; }

		WizardResult IWizardService2.ShowDialog(string title, string documentType, object viewModel, object parameter, object parentViewModel)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)((ViewServiceBase)this).CreateAndInitializeView(documentType, viewModel, parameter, parentViewModel, (IDocumentOwner)this);
			frameworkElement.Loaded += OnViewLoaded;
			((DialogService)this).ShowDialog((IEnumerable<UICommand>)null, title, (object)frameworkElement);
			return Result;
		}

		private void OnViewLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)sender;
			frameworkElement.Loaded -= OnViewLoaded;
			WizardControl = LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualChildren((DependencyObject)frameworkElement).OfType<WizardControl>().FirstOrDefault();
			WizardControl.Do(delegate(WizardControl x)
			{
				x.OwnerService = this;
			});
		}

		protected override void OnDialogWindowClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((DialogService)this).OnDialogWindowClosed(sender, e);
			WizardControl.Do(delegate(WizardControl x)
			{
				x.OwnerService = null;
			});
			WizardControl = null;
		}

		internal void SetResult(WizardResult result)
		{
			Result = result;
		}

		void IWizardService2.Back()
		{
			WizardControl.Do(delegate(WizardControl x)
			{
				x.Back();
			});
		}

		void IWizardService2.Next()
		{
			WizardControl.Do(delegate(WizardControl x)
			{
				x.Next();
			});
		}

		void IWizardService2.Finish()
		{
			WizardControl.Do(delegate(WizardControl x)
			{
				x.Finish();
			});
		}

		void IWizardService2.Cancel()
		{
			WizardControl.Do(delegate(WizardControl x)
			{
				x.Cancel();
			});
		}

		void IWizardService2.NavigateTo(object id)
		{
			WizardControl.Do(delegate(WizardControl x)
			{
				x.NavigateTo(id);
			});
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			UpdateAssociatedObject();
			if (wizard == null)
			{
				SubsribeAssociatedObject(base.AssociatedObject);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			UnsubsribeAssociatedObject(base.AssociatedObject);
			Command = null;
			wizard = null;
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
		}

		private Wizard FindWizard()
		{
			return LinqExtensions.Unfold(base.AssociatedObject, (DependencyObject x) => LayoutHelper.GetParent(x, true), (DependencyObject x) => x == null).OfType<Wizard>().FirstOrDefault();
		}

		private void OnAssociatedObjectLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateAssociatedObject();
			if (wizard != null)
			{
				UnsubsribeAssociatedObject(base.AssociatedObject);
			}
		}

		private void OnAssociatedObjectLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateAssociatedObject();
			if (wizard != null)
			{
				UnsubsribeAssociatedObject(base.AssociatedObject);
			}
		}

		private void OnCommandChanged()
		{
			Type type = base.AssociatedObject.GetType();
			PropertyInfo property = type.GetProperty(CommandPropertyName, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.SetProperty);
			if (!(property == null))
			{
				property.SetValue(base.AssociatedObject, Command, null);
				PropertyInfo property2 = type.GetProperty(CommandTargetPropertyName, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.SetProperty);
				if (!(property2 == null))
				{
					property2.SetValue(base.AssociatedObject, wizard, null);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RegisterButton()
		{
			if (wizard != null)
			{
				wizard.RegisterWizardButton(base.AssociatedObject);
			}
		}

		private void SubsribeAssociatedObject(object obj)
		{
			FrameworkElement input = obj as FrameworkElement;
			FrameworkContentElement input2 = obj as FrameworkContentElement;
			input.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
			{
				x.Loaded += OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			});
			input.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
			{
				x.LayoutUpdated += OnAssociatedObjectLayoutUpdated;
			});
			input2.Do(delegate(FrameworkContentElement x)
			{
				x.Loaded += OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			});
		}

		private void UnsubsribeAssociatedObject(object obj)
		{
			FrameworkElement input = obj as FrameworkElement;
			FrameworkContentElement input2 = obj as FrameworkContentElement;
			input.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
			{
				x.Loaded -= OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			});
			input.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
			{
				x.LayoutUpdated -= OnAssociatedObjectLayoutUpdated;
			});
			input2.Do(delegate(FrameworkContentElement x)
			{
				x.Loaded -= OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			});
		}

		private void UpdateAssociatedObject()
		{
			wizard = FindWizard();
			RegisterButton();
			UpdateCommand();
			UpdateVisibility();
		}

		private void UpdateCommand()
		{
			Command = ((wizard == null) ? null : WizardCommands.GetCommand(ButtonType));
		}

		private void UpdateVisibility()
		{
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (base.AssociatedObject is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				if (wizard == null)
				{
					uIElement.ClearValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
					return;
				}
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(uIElement, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, new Binding($"Is{ButtonType}ButtonVisible")
				{
					Source = wizard,
					Converter = (IValueConverter)new BoolToVisibilityConverter()
				});
			}
		}
	}

	}
	public class WizardController : ViewModelBase
	{
		private readonly Func<ICurrentDialogService> getCurrentDialogServiceCallback;

		private readonly Func<INavigationService> getNavigationServiceCallback;

		private readonly object parameter;

		private object _current;

		private ICommand backCommand;

		private ICommand<CancelEventArgs> cancelCommand;

		private ICommand<CancelEventArgs> finishCommand;

		private ICommand<object> navigateToCommand;

		private ICommand<string> navigateToPageCommand;

		private ICommand nextCommand;

		private DelegateCommand onLoadedCommand;

		private object startPageViewModel;

		private string startPageViewType;

		public ICommand BackCommand
		{
			get
			{
				return backCommand;
			}
			private set
			{
				SetProperty(ref backCommand, value, () => BackCommand);
			}
		}

		public ICommand<CancelEventArgs> CancelCommand
		{
			get
			{
				return cancelCommand;
			}
			private set
			{
				SetProperty(ref cancelCommand, value, () => CancelCommand);
			}
		}

		public object CurrentPage => GetCurrentPage();

		public ICommand<CancelEventArgs> FinishCommand
		{
			get
			{
				return finishCommand;
			}
			private set
			{
				SetProperty(ref finishCommand, value, () => FinishCommand);
			}
		}

		public ICommand<object> NavigateToCommand
		{
			get
			{
				return navigateToCommand;
			}
			private set
			{
				SetProperty(ref navigateToCommand, value, () => NavigateToCommand);
			}
		}

		public ICommand<string> NavigateToPageCommand
		{
			get
			{
				return navigateToPageCommand;
			}
			private set
			{
				SetProperty(ref navigateToPageCommand, value, () => NavigateToPageCommand);
			}
		}

		public ICommand NextCommand
		{
			get
			{
				return nextCommand;
			}
			private set
			{
				SetProperty(ref nextCommand, value, () => NextCommand);
			}
		}

		public ICommand OnLoadedCommand => onLoadedCommand ?? (onLoadedCommand = new DelegateCommand(OnLoaded));

		internal object WizardViewModel { get; private set; }

		internal IWizardService WizardService { get; set; }

		protected virtual bool CloseWindowOnCancelClick => true;

		protected virtual bool CloseWindowOnFinishClick => true;

		protected object Current
		{
			get
			{
				return _current;
			}
			private set
			{
				SetProperty(ref _current, value, () => Current, OnCurrentChanged);
			}
		}

		protected ICurrentDialogService CurrentDialogService => getCurrentDialogServiceCallback();

		protected internal object CurrentContainer { get; private set; }

		protected bool IsInitialized => getNavigationServiceCallback != null;

		protected INavigationService NavigationService => getNavigationServiceCallback();

		public WizardController(object viewModel, object parameter)
			: this(null, null, parameter)
		{
			GuardHelper.ArgumentNotNull(viewModel, "viewModel");
			this.SetParentViewModel(viewModel);
			getNavigationServiceCallback = () => GetServiceFromViewModel<INavigationService>(viewModel);
			getCurrentDialogServiceCallback = () => GetServiceFromViewModel<ICurrentDialogService>(viewModel);
			Initialize();
		}

		public WizardController(string startPageViewType, object startPageViewModel, object parameter)
		{
			if (startPageViewType != null && startPageViewModel != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			this.startPageViewType = startPageViewType;
			this.startPageViewModel = startPageViewModel;
			this.parameter = parameter;
			getNavigationServiceCallback = () => GetServiceFromViewModel<INavigationService>(this);
			getCurrentDialogServiceCallback = () => GetServiceFromViewModel<ICurrentDialogService>(this);
		}

		public WizardController(Func<INavigationService> getNavigationServiceCallback, Func<ICurrentDialogService> getCurrentDialogServiceCallback, object parameter, object parentViewModel)
			: this(null, null, parameter)
		{
			GuardHelper.ArgumentNotNull(getNavigationServiceCallback, "getNavigationServiceCallback");
			GuardHelper.ArgumentNotNull(getCurrentDialogServiceCallback, "getCurrentDialogServiceCallback");
			this.SetParentViewModel(parentViewModel);
			this.getNavigationServiceCallback = getNavigationServiceCallback;
			this.getCurrentDialogServiceCallback = getCurrentDialogServiceCallback;
			Initialize();
		}

		public void Back()
		{
			Back(null);
		}

		public virtual void Back(object parameter)
		{
			AssertIsInitialized();
			CancelEventArgs args = new CancelEventArgs();
			(WizardViewModel as ISupportWizardBackCommand).Do(delegate(ISupportWizardBackCommand x)
			{
				x.OnGoBack(args);
			});
			if (!args.Cancel)
			{
				NavigationService.GoBack(parameter);
			}
		}

		public bool CanBack()
		{
			AssertIsInitialized();
			if (WizardViewModel is ISupportWizardBackCommand { CanGoBack: false })
			{
				return false;
			}
			return NavigationService.CanGoBack;
		}

		public bool CanCancel(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			AssertIsInitialized();
			if (WizardViewModel is ISupportWizardCancelCommand supportWizardCancelCommand)
			{
				return supportWizardCancelCommand.CanCancel;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Cancel(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			AssertIsInitialized();
			ISupportWizardCancelCommand supportWizardCancelCommand = WizardViewModel as ISupportWizardCancelCommand;
			CancelEventArgs e2 = e ?? new CancelEventArgs();
			supportWizardCancelCommand?.OnCancel(e2);
			if (e == null && !e2.Cancel && CloseWindowOnCancelClick)
			{
				CurrentDialogService.Close(MessageResult.Cancel);
			}
		}

		public bool CanFinish(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			AssertIsInitialized();
			if (WizardViewModel is ISupportWizardFinishCommand supportWizardFinishCommand)
			{
				return supportWizardFinishCommand.CanFinish;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool CanNext()
		{
			AssertIsInitialized();
			if (WizardViewModel is ISupportWizardNextCommand { CanGoForward: false })
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!NavigationService.CanGoForward)
			{
				return WizardService != null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Finish(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			AssertIsInitialized();
			ISupportWizardFinishCommand supportWizardFinishCommand = WizardViewModel as ISupportWizardFinishCommand;
			CancelEventArgs e2 = e ?? new CancelEventArgs();
			supportWizardFinishCommand?.OnFinish(e2);
			if (e == null && !e2.Cancel && CloseWindowOnFinishClick)
			{
				CurrentDialogService.Close(MessageResult.OK);
			}
		}

		public virtual void Navigate(string viewType, object viewModel, object parameter, object parentViewModel)
		{
			AssertIsInitialized();
			NavigationService.Navigate(viewType, viewModel, parameter, parentViewModel, saveToJournal: true);
		}

		public void NavigateTo(object pageViewModel)
		{
			AssertIsInitialized();
			NavigateToOverride(pageViewModel);
		}

		public void NavigateToPage(string page)
		{
			NavigateToPage(page, null);
		}

		public virtual void NavigateToPage(string page, object parameter)
		{
			AssertIsInitialized();
			CancelEventArgs args = new CancelEventArgs();
			(WizardViewModel as ISupportWizardNextCommand).Do(delegate(ISupportWizardNextCommand x)
			{
				x.OnGoForward(args);
			});
			if (!args.Cancel)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(page))
				{
					NavigationService.GoForward(parameter);
				}
				else
				{
					NavigationService.Navigate(page, parameter);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void NavigateToPage(string page, object pageViewModel, object parameter)
		{
			AssertIsInitialized();
			NavigationService.Navigate(page, pageViewModel, parameter, this, saveToJournal: true);
		}

		public void Next()
		{
			Next(null);
		}

		public void Next(object parameter)
		{
			NavigateToPage(null, parameter);
		}

		internal virtual object CreateContainerForView(object view)
		{
			return view;
		}

		protected static T GetServiceFromViewModel<T>(object viewModel) where T : class
		{
			GuardHelper.ArgumentNotNull(viewModel, "viewModel");
			return GuardHelper.ArgumentMatchType<ISupportServices>(viewModel, "viewModel").ServiceContainer.GetRequiredService<T>();
		}

		protected void AssertIsInitialized()
		{
			if (!IsInitialized)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		protected virtual object GetCurrentPage()
		{
			return ViewHelper.GetViewModelFromView(CurrentContainer);
		}

		protected virtual object GetWizardViewModel()
		{
			return ViewHelper.GetViewModelFromView(CurrentContainer);
		}

		protected void Initialize()
		{
			NavigateToPageCommand = new DelegateCommand<string>(NavigateToPage);
			NavigateToCommand = new DelegateCommand<object>(NavigateTo);
			NextCommand = new DelegateCommand(Next, CanNext);
			FinishCommand = new DelegateCommand<CancelEventArgs>(Finish, CanFinish);
			BackCommand = new DelegateCommand(Back, CanBack);
			CancelCommand = new DelegateCommand<CancelEventArgs>(Cancel, CanCancel);
			INavigationService navigationService = NavigationService;
			navigationService.CurrentChanged += OnNavigationServiceCurrentChanged;
			navigationService.CanGoBackChanged += OnNavigationServiceCanGoBackChanged;
			navigationService.CanGoForwardChanged += OnNavigationServiceCanGoForwardChanged;
			if (startPageViewType != null)
			{
				NavigateToPage(startPageViewType);
				startPageViewType = null;
			}
			else if (startPageViewModel != null)
			{
				NavigateTo(startPageViewModel);
				startPageViewModel = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void NavigateToOverride(object pageViewModel)
		{
			NavigationService.Navigate(pageViewModel, parameter, this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnCurrentChanged()
		{
			CurrentContainer = CreateContainerForView(Current);
			object wizardViewModel = WizardViewModel;
			WizardViewModel = GetWizardViewModel();
			OnCurrentPageChanged(wizardViewModel);
		}

		protected virtual void OnCurrentPageChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue is INotifyPropertyChanged notifyPropertyChanged)
			{
				notifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged -= OnPagePropertyChanged;
			}
			if (WizardViewModel is INotifyPropertyChanged notifyPropertyChanged2)
			{
				notifyPropertyChanged2.PropertyChanged += OnPagePropertyChanged;
			}
			UpdateNextCommand();
			UpdateFinishCommand();
			UpdateBackCommand();
			UpdateCancelCommand();
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded()
		{
			Initialize();
		}

		private void OnNavigationServiceCanGoBackChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateBackCommand();
		}

		private void OnNavigationServiceCanGoForwardChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateNextCommand();
		}

		private void OnNavigationServiceCurrentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Current = NavigationService.Current;
		}

		private void OnPagePropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyName((ISupportWizardNextCommand x) => x.CanGoForward))
			{
				UpdateNextCommand();
			}
			else if (e.PropertyName == ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyName((ISupportWizardFinishCommand x) => x.CanFinish))
			{
				UpdateFinishCommand();
			}
			else if (e.PropertyName == ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyName((ISupportWizardCancelCommand x) => x.CanCancel))
			{
				UpdateCancelCommand();
			}
			else if (e.PropertyName == ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyName((ISupportWizardBackCommand x) => x.CanGoBack))
			{
				UpdateBackCommand();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateBackCommand()
		{
			((DelegateCommand)BackCommand).RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
		}

		private void UpdateCancelCommand()
		{
			((DelegateCommand<CancelEventArgs>)CancelCommand).RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
		}

		private void UpdateFinishCommand()
		{
			((DelegateCommand<CancelEventArgs>)FinishCommand).RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
		}

		private void UpdateNextCommand()
		{
			((DelegateCommand)NextCommand).RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
		}
	}
}

		protected virtual void OnCommandChanged(ICommand oldValue, ICommand newValue)
		{
			SetValue(HasCommandPropertyKey, newValue != null);
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				UnhookCommand(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				HookCommand(newValue);
			}
		}

		private void UnhookCommand(ICommand command)
		{
			command.CanExecuteChanged -= OnCanExecuteChanged;
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private void HookCommand(ICommand command)
		{
			command.CanExecuteChanged += OnCanExecuteChanged;
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private void OnCanExecuteChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private void UpdateCanExecute()
		{
			CanExecute = Command == null || CommandHelper.CanExecuteCommand(this);
		}

		protected override ControlControllerBase CreateController()
		{
			return (ControlControllerBase)(object)new ButtonBaseController((IControl)(object)this);
		}

		protected virtual void InvokeCommand()
		{
			CommandHelper.ExecuteCommand(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnClick()
		{
			InvokeCommand();
		}

		void IClickableControl.OnClick()
		{
			OnClick();
		}
	}

	public class ClickableController : ControlControllerBase
	{
		protected virtual bool FocusOnMouseDown => false;

		protected virtual bool FocusOnMouseUp => false;

		private IClickableControl IClickableControl => ((ControlControllerBase)this).Control as IClickableControl;

		protected bool ClickOnMouseDown { get; set; }

		public event EventHandler Click;

		public ClickableController(IControl control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		public void InvokeClick()
		{
			OnClick();
		}

		protected virtual void OnClick()
		{
			if (this.Click != null)
			{
				this.Click(((ControlControllerBase)this).Control, new RoutedEventArgs());
			}
			if (IClickableControl != null)
			{
				IClickableControl.OnClick();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(DXMouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (FocusOnMouseDown)
			{
				((ControlControllerBase)this).Control.Focus();
			}
			if (ClickOnMouseDown)
			{
				OnClick();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			if (((Controller)this).CaptureMouseOnDown)
			{
				((ControlControllerBase)this).Control.CaptureMouse();
			}
			((Controller)this).OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(DXMouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e != null && e.Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = ((Controller)this).IsMouseLeftButtonDown && ((Controller)this).IsMouseEntered && !ClickOnMouseDown;
			((Controller)this).OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			if (flag && ((ControlControllerBase)this).Control.IsMouseOver)
			{
				if (FocusOnMouseUp)
				{
					((ControlControllerBase)this).Control.Focus();
				}
				OnClick();
				if (e != null)
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal interface IClickableControl : IClickable
	{
		void OnClick();
	}

	public class FlyoutAdornerControl : FlyoutControl
	{
		private FlyoutAdornerContentControl flyoutAdornerContentControl;

		static FlyoutAdornerControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<FlyoutAdornerControl>();
		}

		public FlyoutAdornerControl()
		{
			((FlyoutBase)this).AllowOutOfScreen = true;
			((FlyoutBase)this).AllowMoveAnimation = false;
		}

		protected override FlyoutContainer GetFlyoutContainer()
		{
			if (flyoutAdornerContentControl != null)
			{
				flyoutAdornerContentControl.IsOpen = false;
			}
			flyoutAdornerContentControl = ((FrameworkElement)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_Popup") as FlyoutAdornerContentControl;
			return (FlyoutContainer)(object)new AdornerFlyoutContainer
			{
				FlyoutAdornerContentControl = flyoutAdornerContentControl
			};
		}

		protected override void UpdatePopupLocation(System.Windows.Point location)
		{
			if (!((FlyoutBase)this).IsPopupVisible || !((FlyoutBase)this).IsValid(location) || !(((FrameworkElement)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_cc") is FrameworkElement frameworkElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Point location2 = ((FlyoutBase)this).GetTransformedRect(new Rect(((FlyoutBase)this).NormalizeToScreenOrigin(location), new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0)), false).Location;
			FrameworkElement topLevelVisual = LayoutHelper.GetTopLevelVisual((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			if (topLevelVisual != null)
			{
				location2 = TransformToDeviceDPI(topLevelVisual, location2);
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = (LayoutHelper.GetTopContainerWithAdornerLayer((UIElement)Window.GetWindow((DependencyObject)(object)this)) as FrameworkElement) ?? topLevelVisual;
				System.Windows.Point point = frameworkElement2.PointFromScreen(location2);
				double num = ((frameworkElement2.FlowDirection == ((FrameworkElement)this).FlowDirection) ? point.X : (frameworkElement2.ActualWidth - point.X));
				MatrixTransform transform = ((Visual)this).TransformToVisual((Visual)topLevelVisual) as MatrixTransform;
				Matrix matrix = transform.Matrix;
				transform = new MatrixTransform(Math.Abs(matrix.M11), matrix.M12, matrix.M21, Math.Abs(matrix.M22), 0.0, 0.0);
				if ((frameworkElement.LayoutTransform as MatrixTransform).Return((MatrixTransform x) => x.Matrix != transform.Matrix, () => true))
				{
					frameworkElement.LayoutTransform = transform;
				}
				FrameworkElementExtensions.SetLeft(frameworkElement, num);
				FrameworkElementExtensions.SetTop(frameworkElement, point.Y);
			}
		}

		private static System.Windows.Point TransformToDeviceDPI(FrameworkElement element, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return PresentationSource.FromVisual(element).CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice.Transform(point);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Point NormalizeToScreenOrigin(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return point;
		}

		protected override void ClosePopup()
		{
			if (((FrameworkElement)this).IsLoaded)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)this).ClosePopup();
			}
			else if (!((FlyoutBase)this).IsOpen)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)this).FlyoutContainer.Do(delegate(FlyoutContainer x)
				{
					x.IsOpen = false;
				});
			}
		}

		protected override void IsOpenChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			if (((FlyoutBase)this).RenderGrid != null)
			{
				((FlyoutBase)this).RenderGrid.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			((FlyoutBase)this).IsOpenChanged(newValue);
		}

		public override Rect GetTargetBounds(UIElement baseElement, UIElement element, Func<Rect> GetDefaultTargetBounds)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				return TranslateHelper.TranslateBounds(baseElement, element);
			}
			return GetDefaultTargetBounds();
		}
	}
	[ContentProperty("Content")]
	public class FlyoutAdornerContentControl : Control
	{
		private class FlyoutFloatingContainer : FloatingAdornerContainer
		{
			public FlyoutFloatingContainer()

		private class FlyoutPlacementAdorner : DefaultPlacementAdorner
		{
			public FlyoutPlacementAdorner(UIElement container)
				: base(container)
			{
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Content", typeof(object), typeof(FlyoutAdornerContentControl), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnContentChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsOpenProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsOpen", typeof(bool), typeof(FlyoutAdornerContentControl), new PropertyMetadata(false, OnIsOpenChanged));

		private FloatingContainer container;

		public object Content
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ContentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ContentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsOpen
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsOpenProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsOpenProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren
		{
			get
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				if (Content != null)
				{
					list.Add(Content);
				}
				if (container != null)
				{
					list.Add(container);
				}
				return list.ToArray().GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler Closed;

		public event EventHandler Opened;

		private static void OnContentChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((FlyoutAdornerContentControl)dObj).OnContentChanged(e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}

		private static void OnIsOpenChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((FlyoutAdornerContentControl)dObj).OnIsOpenChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				AddLogicalChild(newValue);
			}
			if (container != null)
			{
				EnsureFloatingContainer();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsOpenChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				container = CreateFloatingContainer();
			}
			EnsureFloatingContainer();
			((BaseFloatingContainer)container).IsOpen = newValue;
			if (newValue)
			{
				RaiseOpened();
				return;
			}
			((BaseFloatingContainer)container).Content = null;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)container).Owner.SizeChanged -= OnOwnerSizeChanged;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)container).Owner = null;
			container.Close();
			RemoveLogicalChild(container);
			container = null;
			RaiseClosed();
		}

		protected virtual FloatingContainer CreateFloatingContainer()
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (LayoutHelper.GetTopContainerWithAdornerLayer((UIElement)(((object)Window.GetWindow(this)) ?? ((object)this))) as FrameworkElement) ?? this;
			FlyoutFloatingContainer flyoutFloatingContainer = new FlyoutFloatingContainer();
			((BaseFloatingContainer)flyoutFloatingContainer).Owner = frameworkElement;
			FlyoutFloatingContainer flyoutFloatingContainer2 = flyoutFloatingContainer;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)flyoutFloatingContainer2).ShowContentOnly = true;
			((FloatingContainer)flyoutFloatingContainer2).SizeToContent = SizeToContent.Manual;
			((FloatingAdornerContainer)flyoutFloatingContainer2).UseSizingMargin = false;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)flyoutFloatingContainer2).UseActiveStateOnly = true;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)flyoutFloatingContainer2).FloatSize = new System.Windows.Size(frameworkElement.ActualWidth, frameworkElement.ActualHeight);
			frameworkElement.SizeChanged += OnOwnerSizeChanged;
			AddLogicalChild(flyoutFloatingContainer2);
			return (FloatingContainer)(object)flyoutFloatingContainer2;
		}

		private void OnOwnerSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (container != null)
			{
				((BaseFloatingContainer)container).FloatSize = e.NewSize;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureFloatingContainer()
		{
			((BaseFloatingContainer)container).BeginUpdate();
			((BaseFloatingContainer)container).Content = Content;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)container).EndUpdate();
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseOpened()
		{
			if (this.Opened != null)
			{
				this.Opened(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseClosed()
		{
			if (this.Closed != null)
			{
				this.Closed(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class ItemsContainerSyncHelper
	{
		private readonly ItemContainerGenerator Generator;

		private Panel Panel;

		private IItemContainerGenerator IGenerator => Generator;

		public ItemsContainerSyncHelper(ItemContainerGenerator generator)
		{
			Generator = generator;
		}

		public void Attach(Panel panel)
		{
			Panel = panel;
			Generator.ItemsChanged += OnItemsChanged;
			ReGenerateChildren();
		}

		public void Detach(Panel panel)
		{
			Generator.ItemsChanged -= OnItemsChanged;
			Panel.Do(delegate(Panel x)
			{
				x.Children.Clear();
			});
			Panel = null;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ReGenerateChildren();
		}

		private void OnItemsChanged(object sender, ItemsChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnItemsChangedInternal(e);
		}

		private void OnItemsChangedInternal(ItemsChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				AddChildren(e.Position, e.ItemCount);
				return;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				RemoveChildren(e.Position, e.ItemUICount);
				return;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				ReplaceChildren(e.Position, e.ItemCount);
				return;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				MoveChildren(e.OldPosition, e.Position, e.ItemUICount);
				return;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				ReGenerateChildren();
				return;
			}
			Panel.Do(delegate(Panel x)
			{
				x.InvalidateMeasure();
			});
		}

		private void AddChildren(GeneratorPosition pos, int itemCount)
		{
			using (IGenerator.StartAt(pos, GeneratorDirection.Forward))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < itemCount; i++)
				{
					UIElement element = IGenerator.GenerateNext() as UIElement;
					if (element != null)
					{
						Panel.Do(delegate(Panel x)
						{
							x.Children.Insert(pos.Index + 1 + i, element);
						});
						IGenerator.PrepareItemContainer(element);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void RemoveChildren(GeneratorPosition pos, int containerCount)
		{
			Panel.Do(delegate(Panel x)
			{
				x.Children.RemoveRange(pos.Index, containerCount);
			});
		}

		private void ReplaceChildren(GeneratorPosition pos, int itemCount)
		{
			using (IGenerator.StartAt(pos, GeneratorDirection.Forward))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < itemCount; i++)
				{
					UIElement item = IGenerator.GenerateNext() as UIElement;
					if (item != null)
					{
						Panel.Do(delegate(Panel x)
						{
							x.Children[pos.Index + 1 + i] = item;
						});
						IGenerator.PrepareItemContainer(item);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void MoveChildren(GeneratorPosition fromPos, GeneratorPosition toPos, int containerCount)
		{
			if (Panel != null && fromPos != toPos)
			{
				int num = IGenerator.IndexFromGeneratorPosition(toPos);
				UIElement[] array = new UIElement[containerCount];
				for (int i = 0; i < containerCount; i++)
				{
					array[i] = Panel.Children[fromPos.Index + i];
				}
				Panel.Children.RemoveRange(fromPos.Index, containerCount);
				for (int j = 0; j < containerCount; j++)
				{
					Panel.Children.Insert(num + j, array[j]);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ReGenerateChildren()
		{
			IGenerator.RemoveAll();
			Panel.Do(delegate(Panel x)
			{
				x.Children.Clear();
			});
			using (IGenerator.StartAt(new GeneratorPosition(-1, 0), GeneratorDirection.Forward))
			{
				UIElement element;
				while ((element = IGenerator.GenerateNext() as UIElement) != null)
				{
					Panel.Do(delegate(Panel x)
					{
						x.Children.Add(element);
					});
					IGenerator.PrepareItemContainer(element);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public virtual int GetItemIndex(UIElementCollection items, int visibleIndex)
		{
			if (visibleIndex == ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)LayoutItems).Count)
			{
				return items.IndexOf(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)LayoutItems)[((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)LayoutItems).Count - 1]) + 1;
			}
			return items.IndexOf(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)LayoutItems)[visibleIndex]);
		}

		public virtual int GetItemPlaceIndex(FrameworkElement item, Rect bounds, System.Windows.Point p, out FlowPanelLayerBreak flowBreakKind)
		{
			flowBreakKind = FlowPanelLayerBreak.None;
			if (!bounds.Contains(p) || ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)LayoutItems).Count == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < LayerInfos.Count; i++)
			{
				FlowLayoutPanelLayerInfo flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo = LayerInfos[i];
				if (!GetElementHitTestBounds(GetLayerBounds(flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo), bounds, isFront: true, isBack: true).Contains(p))
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo.SlotCount; j++)
				{
					Rect slotBounds = GetSlotBounds(flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo, j);
					if (!GetElementHitTestBounds(slotBounds, bounds, j == 0, j == flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo.SlotCount - 1).Contains(p))
					{
						continue;
					}
					bool isBeforeItemPlace;
					int num = GetSlotItemPlaceIndex(flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo, j, item, bounds, p, out isBeforeItemPlace);
					if (isBeforeItemPlace)
					{
						if (num == 0 || FlowLayoutPanel.GetIsFlowBreak(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)LayoutItems)[num]))
						{
							flowBreakKind = FlowPanelLayerBreak.Existing;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num++;
					}
					return num;
				}
			}
			foreach (FlowLayoutPanelLayerInfo layerInfo in LayerInfos)
			{
				if (layerInfo.IsHardFlowBreak && GetLayerSpaceBounds(layerInfo, bounds).Contains(p))
				{
					if (CanAddHardFlowBreaks)
					{
						flowBreakKind = FlowPanelLayerBreak.New;
					}
					return layerInfo.FirstItemIndex;
				}
			}
			if (GetRemainderBounds(bounds, GetLayerBounds(GetLayerInfo(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)LayoutItems).Count - 1))).Contains(p))
			{
				if (CanAddHardFlowBreaks)
				{
					flowBreakKind = FlowPanelLayerBreak.New;
				}
				return ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)LayoutItems).Count;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public double GetLayerMinWidth(System.Windows.Size itemsMinSize)
		{
			return GetItemSize(itemsMinSize).Width;
		}

		public double GetLayerMaxWidth(System.Windows.Size itemsMaxSize)
		{
			return GetItemSize(itemsMaxSize).Width;
		}

		public double GetLayerWidth(FrameworkElements items, out System.Windows.Size itemSize)
		{
			double num = double.PositiveInfinity;
			itemSize = new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
			foreach (FrameworkElement item in (Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)
			{
				double width = GetItemSize(FrameworkElementExtensions.GetSize(item)).Width;
				if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(num) && width != num)
				{
					return double.PositiveInfinity;
				}
				num = width;
			}
			if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(num))
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			itemSize = GetItemSize(new FlowLayoutPanelItemSize(num, double.PositiveInfinity));
			return num;
		}

		public void SetLayerWidth(FrameworkElements items, double value, out System.Windows.Size itemSize)
		{
			itemSize = GetItemSize(new FlowLayoutPanelItemSize(value, double.PositiveInfinity));
			if (GetLayerWidth(items, out var _) == value)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FrameworkElement item in (Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)
			{
				if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(itemSize.Width))
				{
					item.Width = itemSize.Width;
				}
				if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(itemSize.Height))
				{
					item.Height = itemSize.Height;
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual double GetLayerDistance(bool isHardFlowBreak)
		{
			return GetLayerSpace(isHardFlowBreak);
		}

		public virtual double GetLayerSpace(bool isHardFlowBreak)
		{
			return Parameters.LayerSpace;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnMeasure(FrameworkElements items, System.Windows.Size maxSize)
		{
			CalculateLayout(items, RectHelper.New(maxSize), delegate(FrameworkElement item)
			{
				FlowLayoutPanelItemSize itemSize2 = new FlowLayoutPanelItemSize(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
				if (StretchContent)
				{
					itemSize2.Width = GetLayerWidth(RectHelper.New(maxSize));
				}
				System.Windows.Size itemSize3 = GetItemSize(itemSize2);
				item.Measure(itemSize3);
				return UIElementExtensions.GetDesiredSize((UIElement)item);
			}, null);
			FlowLayoutPanelItemSize itemSize = new FlowLayoutPanelItemSize(0.0, 0.0);
			if (((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count != 0)
			{
				for (int num = 0; num < LayerInfos.Count; num++)
				{
					FlowLayoutPanelLayerInfo flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo = LayerInfos[num];
					if (num == 0)
					{
						itemSize.Width += flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo.Size.Width;
					}
					itemSize.Length = Math.Max(itemSize.Length, flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo.Size.Length);
				}
			}
			return GetItemSize(itemSize);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnArrange(FrameworkElements items, Rect bounds, Rect viewPortBounds)
		{
			CalculateLayout(items, bounds, (FrameworkElement item) => UIElementExtensions.GetDesiredSize((UIElement)item), delegate(FrameworkElement item, FlowLayoutPanelItemPosition itemPosition, FlowLayoutPanelItemSize itemSize)
			{
				itemSize = GetItemSize(item.DesiredSize);
				if (StretchContent)
				{
					itemSize.Width = GetLayerWidth(viewPortBounds);
				}
				Rect itemBounds = GetItemBounds(itemPosition, itemSize);
				ArrangeItemCore(item, itemBounds);
			});
			return RectHelper.Size(bounds);
		}

		protected virtual bool CanArrangeItem(FrameworkElement item)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void CalculateLayout(FrameworkElements items, Rect bounds, MeasureItem measureItem, ArrangeItem arrangeItem)
		{
			double layerContentStart = GetLayerContentStart(bounds);
			double num = layerContentStart;
			FlowLayoutPanelItemPosition flowLayoutPanelItemPosition = new FlowLayoutPanelItemPosition(GetLayerStart(bounds), num);
			LayoutItems = items;
			LayerInfos.Clear();
			FlowLayoutPanelLayerInfo flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo = null;
			HiddenItemsCount = 0;
			VisibleChildren.Clear();
			ArrangeInfos = new LayoutPanelArrangeInfos();
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count; i++)
			{
				FrameworkElement item = ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[i];
				FlowLayoutPanelItemSize itemSize = GetItemSize(measureItem(item));
				if (i == 0)
				{
					bool isHardFlowBreak = false;
					bool isHardFlowBreak2 = IsFlowBreak(item, bounds, num, GetSlotLength(items, i, itemSize), out isHardFlowBreak);
					flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo = new FlowLayoutPanelLayerInfo(0, isHardFlowBreak2, flowLayoutPanelItemPosition);
					LayerInfos.Add(flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo);
				}
				else
				{
					bool isHardFlowBreak3 = false;
					if (IsFlowBreak(item, bounds, num, GetSlotLength(items, i, itemSize), out isHardFlowBreak3))
					{
						flowLayoutPanelItemPosition.ItemOffset = num + GetLayerDistance(isHardFlowBreak3);
						flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo = new FlowLayoutPanelLayerInfo(i, isHardFlowBreak3, flowLayoutPanelItemPosition);
						LayerInfos.Add(flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo);
					}
					else
					{
						flowLayoutPanelItemPosition.ItemOffset = num;
					}
				}
				flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo.SlotFirstItemIndexes.Add(i);
				FlowLayoutPanelItemSize flowLayoutPanelItemSize = itemSize;
				double num2 = num + flowLayoutPanelItemSize.Length - layerContentStart;
				double num3 = Math.Max(flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo.Size.Width, flowLayoutPanelItemSize.Width);
				if (!CanArrangeItem(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[i]) || (Parameters.AllowItemClipping && num2 > (IsHorizontal ? bounds.Width : bounds.Height) + 0.5) || HiddenItemsCount > 0)
				{
					HiddenItemsCount++;
					if (arrangeItem != null)
					{
						ArrangeItemCore(item, default(Rect));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					arrangeItem?.Invoke(item, flowLayoutPanelItemPosition, itemSize);
					flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo.Size.Length = num + flowLayoutPanelItemSize.Length - layerContentStart;
					flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo.Size.Width = Math.Max(flowLayoutPanelLayerInfo.Size.Width, flowLayoutPanelItemSize.Width);
					num += GetSlotMaxLength(item, itemSize) + Parameters.ItemSpace;
					VisibleChildren.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ArrangeItemCore(UIElement item, Rect bounds)
		{
			ArrangeInfos.Add(new LayoutPanelArrangeInfo
			{
				ArrangeBounds = bounds
			});
			item.Arrange(bounds);
		}

		protected double GetSlotMaxWidth(FrameworkElements items)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count; i++)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[i];
				FlowLayoutPanelItemSize itemSize = GetItemSize(UIElementExtensions.GetDesiredSize((UIElement)frameworkElement));
				num = Math.Max(num, GetSlotMaxWidth(frameworkElement, itemSize));
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected virtual bool NeedsFullSlot(FrameworkElement item)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected FlowLayoutPanelLayerInfo GetLayerInfo(int itemIndex)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < LayerInfos.Count; i++)
			{
				if (itemIndex < LayerInfos[i].FirstItemIndex)
				{
					if (i != 0)
					{
						return LayerInfos[i - 1];
					}
					return null;
				}
			}
			if (LayerInfos.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return LayerInfos[LayerInfos.Count - 1];
		}

		protected int GetSlotLastItemIndex(FlowLayoutPanelLayerInfo layerInfo, int slotIndex)
		{
			if (slotIndex == layerInfo.SlotCount - 1)
			{
				int num = LayerInfos.IndexOf(layerInfo);
				if (num == LayerInfos.Count - 1)
				{
					return ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)LayoutItems).Count - 1;
				}
				return LayerInfos[num + 1].FirstItemIndex - 1;
			}
			return layerInfo.SlotFirstItemIndexes[slotIndex + 1] - 1;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsFlowBreak(FrameworkElement item, Rect bounds, double slotOffset, double slotLength, out bool isHardFlowBreak)
		{
			isHardFlowBreak = FlowLayoutPanel.GetIsFlowBreak(item);
			return !StretchContent & isHardFlowBreak;
		}

		protected Rect GetItemBounds(FlowLayoutPanelItemPosition itemPosition, FlowLayoutPanelItemSize itemSize)
		{
			if (IsHorizontal)
			{
				return new Rect(itemPosition.ItemOffset, itemPosition.LayerOffset, itemSize.Length, itemSize.Width);
			}
			return new Rect(itemPosition.LayerOffset, itemPosition.ItemOffset, itemSize.Width, itemSize.Length);
		}

		protected void GetItemPositionAndSize(Rect itemBounds, out FlowLayoutPanelItemPosition itemPosition, out FlowLayoutPanelItemSize itemSize)
		{
			if (IsHorizontal)
			{
				itemPosition = new FlowLayoutPanelItemPosition(itemBounds.Y, itemBounds.X);
				itemSize = new FlowLayoutPanelItemSize(itemBounds.Height, itemBounds.Width);
			}
			else
			{
				itemPosition = new FlowLayoutPanelItemPosition(itemBounds.X, itemBounds.Y);
				itemSize = new FlowLayoutPanelItemSize(itemBounds.Width, itemBounds.Height);
			}
		}

		protected FlowLayoutPanelItemSize GetItemSize(System.Windows.Size itemSize)
		{
			GetItemPositionAndSize(RectHelper.New(itemSize), out var _, out var itemSize2);
			return itemSize2;
		}

		protected System.Windows.Size GetItemSize(FlowLayoutPanelItemSize itemSize)
		{
			return RectHelper.Size(GetItemBounds(new FlowLayoutPanelItemPosition(0.0, 0.0), itemSize));
		}

		protected double GetLayerStart(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (!IsHorizontal)
			{
				return bounds.Left;
			}
			return bounds.Top;
		}

		protected double GetLayerWidth(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (!IsHorizontal)
			{
				return bounds.Width;
			}
			return bounds.Height;
		}

		protected double GetLayerEnd(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (!IsHorizontal)
			{
				return bounds.Right;
			}
			return bounds.Bottom;
		}

		protected double GetLayerCenter(Rect bounds)
		{
			return (GetLayerStart(bounds) + GetLayerEnd(bounds)) / 2.0;
		}

		protected double GetLayerOffset(System.Windows.Point p)
		{
			if (!IsHorizontal)
			{
				return p.X;
			}
			return p.Y;
		}

		protected double GetLayerContentStart(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (!IsHorizontal)
			{
				return bounds.Top;
			}
			return bounds.Left;
		}

		protected double GetLayerContentLength(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (!IsHorizontal)
			{
				return bounds.Height;
			}
			return bounds.Width;
		}

		protected double GetLayerContentEnd(Rect bounds)
		{
			return GetLayerContentStart(bounds) + GetLayerContentLength(bounds);
		}

		protected double GetLayerContentCenter(Rect bounds)
		{
			return (GetLayerContentStart(bounds) + GetLayerContentEnd(bounds)) / 2.0;
		}

		protected double GetLayerContentOffset(System.Windows.Point p)
		{
			if (!IsHorizontal)
			{
				return p.Y;
			}
			return p.X;
		}

		protected virtual Rect GetElementHitTestBounds(Rect elementBounds, Rect bounds, bool isFront, bool isBack)
		{
			GetItemPositionAndSize(elementBounds, out var itemPosition, out var itemSize);
			itemSize.Width += Parameters.ItemSpace;
			if (isFront)
			{
				double num = Math.Max(0.0, itemPosition.ItemOffset - GetLayerContentStart(bounds));
				itemPosition.ItemOffset -= num;
				itemSize.Length += num;
			}
			if (isBack)
			{
				itemSize.Length = Math.Max(0.0, GetLayerContentEnd(bounds) - itemPosition.ItemOffset);
			}
			else
			{
				itemSize.Length += Parameters.ItemSpace;
			}
			return GetItemBounds(itemPosition, itemSize);
		}

		protected Rect GetLayerBounds(FlowLayoutPanelLayerInfo layerInfo)
		{
			return GetItemBounds(layerInfo.Position, layerInfo.Size);
		}

		protected Rect GetLayerSpaceBounds(FlowLayoutPanelLayerInfo layerInfo, Rect bounds)
		{
			FlowLayoutPanelItemPosition itemPosition = new FlowLayoutPanelItemPosition(0.0, GetLayerContentStart(bounds));
			FlowLayoutPanelItemSize itemSize = new FlowLayoutPanelItemSize(0.0, GetLayerContentLength(bounds));
			if (layerInfo.FirstItemIndex == 0)
			{
				itemSize.Width = Math.Max(0.0, layerInfo.Position.LayerOffset - GetLayerStart(bounds));
			}
			else
			{
				itemSize.Width = GetLayerDistance(layerInfo.IsHardFlowBreak);
			}
			itemPosition.LayerOffset = layerInfo.Position.LayerOffset - itemSize.Width;
			return GetItemBounds(itemPosition, itemSize);
		}

		protected Rect GetRemainderBounds(Rect bounds, Rect lastLayerBounds)
		{
			GetItemPositionAndSize(bounds, out var itemPosition, out var itemSize);
			double num = GetLayerEnd(lastLayerBounds) - itemPosition.LayerOffset;
			itemPosition.LayerOffset += num;
			itemSize.Width = Math.Max(0.0, itemSize.Width - num);
			return GetItemBounds(itemPosition, itemSize);
		}

		protected Rect GetSlotBounds(FlowLayoutPanelLayerInfo layerInfo, int slotIndex)
		{
			GetItemPositionAndSize(GetLayerBounds(layerInfo), out var itemPosition, out var itemSize);
			int index = layerInfo.SlotFirstItemIndexes[slotIndex];
			GetItemPositionAndSize(FrameworkElementExtensions.GetBounds(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)LayoutItems)[index]), out var itemPosition2, out var itemSize2);
			itemSize.Length = itemPosition.ItemOffset + itemSize.Length - itemPosition2.ItemOffset;
			itemPosition.ItemOffset = itemPosition2.ItemOffset;
			if (slotIndex < layerInfo.SlotCount - 1)
			{
				index = layerInfo.SlotFirstItemIndexes[slotIndex + 1];
				GetItemPositionAndSize(FrameworkElementExtensions.GetBounds(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)LayoutItems)[index]), out itemPosition2, out itemSize2);
				itemSize.Length = itemPosition2.ItemOffset - Parameters.ItemSpace - itemPosition.ItemOffset;
			}
			return GetItemBounds(itemPosition, itemSize);
		}

		protected virtual int GetSlotItemPlaceIndex(FlowLayoutPanelLayerInfo layerInfo, int slotIndex, FrameworkElement item, Rect bounds, System.Windows.Point p, out bool isBeforeItemPlace)
		{
			int num = layerInfo.SlotFirstItemIndexes[slotIndex];
			if (NeedsFullSlot(item) || NeedsFullSlot(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)LayoutItems)[num]))
			{
				isBeforeItemPlace = GetLayerContentOffset(p) < GetLayerContentCenter(GetSlotBounds(layerInfo, slotIndex));
				if (isBeforeItemPlace)
				{
					return num;
				}
				return GetSlotLastItemIndex(layerInfo, slotIndex);
			}
			isBeforeItemPlace = false;
			return -1;
		}
	}

			: base(control)
		{
		}

		public override bool IsScrollable()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override DragAndDropController CreateItemDragAndDropController(System.Windows.Point startDragPoint, FrameworkElement dragControl)

	public class FlowLayoutPanelDragAndDropControllerBase : LayoutPanelDragAndDropControllerBase
	{
		protected static ElementBoundsAnimation ElementPositionsAnimation { get; set; }

		protected virtual bool CanModifyChildrenCollection => true;

		protected new FlowLayoutPanelController Controller => (FlowLayoutPanelController)base.Controller;

		private Dictionary<UIElement, bool> IsFlowBreakOriginalValues { get; set; }

		public FlowLayoutPanelDragAndDropControllerBase(Controller controller, System.Windows.Point startDragPoint, FrameworkElement dragControl)
			: base(controller, startDragPoint, dragControl)
		{
			if (ElementPositionsAnimation != null)
			{
				ElementPositionsAnimation.Stop();
				ElementPositionsAnimation = null;
			}
		}

		public override void DragAndDrop(System.Windows.Point p)
		{
			((DragAndDropController)this).DragAndDrop(p);
			if (ElementPositionsAnimation != null && ElementPositionsAnimation.IsActive)
			{
				return;
			}
			FlowPanelLayerBreak flowBreakKind;
			int itemPlaceIndex = Controller.LayoutProvider.GetItemPlaceIndex(base.DragControl, ((PanelControllerBase)Controller).ClientBounds, GetItemPlacePoint(p), out flowBreakKind);
			if (itemPlaceIndex == -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = Controller.LayoutProvider.GetItemIndex(base.DragControlParent.Children, itemPlaceIndex);
			if (flowBreakKind == FlowPanelLayerBreak.New)
			{
				flowBreakKind = ((itemPlaceIndex == 0) ? FlowPanelLayerBreak.Existing : FlowPanelLayerBreak.None);
			}
			bool flag = flowBreakKind != FlowPanelLayerBreak.None;
			FrameworkElements layoutItems = Controller.LayoutProvider.LayoutItems;
			int num2 = ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)layoutItems).IndexOf(base.DragControlPlaceHolder);
			int num3 = base.DragControlParent.Children.IndexOf(base.DragControlPlaceHolder);
			bool flag2 = num2 == 0 || FlowLayoutPanel.GetIsFlowBreak(base.DragControlPlaceHolder);
			bool flag3 = flag2 && (num2 == ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)layoutItems).Count - 1 || FlowLayoutPanel.GetIsFlowBreak(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)layoutItems)[num2 + 1]));
			if (num > num3)
			{
				num--;
			}
			if (num3 == num && (!(num2 + 1 == itemPlaceIndex && flag) || (flag2 && flowBreakKind != FlowPanelLayerBreak.Existing)) && (itemPlaceIndex != num2 || (!(!flag && flag2) && (flowBreakKind != FlowPanelLayerBreak.New || flag3))))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Controller.ILayoutControl.AnimateItemMoving)
			{
				ElementPositionsAnimation = new ElementBoundsAnimation(layoutItems);
				ElementPositionsAnimation.StoreOldElementBounds();
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				if (flag3)
				{
					OnGroupFirstItemChanged(base.DragControlPlaceHolder, null);
				}
				else
				{
					OnGroupFirstItemChanged(base.DragControlPlaceHolder, ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)layoutItems)[num2 + 1]);
				}
			}
			if (flowBreakKind == FlowPanelLayerBreak.Existing)
			{
				OnGroupFirstItemChanged(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)layoutItems)[itemPlaceIndex], base.DragControlPlaceHolder);
			}
			base.DragControlParent.Children.RemoveAt(num3);
			base.DragControlParent.Children.Insert(num, base.DragControlPlaceHolder);
			if (flag2 && num2 < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)layoutItems).Count - 1)
			{
				SetIsFlowBreakAndStoreOriginalValue(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)layoutItems)[num2 + 1], value: true);
			}
			if (flag && itemPlaceIndex < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)layoutItems).Count)
			{
				SetIsFlowBreakAndStoreOriginalValue(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)layoutItems)[itemPlaceIndex], flowBreakKind == FlowPanelLayerBreak.New);
			}
			FlowLayoutPanel.SetIsFlowBreak(base.DragControlPlaceHolder, flag);
			if (Controller.ILayoutControl.AnimateItemMoving)
			{
				((Controller)Controller).Control.UpdateLayout();
				ElementPositionsAnimation.StoreNewElementBounds();
				ElementPositionsAnimation.Begin(Controller.ILayoutControl.ItemMovingAnimationDuration);
			}
		}

		public override void EndDragAndDrop(bool accept)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_003f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (ElementPositionsAnimation != null)
			{
				ElementPositionsAnimation.Stop();
				ElementPositionsAnimation = null;
			}
			if (Controller.ILayoutControl.AnimateItemMoving)
			{
				FrameworkElements val = new FrameworkElements();
				((Collection<FrameworkElement>)val).Add(base.DragControl);
				ElementPositionsAnimation = new ElementBoundsAnimation(val);
				ElementPositionsAnimation.StoreOldElementBounds(((Controller)Controller).Control);
			}
			int num = base.DragControlParent.Children.IndexOf(base.DragControlPlaceHolder);
			bool isFlowBreak = FlowLayoutPanel.GetIsFlowBreak(base.DragControlPlaceHolder);
			((DragAndDropController)this).EndDragAndDrop(accept);
			if (accept)
			{
				if (base.DragControlIndex != num || FlowLayoutPanel.GetIsFlowBreak(base.DragControl) != isFlowBreak)
				{
					int oldPosition = ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)((IPanel)Controller.ILayoutControl).GetLogicalChildren(false)).IndexOf(base.DragControl);
					if (CanModifyChildrenCollection)
					{
						base.DragControlParent.Children.RemoveAt(base.DragControlIndex);
						base.DragControlParent.Children.Insert(num, base.DragControl);
					}
					FlowLayoutPanel.SetIsFlowBreak(base.DragControl, isFlowBreak);
					int newPosition = (CanModifyChildrenCollection ? ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)((IPanel)Controller.ILayoutControl).GetLogicalChildren(false)).IndexOf(base.DragControl) : num);
					Controller.ILayoutControl.OnItemPositionChanged(oldPosition, newPosition);
				}
				SendIsFlowBreakChangeNotifications();
			}
			else
			{
				RestoreIsFlowBreakOriginalValues();
			}
			if (!Controller.ILayoutControl.AnimateItemMoving)
			{
				return;
			}
			object storedDragControlOpacity = DependencyObjectExtensions.StorePropertyValue((DependencyObject)base.DragControl, UIElement.OpacityProperty);
			base.DragControl.Opacity = 0.0;
			((Controller)Controller).Control.UpdateLayout();
			if (IsConnectedToPresentationSource(base.DragControl))
			{
				ElementPositionsAnimation.StoreNewElementBounds();
				object storedDragControlZIndex = DependencyObjectExtensions.StorePropertyValue((DependencyObject)base.DragControl, Panel.ZIndexProperty);
				FrameworkElementExtensions.SetZIndex(base.DragControl, 1000);
				object storedDragControlIsHitTestVisible = DependencyObjectExtensions.StorePropertyValue((DependencyObject)base.DragControl, UIElement.IsHitTestVisibleProperty);
				base.DragControl.IsHitTestVisible = false;
				ElementPositionsAnimation.Begin(FlowLayoutPanel.ItemDropAnimationDuration, new ExponentialEase
				{
					Exponent = 5.0
				}, delegate
				{
					DependencyObjectExtensions.RestorePropertyValue((DependencyObject)base.DragControl, Panel.ZIndexProperty, storedDragControlZIndex);
					DependencyObjectExtensions.RestorePropertyValue((DependencyObject)base.DragControl, UIElement.IsHitTestVisibleProperty, storedDragControlIsHitTestVisible);
					ElementPositionsAnimation = null;
				});
			}
			else
			{
				ElementPositionsAnimation = null;
			}
			Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				DependencyObjectExtensions.RestorePropertyValue((DependencyObject)base.DragControl, UIElement.OpacityProperty, storedDragControlOpacity);
			}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
		}

		protected bool IsConnectedToPresentationSource(UIElement element)
		{
			return PresentationSource.FromVisual(element) != null;
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Point GetItemPlacePoint(System.Windows.Point p)
		{
			return p;
		}

		protected virtual void OnGroupFirstItemChanged(FrameworkElement oldValue, FrameworkElement newValue)
		{
		}

		protected void RestoreIsFlowBreakOriginalValues()
		{
			if (IsFlowBreakOriginalValues == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<UIElement, bool> isFlowBreakOriginalValue in IsFlowBreakOriginalValues)
			{
				FlowLayoutPanel.SetIsFlowBreak(isFlowBreakOriginalValue.Key, isFlowBreakOriginalValue.Value);
			}
		}

		protected void SendIsFlowBreakChangeNotifications()
		{
			if (IsFlowBreakOriginalValues == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			FrameworkElements logicalChildren = ((IPanel)Controller.ILayoutControl).GetLogicalChildren(false);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<UIElement, bool> isFlowBreakOriginalValue in IsFlowBreakOriginalValues)
			{
				if (FlowLayoutPanel.GetIsFlowBreak(isFlowBreakOriginalValue.Key) != isFlowBreakOriginalValue.Value)
				{
					int num = ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)logicalChildren).IndexOf((FrameworkElement)isFlowBreakOriginalValue.Key);
					Controller.ILayoutControl.OnItemPositionChanged(num, num);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void SetIsFlowBreakAndStoreOriginalValue(UIElement element, bool value)
		{
			if (FlowLayoutPanel.GetIsFlowBreak(element) != value)
			{
				if (IsFlowBreakOriginalValues == null)
				{
					IsFlowBreakOriginalValues = new Dictionary<UIElement, bool>();
				}
				if (!IsFlowBreakOriginalValues.ContainsKey(element))
				{
					IsFlowBreakOriginalValues.Add(element, FlowLayoutPanel.GetIsFlowBreak(element));
				}
				FlowLayoutPanel.SetIsFlowBreak(element, value);
			}
		}

		protected override Container CreateDragImageContainer()
		{
			return (Container)(object)new NonLogicalContainer();
		}

		protected override Panel GetDragImageParent()
		{
			return (((PanelControllerBase)Controller).IPanel as Panel) ?? ((DragAndDropController)this).GetDragImageParent();
		}
	}

	public class StackPanelGroupHeader : ContentControlBase
	{

	public class StackPanelGroupHeaders : ElementPool<StackPanelGroupHeader>
	{
		private DataTemplate _ItemContentTemplate;

		public DataTemplate ItemContentTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return _ItemContentTemplate;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ItemContentTemplate != value)
				{
					_ItemContentTemplate = value;
					OnItemContentTemplateChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public StackPanelGroupHeaders(Panel container)
			: base(container)
		{
		}

		protected override StackPanelGroupHeader CreateItem()
		{
			StackPanelGroupHeader stackPanelGroupHeader = CreateItemCore();
			if (ItemContentTemplate != null)
			{
				UpdateItemContentTemplate(stackPanelGroupHeader);
			}
			return stackPanelGroupHeader;
		}

		protected virtual StackPanelGroupHeader CreateItemCore()
		{
			return base.CreateItem();
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemContentTemplateChanged()
		{
			base.Items.ForEach(UpdateItemContentTemplate);
		}

		private void UpdateItemContentTemplate(StackPanelGroupHeader item)
		{
			DependencyObjectExtensions.SetValueIfNotDefault((DependencyObject)(object)item, ContentControlBase.ContentTemplateProperty, (object)ItemContentTemplate);
		}

		public StackPanelGroupHeader Add()
		{
			StackPanelGroupHeader stackPanelGroupHeader = base.Add();
			if (!base.Container.Children.Contains((UIElement)(object)stackPanelGroupHeader))
			{
				base.Container.Children.Add((UIElement)(object)stackPanelGroupHeader);
			}
			return stackPanelGroupHeader;
		}

		public void DeleteUnusedItems()
		{
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			for (int num = base.Items.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				StackPanelGroupHeader stackPanelGroupHeader = base.Items[num];
				if (!base.IsItemUsed(stackPanelGroupHeader))
				{
					((ILogicalOwner)base.Container).RemoveChild((object)stackPanelGroupHeader);
				}
			}
			base.DeleteUnusedItems();
		}

		protected override bool IsItemInTree(StackPanelGroupHeader item)
		{
			if (!base.IsItemInTree(item))
			{
				return base.Container.Children.Contains((UIElement)(object)item);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class HeaderedStackLayoutProvider : StackLayoutPanelProvider
	{
		private new IHeaderedStackPanelModel Model => base.Model as IHeaderedStackPanelModel;

		public virtual bool ShowGroupHeaders => Model.ShowGroupHeaders;

		protected new HeaderedStackLayoutPanelParameters Parameters => base.Parameters as HeaderedStackLayoutPanelParameters;

		public HeaderedStackLayoutProvider(IHeaderedStackPanelModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnArrange(FrameworkElements items, Rect bounds, Rect viewPortBounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.OnArrange(items, bounds, viewPortBounds);
			if (ShowGroupHeaders)
			{
				AddGroupHeaders();
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected void AddGroupHeader(object headerSource, Rect headerAreaBounds)
		{
			StackPanelGroupHeader stackPanelGroupHeader = Parameters.GroupHeaders.Add();
			((FrameworkElement)(object)stackPanelGroupHeader).SetBinding(ContentControlBase.ContentProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding
			{
				Source = headerSource,
				Path = new PropertyPath(HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.GroupHeaderProperty),
				Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay
			});
			UIElementExtensions.InvalidateParentsOfModifiedChildren((UIElement)(object)stackPanelGroupHeader);
			((UIElement)(object)stackPanelGroupHeader).Measure(RectHelper.Size(headerAreaBounds));
			((UIElement)(object)stackPanelGroupHeader).Arrange(GetGroupHeaderBounds(headerAreaBounds, ((UIElement)(object)stackPanelGroupHeader).DesiredSize));
		}

		protected virtual void AddGroupHeaders()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)base.LayoutItems).Count; i++)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)base.LayoutItems)[i];
				object groupHeader = HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.GetGroupHeader(frameworkElement);
				if (groupHeader != null)
				{
					AddGroupHeader(frameworkElement, GetGroupHeaderAreaBounds(i));
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual Rect GetGroupBounds(int groupFirstLayerInfoIndex)
		{
			Rect arrangeBounds = base.ArrangeInfos[groupFirstLayerInfoIndex].ArrangeBounds;
			for (int i = groupFirstLayerInfoIndex + 1; i < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)base.LayoutItems).Count; i++)
			{
				object groupHeader = HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.GetGroupHeader(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)base.LayoutItems)[i]);
				if (groupHeader != null)
				{
					break;
				}
				LayoutPanelArrangeInfo layoutPanelArrangeInfo = base.ArrangeInfos[i];
				arrangeBounds.Union(layoutPanelArrangeInfo.ArrangeBounds);
			}
			return arrangeBounds;
		}

		protected virtual Rect GetGroupHeaderAreaBounds(int groupFirstLayerInfoIndex)
		{
			Rect groupBounds = GetGroupBounds(groupFirstLayerInfoIndex);
			groupBounds.Y -= Parameters.GroupHeaderSpace;
			groupBounds.Height = double.PositiveInfinity;
			return groupBounds;
		}

		protected virtual Rect GetGroupHeaderBounds(Rect headerAreaBounds, System.Windows.Size headerSize)
		{
			Rect result = headerAreaBounds;
			result.Y -= headerSize.Height;
			result.Height = headerSize.Height;
			return result;
		}
	}

	{
		public new IHeaderedStackLayoutPanel ILayoutControl => base.ILayoutControl as IHeaderedStackLayoutPanel;

		public HeaderedStackLayoutPanelController(IStackLayoutPanel control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		protected override DragAndDropController CreateItemDragAndDropController(System.Windows.Point startDragPoint, FrameworkElement dragControl)

		}

	public class HeaderedStackLayoutPanelDragAndDropControllerBase : StackLayoutPanelDragAndDropControllerBase
	{
		protected new HeaderedStackLayoutPanelController Controller => (HeaderedStackLayoutPanelController)base.Controller;

		private Dictionary<UIElement, object> GroupHeaderOriginalValues { get; set; }

		public HeaderedStackLayoutPanelDragAndDropControllerBase(Controller controller, System.Windows.Point startDragPoint, FrameworkElement dragControl)
			: base(controller, startDragPoint, dragControl)
		{
		}

		public override void EndDragAndDrop(bool accept)
		{
			if (accept)
			{
				HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.SetGroupHeader(base.DragControl, HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.GetGroupHeader(base.DragControlPlaceHolder));
			}
			else
			{
				RestoreGroupHeaderOriginalValues();
			}
			((DragAndDropController)this).EndDragAndDrop(accept);
		}

		protected override void InitDragControlPlaceHolder()
		{
			base.InitDragControlPlaceHolder();
			HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.SetGroupHeader(base.DragControlPlaceHolder, HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.GetGroupHeader(base.DragControl));
		}

		protected void MoveGroupHeaderAndStoreOriginalValues(UIElement from, UIElement to)
		{
			if (GroupHeaderOriginalValues == null)
			{
				GroupHeaderOriginalValues = new Dictionary<UIElement, object>();
			}
			object groupHeader = HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.GetGroupHeader(from);
			if (!GroupHeaderOriginalValues.ContainsKey(from))
			{
				GroupHeaderOriginalValues.Add(from, groupHeader);
			}
			HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.SetGroupHeader(from, DependencyProperty.UnsetValue);
			if (to != null)
			{
				if (!GroupHeaderOriginalValues.ContainsKey(to))
				{
					GroupHeaderOriginalValues.Add(to, HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.GetGroupHeader(to));
				}
				HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.SetGroupHeader(to, groupHeader);
			}
		}

		protected void RestoreGroupHeaderOriginalValues()
		{
			if (GroupHeaderOriginalValues == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<UIElement, object> groupHeaderOriginalValue in GroupHeaderOriginalValues)
			{
				HeaderedStackLayoutPanel.SetGroupHeader(groupHeaderOriginalValue.Key, groupHeaderOriginalValue.Value);
			}
		}
	}

			};

		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement item in (Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)((PanelBase)this).GetLogicalChildren(false))
			{
				if (!UIElementExtensions.GetVisible((UIElement)item))
				{
					item.Measure(availableSize);
				}
			}
			return LayoutProvider.Measure(((PanelBase)this).GetLogicalChildren(true), availableSize, CreateLayoutProviderParameters());
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnArrange(Rect bounds)
		{
			Rect viewPortBounds = bounds;
			if (((Controller)Controller).IsScrollable())
			{
				RectHelper.Offset(ref bounds, 0.0 - ((ScrollControl)this).HorizontalOffset, 0.0 - ((ScrollControl)this).VerticalOffset);
			}
			return LayoutProvider.Arrange(((PanelBase)this).GetLogicalChildren(true), bounds, viewPortBounds, CreateLayoutProviderParameters());
		}

		protected override Thickness GetContentPadding()
		{
			Thickness contentPadding = ((PanelBase)this).GetContentPadding();
			ThicknessHelper.Inc(ref contentPadding, Padding);
			return contentPadding;
		}

		protected virtual void AfterArrange()
		{
		}

		protected abstract LayoutPanelProviderBase CreateLayoutProvider();

		protected virtual LayoutPanelParametersBase CreateLayoutProviderParameters()

			Parameters = parameters;

		public virtual void CopyLayoutInfo(FrameworkElement from, FrameworkElement to)
		{
			to.Width = from.Width;
			to.Height = from.Height;
			to.MinWidth = from.DesiredSize.Width - (from.Margin.Left + from.Margin.Right);
			to.MinHeight = from.DesiredSize.Height - (from.Margin.Top + from.Margin.Bottom);
			to.MaxWidth = from.MaxWidth;
			to.MaxHeight = from.MaxHeight;
			to.Margin = from.Margin;
			to.HorizontalAlignment = from.HorizontalAlignment;
			to.VerticalAlignment = from.VerticalAlignment;
		}

		public virtual void UpdateChildBounds(FrameworkElement child, ref Rect bounds)
		{
		}

		{
		}

		{
			return new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Size OnArrange(FrameworkElements items, Rect bounds, Rect viewPortBounds)
		{
			return RectHelper.Size(bounds);
		}

		protected virtual void OnParametersChanged()
		{
		}
	}

				return bounds;

		public LayoutPanelControllerBase(ILayoutPanelBase control)
			: base((IScrollControl)control)
		{
		}

		public virtual FrameworkElement GetMoveableItem(System.Windows.Point p)
		{
			return (FrameworkElement)((PanelControllerBase)this).IPanel.ChildAt(p, true, true, false);
		}

		protected virtual bool CanItemDragAndDrop()
		{
			return ILayoutControl.AllowItemMoving;
		}

		{
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual DragAndDropController CreateItemDragAndDropController(System.Windows.Point startDragPoint, FrameworkElement dragControl)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override bool WantsDragAndDrop(System.Windows.Point p, out DragAndDropController controller)
		{
			if (WantsItemDragAndDrop(p, (System.Windows.Point point) => GetMoveableItem(point), out controller))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((ScrollControlController)this).WantsDragAndDrop(p, ref controller);
		}

		protected bool WantsItemDragAndDrop(System.Windows.Point p, Func<System.Windows.Point, FrameworkElement> getItem, out DragAndDropController controller)
		{
			if (CanItemDragAndDrop())
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = getItem(p);
				if (frameworkElement != null && CanDragAndDropItem(frameworkElement))
				{
					controller = CreateItemDragAndDropController(p, frameworkElement);
					return true;
				}
			}
			controller = null;
			return false;
		}
	}
	public abstract class LayoutPanelDragAndDropControllerBase : DragAndDropController
	{
		public static double DragImageOpacity = 0.7;

		private object _MaxWidthStoredValue;

		private object _MaxHeightStoredValue;

		private object _OpacityStoredValue;

		public System.Windows.Point StartDragRelativePoint { get; set; }

		protected override bool AllowAutoScrolling => true;

		protected LayoutPanelControllerBase Controller => (LayoutPanelControllerBase)(object)((DragAndDropController)this).Controller;

		protected FrameworkElement DragControl { get; private set; }

		protected int DragControlIndex { get; private set; }

		protected System.Windows.Point DragControlOrigin { get; private set; }

		protected Panel DragControlParent { get; private set; }

		protected FrameworkElement DragControlPlaceHolder { get; private set; }

		protected bool IsDragControlVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (DragControlParent != null)
				{
					return UIElementExtensions.GetVisible((UIElement)DragControlParent);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected System.Windows.Size DragImageSize
		{
			get
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = FrameworkElementExtensions.GetSize(((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage);
				if (size == SizeHelper.Zero)
				{
					size = ((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage.DesiredSize;
					SizeHelper.Deflate(ref size, ((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage.Margin);
				}
				return size;
			}
		}

		public LayoutPanelDragAndDropControllerBase(Controller controller, System.Windows.Point startDragPoint, FrameworkElement dragControl)
			: base(controller, startDragPoint)
		{
			DragControl = dragControl;
			DragControlParent = (Panel)controller.Control;
			if (IsDragControlVisible)
			{
				DragControlOrigin = FrameworkElementExtensions.GetPosition(DragControl, ((Controller)Controller).Control);
				DragControlPlaceHolder = CreateDragControlPlaceHolder();
				InitDragControlPlaceHolder();
			}
			else
			{
				DragControlOrigin = PointHelper.Empty;
			}
			DragControlIndex = ((DragControlParent != null) ? DragControlParent.Children.IndexOf(DragControl) : (-1));
			if (!PointHelper.IsEmpty(DragControlOrigin))
			{
				StartDragRelativePoint = new System.Windows.Point((((DragAndDropController)this).StartDragPoint.X - DragControlOrigin.X) / DragControl.ActualWidth, (((DragAndDropController)this).StartDragPoint.Y - DragControlOrigin.Y) / DragControl.ActualHeight);
			}
		}

		protected virtual FrameworkElement CreateDragControlPlaceHolder()
		{
			return new Canvas();
		}

		protected virtual void InitDragControlPlaceHolder()
		{
			if (DragControlPlaceHolder is Panel)
			{
				((Panel)DragControlPlaceHolder).Background = Controller.ILayoutControl.MovingItemPlaceHolderBrush;
			}
			Controller.LayoutProvider.CopyLayoutInfo(DragControl, DragControlPlaceHolder);
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement CreateDragImage()
		{
			return DragControl;
		}

		protected override void InitializeDragImage()
		{
			_MaxWidthStoredValue = DependencyObjectExtensions.StorePropertyValue((DependencyObject)((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage, FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty);
			_MaxHeightStoredValue = DependencyObjectExtensions.StorePropertyValue((DependencyObject)((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage, FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty);
			_OpacityStoredValue = DependencyObjectExtensions.StorePropertyValue((DependencyObject)((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage, UIElement.OpacityProperty);
			((DragAndDropController)this).InitializeDragImage();
			if (double.IsNaN(((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage.Width))
			{
				((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage.MaxWidth = Math.Min(((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage.MaxWidth, ((PanelControllerBase)Controller).IPanel.ContentBounds.Width);
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage.Height))
			{
				((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage.MaxHeight = Math.Min(((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage.MaxHeight, ((PanelControllerBase)Controller).IPanel.ContentBounds.Height);
			}
			((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage.Opacity = DragImageOpacity;
			if (IsDragControlVisible)
			{
				DragControlParent.Children.Insert(DragControlIndex, DragControlPlaceHolder);
			}
		}

		protected override void FinalizeDragImage()
		{
			if (IsDragControlVisible)
			{
				DragControlParent.Children.Remove(DragControlPlaceHolder);
			}
			DependencyObjectExtensions.RestorePropertyValue((DependencyObject)((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage, FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty, _MaxWidthStoredValue);
			DependencyObjectExtensions.RestorePropertyValue((DependencyObject)((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage, FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty, _MaxHeightStoredValue);
			DependencyObjectExtensions.RestorePropertyValue((DependencyObject)((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage, UIElement.OpacityProperty, _OpacityStoredValue);
			((DragAndDropController)this).FinalizeDragImage();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Point GetDragImageOffset()
		{
			System.Windows.Size dragImageSize = DragImageSize;
			return new System.Windows.Point(0.0 - Math.Floor(StartDragRelativePoint.X * dragImageSize.Width) - ((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage.Margin.Left, 0.0 - Math.Floor(StartDragRelativePoint.Y * dragImageSize.Height) - ((DragAndDropController)this).DragImage.Margin.Top);
		}
	}
