		private System.Windows.Size GetItemMinOrMaxSize(FrameworkElement item, System.Windows.Size originalMinOrMaxSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = originalMinOrMaxSize;
			if (!double.IsNaN(item.Width))
			{
				result.Width = FrameworkElementExtensions.GetRealWidth(item);
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(item.Height))
			{
				result.Height = FrameworkElementExtensions.GetRealHeight(item);
			}
			SizeHelper.Inflate(ref result, item.Margin);
			return result;
		}

		protected System.Windows.Size GetItemDesiredSize(FrameworkElement item)
		{
			return UIElementExtensions.GetDesiredSize((UIElement)item);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateTotalSize(ref double totalLength, ref double totalWidth, System.Windows.Size itemSize)
		{
			totalLength += GetItemLength(itemSize);
			totalWidth = Math.Max(totalWidth, GetItemWidth(itemSize));
		}

		protected virtual void MeasureItem(FrameworkElement item, System.Windows.Size maxSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size itemMinSize = GetItemMinSize(item, getActualMinSize: false);
			SetItemLength(ref maxSize, Math.Max(GetItemLength(itemMinSize), GetItemLength(maxSize)));
			SetItemWidth(ref maxSize, double.PositiveInfinity);
			item.Measure(maxSize);
		}

		protected void MeasureItem(FrameworkElement item, System.Windows.Size maxSize, ref double totalLength, ref double totalWidth)
		{
			MeasureItem(item, maxSize);
			UpdateTotalSize(ref totalLength, ref totalWidth, GetItemDesiredSize(item));
		}

		public virtual HorizontalAlignment GetItemHorizontalAlignment(FrameworkElement item)
		{
			HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment = item.HorizontalAlignment;
			if (horizontalAlignment == HorizontalAlignment.Stretch && !double.IsNaN(item.Width))
			{
				horizontalAlignment = ((!Model.IsHorizontal) ? HorizontalAlignment.Center : HorizontalAlignment.Left);
			}
			return horizontalAlignment;
		}

		public virtual VerticalAlignment GetItemVerticalAlignment(FrameworkElement item)
		{
			VerticalAlignment verticalAlignment = item.VerticalAlignment;
			if (verticalAlignment == VerticalAlignment.Stretch && !double.IsNaN(item.Height))
			{
				verticalAlignment = (Model.IsHorizontal ? VerticalAlignment.Center : VerticalAlignment.Top);
			}
			return verticalAlignment;
		}

		internal ItemAlignment GetItemAlignment(FrameworkElement item)
		{
			if (!Parameters.AllowItemAlignment)
			{
				return ItemAlignment.Start;
			}
			if (!Model.IsHorizontal)
			{
				return GetItemVerticalAlignment(item).GetItemAlignment();
			}
			return GetItemHorizontalAlignment(item).GetItemAlignment();
		}

		protected virtual void MeasureStretchedItems(FrameworkElements stretchedItems, double availableLength, double availableWidth, ref double totalLength, ref double totalWidth)
		{
			if (double.IsInfinity(availableLength))
			{
				System.Windows.Size itemSize = GetItemSize(availableLength, availableWidth);
				{
					foreach (FrameworkElement item in (Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)stretchedItems)
					{
						MeasureItem(item, itemSize, ref totalLength, ref totalWidth);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			StretchedLengthsCalculator stretchedLengthsCalculator = new StretchedLengthsCalculator(availableLength);
			foreach (FrameworkElement item2 in (Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)stretchedItems)
			{
				stretchedLengthsCalculator.Add(new StackLayoutPanelItemInfo(0.0, GetItemLength(GetItemMinSize(item2, getActualMinSize: true)), GetItemLength(GetItemMaxSize(item2, getActualMaxSize: true)), ItemAlignment.Stretch));
			}
			stretchedLengthsCalculator.Calculate();
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)stretchedItems).Count; i++)
			{
				MeasureItem(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)stretchedItems)[i], GetItemSize(stretchedLengthsCalculator[i].Length, availableWidth));
				flag = flag || GetItemLength(GetItemDesiredSize(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)stretchedItems)[i])) == stretchedLengthsCalculator[i].Length;
			}
			if (flag && !stretchedLengthsCalculator.NeedsMoreLength)
			{
				UpdateTotalSize(ref totalLength, ref totalWidth, GetItemSize(availableLength, 0.0));
			}
			else
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				foreach (FrameworkElement item3 in (Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)stretchedItems)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, GetItemLength(GetItemDesiredSize(item3)));
				}
				double num2 = 0.0;
				for (int j = 0; j < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)stretchedItems).Count; j++)
				{
					if (stretchedLengthsCalculator[j].Length < num && stretchedLengthsCalculator[j].Length != stretchedLengthsCalculator[j].MaxLength)
					{
						MeasureItem(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)stretchedItems)[j], GetItemSize(num, availableWidth));
					}
					num2 += Math.Min(num, stretchedLengthsCalculator[j].MaxLength);
				}
				UpdateTotalSize(ref totalLength, ref totalWidth, GetItemSize(num2, 0.0));
			}
			foreach (FrameworkElement item4 in (Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)stretchedItems)
			{
				UpdateTotalSize(ref totalLength, ref totalWidth, GetItemSize(0.0, GetItemWidth(GetItemDesiredSize(item4))));
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnMeasure(FrameworkElements items, System.Windows.Size maxSize)
		{
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			LayoutItems = items;
			double num = (double)(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count - 1) * Parameters.ItemSpace;
			SetItemLength(ref maxSize, Math.Max(0.0, GetItemLength(maxSize) - num));
			double totalLength;
			double totalWidth;
			while (true)
			{
				System.Windows.Size itemSize = maxSize;
				SetItemLength(ref itemSize, double.PositiveInfinity);
				totalLength = 0.0;
				totalWidth = 0.0;
				FrameworkElements val = new FrameworkElements();
				foreach (FrameworkElement item in (Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)
				{
					if (GetItemAlignment(item) == ItemAlignment.Stretch)
					{
						((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)val).Add(item);
					}
					else
					{
						MeasureItem(item, itemSize, ref totalLength, ref totalWidth);
					}
				}
				if (((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)val).Count != 0)
				{
					MeasureStretchedItems(val, Math.Max(0.0, GetItemLength(maxSize) - totalLength), GetItemWidth(maxSize), ref totalLength, ref totalWidth);
				}
				if (totalWidth <= GetItemWidth(maxSize))
				{
					break;
				}
				SetItemWidth(ref maxSize, totalWidth);
			}
			System.Windows.Size itemSize2 = GetItemSize((totalLength != 0.0) ? (totalLength + num) : 0.0, totalWidth);
			return new System.Windows.Size(Math.Min(itemSize2.Width, maxSize.Width), Math.Min(itemSize2.Height, maxSize.Height));
		}

		private StackLayoutPanelItemInfos CreateItemInfos(double availableLength, double itemSpace)

			RectHelper.SetLocation(ref itemBounds, itemLocation);
		}

		protected virtual bool CanArrangeItem(FrameworkElement item)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnArrange(FrameworkElements items, Rect bounds, Rect viewPortBounds)
		{
			HiddenItemsCount = 0;
			VisibleChildren.Clear();
			LayoutItems = items;
			StackLayoutPanelItemInfos stackLayoutPanelItemInfos = CreateItemInfos(GetItemLength(RectHelper.Size(bounds)), Parameters.ItemSpace);
			foreach (FrameworkElement item in (Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)
			{
				stackLayoutPanelItemInfos.Add(new StackLayoutPanelItemInfo(GetItemLength(GetItemDesiredSize(item)), GetItemLength(GetItemMinSize(item, getActualMinSize: true)), GetItemLength(GetItemMaxSize(item, getActualMaxSize: true)), GetItemAlignment(item)));
			}
			stackLayoutPanelItemInfos.Calculate();
			ArrangeInfos = new LayoutPanelArrangeInfos();
			double itemOffset = GetItemOffset(bounds);
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count; i++)
			{
				System.Windows.Point itemLocation = default(System.Windows.Point);
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[i];
				System.Windows.Size itemSize = GetItemDesiredSize(frameworkElement);
				SetItemOffset(ref itemLocation, itemOffset + stackLayoutPanelItemInfos[i].Offset);
				SetItemLength(ref itemSize, stackLayoutPanelItemInfos[i].Length);
				Rect rect = new Rect(itemLocation, itemSize);
				if (Model.IsHorizontal)
				{
					RectHelper.AlignVertically(ref rect, bounds, GetItemVerticalAlignment(frameworkElement));
					if (!CanArrangeItem(frameworkElement) || (Parameters.AllowItemClipping && rect.Right > bounds.Width + 0.5))
					{
						double width = (rect.Height = 0.0);
						rect.Width = width;
						HiddenItemsCount++;
					}
					else
					{
						VisibleChildren.Add(frameworkElement);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					RectHelper.AlignHorizontally(ref rect, bounds, GetItemHorizontalAlignment(frameworkElement));
					if (Parameters.AllowItemClipping)
					{
						if (rect.Bottom > bounds.Height)
						{
							double width = (rect.Height = 0.0);
							rect.Width = width;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						VisibleChildren.Add(frameworkElement);
					}
				}
				frameworkElement.Arrange(rect);
				ArrangeInfos.Add(new LayoutPanelArrangeInfo
				{
					ArrangeBounds = rect
				});
			}
			return RectHelper.Size(bounds);
		}
	}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnMeasure(FrameworkElements items, System.Windows.Size maxSize)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size = maxSize;
			LayoutItems = items;
			double num = (double)(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count - 1) * Parameters.ItemSpace;
			SetItemLength(ref maxSize, Math.Max(0.0, GetItemLength(maxSize) - num));
			int num2 = 0;
			double totalLength;
			double totalWidth;
			while (true)
			{
				System.Windows.Size itemSize = maxSize;
				SetItemLength(ref itemSize, double.PositiveInfinity);
				totalLength = 0.0;
				totalWidth = 0.0;
				num2 = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count; i++)
				{
					FrameworkElement item = ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[i];
					MeasureItem(item, itemSize, ref totalLength, ref totalWidth);
					System.Windows.Size itemDesiredSize = GetItemDesiredSize(item);
					if (!CanArrangeItem(item) || (Parameters.AllowItemClipping && totalLength + Parameters.ItemSpace * (double)i > size.Width))
					{
						totalLength -= itemDesiredSize.Width;
						break;
					}
					num2++;
				}
				if (totalWidth <= GetItemWidth(maxSize))
				{
					break;
				}
				SetItemWidth(ref maxSize, totalWidth);
			}
			num = (double)(num2 - 1) * Parameters.ItemSpace;
			System.Windows.Size itemSize2 = GetItemSize((totalLength != 0.0) ? (totalLength + num) : 0.0, totalWidth);
			return new System.Windows.Size(Math.Min((int)(itemSize2.Width + 0.5), size.Width), Math.Min(itemSize2.Height, size.Height));
		}

			if (verticalAlignment == VerticalAlignment.Stretch && !double.IsNaN(item.Height))
			{
				verticalAlignment = (Model.IsHorizontal ? VerticalAlignment.Center : VerticalAlignment.Top);
			}
			return verticalAlignment;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size OnArrange(FrameworkElements items, Rect bounds, Rect viewPortBounds)
		{
			LayoutItems = items;
			StackLayoutPanelItemInfos stackLayoutPanelItemInfos = CreateItemInfos(GetItemLength(RectHelper.Size(bounds)), Parameters.ItemSpace);
			foreach (FrameworkElement item in (Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)
			{
				stackLayoutPanelItemInfos.Add(new StackLayoutPanelItemInfo(GetItemLength(GetItemDesiredSize(item)), GetItemLength(GetItemMinSize(item, getActualMinSize: true)), GetItemLength(GetItemMaxSize(item, getActualMaxSize: true)), ItemAlignment.Start));
			}
			stackLayoutPanelItemInfos.Calculate();
			ArrangeInfos = new LayoutPanelArrangeInfos();
			double itemOffset = GetItemOffset(bounds);
			HiddenItemsCount = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count; i++)
			{
				System.Windows.Point itemLocation = default(System.Windows.Point);
				System.Windows.Size itemSize = GetItemDesiredSize(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[i]);
				SetItemOffset(ref itemLocation, itemOffset + stackLayoutPanelItemInfos[i].Offset);
				SetItemLength(ref itemSize, stackLayoutPanelItemInfos[i].Length);
				Rect rect = new Rect(itemLocation, itemSize);
				if (Model.IsHorizontal)
				{
					RectHelper.AlignVertically(ref rect, bounds, GetItemVerticalAlignment(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[i]));
					if (!CanArrangeItem(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[i]) || (Parameters.AllowItemClipping && rect.Right > bounds.Width + 0.5))
					{
						double width = (rect.Height = 0.0);
						rect.Width = width;
						HiddenItemsCount++;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					RectHelper.AlignHorizontally(ref rect, bounds, GetItemHorizontalAlignment(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[i]));
					if (Parameters.AllowItemClipping && rect.Bottom > bounds.Height)
					{
						double width = (rect.Height = 0.0);
						rect.Width = width;
						HiddenItemsCount++;
					}
				}
				((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[i].Arrange(rect);
				ArrangeInfos.Add(new LayoutPanelArrangeInfo
				{
					ArrangeBounds = rect
				});
			}
			return RectHelper.Size(bounds);
		}
	}
	public class LayoutPanelArrangeInfo
	{
		public Rect ArrangeBounds { get; set; }
	}
	public class LayoutPanelArrangeInfos : List<LayoutPanelArrangeInfo>
	{
	}
	internal enum ItemAlignment
	{
		Start,
		Center,
		End,
		Stretch
	}
	internal static class ItemAlignmentExtensions
	{
		public static ItemAlignment GetItemAlignment(this HorizontalAlignment alignment)
		{
			return alignment switch
			{
				HorizontalAlignment.Left => ItemAlignment.Start, 
				HorizontalAlignment.Center => ItemAlignment.Center, 
				HorizontalAlignment.Right => ItemAlignment.End, 
				HorizontalAlignment.Stretch => ItemAlignment.Stretch, 
				_ => ItemAlignment.Start, 
			};
		}

		public static ItemAlignment GetItemAlignment(this VerticalAlignment alignment)
		{
			return alignment switch
			{
				VerticalAlignment.Top => ItemAlignment.Start, 
				VerticalAlignment.Center => ItemAlignment.Center, 
				VerticalAlignment.Bottom => ItemAlignment.End, 
				VerticalAlignment.Stretch => ItemAlignment.Stretch, 
				_ => ItemAlignment.Start, 
			};
		}

		public static HorizontalAlignment GetHorizontalAlignment(this ItemAlignment alignment)
		{
			return alignment switch
			{
				ItemAlignment.Start => HorizontalAlignment.Left, 
				ItemAlignment.Center => HorizontalAlignment.Center, 
				ItemAlignment.End => HorizontalAlignment.Right, 
				ItemAlignment.Stretch => HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, 
				_ => HorizontalAlignment.Left, 
			};
		}

		public static VerticalAlignment GetVerticalAlignment(this ItemAlignment alignment)
		{
			return alignment switch
			{
				ItemAlignment.Start => VerticalAlignment.Top, 
				ItemAlignment.Center => VerticalAlignment.Center, 
				ItemAlignment.End => VerticalAlignment.Bottom, 
				ItemAlignment.Stretch => VerticalAlignment.Stretch, 
				_ => VerticalAlignment.Top, 
			};
		}
	}
	internal class StackLayoutPanelItemInfo
	{
		public double Offset = double.NaN;

		public ItemAlignment Alignment { get; private set; }

		public bool IsProcessed { get; set; }

		public double Length { get; set; }

		public double MinLength { get; set; }

		public double MaxLength { get; private set; }

		public StackLayoutPanelItemInfo(double length, double minLength, double maxLength, ItemAlignment alignment)
		{
			MinLength = minLength;
			MaxLength = maxLength;
			Length = length;
			Alignment = alignment;
		}
	}
	internal class StackLayoutPanelItemInfos : List<StackLayoutPanelItemInfo>
	{
		public double AvailableLength { get; private set; }

		public double ItemSpace { get; private set; }

		protected double CenteredLength => GetLength(ItemAlignment.Center);

		protected double FixedLength => Length - GetLength(ItemAlignment.Stretch);

		protected double Length => GetLength(null);

		public StackLayoutPanelItemInfos(double availableLength, double itemSpace)
		{
			AvailableLength = availableLength;
			ItemSpace = itemSpace;
		}

		public virtual void ArrangeItems(FrameworkElements items, Func<FrameworkElement, ItemAlignment> getItemAlignment)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			while (num3 < ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count - (num + num2))
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items)[num3];
				switch (getItemAlignment(frameworkElement))
				{
				case ItemAlignment.Center:
					((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).RemoveAt(num3);
					((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Insert(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count - num2, frameworkElement);
					num++;
					break;
				case ItemAlignment.End:
					((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).RemoveAt(num3);
					((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Insert(((Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)items).Count, frameworkElement);
					num2++;
					break;
				default:
					num3++;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void Calculate()
		{
			CalculateStretchedLengths();
			CalculateOffsets();
		}

		protected virtual void CalculateOffsets()
		{
			double num = CalculateOffsets(0.0, forward: true, (StackLayoutPanelItemInfo itemInfo) => itemInfo.Alignment == ItemAlignment.Start || itemInfo.Alignment == ItemAlignment.Stretch);
			double num2 = CalculateOffsets(Math.Max(Length, AvailableLength), forward: false, (StackLayoutPanelItemInfo itemInfo) => itemInfo.Alignment == ItemAlignment.End);
			CalculateOffsets(Math.Round((num + num2 - CenteredLength) / 2.0), forward: true, (StackLayoutPanelItemInfo itemInfo) => itemInfo.Alignment == ItemAlignment.Center);
		}

		protected virtual double CalculateOffsets(double offset, bool forward, Predicate<StackLayoutPanelItemInfo> isItemForProcessing)
		{
			int num = ((!forward) ? (base.Count - 1) : 0);
			while ((forward && num < base.Count) || (!forward && num >= 0))
			{
				StackLayoutPanelItemInfo stackLayoutPanelItemInfo = base[num];
				if (isItemForProcessing(stackLayoutPanelItemInfo))
				{
					if (!forward)
					{
						offset -= stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.Length;
					}
					stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.Offset = offset;
					offset = ((!forward) ? (offset - ItemSpace) : (offset + (stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.Length + ItemSpace)));
				}
				num = ((!forward) ? (num - 1) : (num + 1));
			}
			return offset;
		}

		protected virtual void CalculateStretchedLengths()
		{
			List<StackLayoutPanelItemInfo> stretchedItems = GetStretchedItems();
			if (stretchedItems.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			StretchedLengthsCalculator stretchedLengthsCalculator = new StretchedLengthsCalculator(Math.Max(0.0, AvailableLength - FixedLength - (double)(stretchedItems.Count - 1) * ItemSpace));
			stretchedLengthsCalculator.AddRange(stretchedItems);
			if (stretchedLengthsCalculator.CanFitItemsUniformly())
			{
				stretchedLengthsCalculator.ForEach(delegate(StackLayoutPanelItemInfo item)
				{
					item.MinLength = item.Length;
					item.Length = 0.0;
				});
			}
			stretchedLengthsCalculator.Calculate();
		}

		protected virtual double GetLength(ItemAlignment? alignment)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					StackLayoutPanelItemInfo current = enumerator.Current;
					if (!alignment.HasValue || current.Alignment == alignment)
					{
						num += current.Length + ItemSpace;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num != 0.0)
			{
				num -= ItemSpace;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected List<StackLayoutPanelItemInfo> GetStretchedItems()
		{
			List<StackLayoutPanelItemInfo> list = new List<StackLayoutPanelItemInfo>();
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				StackLayoutPanelItemInfo current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Alignment == ItemAlignment.Stretch)
				{
					list.Add(current);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal class StretchedLengthsCalculator : List<StackLayoutPanelItemInfo>
	{
		public double AvailableLength { get; private set; }

		public bool NeedsMoreLength { get; private set; }

		protected double ItemsLength
		{
			get
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					StackLayoutPanelItemInfo current = enumerator.Current;
					if (!current.IsProcessed)
					{
						num += current.Length;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public StretchedLengthsCalculator(double availableLength)
		{
			AvailableLength = availableLength;
		}

		public void Calculate()
		{
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			double availableLength = (double.IsInfinity(AvailableLength) ? ItemsLength : AvailableLength);
			while (true)
			{
				double itemsLength = ItemsLength;
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				double num3 = 0.0;
				double num4 = 0.0;
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
				{
					StackLayoutPanelItemInfo stackLayoutPanelItemInfo = base[i];
					if (!stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.IsProcessed)
					{
						double num5 = ((itemsLength == 0.0) ? GetUniformStretchedOffset(i + 1) : Math.Round(availableLength * (num + stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.Length) / itemsLength));
						num += stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.Length;
						stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.Length = num5 - num2;
						num2 += stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.Length;
						if (stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.Length < stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.MinLength)
						{
							num3 += stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.MinLength - stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.Length;
						}
						if (stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.Length > stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.MaxLength)
						{
							num4 += stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.Length - stackLayoutPanelItemInfo.MaxLength;
						}
					}
				}
				if (num3 != 0.0 || num4 != 0.0)
				{
					NeedsMoreLength = num3 != 0.0;
					ProcessMinOrMaxLengthItems(num3 > num4, ref availableLength);
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		public bool CanFitItemsUniformly()
		{
			return ItemsLength != AvailableLength;
		}

		protected double GetUniformStretchedOffset(int index)
		{
			if (base.Count == 1)
			{
				return AvailableLength * (double)index;
			}
			return Math.Round(AvailableLength * (double)index / (double)base.Count);
		}

		protected void ProcessMinOrMaxLengthItems(bool processMinLengthItems, ref double availableLength)
		{
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					StackLayoutPanelItemInfo current = enumerator.Current;
					if (!current.IsProcessed && ((processMinLengthItems && current.Length < current.MinLength) || (!processMinLengthItems && current.Length > current.MaxLength)))
					{
						if (processMinLengthItems)
						{
							current.Length = current.MinLength;
						}
						else
						{
							current.Length = current.MaxLength;
						}
						current.IsProcessed = true;
						availableLength -= current.Length;
					}
				}
			}
			availableLength = Math.Max(0.0, availableLength);
		}
	}

	public class ElementBoundsAnimation
	{
		protected class ElementBounds : Dictionary<FrameworkElement, Rect>
		{
		}

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		protected static readonly DependencyProperty ClipRectWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ClipRectWidth", typeof(double), typeof(ElementBoundsAnimation), new PropertyMetadata(OnClipRectSizeChanged));

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		protected static readonly DependencyProperty ClipRectHeightProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ClipRectHeight", typeof(double), typeof(ElementBoundsAnimation), new PropertyMetadata(OnClipRectSizeChanged));

		public bool IsActive => Storyboard != null;

		protected FrameworkElements Elements { get; private set; }

		protected ElementBounds NewElementBounds { get; private set; }

		protected ElementBounds OldElementBounds { get; private set; }

		protected Storyboard Storyboard { get; private set; }

		protected Action StoryboardCompleted { get; private set; }

		private static void OnClipRectSizeChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (o is UIElement { Clip: RectangleGeometry { Rect: var rect } clip })
			{
				if (e.Property == ClipRectWidthProperty)
				{
					rect.Width = (double)e.NewValue;
				}
				else
				{
					rect.Height = (double)e.NewValue;
				}
				clip.Rect = rect;
			}
		}

		public ElementBoundsAnimation(FrameworkElements elements)
		{
			Elements = elements;
		}

		public bool Begin(TimeSpan duration, IEasingFunction easingFunction = null, Action onCompleted = null)
		{
			if (IsActive)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Storyboard = new Storyboard();
			foreach (FrameworkElement key in OldElementBounds.Keys)
			{
				Rect rect = OldElementBounds[key];
				Rect rect2 = NewElementBounds[key];
				AnimateElementPosition(Storyboard, key, RectHelper.Location(rect), RectHelper.Location(rect2));
				AnimateElementSize(Storyboard, key, RectHelper.Size(rect), RectHelper.Size(rect2));
			}
			if (Storyboard.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				Storyboard = null;
				if (onCompleted != null)
				{
					onCompleted();
				}
				return false;
			}
			foreach (DoubleAnimation child in Storyboard.Children)
			{
				child.Duration = duration;
				child.EasingFunction = easingFunction;
			}
			StoryboardCompleted = delegate
			{
				Storyboard.Stop();
				foreach (FrameworkElement key2 in OldElementBounds.Keys)
				{
					if (DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertyAssigned((DependencyObject)key2, UIElement.RenderTransformProperty))
					{
						key2.ClearValue(UIElement.RenderTransformProperty);
					}
					if (DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertyAssigned((DependencyObject)key2, UIElement.ClipProperty))
					{
						key2.ClearValue(UIElement.ClipProperty);
					}
				}
				StoryboardCompleted = null;
				Storyboard = null;
				if (onCompleted != null)
				{
					onCompleted();
				}
			};
			Storyboard.Completed += delegate
			{
				if (StoryboardCompleted != null)
				{
					StoryboardCompleted();
				}
			};
			Storyboard.Begin();
			return true;
		}

		public void Stop()
		{
			if (IsActive)
			{
				Storyboard.SkipToFill();
				StoryboardCompleted();
			}
		}

		public void StoreNewElementBounds(FrameworkElement relativeTo = null)
		{
			NewElementBounds = GetElementBounds(relativeTo);
		}

		public void StoreOldElementBounds(FrameworkElement relativeTo = null)
		{
			OldElementBounds = GetElementBounds(relativeTo);
		}

		protected void AnimateElementPosition(Storyboard storyboard, FrameworkElement element, System.Windows.Point oldPosition, System.Windows.Point newPosition)
		{
			if (!(newPosition == oldPosition))
			{
				element.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform();
				storyboard.Children.Add(CreateDoubleAnimation(element, "(RenderTransform).X", oldPosition.X - newPosition.X, 0.0));
				storyboard.Children.Add(CreateDoubleAnimation(element, "(RenderTransform).Y", oldPosition.Y - newPosition.Y, 0.0));
			}
		}

		protected void AnimateElementSize(Storyboard storyboard, FrameworkElement element, System.Windows.Size oldSize, System.Windows.Size newSize)
		{
			if (!(newSize == oldSize) && !(newSize.Width < oldSize.Width) && !(newSize.Height < oldSize.Height))
			{
				element.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = SizeHelper.ToRect(oldSize)
				};
				storyboard.Children.Add(CreateDoubleAnimation(element, ClipRectWidthProperty, oldSize.Width, newSize.Width));
				storyboard.Children.Add(CreateDoubleAnimation(element, ClipRectHeightProperty, oldSize.Height, newSize.Height));
			}
		}

		protected DoubleAnimation CreateDoubleAnimation(FrameworkElement element, object property, double from, double to)
		{
			DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation();
			Storyboard.SetTarget(doubleAnimation, element);
			Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation, (property is string) ? new PropertyPath((string)property) : new PropertyPath(property));
			doubleAnimation.From = from;
			doubleAnimation.To = to;
			return doubleAnimation;
		}

		protected ElementBounds GetElementBounds(FrameworkElement relativeTo = null)
		{
			ElementBounds elementBounds = new ElementBounds();
			foreach (FrameworkElement item in (Collection<FrameworkElement>)(object)Elements)
			{
				elementBounds.Add(item, (relativeTo == null) ? FrameworkElementExtensions.GetBounds(item) : FrameworkElementExtensions.GetBounds(item, relativeTo));
			}
			return elementBounds;
		}
	}

			OrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Orientation", typeof(Orientation), typeof(ScrollableControl), new PropertyMetadata(Orientation.Horizontal, OnOrientationChanged));

			ScrollPrevProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ScrollPrev", typeof(IDelegateCommand), typeof(ScrollableControl));
			IsScrollableProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsScrollable", typeof(bool), typeof(ScrollableControl), new UIPropertyMetadata(true, OnIsScrollableChanged));
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ScrollableControl>.New().OverrideMetadata(FlyoutSourceTypeHelper.FlyoutSourceTypeProperty, (Action<ScrollableControl>)delegate(ScrollableControl d)
			{
				d.OnFlyoutSourceTypeChanged();
			}).Register<ScrollButtonColorMode>("ScrollButtonColorMode", ref ScrollButtonColorModeProperty, ScrollButtonColorMode.Default, (Action<ScrollableControl>)delegate
			{
			}, (Func<ScrollableControl, ScrollButtonColorMode, ScrollButtonColorMode>)((ScrollableControl d, ScrollButtonColorMode value) => d.CoerceScrollButtonColorMode(value)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		{

				scrollableControl.OnOrientationChanged((Orientation)e.OldValue, (Orientation)e.NewValue);

		private static void OnScrollButtonModeChanged(DependencyObject o, ScrollButtonMode oldValue, ScrollButtonMode newValue)
		{
			if (o is ScrollableControl scrollableControl)
			{
				scrollableControl.UpdateVisualState();
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsScrollableChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (o is ScrollableControl scrollableControl)
			{
				scrollableControl.OnIsScrollableChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		public ScrollableControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ScrollableControl>(this);
			ScrollNext = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(OnScrollNext, CanScrollNext, useCommandManager: false);
			ScrollPrev = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(OnScrollPrev, CanScrollPrev, useCommandManager: false);
		}

		public void InvalidateScroll()
		{
			ScrollNext.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			ScrollPrev.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartScrollablePanel = base.Content as IScrollablePanel;
			if (PartScrollablePanel == null)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = base.Content as System.Windows.Controls.ItemsPresenter;
				if (frameworkElement != null)
				{
					frameworkElement.SizeChanged += OnItemsPresenterSizeChanged;
				}
			}
			if (PartScrollablePanel != null)
			{
				PartScrollablePanel.ScrollOwner = this;
				PartScrollablePanel.Orientation = Orientation;
			}
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsScrollableChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnOrientationChanged(Orientation oldValue, Orientation newValue)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
			if (PartScrollablePanel != null)
			{
				PartScrollablePanel.Orientation = newValue;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "EmptyOrientationState", useTransitions: false);
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, Orientation.ToString(), useTransitions: false);
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, (!IsScrollable) ? "DisabledScroll" : ((ScrollButtonMode == ScrollButtonMode.Default) ? "DefaultScroll" : "OverlappedScroll"), useTransitions: false);
		}

		private bool CanScrollNext()
		{
			EnsureScrollablePanel();
			if (PartScrollablePanel != null)
			{
				return PartScrollablePanel.CanScrollNext;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CanScrollPrev()
		{
			EnsureScrollablePanel();
			if (PartScrollablePanel != null)
			{
				return PartScrollablePanel.CanScrollPrev;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private ScrollButtonColorMode CoerceScrollButtonColorMode(ScrollButtonColorMode value)
		{
			if ((DependencyObjectExtensions.IsInDesignTool((DependencyObject)this) || FlyoutSourceTypeHelper.GetFlyoutSourceType(this) != FlyoutSourceType.FromTileBar) && value != ScrollButtonColorMode.Inverted)
			{
				return ScrollButtonColorMode.Default;
			}
			return ScrollButtonColorMode.Inverted;
		}

		private IScrollablePanel EnsureScrollablePanel()
		{
			if (PartScrollablePanel == null || (base.IsLoaded && !PartScrollablePanel.IsLoaded))
			{
				PartScrollablePanel = LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)this, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement x) => x is IScrollablePanel)) as IScrollablePanel;
				if (PartScrollablePanel != null)
				{
					PartScrollablePanel.ScrollOwner = this;
					PartScrollablePanel.Orientation = Orientation;
				}
			}
			return PartScrollablePanel;
		}

		private void OnFlyoutSourceTypeChanged()
		{
			CoerceValue(ScrollButtonColorModeProperty);
		}

		private void OnItemsPresenterSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				frameworkElement.SizeChanged -= OnItemsPresenterSizeChanged;
			}
			EnsureScrollablePanel();
		}

		private void OnScrollNext()
		{
			EnsureScrollablePanel();
			if (PartScrollablePanel != null && PartScrollablePanel.CanScrollNext)
			{
				PartScrollablePanel.ScrollNext();
				if (this.ScrollChanged != null)
				{
					this.ScrollChanged(this, new EventArgs());
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnScrollPrev()
		{
			EnsureScrollablePanel();
			if (PartScrollablePanel != null && PartScrollablePanel.CanScrollPrev)
			{
				PartScrollablePanel.ScrollPrev();
				if (this.ScrollChanged != null)
				{
					this.ScrollChanged(this, new EventArgs());
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal static class CommandHelper
	{
		internal static bool CanExecuteCommand(ICommandSource commandSource)
		{
			ICommand command = commandSource.Command;
			if (command != null)
			{
				object commandParameter = commandSource.CommandParameter;
				IInputElement inputElement = commandSource.CommandTarget;
				if (command is RoutedCommand routedCommand)
				{
					if (inputElement == null)
					{
						inputElement = commandSource as IInputElement;
					}
					return routedCommand.CanExecute(commandParameter, inputElement);
				}
				return command.CanExecute(commandParameter);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void ExecuteCommand(ICommandSource commandSource)
		{
			ICommand command = commandSource.Command;
			if (command == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object commandParameter = commandSource.CommandParameter;
			IInputElement inputElement = commandSource.CommandTarget;
			if (command is RoutedCommand routedCommand)
			{
				if (inputElement == null)
				{
					inputElement = commandSource as IInputElement;
				}
				if (routedCommand.CanExecute(commandParameter, inputElement))
				{
					routedCommand.Execute(commandParameter, inputElement);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (command.CanExecute(commandParameter))
			{
				command.Execute(commandParameter);
			}
		}
	}

	public class DynamicStandardControlResourceExtension : ThemeResourceExtensionBase
	{
		private const string themesPrefix = "DevExpress.Xpf.Themes";

		private string themeName;

		protected sealed override string Namespace
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsDefault(themeName))
				{
					return "DevExpress.Xpf.Core.v23.2".Remove("DevExpress.Xpf.Core.v23.2".Length - ".v23.2".Length);
				}
				return string.Format("{0}.{1}", "DevExpress.Xpf.Themes", themeName);
			}
		}

		public DynamicStandardControlResourceExtension(string resourcePath)
			: base(resourcePath)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetResourcePath(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			themeName = ThemeNameHelper.GetThemeName(serviceProvider);
			if (IsDefault(themeName))
			{
				return "Themes/DeepBlue/StandardControlStyles/" + ((ThemeResourceExtensionBase)this).ResourcePath;
			}
			if (((ThemeResourceExtensionBase)this).ShortPaths)
			{
				return $"Core/Core/Themes/{themeName}/StandardControlStyles.XAML";
			}
			return string.Format("{0}/{0}/Themes/StandardControlStyles.XAML", "DevExpress.Xpf.Core");
		}

		private bool IsDefault(string themeName)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(themeName))
			{
				return string.Equals(themeName, "DeepBlue", StringComparison.Ordinal);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class AlignmentHelper
	{
		private static List<Tuple<TextAlignment, VerticalAlignment, HorizontalAlignment>> list;

		static AlignmentHelper()
		{
			list = new List<Tuple<TextAlignment, VerticalAlignment, HorizontalAlignment>>();
			AddRow((TextAlignment)512, VerticalAlignment.Bottom, HorizontalAlignment.Center);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)8096, VerticalAlignment.Bottom, HorizontalAlignment.Stretch);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)256, VerticalAlignment.Bottom, HorizontalAlignment.Left);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)1024, VerticalAlignment.Bottom, HorizontalAlignment.Right);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)32, VerticalAlignment.Center, HorizontalAlignment.Center);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)4096, VerticalAlignment.Center, HorizontalAlignment.Stretch);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)16, VerticalAlignment.Center, HorizontalAlignment.Left);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)64, VerticalAlignment.Center, HorizontalAlignment.Right);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)32, VerticalAlignment.Stretch, HorizontalAlignment.Center);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)4096, VerticalAlignment.Stretch, HorizontalAlignment.Stretch);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)16, VerticalAlignment.Stretch, HorizontalAlignment.Left);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)64, VerticalAlignment.Stretch, HorizontalAlignment.Right);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)2, VerticalAlignment.Top, HorizontalAlignment.Center);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)2048, VerticalAlignment.Top, HorizontalAlignment.Stretch);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)1, VerticalAlignment.Top, HorizontalAlignment.Left);
			AddRow((TextAlignment)4, VerticalAlignment.Top, HorizontalAlignment.Right);
		}

		private static void AddRow(TextAlignment textAlignment, VerticalAlignment verticalAlignment, HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment)
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			list.Add(new Tuple<TextAlignment, VerticalAlignment, HorizontalAlignment>(textAlignment, verticalAlignment, horizontalAlignment));
		}

		public static TextAlignment GetFullAlignment(VerticalAlignment verticalContentAlignment, HorizontalAlignment horizontalContentAlignment)
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (Tuple<TextAlignment, VerticalAlignment, HorizontalAlignment> item in list)
			{
				if (item.Item2 == verticalContentAlignment && item.Item3 == horizontalContentAlignment)
				{
					return item.Item1;
				}
			}
			throw new ArgumentException();
		}
	}
	public class XamlEnumTypeConverter<T> : TypeConverter where T : struct
	{
		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			return Enum.Parse(typeof(T), (string)value);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}
	}
	public static class WindowsFormsHelper
	{
		public static System.Windows.Media.Brush ConvertBrush(System.Drawing.Brush brush)
		{
			System.Drawing.Color color = ((SolidBrush)brush).Color;
			return new SolidColorBrush(ConvertColor(color));
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Brush ConvertColorToBrush(System.Drawing.Color color)
		{
			return new SolidColorBrush(ConvertColor(color));
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color ConvertColor(System.Drawing.Color color)
		{
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(color.A, color.R, color.G, color.B);
		}

		public static TextAlignment ConvertStringToTextAlignment(StringAlignment stringAlignment)
		{
			return stringAlignment switch
			{
				StringAlignment.Near => TextAlignment.Left, 
				StringAlignment.Center => TextAlignment.Center, 
				StringAlignment.Far => TextAlignment.Right, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(), 
			};
		}

		public static System.Drawing.Color ConvertBrushToColor(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			if (brush == null || !(brush is SolidColorBrush))
			{
				return System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(0);
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = (brush as SolidColorBrush).Color;
			return System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(color.A, color.R, color.G, color.B);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color ConvertBrushToColor(System.Drawing.Brush brush)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color result = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0);
			if (brush == null || !(brush is SolidBrush))
			{
				return result;
			}
			System.Drawing.Color color = (brush as SolidBrush).Color;
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(color.A, color.R, color.G, color.B);
		}
	}

	public class BookAnimator
	{
		public bool IsUninterruptedAnimation
		{
			get
			{
				if (AnimationType != BookAnimationType.None)
				{
					return AnimationType != BookAnimationType.LeaveActiveArea;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool IsTurnPageAnimation
		{
			get
			{
				if (AnimationType != BookAnimationType.TurnPage && AnimationType != BookAnimationType.TurnOnePageForward)
				{
					return AnimationType == BookAnimationType.TurnOnePageBackward;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool IsPartialTurnAnimation
		{
			get
			{
				if (AnimationType != BookAnimationType.PartialTurnForward)
				{
					return AnimationType == BookAnimationType.PartialTurnBackward;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal Book Book { get; set; }

		protected internal BookGeometryParams Params => Book.GeometryParams;

		protected internal BookEventHandler Handler => Book.EventHandler;

		protected internal BookDragTracker Tracker => Book.DragTracker;

		protected internal BookViewState ViewState
		{
			get
			{
				return Handler.ViewState;
			}
			set
			{
				Handler.ViewState = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal System.Windows.Point OddPoint => RectHelper.BottomLeft(OddPageRect);

		protected internal System.Windows.Point EvenPoint => RectHelper.BottomRight(EvenPageRect);

		protected internal virtual System.Windows.Point PartialTurnForwardEndPoint => new System.Windows.Point
		{
			X = EvenPoint.X - Book.BookWidth * Book.PartialTurnEndPoint.X,
			Y = EvenPoint.Y - Book.BookHeight * Book.PartialTurnEndPoint.Y
		};

		protected internal virtual System.Windows.Point PartialTurnBackwardEndPoint => new System.Windows.Point
		{
			X = OddPoint.X + Book.BookWidth * Book.PartialTurnEndPoint.X,
			Y = OddPoint.Y - Book.BookHeight * Book.PartialTurnEndPoint.Y
		};

		protected internal double TurnPageRadius => Math.Sqrt(AvgPageWidth * AvgPageWidth + AvgPageHeight * AvgPageHeight);

		protected internal double AvgPageWidth
		{
			get
			{
				double num = (double.IsNaN(OddPageRect.Width) ? 0.0 : OddPageRect.Width);
				double num2 = (double.IsNaN(EvenPageRect.Width) ? 0.0 : EvenPageRect.Width);
				if (!(num > num2))
				{
					return num2;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		protected internal double AvgPageHeight
		{
			get
			{
				double num = (double.IsNaN(OddPageRect.Height) ? 0.0 : OddPageRect.Height);
				double num2 = (double.IsNaN(EvenPageRect.Height) ? 0.0 : EvenPageRect.Height);
				if (!(num > num2))
				{
					return num2;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		protected internal double AnimationRate => Book.AnimationRate;

		protected internal double AnimationSpeed => Book.AnimationSpeed;

		protected internal double ShortAnimationSpeed => Book.ShortAnimationSpeed;

		public virtual Rect OddPageRect => Params.OddPageRect;

		public virtual Rect EvenPageRect => Params.EvenPageRect;

		protected internal DispatcherTimer Timer { get; set; }

		protected internal PathBuilder Builder { get; set; }

		protected internal BookAnimationType AnimationType { get; set; }

		protected internal int AnimationCounter { get; set; }

		public BookAnimator(Book book)
		{
			Book = book;
			Timer = new DispatcherTimer();
			Timer.Interval = new TimeSpan((long)(1000000.0 / AnimationRate));
			Timer.Tick += delegate
			{
				TimerTick();
			};
			AnimationType = BookAnimationType.None;
		}

		public void Start(BookAnimationType type)
		{
			Cancel();
			AnimationType = type;
			switch (type)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case BookAnimationType.LeaveActiveArea:
				CreateLinePathBuilder(Tracker.BaseCornerPoint, ShortAnimationSpeed);
				break;
			case BookAnimationType.TurnPage:
				CreateLinePathBuilder(Tracker.TurnPageEndPoint, AnimationSpeed);
				break;
			case BookAnimationType.ReturnPage:
				CreateLinePathBuilder(Tracker.BaseCornerPoint, AnimationSpeed);
				break;
			case BookAnimationType.TurnOnePageForward:
				TurnOnePage(BookViewState.Next, EvenPoint, OddPoint);
				break;
			case BookAnimationType.TurnOnePageBackward:
				TurnOnePage(BookViewState.Prev, OddPoint, EvenPoint);
				break;
			case BookAnimationType.PartialTurnForward:
				TurnOnePage(BookViewState.Next, EvenPoint, PartialTurnForwardEndPoint);
				break;
			case BookAnimationType.PartialTurnBackward:
				TurnOnePage(BookViewState.Prev, OddPoint, PartialTurnBackwardEndPoint);
				break;
			case BookAnimationType.PartialReturn:
				Book.EventHandler.IsPartialTurn = false;
				CreateLinePathBuilder(Tracker.BaseCornerPoint, AnimationSpeed);
				break;
			}
			BeginAnimation();
		}

		public void Cancel()
		{
			Timer.Stop();
			AnimationType = BookAnimationType.None;
		}

		protected internal void CreateLinePathBuilder(System.Windows.Point endPoint, double speed)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Builder = new PathBuilder(Tracker.DragPoint, endPoint, AnimationRate / speed);
			Builder.CreateLinePath();
		}

		protected internal void TurnOnePage(BookViewState state, System.Windows.Point startPoint, System.Windows.Point endPoint)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Handler.ViewState = state;
			Builder = new PathBuilder(startPoint, endPoint, AnimationRate / AnimationSpeed);
			System.Windows.Point point = RectExtension.TopMiddle(Params.BookRect);
			Builder.CreateArcPath(TurnPageRadius, point, false);
			Tracker.StartDrag(Builder.StartPoint);
		}

		protected internal void BeginAnimation()
		{
			if (AnimationType == BookAnimationType.TurnOnePageBackward || AnimationType == BookAnimationType.TurnOnePageForward || AnimationType == BookAnimationType.PartialTurnBackward || AnimationType == BookAnimationType.PartialTurnForward)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = Builder.GetPoint();
				AnimationCounter = Builder.NumberOfPoints - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				AnimationCounter = Builder.NumberOfPoints;
			}
			Timer.Start();
		}

		protected internal virtual void EndAnimation()
		{
			if (IsTurnPageAnimation)
			{
				TurnThePage();
			}
			if (IsPartialTurnAnimation)
			{
				Book.EventHandler.IsPartialTurn = true;
			}
			else
			{
				Handler.ViewState = BookViewState.Current;
			}
			Cancel();
		}

		protected internal virtual void TimerTick()
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = Builder.GetPoint();
			if (AnimationCounter != 0)
			{
				AnimationCounter--;
			}
			else
			{
				EndAnimation();
			}
			try
			{
				UpdateDragPoint(point);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		protected internal void UpdateDragPoint(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			Tracker.ContinueDrag(point);
			Book.UpdateAllProperties();
		}

		protected internal void TurnThePage()
		{
			Book.PageIndex += ((Handler.ViewState == BookViewState.Next) ? 2 : (-2));
		}
	}

	public class BookEventHandler
	{
		protected internal Book Book { get; set; }

		protected internal BookViewState ViewState { get; set; }

		protected internal bool IsPartialTurn { get; set; }

		protected internal BookPageManager PageManager => Book.PageManager;

		protected internal BookDragTracker Tracker => Book.DragTracker;

		protected internal BookAnimator Animator => Book.Animator;

		protected internal BookActiveAreaHelper ActiveAreaHelper { get; set; }

		protected internal bool IsMouseTrackedEverywhere { get; set; }

		protected internal bool IsUninterruptedAnimation => Animator.IsUninterruptedAnimation;

		public BookEventHandler(Book book)
		{
			Book = book;
			ActiveAreaHelper = new BookActiveAreaHelper(book);
			ViewState = BookViewState.Current;
			IsMouseTrackedEverywhere = false;
		}

		public void OnMouseMove(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (IsUninterruptedAnimation)
			{
				ActiveAreaHelper.Reset();
				return;
			}
			if (IsMouseTrackedEverywhere)
			{
				TrackPointWithoutAnimation(point);
				return;
			}
			ActiveAreaHelper.Track(point);
			if (ActiveAreaHelper.IsInsideAnyActiveArea && CheckAndChangeViewState(point))
			{
				TrackPointWithoutAnimation(point);
			}
			else if (ActiveAreaHelper.IsLeaveActiveArea)
			{
				OnLeaveActiveArea();
			}
		}

		public void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			ActiveAreaHelper.Reset();
			if (!IsUninterruptedAnimation && !IsMouseTrackedEverywhere && Book.ActualWidth != 0.0 && Book.ActualHeight != 0.0)
			{
				OnLeaveActiveArea();
			}
		}

		public void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (!IsUninterruptedAnimation)
			{
				IsMouseTrackedEverywhere = CheckAndChangeViewState(point);
				if (IsMouseTrackedEverywhere)
				{
					Book.CaptureMouse();
					TrackPointWithoutAnimation(point);
				}
			}
		}

		public void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (IsMouseTrackedEverywhere)
			{
				Book.ReleaseMouseCapture();
				IsMouseTrackedEverywhere = false;
				BookAnimationType type = (Tracker.EndDrag(point) ? BookAnimationType.TurnPage : BookAnimationType.ReturnPage);
				Animator.Start(type);
			}
		}

		protected internal void OnLeaveActiveArea()
		{
			Animator.Start(BookAnimationType.LeaveActiveArea);
		}

		public bool CheckAndChangeViewState(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			BookViewState desiredViewState = GetDesiredViewState(point);
			bool flag = PageManager.CanChangePagesViewStateTo(desiredViewState);
			if (flag)
			{
				ViewState = desiredViewState;
				Tracker.StartDrag(point);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected internal void TrackPointWithoutAnimation(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			Animator.Cancel();
			Tracker.ContinueDrag(point);
			Book.UpdateAllProperties();
		}

		protected internal BookViewState GetDesiredViewState(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RectCorner val = RectExtension.NearestCorner(Book.GeometryParams.BookRect, point);
			if (!RectCornerExtension.IsRight(val))
			{
				return BookViewState.Prev;
			}
			return BookViewState.Next;
		}
	}
	public class BookActiveAreaHelper
	{
		protected internal enum BookActiveAreaHelperResult
		{
			Outside,
			Entered,
			Leaved,
			Changed,
			Inside
		}

		public bool IsInsideAnyActiveArea
		{
			get
			{
				if (Result != BookActiveAreaHelperResult.Entered && Result != BookActiveAreaHelperResult.Inside)
				{
					return Result == BookActiveAreaHelperResult.Changed;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool IsLeaveActiveArea => Result == BookActiveAreaHelperResult.Leaved;

		protected internal BookActiveAreaHelperResult Result { get; set; }

		protected internal BookGeometryParams Params { get; set; }

		protected internal System.Windows.Size ActiveAreaSize => Params.ActiveAreaSize;

		protected internal double Right => Params.BookWidth - ActiveAreaSize.Width;

		protected internal double Bottom => Params.BookHeight - ActiveAreaSize.Height;

		protected internal RectCorner? CurrentCorner { get; set; }

		public BookActiveAreaHelper(Book book)
		{
			Params = book.GeometryParams;
			Reset();
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			CurrentCorner = null;
		}

		public void Track(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			Result = CheckPoint(point);
		}

		protected internal BookActiveAreaHelperResult CheckPoint(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RectCorner? currentCorner = CurrentCorner;
			CurrentCorner = GetActiveAreaCorner(point);
			if (!currentCorner.HasValue)
			{
				if (!CurrentCorner.HasValue)
				{
					return BookActiveAreaHelperResult.Outside;
				}
				return BookActiveAreaHelperResult.Entered;
			}
			if (!CurrentCorner.HasValue)
			{
				return BookActiveAreaHelperResult.Leaved;
			}
			if (CurrentCorner.Value != currentCorner.Value)
			{
				return BookActiveAreaHelperResult.Changed;
			}
			return BookActiveAreaHelperResult.Inside;
		}

		protected internal RectCorner? GetActiveAreaCorner(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Array values = EnumExtensions.GetValues(typeof(RectCorner));
			foreach (RectCorner item in values)
			{
				if (IsInsideArea(point, item))
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal bool IsInsideArea(System.Windows.Point point, RectCorner corner)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Rect rect = CreateRect(corner);
			return RectExtension.IsInside(rect, point);
		}

		protected internal Rect CreateRect(RectCorner corner)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new Rect(CreateLeftTopPoint(corner), ActiveAreaSize);
		}

		protected internal System.Windows.Point CreateLeftTopPoint(RectCorner corner)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (corner - 1) switch
			{
				0 => new System.Windows.Point(Right, 0.0), 
				1 => new System.Windows.Point(Right, Bottom), 
				2 => new System.Windows.Point(0.0, Bottom), 
				_ => new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), 
			};
		}
	}
	public class BookDragTracker
	{
		private const double EdgeRadiusSafeDecrement = 0.01;

		public System.Windows.Point DragPoint { get; private set; }

		public RectCorner BaseCorner { get; private set; }

		public System.Windows.Point BaseCornerPoint => RectExtension.Corner(BasePageRect, BaseCorner);

		public System.Windows.Point BaseNearCornerPoint => RectExtension.Corner(BasePageRect, BaseNearCorner);

		public MathLine BaseLine => new MathLine(BaseCornerPoint, BaseNearCornerPoint);

		public MathLine DraggingLine => new MathLine(BaseCornerPoint, DragPoint);

		public MathLine CuttingLine => DraggingLine.Perpendicular(PointExtension.MiddlePoint(BaseCornerPoint, DragPoint));

		public double PageHeight => BasePageRect.Height;

		public double PageWidth => BasePageRect.Width;

		public Rect BasePageRect
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (!RectCornerExtension.IsRight(BaseCorner))
				{
					return OddPageRect;
				}
				return EvenPageRect;
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Point TurnPageEndPoint => RectExtension.Corner(MirrorPageRect, BaseNearCorner);

		protected internal Book Book { get; set; }

		protected internal BookGeometryParams Params => Book.GeometryParams;

		protected internal Rect BookRect => Params.BookRect;

		protected internal Rect OddPageRect => Params.OddPageRect;

		protected internal Rect EvenPageRect => Params.EvenPageRect;

		protected internal double SmallRadius => PageWidth;

		protected internal double BigRadius => Math.Sqrt(PageWidth * PageWidth + PageHeight * PageHeight);

		protected internal System.Windows.Point BaseFarCornerPoint => RectExtension.Corner(BasePageRect, RectCornerExtension.DiagonalMirror(BaseCorner));

		protected internal Rect MirrorPageRect
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (!RectCornerExtension.IsRight(BaseCorner))
				{
					return EvenPageRect;
				}
				return OddPageRect;
			}
		}

		protected internal RectCorner BaseNearCorner => RectCornerExtension.HorizontalMirror(BaseCorner);

		public BookDragTracker(Book book)
		{
			Book = book;
		}

		public void StartDrag(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			BaseCorner = RectExtension.NearestCorner(BookRect, point);
			SetDragPoint(point);
		}

		public void ContinueDrag(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			SetDragPoint(point);
		}

		public bool EndDrag(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SetDragPoint(point);
			RectCorner val = RectExtension.NearestCorner(BookRect, DragPoint);
			return !RectCornerExtension.IsSameHorizontalSide(val, BaseCorner);
		}

		protected internal void SetDragPoint(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			DragPoint = CalcActualDraggingPoint(point);
		}

		protected internal System.Windows.Point CalcActualDraggingPoint(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_008a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0090: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (IsDragPointValid(point))
			{
				return point;
			}
			if (BaseLine.IsSameSide(point, BaseFarCornerPoint))
			{
				return PointExtension.RadialEdgePoint(BaseNearCornerPoint, point, SmallRadius - 0.01);
			}
			MathLine val = new MathLine(BaseCornerPoint, BaseFarCornerPoint);
			if (val.IsDifferentSide(point, BaseNearCornerPoint))
			{
				return BaseCornerPoint;
			}
			MathLine val2 = new MathLine(BaseNearCornerPoint, BaseFarCornerPoint);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = PointExtension.MirrorPoint(BaseCornerPoint, val2);
			val = new MathLine(point2, BaseFarCornerPoint);
			if (val.IsDifferentSide(point, BaseNearCornerPoint))
			{
				return point2;
			}
			return PointExtension.RadialEdgePoint(BaseFarCornerPoint, point, BigRadius - 0.01);
		}

		protected internal bool IsDragPointValid(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (PointExtensions.Distance(point, BaseNearCornerPoint) <= SmallRadius)
			{
				return PointExtensions.Distance(point, BaseFarCornerPoint) <= BigRadius;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class BookPageManager
	{
		public double BaseForeShadowWidth => Pages[BookPageLayout.NextEven].BaseForeShadowWidth;

		public double OverlayForeShadowWidth => Pages[BookPageLayout.NextOdd].OverlayForeShadowWidth;

		public double BackShadowWidth => Pages[BookPageLayout.NextOdd].BackShadowWidth;

		public Rect OddPageRect => OddPage.PageRect;

		public Rect EvenPageRect => EvenPage.PageRect;

		protected internal Book Book { get; set; }

		protected internal Dictionary<BookPageLayout, BookPage> Pages { get; set; }

		protected internal int BasePageIndex
		{
			get
			{
				int num = Book.PageIndex + FirstPageIndex;
				if (num < FirstPageIndex)
				{
					num = FirstPageIndex;
				}
				if (num > LastPageIndex)
				{
					num = LastPageIndex;
				}
				if (num % 2 == 0)
				{
					return num - 1;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		protected internal IList BookDataSource => Book.DataSource;

		protected internal DataTemplate Template => Book.PageTemplate;

		protected internal int PageCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (BookDataSource != null)
				{
					return BookDataSource.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool IsNextPage => PageIndex(BookPageLayout.NextOdd) != -1;

		protected internal bool IsPrevPage => PageIndex(BookPageLayout.PrevEven) != -1;

		protected internal BookViewState State => Book.EventHandler.ViewState;

		protected internal bool IsPrevView => State == BookViewState.Prev;

		protected internal bool IsNextView => State == BookViewState.Next;

		protected internal BookPage OddPage => Pages[BookPageLayout.Odd];

		protected internal BookPage EvenPage => Pages[BookPageLayout.Even];

		protected internal int FirstPageIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (Book.FirstPage != PageType.Odd)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		protected internal int LastPageIndex => FirstPageIndex + PageCount - 1;

		public BookPageManager(Book book)
		{
			Book = book;
		}

		public bool CanChangePagesViewStateTo(BookViewState desiredState)
		{
			bool flag = desiredState == BookViewState.Next && IsNextPage;
			bool flag2 = desiredState == BookViewState.Prev && IsPrevPage;
			return flag || flag2;
		}

		public void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			InitializePagesDictionary();
			InitializePagesProperties();
		}

		public void UpdateAllProperties()
		{
			if (Pages == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateDragPoint();
			foreach (BookPageLayout key in Pages.Keys)
			{
				UpdateContentProperty(key);
				UpdateTemplateProperty(key);
				UpdateVisibilityProperty(key);
				UpdateClipProperty(key);
				UpdateTransformProperties(key);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateDragPoint()
		{
			if (Book.BookWidth != 0.0 && Book.BookHeight != 0.0 && Book.EventHandler.IsPartialTurn)
			{
				System.Windows.Point dragPoint = ((Book.EventHandler.ViewState == BookViewState.Next) ? Book.Animator.PartialTurnForwardEndPoint : Book.Animator.PartialTurnBackwardEndPoint);
				Book.DragTracker.SetDragPoint(dragPoint);
			}
		}

		protected internal void InitializePagesDictionary()
		{
			Pages = new Dictionary<BookPageLayout, BookPage>();
			Array values = EnumExtensions.GetValues(typeof(BookPageLayout));
			foreach (BookPageLayout item in values)
			{
				BookPage value = new BookPage(Book, item);
				Pages.Add(item, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal void InitializePagesProperties()
		{
			BookGeometryParams geometryParams = Book.GeometryParams;
			foreach (BookPageLayout key in Pages.Keys)
			{
				BookPage bookPage = Pages[key];
				bookPage.SetTemplate(Template);
				bookPage.SetHorizontalContentAlignment(HorizontalAlignment.Stretch);
				bookPage.SetVerticalContentAlignment(VerticalAlignment.Stretch);
				bookPage.SetZIndex(ZIndex(key));
				bookPage.SetColumn(GetPageColumn(key));
				bookPage.SetShadowHeight(geometryParams.ShadowHeight);
				bookPage.SetShadowTop(geometryParams.ShadowTop);
			}
		}

		protected virtual int GetPageColumn(BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			return (int)layout % 2;
		}

		protected internal void ClearContentProperty(BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			Pages[layout].SetContent(null);
		}

		protected internal void ClearTemplateProperty(BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			Pages[layout].SetTemplate(null);
		}

		protected internal void UpdateContentProperty(BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			Pages[layout].SetContent(PageContent(layout));
		}

		protected internal void UpdateTemplateProperty(BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			Pages[layout].SetTemplate(PageTemplate(layout));
		}

		protected internal void UpdateVisibilityProperty(BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			Pages[layout].SetVisible(IsVisible(layout));
		}

		protected internal void UpdateClipProperty(BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			Geometry clip = BookClipBuilder.CreateClip(Book, layout);
			Pages[layout].SetClip(clip);
		}

		protected internal void UpdateTransformProperties(BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			Array values = EnumExtensions.GetValues(typeof(BookTemplateElementType));
			foreach (BookTemplateElementType item in values)
			{
				if (IsTransform(layout, item))
				{
					Transform transform = CreateTransform(Book, layout, item);
					Pages[layout].SetTransform(item, transform);
				}
			}
		}

		public Transform CreateTransform(Book book, BookPageLayout layout, BookTemplateElementType element)
		{
			BookTransformBuilder bookTransformBuilder = CreateTransformBuilder(book, layout, element);
			RotateTransform value = new RotateTransform
			{
				CenterX = bookTransformBuilder.RotationX,
				CenterY = bookTransformBuilder.RotationY,
				Angle = bookTransformBuilder.RotationAngle
			};
			TranslateTransform value2 = new TranslateTransform
			{
				X = bookTransformBuilder.TranslationX,
				Y = bookTransformBuilder.TranslationY
			};
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			transformGroup.Children.Add(value);
			transformGroup.Children.Add(value2);
			return transformGroup;
		}

		protected internal BookTransformBuilder CreateTransformBuilder(Book book, BookPageLayout layout, BookTemplateElementType element)
		{
			return element switch
			{
				BookTemplateElementType.Grid => CreateGridTransformBuilder(book, layout, element), 
				BookTemplateElementType.BaseForeShadow => new BookBaseForeShadowTransformBuilder(book, layout, element), 
				BookTemplateElementType.OverlayForeShadow => new BookOverlayForeShadowTransformBuilder(book, layout, element), 
				BookTemplateElementType.BackShadow => new BookBackShadowTransformBuilder(book, layout, element), 
				_ => new BookTransformBuilder(book, layout, element), 
			};
		}

		public virtual BookGridTransformBuilder CreateGridTransformBuilder(Book book, BookPageLayout layout, BookTemplateElementType element)
		{
			return new BookGridTransformBuilder(book, layout, element);
		}

		protected internal int PageIndex(BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			int num = (int)(BasePageIndex + layout - 2);
			if (!IsPageIndexInRange(num))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected internal object PageContent(BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			int num = PageIndex(layout);
			if (!IsPageIndexInRange(num))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return BookDataSource[num - FirstPageIndex];
		}

		protected internal DataTemplate PageTemplate(BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			if (!IsLayoutPageIndexInRange(layout))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Template;
		}

		protected internal bool IsLayoutPageIndexInRange(BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			return IsPageIndexInRange(PageIndex(layout));
		}

		protected internal bool IsPageIndexInRange(int index)
		{
			if (index >= FirstPageIndex)
			{
				return index <= LastPageIndex;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool IsVisible(BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			bool flag = layout == BookPageLayout.Even || layout == BookPageLayout.Odd;
			bool flag2 = IsPrevView && (layout == BookPageLayout.PrevEven || layout == BookPageLayout.PrevOdd);
			bool flag3 = IsNextView && (layout == BookPageLayout.NextEven || layout == BookPageLayout.NextOdd);
			return flag || flag2 || flag3;
		}

		protected internal bool IsTransform(BookPageLayout layout, BookTemplateElementType element)
		{
			bool flag = IsPrevView && layout == BookPageLayout.PrevEven;
			bool flag2 = IsNextView && layout == BookPageLayout.NextOdd;
			bool flag3 = (IsPrevView || IsNextView) && element == BookTemplateElementType.BaseForeShadow;
			return flag || flag2 || flag3;
		}

		protected internal static int ZIndex(BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			switch (layout)
			{
			case BookPageLayout.PrevOdd:
			case BookPageLayout.NextEven:
				return -1;
			case BookPageLayout.PrevEven:
			case BookPageLayout.NextOdd:
				return 1;
			default:
				return 0;
			}
		}
	}
