	public class BookTransformBuilder
	{
		protected internal virtual double RotationAngle => 0.0;

		protected internal virtual double RotationX => 0.0;

		protected internal virtual double RotationY => 0.0;

		protected internal virtual double TranslationX => 0.0;

		protected internal virtual double TranslationY => 0.0;

		protected internal double BaseForeShadowWidth => Params.BaseForeShadowWidth;

		protected internal double OverlayForeShadowWidth => Params.OverlayForeShadowWidth;

		protected internal double BackShadowWidth => Params.BackShadowWidth;

		protected internal double DraggingLineAngle => Tracker.DraggingLine.AbscissAngleDeg;

		protected internal bool IsNextOdd => PageLayout == BookPageLayout.NextOdd;

		protected internal bool IsNextEven => PageLayout == BookPageLayout.NextEven;

		protected internal double ShadowRotationPointY => IntersectY - BaseRect.Top - Params.ShadowTop;

		protected internal double ActualBackShadowWidth
		{
			get
			{
				double val = PointExtensions.Distance(Tracker.DragPoint, Tracker.BaseCornerPoint);
				return Math.Min(BackShadowWidth, val) - 2.0;
			}
		}

		protected internal double IntersectX => IntersectPoint.X;

		protected internal double IntersectY => IntersectPoint.Y;

		protected internal System.Windows.Point IntersectPoint
		{
			get
			{
				System.Windows.Point? point = Tracker.CuttingLine.Intersect(Tracker.BaseLine);
				if (!point.HasValue)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Point(10000.0, 10000.0);
				}
				return point.Value;
			}
		}

		protected internal Rect BaseRect => Tracker.BasePageRect;

		protected internal Book Book { get; set; }

		protected internal BookPageLayout PageLayout { get; set; }

		protected internal BookTemplateElementType PageElement { get; set; }

		protected internal BookGeometryParams Params => Book.GeometryParams;

		protected internal BookDragTracker Tracker => Book.DragTracker;

		public BookTransformBuilder(Book book, BookPageLayout layout, BookTemplateElementType element)
		{
			Book = book;
			PageLayout = layout;
			PageElement = element;
		}
	}
	public class BookGridTransformBuilder : BookTransformBuilder
	{
		protected internal override double RotationAngle => base.DraggingLineAngle * 2.0;

		protected internal override double RotationX => base.BaseRect.Right - base.IntersectX;

		protected internal override double RotationY => base.IntersectY - base.BaseRect.Top;

		protected internal override double TranslationX => (base.IntersectX - base.Tracker.BaseNearCornerPoint.X) * 2.0;

		public BookGridTransformBuilder(Book book, BookPageLayout layout, BookTemplateElementType element)
			: base(book, layout, element)
		{
		}
	}
	public class BookBaseForeShadowTransformBuilder : BookTransformBuilder
	{
		protected internal override double RotationAngle => base.DraggingLineAngle;

		protected internal override double RotationX
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.IsNextEven)
				{
					return base.BaseForeShadowWidth;
				}
				return 1.0;
			}
		}

		protected internal override double RotationY => base.ShadowRotationPointY;

		protected internal override double TranslationX => base.IntersectX - base.BaseRect.Left - RotationX;

		public BookBaseForeShadowTransformBuilder(Book book, BookPageLayout layout, BookTemplateElementType element)
			: base(book, layout, element)
		{
		}
	}
	public class BookOverlayForeShadowTransformBuilder : BookTransformBuilder
	{
		protected internal override double RotationAngle => 0.0 - base.DraggingLineAngle;

		protected internal override double RotationX
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.IsNextOdd)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return base.OverlayForeShadowWidth - 1.0;
			}
		}

		protected internal override double RotationY => base.ShadowRotationPointY;

		protected internal override double TranslationX => base.BaseRect.Right - base.IntersectX - RotationX;

		public BookOverlayForeShadowTransformBuilder(Book book, BookPageLayout layout, BookTemplateElementType element)
			: base(book, layout, element)
		{
		}
	}
	public class BookBackShadowTransformBuilder : BookTransformBuilder
	{
		protected internal override double RotationAngle => base.DraggingLineAngle;

		protected internal override double RotationX
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.IsNextOdd)
				{
					return base.BackShadowWidth - base.ActualBackShadowWidth;
				}
				return base.ActualBackShadowWidth;
			}
		}

		protected internal override double RotationY => base.ShadowRotationPointY;

		protected internal override double TranslationX => base.IntersectX - base.BaseRect.Left - RotationX;

		public BookBackShadowTransformBuilder(Book book, BookPageLayout layout, BookTemplateElementType element)
			: base(book, layout, element)
		{
		}
	}
	public class BookClipBuilder
	{
		protected internal Book Book { get; set; }

		protected internal BookPageLayout PageLayout { get; set; }

		protected internal BookDragTracker Tracker => Book.DragTracker;

		protected internal BookPageManager PageManager => Book.PageManager;

		protected internal bool IsPrevView => PageManager.IsPrevView;

		protected internal bool IsNextView => PageManager.IsNextView;

		public BookClipBuilder(Book book, BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			Book = book;
			PageLayout = layout;
		}

		public static Geometry CreateClip(Book book, BookPageLayout layout)
		{
			return new BookClipBuilder(book, layout).CalcClip();
		}

		protected internal Geometry CalcClip()
		{
			PointCollection pointCollection = CalcPoints();
			if (pointCollection == null || pointCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment = new PolyLineSegment
			{
				Points = pointCollection
			};
			PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure
			{
				IsClosed = true,
				StartPoint = polyLineSegment.Points[0]
			};
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(polyLineSegment);
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
			return pathGeometry;
		}

		protected internal PointCollection CalcPoints()
		{
			if (IsClip())
			{
				return CalcClipPoints();
			}
			if (IsRectangle())
			{
				return CalcRectanglePoints();
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal PointCollection CalcClipPoints()
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RectCorner baseCorner = Tracker.BaseCorner;
			RectCorner primaryCorner = RectCornerExtension.DiagonalMirror(baseCorner);
			RectCorner secondaryCorner = RectCornerExtension.HorizontalMirror(baseCorner);
			BookPageTruncator bookPageTruncator = new BookPageTruncator(Tracker.BasePageRect, Tracker.CuttingLine, primaryCorner, secondaryCorner);
			if (PageLayout != BookPageLayout.Even && PageLayout != BookPageLayout.Odd)
			{
				return bookPageTruncator.OverlayPageResult;
			}
			return bookPageTruncator.BasePageResult;
		}

		protected internal PointCollection CalcRectanglePoints()
		{
			BookPageTruncator bookPageTruncator = new BookPageTruncator(Tracker.BasePageRect);
			return bookPageTruncator.BasePageResult;
		}

		protected internal bool IsClip()
		{
			bool flag = IsPrevView && (PageLayout == BookPageLayout.Odd || PageLayout == BookPageLayout.PrevEven);
			bool flag2 = IsNextView && (PageLayout == BookPageLayout.Even || PageLayout == BookPageLayout.NextOdd);
			return flag || flag2;
		}

		protected internal bool IsRectangle()
		{
			bool flag = IsPrevView && PageLayout == BookPageLayout.PrevOdd;
			bool flag2 = IsNextView && PageLayout == BookPageLayout.NextEven;
			return flag || flag2;
		}
	}
	public class BookPageTruncator
	{
		public PointCollection BasePageResult { get; private set; }

		public PointCollection OverlayPageResult { get; private set; }

		protected internal Rect Rectangle { get; set; }

		protected internal MathLine Line { get; set; }

		public BookPageTruncator(Rect rect)
		{
			Rectangle = rect;
			BasePageResult = CreateRectanglePoints(isVisible: true);
		}

		public BookPageTruncator(Rect rect, MathLine line, RectCorner primaryCorner, RectCorner secondaryCorner)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Rectangle = rect;
			Line = line;
			if (!Proceed(primaryCorner))
			{
				Proceed(secondaryCorner);
			}
		}

		protected internal bool Proceed(RectCorner corner)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			RectTruncator val = new RectTruncator(Rectangle, Line, corner);
			RectTruncatorResultType resultType = val.ResultType;
			switch (resultType - 1)
			{
			case 0:
				return false;
			case 1:
				ProceedPaths(val);
				return true;
			case 3:
				ProceedEdgeResult(Line.IsMoreHorizontal);
				return true;
			default:
				ProceedEdgeResult(isBasePageVisible: true);
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal void ProceedEdgeResult(bool isBasePageVisible)
		{
			BasePageResult = CreateRectanglePoints(isBasePageVisible);
			OverlayPageResult = CreateRectanglePoints(!isBasePageVisible);
		}

		protected internal void ProceedPaths(RectTruncator truncator)
		{
			BasePageResult = truncator.ResultPoints;
			OverlayPageResult = truncator.InvertedResultPoints;
			MovePointsToNull(BasePageResult);
			MovePointsToNull(OverlayPageResult);
			HorizontalFlipPoints(OverlayPageResult);
		}

		protected internal void MovePointsToNull(PointCollection points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				points[i] = MovePointToNull(points[i]);
			}
		}

		protected internal System.Windows.Point MovePointToNull(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(point.X - Rectangle.Left, point.Y - Rectangle.Top);
		}

		protected internal void HorizontalFlipPoints(PointCollection points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				points[i] = HorizontalFlipPoint(points[i]);
			}
		}

		protected internal System.Windows.Point HorizontalFlipPoint(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(Rectangle.Width - point.X, point.Y);
		}

		protected internal PointCollection CreateRectanglePoints(bool isVisible)
		{
			PointCollection pointCollection = new PointCollection();
			pointCollection.Add(RectHelper.TopLeft(Rectangle));
			if (isVisible)
			{
				pointCollection.Add(RectHelper.TopRight(Rectangle));
				pointCollection.Add(RectHelper.BottomRight(Rectangle));
				pointCollection.Add(RectHelper.BottomLeft(Rectangle));
			}
			MovePointsToNull(pointCollection);
			return pointCollection;
		}
	}

			if (!LayoutDoubleHelper.AreClose(size, ((UIElement)this).DesiredSize))
			{
				((UIElement)((Visual)this).VisualParent)?.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			return size;
		}
	}

			{
				SetValue(PopupMaxWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate SubItemTemplate

		private BreadcrumbArrowControl PartArrow { get; set; }

		private BreadcrumbButton PartButton { get; set; }

		private BreadcrumbSubItemsControl PartSubItemsContainer { get; set; }

		BreadcrumbNode IBreadcrumbItem.BreadcrumbNode => base.DataContext as BreadcrumbNode;

		public event EventHandler ItemClick
		{
			add

			}

		public event DependencyPropertyChangedEventHandler IsPopupOpenChanged;

		static BreadcrumbItem()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BreadcrumbItem>.New().Register<bool>("IsPopupOpen", ref IsPopupOpenProperty, false, (Action<BreadcrumbItem, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(BreadcrumbItem d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				d.OnIsPopupOpenChanged(e);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<bool>("IsArrowPressed", ref IsArrowPressedProperty, false, (Action<BreadcrumbItem>)delegate(BreadcrumbItem d)
			{
				d.OnIsArrowPressedChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("IsArrowMouseOver", ref IsArrowMouseOverProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("IsButtonPressed", ref IsButtonPressedProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("IsButtonMouseOver", ref IsButtonMouseOverProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("ShowArrow", ref ShowArrowProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<IEnumerable<object>>("SubItems", ref SubItemsProperty, (IEnumerable<object>)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplate>("ButtonContentTemplate", ref ButtonContentTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("ButtonContentTemplateSelector", ref ButtonContentTemplateSelectorProperty, (DataTemplateSelector)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<RotateTransform>("ArrowGlyphTransform", ref ArrowGlyphTransformProperty, (RotateTransform)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplate>("SubItemTemplate", ref SubItemTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("SubItemTemplateSelector", ref SubItemTemplateSelectorProperty, (DataTemplateSelector)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("PopupHeight", ref PopupHeightProperty, double.NaN, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("PopupMinHeight", ref PopupMinHeightProperty, 0.0, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("PopupMaxHeight", ref PopupMaxHeightProperty, double.PositiveInfinity, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("PopupWidth", ref PopupWidthProperty, double.NaN, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("PopupMinWidth", ref PopupMinWidthProperty, 0.0, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("PopupMaxWidth", ref PopupMaxWidthProperty, double.PositiveInfinity, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.OverrideMetadata(UIElement.FocusableProperty, (object)false, (Action<BreadcrumbItem>)null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None)
				.OverrideMetadata(Control.IsTabStopProperty, (object)false, (Action<BreadcrumbItem>)null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None);
			ItemClickEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ItemClick", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler), typeof(BreadcrumbControl));
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			UnsubscribeEvents();
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			BreadcrumbArrowControl breadcrumbArrowControl = (PartArrow = GetTemplateChild("PART_Arrow") as BreadcrumbArrowControl);
			if (breadcrumbArrowControl != null)
			{
				SetBinding(IsArrowPressedProperty, new Binding("IsPressed")
				{
					Source = PartArrow
				});
				SetBinding(IsArrowMouseOverProperty, new Binding("IsMouseOver")
				{
					Source = PartArrow
				});
			}
			PopupControlContainer val = (PartPopup = (PopupControlContainer)/*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/);
			if (val != null)
			{
				SetBinding(IsPopupOpenProperty, new Binding("IsOpen")
				{
					Source = PartPopup
				});
			}
			BreadcrumbButton breadcrumbButton = (PartButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_Button") as BreadcrumbButton);
			if (breadcrumbButton != null)
			{
				SetBinding(IsButtonPressedProperty, new Binding("IsPressed")
				{
					Source = PartButton
				});
				SetBinding(IsButtonMouseOverProperty, new Binding("IsMouseOver")
				{
					Source = PartButton
				});
			}
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			PartButton.Do(delegate(BreadcrumbButton x)
			{
				x.Click += OnButtonClick;
			});
			PartPopup.Do(delegate(PopupControlContainer x)
			{
				((Popup)(object)x).Opened += OnPartPopupOpened;
			});
		}

		private void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
			PartButton.Do(delegate(BreadcrumbButton x)
			{
				x.Click -= OnButtonClick;
			});
			PartPopup.Do(delegate(PopupControlContainer x)
			{
				((Popup)(object)x).Opened -= OnPartPopupOpened;
			});
		}

		private void OnButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(ItemClickEvent, this));
		}

		private void OnPartPopupOpened(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Popup)(object)PartPopup).Opened -= OnPartPopupOpened;
			OnPopupInitialized();
		}

		protected virtual void OnPopupInitialized()
		{
			PartSubItemsContainer.Do(delegate(BreadcrumbSubItemsControl x)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(x);
				x.ItemClick -= OnSubItemClick;
			});
			PartSubItemsContainer = GetTemplateChild("PART_SubItemsContainer") as BreadcrumbSubItemsControl;
			PartSubItemsContainer.Do(delegate(BreadcrumbSubItemsControl x)
			{
				x.ItemClick += OnSubItemClick;
				x.SetBinding(ItemsControl.ItemsSourceProperty, new Binding("SubItems")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			});
		}

		private void OnIsArrowPressedChanged()
		{
			if (IsArrowPressed)
			{
				if (PopupClosedOnArrowClick)
				{
					PopupClosedOnArrowClick = false;
				}
				else if (!((Popup)(object)PartPopup).IsOpen)
				{
					OpenPopup();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnIsPopupOpenChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			PopupClosedOnArrowClick = !IsPopupOpen && Mouse.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && PartArrow.IsMouseOver;
			this.IsPopupOpenChanged?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected void OnSubItemClick(object sender, ItemClickEventArgs args)
		{
			ClosePopup();
			RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(ItemClickEvent, args.Item));
		}

		public void OpenPopup()
		{
			if (AllowOpenPopup())
			{
				SetPopupIsOpen(isOpen: true);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool AllowOpenPopup()
		{
			if (SubItems != null)
			{
				return SubItems.Cast<object>().Any();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ClosePopup()
		{
			SetPopupIsOpen(isOpen: false);
		}

		private void SetPopupIsOpen(bool isOpen)
		{
			PartPopup.Do(delegate(PopupControlContainer x)
			{
				((Popup)(object)x).IsOpen = isOpen;
			});
		}
	}

		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BreadcrumbRootItem>.New().OverrideMetadata(BreadcrumbItem.ShowArrowProperty, (object)true, (Action<BreadcrumbRootItem>)null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None).OverrideMetadata(BreadcrumbItem.SubItemsProperty, (object)null, (Action<BreadcrumbRootItem>)delegate(BreadcrumbRootItem d)
			{
				d.OnSubItemsChanged();
			}, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None)
				.Register<bool>("ShowPredefinedSubItems", ref ShowPredefinedSubItemsProperty, false, (Action<BreadcrumbRootItem>)delegate(BreadcrumbRootItem d)
				{
					d.OnShowPredefinedSubItemsChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<IEnumerable<object>>("PredefinedSubItems", ref PredefinedSubItemsProperty, (IEnumerable<object>)null, (Action<BreadcrumbRootItem>)delegate(BreadcrumbRootItem d)
				{
					d.OnPredefinedSubItemsChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		private void OnSubItemsChanged()
		{
			UpdateSeparatorVisibility();
		}

		private void OnShowPredefinedSubItemsChanged()
		{
			UpdateSeparatorVisibility();
		}

		private void OnPredefinedSubItemsChanged()
		{
			UpdateSeparatorVisibility();
		}

		private void UpdateSeparatorVisibility()
		{
			if (PartSubItemsSeparator != null)
			{
				PartSubItemsSeparator.Visibility = ((!ShowPredefinedSubItems || BreadcrumbDataController.IsEmptyCollection(base.SubItems) || BreadcrumbDataController.IsEmptyCollection(PredefinedSubItems)) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		protected override bool AllowOpenPopup()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnPopupInitialized()
		{
			base.OnPopupInitialized();
			PartPredefinedSubItemsControl.Do(delegate(BreadcrumbSubItemsControl x)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(x);
				x.ItemClick -= base.OnSubItemClick;
			});
			PartPredefinedSubItemsControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_PredefinedSubItemsContainer") as BreadcrumbSubItemsControl;
			PartPredefinedSubItemsControl.Do(delegate(BreadcrumbSubItemsControl x)
			{
				x.ItemClick += base.OnSubItemClick;
				x.SetBinding(ItemsControl.ItemsSourceProperty, new Binding("PredefinedSubItems")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			});
			PartSubItemsSeparator = GetTemplateChild("PART_SubItemsSeparator") as Separator;
			UpdateSeparatorVisibility();
		}
	}

	public static class BreadcrumbHistoryMutator
	{
		public static BreadcrumbHistoryNode CreateHistoryNode(object item, string path, ImageSource image, string text)
		{
			return new BreadcrumbHistoryNode(item, path, image, text);
		}

		public static void ClearHistory(BreadcrumbHistoryNodeCollection history)
		{
			history.Clear();
		}

		public static void AddToHistory(BreadcrumbHistoryNodeCollection history, object item, string path, ImageSource image, string text)
		{
			history.Add(CreateHistoryNode(item, path, image, text));
		}
	}
	public class BreadcrumbRootNode : BreadcrumbNode
	{
		internal BreadcrumbRootNode(BreadcrumbDataController controller)
			: base(null, null, controller)
		{
		}

		protected override ImageSource InitializeImage()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override string InitializeText()
		{
			return base.Controller.EmptySelectionText;
		}

		protected override bool InitializeHasChildNodes()
		{
			return base.Controller.DataProvider.Roots.Any();
		}

		protected override BreadcrumbNodesCollection InitializeChildNodes()
		{
			return new BreadcrumbNodesCollection(this, () => base.Controller.DataProvider.Roots, (object child) => base.Controller.CreateNode(null, child));
		}
	}
	public class BreadcrumbDataController
	{
		public class HistoryChangingEventArgs : CancelEventArgs
		{
			public BreadcrumbHistoryNode Node { get; }

			public BreadcrumbHistoryChangingReason Reason { get; }

			internal HistoryChangingEventArgs(object source, BreadcrumbHistoryNode node, BreadcrumbHistoryChangingReason reason)
			{
				Node = node;
				Reason = reason;
			}
		}

		private enum SelectionChangedKind
		{
			Item,
			Items
		}

		internal enum UpdateNodeProperty
		{
			Text,
			Image,
			HasChildren,
			Children
		}

		private string pathSeparator;

		private bool allowFillHistory;

		private IEnumerable source;

		private string emptyItemText;

		private BreadcrumbLockerAction DataAdapterPropertyChangedAction;

		private BreadcrumbLockerAction SourceChangedAction;

		private BreadcrumbLockerAction RefreshDataAction;

		public BreadcrumbHistoryNodeCollection HistoryNodes;

		public IBreadcrumbDataAdapter DataAdapter { get; }

		public IBreadcrumbDataProvider DataProvider { get; private set; }

		public string PathSeparator
		{
			get
			{
				return pathSeparator;
			}
			set
			{
				SetPropertyHelper.Set(ref pathSeparator, value, delegate(string oldValue, string newValue)
				{
					OnPathSeparatorChanged(oldValue);
				});
			}
		}

		public bool AllowFillHistory
		{
			get
			{
				return allowFillHistory;
			}
			set
			{
				SetPropertyHelper.Set(ref allowFillHistory, value, OnAllowFillHistoryChanged);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable Source
		{
			get
			{
				return source;
			}
			set
			{
				SetPropertyHelper.Set(ref source, value, OnSourceChanged);
			}
		}

		public BreadcrumbRootNode RootNode { get; }

		public BreadcrumbNode SelectedNode { get; private set; }

		public string SelectedNodePath => GetPath(SelectedNode);

		public BreadcrumbNode NavigatedNode { get; set; }

		private SelectionChangedKind SelectionKind { get; set; }

		public string EmptySelectionText
		{
			get
			{
				return emptyItemText;
			}
			set
			{
				SetPropertyHelper.Set(ref emptyItemText, value, OnEmptyItemTextChanged);
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmptySelection => SelectedNode is BreadcrumbRootNode;

		private BreadcrumbLocker UpdateLocker { get; }

		public event EventHandler<HistoryChangingEventArgs> HistoryChanging;

		public BreadcrumbDataController(IBreadcrumbDataAdapter dataAdapter, string separator, bool allowFillHistory)
		{
			HistoryNodes = new BreadcrumbHistoryNodeCollection();
			AllowFillHistory = allowFillHistory;
			PathSeparator = separator;
			DataAdapter = dataAdapter;
			DataAdapter.PropertyChanged += OnDataAdapterPropertyChanged;
			UpdateLocker = new BreadcrumbLocker();
			DataAdapterPropertyChangedAction = CreateUpdateAction(UpdateDataProvider, 2);
			SourceChangedAction = CreateUpdateAction(delegate
			{
				DataProvider.OriginSource = Source;
			}, 1);
			RefreshDataAction = CreateUpdateAction(delegate
			{
				DataProvider.RefreshData();
			}, 0);
			UpdateDataProvider();
			RootNode = new BreadcrumbRootNode(this);
			SelectEmptyNode();
		}

		private BreadcrumbLockerAction CreateUpdateAction(Action action, int weight)
		{
			return new BreadcrumbLockerAction(delegate
			{
				action();
				UpdateNodes();
			}, weight);
		}

		private void OnAllowFillHistoryChanged()
		{
			if (!AllowFillHistory)
			{
				ClearHistory();
			}
		}

		private void OnPathSeparatorChanged(string oldSeparator)
		{
			UpdateHistory(oldSeparator);
		}

		private void OnDataAdapterPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateLocker.DoOrPostpone(DataAdapterPropertyChangedAction);
		}

		private void OnSourceChanged()
		{
			UpdateLocker.DoOrPostpone(SourceChangedAction);
		}

		private void OnEmptyItemTextChanged()
		{
			if (IsEmptySelection)
			{
				SelectedNode.UpdateProperty(UpdateNodeProperty.Text);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateNodes()
		{
			TryClearHistory();
			RootNode.UpdateProperty(UpdateNodeProperty.Children);
			RestoreSelection();
			NavigatedNode = null;
		}

		private void RestoreSelection()
		{
			if (IsEmptySelection)
			{
				SelectEmptyNode();
				return;
			}
			switch (SelectionKind)
			{
			case SelectionChangedKind.Item:
				SelectItem(SelectedNode.Item);
				break;
			case SelectionChangedKind.Items:
				SelectItems(from x in GetNodesPath(SelectedNode)
					select x.Item);
				break;
			default:
				throw new Exception("SelectionChangedKind");
			}
		}

		public void BeginDataInit()
		{
			UpdateLocker.Lock();
		}

		public void EndDataInit()
		{
			UpdateLocker.Unlock();
		}

		public void RefreshData()
		{
			UpdateLocker.DoOrPostpone(RefreshDataAction);
		}

		private void UpdateDataProvider()
		{
			DataProvider?.Destroy();
			DataProvider = CreateDataProvider();
		}

		private IBreadcrumbDataProvider CreateDataProvider()
		{
			if (DataAdapter.ChildSelector != null || DataAdapter.ChildMember != null)
			{
				return new BreadcrumbHierarchyDataProvider(this, DataAdapter.ParentMember, DataAdapter.GetHierarchyChildrenAccessor());
			}
			if (DataAdapter.ParentMember != null)
			{
				return new BreadcrumbSelfReferenceDataProvider(this, DataAdapter.KeyMember, DataAdapter.ParentMember);
			}
			return new BreadcrumbPlainListDataProvider(this);
		}

		public void SelectItem(object item)
		{
			UpdateSelection(FindItem(item), SelectionChangedKind.Item, BreadcrumbHistoryChangingReason.SelectItem);
		}

		public void SelectNode(BreadcrumbNode node, BreadcrumbHistoryChangingReason reason = BreadcrumbHistoryChangingReason.SelectNode)
		{
			UpdateSelection(node, SelectionChangedKind.Item, reason);
		}

		public void SelectItems(IEnumerable<object> items)
		{
			UpdateSelection(FindItems(items), SelectionChangedKind.Items, BreadcrumbHistoryChangingReason.SelectItems);
		}

		public void SelectPath(string path)
		{
			string[] path2 = SplitPath(path, PathSeparator, ignoreLastSeparator: true);
			BreadcrumbNode breadcrumbNode = QueryPath(path2);
			if (breadcrumbNode != null)
			{
				UpdateSelection(breadcrumbNode, SelectionChangedKind.Items, BreadcrumbHistoryChangingReason.SelectPath);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateSelection(FindNode(path2), SelectionChangedKind.Item, BreadcrumbHistoryChangingReason.SelectPath);
			}
		}

		private void SelectEmptyNode()
		{
			UpdateSelection(null, SelectionChangedKind.Item, BreadcrumbHistoryChangingReason.SelectNode);
		}

		private void UpdateSelection(BreadcrumbNode selectedNode, SelectionChangedKind kind, BreadcrumbHistoryChangingReason reason)
		{
			SelectedNode = selectedNode ?? GetEmptySelectionNode();
			SelectionKind = kind;
			AddSelectedNodeToHistory(reason);
		}

		public ReadOnlyCollection<BreadcrumbPathNode> Navigate(string path)
		{
			string[] array = SplitPath(path, PathSeparator, ignoreLastSeparator: false);
			string[] array2 = array.Take(array.Length - 1).ToArray();
			string filtrationString = array.LastOrDefault() ?? string.Empty;
			if (NavigatedNode == null || ShouldUpdateNavigatedNode(GetTextsPath(NavigatedNode).ToArray(), array2))
			{
				NavigatedNode = QueryPath(array2) ?? FindNode(array2) ?? ((!array2.Any()) ? RootNode : null);
			}
			Func<BreadcrumbNode, bool> condition = (BreadcrumbNode node) => node.Text.StartsWith(filtrationString, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			return (from x in NavigatedNode?.ChildNodes
				where condition(x)
				select ConvertToPathNode(x)).ToReadOnlyCollection();
		}

		private static bool ShouldUpdateNavigatedNode(string[] oldPath, string[] newPath)
		{
			if (oldPath.Length != newPath.Length)
			{
				return true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < newPath.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!CompareString(oldPath[i], newPath[i]))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private BreadcrumbPathNode ConvertToPathNode(BreadcrumbNode node)
		{
			return new BreadcrumbPathNode(node.Item, GetPath(node), node.Image, node.Text);
		}

		protected virtual string GetPath(BreadcrumbNode node)
		{
			return GetPath(node, PathSeparator);
		}

		private static string GetPath(BreadcrumbNode node, string separator)
		{
			return string.Join(separator, GetTextsPath(node));
		}

		private static IEnumerable<string> GetTextsPath(BreadcrumbNode node)
		{
			return GetNodesPath(node)?.Select((BreadcrumbNode x) => x.Text);
		}

		public BreadcrumbNode FindItem(object item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetNode(DataProvider.FindPath(item));
		}

		public BreadcrumbNode FindItems(IEnumerable items)
		{
			return GetNode(items);
		}

		public BreadcrumbNode FindPath(string path)
		{
			string[] path2 = SplitPath(path, PathSeparator, ignoreLastSeparator: true);
			return FindPath(path2);
		}

		public virtual BreadcrumbNode FindPath(IEnumerable<string> path)
		{
			return QueryPath(path) ?? FindNode(path);
		}

		private BreadcrumbNode QueryPath(IEnumerable<string> path)
		{
			return DataAdapter.QueryPath(path).With((IEnumerable x) => FindItems(x));
		}

		private BreadcrumbNode FindNode(IEnumerable<string> path)
		{
			if (path == null || !path.Any())
			{
				return null;
			}
			BreadcrumbNode breadcrumbNode = RootNode;
			foreach (string text in path)
			{
				BreadcrumbNode[] array = breadcrumbNode.ChildNodes.Where((BreadcrumbNode node) => CompareString(node.Text, text)).ToArray();
				if (!array.Any())
				{
					return null;
				}
				breadcrumbNode = array[0];
			}
			return breadcrumbNode;
		}

		private BreadcrumbNode GetNode(IEnumerable hierarchy)
		{
			if (hierarchy == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BreadcrumbNode breadcrumbNode = null;
			foreach (object item in hierarchy)
			{
				breadcrumbNode = CreateNode(breadcrumbNode, item);
			}
			return breadcrumbNode;
		}

		public BreadcrumbNode CreateNode(BreadcrumbNode parentNode, object item)
		{
			return new BreadcrumbNode(parentNode, item, this);
		}

		internal void NotifyItemPropertyChanged(BreadcrumbNode node, string propertyName)
		{
			if (CompareString(propertyName, DataAdapter.DisplayMember))
			{
				node.UpdateProperty(UpdateNodeProperty.Text);
			}
			else if (CompareString(propertyName, DataAdapter.ImageMember))
			{
				node.UpdateProperty(UpdateNodeProperty.Image);
			}
			else if (CompareString(propertyName, DataAdapter.HasChildMember))
			{
				node.UpdateProperty(UpdateNodeProperty.HasChildren);
			}
			else if (CompareString(propertyName, DataAdapter.ChildMember) || CompareString(propertyName, DataAdapter.ParentMember) || CompareString(propertyName, DataAdapter.KeyMember))
			{
				RefreshData();
			}
		}

		private void AddSelectedNodeToHistory(BreadcrumbHistoryChangingReason reason)
		{
			BreadcrumbHistoryNode node = ConvertToHistoryNode(SelectedNode);
			if (AllowFillHistory && !IsEmptySelection && ShouldChangingHistory(node, reason))
			{
				HistoryNodes.Add(node);
			}
		}

		private BreadcrumbHistoryNode ConvertToHistoryNode(BreadcrumbNode node)
		{
			BreadcrumbPathNode breadcrumbPathNode = ConvertToPathNode(node);
			return new BreadcrumbHistoryNode(breadcrumbPathNode.Item, breadcrumbPathNode.Path, breadcrumbPathNode.Image, breadcrumbPathNode.Text);
		}

		private void TryClearHistory()
		{
			if (HistoryNodes.Any() && ShouldChangingHistory(null, BreadcrumbHistoryChangingReason.Clear))
			{
				ClearHistory();
			}
		}

		public void ClearHistory()
		{
			HistoryNodes.Clear();
		}

		private void UpdateHistory(string oldSeparator)
		{
			HistoryNodes.UpdatePaths(oldSeparator, PathSeparator);
		}

		private bool ShouldChangingHistory(BreadcrumbHistoryNode node, BreadcrumbHistoryChangingReason reason)
		{
			HistoryChangingEventArgs e = new HistoryChangingEventArgs(this, node, reason);
			this.HistoryChanging?.Invoke(this, e);
			return !e.Cancel;
		}

		private BreadcrumbRootNode GetRootNode()
		{
			return new BreadcrumbRootNode(this);
		}

		private BreadcrumbNode GetEmptySelectionNode()
		{
			return RootNode;
		}

		private static string[] SplitPath(string path, string separator, bool ignoreLastSeparator)
		{
			if (path == null)
			{
				return EmptyArray<string>.Instance;
			}
			if (ignoreLastSeparator && path.EndsWith(separator))
			{
				path = path.Substring(0, path.Length - separator.Length);
			}
			return path.Split(separator.YieldIfNotNullToArray(), StringSplitOptions.None);
		}

		public static IEnumerable<BreadcrumbNode> GetNodesPath(BreadcrumbNode node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return LinqExtensions.Unfold(node, (BreadcrumbNode x) => x.ParentNode, (BreadcrumbNode x) => x == null).Reverse();
		}

		internal static bool CompareString(string a, string b)
		{
			return string.Equals(a, b, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
		}

		internal static IBindingList ExtractListSource(IEnumerable source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IList list = source as IList;
			if (list == null)
			{
				list = new EnumerableObservableWrapper<object>(source);
			}
			if (list is IBindingList)
			{
				return (IBindingList)list;
			}
			return (IBindingList)BindingListAdapterBase.CreateFromList(list, (ItemPropertyNotificationMode)0);
		}

		internal static bool IsEmptyCollection(IEnumerable<object> collection)
		{
			if (collection != null)
			{
				return !collection.Any();
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public interface IBreadcrumbDataAdapter
	{
		string KeyMember { get; }

		string ParentMember { get; }

		IChildSelector ChildSelector { get; }

		string ChildMember { get; }

		string ImageMember { get; }

		string DisplayMember { get; }

		string HasChildMember { get; }

		event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		string GetCustomDisplayText(object item);

		ImageSource GetCustomImage(object item);

		IEnumerable QueryPath(IEnumerable<string> path);
	}
	public delegate IEnumerable HierarchyChildrenAccessor(object item);
	public static class BreadCrumbDataAdapterExtension
	{
		public static ImageSource GetImage(this IBreadcrumbDataAdapter dataAdapter, object item)
		{
			ImageSource customImage = dataAdapter.GetCustomImage(item);
			return customImage ?? GetMemberValue(item, dataAdapter.ImageMember, (object value) => ImageEditStrategy.GetImageFromData(value));
		}

		public static string GetDisplayText(this IBreadcrumbDataAdapter dataAdapter, object item)
		{
			string customDisplayText = dataAdapter.GetCustomDisplayText(item);
			if (customDisplayText != null)
			{
				return customDisplayText;
			}
			if (dataAdapter.DisplayMember == null)
			{
				return item.ToString();
			}
			return GetMemberValue(item, dataAdapter.DisplayMember, (object value) => value?.ToString());
		}

		public static bool? HasChildren(this IBreadcrumbDataAdapter dataProvider, object item)
		{
			return GetMemberValue(item, dataProvider.HasChildMember, (object value) => value as bool?);
		}

		private static T GetMemberValue<T>(object item, string memberPath, Func<object, T> getValue)
		{
			return PropertyDescriptorHelper.TryGetMemberValue(item, memberPath).Match(getValue, default(T));
		}

		public static HierarchyChildrenAccessor GetHierarchyChildrenAccessor(this IBreadcrumbDataAdapter dataAdapter)
		{
			if (dataAdapter.ChildSelector != null)
			{
				return (object item) => dataAdapter.ChildSelector.SelectChildren(item) ?? EmptyArray<object>.Instance;
			}
			if (dataAdapter.ChildMember != null)
			{
				return delegate(object item)
				{
					IEnumerable memberValue = GetMemberValue(item, dataAdapter.ChildMember, (object value) => value as IEnumerable);
					return memberValue ?? EmptyArray<object>.Instance;
				};
			}
			return (object item) => EmptyArray<object>.Instance;
		}
	}
	public interface IBreadcrumbDataProvider
	{
		IEnumerable OriginSource { get; set; }

		IEnumerable<object> Roots { get; }

		IEnumerable<object> FindPath(object item);

		IEnumerable GetChildren(object item);

		void RefreshData();

		void Destroy();
	}
	public abstract class BreadcrumbBaseDataProvider : IBreadcrumbDataProvider
	{
		private IEnumerable originSource;

		private static ListChangedType[] IgnoredChangedTypes = new ListChangedType[3]
		{
			ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorAdded,
			ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorDeleted,
			ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged
		};

		protected BreadcrumbDataController Controller { get; }

		public IEnumerable OriginSource
		{
			get
			{
				return originSource;
			}
			set
			{
				SetPropertyHelper.Set(ref originSource, value ?? EmptyArray<object>.Instance, (Action)delegate
				{
					OnOriginSourceChanged();
				});
			}
		}

		private IBindingList SourceList { get; set; }

		public abstract IEnumerable<object> Roots { get; }

		public BreadcrumbBaseDataProvider(BreadcrumbDataController controller)
		{
			Controller = controller;
		}

		private void OnOriginSourceChanged()
		{
			DetachSourceListChanged();
			SourceList = BreadcrumbDataController.ExtractListSource(OriginSource);
			AttachSourceListChanged();
			OnOriginSourceChangedOverride();
		}

		private void AttachSourceListChanged()
		{
			if (SourceList != null)
			{
				SourceList.ListChanged += OnOriginListChanged;
			}
		}

		private void DetachSourceListChanged()
		{
			if (SourceList != null)
			{
				SourceList.ListChanged -= OnOriginListChanged;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnOriginSourceChangedOverride()
		{
			RefreshData();
		}

		private void OnOriginListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!IgnoredChangedTypes.Contains(e.ListChangedType))
			{
				OnOriginListChangedOverride();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnOriginListChangedOverride()
		{
			Controller.RefreshData();
		}

		public virtual void RefreshData()
		{
		}

		public abstract IEnumerable<object> FindPath(object item);

		public abstract IEnumerable GetChildren(object item);

		public void Destroy()
		{
			SourceList.ListChanged -= OnOriginListChanged;
		}
	}
	public class BreadcrumbSelfReferenceDataProvider : BreadcrumbBaseDataProvider
	{
		private Dictionary<object, List<object>> ChildrenMap;

		private Dictionary<object, object> ParentMap;

		private string KeyMember { get; }

		private string ParentMember { get; }

		private object[] RootsCollection { get; set; }

		public override IEnumerable<object> Roots => RootsCollection;

		public BreadcrumbSelfReferenceDataProvider(BreadcrumbDataController controller, string keyMember, string parentMember)
			: base(controller)
		{
			KeyMember = keyMember;
			ParentMember = parentMember;
			ChildrenMap = new Dictionary<object, List<object>>();
			ParentMap = new Dictionary<object, object>();
			base.OriginSource = controller.Source;
		}

		public override void RefreshData()
		{
			RefreshHierarchy();
			UpdateRoot();
		}

		private void RefreshHierarchy()
		{
			ChildrenMap.Clear();
			ParentMap.Clear();
			Func<object, object> selfReferenceAccessor = GetSelfReferenceAccessor(base.OriginSource, KeyMember, ParentMember);
			foreach (object item in base.OriginSource)
			{
				object obj = selfReferenceAccessor(item);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					ChildrenMap.GetOrAdd(obj, () => new List<object>()).Add(item);
				}
				ParentMap[item] = obj;
			}
		}

		private static Func<object, object> GetSelfReferenceAccessor(IEnumerable source, string keyMemberPath, string parentMemberPath)
		{
			Dictionary<object, object> keysMap = (from object x in source
				select Tuple.Create(GetKey(x, keyMemberPath), x)).ToDictionary((Tuple<object, object> x) => x.Item1, (Tuple<object, object> x) => x.Item2);
			return (object item) => GetParentKey(item, parentMemberPath).With((object x) => keysMap.GetValueOrDefault(x));
		}

		private static object GetKey(object item, string keyMember)
		{
			return PropertyDescriptorHelper.TryGetMemberValue(item, keyMember).Match((object x) => x, item) ?? item;
		}

		private static object GetParentKey(object item, string parentMember)
		{
			return PropertyDescriptorHelper.TryGetMemberValue(item, parentMember).GetValueOrDefault();
		}

		private void UpdateRoot()
		{
			RootsCollection = ChooseRoots(base.OriginSource, (object x) => ParentMap[x], (object x) => GetChildrenList(x));
		}

		private static object[] ChooseRoots(IEnumerable source, Func<object, object> getParent, Func<object, List<object>> getChildren)
		{
			HashSet<object> hashSet = new HashSet<object>(source.Cast<object>());
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			while (hashSet.Any())
			{
				object obj = hashSet.MaxBy((object x) => (getParent(x) != null) ? getChildren(x).Count : (2147483647L + (long)getChildren(x).Count));
				list.Add(obj);
				hashSet.ExceptWith(ExtractConnectedElements(obj, getParent, getChildren));
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static IEnumerable<object> ExtractConnectedElements(object root, Func<object, object> getParent, Func<object, IEnumerable<object>> getChildren)
		{
			Stack<object> stack = new Stack<object>();
			HashSet<object> viewedElements = new HashSet<object>();
			stack.Push(root);
			while (stack.Any())
			{
				object obj = stack.Pop();
				if (!viewedElements.Contains(obj))
				{
					viewedElements.Add(obj);
				}
				object obj2 = getParent(obj);
				if (obj2 != null && !viewedElements.Contains(obj))
				{
					stack.Push(obj2);
				}
				(from x in getChildren(obj)
					where !viewedElements.Contains(x)
					select x).ForEach(stack.Push);
			}
			return viewedElements.ToArray();
		}

		public override IEnumerable<object> FindPath(object item)
		{
			if (!ParentMap.ContainsKey(item))
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			object obj = item;
			while (obj != null && !list.Contains(obj))
			{
				list.Insert(0, obj);
				if (Roots.Contains(obj))
				{
					break;
				}
				obj = ParentMap[obj];
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override IEnumerable GetChildren(object item)
		{
			return GetChildrenList(item);
		}

		private List<object> GetChildrenList(object item)
		{
			return ChildrenMap.GetValueOrDefault(item) ?? new List<object>();
		}
	}
	public class BreadcrumbHierarchyDataProvider : BreadcrumbBaseDataProvider
	{
		private class TreeItem
		{
			public TreeItem Parent { get; }

			public object Item { get; }

			public bool IsChildItemsCreated { get; private set; }

			public IEnumerable<TreeItem> ChildItems { get; private set; }

			public TreeItem(TreeItem parent, object item)
			{
				Parent = parent;
				Item = item;
				IsChildItemsCreated = false;
			}

			public void CreateChildItems(IEnumerable childItems)
			{
				Collection<TreeItem> collection = new Collection<TreeItem>();
				foreach (object childItem in childItems)
				{
					collection.Add(new TreeItem(this, childItem));
				}
				ChildItems = collection;
				IsChildItemsCreated = true;
			}
		}

		private string ParentMember { get; }

		private HierarchyChildrenAccessor ChildrenAccessor { get; }

		private Collection<object> RootsCollection { get; }

		public override IEnumerable<object> Roots => RootsCollection;

		private TreeItem[] RootItems { get; set; }

		public BreadcrumbHierarchyDataProvider(BreadcrumbDataController controller, string parentMember, HierarchyChildrenAccessor childrenAccessor)
			: base(controller)
		{
			ParentMember = parentMember;
			ChildrenAccessor = childrenAccessor;
			RootsCollection = new Collection<object>();
			base.OriginSource = controller.Source;
		}

		public override void RefreshData()
		{
			RootsCollection.Clear();
			foreach (object item in base.OriginSource)
			{
				RootsCollection.Add(item);
			}
			RootItems = RootsCollection.Select((object x) => new TreeItem(null, x)).ToArray();
		}

		public override IEnumerable<object> FindPath(object item)
		{
			if (ParentMember != null)
			{
				return LinqExtensions.Unfold(item, (object x) => PropertyDescriptorHelper.TryGetMemberValue(x, ParentMember).GetValueOrDefault(), (object x) => x == null).Reverse();
			}
			IEnumerable<TreeItem> enumerable = GetRootItems();
			HashSet<TreeItem> cache = new HashSet<TreeItem>();
			while (enumerable.Any())
			{
				foreach (TreeItem item2 in enumerable)
				{
					if (object.Equals(item, item2.Item))
					{
						return (from x in LinqExtensions.Unfold(item2, (TreeItem x) => x.Parent, (TreeItem x) => x == null)
							select x.Item).Reverse();
					}
					if (!item2.IsChildItemsCreated)
					{
						item2.CreateChildItems(GetChildren(item2.Item));
					}
					cache.Add(item2);
				}
				enumerable = enumerable.SelectMany((TreeItem treeItem) => treeItem.ChildItems.Where((TreeItem childItem) => !cache.Contains(childItem))).ToArray();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private IEnumerable<TreeItem> GetRootItems()
		{
			if (RootItems == null)
			{
				RootItems = RootsCollection.Select((object x) => new TreeItem(null, x)).ToArray();
			}
			return RootItems;
		}

		public override IEnumerable GetChildren(object item)
		{
			return ChildrenAccessor(item);
		}
	}
	public class BreadcrumbPlainListDataProvider : BreadcrumbHierarchyDataProvider
	{
		public BreadcrumbPlainListDataProvider(BreadcrumbDataController controller)
			: base(controller, null, (object _) => EmptyArray<object>.Instance)
		{
		}
	}
	public class BreadcrumbLockerAction
	{
		public Action Action { get; }

		public int Weight { get; }

		public BreadcrumbLockerAction(Action action, int weight)
		{
			Action = action;
			Weight = weight;
		}
	}
	public class BreadcrumbLocker
	{
		private int lockCount;

		private BreadcrumbLockerAction LockedAction { get; set; }

		public bool IsLocked => lockCount > 0;

		public BreadcrumbLocker()
		{
			lockCount = 0;
		}

		public void Lock()
		{
			lockCount++;
		}

		public void Unlock()
		{
			lockCount--;
			if (!IsLocked)
			{
				DoIfPostponed();
			}
		}

		public void DoOrPostpone(BreadcrumbLockerAction action)
		{
			if (IsLocked)
			{
				if (LockedAction == null || action.Weight >= LockedAction.Weight)
				{
					LockedAction = action;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				action.Action();
			}
		}

		public void DoIfPostponed()
		{
			LockedAction?.Action();
			LockedAction = null;
		}
	}
	public static class PropertyDescriptorHelper
	{
		public class PropertyPathElement
		{
			public object PropertyObject { get; private set; }

			public PropertyDescriptor Property { get; private set; }

			public Option<object> PropertyValue { get; private set; }

			public bool HasValue => PropertyValue.HasValue;

			public PropertyPathElement(object propertyObject, string propertyName)
			{
				PropertyObject = propertyObject;
				Property = GetProperty(propertyObject, propertyName);
				PropertyValue = Property.WithOption((PropertyDescriptor x) => x.GetValue(propertyObject));
			}

			private PropertyDescriptor GetProperty(object propertyObject, string propertyName)
			{
				return TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(propertyObject)[propertyName];
			}
		}

		private static char PropertiesSeparator = '.';

		public static Option<object> TryGetMemberValue(object obj, string propertyPath)
		{
			if (obj == null || propertyPath == null)
			{
				return Option<object>.Empty;
			}
			return GetPropertyPathElement(obj, propertyPath).PropertyValue;
		}

		public static PropertyPathElement GetPropertyPathElement(object obj, string propertyPath)
		{
			string[] propertiesPath = GetPropertiesPath(propertyPath);
			PropertyPathElement seed = new PropertyPathElement(obj, propertiesPath.First());
			return propertiesPath.Skip(1).AggregateUntil(seed, (PropertyPathElement pathElement, string propertyName) => new PropertyPathElement(pathElement.PropertyValue.ToValue(), propertyName), (PropertyPathElement pathElement) => !pathElement.HasValue);
		}

		private static string[] GetPropertiesPath(string propertiesPath)
		{
			return propertiesPath.Split(PropertiesSeparator);
		}
	}

	public class BreadcrumbPathEdit : AutoSuggestEdit
	{
		public static readonly RoutedEvent EditCoreAssignedEvent;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty EditorLeftIndentProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RightButtonsWidthProperty;

		private FrameworkElement RightButtonsControl { get; set; }

		public double EditorLeftIndent
		{

			{
				return (double)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(EditorLeftIndentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(EditorLeftIndentProperty, (object)value);
			}

		public double RightButtonsWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(RightButtonsWidthProperty);

				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(RightButtonsWidthProperty, (object)value);

		public event EventHandler<RoutedEventArgs> EditCoreAssigned
		{

			{

			remove

		static BreadcrumbPathEdit()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BreadcrumbPathEdit>.New().Register<double>("EditorLeftIndent", ref EditorLeftIndentProperty, 0.0, (Action<BreadcrumbPathEdit>)delegate(BreadcrumbPathEdit d)
			{
				d.OnEditorLeftIndentChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<double>("RightButtonsWidth", ref RightButtonsWidthProperty, 0.0, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.OverrideMetadata(Control.IsTabStopProperty, (object)false, (Action<BreadcrumbPathEdit>)null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None);
			EditCoreAssignedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("EditCoreAssignedEvent", RoutingStrategy.Direct, typeof(EventHandler<RoutedEventArgs>), typeof(BreadcrumbPathEdit));
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			if (RightButtonsControl != null)
			{
				RightButtonsControl.SizeChanged -= OnRightButtonsControlSizeChanged;
			}
			if (RightButtonsControl != null)
			{
				RightButtonsControl.IsVisibleChanged -= OnRightButtonsControlIsVisibleChanged;
			}
			((TextEditBase)this).OnApplyTemplate();
			RightButtonsControl = ((FrameworkElement)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_RightButtons") as FrameworkElement;
			if (RightButtonsControl != null)
			{
				RightButtonsControl.SizeChanged += OnRightButtonsControlSizeChanged;
			}
			if (RightButtonsControl != null)
			{
				RightButtonsControl.IsVisibleChanged += OnRightButtonsControlIsVisibleChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnRightButtonsControlSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(RightButtonsWidthProperty, (object)RightButtonsControl.ActualWidth);
		}

		private void OnRightButtonsControlIsVisibleChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(RightButtonsWidthProperty, (object)RightButtonsControl.ActualWidth);
		}

		protected override bool CheckAllowLostKeyboardFocus()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override HitTestResult HitTestCore(PointHitTestParameters hitTestParameters)
		{
			return new PointHitTestResult((Visual)(object)this, hitTestParameters.HitPoint);
		}

		protected override void OnEditCoreAssigned()
		{
			((TextEdit)this).OnEditCoreAssigned();
			((UIElement)this).RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(EditCoreAssignedEvent));
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void OnEditorLeftIndentChanged()
		{
			((BaseEdit)this).EditCore.Margin = ThicknessHelper.ChangeValue(((BaseEdit)this).EditCore.Margin, (Side)0, EditorLeftIndent);
		}
	}

		static BreadcrumbItemsControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BreadcrumbItemsControl>.New().OverrideMetadata(Control.IsTabStopProperty, (object)false, (Action<BreadcrumbItemsControl>)null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None).OverrideMetadata<Thickness>(FrameworkElement.MarginProperty, (Action<BreadcrumbItemsControl>)delegate
			{

				.Register<DataTemplate>("SubItemTemplate", ref SubItemTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("SubItemTemplateSelector", ref SubItemTemplateSelectorProperty, (DataTemplateSelector)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("ShowBorder", ref ShowBorderProperty, true, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("PopupHeight", ref PopupHeightProperty, double.NaN, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("PopupMinHeight", ref PopupMinHeightProperty, 0.0, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("PopupMaxHeight", ref PopupMaxHeightProperty, double.PositiveInfinity, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("PopupWidth", ref PopupWidthProperty, double.NaN, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("PopupMinWidth", ref PopupMinWidthProperty, 0.0, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("PopupMaxWidth", ref PopupMaxWidthProperty, double.PositiveInfinity, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("ShowPredefinedItemsSource", ref ShowPredefinedItemsSourceProperty, true, (Action<BreadcrumbItemsControl>)delegate(BreadcrumbItemsControl d)
				{
					d.OnShowPredefinedItemsSourceChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<IEnumerable<object>>("PredefinedItemsSource", ref PredefinedItemsSourceProperty, (IEnumerable<object>)null, (Action<BreadcrumbItemsControl>)delegate(BreadcrumbItemsControl d)
				{

				.Register<double>("RightIndent", ref RightIndentProperty, 0.0, (Action<BreadcrumbItemsControl>)delegate(BreadcrumbItemsControl d)
				{

				.RegisterReadOnly<ReadOnlyCollection<object>>("CollapsedSource", ref CollapsedSourcePropertyKey, ref CollapsedSourceProperty, (ReadOnlyCollection<object>)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)

		private void OnCollapsedCrumbsCountChanged()
		{
			CollapsedSource = base.ItemsSource?.Cast<object>().Take(CollapsedCrumbsCount).ToReadOnlyCollection();
			RotateArrow = ShouldRotateArrow(this);
			UpdateRootItemVisibility();
		}

		private void OnShowPredefinedItemsSourceChanged()
		{
			UpdateRootItemVisibility();
		}

		private void OnPredefinedItemsSourceChanged()
		{
			UpdateRootItemVisibility();
		}

		private void UpdateRootItemVisibility()
		{
			if (PartRootItem != null)
			{
				PartRootItem.Visibility = ((CollapsedCrumbsCount <= 0 && (!ShowPredefinedItemsSource || BreadcrumbDataController.IsEmptyCollection(PredefinedItemsSource))) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		private void OnRightIndentChanged()
		{
			CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.MarginProperty);
		}

		private Thickness CoerceMargin(Thickness value)
		{
			if (!(RightIndent > 0.0))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return ThicknessHelper.ChangeValue(value, (Side)2, value.Right + RightIndent + 8.0);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			PartRootItem.Do(delegate(BreadcrumbRootItem x)
			{
				x.IsPopupOpenChanged -= OnItemIsPopupOpenChanged;
				x.MouseEnter -= OnItemMouseEnter;
			});
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartItemsHost = GetTemplateChild("PART_ItemsHost") as BreadcrumbItemsPanel;
			PartItemsHost.ShouldCollapseFirstItem = ShouldCollapseFirstItem;
			PartRootItem = GetTemplateChild("PART_RootItem") as BreadcrumbRootItem;
			PartRootItem.Do(delegate(BreadcrumbRootItem x)
			{
				x.IsPopupOpenChanged += OnItemIsPopupOpenChanged;
				x.MouseEnter += OnItemMouseEnter;
			});
			UpdateRootItemVisibility();
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new BreadcrumbItem();
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is BreadcrumbItem;
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			(element as BreadcrumbItem).Do(delegate(BreadcrumbItem x)
			{
				x.IsPopupOpenChanged += OnItemIsPopupOpenChanged;
				x.MouseEnter += OnItemMouseEnter;
				x.SetBinding(BreadcrumbItem.ButtonContentTemplateProperty, new Binding("ItemTemplate")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				x.SetBinding(BreadcrumbItem.ButtonContentTemplateSelectorProperty, new Binding("ItemTemplateSelector")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				x.SetBinding(BreadcrumbItem.SubItemsProperty, new Binding("ChildNodes")
				{
					Source = item
				});
				x.SetBinding(BreadcrumbItem.PopupHeightProperty, new Binding("PopupHeight")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				x.SetBinding(BreadcrumbItem.PopupMinHeightProperty, new Binding("PopupMinHeight")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				x.SetBinding(BreadcrumbItem.PopupMaxHeightProperty, new Binding("PopupMaxHeight")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				x.SetBinding(BreadcrumbItem.PopupWidthProperty, new Binding("PopupWidth")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				x.SetBinding(BreadcrumbItem.PopupMinWidthProperty, new Binding("PopupMinWidth")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				x.SetBinding(BreadcrumbItem.PopupMaxWidthProperty, new Binding("PopupMaxWidth")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				x.SetBinding(BreadcrumbItem.ShowArrowProperty, new Binding("HasChildNodes")
				{
					Source = item
				});
				x.SetBinding(BreadcrumbItem.SubItemTemplateProperty, new Binding("SubItemTemplate")
				{
					Source = this
				});
				x.SetBinding(BreadcrumbItem.SubItemTemplateSelectorProperty, new Binding("SubItemTemplateSelector")
				{
					Source = this
				});
			});
		}

		private void OnItemMouseEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			BreadcrumbItem item = sender as BreadcrumbItem;
			if (item != null && FocusedItem != null && item != FocusedItem)
			{
				itemPopupLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					FocusedItem.ClosePopup();
					item.OpenPopup();
					FocusedItem = item;
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnItemIsPopupOpenChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!itemPopupLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				FocusedItem = (((bool)e.NewValue) ? (sender as BreadcrumbItem) : null);
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			(element as BreadcrumbItem).Do(delegate(BreadcrumbItem x)
			{
				x.IsPopupOpenChanged -= OnItemIsPopupOpenChanged;
				x.MouseEnter -= OnItemMouseEnter;
				BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(x);
			});
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			while (CollapsedCrumbsCount != PartItemsHost.CollapsedCrumbsCount)
			{
				bool flag = CollapsedCrumbsCount == 0 && PartItemsHost.CollapsedCrumbsCount != 0;
				bool flag2 = CollapsedCrumbsCount != 0 && PartItemsHost.CollapsedCrumbsCount == 0;
				CollapsedCrumbsCount = PartItemsHost.CollapsedCrumbsCount;
				if (flag || flag2)
				{
					PartRootItem.InvalidateMeasure();
					PartItemsHost.InvalidateMeasure();
					result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

	public class BreadcrumbItemsPanel : Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty CollapsedCrumbsCountProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey CollapsedCrumbsCountPropertyKey;

		public int CollapsedCrumbsCount
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(CollapsedCrumbsCountProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(CollapsedCrumbsCountPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public Func<UIElementCollection, bool> ShouldCollapseFirstItem { get; set; } = (UIElementCollection children) => false;

		private int SkipCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ShouldCollapseFirstItem(base.Children))
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		static BreadcrumbItemsPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BreadcrumbItemsPanel>.New().RegisterReadOnly<int>("CollapsedCrumbsCount", ref CollapsedCrumbsCountPropertyKey, ref CollapsedCrumbsCountProperty, 0, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = SkipCount; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = base.Children[i];
				Rect finalRect = default(Rect);
				if (i >= CollapsedCrumbsCount)
				{
					finalRect = new Rect(num, 0.0, uIElement.DesiredSize.Width, finalSize.Height);
					num += uIElement.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
				uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (base.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			}
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(availableSize);
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			CollapsedCrumbsCount = 0;
			for (int num2 = base.Children.Count - 1; num2 >= SkipCount; num2--)
			{
				if (num + base.Children[num2].DesiredSize.Width > availableSize.Width)
				{
					CollapsedCrumbsCount = num2 + 1;
					break;
				}
				num += base.Children[num2].DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			CollapsedCrumbsCount += SkipCount;
			double height = base.Children.OfType<UIElement>().Max((UIElement x) => x.DesiredSize.Height);
			return new System.Windows.Size(num, height);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ClickableButton : Control
	{
		public static readonly RoutedEvent ClickEvent;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsPressedProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsPressedPropertyKey;

		public bool IsPressed
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsPressedProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(IsPressedPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public event RoutedEventHandler Click
		{
			add
			{
				AddHandler(ClickEvent, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				RemoveHandler(ClickEvent, value);
			}
		}

		static ClickableButton()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ClickableButton>.New().RegisterReadOnly<bool>("IsPressed", ref IsPressedPropertyKey, ref IsPressedProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
			ClickEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Click", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(BreadcrumbButton));
		}

		protected override void OnLostMouseCapture(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			SetIsPressed(pressed: false);
			base.OnLostMouseCapture(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			ProcessMouseLeftButtonDown(() => GetIsMousePressed(e));
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			ProcessMouseLeftButtonUp();
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			ProcessMouseMove(e);
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateIsPressed()
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), base.RenderSize);
			if (rect.Contains(Mouse.GetPosition(this)))
			{
				if (!IsPressed)
				{
					SetIsPressed();
				}
			}
			else if (IsPressed)
			{
				SetIsPressed(pressed: false);
			}
		}

		private bool GetIsMousePressed(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			return (e as MouseButtonEventArgs).Return((MouseButtonEventArgs x) => x.ButtonState == MouseButtonState.Pressed, () => Mouse.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed);
		}

		private void ProcessMouseLeftButtonDown(Func<bool> getIsPressed)
		{
			if (!getIsPressed())
			{
				return;
			}
			CaptureMouse();
			if (base.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				bool flag = getIsPressed();
				if (flag && !IsPressed)
				{
					SetIsPressed();
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					ReleaseMouseCapture();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessMouseLeftButtonUp()
		{
			bool isPressed = IsPressed;
			if (base.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				ReleaseMouseCapture();
			}
			SetIsPressed(pressed: false);
			if (isPressed)
			{
				RaiseClickEvent();
			}
		}

		private void ProcessMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (GetIsMousePressed(e) && base.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
				UpdateIsPressed();
			}
		}

		private void RaiseClickEvent()
		{
			RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(ClickEvent, this));
		}

		private void SetIsPressed(bool pressed = true)
		{
			if (pressed)
			{
				SetValue(IsPressedPropertyKey, pressed);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(IsPressedPropertyKey);
			}
		}
	}
	public class NegativeThicknessConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Thickness thickness = (Thickness)value;
			return new Thickness(0.0 - thickness.Left, 0.0 - thickness.Top, 0.0 - thickness.Right, 0.0 - thickness.Bottom);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class BooleanToVisibilityConverterExtension : IValueConverter
	{
		public bool Invert { get; set; }

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Visibility visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			if (value == null)
			{
				return (!Invert) ? visibility : Visibility.Visible;
			}
			if ((bool)value)
			{
				return Invert ? visibility : Visibility.Visible;
			}
			return (!Invert) ? visibility : Visibility.Visible;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Visibility visibility = (Visibility)value;
			if (visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return Invert;
			}
			return !Invert;
		}
	}
	public class AddWithParameterConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return (int)value + int.Parse(parameter.ToString());
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class ReversibleStepProgressBarPanel : Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ReverseOrderProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty OffsetProperty;

		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Orientation)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double Offset
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(OffsetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OffsetProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool ReverseOrder
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ReverseOrderProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ReverseOrderProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static ReversibleStepProgressBarPanel()
		{
			OrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Orientation", typeof(Orientation), typeof(ReversibleStepProgressBarPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(Orientation.Horizontal, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
			OffsetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Offset", typeof(double), typeof(ReversibleStepProgressBarPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
			ReverseOrderProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ReverseOrder", typeof(bool), typeof(ReversibleStepProgressBarPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsArrange));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeSize)
		{
			if (base.InternalChildren.Count == 0)
			{
				return default(System.Windows.Size);
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
			foreach (UIElement internalChild in base.InternalChildren)
			{
				if (internalChild.DesiredSize.Width > size.Width)
				{
					size.Width = internalChild.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
				if (internalChild.DesiredSize.Height > size.Height)
				{
					size.Height = internalChild.DesiredSize.Height;
				}
			}
			IEnumerable<UIElement> enumerable = (ReverseOrder ? base.InternalChildren.Cast<UIElement>().Reverse() : base.InternalChildren.Cast<UIElement>());
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (UIElement item in enumerable)
			{
				item.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(num, num2), size));
				if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					num += size.Width + Offset;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 += size.Height + Offset;
				}
			}
			int num3 = ((Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal) ? 1 : base.InternalChildren.Count);
			int num4 = ((Orientation != Orientation.Vertical) ? 1 : base.InternalChildren.Count);
			double width = size.Width * (double)num3 + Offset * (double)(num3 - 1);
			double height = size.Height * (double)num4 + Offset * (double)(num4 - 1);
			return new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (base.InternalChildren.Count == 0)
			{
				return default(System.Windows.Size);
			}
			System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
			foreach (UIElement internalChild in base.InternalChildren)
			{
				internalChild.Measure(constraint);
				size.Width = Math.Max(size.Width, internalChild.DesiredSize.Width);
				size.Height = Math.Max(size.Height, internalChild.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			int num = ((Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal) ? 1 : base.InternalChildren.Count);
			int num2 = ((Orientation != Orientation.Vertical) ? 1 : base.InternalChildren.Count);
			double width = size.Width * (double)num + Offset * (double)(num - 1);
			double height = size.Height * (double)num2 + Offset * (double)(num2 - 1);
			return new System.Windows.Size(width, height);
		}
	}
}
